comments: alan’s apartment is stunning! it is a total oasis in the east village so you get the best of both worlds - comfort, peace and space inside and life, fun and entertainment on the doorstep. we found it easy to get everywhere, using the subway (only minutes away) the citi-bikes (there’s a drop off stand round the corner) and walking! every where you turn there is something to do or see - and when you’re ready for a rest, alan’s apartment is the perfect retreat. to be honest, because alan is so quick and clear in his communication, i was expecting it to be lovely. however, after spending 5 days here, it was even better. inside, there is a homely but super stylish open living space with fabulous artwork everywhere. the bed is very comfortable and the kitchen is amazingly spec’d to rustle up breakfast or cook dinner from scratch. the closet is wonderfully spacious (i would love something as roomy as this at home!) and the bathrooms are warm, with soft towels and high specification shower and fixtures. we really couldn’t imagine a better place to base yourself to get the most out of being in nyc. if you want to feel what it’s like to ‘live’ here and feel like a local and enjoy all the creature comforts of a proper home, come and stay here. we feel delighted to have discovered it, and can’t wait to stay again when we return to this awesome city.
kiriko is very nice and welcome. a good experience.
great stay would love to stay again.

back in australia after staying with florian and anna. anna met me on arrival and outlined all i needed to know about apartment and the area. they are a lovely ny artistic couple who made me feel welcome in their apartment. luckily air conditioning in my room made the 38deg days more comfortable. easy access to m&l trains. food shopping nearby and florian and anna’s suggestion of the french patisserie was most welcome. the area is a little noisy but that’s probably just ny. would definitely recommend these hosts.

apartment is very clean and comfortable. looks just like the pictures. shower is fantastic - two shower heads, good water pressure, and heats up quickly. bed and couch both comfortable. apple tv with netflix and fast wifi. it is a 3rd floor walk up but pretty standard for nyc. neighbourhood is great. lots of restaurants on lenox, and pharmacy and shopping close by on 125th. steps away from the subway (2/3 express train) so easy to move around the city. felt very safe in area as solo traveler.
jeniffer was the best. this was my first time in an airbnb and i was a bit anxious. i really am grateful i was that she was able to extend my stay on such last notice was awesome
great value and location for our needs. neighborhood is very quiet and safe. definitely recommend.
she was just great would book again
stayed for a weekend with our family of 5. it’s a great location, easily walkable to many attractions and the perfect size for a family!
great place and location!

erica place is good for public transportation very close subway and bus. j train just 1 minute q56 bus available 24 hours. very safe place. always we back late night no problem. supper market delly london mart shops very close. lots of free parking their. we enjoy her place.i wish her success in airbnb.

i loved my stay at mary's! this was my first solo airbnb booking, and i am so grateful to have found this gem. the room was perfect - comfortable, clean, spacious, functional, and peaceful, flooded with natural light on a sunny day. mary is a warm, wonderful host. her home exhibits interesting books and art. i felt incredibly safe, and the location is excellent to explore the best of brooklyn! thank you, mary, and it was so wonderful to meet you!
clean affordable space in a great area of brooklyn. thanks mary!

the apartment was super cute in a really great neighborhood. we saw sylvia walking their dog when we got there and stopped to say hi. she was very kind and made sure we were settled in. wish we could've stayed longer to enjoy the place more!

this was my second stay at michael’s place. it is as described. it was myself and my young daughter so we stayed in the back room together and the noise from the neighbors (upstairs) we a bit much. it did keep us up. we were able to hear the toilet flushing and children playing. i don’t recall this noise in the room towards the front of the home. this is by no way any fault of the host but something for guest to be mindful of. the property is well maintained and comfortable. it was unfortunately no wash clothes in the property but other then these two hiccups no complaints and a great stay and overall convenient area. parking was never an issue while the property was walking distance to several train stations.

we spent a week here in new york city for my kids’ spring break, and the location was perfect—close to everything we wanted to do. although there were a few cleanliness issues upon arrival, the staff was proactive, responsive, and worked quickly to address everything.

amazing host and beautiful, spacious house. staying at tony's was a great decision. location is very convenient, with a very quiet neighnorhood and close to two subway stations. perfect place to stay when in nyc.

such a fantastic place to stay. highly recommended. big and beautiful space in an awesome location. we stayed with our toddler and it worked out so well! and great, speedy communication from host. thank you!

alan’s apartment is super clean, convenient, and has everything a guest would need. alan and his wife are very friendly, responsive, and helpful. the location is close to central park and several markets. i highly recommend the place.
incredible apparment ..!!! million times better than despcripted. very very very quiet ..... monica best host ever. thank you very much ..!!
great place to stay.

christopher’s brooklyn property was so perfect. so spacious, so neat and clean, and everything we needed for our 8 nights in ny. brooklyn neighbourhood was great, we felt safe at all times and enjoyed some local bars and dining. and the chilled bottle of wine after a long flight delay really hit the spot !!!!!

i can't add much to what other people have already said. the apartment was beautiful, comfortable and well furnished. maribel was a thoughtful host, providing breakfast food and a bottle of wine to get you started. it was very easy to self check in.
very clean and cozy place. the location is amazing with everything close by. the host was very good with communication and the whole check-in process was fast and simple.

me and my friends really enjoyed staying at this place. the building is beautiful the room is very spacious and the windows bring in great natural light. the host are also very helpful and reply quickly.
lilia’s place is amazing, so clean and everything is well organized. we stayed for 10 days and she prepared breakfast on the last day... she is so sweet and thoughtful.
we had a wonderful stay in brooklyn at hadiza’s place. she was kind and very communicative leading up to our stay and during. the place was clean, had all the amenities, and was in a great location.
great for travelers going to or coming from the airport

incredible stay! i used to live in the neighborhood, and was so delighted that my partner and i got to stay in this cozy spot when i was back in new york. the place is beautiful, bright, and clean! would love to stay again if i’m back in town.
the apartment was clean, great location, close to the metro, great communication

karen is really nice! just follow her rules and there will be no complaints. very welcoming apartment, she gives you snacks to start you off. she responds fast and doesn’t bother you at all. apartment is spacious. bathroom is really nice. there is a tv in the living room and in two of the bedrooms. thank you karen!

the accommodation was absolutely perfect. the city view was so amazing that we canceled our observation deck reservation. it was even better than the photos, and we enjoyed the night view with our child until dawn. the size was just right for three people. the security was great, and the location was ideal. it took about 30 minutes to walk to times square at our 5-year-old's pace. the subway was very close, and koreatown was nearby as well. there was also a grocery store nearby, which made it easy to cook our own meals. i highly recommend this place—it was flawless.

i spoke mainly with lisa and she went above and beyond. i had family coming from out of the country and needed a dependable and comfortable place for them to stay. they absolutely loved the place and everything that was promised was executed. anytime i had to contact lisa she responded quickly. my family was so impressed and comfortable with their stay. i’ll recommend lisa and james’ place again 100%!

i was 7 nigths in lillian's apartment. the place is very close to the subway and it takes 15 mins to reach manhattan, so it's very convenient. the building is a little old and there's no elevator (4th floor walk-up) but the neighborhood is very quiet and safe. moreover, there are kinds of shops nearby, fruit shop, restaurants, coffes and 2 supermarket 24h. lillian was very friendly, we met her just once the night of our arrival but we kept in touch by phone during our stay and she was always kind and helpful.

jaleh and her daughter are extremely friendly and hospitable. their apartment is only 3 blocks away from central park. if you are looking for basic accommodation in an extremely attractive part of ny, you are at the right address and in the right hands.
great stay, appreciate the last minute booking.
this was a great location and ha was super great at communication!
great host and great place to stay at in nyc!

camilla's apartment is so fun and funky. it's cozy and comfortable and i highly enjoyed my stay. camilla was communicative and accommodating. appreciate how convenient it was to the l train, but be aware that it is a fourth floor walk up!
anil was super sweet and helpful during our stay. anytime i had a question she was very responsive during my time there.
very clean space! great neighborhood! great stay!

this was a much better experience than the last place i stayed in nyc. communication was great, and the location is one of my favorites in the city. the apartment itself was clean, and comfortable. i wound up extending my stay for 4 extra weeks. any issue i had over 3 months was promptly dealt with. this is a great value for the area, and i will definitely consider staying again when i am back in the area.
gregory's place is a great stay! very easy to get around the city, and a very cool space with great hospitality.

4 of us stayed at drica's adorable les apartment for 9 days. we had a wonderful stay! we were comfortable, she gave us great tips on things to do and places to eat in nyc! the neighborhood was full of energy and so trendy! it was great to have a "home" to come back to at the end of a long day in the city! thank you drica for being a wonderful host and sharing your home and city with us!!

second time at rob’s place. beautiful tree lined street in terrific neighborhood in brooklyn. so many easy places within a short walk. in our case, kids and grandkids a 12 minute walk. you feel like you live in brooklyn, not a tourist. rob is very responsive to guest’s needs. will stay again.

i really loved my stay at the studio in hell's kitchen! the location is so close to public transit, and walking distance from some great restaurants. easy to rent a citibike and ride along the hudson river greenway, only blocks from your front door. the rent is high, but the building and unit are very clean, and the unit was recently remodeled with very nice kitchen and bathroom appliances and excellent lighting. the windows also let in a good amount of sunlight during the day. shai is a very friendly landlord and he is extremely prompt and responsive. would love to stay there again!

‘underpromise and overachieve’ - peter made sure that we knew exactly what to expect and it was all way more than we wished for. the house was new, clean and (indeed) stylish. we stayed with our two kids and it felt great to fix our own meals. the kitchen was great. the metro was close by and we were in a good spot to discover the whole of nyc; from a mets game in queens to downtown manhattan. also jfk was easy to reach. there is more to discover. and we would not hesitate to visit peter and tina and their boys again. they were very helpful and relaxed.

quick, excellent communication. comfy bed. ideal location for rest. 5 minutes to lga airport!! only thing was around 7:00am there was loud construction (sounded almost like an explosion?) that woke me up even with my earplugs in and noise machine running. still giving it 5 stars though. thank you! xo

our stay at linda's home was exceptional. they went above and beyond ensuring we had a comfortable stay, recommended a baby sitting service, milk in the refrigerator and even cookies! we felt like we were home while visiting their lovely city. we will definitely stay with them again when we are in town next. :)
steven’s place truly is a gem! the location is perfect, the place is spacious & comfortable and the layout is perfect! we would definitely stay there again!

the location is perfect—especially if you enjoy walking. i think it’s a great place to stay in midtown, as it’s very close to some of nyc’s most iconic landmarks. the reception staff were kind and helpful. as a solo traveler, i would definitely recommend staying here.
great room, busy bnb and great communication. great stay close to jfk.
great stay! perfect for a group!! beds were great! very clean! jason was a great host!

stayed with linda for a couple days and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. she was very accommodating and we felt right at home - was in a great location and an easy walk to all the great food in flushing and all the public transit we needed. would recommend to anyone!
very nice and small place for a stay on the weekend! host was very quick responding!
15min to nearest subway station. overall, nice and clean place

location was good, apartment was as described. we were able to access some sheets for the couch, it was not prepared at check in even though 3 were in our party. we were able to provide blanket and pillows from the main bedroom. fold out couch was not comfortable. kitchen was great for our needs, nice refrigerator, microwave, dishes, toaster and keurig. it was easy to communicate with tom and we enjoyed our stay.
very cozy spot not too far from subways that lead into the new york city. host communicated throughout the stay. the price was reasonable .

it’s a great location and accurate as described on the listing. i was able to take the train to the city right down the block. good internet so i was able to work also. completely happy for the whole stay. highly recommend if you want a privacy, convenience, and next to a great bagels 🥯 in the morning :)
everything was seamless! the place is super clean, comfy and in a unbeatable location. reka and her roomates are lovely. i had a wonderful stay, would def stay again!

we had the most amazing experience with razia. i have never had a more attentive and supportive host. we flew in with kids and had flight delays. by the time we reached the airbnb, it was so late, and razia offered to help us find parking. we had an issue with a blocked toilet and she left a party and was there within 15 minutes to help resolve the issue. she is incredibly friendly and really kind. i would definitely stay here again. her place is super clean and she has thought of everything! decor is functional and very well thought out. she is a dream to work with! will definitely stay here again.
kweson ‘s place is the best 👍 🔥🔥🔥🔥
thomas place was perfect! clean and easy to communicate. he had snacks, food and drinks at check in.

this place is great! great, great location, very close to subway station without hearing noise from the train. the bed is comfortable and the bathroom is very clean. we both like the design of cesar's living room with a lightening christmas tree. cesar and his wife are very friendly and welcoming. they waited till 10 p.m. to greet us because we arrived late. they warmly introduced the housing rules and neighborhood to us. i believe they will answer all the related questions about nyc etc., they are great person to communicate. i highly recommend this place to other people who visits nyc! i will stay here next time when i visit nyc.

yankees fans⚾️⚾️…. this is it! stop looking; you want to stay here! the location is an easy walk through an eclectic neighborhood. we came from the west coast to catch as many games as we could. the location was fantastic and we walked “home” every night and felt very safe. the loft is bright, airy, thoughtfully decorated, and very clean. check in and out was streamline and natalie and pierre accommodated us early on check-in. i highly recommend this rental!

staying at jasmine’s apartment was very comfortable . everything is very clean and cozy. moreover, jasmine is very guest friendly and take care about leaving some sweets and breakfast stuff. jasmine is very responsible and always happy to help you with some information about apartments or travelling. i truly recommend jasmine and her apartment !

great apartment in an ideal location. nicole was a great host, was fast at responding. apartment was clean and had all the amenities you'd want. be aware though that this is a ground floor apartment so the level of noise you hear from the street at night is much louder and pedestrians seem much closer to you than if you were higher up. would recommend staying here!

collen's place provides easy access to manhattan and a very cool upbeat neighborhood. as a family of four, the apartment more than suited our needs. if we were to visit new york again we would definitely look to arrange our stay with collen!

i spent 4 nights here & it was a great place to stay. ideal location, with many sightseeing spots within walking distance. nyc was in the middle of a snowy, cold winter but the flat is amazingly warm. michael was really helpful with things like guidebooks, advice, let me use cooking space & even got up at 4.30 am to help me downstairs with my luggage. i would stay here again.

nir is a great host. there was a tiny mixup in the beginning with airbnb but nir was quick to offer a solution. the apt is nice and in a convenient location. small but all a traveler of one like myself needs.
good location with easy access to the j train.

really nice place, exactly what i wanted for my stay in nyc only drawbacks: the man only has 2 forks didn't tell us that sometimes the water goes off when they're doing maintenance other than that the place was a very nice and so was darren
pervaiz had a truly beautiful and spacious place. i’ve also never seen so many towels and blankets in an airbnb! very comfy and great host. really helpful and accommodative with our whole trip!

this hotel was great. friendly, clean. easily accessible. awesome location to bryant park, time square, grand central and all of the other must see places when visiting the city. guest were polite and quiet. the guest services was helpful and nice as well.
good place to stay in flushing
excellent thank you so much

it was good house overall but i am from ohio and not sure how its in nyc but i felt the houses overall are the same where you have a lot of sound when u walk and all. which is not big of an issue but just wanted to be honest. i’ d give him 5 star for how he maintains the house and the looks.
very responsive, pro active and helpful. a wonderful place to stay in ny.
loved everything about this place and definitely loved everything about brooklyn it was whole vibe! will definitely be back!
we really enjoyed the neighborhood location.
ame’s beautiful and comfortable lodging was perfect for my whirlwind trip to nyc! the location is great for brooklyn and manhattan. i hope to be back!
cute hotel in the perfect location situated right between soho, little italy, and chinatown.

excellent lodging! super clean, very comfortable and fully equipped. stephen helped us at all times we needed and was always available. the location is good, one block from the subway. we recommend it!

what a nice apartment in wash. heights! a cozy and clean room provided by the kind host, susan, and her two charming kitties. i recommend her abode to anyone who is worthy of it; just don't book it when i need it! haha.
great great experience i loved it can’t wait to come back again

irene and her hudsband silvan are really nice and helpful. there was a snow storm attacked nyc the second day i came and my car were buried on the street parking spot. silvan helped me to dig the car out! so if you want a warm place to stay, you should definitly stay here in irene's.
the house is super clean and the shiny floor made me surprised. also, classic furniture are so pretty and the location is super convenient to get mta and to go to manhattan!

my mother and i needed this space very suddenly when her flight home was canceled last minute. irina kindly allowed us to book immediately and also offered an early check in. the space was very clean, but it is on the cramped side if you have large luggage. no one else was in the other units, which made using the kitchen easy- i can imagine it would be difficult if sharing with other parties. there was some noise overhead from the family upstairs (not a dealbreaker, but fyi) and also strong air freshener. the beds were comfy but a bit creaky. you can open the tiny windows if you want fresh air. irina followed up after our stay to wish us well, and while we didn’t meet her in person, seems like a very nice host :)
love the coffee and tea and the gaming cabinet

beautiful appartment in brooklyn in an up and coming neighbourhood with some brilliant bars (the way station for dr who fans) and restaurants (try the sunburnt calf aussie-asian resto on vanderbilt). we had a bit of an issue getting in as the front doorbell was broken but after texting demi she showed us to our flat which was great. good kitchen for making breakfast, a place to eat, good stereo and a huge light, bright bedroom). all very clean. would recommend.

this place was wonderful. the location is absolutely perfect, beautiful and right next to a variety of transportation options. bay ridge is for sure the place to stay! the bathroom and bedding were very clean, my only grievance for the entirety of the trip and stay—the floor and the blinds. the rug was dirty and needs to be replaced, and the blinds were broken. they still open and close, they just have some gaps and were unable to compress completely. otherwise, emily and saul were great, the location was spectacular, and i will absolutely come again!
nice apartment! highly recommended
best air bnb experience you could ask for. clean, helpful and nice. perfect spot to stay in brooklyn.

it was a cute place to stay. plenty of room. we weren't really crazy about the neighborhood but it wasn't bad. there were plenty of towels but no washcloths. gya does not want you to touch the a/c but she will turn it off whenever she wants. we only saw her once, but she would stomp through early in the morning while we were sleeping.

ted and diane really have a wonderful space here in the upper west side of manhattan. and they weren't kidding when they said "sun-drenched!" the studio is conveniently located near a trader joe's, cvs, train station, central park...as well as shake shack and magnolia's bakery ;). yummm. the space was extremely clean and cozy. i was in nyc for a 10 day business trip, and i don't think i any feeling could ever beat coming back to this place after a long, busy, and cold day outside. now that i'm back home in california, i don't think i'll ever forget my stay here. i already miss drinking coffee in the morning while looking out of those big sunny windows. ted and diane were really great as well! i felt like i really lucked out to have found such a great spot with great owners. they were incredibly responsive and helpful whenever i had questions, and besides that, were just really, really nice. highly, highly recommended!

best host imaginable!!! milan's apartment is in the best location, close to great shopping, restaurants & night life...the apartment itself is absolutely beautiful, spacious & very clean!!! i have been fortunate enough to travel to ny on four occasions and this is by far the best stay i have had. charles the doorman is awesome & will look after you. i will be back next year & hopefully get to stay again. highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great comfortable stay. milan is really easy going & an extraordinary host. he made me feel very welcome in his home.
we had a wonderful time in nyc. ana's place was comfortable, quiet, and in a fantastic location.
great just a great place

great location if you want to be near wall st/battery park. had a great week with family. 24 reception, easy check in and out. clean, well supplied. only downside was one bathroom for 5 adults but other than that perfect.

location is great, just a short walk from penn station and right near loads of sightseeing! check-in and out is uncomplicated. be aware that there are a couple of flights of very narrow stairs that you need to climb, which can be very challenging with luggage. it is winter and the heating works, but only comes on at odd times. so there are extended periods during the day and night when the apartment gets very cold. there is a small fan heater in the bedroom which helps a little. noise from the street is loud if you sleep on the sleeper-couch in the front. the bedroom is much quieter. there is no cable tv, and although the apple tv works, you cannot watch anything unless you have your own apple id (to even get into the tv in the first place) and then your own netflix/hulu/other id to watch anything on those channels. the only time we really wanted to watch tv was on our first afternoon/night in the apartment, and could not because we didn't have our own netflix etc. non-us guests be particularly aware of this. after endless texting with sherry, who tried to facilitate communication with the actual owner, we gave up and went to sleep. the next day sherry sent a temporary guest netflix account, but we were out all day and didn't get to try it out in the end. the orientation booklet has some info on how to work the fireplace (its a gas one, so know that you will smell gas when it is on!), and the coffee maker. there are enough towels and kitchen things. only thing we missed was a good orientation on how to use the taps in the shower (took lots of trial and error to figure it out as it was an unfamiliar system - even different to most other usa showers), and an extra blanket or duvet for the bed. sherry, who is very responsive, is the housekeeper, not the owner. so if any real issues arise, she gets in contact with the owner and this may be a long process of to and fro.
great place to stay in, very clean and comfortable! area is very relaxing, will definitely come back very soon! host was very helpful and honestly this was an excellent service.
absolutely loved it and would definitely would go back!!

a great apartment in a great location. we were a family of 7 and this place suited us perfectly. the description and pictures on the airbnb are accurate. the hosts were responsive and accurate in all their communications, and were helpful with local recommendations. it is difficult to appreciate just how big this apartment is - plenty of room for a few groups at the same time. heating system was good, plenty of hot water etc. as a location, this straddles soho, nolita, chinatown etc and was a great base from which to explore new york.
great location and value. close to everything and it was very clean. would definitely stay again.

earlene’s place was beautiful! she was also very responsive to any of my questions. quiet neighborhood, lots of food places around, ample amount of parking (especially for nyc), cozy stay, and more. staying here felt like home. would recommend and will definitely stay here again. thanks earlene!
the host and the place were fantastic. we were 4 adults and 2 kids. highly recommended!
clean and tidy home, smelled great, access to the backyard. very accommodating would stay again.
very nice place, and easy, flexible access. exactly what we needed
great location qnd great room!!
ronald is just a great heart

there were five of us in ny for a theater trip. we appreciated the roominess and comfort of this apartment. it was beautiful and nicely appointed and francesca was very responsive to our needs. the apartment is located 1/2 block from central park and an easy walk to many museums, the grocery store, drug stores and some fabulous restaurants and bars.

i have an infinite amount of compliments for my stay at margarita's apartment in manhattan! first, the location was perfect. so close to buses and subways. and might i add that a movie theater is directly across the street! for film lovers like me, this was serendipitous. second, the apartment (easy walk up to 2nd floor) felt like an oasis. lots of plants and decorations from all around the world. it was so comforting to return to the apartment after a long day's work. third, margarita was extremely communicative! at one point, she was worried about the weather dropping so low (my visit was in the winter) that she contacted her landlord to see what could be done. she and her landlord are saints, because they brought up a top-notch space heater for free! it honestly felt like a 5-star hotel at that point - even a 5-star hotel would not have brought up a heater that fast. fourth, i loved the apartment/location/margarita so much that i extended my stay two extra weeks! i will go again!
i enjoyed my stay—it was a nice space! it was nice to have the 2 a/c units.
in a nice calmer area but still very close to times square just less congested. located right by freedom tower and 9/11 memorial. hotel is very nice and clean better than i expected.

we thank our gracious hosts for a wonderful stay. they were helpful, communicative, supportive, welcoming, and flexible with check in and check out throughout our stay. surrounding area is pleasant to walk around with plenty of local boutiques, coffee shops, and local various small tasteful establishments for food and drink. our hosts were most of all thoughtful and sincere. we thank you.
fantastic! will now be my go to place for new york city - loved it. thank you for everything and for all your amenities. so amazing

i first will start with good; photos match; nice spacious room; safe neighborhood; stable wifi connection; roommate friendly and helpful; overall quiet experience; microwave and fridge accessible; con; room really cold despite heating measures (floor heater and bed warmer); sheets weren’t changed smelled strongly of cologne; pictures a bit misleading with kitchen and living room not available for use; no cable; i think the rate is a bit overpriced; must go downstairs for bathroom; i did catch a cold from my stay
amazing stay, great area, brooklyn was extremely helpful and accommodating to all our needs. highly recommend.
very nice and clean spot, the on-street parking was great as well!

staying at seth's was a fabulous and seamless experience. he was an excellent communicator, kindly left the keys at a convenient location, he and his partner were very welcoming, gracious and accommodating. their apartment was great and the bedroom was cozy, warm and everything i needed for my stay. plus the location seriously cannot be beat. all in all, it was terrific and i'd definitely stay there again.

the rooms are showing the wear and tear of guests. the showers are frustrating in that they flood the bathroom and make the floor wet - they have a drain in the middle of the room but still a pain when they remain wet while you get ready after a shower.
very happy with our stay. perfect location for a peaceful but well connected new york holiday. easy 5 stars!
great place with everything you might need for your nyc trip.
place was awesome as per usual. loved it!
a great little unit, we enjoyed our stay and the hosts were great.

firstly, antonio is a superb host. through no fault of his own the gas was shut off on our first day meaning that we could not shower when we arrived (the fault was due to one of the neighbours). antonio messaged ahead of time to let me know and made sure to gas was sorted as soon as possible the next day. and although we had not been very inconvenienced by this he refunded some of our money after we left, completely unprompted! the apartment itself was clean and well kept. we were each impressed at how quiet the neighbourhood was and were not disturbed at all. one thing to consider is that noise travels within the apartment so if anyone is watching tv while you are in bed next door you will hear it word for word. or perhaps my father is just losing his hearing... connections to downtown and midtown manhattan are easy and quick via two subways. however i don't believe antonio's assertion that you can be in the city within 20 minutes is correct. maybe if you were very lucky and all subway connections lined up perfectly, but really it's going to be more like 45 minutes. but this is still a great time to be in and out of manhattan for the price you are paying so do not let that dissuade you! i would say that the wifi was not very helpful. my laptop connected to it fine but it was not strong enough for any of the phones and tablets we brought. i guess this is as much a reflection of how small devices are not so good with these connections, but be aware that if you are planning on using iphones/ipads to plan trips out you may struggle. lastly i would say that any negatives i have written here are completely outweighed by the huge positives of having a helpful and communicative host and a cosy and quiet apartment. i have included the small negatives just so other people can have as much information as possible, but would heartily recommend this apartment to anyone. i know that when i next come back to brooklyn i will be firstly checking if this place is available.

the neighborhood is very nice. even though the house is very close to the airport, the noise is minimal. there are several buses nearby that can take you where you need to go (manhattan or to nearby subway stations). the house is very clean and just as described. maría and armando were good hosts so i would recommend staying here if you get a chance!

our stay in the shipping container was great. d&j were very welcoming and personable- made sure we had everything we needed and gave us a tour of the house which was really cool- i would describe it as "cozy industrial". we stayed in the basement area but there is a ground level window with a window unit in the sleeping room, and a window in the bathroom as well. there is a mini fridge and toaster oven, coffee maker in the little room off the sleeping room. also a tv and wifi. it was clean, cozy, and comfortable. we were able to hang out on the rooftop as well which was a real treat. also great dog- mormon. the location was very convenient for walking-both for exploring williamsburg and getting on the train to go into manhattan. we would definitely stay again.
a spacious spare room in a great location - easy walking access to the subway and the restaurants and shops in the area are great. the bed was cozy and the hosts were very clean and friendly.

perfect place , house looks exactly like the pictures . house is huge . great stay for a family with children . al was very friendly & helpful . smoothe check in process. look forward to being hosted by al in the future

tusnoda's place is an upstairs apartment right in the heart of manhattan just a half block away from the 28th street subway entrance and easily walkable to there, penn station, and a number of restaurants and stores in the area. while the apartment is a bit aged, it's clean and comfortable and housed 5 of us very well, including a fully-stocked kitchen. it is not the fanciest of places but for an apartment directly in the city, it's a steal for the price and the convenience! the check-in is a little non-conventional, having to hook up with one of his friends to get in and get the keys, but he was super nice and check-in was quick and easily done, so no problems there. we are grateful for such a great place at a great price to spend christmas in nyc!
i really enjoyed my stay here, good location and good value for money.

this is a very good place, the bed was clean and comfortable as was the shower. a good location near the subway to get to manhattan. we also went to the little restaurant/bar snowdonia down the street once for a simple meal which we also enjoyed.
great place to stay - clean and quiet
why don’t showers have doors anymore?

in the world of airbnb's, jennifer and grace's place is top notch! the space is clean, private, charming, and has lots of wonderful personal touches. the heater works in that chilly nyc winter. the beds are comfy. the shower has some stellar hot water. there are no bugs, no mice, and no window ac unit that you worry will fall out and bonk someone below. there are working appliances (!!) like a washer/dryer, a full fridge and oven, stocked kitchen supplies, and a dishwasher. in nyc, just having one of these is hard to find. having them all is a miracle. jennifer was my main contact on the app and was quick, kind, and open to my questions. this team really went above and beyond to make my stay comfy. i felt very safe and welcome here and can't wait to book again in the future!

i had a great stay!!! the staff was incredibly kind and welcoming, housekeeping was just as friendly and helpful! the location is honestly one of the best parts you're just minutes away from ecerything: times square, 5th avenue, and central park, super convenient to get around and explore the city. everything felt easy and comfortable during my stay, i truly enjoyed my time here, and since i definitely plan on coming back, i wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!

this is a very clean, cozy space in a great location, right in ridgewood and near brooklyn and easy subway access to manhattan. very quiet, walkable neighborhood and not far from restaurants and shops. excellent place!
great stay, will seek to come back here if / when i come back to nyc!

john and julie were super nice, and live in a beautiful apartment that's so great to stay in! they're clearly locals who are interested in getting to know travelers; i wish we had more than a day to appreciate their hospitality and chat over coffee

i highly recommend this apt. i felt at home there. the apt was comfortable, clean and had everything i needed. the location couldn’t be better, steps from all nice hell’s kitchen’s restaurants and cafes with easy access to subway. roger was a great host, very friendly and easy communication all the way through.
great place to stay! good location, nice vibe, friendly staff.
spacious accommodations near to subway.
they are always very friendly, responsive and they give great care and service. i appreciate them!
stacey's place is well located , clean and spacious. it fitted our group of 6. i will definitely recommend her place.

ron's place was convenient for my parents who was visiting nyc for about over a week. the place is adequate for 2 people with a kitchen and a bathroom. the location is very accessible to different parts of the city (close to 6 train), and the neighborhood has some decent restaurants. check-in was not smooth because my parents' flight was delayed and we had to get keys from ron. but he and his wife were very responsive and in communication with me the entire time. overall this was a good place for us.
great place very private and clean
adekunle was a very nice host , the whole space was clean and everything was accurate as is in the pictures . you won’t regret booking his space .
this residential was so spacious and beautiful! would definitely recommend. host is quick to respond and gives amazing detailed instructions. thank you so much!
great place to stay in nyc! everything was as expected and the host was super responsive to all my questions and very helpful.
great host. we are returning customers. thanks.

this airbnb was terrific, and she was a great host! i would definitely stay here again if i had another early flight to catch in the a.m. at jfk! the room was very clean for the night and had everything you needed to wake up in the morning to catch your flight.

sarah was a wonderful host! we felt welcome and secure staying with her. the rooms were very clean, spacious and comfortable. quiet, too - we couldn't hear any noise from other floors, or from the street with the ac on. the location was incredible - 1/2 block to central park, one block from b/c subway. lots of great restaurants nearby - we loved effy's for breakfast and rancho taquileria. we had a wonderful stay!

francine, soon and alex were great hosts. they’re a very friendly family, that recommends cool places for visit in nyc. conversation with them was funny and interesting. we would like to meet them again, maybe in “our hood” in prague :)) best for travellers who want to be in touch with local people and neigbourhood. (they also have super cute and friendly cats and dog) simona and tuan

we had several great days in nyc on our city trip. the appartment is located within 10minute walking distance to a express train that connects you quickly to midtown and downtown in general. doris was a fantastic host and our „welcome package“ with water, snacks, coffee, milk, wine and other great basics was very much appreciated! thank you again for everything!
great place to stay. very comfortable and nice place. will book again.

stayed at this beautiful queens location and i can't say enough wonderful things about our stay!! the place was pristine!! neil was a delight!! he made sure we had everything that we needed and responded quickly to any questions we had!! we would definitely stay again!! thank you so much neil!
the location of the millenium is excellent, the service great, but the room was deteriorated.

warm, beautiful apartment. stylish, antique-filled interior with everything you could possibly need for a comfortable stay (including essential kitchen items and organic toiletries in the bathroom). the neighbourhood offered several lovely dining options just a short stroll away and there is also a well-stocked fresh food market/grocery on halsey st which offers lots of great produce for cooking if you would prefer to eat at home. mia also provided some lovely guides with her top recommendations for bars/restaurants/shops in the area. ralph st station was just a few minutes walk from the house, so getting in and out of manhattan was a breeze. highly recommend this apartment to all.

everything about jan’s place is perfect! she has thought of everything to make sure you are comfortable. there is soap/shampoo/conditioner for the shower, plenty of outlets, various snacks provided, and more. the location is close to everything in brooklyn, including the subway which takes you right to manhattan. we loved the notebook filled out with recommendations from previous guests. also, the bed is comfy with plenty of pillows, which is a rarity for airbnb’s. we will definitely be back here if the opportunity ever arises!”

for a place this nice in ny at such an affordable price it’s a steal! not only did they leave us snacks and water but they were also very gracious when i accidentally broke a glass. thank you for a perfect stay!
amazing stay and great host! was a lovely neighborhood to explore and was one of my favorite things about my trip to ny
nice and walkable neighbourhood. it was a bit loud but the white noise machine drowned out pretty much all the sound from outside.

overall a good stay. the place is clean and very spacious for our family of four. we lived in the neighborhood for 10 years not long ago and it was great to be back in our old ‘hood with lots of restaurants, shops, grocery stores and public transportation nearby. the two biggest downsides were 1) communication before and during our stay — it was slow though the hosts were friendly and apologetic — and 2) the check-in process. we didn’t have check-in instructions upon arrival so had to wait out front trying to get in touch with the hosts. while we did this, i noticed an employee of the kitchen supply store that occupies the space below the apartment taking a photo of me and my family and looking up towards the hosts’ unit windows. i have to assume they know the apartment owners and were alerting them to who was arriving (and fumbling around to get in!) which is understandable. but when asked why they were photographing us, the person denied it. very strange experience.
dawn was an amazing host, would stay again

we spent 5 lovely days in ted and diane's upper west side studio leading up to daniel's running of the nyc marathon. the unit is cozy, clean and extremely comfortable with all of the conveniences of home and the added bonus of peace and quiet. a very convenient location in easy walking distance of river side and central parks, great shopping and excellent restaurants all in a safe neighborhood. hop on the subway -- just two blocks away -- two access all of manhattan. we had very positive electronic communications with both ted and diane leading up to our stay and it was lovely to be warmly greeted by diane upon our arrival. we would definitely return and would strongly recommended this accommodation to others.
had a great stay with andrew and adriana! room was comfortable and clean, great location just a hop away from subway. lovely and friendly hosts too :) would stay again!

we loved our time at allen & irina's place! it was really clean, bright and in a fantastic location. we met irina on arrival, and she was very welcoming and happy to host us. they were especially accommodating to us, considering our flight was delayed several hours and arrived around midnight. the bed in this place is magnificent - very soft, and warm! the full kitchen is really nice, and is was great to see the dishwasher and clothes washer, even though we didn't use them. we recommend this place to anyone who needs a place to stay in williamsburg. we will certainly look to allen & irina the next time we plan a trip to the area.
great stay. i'll be back

mark -- thank you! you made this visit so comfortable and safe. i cannot thank you enough for your wonderful, on-the-ball communication. checking in and out couldn't have been easier. your home is beautiful (the old brooklyn brownstone details and charm!), well-appointed, and *spotless*. thank you thank you thank you!

if you’re thinking about reserving evert’s place, don’t give it a second thought, do it. the pictures definitely does not do the space justice. it looks even better. my family and i really enjoyed staying at evert’s place. the two-story apartment was very clean and well organized. i enjoy the fact that it wasn’t cluttered with unnecessary items. some guest complained about not televisions in the bedrooms, but i kind of enjoyed that. i would definitely stay here again. being able to park in front of the building was a definite bonus. finding parking in new york and sometimes be difficult. the parking area is large enough for two vehicles. given the opportunity, i would definitely reserve the space again.
great space. clean, comfortable, and affordable.

my son and i stayed with kartika during our new york trip, it was a great stay, her place is around the corner from train station, so going to and from manhattan was very easy. kartika was an excellent host, she was very helpful when i broke my phone and she made us breakfast on our last day.
perfect stay in perfect spot! all as described with sweet valentine’s day sweet greet. we lived it!

loved this room: clean, perfect location between 2/3 and a/c trains, close to lots of places to eat in harlem, well organized, and air conditioned for those hot nyc summer days. most of all, yvette is an amazing host, and makes you feel like her casa is your casa. will definitely return! 5 stars!
this was a last minute find i needed for a night before my flight and 10/10 would recommend! louann was helpful with my check-in, helped with my bags and showed me around. would definitely stay again

alejandra's home was incredible. we made it our home away from home! she treated us like family and was always available with every little thing we needed. house was so nice and in the best neighborhood. 10 out of 10.

positive notes: the host allowed us to check in and check out very late, allowing us to stay a few extra hours. he provided us with some bottles of water and offered us food for dinner. the norwood metro stop is very close to the accommodation, allowing you to reach manhattan in 45 minutes. negative points: the underground station is not accessible to people with mobility disabilities; the accommodation was generally dirty, for example there was dust on the floor and on the radiator; the air conditioner was attached with adhesive tape; there were some cracks in the ceiling. the area is dangerous at night, we were chased by a drunk man and were forced to take refuge in a nearby supermarket (open until late). the host was definitely one of the kindest we have ever met, but we recommend that he pay more attention to the cleanliness of the accommodation. a sufficient solution for those who want to sleep in new york on a budget.
a very cozy apartment and the traffic is convinent. also there is a lot of restaurants near by, suitable for travelers
yemi was very hospitable and attentive. the room had great amenities and was conveniently located near a station. definitely recommend!

it was a clean and convenient location. we notified the owners regarding the loud noise at the bar downstairs. we asked if other rooms were available to maybe avoid noise. they responded quickly with no other space available. they reminded me it was nyc and to try earplugs. i’ve visited nyc numerous times. the noise was unusually loud even with ear plugs in.

tonya’s place was easily accessible by bus and subway which made our time in new york really easy to get around. the place was spacious and comfortable. tonya was very flexible with check in and allowed us to drop off our bags before check in time so we didn’t have to lug them around. overall a great place to stay!
great, perfect location, wonderful place
great place! loved the location ❤️

really loved staying at cynthia and raphaele’s home! they were lovely and kind. the master suite was spacious and comfortable. the bed was soooo comfie and we found the bedroom to be really quiet and peaceful. actually slept better than we do at home. thank you both for such a delightful stay! we hope to come back one day!

this top-floor private place was a great stay for a half-week in new york. just minutes from the c-train, it allowed us to get private place with two bedrooms for a good value. all amenities worked great, and we liked the information package left by the host! the apartment was clean, and the patio was very nice to enjoy some evening beers on. the area is very residential so quite calm, but of course the areas near the stations get a bit lively after dark. only issue we really had was the noisy traffic outside of the larger bedroom which faces the street. quite a bit of honking and car/motorcycle noises, even during the night. it's city living, but bring ear plugs if you're sensitive.

the home was a perfect place to enjoy manhattan. convenient to nearby grocery, pharmacy, and wine and liquor stores , the home is quiet yet close to central park , public transportation, and the excitement of new york city. we look forward to returning again in the future.
clean room with beautiful massive windows. the location was perfect!!! the subway was super convenient and everything else was within walking distance! we will be back!

frederique made us very welcome in her lovely apartment. everything was super high spec: comfy bed, gorgeous bathroom and shower and lots of space. it was very easy to meet with her and she gave us hints of places to go in the local area. all in all - a great stay!
the location is perfect , quiet, safe, and just a few miles from delicious food. carolyn is very kind and considerate. enjoyed the stay here very much!

we loved our stay at stacey's. her apartment is clean and has great living space. stacey was so helpful and was so quick to respond and offered suggestions on things in the area. the location was perfect for us as a base for exploring nyc; the subway is just 3-4 mins walk from the apartment. would definitely stay here again if we return to nyc
the mere fact that i extended my stay here for another two months says it all.
great place, simple checkin, great location. no issues, would stay here again
this place is good to stay if you only go to sleep and rest. nothing fancy but comfortable. staff was very nice and supportive. for the price, definitely recommend it.

the real bronx fordham experience. multiple restaurants downstairs, the train and college right across the street. fordham mall a couple blocks down. also the host bergica is very responsive to help with requests. other than the train right outside your window which you’ll get used to after a day this is the best location with a great price.
nice large updated space wonderful to relax in after a long day exploring the city nice to have parking available too owner was always quick to respond if we had any questions
elliot is a nice host who communicates clearly. you’d be paying for the location. it’s nice that you get your own bedroom
went great! literally everything i needed is walking distance.

i came here for 10 days since i needed a place to stay before moving into my more permanent place (lease started feb 1). the room was small just as described but it was clean and worked well. what i didnt like was one person i shared the space with who did not lock the door when he would come back at night (while i was asleep). i told dylana and she handled it immediately which was awesome. good place for the price.

very big place, the description is accurate, better than the photos show. good location in a safe neighborhood close to subway. johny is super responsive and helpful, easy check-in and check out. highly recommend!
michaels place was perfect for our stay in nyc. location was amazing, the room was spacious and very comfortable. michael was responsive and very helpful. churro was super cute and kept to himself.

we booked this airbnb so that we would have a month to apartment hunt after moving to new york, and it was a great welcome. the location is amazing. there is an incredible grocery store only a block away, and you are close to a bunch of subway lines. charisse, and mike (the super), were very responsive to our needs and super helpful, even when our flight was delayed upon arrival. would recommend!
great location! east village. cute place! huge window view of 14th st. ella was quick in responding to any questions.

i stayed at taylor's place with my wife and daughter for 4 nights. the overall experience was excellent. taylor is a great host. great communication, very responsive and understanding. condo was very clean when we checked in and very really appriciated the chilled bottle of wine waiting for us after a long trip. condo is located in walking distance from many activities. we walked to our broadway show, central park, the met, etc. on our last night in ny, i lost of condo fob in one of the soho shops. we didn't have time to go to the shop and get the key before our flight. taylor was very understanding. she offered to go to the shop herself and pick up the keys saving us a lot of headache trying to chase down the keys from the west coast.

spacious, comfortable top floor of a classic brownstone. we felt right at home - the bed and pillows were very comfortable, everything was so clean, well equipped, and exactly as described. we enjoyed the beautiful neighborhood, easy access to the subway, and being able to explore brooklyn. the hosts respond promptly with any questions. we would definitely stay again.
amazing apartment! would recommend. clean and in a nice area, looks the same as the pictures.
our go-to airbnb in brooklyn! great space and location!

overall my stay was very pleasant and easy. the apartment is walking distance from the train and bus. the bus is only 1 stop from harlem over the bridge. the separate entrance minimizes any intrusiveness. the apartment was very clean and stocked with amenities such as towels, soap, linens, hangers, iron, and tv with fire stick. i did wish there was an ironing board and that the iron was better maintained for those who need it. wifi is provided but it did have some spotty periods during my stay primarily late at night. the host was very friendly and proactive about making sure my stay went well. i would book in the future.

luxurious and very well located apartment. the view is just fantastic. it was perfect for our business/fun trip to nyc. the host diane and the doormen/doorwomen at the buildings were very friendly, which just made the whole experience feel so special. highly recommended.

i miss this place already. it is definitely one of the most efficiently decorated flats you'll find on airbnb. everything has been thought of, and everything makes perfect sense inside the flat. the host is clearly making an effort to make you feel at home, and they are also very generous with the minibar and snacks. speaking of feeling at home, the neighbours in the building are super friendly. and we felt like east village was the perfect place to be to feel like a local during our trip. it was such a joy to sit by the window with my girlfriend and watch the lovely street the building is located at. thank you.

the place was quite warm when we got it and we didn’t anticipate the climb to the third floor but both of those things became something to easily look over as the trip went on. once we got the air circulating we were comfortable and cozy. the place itself was nice, clean and comfortable. i wouldn’t stay here again bc of preference only(not bc anything was wrong at all) but i would recommend it to others if they want to be away from the loudness and hustle and bustle of the city.

carol's was very nice when i arrived, she went over the rules and even went out her way to drive me to the mall. the neighborhood at night is not as safe after 9pm. the room was clean, wifi worked perfect and ac was cold. only problem which i never write bad reviews is my check out. i didn't know where to leave the keys no text answer or phone. carol let me keep my luggage there till after work so i didn't think it would be an issue to leave with keys. she reported me to airbnb they called several times while i was at work and she wanted compensation. the sad part was airbnb said we won't charge you. 2 days later airbnb attempted to take 89.90 out of my account 3 times. i was disappointed she requested them to do that because i didn't have much money and original each night stay was cheaper. i even gave her cash for keeping my things there for the night. my card got shut down i had problems all weekend looking for a place. i feel that wasn't right.
loved this hotel! the room had everything and it was in a perfect location. great place to stay and great hosts!

i had a great stay at krystal’s place! communication was excellent from start to finish—quick responses and clear instructions made everything so easy. the space was comfortable, and exactly as described. i would definitely stay here again thank you for being such a great host!
this place is a the perfect place to stay why on new york. it's clean, safe, and beebe is simply the best. this is our second time and it felt like coming home ❤️ can't wait to go back!!

we enjoyed staying at this apartment and give it the highest rating in all categories. while it was very clean and accommodated our every need, having the stacked washer and dryer made it outstanding. we kept up on laundry throughout our stay so when we arrived home in illinois, we had only a small amount of laundry after seeing both maine and nyc. instructions where clear for arrival and departure and while we met our host, jana, we only talked to her one time because all of our needs were already covered. we had no need to ask for help! thank you jana for the great accommodations!

we really enjoyed our stay. it was so close to the water and had everything nearby that we could walk to. apartment was quiet and it was nice to have access to large kitchen and gym areas. the only difference from the listing is that is showed a dividing curtain next to the murphy bed and that wasn’t there.
we loved this place! clear communication and easy check in. great location, quiet neighborhood, very clean and modern. we will definitely stay again!

my visit to nyc this november was only made better by mrs. jaleh. she was incredibly welcoming and accomodating, and helped make my visit stress and hassle free. she even helped me through my awkward arrival and depature times. her recommendations around the city were very helpful and i'm very glad to have been her guest. thank you for being a great host, mrs. jaleh, i would recommend your place anyday!

i stayed at the kasa location in the lower east side. the location is great, lots to do and easy access to public transit. i just felt that the space was quite small for the price. i think if each room had a full kitchen, it would have felt more worth the price. the host was easy to contact and they responded quickly.

stayed for a few months. due to the price. the location is great, the building is also well maintained. most of my issues are with the host - extremely unavailable. i've had issues with plumbing. took them days to reply. messaged them the day of check in just to make sure everything is ok - they haven't bothered to reply. (the building door happened to be unlocked, so i managed to get in). on the day of the checkout, i checked out an hour early. then, about 10 minutes after the official checkout time i noticed that i have a package waiting at the lobby. i messaged the host if there is any way they can help me get the package (the front door is locked, and i left the key at the apartment). they haven't replied. i could have still gotten it (didn't have to leave the city until late) - but even 12 hours after - no reply. tl;dr- book if you are ok with the price but also have 0 support from host. otherwise, hosts in nyc are usually very responsive. i'd book a different place

i had a wonderful time in nyc. kaitlyn was a great host. she is a very open and nice person and she can give you a lot of advices, if you need. 100% recommendation. room is small but has everything you need, especially a very comfortable bed plus if you need there is a living room you can use.
good location, close to subways. cafes and restaurants around. 2 br apartments with big living areas. only the laundry room is under renovation, can’t use it during our three nights stay.

e vera is a wonderful, generous, and amazing person! her home is beautiful and very well kept. she has many amenities and comforts of home. she is also very organized and efficient and a great communicator. as a first time airbnb user, she had set the bar high for me!

ohad's please was excellent! the location is absolutely perfect - right in the middle of vanderbilt, next to a ton of great restaurants and bars (including ample hills icecream & olde brooklyn bagel shop, among lots of other great options). the apartment is spacious and has all the amenities you need to feel at home. one particularly awesome feature is the huge bathtub & in-unit laundry – two things you very rarely find in new york. i would happily stay here again.
lakisha room was exactly as listed. the room was clean and larger than i expected. i would stay here again the next time i am in brooklyn.

we had never heard of red hook before our trip and it turned out to be an amazing location! the lost is amazing and there’s great breweries, a winery and other awesome neighborhoods within walking distance, along with the ferry terminal 5 minutes away. the ferry was the least stressful and best way to get around the city. brooklyn ice house also had amazing food and the locals were so nice to us!

i wish i could give a better review because christina was so responsive and allowed us to drop off our bags early. my issue is that right when you enter there's a sign saying airbnb and temporary guest will be trespassed. the maintenance man, eduardo, was the one to give us the keys to come back and saw that we were two females. christina and i agreed my check in time was 4pm and when we got into the apartment at 4:30pm there was a laundry bag on the table. a couple minutes later eduardo let himself in, didn't knock or announce himself. we had no idea how to react and just stared at him. he said he had to finish making the bed and took photos and left. we were already in a bad part of town and felt even more uneasy about how nonchalant he was about bursting in. airbnb had to relocate us and as i look at other reviews this incident has happened before. as a side note the blanket on the couch was not washed because i found a starbucks order sticker on it from a previous guest.
walkable area in the city center. enough beds to sleep 5 of us during the weekend trip to ny. i recommend asking for the photos of the bathtub and walls behind the sliding tub door prior to booking.

located conveniently in the middle of all the major streets. you could walk to wherever you needed to go and especially to the subway. pretty quiet from outside noise. overall it was a great stay and i would recommend :)
emma was lovely to communicate with. the place is great and so is the location! we had a great stay. thank you, emma!

we enjoyed our stay at william’s place. the airbnb was a lovely room with a bathroom and a small kitchen that we didn’t use. it was very comfortable for 2 people and had everything we needed for our trip to new york. the bed and pillows were comfortable, the shower was good, and we liked that we were able to open a couple windows to get some fresh air. it was very quiet which surprised me, and the street outside was very lovely with lots of little coffee shops and restaurants within a few blocks. the subway was about a 10 minute walk for us but we are used to that.
description was accurate, a little smaller than it looks.
the house was very clean and had everything we needed. vie was very welcoming and helpful. we enjoyed our stay here!
very nice stay. responsive host. would stay again!

andrada is very welcoming and communicative. she is a great host. the apartment is very clean and incredibly well equiped. little touches are well considered such as treat in the room upon arrival, the shower equipped with products and the room has its own iron and small ironing board. the whole apartment is styled well and everything you need for a comfortable stay is available. my partner and i thought it was great to be close to a metro but the area, although apparently safe, feels a bit on the grungy side. not a problem, just something to keep expectations in check. also we didn’t realise that each room in the apartment was a seperate airbnb. so there was 6 people sharing one bathroom. total of 8 in the apartment. it’s easy enough to navigate this but we didn’t expect to be sharing with so many people. also the kitchen isn’t available between 9pm-7am as it is for the master. this is fine but good to know beforehand. we would recommend for its cleanness and value.
great stay would recommend this to anyone looking for a quiet comfortable pl. great host
sadie is pleasant and friendly and the space was clean and spacious .
it was great, i would absolutely recommend this place.
lovely apartment in a wonderful area,great shopping and restaurants nearby ,felt like the real new york ! yann was really easy to contact and let us extend our checking out time. thank you yann
adam was very nice and accommodating. 10 minute walk to the a or c train which was convenient enough for me. the space was very clean.

i was very impressed with marco's place. we have been staying at hotels every year for the past 20 years so this was our first time staying at an airbnb. we made the change because my friend keisha who is a repeat guest had very high praises for both marco and his place. i love the place, it is very modern and comfortable and marco is friendly. i will stay there again and recommend it to others. roxanne

this is a fantastic airbnb! entire one bedroom thats by two subway stations so getting everywhere is super easy. the place itself has everything you need from spices to extra bedding. milton was easy to reach and was so kind to answer all of my questions!

anisia was the best! welcoming, friendly and thoughtful; her place is cozy and comfortable, the kitchen was well equipped and her cat is just lovely :) the neighborhood was cool too, lot's of places to eat, go out, shop, etc. also two blocks from the subway! would definitely stay there again
it was a great place to stay!
we had an amazing stay in brooklyn and would definitely stay in sara's place again!
definitely accommodating and cozy, would recommend to anybody to stay here.

this was a great place to stay at. easy access to buses and ability to transfer to trains to get to the popular tourist areas. very responsive and very accommodating during our stay. the bed was very comfy and the neighborhood was nice and quiet. overall great experience i’d stay here again for sure.
loved the fact that the subway entrance/exit was just right across the street. it was also very convenient having several stores and restaurants around. we enjoyed our stay!!

my friends and i had a great stay at michela's place. it was very clean and even more spacious than we thought based on the pictures. michela was very helpful when we had some questions about the remote lock app. the snacks and water bottles were very accommodating and free street parking was easy to find. keep in mind that since this is conveniently close to jfk airport, you can hear the planes in the morning and afternoon. would recommend to book if you are looking for a stay in queens!

this is our second time staying here, and we loved it as much as the first! location is fantastic and close to public transport. it is very nice to have astoria park so nearby. additionally, astoria has some great food and the host was able to provide a great list of local recommendations. we will be coming back soon!
it was spotless clean, even better than the photos. we felt super at home during our 6 day stay :-)

to start the area is nice just right by the financial district, space was clean only issue i had was they listed the room knowing it didn’t have heat, i called several times the maintenance guy came but never actually fixed anything just acted like it would work knowing that they only had a/c. so i was freezing 3/3 of my days staying here the last day they finally gave me extra blankets and a small heater i asked for a room change they denied it. that’s the only real issue i had that kind of annoyed me other than that easy check in area is walkable.

our stay was great. however, we probably will not lease a basement apartment again (this property was extremely noisy) and would need a stove. we realize that this is a safety issue. overall, the apartment was clean and comfortable and we really appreciated the coffee. thank you, mary & joe doner

very good stay, enjoyed my time. very clean and sandra is very good at communication and responds fairly quickly. i would've preferred knowing about the extra bed cost, however it is okay. enjoyable experience overall!

perfect place to visit nyc! the apartment is super close to the train station so you don’t have to worry about another long walk after being all day in the streets of manhattan. everything in the apartment was super tidy and clean. natalia is excellent at replying fast and also very helpful with whatever you may need. would def stay there again!
amazing location, prompt responses, great space for anyone with a full itinerary of seeing nyc. coming back!
very kind and welcoming host. great apartment, right next to the park.

noelva and alex's place was everything we were excepting ! it's really nice to leave outside of the city and by the water to relax after the craziness of ny. we've been going to new york everyday and it's about an hour far but with express lines it's pretty okay ! noelva and alex were really nice and helpful whenever we needed anything they were with us in five minutes !! thank you !

juan is a great host and he made my stay very comfortable. the flat is spotlessly clean and the roon has a large tv. don't be put off by the landing and stairs in the building. they are not very clean but the flat is spotless. the area can be a bit noisy but i never felt unsafe. it is quite a distance from midtown but if you get the express a train from 168th st, you can get there quite fast. it is a real new york exprerience far away from the impersonal hotels of midtown.
easy check-in, super clean and felt like a safe neighborhood. litterally a walking minute to the train makes it easy to commute to anywhere. thank you mike!
i felt very welcome and had plenty of my own space, the whole downstairs was provided for me. very convenient location in manhattan as well.
masoud & cassandra’s place was beautiful! the perfect accommodation for our stay & the cafe downstairs was delicious! thank you for everything, highly recommend this place.

i don’t know if the comments i left for the categorical evaluations can be seen, so i’ll repeat them here: some of the rooms had windows and desks, and some of the rooms had neither. also use of the common space with the beverages was suspended in the middle of my stay due to covid, and i think that was information that should’ve been in the description of the listing and it’s also something that chelsea should’ve started doing earlier, since covid started a long time ago. for communication, chelsea did a fairly good job. sometimes i would get confusing answers from different responders on airbnb in the same conversation(for example when i asked them about mail), but generally they were pretty quick with responses, just sometimes you do have to follow up with them to get a response. the good thing is that chelsea’s team is very responsive and understanding of your concerns and will try their best to accomodate you, including switching rooms. throughout my stay i kept having wifi issues, and they were accommodating to that and kept contacting their engineers to adjust the wifi settings. there was a fire that happened on the second floor during my stay which set off the sprinklers and drowned the entire first and second floors. i was staying in room 103 at the time and the water starting coming into my room so fast that i had to block it with all of my towels and sheets as well as pack up and evacuate immediately with all my belongings. because there wasn’t any chelsea staff on site at the moment, they took at least an hour to respond and later the fire trucks came. i’m not entirely sure whether it was a guest or something with the building that caused the fire, but it definitely impacted most of the residents especially on the first and second floors, and chelsea can also improve their response rate next time in cases of emergency like this. overall, this is a really cute and quality boutique hotel in a great location and you get what you paid for. they’re good with communication as long as you voice your concerns, but there are minor issues that they should improve on.

i come to ny often for both business and pleasure. i had the opportunity to book david's place at the last minute before a trip and i am so happy i did. it is everything that it says in the listing and more. the more comes simply because you can tell that they have left no stone unturned for their guess. they have tried to make sure you are as comfortable as possible. i lived near this apartment for many years so the neighborhood was awesome. it will continue to grow with little restaurants and shops popping up daily. it's the perfect spot. a short 10 minute walk to the "a" train with only about 4 stops before you get to the city. overall, david's place is amazing. i look to book it for every one of my upcoming trips to ny! perfect space.

a fantastic find. nancy was a joy to meet and very welcoming. the room was spacious, and with good aircon keeping it at a nice temperature. the location is great for midtown manhattan, really easy access on the subway, which is only a short walk away. the neighbourhood felt safe at all times of the day. i would heartily recommend this for your stay in ny.

other reviews were very accurate. the space is small but, it was perfect for two people. there is enough space to store luggage and still feel comfortable in the room. i appreciated the thoughtfulness that paris put into preparing the room. there was water, ear plugs and a air fan already on when we arrived. the bed was very comfortable and the pillows were nice and soft. paris communicated with us throughout our time and was very accommodating. location was perfect!
it was an absolute amazing and blissful stay

thank you elizabeth for hosting us at your wonderful harlem home. we felt like we had a true new york experience. the home was lovely, the location was great being so close to the subway and we had a lovely time. elizabeth was always very responsive both before and during our stay and the check in process was so simple. we would definitely recommend elizabeth’s place for a new york stay especially if you have a big family!
wonderful place! the whole 2nd floor was ours so it was very private. considering the affordable price angel’s place is just so amazingly perfect!

17 hotel is a great place for long stays, i highly recommend. all members of the staff were always nice and helpful. i would definitely stay again! i rented a mini-fridge for my stay so that helped a lot with food-wise situation if you're looking to not overspend. you do however have to know what kind of place you're staying at. if you're a very picky person as to noise or having to share a bathroom – then this is not the place for you. i have some slight ocd, i can for sure say i never had an issue with not having a clean bathroom, they were cleaned every-other day by the staff. also room cleaning service every week was great! as for the noise – i did have a slightly noisy neighbor who rehearsed for his opera sessions (or something of that sort lol 😂) but honestly, it wasn't too annoying, that's why i never made an issue about it. but this is what i mean when you have to know what you're getting into. thanks for a great stay and for being my home for a month! ❤️
there was a good place for trip of lower manhatten and brooklyne. the breakfast was small but we can enjoy coffee and bread any time in the cafeteria. we had a great trip in there.
