diavanna’s place is the perfect place to stay in brooklyn. it’s close to everything and provides more than you could ever need in terms of amenities. the place was stocked with cereal and milk, spices, coffee, tea and all your cooking essentials. it was clean, well decorated and truly made my stay the best it could be. diavanna was very helpful and a lovely host all round. i highly recommend this place as your next spot in the warm little suburb of bedford!
amazing host and great deal for the location. felt safe staying here

edmund was a terrific host, providing us with all information we needed to have a pleasant stay. restaurants, area information and travel assistance were all provided in a convenient book. edmund also provided us with complementary beverages when we arrived, as well as a few candies. as previously stated, the apartment was clean and comfortable, however during our stay, there was a neighborhood party going on, where rap music was played in the street until 1 am. made it somewhat difficult for us to ready ourselves for a full morning the next day. the area was pleasant, however there were a couple of project housing units that had to be passed to reach the subway train, which was approx 15-20 mins from the apartment. then the train ride was another 30 mins to the city, so travel became more than we wanted. the master bed had quite a divot in the middle, however the second room had a very nice comfortable bed. the couch pullout was serviceable, but not terribly comfortable. all in all, this was a very nice location, with very serviceable amenities.

peter’s place was great. very clean and comfortable with excellent access to transportation. peter was communicative and helpful, and everything went smoothly. my friend and i had a great time. totally recommend.

anthony's condo was the perfect place for my husband and i to stay while visiting family in nyc. the space is clean, inviting and cozy. the garden in the backyard was such an unexpected perk. this is the perfect place to stay while staying in nyc as there is easy access to the bqe, subways and plentiful restaurants in walking distance. thank you anthony for your hospitality and making this an unforgettable trip.
place was decent but she said she had cable and she didn’t... no cable, no netflix or appletv
very nice place to stay. easy check in, and very clean room

waldemar is an amazing host. our room was clean, tidy and had direct access to the back garden wich was great. waldemar even supplied us with towels (which was completely unexpected)!! we will definitely stay over at waldemar's when visiting new york again.
stay was awesome ! friendly hosts.

unfortunately, our stay was extremely negative. there’s no sound proofing between the floors so we could hear the upstairs occupants conversations and hear loud stomping across the floor all hours of the night. people would come and go, stomping across the floor, slamming the front door and gate shut and a dog would run back and forth until 3-4 am every night we were there. we couldn’t sleep and felt tired and miserable our entire vacation. also, the door that separates the basement from the rest of the house doesn’t have a lock on the basement side. the upstairs renters could lock/unlock from their side and walk into the basement anytime they want. the place looked just like the pictures, water pressure was good and hot water worked but that is the only nice things i can say.
always a pleasure staying here! the host goes above and beyond to accommodate all your needs. thank you for a wonderful stay!

great location, terrific amenities and a perfect example of why airbnb is the best way to travel. you know you’ve found a great airbnb when you want to buy the home and live there forever. that’s how i felt after my stay in this gem in nyc. i was in nyc for one month (sept to oct) for a set of fashion photography shoots. lindsee and peter's home provided the perfect based for my operations. let me start with location – absolutely perfect. it is located conveniently to everything you need – subway, stores, bars and restaurants. while all is busy and fun on the street level, the apartment is located on the fifth floor as a quiet oasis sitting above the city. it includes a large roof garden, where i spent many hours relaxing or editing photographs. the apartment itself has all you’ll need. the décor is lovely, and has a lot of personal touches, which i loved. i ate more at home than i expected as the kitchen invites you to cook. i had very few issues during my month in the apartment – and for anything that did come up the hosts are very responsive and helpful. the only thing to be aware of is that it is a walk-up. if you have any issues with climbing stairs this may not be the place for you. for everyone else, book it now. you will not regret it. i will book it again in a heartbeat when i am in nyc.

staying with katya is great. she's kind and thoughtful, and had everything prepared in advance. the room is spacious and clean, and it was a little bigger than i thought it'd be. she lives on a great block, and being close to the subway station made it easy to get around.

james’s house is great! it’s located at great location which very convenient to gas station, restaurant, deli & etc! and the the host james always response my message very fast! my family really enjoy the stay at james’s house!
my second stay at anthony's was amazing once again. thanks for the wonderful experience again.

great stay all around! sissy and joey are fantastic hosts. they went above and beyond to make sure my stay was perfect. the location is great, right across from central park and one block away from the subway. the room is spacious, with at least a queen mattress, tv with all the channels, and a desk that made working remotely easy. i would highly recommend to anyone visiting ny.

stayed at this airbnb for my trip up to new york, and truly fantastic value. the room looked identical to the photos, and barry provided additional amenities (shampoo, body wash, toothbrushes) that made the experience great. the apartment is also very close walking distance to the subway station, making it easy to commute to and from the city. would definitely recommend if looking for a cheap place to stay in the bronx.

my family had a wonderful stay at william’s place, the children were very excited they especially loved the upstairs bed…can’t tell why the bed makes them happy 😅 but, from they are happy, i am happy. the stay was a good one, thank you william for your quick response when called upon, and for making sure that the stay was a good one.

a beautiful house with many period features yet warm and cosy. everything was spotlessly clean and well kept. lots of easy to follow instructions to guide you. everything you could need for a comfortable stay short of cooking a meal. very private but worth remembering the hallway is shared. very handy for the subway station and access to downtown new york city. christine was helpful and responsive to all our queries both before and and during our stay. its a good area with lots of shops, supermarkets and restaurents. we particulalrly liked the cinnamon girl coffee shop.
great area. clean and spacious apartment. i would be happy to stay there again!
exactly how it’s described in the descriptions and reviews. it’s an older home that fees like a home in nyc. the neighborhood on the street up felt walkable and like a wonderful community.

this hotel is in a great location. it's a couple blocks from penn station and easy to walk to many restaurants and the subway. the room itself was reasonable for a ny city hotel room--clean, and comfortable! we'll stay there again!
great stay, convenient location.
great space convenient to everything. quiet. easy check-in. great restaurants nearby. clean! would definitely book again.

this was our first time using airbnb, and our first trip to nyc. charlie's place was very affordable and in a great location. we had everything we needed, and it was only a short walk to get to the subway. harlem is a great place to stay, as it was a bit quieter than the rest of manhattan, which was fantastic. the amenities were so close, and we found everything very easily. it has tv! which 2 of our other airbnb places did not, even though they said they did. thankyou for a very memorable experience.

it’s good for an over night stay for one or two adults. this is not a vacation spot. the space is small and there is zero privacy from anyone in the room. the location is good for getting to inner city things. the cleanliness leaves something to be desired. i point this out because it is 100% due to neglect and laziness from management. an extra 5 minutes in a room can fix all of that.

i would have gone for a straight 5 if there were no issues regarding the wifi for last 2 days. now i hope that's a temporary misfortune that i had, all the other things were perfect. clean, peaceful, primary guest care provided like hand written notes , instructions, washroom and kitchen loaded with daily needs, comfortable bed , a laptop workstation, full length mirror, drawer and closet . the space is also mindfully decorated. i liked staying here and can stay in future
great place and really nice hosts. easy to get to manhattan.

the place is really confortable and is located in a very nice and quiet neighborhood, it is also very close to the subway. it is ideal to rest; everything is very nice and clean. sunny was a great host and helped us with anything we needed! very recommended.

guillermo was a great host and gave us some advice about places to go locally. the studio is bigger than the pictures show and has more amenities than i expected. 5min walk to get the l train into williamsburg or manhattan made this a great place to stay.
great location. great place. great deal. i will definitely stay again. the front desk people were nice and helpful as well.

loved staying at the freehand nyc. it's a fantastic location, just a few blocks away from the new photography museum - fotografiska new york (well worth a visit if you are into photography and the visual arts). close to the lower east side, the flatiron building, gramercy park and union square. the broken shaker roof top bar is great with some fine views. the staff was friendly without being fawning. we had a queen room with a very comfortable bed. only two things kept this from being five stars in my book: there are no coffee or tea makers in the rooms or common areas, and the fridge is only one soda can deep, so there is no room to store leftovers, which for us would have been about half our victual uptake. this adds to your bottom line expenses plus throwing out all that great food. the lack of a decent sized mini fridge was the larger of these deficits. thanks freehanders we enjoyed our stay and hats off to our daytime concierge!
we had an awesome stay. everything was clean and they were really helpfully and super nice people !
this was perfect and wonderful. exactly what i needed and a really wonderful view

marek's place was comfortable and very inviting. i appreciate the fact the the pictures were true to what the actual place looked like and everything was super clean. i wasn't greeted by marek upon my arrival but his wife was a great substitute , showing me around the apartment and making sure i was comfortable. contact with marek was prompt and he always responded back quickly. i spent my time there on one of the coldest days of the year and everything was warm and comfy. i'd definitely recommend this unit and would absolutely return.

ercilia is truly a great host! this studio is clean, well-appointed, and exactly as described. within walking distance to everything you may need. the shower is amazing! kitchen is impeccable with everything needed to cook up a meal or two. aromatherapy diffusers with a large selection of scents to promote both energetic mornings and relaxing nights. jerecho & i truly enjoyed our stay and created a lasting memory. if you’re looking for a great place in queens, this is where you need to be.
place was comfy and clean . host has good communication and is very responsive. location is good right near the subway . .

this was an incredible airbnb with tons of space and incredible views! the only issue we had was with the location, which is several blocks from the description on the website. there are no subway stops nearby, but there are some good food and convenient store options. the hosts were responsive and the place was great!

a beautiful space that was perfect for a short work trip to nyc! the room is really cute, impeccably clean, and an incredible value. kwan was a fantastic host who accommodated my late check in time with a super clear self-check in process and communicated quickly throughout my stay. would 100% say here again if i come back to town.

can't say enough good things about yuval's place and his hosting. this was exactly what i needed. the place is immaculately clean, the bed super compfy, but the highlight is without a doubt the location. absolutely love that area of brooklyn. so close to the museum, and a slew of trendy bars, restaurants, and coffee shops. highly recommended!
the views from the room were amazing! great accommodations. when we needed sheets for the pull-out couch they were kind and accommodating. would love to come back for another stay!
reka was extremely helpful and east village is a great spot. highly recommend

molly is the kind of host that makes me wish my previous five-star reviews were four-star reviews. she's very attentive and helpful. she met us in person and answered all of our questions even after we checked in. the space is a genuine nyc-style apartment and comes with all the charm (and for some, maybe surprises) which that entails. the location is great and in a fun part of manhattan. there is some street noise but it was actually much less than i expected. most folks staying here will fine with the hum of the a/c and others will be fine simply wearing earplugs. some may need neither. consider booking this place because both the host and the apartment are great, and it provides a genuine nyc-apartment experience in a great part of town.

i’ve stayed in airbnbs all over the world, and this was definitely the most well equipped. from shower gel and shampoo to laundry detergent to wash some clothes. this apartment was very cozy, incredibly clean well located and i couldn’t recommend it enough to anyone who’s thinking of staying in manhattan!

this unit is not a two bedroom unit, it is two units that has a little corridor in the middle. with small kids it was a little challenging. also there is no separate sitting area but just two studios. location was great we could walk to lots of attractions. the elevator from street to lobby at any given time was very busy with long lines, one of them was broken for half the time and i even heard someone stuck in there asking for help and went to fetch a staff member for them. destination charge is another thing that i was not aware at the time of booking, the check in counter could not articulate how much was the deposit for incidentals and how much was for the destination fee, but it was late with little kids so we had no other option but to check in. overall we had a good time because we were in a good location in manhattan, the hotel experience itself was just okay.

the place was very comfortable and neat. great space, beds and areas like living room and kitchen. close to the hudson line and subway train 1. there are many restaurants and stores nearby this is a 100% recommended one!!
many thanks to omar and kareema for sharing their house with us. it was very confortable, near many services and the spaces was big! warmly suggested!
room was perfect. apartment spotless. communication excellent and location ideal. highly recommend. thanks
friendly and very understanding. i will come back
nice place , spacious , clean and comfortable. near stores , places of worship and transportation.
would 100% come back here! loved our stay!

hands down, this was one of the most thoughtfully appointed spaces i’ve ever stayed in. my partner and i enjoyed all of the details, design, and comfort we experienced staying at cathie’s home. communication was a breeze and her kindness stood out through every interaction. the building is really quiet and even with a train stop not far from it, it still felt like a zen oasis away from the constant activity of the city. we’d definitely stay here again in the future.
great location, near to beach and all the rockaways have to offer. please was very clean and efficient.
stay was a good bang for and emma was a great host!

had a great stay in angelika’s apartment. even better and more spacious than the pictures! also appreciated the privacy, you have your own entrance. great communication with the host, everything in the apartment worked like a clock. we took the subway all the time, convenient and cheap option to uber or taxi. we walked a lot in brooklyn also, 40 min to williamsburg, 30 to bushwick. if you appreciate the brooklyn vibe like us this is definately a good option! don’t miss brooklyn blend - a nice breakfast spot. the wine store that you find in the guest book is also recommended. would stay here again next time in ny.
great host, great help, so many great things to say about him. booked him asap.

spencer went above and beyond helping me. he was of great assistance. his recommendations were very helpful. would recommend his establishment for anyone. great stay and i will definitely be back! charles f rentschler

i totally recommend yuval's place. i stayed for 10 days at his place and had a great time. yuval was nice and helpful. the apartment was nicely furnished and quiet. my bedroom was small but had a comfortable bed and anything one might need while travelling. i also enjoyed the neighbourhood with many shops and restaurants. if you stay there, don’t miss the brooklyn museum nearby!
leon was amazing! communication was great and place was super clean and comfy
we had a great stay :)

we have stayed at abnb's all over the country. this is easily one of our top two or three. the house was exactly as advertised, communication was perfect, timely, and clear. the apartment is perfect for a single, couple, two couples, or couples with 1-2 children. it has two spacious bedrooms with separate ac units, lots of drawer space, and a big full-length mirror in the hall. the kitchen is well equipped and can easily accommodate full meal prep with a full size frig, a five-burner stove and oven, ample microwave, as well as dishes, pots, pans, and knives. the main living is wide open with a corner couch (perfect for napping!), a very large tv with cable, fast internet, and large windows that can be opened. and it has large farm style table for dining or work. visiting bedsty? look no further and grab this gem if it is available!

my stay at ty’s was amazing. i’m from the area so it felt like i was back at home. communication was great and stay was nice and neat. everything walking distance is always a plus. for sure coming back on my visits
great host. was able to compromise and fix me up real quick
loved the stay here. robes were appreciated

jeffrey was the best host ever. staying at his place in the upper west side was the highlight of my entire trip. he’s not only incredibly welcoming, but genuinely a joy to spend time with—you immediately feel at home. the apartment itself is so charming and peaceful, with the most comfortable bed i’ve ever slept in. the location couldn’t be better—right next to the subway, with lots of great spots for coffee and food nearby, including trader joe’s. i can’t recommend staying with jeffrey enough. if you get the chance, go for it—you’ll love every minute.

i greatly enjoyed my stay at madison's place! the apartment was absolutely gorgeous, and extremely comfortable and homey! the bed was so cozy and the kitchen was extremely well stocked. madison also made check-in and check-out a breeze, and was so welcoming, providing wonderful neighborhood recommendations and tips! i definitely look forward to another stay at madison's sometime in the future!! :d

communication with david was quick and easy. very helpful if needed. david's place is awesome – very clean, with everything you need. very spacious living room and kitchen, two bedrooms, and a big bathroom. perfect location to visit manhattan. only 1 minute to the subway, and i really mean just 1 minute. and then just 8 minutes to times square. there's even a neighborhood cat – so cute! all in all, it's great for tourists who want to be close to the action but not within the action.

this place was a great place to stay while in brooklyn! michal's place is centrally located in brooklyn. we were right next next to a subway stop, shops and markets, and great walking areas. the tree-lined streets with all the classic new york brownstone buildings are right there, and we took many opportunities for relaxed strolls. prospect park is also close by. the information they left for us and various tips and suggestions were perfect we certainly would stay here again. john, maxine, and naomi oakland, ca
perfect for those who want just the necessary, in all the best ways. they thought of everything essential.
marek is a awesome host !!
gala's place is beautiful. highly recommended!
thank you for such a warm welcome and stay. thank you for everything!
lovely place, excellent location, exactly as described. jen and her housemates were so welcoming and friendly.
very nice place to stay. very cozy and host is very accommodating. would stay here again.
really nice place in a great neighborhood.

this is a fantastic spot that gives you the best of both worlds, it's a private residence inside a hotel. the apartment is fantastic and spacious and you really can't beat the location. next door is 9th street espresso which is one of the best coffee shops in the neighborhood. american cut is also a fantastic spot for a cocktail or a great dinner. give this a go when you need a modern oasis in the middle of manhattan.

our stay at sarah’s apartment was perfect and beyond what we expected. her apartment is spacious, clean, modern décor, and located in a quiet neighborhood. in addition, sarah recommended an excellent restaurant right around the block with great wine and french food (it quickly became our end of the night go-to). it was very convenient to get to around nyc. the m60 bus takes you to the airport, and subway is two blocks. sarah is quick to respond, kind, and accommodating. we greatly thank her for everything, and wish her the best!!!

fahim's place was great. it is decorated with care and includes lots of little touches that show you they care, like providing coffee and snacks. they were very caring, offering to provide a space heater for cool nights, and were flexible regarding our early check-out date. it's a good size for nyc. i have back issues, and so didn't have much luck sleeping on the bed. it was surprisingly quiet - no street noise at all. i expected some noise, but was pleasantly surprised. the neighborhood is fun - very multicultural, with tons of food options nearby and an easy walk from the train.
karla and carlos were so welcoming and open with communication and recommendations. i’d stay here again in a heartbeat!
the space was nice and clean, and the host was very helpful.
only stayed a night, but it was a great spot in a wonderful area. easy friendly communication. 5 stars would recommend
really great location and services for the price. the room itself was very cozy and had just what i needed for a short stay.
if you need a comfortable and safe place to rest while you explore nyc, stay with shailah. she is a wonderful person who will make your stay feel extra special. thank you, shailah :)

i loved this airbnb so much! it’s exactly as pictured. bright, spacious, cute and clean. i was very happy there for my month stay and 100% recommend (as long as you are able to do a few flights of stairs which was personally a non issue for me!!) the hosts were great and responsive too
abhi was responsive and we liked the view from the room.

excellent place right next to central park. mark is amazing. the place is clean, well stocked and has a pullout bed with a regular bed as well. the bottle of wine was excellent and overall it gave us an excellent feel of life in a new york brownstone steps from central park and the onassis reservoir

this airbnb was very nice, it’s way bigger then it looks in the photos. it was 30 seconds away from the subway, so easy access to the city or wherever it is you want to go. it was super comfy and homey.
the place is amazing. mike is a gem. couldn't have asked for a better stay.

our stay at eduardo’s apartment in chelsea was excellent. my boyfriend and i felt completely at home, everything was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. the location was perfect, close to several subway lines and in a beautiful neighborhood for walking around. check-in was very easy, and the instructions were clear and straightforward. eduardo was incredibly responsive and attentive to our needs, which made the whole experience even better. we truly enjoyed our vacation and would definitely stay here again!

very, very clean place. loved it! only thing (very minor at that) was not enough bathroom towels or kitchen towels. i did not call for more but am certain if i have they would have delivered them asap. their communication was very prompt!

paiges place is a clean, perfect room for your stay in brooklyn. room was spacious, and with air conditioning. paige offered a blow dryer to me when i was in need of one. the patio area is shared with another apartment, which i was not expecting but it wasn’t a problem for me.
this was a great location as it is central to a lot of activities my group was doing in the city. it was really clean and the beds were comfortable.
great stay, very convenient

it was our first time in nyc, the appartement is gorgious, you really feel like a new yorker :) the area is great u literally walk on columbus avenue - 50min later you hit timesquare, broadway. also 2 close subways close by and of course central park just a couple of minutes away - only one word - amazing - dana was a brilliant host. thank you dana

excellent place to stay! the views were spectacular, absolutely the best, the balcony and the rooftop views were epic! it was clean, plenty of space, you will have no worries here! also a big perk was the ferry was only half a block away. thank you for the wonderful place!
me and my girlfriend enjoyed our stay thank you

gladwyn, i just want to say you were amazing!! this was my first time staying in an airbnb. you were so accommodating to me and my best friend. thank you for staying longer to wait for our late arrival after traveling through so many storms to get there. you were so quick to respond and so caring. you reminded us to take our time and drive safely. once we got there you welcomed us with warm hugs and such a lovely smile. your home is beautiful and i want to say thank you for sharing it with us. that night after being on the road so long you offered us wonderful food and conversation. it was also great meeting your son. the entire stay i felt at home and i could feel how genuinely sweet you were. i can’t thank you enough for such a great stay. next time we come to brooklyn we will be staying with you!! i can’t wait to cross paths again in the future. many blessing to you and your family!!
great spot in a great location. easy check in and good communication.

anthony is an extremely kind and thoughtful host with an eye for detail and great care for the quality of your stay. the apartment is a beautiful place on the top floor of a brownstone in a great area in bed-stuy. the a express train is very close by, making manhattan very accessible. the g train is not too far to get to other parts of brooklyn, namely williamsburg. for those driving a car, the surrounding area has great street parking availability. i felt very safe and never once had an issue with the apartment or the surrounding area. i would highly recommend this stay to anybody who is looking for a calm place near the city with great company!!

we had a great stay! the location is extremely central and the unit was equipped with light kitchen/pantry items that proved helpful for us. there was a *tiny* audible bit of noise late at night from adjoining units (i think?) but it didn’t bother us at all. recommended!

m.e. was the consummate host. she was there when we needed her, but gave us space too. we loved her space and the location in the city - close to our daughter's school. very easy and safe walking. not too far from the train. thanks too for the breakfast and tea! m.e. really went out of her way to make us feel welcome in her beautiful home. we'll be back!

my stay at the apartment was amazing for the 4 nights i was in nyc. it is in a really good area and there are plenty of places to explore in the upper east side. darya is a great host and will either chat if you want to or leave you in privacy of you prefer that. i will be back.

jae's place was amazing. he was an awesome host. he stayed in communication with us whenever we needed him and had some great recommendations for places around the neighborhood go eat, drink, and check out. the flight of stairs to the third floor apartment really wasn't an issue. if anything just exercise after eating all the amazing food williamsburg had to offer. the apartment is stacked with all the amenities you'd need and the ac wall units kept us very cool during an amazing heat wave. thanks again jae!
great stay! very clean! we had such an amazing time there.

really large suite with a useful kitchenette. the bed was super comfy, and there is no noise at all, so we got a good night sleep. the hotel staff is extremely friendly and help us with our luggage drop off and on from the car, as well as storing it from some hours. the area is busy, but there are many options for dinner or buying something to reheat (like wholefoods) in colombus center. central park is 2 blocks away, perfect for a morning run, and the subway 1 block. we had a really nice time, thank you!

i extended my stay 2x. this was in a safe location and private. everything was clean and organized. kitchen is a good size and plenty of room for 2 people to cook. there are 2 closets, lots of storage space for longer visits. grocery, deli and stores are a block away host is responsive and friendly. she checked on me through my stay and was available if needed. recommend the stay!

the host was friendly, the room was as expected, the price was fair and overall recommended to couple or couple with one kid. we had with us our children (two) and it felt too crowded. if you plan to go out and come back at night this is the room for you. we find the place dusty and not clean enough. only a few towels for three nights and no face towels or hands. i was discussed using the same towel for everything. i had to use my flip flop to take a shower and walk around the room. the location is central, you have most of the trains in walking distance. it was easy to go places from this apartment. close to trains, parks, famous buildings, and so much more!! if you are a female alone i would feel kind of scared because outside the building there some man who hangs out day and night, just sitting there and doing nothing. i was with my husband so i felt if we won’t make eye contact it’s ok and that’s how it was. overall we enjoyed our stay in this apartment and the location.

chris, the host, is a great guy. very polite and helps in everything. the place is in excelent location, 1 minute walking to metro station. close to restaurants, pharmacy, to barclays center (9 min walking). very nice place to stay
ravindra was very helpful nice guy.he took care of me really good.

best host ever! he is so kind and also room was so tidy and clean. even towels smell very good. the location is near to subway and buses so it’s easy to travel new york. i’m really happy to stay in this house.🙌🏼

monica was very helpful with directions into the city via the subway station which qas only a 6 minute walk away. it was relatively easy to get into the city. place was nice, clean and spa ious. had everything we needed for our 4 day trip. would definitely recommend!

toni's place is wonderful. the neighborhood is great, and it really is fairly close to manhattan if you don't mind a 10-min walk. toni is incredibly communicative and helpful with questions leading up to the stay and after. he was flexible and responsive. the studio itself is incredibly quaint and well-furnished. i really enjoyed my stay!

i spent over 2 weeks at lorelei & alex's beautiful and warm house while visiting my family. the room is a pleasant and very spacious room with a private bathroom, both are beautifully designed and decorated, with attention to every detail. the room and the bathroom, were equipped with everything i needed, and more. alex and lorelei were very attentive and welcoming. they gave me a feeling that they are open to chat and to respect my privacy at the same time. i will definitely return if i'm in the area. thank you so much lorelei & alex for letting me share the beauty and warmth of your home.
the place was very nice and a cozy little studio. the neighborhood was good and subway station was nearby. thank you for a wonderful stay!
t is responsive and helpful. the apartment is in a good location & the bedroom was clean and comfortable.
what a great place! really enjoyed it.
great host! everything was in order and as advertised. would stay here again
great place in a quiet area! walkable to a number of food spots and subway station is very walkable to!
everything was great, place was awesome and close to everything
amazing location, everything we needed. the hosts were very helpful and responsive. would stay here again

we really enjoyed our weeklong stay! the place was peaceful after a long day of sightseeing and easy to access. it is conveniently located to many restaurants, time square, and the metro system. we would definitely recommend it!
a lovely space in a fabulous location. michael was responsive, helpful, and welcoming. our rooms were private, clean, and comfortable. the home has a wonderful feeling.

great place! living space larger than photographs indicate. outdoor space is very nice. there are stairs to house and to garden, bathroom is small, and one door is beads not a door (not a problem for us, just fyi). bikes were a wonderful amenity to have.
sarah and her husband are amazing hosts!!! place was beautiful and very homey. thank you for the hospitality. we will look you up nex time we take a trip with no kids!!!
place was just as pictured, easy check-in and out.
jana's ground-floor apartment is the perfect place for a week-long work trip: it is private, quiet, has full amenities, and very clean. we will certainly be back again!

a great stay, wonderful location. the apartment itself is exactly what i needed and is spacious. the amenities were all working and avi is a responsive host. would highly recommend and look forward to staying again in future.
a beautiful, romantic apartment
palce is spacious and quiet
the place is very near to columbia university, 15 mins walking distance. very easy to find, right next to the subway station.
nice place to stay, jessica was friendly and helpful!

jenny and ted responsed quickly to requests, gave local tips and even walked us to the closest metro the day we arrived. early checkin and late checkout were freely given. coffee every morning and at the time we asked was a special bonus.

this was a fabulous find in the heart of brooklyn. near all bus and train connections. great local food (not rays has great pizza). plus douglas was the perfect host, giving us directions and recommendations which were spot on. he has a beautiful space in a quiet neighborhood. i highly recommend it and look forward to returning in the future.

roberta is a lovely and thoughtful host. the apartment is really confortable, well equipped and well located, close from bus station and subway. you can access to canal street in 20min l had a perfect stay and would easily come back there. definitely a place to be

deidre’s place was just as described. we really enjoyed our stay. the lockbox check-in and check-out was easy. we were curious how things would go with the shared bathroom but we experienced no difficulties during our visit. we would definitely come again. thank you, deidre!
camilla’s apartment was perfect for our needs. quiet, comfy, and in a great location. i would definitely stay here again
small but clean. room can get very cold in the winter.
clean place. everything as pictured. very close to the train station. restaurants, pharmacies and stores nearby. quiet neighborhood. would definitely stay again.

dorina was such an amazing host form the very begging she responded immediately to emails and questions. the moment you arrive she checks in with you to make sure everything is okay. the apartment is located a short walk to the subway station which is about 30-40 minutes to midtown manhattan. the apartment is brand new tastefully decorated, feels both spacious and cozy. it's a nice and quiet neighborhood which gives you a feeling of belonging. the sushi place in metropolitan is highly recommended or the italian restaurant nearby is very good as well. the kitchen is stocked with the breakfast necessities and you have all the necessary pots and pans to cook as well if you feel like. it was a short and delightful stay and anyone who's in luck to find availability is lucky to be dorina's guest!

this was a perfect place for my family of 5 to stay as we were here attending a wedding in brooklyn. the subway was literally a 5 minute walk away to the winthrop station. this was the first time using the subway and it couldn't have been easier or more convenient. a tap with apple pay and the #2 got us to everywhere we needed to go in the city. i believe the neighborhood is "little caribbean" or something, and it's filled with people at the local restaurants, etc., until late in the evening. we went out walking several late nights for some things at the local convenience stores and felt totally safe. it seems like one of those areas where everyone knows each other. they actually shut down our street on a saturday for some block party. i was worried the music and party would go late into the evening but by around 8pm they shut things down. yaakov was very proactive with communication and took care of everything while we were there. i definitely would recommend this place!

overall good stay in the location we wanted as we were in brooklyn for a graduation. cons: spotty wi-fi. if you need a solid connection for work or just to watch tv, forget about it.... ants were coming in from the patio door into the kitchen and onto the countertops...we were unable to fully enjoy the patio as the down stairs neighbors' dog continually ran up the patio stairs barking. we didn't want to take the chance of getting bit anf one guest had a pet allergy... the kitchen is well short of cookware and such...similarly, the home is not supplied with an adequate amount of linens for larger parties and the home is not equiped with a washer/dryer.
patricia is a great host and the place and location were fantastic! access to midtown manhattan was surprisingly fast and our family enjoyed staying in that part of manhattan.

christa and zach were very nice and helpful. the house itself is great and the room is small but definitely enough for one person traveling. lively neighborhood with lots and close to convenient subway stop. only thing is it's not super convenient to take public transport to airports so taxi or über is the better option.

from personal experience (obviously), i enjoyed my weekend stay. perfect for 2-4 people that want a calm and simple experience. the host was very nice, the place was very clean and the amenities were well served.

jennifer was a great host and the apartment itself is lovely and cozy. it was perfectly warm and clean. the neighborhood is mostly quiet and has tons of great food options nearby. (check out tom’s diner, nacho macho taco, and grab some patties from mrs. muffin) all in all a wonderful stay!

professionally managed and exactly as advertised. there are lots of little touches that leave you needing nothing. the location is fantastic, along with the actual residence, and just a worthwhile stay overall.

our stay was absolutely wonderful!!! this apartment was a complete antique lovers dream!!!! everything was even more than perfect! by far my very best ever airbnb experience. thank you chris & gilma!! ❤️
gordon was and is amazing!!! he was so welcoming and his place was very clean and felt like home!!!!
great place to stay!
one of the best airbnb experiences we have had - very nice space!
great location, easily walkable to the javits center & time square.
david's place is lovely! it's cozy and accommodating to all needs you'd have on a trip. what tops it off is the location which is conveniently near many amazing restaurants and coffee shops.

marek and his family are the perfect host. their apartment his clean and close to the beach (you can walk to one of the best beach in ny) and to the subway. you are one hour from manhattan. when you enter the apartment for the first time is like a dream come true: the place its really like the pictures and the reviews says ! welcome in nyc and at the beach all together.
sean's place was very aptly described. it suited our needs very well. good location.

lovely studio apartment! very comfortable with all the basic amenities. the bed is very comfortable with great pillows and nice linens. michelle is extremely prompt with communication. enjoyed staying there!

we stayed in danica's house for 12 days and it was wonderful, the house is as described, the metro and train are just 2 bloks away from the house, grocerys and everything you need, the neighborhood is very calm, we enjoyed our staying there and if we have to come again to new york we would definitely stay over again :))

liana was helpful before and during our stay. the apartment was exactly as shown. it's clean and bright, with beautiful windows that open onto a great deck. it's pretty spacious for a ny apartment. the area has lots of restaurants, coffee houses, shops and a subway line into the city, just minutes away. we had a wonderful stay.

had a great stay. if i need a short stay in nyc, i’d easily rent here again. place was beautifully and thoughtfully decorated by seth and was clean. ac unit in room. i was here on a stressful work trip and the room was great to come back to to unwind. location allowed me to walk to places i needed to get to and the l train close by. he’s quick to respond and if you want recommendations - just ask. definitely recommend.

i had the most amazing stay here in brooklyn. the studio was clean and had everything i needed, the outside balcony was the best part. i was also able to drop my bags off early and leave them in the hallway until my room was ready for check in. will definitely stay here again.

in searching for a new home, leyla was well accommodating to my full month stay. hosts are friendly, and kind. always responsive and patient. maintain a peaceful atmosphere. the small room was peaceful, and cozy. the walks to the m, g, and a train are about 15-20 minutes each way.
great host, nice location. very responsive and helpful host.
great place, helpful host and very responsive!
straight forward and simple.

i had a great stay at vincent's place. it was a very quiet and convenient location for brooklyn. it was a great space that had all the amenities needed, and i was very comfortable. i would stay here again if i were coming to brooklyn.
i enjoyed my overnight stay. christina was wonderful host and very accommodating.
it's a good and clear place to live. it has convenient transportation, and it's simple to find a parking space. but the bathroom is shared, not private as described.
loved staying here! the space is clean, and bright and in a great neighborhood. the backyard space is gorgeous and there’s a great dvd selection too!

great room in brooklyn. the apartment was comfortable and beautifully decorated. it was spotless even with cats in there. you have a subway station 5 minutes from the place that can take you to manhattan. hosts were nice and helpful.

the studio is minimal and well-designed, with plenty of storage, and the location is perfect. however, be aware that the wooden floors and stairs can be noisy, which might be an issue if you're working from home or a light sleeper. overall, i loved my stay in the village and this charming cabin studio!
the place is really great and cozy!
the hotel was awesome! the view was great! it’s walking distance to everything. it’s a smaller space than i imagined but overall a great place & i’d stay again!
modern and clean space. the host was very friendly and responsive.

the location is great for a pratt institute visit. it can get noisy during nights on weekends due to activity on street but this typical for new york apartment. the apartment satisfies all the basic needs and it is huge for a nyc apartment. brooklyn kolasche across from apartment is great for breakfast. if one looks around for parking it is easy find a stop with a block of the apartment. some enhancements can make the apartment posh as advertised.
gorgeous space a short walk away from the stores/subway. the building felt very safe and secured, highly recommend.
was good.okay for the price. monisha was helpful and quick to respond.

dr. bedi, was practically family in my 10 weeks in nyc, it was truly a home away from home! i’m gonna visit him even when i’m not living there, this is the best place for students to spend their summer in nyc
i loved loved loved this place, everything was neat, and clean, and the host made sure my accommodations were met. i had a good time, i will book again my next visit
vigil made my cousin feel very comfortable and welcomed. the room she provided was exactly how it was listed on her site. it was clean and comfortable. my cousin enjoyed her stay there.

we enjoyed out stay! the showers are awesome! the house is less than a mile from the staten island ferry (free) which we rode a bunch. there is a fenced backyard for the dogs (shared with the other units). great home!
had an amazing stay at joanna's place. the apartment was beautifully kept and in a great location to explore brooklyn.
a clean and cozy space in a great location -- i would come back!
kris was a kind, patient and lovely host. the place is lovely and had a brilliant authentic charm to it and was a pleasure staying there

there’s a great restaurant at the top of the hill to the right second door very friendly owner literally saw us walking in the streets started talking to us who walked about 23 blocks, looking at all kinds of other restaurants and decided we really like the fact, the guy said hello then wait there for every meal when we weren’t at the stadium except for times square. heading to the stadium was fine with the subway, but it’s actually quicker to walk back when the game was over. plus, it was a nice walk very convenient also to take the subway to go down the times square where i met with many of my past employees we had a great time. even got lucky that my son who were celebrating his birthday with his girlfriend, got on the jumbotron at the stadium

our stay was very comfortable and the home was so clean which is super important to me. every room smelled great and matched the description perfectly. it was the perfect space for our family and our hosts were very responsive. i would definitely stay again.

douglas and monica are fab hosts. they responded really quickly to queries and went out of their way to make us feel welcome. the apartment is beautiful, comfortable and spacious enough for us to chill out there when the heat wave got too hot outside. the location is a great base for getting to all the sights of nyc and i loved the fact i could walk to central park.

jarret and dan are amazing hosts who have curated a lovely experience in a beautiful part of brooklyn! you really get to feel apart of the community! jarret and dan were responsive and flexible with us and did everything they could to make our stay comfortable and fun!
linda was super helpful, the apartment was clean and very functional. all super!

we had a great stay. perfect location for staying in manhattan; everything seemed like a short walk or a quick subway ride away (subway stations were right outside the hotel). the space felt a bit cramped for 5 people, however for the price and convenience, we would book again. the host was super responsive, which made checking in/out or any requests we had easily accommodated.

liron and his wife are great hosts, always responsive and helpful. the appartment is nice and spacious and you'll find everything you need. with the subway nearby you can easily explore manhattan, queens, brooklyn etc. we can definitely recommend this great place!

antonio was extremely good on communication. good instructions. fast response. my daughter stayed two nights with us. antonio brought sheets and towels down for her in minutes! also, his mom helped us get back into the apartment after locking both sets of keys inside. we had just said "goodbye" to antonio as he was stepping out...all the info to contact him was inside the apartment. thankfully, is mom came to our rescue. it was a very nice stay. we especially liked it being on one level, ground floor. my husband had an injured ankle, so that made things easy.

marcus is an exceptional host. he was always avaiable when i nrrd him and he even agreed for me to stay an extra day when i asked. thank you so much. you were very amazing. i will definitely come back here
had a very pleasant stay and enjoyed interaction and conversations with alysia and rachel - both very helpful and provided wonderful hospitality.
this is a great place to stay if you’re looking for a place to stay in queens. the hostess is very responsive and the room is really nice. the balcony makes it a perfect place to start your day.

i am so happy i stayed at meli's place. to be honest i am not a fan of new york and i was skeptical about using an airbnb but she exceeded all my expectations, even the touch of having snacks and water for me was very thoughtful because my flight was delayed somewhat. this was really super host type service!
nia was great- so hospitable and the room was perfect for me. would definitely stay again!
great communication and super clean!

ash is a fantastic host. extremely available, accommodating, and generous. the house is gorgeous, incredibly spacious (even bigger than the pics) and well appointed, a dream sanctuary. the location can't be beat. this is a great spot.
great location, clean, comfortable, great restaurant/lobby area to work from as well. i give this place an a for sure!

the property was extremely clean, the room spatious enough for two people and their bags, furnished with everything you need. location very convenient. great communication - we received every piece of useful information at the most appropriate moment.
celina and her husband are very helpful and welcoming.

impeccably clean and spacious studio with a very comfortable bed. situated a few mins walk to the subway, and also very close to some great bars and restaurants. norman was kind enough to let me extend my checkout due to a late flight. highly recommend!

overall decent spot to stay at in the city if you can adapt on the go. very clean room, beds were comfortable, check in/out process was straight forward. few issues with getting hot water during the second day, we had to take cold showers. bring ear plugs at night to block out the street noise and noise from the heater (clicking noise). parking was a bit of a hassle as we couldn’t do overnight parking for consecutive days, had to move the car 2-3 blocks away and walk back.
great location, great room, and an amazing space with a splendid view for the price. highly recommend!
booked last minute, everything was super quick and ready

great value, good location, clean place and accurately described. the apartment has some signs of wear and tear but the place was clean and what you see in the pictures is what you get. olga was responsive with communication, the neighborhood is safe, and there were no surprises. a good overall experience.
the place is stunning! beautiful views, great location, 5 stars for the cleanliness. would definitely book it again.
emmanuel is very kind and attentive. the location is fantastic! close to the long island railroad plus lots of great restaurants and cafes.
great location and easy check in process
felt right at home! very beautiful space and super attentive host! had such a great stay ★
juliette is great to work with and is attentive about check. she always makes sure i have everything i require.

adam is really kind and friendly host, i'm really glad that i met him! he was also really flexible with the checkout time which helped us a lot! location is in walking distance to the nearest 2 subways and has nice restaurants, cafes nearby. we liked the neighborhood and didn't run into any issues. would definitely recommend this place!

great location in a nice area of east village, neat little apartment, everything was absolutely fine. easy access, however you do need to walk up some a couple of flights of stairs (no elevator access) - so be aware if you don't like carrying your luggage up stairs! pretty quiet street too for manhatten! definately reccommend

this place is just okay. it really wasn’t what we were expecting, as we planned to have a 5 person friendsgiving. there’s no real dining table. only saving grade really is that the place had beautiful natural sunlight but for the price of the place, we thought it would be much bigger. i’ve stayed in much bigger homes in clinton hill for around the same nightly rate. there were ants in the kitchen, sheets and towels looked dingy. it’s a cute apartment but not a nice airbnb. use that info how you will.
marjorie’s home is beautiful

jesse was a fantastic host. this airbnb was just what my family needed for our stay in nyc. we had 6 people and we fit comfortably in the airbnb, especially since we were out and about most of the time. this space was very walkable to nearby attractions and close to the subway entrance. jesse was quick to respond and very kind. matt helped us check in to the airbnb and he was extremely helpful! i would recommend this space to anyone looking to travel to nyc. thank you jesse & matt!
tanya’s place was in a great location where you can walk 5 minutes and find breakfast, lunch or dinner. parking was a breeze and the street felt quiet and safe.
great, great place. easy check-in, beautifully decorated, spacious and comfortable. loved the neighborhood too — it was the perfect place for a weekend in brooklyn.
a nice dorm/hotel style room for quick trips to the city! shower takes quite a while to get to a usable temperature.
our stay in chunhsien’s place was great! place is exactly how it is described, clear instructions and good location

everything was like i expected. small place good for two people with private bathroom. very good for the price. better stay here than expensive manhattan. we are from country where everything is a way cheaper so we were very thankfull that we found place like this. near the subway, quiet and peacefull. raj was very caring. he often asked if we need something. but we had there everything we needed. when you don't look for luxurious place but simple place to stay this is very good choice. sorry for my english 😀

wonderful stay! as a brooklyn native coming back for a work trip, i felt right at home!! hosts were super responsive, accommodating and sweet. lots to do in the neighborhood, close to restaurants, grocery stores, and the many happenings of bushwick and bed-stuy. apartment was super cute! lovely furnishings, spotless and all around very homey!
dionne was a great host. she was always readily available to talk and assist if there was a problem. my friends and i really enjoyed our stay!

this is a really nice stay at a good location of lower manhattan. the room is clean and big, with a kitchenette where you can make quick breakfast for yourself. the room is literally private, and you basically wouldn't hear any noises during nights and you can rest well on the cozy bed. it is noteworthy that you will need to climb up to your bed (which maybe a concern for some people but not for me.) lastely, the host iryna is really nice and helpful and gives quick responses. i enjoyed this little room very much.
this apartment in sky is great. we enjoyed our time near hudson yards. beautiful building.

this place is so clean and so cute! it’s everything i had in mind in a new york style apartment! i highly recommend this place if your looking for an affordable place. it’s very close to the subway so you can easily get to the city in 15-20 minutes depending on where you are going. ruthven and olympia were so gracious hosts and walked us through the apartment upon our arrival! great place!
great location, amazing view. very clean and equipped. smooth communications and extreme fast check-in with through a door-man. highly recommended.
good location, comfortable beds.
nice hotel very convenient for a short stay or layover night

we had a great time at chris apartment! chris was super friendly and welcoming and had lots of recommendations for bars and restaurants in the neighborhood. the apartment was very clean and the room was nice and spacious. highly recommended!

after a great week in ny with base in thomas´ authentic luxury 1 bedroom loft can i only recommend to rent this apartment. we lived two ladies and two men without any problems. the apartment is located excellent with 5 min to the nearest subway which brings you till union sq. in about 15 min. it´s a nice neighborhood with good restaurants and chilled bars, and close to bedford st. which clearly worth a visit. finally it had the most awesome rooftop with the most unique view. rent it and have a great time ! phil
place is convenient and nearby times square, central park. bedsheets and towels were stinking
this was great value for the price! the location is spot on and in a safe neighborhood!
a wonderful place in a great location - a nice friendly neighbourhood with good transport links. perfect for my short business trip.
beautiful apartment. photos don't do it justice. central location. we would definitely visit again. thanks gary!

karen and faruk were great hosts; although we didn't have the opportunity to meet them they were constantly in touch with me to ensure my family and i were comfortable. i can't comment on the amenities nearby as we didn't have time to experience them, but the availability of a parking spot was very helpful for us, and we found it so easy to get to manhattan from there. feeling safe is paramount to anyone's stay, and although the area appeared to have a few rough edges, we slept at ease knowing there was a 24 hr doorman guarding the building.

i thoroughly enjoyed my stay at edgar’s even though it was just for two nights. he was a very helpful and accommodating host with the sweetest cat! his apt was very clean as well as the room i stayed in. the g train is within walking distance and the apt is nearby many bodegas/cafes/restaurants. will definitely be staying here the next time i’m in ny so i can see digi again. :)

honestly, this was the best place that i have ever stayed in within all my trips to new york. my friends and i were amazed by the amount of space that we had. we were able to open all of our suitcases and leave them open the entire trip. there was room for us to do our makeup, sit and chill, everything! the bathroom had all of our necessities. the room had enough storage and entertainment for us to enjoy. i told everyone about this space and how i will be booking again in the future. thank you hilton brooklyn for giving us this beautiful place with an affordable price!

its been great living here for two months now, and looking forward for another month, andrew been extremely kind and doing his best to have a comfortable stay, the place is very convenient, good location and safe area.

yoo mi's place is immaculately clean. it's also in a prime location, accessible to many popular food joints and a short walking distance to the water. my stay was extremely comfortable and left me feeling refreshed and reenergized. yoo mi is a fantastic host and i highly recommend her.

it was my second time stay at yamid’s place. everything is great with convenient location, 2 blocks away from 7 train station. will come back when time is good. thanks again yamid for everything. hope all is well,
hello keishin is superb, ian is extremely the location is superb, ian is extremely communicative and easy to deal with. check-in was seamless and everything in the unit worked.
had an amazing stay, was better than the pictures!
had a great stay, the location is good and the surrounding neighborhoods are easy to get to by walking or metro.

what’s good: the price is cheap, it’s very clean and it is central. so you can commute easily as you have the trains and buses right in front of the hotel. you’re close broadway. checkin in is really quick and there is someone at the lobby pretty much all the time. what’s not good: the airbnb listing is a bit unclear about the fact the room is located in a 3 stars hotel. so, expect 3 stars hotel customers. i got the room 701 and as mentioned in the listing, you can’t regulate your room temperature. so you’re either really hot and dry or you have to open the window and get some freezing air from outside. the heating system makes a horrible banging noise every 15 minutes. it’s impossible to sleep and that explains why they give you free earplugs upon checkin. they were nice enough to give me another bedroom but i couldn’t sleep for 3 days and had to sleep somewhere else for a night.

joe's place was very well organized and was exactly the same as the pictures. the apartment is equipped with all the things which you may require during your stay. me and my family was very satisfied with the stay.
the ridge was accommodating, proactive in communications, and a great home base during our week of professional development in nyc. we will return!
amazing location. great beds. nice balcony. decent value but kind of expensive. i would stay here again!
cover the needs, sleep and shower! very good location, subway and transportation just a few blocks away
great, comfortable stay. would recommend to anyone in the area.
great place, spacious, comfortable beds, just a good time.

very spacious and peaceful room that includes all amenities that make it feel more like a studio apartment. located under a minute from the q train, so it’s an excellent spot for commuting. the surrounding area has plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacy, etc. so you’ll want for nothing. as the other reviews have mentioned, janice is an extremely personable and communicative host. she went the extra mile to make me feel at home and it was always wonderful speaking to her! definitely recommend this place for any length of stay.

akari's place is amazing, well designed, spacious, and super clean! akari is the most gracious host, i can't thank her enough. highly recommended definitely my top choice for my next visit, thank you akari
the location was great and the room was spacious enough for all of our guests. easy check in and check out along with a place to keep bags prior to and after. great place to stay!

great location and safe/quiet neighborhood. is close to multiple bus stops that will get you to a metro station. close to airport as well. giovanni is a great host! always responsive and open to help if needed.

we can't emphasize enough what an amazing time we had at roxanne's place in brooklyn. the set-up was perfect for everyone in our two-family covid-conscious group. roxanne was incredibly helpful and really thought of everything as she planned and stocked this beautiful space. special touches like milk and juice, cereals and snacks were very much appreciated and the pool table, video games and treadmill were a huge hit. the location is great and parking was easy -- a perfect bed stuy home away from home! we can't thank roxanne enough for letting us stay at her place and hope to return some day soon!

maite is very awesome host i’ve ever met. she is very helpful and kind. she always ready to help me. if i have some problems, she always solved that problem quickly. the room is very similar with pictures. and house location is really good for moving anywhere in new york. i really recommend this room. really thank you maite :)

i had an enjoyable stay at waldemar's apartment in brooklyn. the room is large with a small balcony overlooking the backyards, a modern private bathroom, and a tv with lots of channels. i was greeted by kitty, the friendly house cat on arrival. it's only 2 blocks from the subway and a good, affordable choice for exploring brooklyn or manhattan.
spacious high ceilinged room in charming old brooklyn brownstone. very good value for money. (locks on room door and bathroom door would be a good addition given that other guests use house.)
this place has become my second home seriously! i plan on finishing the rest of the summer at this spot if i can . it’s a break away from the city and easy access to the beach
shully was a great host, very nice and welcoming, the place looked exactly like the pictures and was even better in person, super clean and i would definitely recommend it.

a great location , margo was always available. neat neighborhood. apartment was spacious, clean, beautiful. location , location , location. close to whole foods, handy since we cooked some of our meals. able to explore also walking distance to columbia university, subway buses..
stayed at charles place in october 2018. the place is great and the location is just amazing you are so close to everything new york has to offer. very happy to recommend to anyone!
absolutely wonderful- peaceful oasis in one of the best neighbourhoods in nyc. hosts could not be more thoughtful. 10/10 would stay again!

kim welcomed me warmly and made sure i had everything i needed, including a space heater when i thought i might be cold. kim was available when needed but otherwise i had plenty of privacy to come and go. coffee shops and a great patisserie are right around the corner, and the building is walkable to major subway lines. i would be happy to stay here again.
great place. e quiet neighborhood. very clean.
great deal for the heart of manhattan! each family member got their own space to decompress. and comfy beds!
seira was so kind and helpful and her place is in an amazing location. not a matter of if, but when, we’ll be back. highly recommend!
a very nice stay and place is very clean.kerri is a great host..will recommend this place.
perfect location. right near subway stops, couldn't recommend the place more! koichi was the perfect host

the inside of this place is a charm. the upgraded kitchen and bathroom are clean and very comfortable. love the gas stove and full size frig. the bed and pillows were perfect for us. slept very well. it was colder than expected outside (15 degrees) and we stayed indoors and it was very comfortable. i had never been to the area, so i was a bit surprised by the subway noise and there is a hospital across the street. you can hear the host family upstairs, but that didn't bother us much because we have a toddler too. it's very secure, as there were three separate doors to enter the unit. whilst inside, we were at home and very comfortable. subway stop is just around the corner. the area is definitely up and coming with a lot of construction. like any other neighborhood going through gentrification, there are pros and cons. indian food a few blocks over, indian masala, was fantastic! great corner store around the block with lots of organics.

loved my stay! the location was incredibly convenient and made it easy to get around the city. the staff was friendly, and everything was clean and comfortable. my only minor con was that the rooms are on the smaller side but that’s pretty typical for nyc. overall, i had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!
was flexible with check-in and responsive to messages which we really appreciated. airbnb was clean and exactly as described. perfect for what we needed.

my children and i loved our stay at rhonda's place. rhonda is very friendly and made us feel at ease and at home. the apartment is nice, clean and comfortable. the location is perfect! it is on a peaceful, quiet street with so much bed-stuy culture to explore nearby. i highly recommend a stay at rhonda's air bnb.
very accommodating staff. great location. very close to central park and subway terminal. lots of restaurant choices within easy walking distance. cvs pharmacy right across the street.

nandas house its amazing, there its a lot of privacy and the basement has everything you could ask for. we didnt meet her, but we met her husband who was really kind. there is a luigis pizza really close , i definetly recommend it.
the location was perfect. 3 bathrooms. clean and true to the pics. thanks for the hospitality.

igloo is no longer there :( but other than that, great place. far from the big noise but sirens can still get noisy, if you're sensitive to noise i would suggest taking some noise canceling plugs. right at koreatown so lots of food near by & only a 20 min walk to times square. we fit 6 people & place is big enough not to feel too crowded.

henri's place was a perfect location for us.... just a 15 minute walk to times square.... the theater where we saw a show.. empire state building....and the train station! koreatown had so much going on on a saturday night in the winter i would love to go in the summer where i'm sure it's alot more bustling! henri gave us food recommendations as well (bread and butter came in handy at 12am when we got back in from our show and we were starving) and answered any question i had! i would def stay here again!
great location. easy walks to public transportation.

great value for the price! friendly staff, convenient location near whole foods and cvs, and breakfast included. the room was a bit small, no views, and room service was average, but overall a pleasant stay.
ken and morteen were wonderful guests. the locality was safe and lovely. the place was beautiful, clean and i felt right at home. will definitely come back again
beautiful place, relatively quiet area and place, responsive host(s), room was exactly as pictured and things were easy to find. close to public transit
the location was great and lots of local places to grab a coffee or some food.

our stay was fantastic! we were looking for a place in canarsie to be close to family and also that had parking! kwadwo’s home was perfect for us! a front yard, private driveway and very spacious! kwadwo is quick to respond, reached out ahead of our stay and made sure he was available for questions. highly recommend and will return in the future!
it was fine for and my wife and dog ..we had the place to ourselves so it was peaceful ..the hostess was pleasant

i had to book on very last minut this room at jamie's house. with her boyfriend, they have been really reactive and really helpful with me. i can't stop saying thank you for this ! even if the room doesn't have a window, it's so quiet, so it's perfect after hanging the whole day in the noise of a huge town. also, it's really clean. and the cat is really friendly. you can book your stay without any fear.
everything was really great, just that we needed for our trip, the location is good, and everything was clean and organized, like in the pictures, thankful with chester.

i really enjoyed staying here. the neighborhood is calm but with some good shops for coffee and food right around it. the train is close (though when it was hot it felt far away!) the hosts were great: offered coffee and shared an umbrella. i've stayed in a few places in the area and this was the best for a short stay.

this was perfect for our group. easily walkable to shops and great restaurants. close to public transit. private and clean and quiet, with a host that was considerate and responsive but not intrusive. highly recommended!

gregory's place was as shown in the pictures, all worked well, he kept in touch to check we were having no problems, the place is near a station to take line 2 into manhattan and it was very convenient. overall very good experience.

janet was a perfect host and her place is lovely. it’s location is great, easy walking to subways and the m60 that goes to laguardia. her airbnb provided everything we needed and having breakfast items and some frozen meals for us was a plus! also having a washer and dryer available was great. be sure to read the nyc binder janet has compiled. it’s a combination of resource and historical information. i look forward to staying there again!
budget location, close to subway, amazing
rafael is an amazing host, the apartment is in a very calm area, is clean and comfy. right next to the subway station to manhattan or jfk. suggested!

shama's place was exactly what we were looking for. my friends traveling to meet us from nc were able to check in early which they really appreciated. place was spotless, and quite large for nyc. beds were comfortable. short walk to the subway, and places to eat. really enjoyed this location. would definitely stay again
great place in great neighborhood. perfect size and location for four people. everything was as expected and better. host is very helpful. will go again.
great apartment, nice neighborhood, spotless clean, all amenities, clear and warm communication. just perfect!

we had a perfect stay at liesha‘s place. everything was as described. liesha even allowed us to check out late as our flights home were at night. the communication with liesha was great and we would definetely stay again at this place. nothing to complain about!

this is an ideal location for two. it is a shotgun layout, but works well. a nice patio is out the back door. situated in a brownstone neighborhood, the subway is an easy walk to take you to ny. restaurants line the streets and brooklyn bridge is within walking distance. all amenities including a washer/dryer are available. very nice, accommodating hosts! we would definitely do this place again!

this was an amazing apartment for my long work stay in new york for one month. oel went over and above to accomodate my needs for a long stay. he was flexible and responsive at all times of day. the apartment was clean and spacious. i was able to easily use the kitchen to cook, as well as the laundry facilities. the location is fabulous only blocks from all the main shopping on 5th avenue. i highly recommend staying here.
nice place, nice location. super quick responses from the host, which is very important to me.
great stay. host was quick in responding
lovely comfortable apartment. beautiful backyard and great location. jane is very accommodating and thoughtful. we had a wonderful stay . would cone back again
the apartment is located in a great spot in bed-stuy. the house was clean and quiet. highly recommended.
yes, amazing house i recommend
this was a great find! close to family and walkable to parks, museums, train and restaurants!! we plan on returning!
it’s very good for the price. clean, comfortable, mear chinatown. i liked it a lot.

jimmy's apartment was perfect for my husband and i very good location and on the back of the building so it was pretty quiet! jimmy was a great host and greeted us at the apartment and was very accommodating. we would love to stay again. only warning... four floors up!

i never slept on such a hard mattress - i would be probably better off sleeping on a friends couch, haha. there was also an upcharge for 2 people coming into the room. why? god knows. the host's costs stay the same, we didn't take more space, so its just money extortion. had to pay extra $20/day to stay with my wife. my bad i didn't select 2 guests on the website but i never considered that a queen bed room might cost more for 2 than for 1. the chair and table in the room are 3/5, cant really work there, the table would rock around too much and the chair is the cheapest one you can find.
definitely would like to stay here again the next time i’m in new york. it was very clean and had such a cool atmosphere

my daughter and i stayed for two months and it was perfect here. close to everything uptown and also to the subway and busses to go anywhere in the city. if you like using city bike, that’s another option. sheine’s apartment is comfortable and roomy and looks just like in the photos. for an apartment in nyc, there is so much space! we cooked meals here with all the utensils needed including a blender. the kitchen is ny style and only seats 2. the internet worked well for work. sheine was responsive and easy to communicate with. i will definitely stay here again when i’m in the city. thank you so much sheine!

this apartment was just what we were looking for to stay in nyc over the christmas vacations. it is located in a quiet and safe neighborhood near to the park. it was very convenient for the subway. it was really well equipped with cable tv, wifi, home theater etc. we had everything we needed (even two new bicycles!) and it had we fully equipped kitchen too, so we could cook! it was clean, new and well-maintained. the agent was helpful and flexible. the price was right!! i would absolutely recommend this place to anyone wishing to stay in nyc for a while.
second time staying and it was just as great as my first, would definitely book again !

this apartment was perfect for our stay in park slope. the decor is fun, sophisticated and a bit whimsical, such a treat for the senses! lots of attention to detail was involved in creating this lovely space. the necessities weren’t overlooked either; everything we needed was here. well-stocked kitchen and nice bathroom amenities. the bed was very comfortable as well. we’d love to stay here again the next time we visit.

al’s place is a really nice space in great location. close to the subway which made it very easy to get around the city. also located near markers to pick up necessities like water, snacks, etc. we would definitely stay again the next time were in brooklyn.
