me and my other half stayed at cynthias from 28th dec until 4th jan 2011. the apartment is in a great location about a ten second walk from the subway, and then a quick route straight down to times square. the area is lovely with a great smoothie shop with cheap prices just round the corner which cynthia kindly took us to. the apartment itself is amazing!! me and my other half absolutely loved everything about her place it was very homely, clean and just stunning!! after a stressful 18 hour journey thanks to many delays, we arrived in the middle of the night and what a relief to arrive to such a nice welcoming apartment was fantastic. cynthia is a lovely kind hearted, warm person and we are very grateful to have met her and stayed at her beautiful home. we look forward to visiting again hopefully in the summer :) ps... we stayed in the grand room, the bed is extremely comfortable and you will get a great nights sleep!!
very clean, very pleasant!
as always staying at marcelo's place is excellent. will continue to book reservations at marcelo's. 😘
is nice, clean and very close to jfk for thos traveling.
really enjoyed the stay. in addition to the great services and attentions detailed earlier, the airbnb, when needed, was a nice retreat for us from ours comings and goings in nyc.

this place was fantastic! very clean and had all amenities. bonus points, we were able to drop off our luggage before check in which gave us more time to check out ny. great location with easy access to the subway station and bus stops, will add it is quite a walk if you are not use to walking. over all i would definitely stay again.
really amazing place. close to public transport and surrounded by great food spots, parks, and attractions. sid was an amazing host!

the place is well kept aside from some minor things that may have been overlooked during the cleaning process. heating system is loud and obnoxious when turned on. it makes a hissing sound which didn’t allow for a good nights sleep. heating system doesn’t properly warm the space but a space heater is provided. it’s a basement add-on with little to no insulation to keep the space warm during winter months. bathroom and fridge had previously used items still left behind from previous guest. i expected everything to be immaculate for the price i paid. also was charged for cleaning fee and was expected to clean the place before i left. i’m not sure why i’m paying a cleaning fee if i was directed to clean and remove trash myself. low clearance ceilings not recommended for tall people. neighborhood isn’t in the greatest of areas in the bronx. street parking is impossible especially after a certain time. very limited street parking especially if you try finding parking at night.
shelley's place was amazingly perfect! everything we needed was provided and it was the coziest airbnb ever! not to mention, she is an amazing host!

i had such a great time staying in sancar's loft. their place is wonderful; full of light, well decorated and located in a great area. sancar is an amazing host; very communicative, thoughtful and helpful. he provided lots of great tips and took the time to make sure that i had checked in with no issues. this was hands down the best air bnb experience i ever had and i highly recommend it. thanks sancar!

we had a great stay in this beautiful apartment!! the neighborhood has so much to offer and is in vibrant area of brooklyn. the walk to the j was really nice and you’re a very quick ride into manhattan. i really enjoyed the laundry in the kitchen area and would have packed lighter for our weekend. also i enjoyed my coffee outside in the back patio. i will absolutely look to see if kristophers apartment is available for our next visit. thanks again!
this apartment is fantastically located, clean and well equipped for a fantastic nyc trip whatever your purpose. it is small but comfortable.

stunning room, just as advertised. the hosts were incredibly helpful and friendly. the location was ideal, right in the financial district, plenty food options, shops, and train stations. i will stay here again.
the bed was comfortable.
lovely spot in brooklyn - hosts were great and the space was too. if you’re considering this spot - do it.
i’m definitely booking leon’s place again. i felt welcomed, and comfy.

this room is as listed: large, clean, very comfortable bed, window that opens and a/c. access to a kitchen with use of the refrig, microwave and dishes was convenient. room is on the second floor, where you share the bathroom and kitchen with others renting rooms. during my stay there was only two of us so no problem. haydar was welcoming and alway quick to respond to text mgs.

soon and francine are very very friendly!we have a good time here.the whole family (including a lovely dog and two cats)impressed us with comfortable house and warm-hearted help.we love the peace and quiet after visiting crowded nyc for a day.and the soft bed help us to sleep well,as well as great for my wife to overcome the jet lag!by the way,francine made the most fantastic coffee!we appreciate it!all in all,it’s a great place! -hao and yan

the apartment was really comfortable, spacious for ny and immaculately clean.check in was stressless and viviana was a great host responding very quickly to any communication. the location was great, very close to the metro.i can recommend this apartment.
great location. close enough to walk anywhere you want to go and lots of great spots to eat/drink right near the apt.. made for a wonderful time in nyc.
great clean space. perfect for one day before or after flights.
yonathan responded very quickly and check on you for assistance from time to time even when he is out of town. the location is very convenient. it was a pleasant stay.

my stay was absolutely perfect. the room might be small for some people but it was great for me and the little bathroom for myself was a plus. it was very clean and the bed super comfortable. i would highly recommend staying there!

owen’s place was well situated, and a great place to spend a month working remotely. the apartment’s double panes windows made this the quietest spot i’ve had in new york, despite being on a major street. it was set up for easy work-from-home, and i could cook, work, exercise and live comfortably. the bed is comfortable, the space is not huge but well divided to create discrete spaces, and the bathroom is large and well appointed. checking in was very easy, and both owen and his father were extremely communicative and quick to help out. i’d definitely stay here again!
it’s ok if you just need a place to sleep. the top bunk had inclined steps so it wasn’t really safe for going up/ down. it’s definitely a small room but it’s fine for a short term stay
a clean and peaceful place in a vibrant and nice neighborhood. byron is a kind and interesting person. i enjoyed my stay in his home and will definitely stay there again.
this was a great to stay. the staff was really helpful and kind. it’s a great location and closed to a subway stop. the entrance was really pretty and the place was clean. i would stay here again.
good experience every time

immediately the house creates a very welcoming vibe- with cool decor, nice lighting and a warm atmosphere. there were plenty of ammenities (ear plugs, toiletries for the shower), a very easy and stress free check in procedure.
martin is incredibly friendly and communicative. he quickly answered any questions that came up, and did so enthusiastically. he is a stellar host!

the hudson river hotel is in a prime central location in nyc which makes it awesome for the price you pay! we did find that the door to our room didn't lock unless we slammed the door but it wasn't anything we were unable to work around. would recommend if you're looking for an affordable central location and don't plan on spending much time in the hotel!
awesome stay. hosts were very helpful and responsive. the spot was well furnished, clean, and comfortable. would definitely come again.

a light, bright, and airy apartment, perfectly located in a peaceful neighborhood. lots going on nearby with quick and easy travel downtown on the subway or bus. dennis was super-reponsive and friendly. would stay again!

gil was a great host and very welcoming. he communicated regularly before we arrived and gave excellent instructions for getting in, etc. he provided a very nice summary of local amenities as well. the location is in a beautiful neighborhood near brooklyn college, leafy and pleasant. easy access to the subway right nearby.
rooms smaller than expected and shown in photos. common areas need better cleaning and maintenance. well connected but the area felt a little unsafe.

gorgeous brownstone in a perfect location in brooklyn, easy access to subway and lots of local restaurants and shops. we drove in and didn’t have a problem parking on the street. this was the perfect spot for a girls trip to see harry styles. 10/10
close to public transit so makes it really always to get into the city.. for the price it is a very good value and makes it hard to beat!
booked this place for my family. they were absolutely gushing about it! loved everything about the box house, hands down will be the only place we use for ny trips.

with a refrigerator, a microwave, television and water heater in your room all to yourself, you just feel at home. also have spare phone charger. allowed me to checking before time and also to checkout after time. you are provided with enough bottle water, shampoo, conditioner, body lotion and soap. the room is so big and the bed is extra large and the host is very friendly. a home away from home.

we really enjoyed staying in the spring room, it was actually better than i expected. in the photo it looks like it doesn't have any windows, but it actually has a skylight so you do get natural light. it's close to the subway, in a pretty convenient area. good value for money, considering how expensive everything in ny is. the house is super clean. i was worried about the shared bathrooms, but they were always spotless. the best things were the little touches, like the fact that there's always a pile of clean wash cloths in the bathrooms, so you don't have to dry your hands or face with the same towel everyone's been using; or the fact that they have a bunch of free earplugs by the entrance for those who can't sleep with the sound of ny sirens (which you'll get anywhere in new york, this place was actually quieter than most.) there was free oatmeal, coffee, and cereal bars for breakfast, which was great. we didn't get to meet brady, but jen was very friendly and welcoming, and brady was super responsive over email. all in all, a great stay, i'd definitely recommend it to anyone visiting new york!
nice and clean place to stay. very good host dan. thank you!

a wonderful place with matching photos and accurate description, conveniently located near a metro station to manhattan. we stayed for a couple of days, and it was perfect for four people. would definitely stay here again!
lovely airbnb in chelsea! very clean and in great condition. wonderful stay!
great place to stay in brooklyn.
this was a great location… near the subway, restaurants, local amenities. great stay. perfectly
johnny is a really nice person, he did everything he could to create comfort. the apartment was very clean in a good area not far from transport, i recommend to everyone.

a peaceful, quiet, and comforting stay! the host was very nice, and responded quickly. the stay was great and very comfy, and very centralized to everything like the train, groceries, local restaurants, bars, and bakery.

would highly reccommend jeffs place. clean cosy bed and close to subway and bus routes. jeff was great to respond to any queries i had and was extremely helpful. great first air bnb experience. would happily return.

nomad’s place is great for tourism. its location is strategic close to bryant park, empire state, times square and easy access to public transportation. there’s many places and free activities to do in the area. nomad’s place was very clean, organized and they thought about everything when setting up this space. highly recommended!

i stayed at carmen's place for a month while exploring the city and couldn't be happier! the place was quiet, clean, and the host was attentive in making sure i had everything i needed during my stay. fortunately most of the things i ended up needing were thought of already. would stay again.

joy was really nice, made me feel like i was home. didn’t see her much, but i think that’s supposed to be a good thing. i appreciated her letting me in really late because of my flight. i would come back.
very clean, well stocked kitchen & bathroom, responsive and friendly host - thank you, sherryl!
jim was so warm and friendly. his apartment was perfect for us. the area is nice and well connected. 5 stars!
amazing host! super clean super friendly

this is an absolute gem for the price. situated in the heart of midtown manhattan within walking distance of the empire state building, times square or even central park, among others (within our week-long trip, we only had to make a few public transport rides!). there are many stores nearby - we especially appreciated whole foods market and macy's, both 5 minutes away on foot. the apartment itself is smaller but sufficient for 2 people. the windows are also not facing the street, which was a big plus as no noise was coming in. the only flaw was a bad odor coming from the bathroom (based on other reviews, this is probably an ongoing problem) and the building was quite noisy at night/early morning, but generally ok with earplugs. this is the only reason for 4/5 stars. if i stay again in nyc, this will be one of my main options again!! :)
what a wonderful spot, we can’t talk highly enough about this place and the great service. definitely will be back! thanks manuela :)
stylish space, responsive host and plenty to do in the area. i’d come back for any future trips!

johny was a fantastic host who was always nearby or available for any help needed. the apartment is very spacious for new york, an excellent value! very clean and comfortable accommodations. safe neighborhood with friendly neighbors. minutes to the train and short ride to anywhere in brooklyn. not a ton of late night options in the immediate area but everything you would need could be found. highly recommended!
charles was a great host and was there for everything we needed. it was a charming room in a real brooklyn brownstone and i would recommend to anyone

marjorie is a great host! we love the location and the people of hell’s kitchen. she is kind and helpful and just a genuine lady! she helped me navigate the subways when i told her some of the places my daughter and i were going. she told us where this great market was around the corner when we wanted to pick up a few groceries! i felt like i was a part of the neighborhood! i recommend her place. it was cozy and inviting and we felt right at home! it’s close to time square and broadway if you wanna see a show! we had a blast!
great stay here. i’ve stayed in the area before, so knew my way around. good room, right next to shared bathroom for ease, host great and friendly. would/will stay again.
beautiful !! the pictures do it no justice ! daniel also responded very quickly and was very attentive to all of our needs . i will definitely be back ! thank you again ❤️
i recommend staying at his beautiful abode. such a friendly host, and i enjoyed staying here for the weekend 😀

loved our thanksgiving weekend stay on staten island! house afforded us plenty of room for everyone. it was a great neighborhood — nice delis and italian restaurants within walking distance. house was fully supplied, and the communication with marina was wonderful!
harvin was very responsive and helpful. gave us great local food and shopping recommendations. would definitely stay there again!

it was a good place to stay in brooklyn, well connected with bus line (b63). check-in instruction was pretty clear by the host and she was quite helpful. guest can use the kitchen accessories, bathroom is private but access is outside of the room (just right side of the bedroom). overall it was a great stay.
great place close to everything in the city and with everything we needed.

highly recommend this place. just 2 mins walk to the mta and bus stop right in front of the house. hosts were really responsive and helpful with everything that we needed. clean house overall and great location.
anthony’s airbnb was great! very clean and a pretty quiet neighborhood. it was close to public transit and great for our family trip to nyc.

fatima was a super nice host, and help us with everything we needed with a great vibe and always a smile. the apartment is beautiful and very special, location is perfect and for sure we will be back. waiting to meet you again f!

abbe’s place is cozy quiet and relaxing. we loved the rain head shower and general vibe of the place. would definitely recommend!!! abbe was super quick to communicate and was proactively making sure things were going good with our stay. we will definitely be looking her place up the next time we’re in the area.

the best place for your days in n.y. the apartment was fantastic close to different restaurants and one block away from the subway line that takes you to manhattan, brooklyn or back to queens in just one train. also close by is astoria park, a great place to walk around and see the sunset, and if you like to try something different the astoria ferry station is just 25 min away walking and you can also take it to move around the city with spectacular views. the bedroom is amazing with everything that you need, comfortable bed, widescreen tv and organizers for your stuff as well as air conditioning. i couldn’t have stayed at a better place to explore new york
a very nice apartment in a good location. i would certainly stay there again. the super, tom, was also extremely helpful,
clean and neat, convenient location.
exceeded all my expectations. tony is a wonderful hands on host, always available to accommodate his guest. lucky to have had this experience.
evelyn was very helpful and welcoming. the apartment is charming and in a perfect spot. you are in the middle of the west village, walk to everything. thanks
had an amazing time. even extended our stay for one more day, which nita and eka were more than happy to accommodate.
alex was great, hdr roommate mike was very helpful and the apartment was exactly as described and it worked beautifully.

the studio was well maintained and spacious. everything was pretty clean except the drawers to store clothing in (they were quite dusty). communication was an issue - the management company prefers to communicate off of the airbnb platform, especially for any issues, and i prefer to use the airbnb platform for safety. the air conditioning started smelling and spewing black soot all over the bed and floor during a particularly hot few days. neither airbnb or i could get in touch with the host for a full evening/night so airbnb provided alternate hotel accommodation. the location is great and the subway was a. 5 minute walk. the elevator in the building is a great amenity, just know that there are many stairs out front before you reach the elevator. i loved the apartment and would have totally considered staying here again if it weren't for the communication difficulties.

great place to stay you’re in new york city and a great value. the house is beautifully redone on the outside. classic wood floors inside with an updated bathroom. i stayed one night and enjoyed the neighborhood as well. this is a great spot. i would stay here again.
excellent price- it’s just like the apartments in the neighborhood-

jennifer's places was great! it's a short walk from trains, shops nearby. jennifer was a great host, welcoming and responsive. we stayed one night on a drive through nyc, it suited us (2 people) perfectly.

the listing was exactly as advertised. tara was incredibly responsive and the apartment is beautiful. it's in a great part of williamsburg and one is just minutes away from some outstanding bars and restaraunts.
no complaints, very comfortable bedroom with all the premium cable stations, quiet safe urban area right by a large park. i would stay here again.
amazing host, easy communication.
good small place , very clean if you wanna get away , just felt the wifi was slow and the tv wasn’t working but besides that great place!

i had an amazing stay with emily & saul. i’ve stayed at many airbnbs so i’m very picky. i know these hosts have multiple places however my room was different than the one i thought i booked. i was expecting two windows and the microwave area but all i got was the fridge. other than that everything was fine. i found a couple of hairs on my linens but i didn’t let it freak me out too much. i brought my own towels thankfully. as a thicker couple the ones provided was pretty small. the bathroom could’ve used a little paint. otherwise 10/10. would i stay here again absolutely. the price the area and the view and how close to the water it is. made it all worth it. there’s soo many things near by like corner stores, cafes, restaurants. the area is pretty quiet even with night life and the people were so kind. i’m ready to book again. it’s great for a quick weekend trip. we were able to find parking every night even if we had to walk around the corner or down the street. thank you! ✨

my mom and i had a great time staying in this basement flat. it's spacious, cool, and very clean in a cute, quiet part of brooklyn. it's a quick 3-5 min walk to the subway (q train), which gets you into manhattan pretty quickly, and the free on-site parking is very helpful if you're driving into the city. it's also a great place to be if you want to walk around and explore brooklyn. jerry was very helpful and accommodating! we very much enjoyed our stay here!

we had a great stay at jessica’s place. it’s very convenient for exploring brooklyn and manhattan. jessica is a great host and left books for my kid which i really appreciated. the place is cute and comfortable, there is a bit of street noise in the night but that is to be expected for nyc.
amazing room great views of the city with definitely come again
gabriel was a great host and the location was perfect and super close to the train. being a hop, skip, and a jump away from prospect park was wonderful. would definitely stay again.
it was a pleasure to stay in this apartment. it’s close to the main streets, really clean and the host is really nice. i highly recommend it !!!

charlie and sam were absolutely fantastic. the space was beautiful and i enjoyed a glimpse of life in a delightful neighborhood. charlie and sam were very thorough and thoughtful and i appreciate everything they did to make my stay enjoyable.
paget’s place is clean, well decorated, and clearly cared for! if your travels bring you to brooklyn look no further for a delightful and well-priced stay.
the price was responsible and the building was very quite
great location and good design!

good location- the ritz diner next door is great. i was sent the wrong property details 36 hours before check-in : property was in harlem, not upper east side. mistakes happen and the team were very apologetic. however, when the correct details were sent through when we landed in new york they were missing the key lock box code. spent 20 minutes standing outside the property on the phone until we were eventually told the correct code for the lock box -last thing you want after a long-haul flight and hour-long taxi ride from the airport.

small room, better for 2 guests than 3 or 4. but wonderful hospitality; kin is very responsive and overall a great host. location is unparalleled; good latin american and chinese eats nearby, and the subway is very accessible.

the receptionist was rude and unaccommodating regarding the unclear airbnb check-in instructions, placing the blame on us instead of helping. their lack of respect was disappointing, but everything was eventually sorted out, and the rest of the stay was good.
clean and tidy, convenient transportation, safe environment, the landlord is warm-hearted and kind, and i will come again next time.
this is a perfect space that is strategically situated. highly recommended!
the the apartment was very secure, spacious and easily accessible to public transportation.
very accommodating, great locations, and overall a good stay.

a lovely place in a great neighborhood. annette herself is wonderful - responsive, welcoming, warm, and friendly. knowing that i was in town looking for an apartment, she even asked around about places for me!
great hospitality and location

wonderfully charming place, but ac is loud and old.. i didn’t mind, but some might. they were very accommodating bringing me a fan, and a tea kettle etc. very pleasant staff. food at restaurant was awesome too!
you pay for what you get here! a great little space, in the center of one of the greatest cities in the world! did the job well for our 1 week stay.
a lovely place to stay in ny

i cannot say enough for the host (evan) and his cool cat, marty ! everything was fantastic, clean, great location, quick replies, super helpful, nice amenities. evan is a fantastic, caring host and you cannot go wrong staying at his upper west side apt in a quaint, old brownstone! total thumbs up all around ! thx evan, and of course, his friendly cat, marty ! :)
the location on canal street is excellent, close to many shopping and dining options. overall a good experience. room was slightly smaller than expected, but not unreasonable given the location.
great place, clean and a lot space close to everything.
wonderful listing very close to lga. clean, and easy to communicate with.

loved the convenience of this location, within 5 to 10 minutes of the subway m line. room was very clean and had everything i needed for a multi day stay. check in was quick and easy, deposit as stated. i stayed on level 3 facing the street, so the street noise was a bit more obvious. light street noise doesn’t bother me though, and it was only a few of the nights that i was as aware of it. you are close to public housing and there are often clusters of people scattered around the neighborhood at odd hours, which may explain why some people feel unsafe, however, i experienced absolutely no issues or feelings of being unsafe during my marathon laps to the subway and around the neighborhood and through the housing itself. bottom line, it’s worth it and i’d stay again if plans allow.

if you are in the bronx area shully's place is where you want to stay, nice quiet area, her place is clean and immaculately kept. its close to restaurants, stores, public transportation . walking distance to the bus and train. there are grocery store, fish market and pharmacy. she also provides refreshment and snacks for her guest. everything is at close proximity. you don't have to worry about getting food to eat or about getting around this is the place to be...… shully's place.

patricia flat is fantastic and is a perfect location near soho, nolita and little italy, the view is fantastic. patricia is very nice, she gave us a lot of good advices and helped us to get to the airport on our last day. i highly raccomend this place.

super, very comfortable stay apartment completely furnished with all necessary utensils and accessories. all items are of extremely high quality and the environment makes us feel like we were at home. no detail was left behind, everything is very well maintained by the host. host very polite, thoughtful, gentle. he is a very nice guy. the street is very quiet, close to metro stations. close to markets and pharmacies. it was a very satisfying experience. i would like to stay in this apartment again when i return to new york. thanks!
it was an excellent stay and a beautiful clean home.

this is a great apartment. the location is good, it is not far from the subway station and there are many shops and restaurants around. the apt is on the first floor, generally it is quiet though sometimes may hear footsteps from the upper floor, but i think it doesn’t matter. the decoration is wonderful, it makes you feel like at home. you can find everything you need, especially the cooking tools and materials in the kitchen. rob is super kind, he answered our questions quickly and is willing to help. he even provided some snacks for us to enjoy! overall we had an enjoyable experience in this apt and we definitely will come again the next time we visit new york.

overall, my girlfriend and i had a great stay. the area was safe, and right next to central park. it is just 2 streets down from the blue line, and the red line is a bit further, about 3 avenues down, so convenient to get to the subway. it was actually quiet at night, which is surprising given it is the city. a lot of food options near the broadway area, with my personal favorite being miss saigon. the host will usually answer any questions or concerns promptly and succinctly. the super intendant, jack was extremely helpful as well. during our stay, the bedroom did not have a windows ac like the picture, and the washer looking thing in the kitchen photo does not exist. friendly suggestion to the host to please update the pictures so future guests may make an informed decision. i would have given a 5 star review had these pictures been accurate. a useful tip to future guests: bring smaller suitcases instead of larger ones as the stairway up is a bit narrow.
sadio was very responsive and helpful, and provided a clean, comfortable stay.
felix is such a great host, very responsive, helpful, and friendly. we were very well taken care of. the house is comfortable and very spacious.

the city is awesome, and this place was too. looks just like it did in the pictures and was very cozy. the host was very responsive and accommodating. walk to bagels and coffee, and grocery stores. loved it.

teedo was an awesome host. super responsive to any issues we ran into, and always laid back and kind when interacting. he gave us really helpful tips about navigating the area. the space is exactly like the pictures, and is incredibly spacious. couldn’t have asked for a better stay!

excellent spot very close to the city center and a few blocks from msg. the staff are wonderful and the facility is very clean. they held my bag for me for the day after check out which i very much appreciated. one thing i should stress, this is more similar to a hostel type facility than a conventional hotel. rooms are about the size of sleeper car on a train with open tops so you hear everything on the floor. i would stay here again.

my stay was great! there are several bus lines that are within a block or two to connect to the subway. very convenient! the bathroom was very clean! that is my biggest peeve at places i stay and i was pleasantly surprised.

andrew's place was well taken care of and very clean. the bed was comfortable, and the closet and bathroom storage spacious for new york! we were very happy with our stay there, and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it for others.

april was really a great host. the room and shared space was everything i needed. great energy and great person. thank you for opening your space! the neighborhood is also great, alot of nice spots and 5 min walk to subway. would definitely come back! thank you again!

would have been a very nice stay, but there was no blanket in the room, only sheets. brooklyn was very nice and communicative, but not home the night i stayed, and since there were no blankets and the temperature outside was in the low 40's, i turned the heater on. the heater was so loud it sound like plane propellers gearing up to take off. i spent the night either awake because the heater was so loud or awake because i turned the heater off but was freezing under only a top sheet. when i requested a partial refund i was only offered $20. with a proper heating system and/or blankets, this would be an absolutely lovely stay and well worth the money!
great place to stay, definitely will stay there again.
a last minute booking; however, it was such a comfortable/cute space. johnathan and his family was also very accommodating.

we selected this property based on the number of positive reviews it has received over an extended period and we would say the stay lived up to its reputation. from the moment we arrived, the host made us feel very welcome and generously shared insights into the local eats, coffee places and other hidden gems in this delightful brownstone neighbourhood. at the same time the host retained a respectful and considerate "arms length" from us for the duration of our stay allowing our family to enjoy the property as our own and enjoy the excitement of ny. the interior of the property was exactly as we saw on the airbnb website - clean, well appointed and comfortable. the beds were extremely comfortable to sleep in. the subway access location was a very convenient 5 minutes away which our family used extensively during our 7 day stay in ny. we would definitely recommend this property to other airbnb subscribers looking for a great place to stay in ny.

frederique's home was immaculate, warm and spacious. i love all the beautiful decor in her home as well. their eye for detail is impressive. the flat is a peaceful refuge from the busy streets of new york. her apartment is close to so many amenities-restaurants, shops, really cool lounges and the subway is a 5 minute walk from their apartment. if you prefer, you could just as easily, step right outside and grab a cab. you honestly do not have to leave the neighborhood, there's so much to do within walking distance from her flat. dealing with frederique and her lovely family was a joy. they returned emails in a timely manner and were just all around good people. i will always check frederique's place first, for availability when visiting new york!
great stay! flexible check in
james and laureta’s place was good for our purposes - location was nearby where we needed to go. good amount of space. at times at night, it was a little loud from neighbors who lived above.
kenna is a great host and easy to communicate with. the place itself was great; 10min walk to subway and decorated beautifully. would definitely recommend to travellers visiting brooklyn!

such a gorgeous place in a beautiful neighbourhood! so nice to come home to a quiet haven at the end of the day. we arrived close to midnight and paget kindly gave us amazing instructions on how to get there. an easy walk from the station and it felt quite safe even though it was very late. super easy to get around, lovely local restaurants, comfy bed and so clean. would highly recommend!

we were absolutely thrilled with the thorough communication of the owners and the space itself was everything that was promised. we felt right at home and the amenities were perfect for what we needed. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend it to others who plan on visiting brooklyn. great value, thoughtful hospitality and huge space for the price. not too far from the subway into manhattan and other parts of brooklyn.

great apartment on the top floor of a brownstone in a great location. easy access to subways. excellent restaurants nearby. very good street parking by nyc standards. the apartment has ample closet space. beds are comfortable and the kitchen is functional. we stayed for six weeks and had a nice time. we would do so again. the host was professional and responsive.

really enjoyed our stay! the apartment is very spacious and comfortable. the location was great, just blocks from great brunch options. street parking was very easy, and the hosts couldn’t have been more lovely. definitely recommend and would definitely stay again!
lovely little room a few blocks from the cruise piers. perfect!

wonderful place with lots of character and charm! we were greeted very warmly and had a wonderful stay. close to bus stop and were provided with help on the bus schedule even by hans! great choice for a staten island stay.

this place is clean. it’s at the edge of chinatown, which you don’t know until they reveal the address, so , if you don’t know the subway system or buses..it’s not a great location.. only a couple of restaurants if that in the near vicinity. also the bedding was quite inadequate, a light quilt and no other bedding available in winter🤷🏽‍♀️ and not enough towels !! i’ve used airbnb for years and this was a bit of a disappointment

great spot, david is wonderful, amazing neighborhood. easy to get everywhere, safe (despite no doorman). got a $115 parking ticket, despite spending hours in the car daily making sure to adhere to rules. bathroom doesnt have a real door, so lacks privacy. overall, a good spot and a great host.
nice place to stay for a couple nights

my days at this lovely and cozy apartment were amazing. ideal for a chillin getaway with everything you need to feel like you are at home. nina was super clear and supportive on each communication making the experience even better. the surroundings are gorgeous, very close to jfk airport and the big city. can't wait to come back again. 100% recommendable!
we enjoyed our stay and highly recommend staying with allen & his lovely wife! from a squeaky clean room, to fresh bagels in the morning, we loved it all!
frederick's place was great! decorated impeccably, and he was accommodating and great to hang out with over a lovely glass of scotch :) highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in park slope.

this airbnb was great. it's in brooklyn, but subway and bus stops into the city were only a few blocks away. it was very comfortable, safe, and cozy. we had a long weekend exploring the city so we basically were only there to sleep and shower, but i'd highly recommend this airbnb. the hosts were great, friendly and communicated all relevant info (like wifi, check in procedures, etc.). i'd definitely stay there again.
great spot for a night or two in bk!

yvette’s place is amazing! this studio apartment is calming, serene and ultra comfortable. the bed was perfect and the room stay cooled with a big ceiling fan. yvette is very friendly and makes you feel welcome the minute you step in the place. excellent location with tons of amenities in the neighbourhood and accessibility to public transit. i will definitely stay here again!!

2nd time staying here - 100% recommend it. the apartment is beautiful, perfect location, all amenities provided, easy check-in. the local area is really nice too, with lots of things to do, places to eat/drink & quick connection into downtown brooklyn, williamsburg & manhattan. sush has been an amazing host - professional, super nice and very accommodating. thank you sush!
peaceful location. respectful & responsive host. comfortable amenities. felt safe.
easy to check in after a late flight. everything was clean and as expected.

mathieu’s place is a perfect place for a couple who wants to rent the whole place near public transportation in safe and trendy area at the same time with an affordable price! we stayed in his place for a month and always felt welcomed thanks to his hospitality. it seems to me that his place is as same as(or better than) pictures and descriptions in airbnb. i highly recommend his place for a couple or a small size family for the following reasons. first of all, his place is a very clean and spacious studio which is fully equipped (even with free netflix&disney&hulu) with an affordable price. we couldn’t have lots of fun in new york city due to covid-19 but we really enjoyed staying in his place thanks to netflix and disney with a huge and cozy sofa :-) secondly, it’s located near a subway (3-5 mins to f&g train by walk) which takes 15 mins to soho, and bus (2 mins by walk) which take 10 mins to ikea. third, the neighborhood is so peaceful and surrounded with beautiful brownstones and there are lots of trendy boutique shops and restaurants nearby. also, there is even a trader joe’s which is my favorite grocery store in nyc 15 mins by walk. lastly, mathieu is the best host i’ve ever met!!! we were looking for a place which we could check in with a day notice. luckily, he made us feel welcomed even at the late hour. he gave us lots of useful information around the neighborhood and also a first aid kit just in case. also, he provided us with toilet papers while nyc was having a toilet papers crisis due to covid-19. he even gave us clean sheets and towels every week so we didn’t need to wash the sheets and towels by ourselves for a month. and he always responded to our messages and requests like changing light bulbs promptly. so we felt very comfortable in his place. when i visit nyc in the future, i will definitely stay in his place again!!!

adrianne is a friendly person and her apartment is very comfortable, clean and near the subway. we enjoyed a lot the apartment because is an excellent location for exploring new york, there are also many restaurants and shops. we recommend this place.
this was a very nice spot! i had to book last minute and it was well worth it!

i love the place it’s really reasonable and is spacious. the host she’s nice and she was very accurate with her response back to me. i would definitely recommend her place to anyone. and it’s in a nice area, the house was very clean. and she have a lot of amenities.
worst stay , host was very very rude .

beautiful home, fantastic location! thank you for being a great host! i was so happy with the room, that i repeated my booking for the next time i'm around! thank you so very much for making this an awesome experience!

sarah and allon are wonderfull hosts. we liked the apartment very much. the bed fits perfectly for two. we would definitly come back. fort greene is in my eyes a fantastic neighboorhood. i always felt secure there. and we definitly recommand allons coffee.

henry street is the best! it's a super charming space in one of the dreamiest neighborhoods in new york. alexis and jay are quick to respond, friendly and helpful. it's hard to overstate how nice it is to have a dishwasher and washer/dryer in nyc. the apartment is really quiet and peaceful, plus the neighbors have a bird feeder so birds and squirrels visit your balcony. don't hesitate to book this place!
had a great stay while getting started at a new job, apartment is on a nice tree-lined street, conveniently located, and near lots of great food.
great location, just what we needed!

if you're looking for character and charm and location, look no further - we loved this apartment!!! other pros: much bigger than most apartments in hell's kitchen at this price point, big windows (that open!) on both sides, very comfy bed, big closet, good water pressure in the shower + bathtub, very kind and helpful host! flags: have to go through bedroom to get to toilet & kitchenette (layout exactly as shown on schematic), so might not work for all groups; on second floor without elevator and open stairs, so might not work for really little kids or seniors. recommended, especially for a couple or small family!

the stay was absolutely fantastic. it was very welcoming and beautiful, cozy, and lots of and lovely things. it was definitely above and beyond. the neighborhood is nice location, and one thing i can say is i promise that anyone who stays here will be very happy with themselves for choosing to stay here.
karen was incredibly hospitable and generous. my brother and i had a lovely stay. great location - in the heart of park slope with prospect park a short walk away.
christina’s place was incredibly clean, comfortable, spacious and in a fantastic location. she was a consummate host, very responsive, friendly, and flexible
caio and juliana were great hosts! they were very communicative and their unit is clean, well furnished and close to lots of great shops and parks. we thoroughly enjoyed staying at their place!

we really enjoyed our stay here. the place was clean and the hosts were very thoughtful with the amenities. parking is available which is a huge plus and rare in nyc. the hosts are super nice and quick in responding to our needs, and we received a bunch of useful tips and suggestions on where to go, what attractions to see in nyc, and how to get around brooklyn, manhattan, and other places.

i stayed here with my two sons during our trip. the surrounding environment was wonderful; it was a quiet and safe place despite being very close to the subway station. additionally, the transportation to manhattan was very convenient, making our trip to new york extremely satisfying.

i just had an excellent stay at elena's apartment. this is what airbnb was meant to be. a responsive owner, a great location, accurate description and nice amenities add up to a very successful stay. delighted to have had the opportunity to stay here.

jon was a great host. everything was left as discussed. the key was easy to get from his doorman and the place was clean and nicely decorated. the fridge had thoughtfully selected snacks and there was plenty of coffee. i felt at home at jon's place and i would highly recommend for anyone that wants a cozy place to stay while visiting new york.
we had the most amazing stay! we’ll definitely stay here again. everything was great about it: location, design and art, communication with susan and her local tips. we loved it.
geeat place to stay right in the middle of little italy. jennifer was very accommodating. i had to extend my stay several times and there was never an issue. highly recommend.
great stay had a great time.

i had an awesome time at jeff's place. he's a fun, outgoing guy, so it felt more like having a cool roommate than just being an airbnb guest. he even invited me to hang out with him! his place is also only a few minutes in walking distance to the train station and a two minute walk to a 24/7 laundromat. there's a full kitchen, a cozy bathroom, and access to an xbox 360 with a choice of movies and shows. i'm glad i got to meet him and spend time with him!

i’m from brooklyn and i lived in bay ridge for many years. there’s tons to do in the area, some amazing restaurants and cafés and bakeries right across the street. the room size is like a hotel room. i was alone, so it was perfect for me. the bathroom is small, but does the job. had an issue with the hot water, but it was fixed promptly. the host are very kind and communicate well. danny is so sweet! he as well made my stay comfortable . you could tell he really loves his job and the guests. the only thing is the mattresses are very soft so you kind of sink into it. i bring my own pillow so no big deal for me. this place is good for a couple of nights. i definitely don’t see four people fitting here. it would be a tight squeeze. but for 1 or 2 it’s good.
no surprises, cozy spot and close to great food!
great stay. great support from emmory the host. place was ideal. would recommend for sure

our stay of 2 nights has not been pleasant at all and i would strongly not recommend to stay in this apartment. at our arrival we found the curtain of the bath tub down with other bathroom equipment and one bed frame broken. in the evening we discovered that the gas cooker was not working, there was apparently no gas therefore no possibility to cook. the owner brought an electric cooker the day after. but the most shocking was our second evening, we came back late and discovered the apartment open the doors and the window of bedroom with lights on all over and the laptop open and several bags open. we found out that a lady was apparently trying to stay also in this apartment and came back at 1:00 am. after several calls with the owner, this is probably a sad story to solve but we felt strongly unsafe and very pleased to leave this place the following morning.

aliza was a wonderful host! i am so sad to leave her beautiful home! she was responsive and accommodating, and truly went above and beyond my expectations; if i asked for anything, she was very quick to arrange it for me. the house was always clean, comfortable, and impeccably decorated. beyond being a great host, aliza is just such a good person, who loves life and loves people. she really shares her home with you during your stay, in the most sincere and generous way.

the apartment is just as described and depicted. it is very clean, comfortable,and quiet. lovely neighborhood of brownstones and tree lined streets. close to markets, eateries, and public transportation. we hope to return and stay there again.

the area seems to be a little shady but nothing like unsafe,juan is a very helpful host. supermarket around the corner,laundry,gym and subway station. the house very clean and tidy. it’s a good value for money in place like manhattan.
maria was extremely accommodating and allowed a last minute booking due to a home emergency we experienced. i really appreciate her graciousness and the comforts of her beautiful apartment.
great stay! close to the subway and nice neighborhood. comfortable space!

i enjoyed my stay. it was very quite and easy to get around. the place was also very clean which i liked. it wasn’t invasive and the subway it’s only a 2 minute walk. i would say i wish the pillows her more comfortable because the flat pillows kinda made sleeping hard but other than that great stay and would book again.
love staying at jennifer's place when i come to brooklyn. quick walk to both subway and citi bike station. she has a such a cozy and unique places, and i always feel at home there.

absolutely amazing!!! laura and her husband are the nicest people. the place is so nice, well designed and clean. they also gave us products for breakfast as a treat and checked us in earlier without a problem, cause we arrived 4 hours before the time. laura recommended us on all the places of where to eat or what to see and was so helpful. i will definitely stay here again!
great stay in excellent location. we’ll be back.

we loved our stay here! super close to the subway station which made it easy to get in and out of manhattan. our stay felt very private and safe! we loved the space and everything was super comfy. we would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this spot!
it's a cool little hotel. a bit over priced and too many fees.

lovely little apt., very clean, , air con very efficient and was needed as weather was very hot although with the apt. being a basement property was reasonably cool anyway, kumar communication was always helpful and prompt, , all kitchen and bathroom equipment clean and modern, everything we needed, location was spot on for harlem or the subway to go downtown, thanks kumar

i had an amazing one month stay at rubens apartment. im glad i chose it as a solo traveller i felt safe and peaceful. the room is nice and had everything i needed. i definitely recommend anyone who is looking for a place to stay in brooklyn.

the room is very close to central park and has a good deli just around the corner. if you are looking for an uncomplicated and basic accommodation in ny and want to be close to shopping opportunities this is a good solution.

i appreciate wilson taking me in as a guest. the room matched the photos, no discrepancies. i enjoyed my stay notwithstanding a few minor inconveniences. going forward, please provide a full set of towels including a washcloth which was missing; a washcloth makes bathing easier. lastly, please enforce quiet hours for all guests; one of the guests maintained a high volume on their television practically all night long until morning to the point of distraction. make these adjustments, i believe you will attain superhost status! this was one of my best airbnb experiences in new york. thank you.

my friend and i stayed with janice for a week while visiting my family in brooklyn. the room is exactly as pictured and much larger than it appears in the photo. the whole apartment is very clean and comfortable. janice is a wonderful host and a very interesting person as well. check-in was a breeze and the location is ideal for getting into manhattan as well as walking to nearby brooklyn neighborhoods. as women, we really appreciated the "little" things - like a lot of hangers in the closet, lots of hot water and having a doorman to help us bring our luggage in. all in all, ad ideal experience!

alicia was a great host, very friendly and welcoming. her apartment is well located, close to the subway and groceries stores. the room is perfect for a solo traveler with a half private bathroom. would definitely stay again.

great place to stay for a vacation in nyc - 3 min walk to g train, 30min with trains to manhattan! bus stop is 3 min walking, you can easily go to domino park in 20min and enjoy the great view of nyc at night. there were also supermarkets 3-5 min walking, where you can buy everything for your breakfest or dinner. we felt very safe in that area. in apartment there is everything you need. we didnt understand how to turn on shower (although raquel gave an instructions) and something was wrong with water tap in bathroom. i highly recomend you this apartment for your staying in nyc!

anna was an excellent host: thoughtful, thorough, and proactive. the apartment was lovely and looked just like the pictures. it was very comfortable and roomy enough to bring a pack and play for our young child—with a full kitchen, laundry, and a dishwasher! a cozy bed, fluffy towels, and interesting art on the walls. the neighborhood is great for families, very safe with lots to do. overall, a great stay, highly recommended. we’d love to return in the future!
description was accurate and their place looked just as good in person. thanks for a great stay!
it was a very nice place to stay as well as a great view on the top floor. would definitely recommend
i will absolutely reccomend this appartment and benjamin! 10 of 10

my sister and i stayed here during our first trip to new york and our first time renting a room instead of an entire apartment—it turned out to be a wonderful experience. the hosts were warm and welcoming, striking the perfect balance between being attentive and respecting our privacy. while we were initially a bit hesitant about the harlem location, we felt completely safe throughout our stay. the neighborhood was peaceful, and the space itself offered plenty of privacy. plus, the convenient access to public transportation made exploring the city easy. highly recommended!

i had a wonderful stay and highly recommend this place. the house itself is full of character and history, yet beautifully maintained. every room reflects thoughtful design, creating a warm, stylish, and inviting atmosphere. everything was exceptionally clean, and the entire space had a unique charm that made it easy to relax and feel at home. what impressed me most was the host. she is genuinely attentive, caring, and dedicated to providing a great guest experience. her attention to detail is remarkable—from the way the space is prepared to the thoughtful touches throughout the stay. you can truly feel the care and effort she puts into hosting. if you're looking for a beautiful, peaceful, and thoughtfully curated place to stay, this is an excellent choice. thank you for making my visit so enjoyable.

marcus and michael are wonderful hosts, and their place, while a little cozy, was perfect for what i needed. with the subway only a couple blocks away and all kinds of food right around either corner, it would be hard to find a better spot.
great stay! great location for getting round manhattan and out to brooklyn, and loads of great restaurants locally. gary was very friendly and the stay went without a hitch!
quick response, great hospitality.
the host, emma, was amazing and everything was a great!

this airbnb stay was truly a gem from start to finish. the apartment is beautifully laid out, spacious, and very clean, with fresh linens, spotless finishes, and a fully equipped kitchen stocked with essentials and complimentary coffee. the in-unit washer and dryer were a huge bonus and made the stay even more convenient. the location is unbeatable, on a quiet, safe street, tree-lined in the heart of harlem, and harlem is truly amazing in itself! the neighborhood is vibrant, full of culture, and surrounded by stunning historic brownstones. just one avenue over on the restaurant row on lenox, you’ll find great restaurants, cafés, wine bars, speakeasies, and grocery stores, making it easy to enjoy everything nearby. subway (b,c, 2,3 train) access is a 5-minute walk, with midtown only 10–15 minutes away. eric and allen were incredibly kind, warm, and thoughtful hosts who made me feel at home right away. i would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting nyc!
this is a beautiful garden suite unit in a lovely brooklyn brownstone and i definitely hope to return! aitan was exceedingly helpful and responsive as a host- cannot recommend this more highly
this was an excellent place to stay in nyc. it has everything you can need, and also, near home you can find groceries and restaurants if you need. the room, bathroom and kitchen was good too.

our stay was very pleasant. the room was clean and comfortable and met our needs. we appreciated the bottles of water in the refrigerator and also the coffee supplies so we could make our coffee in the mornings. marie was friendly and helpful. we would stay there again.
exactly as described. thomas was very communicative and apt is beautiful and right in the middle of the village.

good place to stay for the price. was clean and the beds were good. noise was a problem and also a mouse in the apartment the first night, but amy solved this issue with the building manager. living room was good size, the rest of the apartment tiny. too many food left previous guests may brought the mouse, i think open food should be disposed after vacating the apartment. disgusting to find open ice creams in the freezer, probably was eaten from the box by who knows who. but we only use the apartment for sleeping since we came just for work, so in general, it was ok.
a very clean, pleasant stay for an extended weekend in nyc! menachem's place is easy to access and very walkable to other parts of midtown manhattan for times square or a broadway show.
nice clean space for our family of three. incredible views right across the street from the 9/11 memorial. great location with plenty to do and good food around. would stay again.

the moxy hotel was a great stay for my quick nyc trip. the location was super walkable, with easy access to soho, little italy, and chinatown. another nice perk was the $15 daily resort credit that could be used at the hotel’s bar and restaurant.
a wonderful place to stay and a gracious host!
very welcoming hosts. a quiet neighbourhood, 15 mins walk from a subway station and shops/cafes restaurants. charming house with modern interior and facilities

the apartment was exactly as described, it was very clean, the communication with alessandra and david was easy and very friendly. the location is perfect. i really enjoyed my stay. for new york standards, the value for money is also very good.

laura is hospitable, friendly and we connected right away. the home is beautifully furnished with antique treasures at every corner - i personally enjoyed myself so much just relishing the beauty in all that she has collected. the space is comfortable, private and really clean. this is the property of truly home-proud people. getting around is amazing located between 2 train/subway stations so accessibility is simple and there are options around. however if you drive, it can be a little bit of a pain getting a roadside parking spot being a residential district, hence be prepared to circle around for a spot or walk a bit. i had such a great time staying and working out of the room, though if you have a lot of baggage it might be a bit of a challenge moving up and down the steps leading up to the rooms (slightly steep and narrow). otherwise, lovely place, even lovelier people who are so filled with love and warmth.
it was a good value for the location. the staff was nice and friendly and the process was easy.

the host is very much available when you need something, responds to any of your concerns immediately, and very considerate of your needs. the place is as described, beds were comfy, and the place is very clean. although we did have a little bit of a problem with the bathroom water since it tends to slow down when other tenants of the building is using it. the place is near a grocery store and a bunch of restoraunts. train station is about 4 to 5 blocks away from the place. it is near a main road which is good when you need a ride. also there's a bus that can take you all the way to manhattan right at the corner. but all in all, it was a great stay. definitely recommended it.

we enjoyed our stay. the hotel room was clean and suited our needs for location. the staff at the hotel were helpful and nice. we would stay again. sadly, did not get to enjoy the roof top area due to its hours of 4pm to 11pm.
melissa's place was absolutely wonderful, she's was quick to respond to my questions the views from the roof was so amazing and beautiful would definitely come back again!

amazing location and very convenient for exploring chelsea…really all of nyc, since you’re between two subway stations and walking distance to penn. just be aware it’s a street-facing walk-up on a noisy block, and communication with the host can feel dismissive at times.

alan was a fantastic communicator. his space worked out to be very functional and convenient when my family came to visit my newborn, as it is a block away from my apartment. alan was also very accommodating when we needed to add an additional guest last minute for a family emergency.

great spot for a family, public transportation into new york city is very accessible. neighborhood is a little sketchy but it’s still safer compared to other areas of new york. overall would recommend to anyone planning a trip to nyc, it was a very nice stay and place to relax after a long day! host is also very nice and helpful!

ravanna’s place was the perfect stay for our weekend visit to nyc. the location was perfect- quiet for sleep but just around the corner there’s plenty of fun things to do. she was super easy to communicate with, gave great instructions making parking and getting into the airbnb super easy and straightforward. plenty of bed space and very clean home. i 110% recommend her to anyone going to that area!

we were so glad to have stayed with montifa and saint for our first airbnb experience. the location was great as it was a quiet, easy street to be picked up on by uber. also very close to public transit. a dunkin doughnuts around the corner for breakfast if we needed it. there were also great amenities from our hosts that helped with breakfast and hygiene. a very cozy, comfy place to stay while visiting new york. would absolutely recommend for anyone looking to visit new york city.
bethany's place was great! very clean and cozy. bethany was also very friendly and easy to approach. i highly recommend this place
legit best airbnb stay i’ve had. super enjoyable person and room.

really lovely little flat. very much what you'd expect in brooklyn, small but cute and very much fit for purpose and easy to find. very close to the r train and near a couple lovely sushi spots and a nice pub (kelly's tavern) i will say, the wifi was slow and we weren't able to use any of the streaming services on the roku device, but this didn't impede on our enjoyment of the place. the hosts are also super friendly and instructions to access the flat are very easy to follow. so i can recommend this place, just not if you're working!
i enjoyed my stay. the location was perfect and the space was neat and tidy. i felt super safe and comfortable. i look forward to staying again.

this is a great location, close to the trains, buses, restaurants and museums. it is nice that it is uptown so not as noisy as midtown. it is a walk up brownstone and you walk down into the apt and then down into the bedroom. the room was very spacious. louise was very responsive when we texted her. the apt is also very warm.
very clean and comfortable. location is great, super close to chinatown.
nice and quiet. very close to the best parts of manhattan! great restaurants close by. gracious host. clean bathrooms. comfy bed.
alejandro was great. i was in town for a conference and his space was exactly what i was looking for.
radeishas place was cozy and quiet. things we personally needed were within walking distance as well as bus/train stations. i would recommend staying here!
a lovely comfortable room, friendly and discrete host, and it's a superb location for accessing the buzzy lower east side. i thoroughly recommend!
i appreciate the quick responses anytime i had a question. the place is very clean and has everything that you need. sandra is a great host and knowledgeable about the area
great host and we loved the service of odalis the housekeeper! amazing

this was my first airbnb experience and i was pleasantly surprised. though brady was not in the city during my time there, i was kept informed days leading up to my trip with regards to keys, codes and how to make myself at home. my daughter lived nearby, but we found uber easier than the subway. i don't know brooklyn at all, so i would not venture out without someone familiar with the area. for my purposes, it was great to be close to my daughter. the room was comfortable and there was no excessive street noise. i met one other guest, who was polite and friendly. the house has the basic requirements for a short-term stay and i am glad i came. i want to thank brady in particular for ensuring i had arrived safely and was settled in despite the fact that he was out of town. it was also very comforting and a pleasant surprise when he suggested and arranged my ride to the airport for a very early flight home. thanks for everything. i would not hesitate to recommend this airbnb to anyone wanting comfortable and economical accommodation in brooklyn.

when we first arrived, the unit was extremely hot. it was 100 degrees that day. they didn’t turn on the ac prior to us visiting. only the window ac units worked properly. the kitchen and living room area was unusable during the hot weather. there was an electrical issue as well. when we used the ac cooler in the kitchen and the light in the kitchen was on, the lights continued to go out. the room with the ac cooler didn’t work the first night and we couldn’t sleep in that room. there was a weird smell in the halls and apartment that was unpleasant. we had roaches and didn’t want to use any of the appliances. we also had some wifi issues. we were very uncomfortable and didn’t enjoy our stay. however, i will say she was responsive and attempted to fix some of the issues. she did provide us with a small refund. i would suggest they fix those issues before their next guest. we were looking forward to doing certain things and wasn’t able to because of these issues.
great location, only thing i would say is if you drive try to check in before the work day ends so you could get street parking. his neighbor was nice enough to let me park in their driveway.

jenni’s studio is located in a wonderful brooklyn neighborhood close to good restaurants, grocery store, and lots of local shops, even a movie theatre around the corner. the studio itself is located within the home, but the separate entrance makes it feel more like your own space. the decor is chic, the bed firm and comfortable, and the bathroom and shower were very nice (great towels!). everything was freshly cleaned which i really appreciated. the fridge was stocked with cream for the nestle espresso pod coffee maker (pods were provided), a hot water kettle & tea available, along with dinner ware and utensils. we especially appreciated being able to drop our bags off early before we headed to the brooklyn museum. a great visit!

great all around stay, andrew was very responsive to messages when needed. room offered was more equipped than most similar offerings and was definitely a very good value for money choice we would opt for again if needed. location is also great with markets/coffee stores within a 2 block radius as well as the metro station, with central park being a 10' walk. all in all definitely recommended.
it’s a nice place,we had a good time!

all time high airbnb experience! benjamin`s chelsea studio was great positioned in the new york grid. the apartment has a relaxing energy with is stylish and with quality furniture and materials. it is oriented towards a courtyard that provides a silent atmosphere. communication was effective and smooth check in/out. highly recommended! would love to come back!
great location. too many guests at the same time for just one bathroom. bathroom needs cleaning at least twice daily due to the number of guests.
levi was communicative, the place was easy to get into and clean and conveniently located. a great place to stay.
amazing stay. super clean and easy. love the neighborhood too.

the apartment was great! no issues with pests or loud neighbors, and the doormen are really just so lovely. the location is absolutely incredible - being so near the park was such a treat. checking in was easy, the apartment was mostly clean and good to go, and we really didn't have any issues. cons: the apartment gets almost no natural light. the utilities are included, so it wasn't a big deal keeping the lights on, but working from home was hard without natural light. there's also no dining room table as it shows in the pics - it really wasn't a big deal so i didn't bother bringing it up, but something to note!
loved the place. it was spacious and clean. also appreciated the personal touches, especially with the fresh flowers.

i usually never leave reviews but for ms.yvonne i had to! this is the best bnb i’ve stayed at. it exceeded all my expectation, ms.yvonne comes round often to clean and provides her tenants with more than the basic amenities. she is consistent and easy to communicate with. the neighborhood itself is calm and overall safe. theres a laundromat and supermarket right across the street, and the q3 runs right in-front of the house. theres an lirr and nice(nassau) buses that run a few blocks down. the room itself is very cozy and the walls aren’t thin at all. definitely great for a long term stay.

great place to stay if you’re on a budget. i stayed here for 2 months and it had everything i needed. the apartment was super quiet, and the windows overlooked a courtyard with lots of trees and plants which was really pretty. it also got a surprising amount of natural light. the mini fridge has a small freezer section, although it doesn’t keep things fully frozen (wasn't a big deal for me). the shared bathroom situation was fine as a guy, but i could see it being less ideal for some women. super convenient location, multiple subway stops <1 block away. overall, a very solid budget-friendly option for nyc.
extremely friendly and helpful staff!

this is a great place to stay if you're coming to chelsea or anywhere on manhattan. great location, cozy room, and the snacks can really save the day if you don't feel like buying lunch at manhattan prices.

i absolutely loved staying with wendy. she was warm and welcoming, and her flat was in the perfect location, right near the subway and many lovely bakeries and coffee shops. the room was beautifully decorated, full of the most gorgeous art! i would definitely go back. highly recommended.
beautiful spacious accommodations in an excellent location with comfortable amenities.
great communication and the cat was very cute. overall great stay, and very close to subway station and not far from the bridge parks with great views!

i had an amazing experience. from the moment i arrived, i felt welcomed and at home. the apartment was spotless and exactly as described, with all the amenities i needed for a comfortable stay. the location is fantastic—close to local attractions, great dining options, and transit. carolyn was incredibly responsive and helpful.
it was a great place and a very quiet zone, i did like charle’s place and i strongly recommend it!
we had a wonderful stay at jose’s place! jose is a phenomenal host and very attentive to our needs. would 100% stay again!

overall the stay was ok. very easy to find and even though i arrived at 11:30 at night i wasn’t really worried about anything as they left clear instructions. couple things though. the stay is suite style and the door that goes into the suite doesn’t lock which is a huge safety concern and violation. so much so that i had someone accidentally enter my unit last night, i’m assuming by accident and most likely from me not locking it manually. there is a code to enter the stairs and elevator but someone could tail someone in and you never know what could happen. strongly advise an extra step of security for anyone who stays there by investing in an automated lock for the suite door and another for the personal units. for the value that i paid as well again it was ok overall but the owners do their best to make it feel like an actual hotel which i applaud them on. thanks for letting me stay here.
george's apartment was spacious, immaculately clean and beautifully comfortable. i am looking forward to my next stay this fall!
tiny cosy place very close to penn station, ideal for a brief stop in transit. would stay again in similar circumstances.
super easy to get to anywhere in the city - great location.

the perfect place for my in-between month in nyc! everything you need, very clean. ampere is a very kind host and was almost always available if i needed anything or had questions. can’t recommend it enough!
edgar’s place was fantastic! close to the subway, super nice apartment, and digi the cat is the most wonderful and perfect cat i have ever met!

we love this neighborhood and nina’s place, while small, is comfortable. shower is great, but you have to have a certain amount of agility to get in and out. there is a back yard that we were able to use during the week. nina is quick to respond to any questions or needs.

alfred’s place (and bedrooms) are great. a bed with a little desk and plenty of room to store things above the bed and underneath. restrooms and showers are shared but very clean. the place is quiet (except with some people snoring at night) but other than that i would certainly recommend this place for a few nights in manhattan. alfred is super responsive and very friendly. they offer breakfast in the morning which is a nice treat.

great location, right next to carnegie hall and central park. the front desk was extremely accommodating—they allowed us to check in well before the standard time and granted a late check-out. they also let us store our luggage after checking out, which was very helpful. we stayed on the 11th floor, and it was surprisingly quiet despite being on such a busy street. we would definitely stay here again!

the stay at araz apartment was amazing. the room and bathroom were very clean, cozy and comfortable. check-in and -out were smooth. araz is very friendly and helpful. we had a small situation with the hot water and araz solved it the same day. location is near the subway station and is calm. we recommend this apartment and wish all the best! :)
the stay was very pleasant, billy even let me extend the stay an extra night on the fly when i needed to.

wonderful stay! hosts were very quick to respond to messages and were very friendly. place was clean, comfy, and close to public transport. great location with lots of things to do nearby. plus cute dogs to greet you! ☺️

i stayed 4 nights here while visiting my son in bushwick and this was absolutely perfect for me. if you like what you see in jacqueline’s pictures and description of her place you will not be disappointed! she’s a wonderful host and i was super comfortable sharing the space with her. the whole place was neat, clean and nicely decorated. the bed was very comfortable and the neighborhood is very quiet. i slept very comfortably. the kitchen and bathroom had everything i needed and the shower is awesome. i especially enjoyed the beautiful back porch. i’ll definitely be returning each and every time i visit my son in the future.

quite simply a wonderful month staying at the sculptor house. barrett is an outstanding host who has designed along with zak a beautiful historic home. it is an incomparable way to experience the east village. i look forward to returning soon.
take advantage of the free walking tours

kristen’s place was perfect for our two-week sojourn in brooklyn. it’s large and airy despite being basement level, very nicely equipped and maintained, and very comfortable. communication was very good too and our request for softer pillows was immediately fulfilled. i’d recommend it as a base for anyone visiting new york city.

it was hard to find airbnb in manhattan for a large family. but this place made everyone happy: 4 rooms with queen size beds, thermostat in each room and living room, 2 bathrooms. soundproofed bedrooms with heavy curtains were perfect for a good night's sleep.
the house is very beautiful. loved the hospitality. would definitely come again.

when we firstly came into this appartment? first reaction was wow! absolutely lovely and clean appartment with any dont’s. very polite roomates, 2 clean bathrooms and cozy kitchen. cleaning of the appartment was everyday on place. so wow. i can’t even believe how it was amazing! thank you!♥️ ps: those cokies are spectacular!
very pleasant space! very comfortable and a bit of a hidden gem!
super easy to find, great hosts, would stay there again!

we loved annie and her gorgeous apartment! now we want to be up in that area all the time and stay there. it was very easy to get around. subway was close and great places to eat. the terrace was cool and we loved how helpful annie was! a gem of a place!

very cute hotel-style airbnb - super easy to check in, team very responsive, coffee and food in common area, room itself was very quaint and cozy and had the necessities including a steamer and blowdryer. the only thing is, the heat is constantly on and there’s no way to turn it off so the room got very hot, very quickly. we did open the windows, but it still wasn’t enough. i would suggest that they just lower the heat a little bit if there’s no way to turn it on or off. it was a major problem, but still something to note. otherwise, wonderful stay in a good location, super clean.
great place to stay close to the empire state building!

beautiful condo, stocked with all necessities. we were able to walk to grocery and cook several meals. easy check-in and kilian extended a 15-minute late checkout even though cleaning staff was en route. much appreciated and would definitely book with host again. be sure to check out rooftop views!

great location, very safe neighborhood, close to the central park! the place itself is tidy and very cosy, surprisingly quiet because the windows face the backyard, not the street. the only downside was the check-in – the app they gave me didn't work with the lock, so i had to wait almost an hour for the host to show up with the extra keys. other than that i recommend this place and hope to again stay there myself sometime soon!!
