excellent stay for two busy days in nyc! clean, serene space in a great location: so convenient to be near the c line subway. hosts were quiet at night and very responsive. host jen is witty, helpful, and has great taste - thank you!

after a busy day of exploring manhattan, it was wonderful to come back to a cozy and clean room to rest and recharge. elen was great at communicating and being accommodating. looking forward to another stay.
great host quite place clean and easy to get to the ferry, generous and helpful host
a nice stay, could get hot in the summer but overall a fair price for a nice area to stay in. would recommend.

overall, what you see is what you get here. the rooms are small, but enough if you spend most of your time outside. common spaces were rarely used during my stay. there is a revolving door of tenants, but most of the tenants i interacted with were friendly. my main concern was that during my check in, my sheets were dirty and the room amenities described in the listing weren't accurate. i couldn't reach the host or the company that this listing is through (outpost club) after numerous calls. subsequently, i contacted airbnb's customer support and discussed moving to another location. i was given fresh sheets and a new, larger room the next day. given the stress of dealing with the host, i will not stay here again. that being said, if you're looking for an affordable place to stay in ny, then this fits the bill.
what an amazing experience. thank so much for hosting.

we had a wonderful time at eleonora 's apt. she was so welcoming when i got there. she had flowers for us. also cookies and cupcakes. she could not have been any more inviting and friendly. her place is huge and beautiful. just awesome.

i wholeheartedly recommend dan's place. the check in instructions were detailed, accurate and easy to follow. the apartment was more spacious than i expected. the living room and bedroom were each a good size and the shower cubicle was huge. the kitchen was well equipped. the whole apartment was spotlessly clean. the neighbourhood was quiet and felt safe, even at night. it was easy to get to the subway and lots of shops were a short walk away. prospect park was also a short distance away. it's such a beautiful park that we went there several times in the few days we were at dan's place. we would definitely stay there again.
exactly as advertised, no surprises! was a very cute, cozy and convenient apartment. was also very convenient for my mother who can't easily walk up steps. thanks, angela!
it was a really nice stay in yasemins appartment. thx for all this comfort. pricewise its totally okay for nyc....
great location. near to subway and malls. clean house. quickly response by host.

this apartment is great! nice and big, plenty of space which is at a premium in brooklyn. excellent neighborhood, very near transit to get around town. kim rules. she’s awesome, communicative, super easy going and made the whole stay smooth.

highly recommend. the home was clean, comfortable and roomy with nice decor. walkable to subway, restaurants and stores. daphney provided exceptional assistance. she always responded promptly and made check-in/check-out easy. thank you daphney, looking forward to a return visit.
great location. host very responsive. easy check-in. it's small but rooftop patio made up for that.

maia is great and so friendly! her place is so cozy and well maintained. maia communicates well and gave me clear directions for check in. her cat is super cute.. i’d def stay here again and recommend to anyone who’s interested
this was a great place to stay! clean & in a good location. felt safe & had such a fun trip being able to stay in manhattan for a reasonable cost. would stay here again!
was right in the heart of the city. very close to the subway station which made checking in and out of the hotel with luggage very smooth.
was made feel very welcome, room actually better than photos, great location.
amazed by this place. pictures and description did not do it justice. the room is huge, well decorated and a comfortable bed. 4 min walk to the metro. would definitely stay again!

giovani's apart was really beatiful and we felt there as at home!! it has a good location (close to the metro). the supermarket and laundry are 5 minutes from there by walk. we were there for one week and all was right. we recommend this apartment to everybody!!
a clean, peaceful place with a great and responsive host — a wonderful place to stay.

⭐️⭐️⭐️☆☆ – beautiful space and great location, but not an accommodating experience we recently stayed at this airbnb in new york and found the home itself to be beautiful and in a fantastic location. the neighborhood was vibrant and safe, and the interior was clean, stylish, and exactly as described. however, as fellow airbnb hosts ourselves, we’re very familiar with airbnb policies and the importance of going above and beyond to earn a five-star review. unfortunately, this stay didn’t reflect that level of hospitality. the listing stated that early check-in and late check-out were available for a fee, which was a major reason we chose this property. but when we asked, the host cited a strict 11am checkout policy—implying it was a new york requirement—and said early check-in wasn’t possible. we also arrived on an early flight and simply requested to drop off our bags before the 4pm check-in time, but that accommodation was declined as well. because of this, we ended up paying $150 for

nicely appointed studio in a great location. lots of nice little touches in the fully renovated room. third floor is a bit tough for carrying bags for older folks like me. but worth the effort. i would stay there again.
paying $60 a day to valet at the same hotel your staying at is crazy . besides that the place was great ! nice view and location.
julia allowed me to drop off my bags early and was so kind + communicative through my stay!
nice location, very close to bars

christine’s place in east williamsburg was really nice. it’s super cute. it’s got a nice big desk to work and kitchen is big too (it is shared technically but we were always in the kitchen at different times than the other tenant on the other side of the kitchen). it’s very close to the l subway grand st and supermarket and good places to eat around (thai, indian, pizza, etc). we would definitely recommend staying here. there are some people making noises outside at night but honestly we just found that funny. we overall liked the neighborhood. most importantly, christine was always there to help us and was super responsive. she worked with us whenever we needed anything and we knew we could trust her. would stay again :))

a genuinely warm and welcoming host. responsive, knowledgeable, friendly, generous. really keen that you enjoy and make this "home" and also explore and connect with the area. you're in very good hands! and embraced by genuine welcome.

very nice place in a nice area of brooklyn. would stay here again. jacqueline was easy to communicate with and left us the place to ourselves. everything as expected and more. we love nyc as well !! ty
the place is very nice and cozy, tyler and his dad are extremely kind and welcoming. the only thing i hope they’ll put at home is pan and pots to cook, but anyway they totally deserve 5 stars!
gina is a great host, and this place is fantastic. it was an awesome 4 day trip, and when we come back to nyc we hope to stay here again.
extremely nice and hospitable couple with two of the friendliest kitties. 5/5, would stay again.
great place for our family of four, easy walk to union sq and access to subway. everything was clean and comfortable. would definitely stay here again.

dear marjorie, it was a pleasure to stay at your house! you was so kind and friendly. the room was very clean and decorate nice. brooklyn ist a very safe place and the ferry is only 5 minutes to walk away. when i would come back to nyc i would prefer this stay. thank you!

great prime location in the soho area! it was really convenient to get around manhattan from here. nice clean room with ample lighting and decent amount of space given the prime location. morning coffee and pastries were really appreciated to start the day. i would stay here again next time i'm in nyc.

we wanted to get the ‘real life harlem’, ny experience. if thát is what you wish for, then you will not be disappointed. kevin’s place is up 4 floors, in a real neighbourhood flat, with all the sounds, sights and smells of harlem. thís is how life is lived here. we were warmly welcomed and had a great stay in this honest place. ps - do visit ‘bills place’ for the best live jazz experience available in harlem.
we will definitely be back!

lolita's place is conveniently located close to the n and q train. it's on a very quiet street, but is just 2 blocks from a very lively area of astoria, so there is great food very close by. the check-in process was very straightforward and independent, which was great for me since i arrived late. the room was lovely (with victorian details) and cozy, and it also felt very private. i would absolutely stay here again and have recommended lolita's place to friends.

mary's place is in the perfect location in brooklyn. we felt very much a part of new york as a result of mary's hospitality and tips. biiiiig room, great shower, very clean. great value for money. a month wasn't long enough. everyone shoukd stay wiyh mary!!!!!

great apartment in great location. quick easy access to subway. good shops and eateries nearby on vanderbilt and 5th avenue. flexible accommodation with good space and views of manhattan from deck. comfortable living in tree lined avenue yet still in the thick of things. perfect for city break avoiding overpriced cramped manhattan and a flavour of true new york/brooklyn living. prospect park is also beautiful and spacious. definitely like to comeback eric is a charming friendly host who provides just the right amount information. trustworthy. we had a really good week in new york.

michal's apartment in nyc is the perfect location for access to public transportation, restaurants, wine bars and shopping. quiet neighborhood at night for sleeping. kitchen is well stocked for all your needs. bed is quite comfortable after a long day of sight seeing. had a great stay in michal's perfect apartment in hell's kitchen. highly recommend.

great experience! the place was comfortable and clean, with fresh towels and bright sunlight in the mornings. peter helped us get in, and was helpful during our stay when we needed it. cool neighbourhood. lots of places to eat and check out. peter left out some guides on the coffee table to find places to check out, as well as some interesting magazines to leaf through. thanks peter! love your place. i'll look to stay at yours the next time i'm in town (june, probably).

outstanding airbnb in the heart of prospect heights, with a very helpful and responsive host. the flat had everything we needed for a month long stay with two young kids including large loungeroom, bathtub, internal laundry, great kitchen, two large bedrooms, a leafy outlook, and a green, shady shared backyard that's perfect for summer dinners. it's just minutes from prospect park and lots of restaurants, plus an easy subway to manhattan if you're working there during your stay like me. a secure building with nice neighbours. i'd recommend it.

jon’s place was really great for our 10 day stay in ny. clean, beautiful decor, great and useful amenities. a safe and good location near a lot of subway stations and a vibrant area full of great places to shop and eat. jon himself was a good host and always ensured everything was going great throughout our stay. would stay here again!
very nice place easy to found and a lot atores places to eat !
location was prime, mezzanine was an ideal spot for working remotely, and the staff was super attentive + amicable.
hyacinth was a very generous and accommodating host. i would definitely stay here again!
great place great location

i can’t describe how good the location is, you’re literally in the middle of everything with incredible transport links around the city as well! gerard was also a spectacular host, always being responsive to my queries and working through any problems. thank you!

a top notch location, minutes away from the subway and close to lots of interesting things to see and do. amazing pizza can be had just on the other side of the park! kakuna was great about responding to questions and has lots of great suggestions if you are not sure what to do of an afternoon. if you time it right, you can leave around the same time as their dog is getting his morning walk and that is always a good way to start your day!!!
felix was incredibly warm, welcoming and accommodating. the listing is well-located in plg, and well-equipped with everything (including ac!)

we loved staying in apt. 2b! it is in a great location and very walkable to subways, park, restaurants etc. it has a large bright living room, a nicely renovated kitchen, a good sized bathroom and bedroom with very comfortable sheets and bed. the high ceilings help make the apartment feel spacious. while there is bright sunlight in the living room, the bathroom and bedroom are less well lit. you can't beat the location!

overall the best experience i’ve had yet in staten island! great guy to communicate with, always helpful, and has an awesome place to stay especially for the money. would absolutely stay here again and probably will!

keisha was a wonderful host. she always responded quickly and was very friendly. we came for the labor day parade and you can get very messy from it because they spray paint and oil everywhere, keisha was nice enough to provide towels and lend us her hose to clean off with. the air bnb itself was very nice, it’s small but perfect for two people.
great location and the property manager was amazing and very helpful !!
nice hotel to stay in new york very convenient
just an amazing experience and place !!! beautiful spot !!

i couldn't have asked for a better "first ever" airbnb experience. johnny certainly deserves his superstar host title. for a shared space - this one was top notch. the apartment was exceptional for it's comfort, cleanliness and convenience.

wonderful spot near a dizzying array of subways, and 3 min walk from fort greene park. lots of bodegas and grocery stores nearby and close to downtown. the apartment itself is fantastic: spacious with all the amenities listed. sandra was a responsive and helpful host who helped resolve any issues quickly.

this was a bright, clean, and comfortable apartment to spend 3 nights in. the location is great as well. the hosts did an outstanding job of communicating (even though i didn't necessarily!) and being available, and i was treated very warmly. would stay again!

adam’s place is extremely well situated and i had an amazing time in williamsburg. although only a very short distance from lively restaurants and bars i slept like a log. public transport was a breeze too, the apartment being only a few blocks from the underground. i was totally at home here the apartment had everything i needed and travelling as a single i also felt safe in the area and very secure in the apartment. it was a joy to stay here and if i ever got the opportunity to come back to the big apple i’d book this place! highly recommended!

kiriko and dominic’s apartment was clean, convenient, and comfortable. it was a pleasure to spend time there and we appreciated how responsive the hosts were when we had questions. the neighborhood also has a lot of great food as well as easy access to gorgeous prospect park. highly recommended!

julia place is as described on the listing. subway is round the corner. interior is clean. beautiful living room and kitchen space. four separate bedrooms, was perfect for our family of 7. street parking is available but finding one is difficult , we were lucky to find spot during our stay. the host met us upon arrival and helped settle in. great communication on text and call.
perfect, simple place to stay for a night if in the area for an interview

romy’s place was so nice and clean and comfortable she was very responsive and welcoming clear instructions on how to get in everything was just like the photos the private backyard was nice to enjoy the weather we will be back oh and she leaves cookies lol

the location is cute! the roof top bar is convenient and the atmosphere was great! the only negative was everything in the area closes early and you can hear everything coming out of the room next to you. other than that it was a nice easy stay.
great neighborhood and overall good stay.
quiet, and that’s hard to find in nyc.

armstrong was a fantastic host and everything was great for our anniversary get away! front desk even brought up a personally signed card, champagne and chocolates to our room which was a very classy touch. location was also great, perfect for walks through the park or down to midtown restaurants and attractions. room is small but expected per other similar -priced places in nyc. added bonus was access to owners lounge for complimentary breakfast and nightly apps which saved us several times. great trip and stay overall!
the room was very nice and as described. yakima was friendly, responsive and helpful with information about getting around. overall a good stay and i would recommend it to others.
great location with all that you could need! occasionally you do hear footsteps though.
large, clean room, comfortable bed. shared bathroom can be a bit of an inconvenience but overall good option.

b' place us in an excellent; many restaurants, walking distance to train and to central park for a romantic stroll. b called us upon arrival and met us at the door to give us the keys. great hostess! and i would definitely return.
i definitely recommend this place. it's close to the airport, the rooms are very clean, and the service exceptional.
very cute place! lovely location!
this is great apartment! elise was there to greet us upon arrival! location is excellent! will be returning for sure!
great stay. host was responsive. unit met all my expectations.
we had a wonderful, easy stay. yemane was very attentive, kind, and communicative. looking forward to next time! thank you!!
you will be love it. she is awesome. she is so helpfully, she always give quick answers and the room is so cute
joe was a friendly and helpful host! this was just a quick place to get ready and sleep when in town for a wedding and worked out well!
chloe is so lovely, welcoming and the apartment was great. very clean, safe building and felt very comfortable as a girl staying there!!!! thanks chloe 🧡

this was such a great alternative to a tiny hotel room. this was the perfect place to relax during downtime. the apartment is very spacious, comfortable and spotless. the location was perfect for us and close to everything we needed. loved the apartment and loved the neighborhood.
clean place to stay in a great location.
another great stay close to jfk.

miriam and may (the mini poodle) were such great hosts! i’ve stayed at a number of airbnbs and this is one of the best, i felt like i was staying at my family home with all the amenities i needed as someone who travels light. location was perfect and accessible given the walking distance to multiple subway lines, you can access manhattan or other parts of brooklyn easily. come here for a comfortable and peaceful stay. i would definitely return!! thank you miriam
loved the place, great location! just needs a tv in the room.

the room is perfect! there is so much attention and care put into making your stay as great as possible. darin was so helpful, understanding, clear, and responsive to any questions i had and even anticipated them. the room had everything i needed and more: fast wifi, storage, hangers, kitchen amenities, an extremely comfortable big bed, a little heater (only used it once since the apartment is so well-insulated), hairdryer, a peaceful atmosphere and cute lighting. i noticed so many little things and attention to detail, which i truly appreciated. the area is also really nice and generally quite calm for manhattan. i was able to walk pretty much anywhere i wanted to as the apartment is so well situated. thanks so much for a wonderful stay!

anthony was very accommodating to my family and i. the unit was very clean and he had it stock with some house everyday household items. we will definitely want to stay here when we come back to new york. thanks for the hospitality!!

this was a lovely place to stay. it was very comfortable, with a great vibe. everything was just as pictured, and kelly was great with communication. in addition, the neighborhood is great. subways are really close, and there are a lot of nice restaurants in the area. would love to stay again!
absolutely gorgeous loft with extremely kind, generous, and accommodating hosts. we had an excellent stay in chelsea with yochi!

upper west side and steps from central park and a block from the mta b & c lines. one block west is columbus and another block is amsterdam which are both loaded with restaurants and services. with 86th street bus across from subway getting across to east side is easy as well as going in and out of laguardia.

chris's place is just as listed. the apartment is very clean and chris is very accommodating. it is a little bit farther out from the manhattan but for my friend and i who wanted to explore brooklyn it was perfect.
fantastic experience, irfan is the warmest of hosts. absolutely recommend 👍🏻
yemi's place was great, warm welcome, clean and excellent hospitality. i recommend everyone to book their stay with yemi, i definitely will :)
great apartment for a great price. located 15 min walking for winthrop subway station. we spent several days in nyc and we enjoyed our staying in omwattie apartment. we’ll definitely comeback

we were extremely pleased with the room, and david and his wife were very hospitable, going to great lengths to make us feel comfortable and at home, giving us directions and even drawing us a map of the local area. our only regret is that we were so busy we hardly had time to socialize. we would highly recommend them to others!

the space was clean and tidy, very easy to access, and had all amenities outlined in the description. pearl is a friendly and easy-going host, and overall i had a very positive experience. also, the hot water was hot, which can be a rarity in brooklyn!

we had a great stay. the room is spacious, comfortable, and very well kept, and the apartment as a whole is also really nice. many times it even felt like we had the entire apartment to ourselves, which was a big plus. the host was very respectful and quiet, but at the same time always communicative and helpful whenever we needed anything. overall, a very pleasant experience. we would definitely recommend this place.
tal & amarelle’s flat was stylish, clean, and charming. the neighbourhood was safe, friendly, full of trendy restaurants/bars, and conveniently located to the subway into the city.
the stay was great, easy to find, check in and check out. host was great 10/10 recommend.

migdalia is very nice, has great communication, and very accommodating. so many hiccups came up on my end and migdalia was willing to sort things out with me. her place is an hour out from times square area which was already made aware so no problem with that. her place was clean and very homey. her kitchen was open for using and the sight on the balcony was amazing. i would definitely recommend this spot.

nice apartment in a cool area. it was clean and check-in was easy. communication with brady was great and he was a super host. we were a group of 4 who used this apartment as a base for a friend's wedding in greenpoint and it was ideal. close to many bars, restaurants, and cafes. also a few blocks from the subway station on bedford avenue, which is a very short trip into manhattan.
sedat was very welcoming! the place is definetely worth the price
great place, spacious and comfy. very close to everything. would def reserve again!
it wasn’t a bad stay, however some maintenance needs to be done. however it was okay

i have been at manuel’s more than i can count. let me put it this way, if i were to run a workshop on how to airbnb??? manuel would be one of my top facilitators. he is excellent at this. it’s no wonder he is always booked. thanks for all you do manuel!

we really enjoyed our time. the house is a little older but the place was sparkling clean and very cute. the neighbourhood was very diverse, convenient and safe. ariela and her husband were friendly and available and came in to help right away when we couldn’t get the tv to work (it did work). they let us leave our bags in the hallway on the last day.
very comfortable stay. would definitely recommend.

this was an excellent and affordable spot to stay in nyc. hotel room was spotless, staff were very friendly and kind. delicious free coffee and treats everyday! lovely room cleaning daily! excellent location and walkable to almost everything!
great host and wonderful apartment, overall a great place to stay!

nicole and i stayed to weeks in martins apartment and we loved the charm and style of it and enjoyed our time there very much. first we were a little bit stressed because martin didn´t answer our messages until one day before our journey started but then everything went quite well and easy. the room is very nice. the mattress was really comfortable but could have been a little bit bigger (think, it is a double-bed size 135x190). we haven´t been up to the rooftop because the accsess is through the window over the fire-escape - unfortunately the two german girls were afraid! bars, restaurants, supermarket are around the corner and it is easy to go to manhatten by subway. martin was a calm and polite host. thank you very much!!!!!! nicole and katharina
if you are after something different, something green and yellow (colours inside the place!), something to talk to your friends and family about..then you should definitely stay at brady's place!!
it's a good place to stay. very much into budget. the host is very cooperative.
amazing i felt right at home i love it soo much !❤️

had a great stay at jonathan’s! easy check in and check out. best part was the location: walking distance from the subway and lots of good places to eat & get a drink. good amount of space in the room for me to unwind at the end of the day. it was easy to communicate with jonathan if i had any issues or questions. wonderful place to stay for a solo trip!
amazing place to spend the night & really close to the local beach highly recommend if your visiting the area !

i had an amazing time staying at shiva's place! the place is very clean with a modern interior and exterior look. quiet and safe neighborhood. shiva is simply the best host you could ask for! very friendly, warm, welcoming presence, super easy going and nice to talk to. he gives you your space and is there to hang out with if you so please. all amenities are readily available and shiva always checked in to see if i needed anything extra. he's also very flexible and understanding. i'm definitely looking to stay with him next time i'm in the city! couldn't have asked for a better experience!
zahava’s place was really worth the price . everything was exactly as described, and she was very responsive about any of our concerns!
everything just as described, great communication with the host, the bed was very comfortable, private bathroom adds a lot of comfort. it was a perfect place for a short stay for us!

great place, exactly as depicted in the photos. florence and peter are friendly hosts with good knowledge of local coffee and jazz spots. large space with private entrance, good value, nicely furnished and only a few blocks from two subway stations.
she was a helpful and responsive host. her house was a same as advestised in airbnb: clean, organized and enough to be rest in an affordable location.
nice and quiet area, beautiful lobby, very noisy ac., the appartement appears a bit worn.
check in check out was excellent facilities was clean neighborhood was safe overall great service

luis’ place is beautiful! bright, spacious and 2 bathrooms!!! a gem. the location is a short 10 min walk to l and m train. great restaurants and services around. beautiful park across the street. luis is a great communicator and has everything well equipped in the apartment. the kitchen is beautiful! go!!! now!! 🙌😊
great place to stay in brooklyn.

my recent stay at this airbnb was very comfortable. the home had a nice, cozy feel, and the bathroom was clean and very comfortable. the bed was especially comfortable, and while the room was on the smaller side, it met my needs perfectly. overall, a pleasant and uncomplicated experience.
super convenient and super affordable. mariela is a sweetheart and we could have spent our entire trip hanging out with her dog archie.
this was such a great place to stay! the room was perfect for 2 of us. it was easy to get to china town, and little italy and there were a few subway stations nearby also.

this was our third time staying with david and janet, the first time we'd been in the private room. it's smaller than the first-floor space, but since we didn't spend a lot of time there it was perfect for us. there also seemed to be less street noise compared to the other space.
great stay in brooklyn! the apartment was clean, cozy, and having a parking spot was great. the host was friendly and responsive, which made everything smooth.

i booked victoria‘s place based on the raving reviews from other travelers. this place is awesome great location, stylish, very clean and quiet. love the shower too. the host is very responsive. this place would be my first choice if i come to new york again.

the place was good and easy walking distance to times square and korea town. however, the wi-fi connection didn't work very well. and, it was very noisy during the night times (both upstairs and next door). it was very hard to get good sleep. overall is a good place to stay for a couple of days. the communication from nomad was also quick and responsive.
i felt super comfortable and cozy! will highly recommend!
the place was so clean and nice, very accessible to public transportation, and only minutes to times square. emily is so kind person who helped a lot
had a wonderful, peaceful and comfortable stay. would definitely return!
great location and had everything we needed!

location, location, location. great studio, very clean, comfortable bed in amazing soho. highly recommended if you want to explore the city and feel like a new yorker. very professional and kind hosts.

i cannot recommend amy’s apartment enough. she is a wonder host and we were made so welcome and had an amazing time. the artist apartment was perfect for us and my late teenage son was thrilled with his basement, it would also suit younger kids. amy’s apartment is a great choice if you want to enjoy nyc by day but might want a bit more quiet at night (though there are plenty of options locally if you do want to go out). the garden is amazing, i didn’t expect a trip to nyc to be a relaxing holiday as well but it was due to the peace and calm of amy’s apartment. i still need to find out where the aromatherapy diffusers are from, i have never slept so well! the facilities and equipment are great, you will want for nothing. amy was around when we had a question and very responsive but we also felt totally left in peace.

great stay in a super clean and comfortable room. plenty of space and peace and quiet. the en-suite bathroom was spotless. very easy access to subway and plenty of coffee shops and cafes around. stephen was friendly, chill and very accommodating.

we loved staying at brady’s spot! perfect for our needs. the area is safe and walkable, a short stroll to the train. we were able to cook a few times w the plugin stove which was helpful. the apartment has ample luggage storage, and i loved that we could put our clothes in the drawers under the bed. the place was bigger than it looked in the photos! the window view of the trees is the perfect wake up to a brooklyn morning. would definitely stay here again!
very pleasant stay. galla was a caring and considerate host. apartment was excellent space. and well furnished and maintained.,for us and our dog . highly recommend in a very quiet and location.

a great value and a fun experience staying in a very old but typical nyc home! the bed was super comfortable and it was nice to stay somewhere away from the chase of manhattan. easily access via subway to the aquarium / cony island, broadway, manhattan chinatown / the lower east side while also walkable to great restaurants and the brooklyn botanic gardens. this is a 4th floor apartment, so make sure you can handle the stairs / don't pack too heavily.

j's apartment was perfect in so many ways - and it was one of the few places i've stayed where i could imagine living in nyc comfortably. and the weekend started off on a high note when i got parking right across the street when i arrived! the location was ideally situated halfway between my son's apartment and that of his girlfriend. it had a fully stocked kitchen if i were inclined to cook (which i wasn't - we ate & drank our way around brooklyn). but, it would have been easy to whip up a few meals. the bed was super comfortable, and i slept like a baby both nights. i slept in the back bedroom, as i am from a pretty quiet area and not used to city noises. no noise problem back there. the towels were thick and soft - nicer than what i have back home! we didn't hang out at the apartment much, but it was very comfortable when we gathered before going out for the evening on saturday. the bluetooth speaker in the sitting area connected seamlessly to my music, and it felt like home. i look forward to returning in the spring and taking advantage of the wonderful back yard. j - thanks again for sharing your home with me.
the place was great! very clean and comfortable. i enjoyed my stay.
there isn’t a button or lever to turn the shower on, had to use the tub to take a bath. the room tv constantly showed on the screen that it was updating and never fully was on.

carrie and ken are great hosts and go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable. the place was exactly as described and the brownies as delicious as everyone said! my only tip would be to take the bus to their place rather than walk.

freddy’s place is me and my wife’s absolute favorite. we love authentic food and this area is surrounded by the hispanic and latino culture. from taco trucks, to 10 minutes away from lga, from just blocks away from the 7 train this place is it for us. freddy is very responsive and very accommodating to what you are going through. this place is our #1 go to!!

the location of this hotel was great. it was very outdated. no refrigerator or microwave and even after changing rooms to a king bed it was still noticeably a full size bed. view was amazing but i would not book again.
great location and value. thanks!

a lot smaller in person and the room needs improvement. we stayed for one night and it was manageable, but i wouldn't suggest it if you are going to spend any time in the room. the walls were very thin and there just isn't a lot of space in the rooms. we barely had space to move around with our bags and the closets were super small. if you're only looking for a place to sleep and shower, it will do the job, just make sure you have minimal bags.
great place, very easy access to midtown and lower manhattan, comfy bed, friendly host, and probably the best shower i've ever experienced through airbnb!
i already wrote a review. see previous e-mails

i stayed at this place over the weekend and i had a great stay. the bathroom was excellent and there was ac throughout the place. parking was easy to find and the house was very easy to get into. will definitely be staying here again.
not only was the space immaculate, well-located and easy to access, but the artwork was wonderful to enjoy during our brief stay. everything you need is here, don't hesitate!

this was a very good place for the price. great location and walkable from the train station. the place was small but that’s to be expected since it’s a studio apartment. the bathroom was nice and clean and overall we had a great experience at this airbnb.
great spot for exploring the city!
is a suitable apartment in a good position

great stay at eli’s, good and easy communication from check in to check out. big and comfy room, lots of storage, clean and beautiful bathroom. the neighborhood is lively and always felt very safe. 2 minutes away from the l train. 4 minutes away from a nice park. grocery store around the corner and coffee shops all around. i definitely recommend ! thanks again !!
great and convenient location. the listing was exactly as described. ofir is a really responsive host. thank you!
very responsive host! just no bin in room.
beautiful stay. art deco style and unique space. had all the necessary amenities. hotel base but private apartment vibe. will recommend.

we had a great stay with my husband and son in midtown. the place is quiet, which is not frequent in manhattan. not much light but as expected in the typical nyc brick building. the wood and brick decor exactly corresponded to the pictures and is very pleasant and cozy. the apartment was spacious enough for the three of us. wifi is good, including for intensive remote work. i especially appreciated the bathroom which is more comfortable than in the usual offers in that price range.
great place, location is amazing, plenty of space, felt very safe. 10/10
very nice place with an even nicer host. it had lots of restaurants and stores with good variety.

joel and renee's place is larger than it looks on the photos. really two separate bedrooms. lots of eatables available. sweet host, thoughtful and helpful. excellent with our cancelling one night. only wish we'd had longer to stay.
staff are nice but the hotel is old

brenda's place was fantastic. perfect location for where we were looking, great space - clean and comfortable beds and living spaces. it couldn't have worked out any better! her son brandon was super helpful, and both of them were always quick to respond to messages. thanks brenda!

i had the best time here,i would definitely say this has been my best airbnb experience,sam is an amazing person and i would recommend this place anytime,it’s also located in a great neighborhood and 3 minutes walk to the train station......next time i’m here i would love to stay with her again.

had a great stay at anthony's place. the place is very cozy, all the linens smelled great and you had all the essentials you needed there. the location is in an industrial area, so it is not the greatest if you are looking to walk out your front door to shops and things to do, but it was perfect for us as it was right between the venue of the music festival we were attending and manhattan, making it fairly easy and inexpensive to travel to either. for the price, we couldn't ask for a better spot.

me and my friends stayed at the property when we visited nyc. the apartment was just as expected and advertised, comfortable and well equipped. the facilities provided were perfect for what we wanted. the beds were comfortable and the property was clean and fully functional. there was a subway station a short walk from the property, along with a variety of shops and take out places. the subway was perfect for easy access to nyc and the surrounding areas. the communication and service from trevor and the property manager toya was brilliant; we felt welcomed and looked after and knew that any queries would be answered. i would highly recommend this airbnb as an affordable option outside of the manhattan and would happily stay again if we ever return to nyc!

teddy's place is super-cool and makes for a fab home-from-home if you're coming to nyc. the flat itself is huge but just as good is the building it's in and the community it's part of - there's a coffee place downstairs, a bike shop, and the l train is about 5 minutes walk away. it is quite a few stops into manhattan from morgan av. but that didn't bother me too much. teddy made staying very easy and straightforward. so highly recommended from me.
no problems with our stay. staff were welcoming and helpful when needed. great location and walkable to many places or very close to subway. happy with our stay (2 adults and 2 children)

nicoletta's place was wonderful. clean, quiet and serene. perfect place to relax after strenuous activities. she also had nice touches like an espresso machine and chocolate, and plenty of bottled water. i will definitely look forward to staying next time i need to be in the area. thanks so much!
that was really good for two days. just fyi you don’t have separate kitchen room, you just have a place to cook on the passage between rooms. really pricey but it’s new york :)
house was clean, spotless and great for family. the host was incredible and helpful. the location was okay. easy access if you want to use public transportation.

the room itself was exactly as described. it was large, especially for the price and the location, and was very clean. towels, hooks, 2 luggage stands, and a clothing rack were thoughtfully provided for our use. we also took advantage of the large tv and were able to log into our hulu and relax. the connection speed was excellent. tarlok was very quick with all communication, though we never actually saw him. one thing to keep in mind is the bathroom is shared with three other airbnb rooms in the same apartment. if you like to be able to leave your things in the bathroom, and you like to interact with your host, this might not be the space for you. otherwise this is a great value in a great location.

my husband and i have stayed with martha and pat about six times in the last year or so (visiting staten island for family visits/holidays). from our first visit to this most recent, we have always been welcomed warmly and generously. martha and pat keep a spotless, lovely home and garden. one of the great pleasures of the home is their beautiful backyard garden that you can see from the breakfast area, and even sit outside on nice days. you feel like you are in the country, far from the city, with the birds and greenery and peace. inside the home is always peaceful, comfortable and welcoming. pat and martha go out of their way to prepare delicious breakfasts (from going to get bagels, to home made freshly cut fruit, breads, oatmeal), among other choices. they are responsive and generous hosts and caring people. they both lead busy lives but find the time to communicate with and get to know their guests. the bedrooms are lovely and comfortable, appointed with just about every convenience/treat you can imagine; and it's quiet in the house, which is so welcome to those of us living near highways or in busy cities. the house is in a lovely residential neighborhood that's easy to walk around, and easy to get to shops, etc. the house alone is terrific, but it's really the hosts that make the stay so special. we love to visit/stay with martha and pat! (and they are super interesting people, as well!)

yes. this place was ok however it was very hot you have to use a ac unit. the smell was horrible every time you showered it smell like sewer which lingers around the house. it’s too many steps and no tv in room
a lovely quiet spot in a delightful neighborhood, comfortable, spacious, and mme diagne is very responsive and helpful! will definitely stay here again!
spotless clean, bright room, very comfortable bed.

emmies remains a great stay. i still get treated as if i'm a first time visitor. my previous reviews is also my current review. very quiet, private, and restful stay. the photo is reflective of what you will find when you arrive.

my sister and i had a great time at tony and david’s apartment. the room was cozy and clean so we felt very comfortable during our stay. the location of the apartment is also great. it doesn’t take long to get to manhattan and there are many restaurants and grocery stores in the neighborhood. tony and david are really friendly and helpful hosts and very communicative! tony helped us with our suitcases and gave us many recommendations regarding restaurants and grocery stores. we also had the opportunity to leave our bags at the apartment after check out, because our flight back was in the evening. i would definitely recommend staying with them :)

cyn was very kind and patient answering all my questions before the trip (and there were quite a few. sorry, cyn!). from the moment i arrived, she made me feel very welcome, even sharing her breakfast with me, and was always attentive during my stay. the apartment has everything you need, with weekly changes of bed sheets and towels. the location is excellent, just one or two blocks from two subway lines and close to many grocery stores, and the apartment itself is a true work of art so if you’re into art, you’ll love it. if you’re not from nyc, it may take a little time to get used to the trash separation system, but there are clear instructions in the building. shoes are not allowed inside, but there’s a designated space to leave them. on my last day, we had breakfast together, she prepared an amazing pasta lunch, helped me with my luggage, and waited with me for my uber. thank you, cyn, for making my first trip to nyc such a wonderful experience. highly recommended! until next time!
fernando is an amazing host!! extremely proactive and helpful! always up for a chat and to share space and experiences while being attentive and respectful of privacy and quiet time.
our stay was wonderful! felt like home. very clean and spacious. great place to stay with family…

it was very unique experience in new york, unlike other hotels in manhattan. roosvelt island was quiet and clean. i felt staying in house in nature. it was easy to reach manhattan by subway or tramway. in addition, the room was very clean and there was no problem to stay. leandro always answered my questions and asking immediately. if i visit new york again, i hope to stay here again.
charlene was a nice person. however my children and i didn't have a good experience.
stan is a great host. we spent an excellent time, we had the feeling to live in new york for a few days. the room is spacious, calm and confortable and there is everything you need.
michael is so nice. the room is clean and comfortable.

jesse's place was perfect for our one night stay. our private room was well kept, with a modern style, and provided all of the sleeping area that we needed. i would definitely recommend this listing to my friends planning on staying in the area.
great location! fantastic shopping and restaurants and good subway access
great location plenty to do around and the roof top is a nice touch to everything. communication is good with them too, they were quick to respond and helped me out

this is an amazing place! beautiful decorative painting on all the walls! the room and bathroom were super clean. clearly some artists have been at work here to create a delightful and magical place. this is a well run airbnb. it is worth the hike out to bed sty to get the value and novelty. plenty of room. it is generously run with a common kitchen area. i only stayed one night but i would have happily stayed a week.

i appreciated the easy self-check in/out, and the convenient location in a quiet neighborhood near groceries, restaurants, subway, and prospect park. the space was clean with a super comfy bed, just right for a single traveler. highway noise is definitely audible inside the unit but it wasn't too disruptive. this was a good homebase for a weeklong stay exploring the city.

james & laureta's "artistic" studio is a beautiful brooklyn getaway. it's located on a quiet street in a charming brownstone building in bed-stuy. i stayed the week before christmas and the halls were most certainly decked with holiday flare which added a homey touch. upon entry, the place was sparkling clean and looked just like the photos. james & laureta were incredible hosts that definitely went the extra mile to ensure that their guests are happy and comfortable. i would highly recommend to any couples looking for a quaint little spot in brooklyn or new york.
thanks for having us lisa. you have such a beautiful home. loved our stay there! just know we will be back!
great appartment in an exciting neighborhood!
very nice space, with a good location near broadway avenue. host was very responsive, and my stay was comfortable.
excellent location with a comfy bed and great little patio! i would recommend staying here if you're heading to bk. perfect distance to trains and restaurants/bars/coffee shops alike.

i had an excellent three-day stay in celine's apartment. while basic, it had everything i needed and was very well-located - a short walk from both 86th street subway stations made travelling through the city really easy. i was given clear instructions on accessing the unit and had no issues doing so. also importantly, despite how cold it was outside, the temperature in the apartment was very well regulated.

max is a great host, their hospitality and attention were great. the apartment is always clean, my room and restroom were also super clean. the apartment is well located, with buses and subway stations nearby. definitely will keep this place in my favorites for my next trips to nyc and columbia university.

we enjoyed our stay at the kimpton theta ! location was great to walk to the subway/ times square/ theatre district - when i needed more hangers/ towels etc they were delivered in 5 minutes - you are in a hotel with a nice sitting area in the lobby/ fast elevators/ friendly helpful and responsive doormen and check-in desk personnel. free coffee upstairs in the restaurant with option to pay for breakfast, and a happy hour in the lobby that we were too busy to take part in. windows open enough to let fresh air in. a/c worked great ! quality bed, bedding and pillows which are a huge plus for us. we would definitely stay here again.
it was super nice to stay here and i enjoyed it with my friends.
what i loved most about the place is the chic decor throughout the hotel and inside our apartment. good amenities which made the apartment feel homey. i’d stay there again!
great little place. we got lucky with parking. a very nice lady was leaving as we arrived and offered her parking spot.

carlos and jose were very helpful throughout my stay. the space was quiet and my stay was uneventful, which did wonders for my peace of mind, especially as a solo female traveler. the location was good, especially as it was close to central park and a metro station that can take you wherever you need in nyc. overall, i had a great time! response time was quick, which is something i appreciated a lot. would stay here again if i find myself in the big apple once more!
amazing location! the place was nice and quiet. perfect size for two people. kitchen has everything you need.

i stayed at the apartment the last 3 months and can totally recommend the airbnb. the apartment looks exactly like the pictures. the apartment was full of natural light and very clean. bev was there for me since day 1. helped me with every question i had and also provided me with great informations about the neighberhood and recommendations for restaurants and stores in the area, even provided me with some essential groceries when i arrived, which was very nice. the location of the apartment is also very convinent. 3 minutes to the laundry, 10 minutes to the next subway station. the only minor negative point for me was the water regulation in the shower, which wasn't very good. this should be fixed soon tho. all in all was it a great stay, beautiful and safe neighberhood and i can gurantee you, you won't find a host which will care more for you than bev.

i really enjoyed staying here. the apartment was very nicely furnished and very clean. andrada reached out to me to make sure i had everything i needed and was very responsive. it was a nice location near the subway, which was exactly what i was looking for. would definitely recommend!

the apartment is located in a serene, walkable neighborhood very close to the east river and the carl schurz park and an easy commute to times square with an 8-minute walk to the train station (q-line).. the urban finished team was super responsive during the entire stay when i had any household issues and that was super impressive and helpful to making this 2.5 months stay comfortable. the only unpleasant experience was going up and down a flight of stairs with luggage but besides this, this was a great apartment and location.
the hotel was very nice in terms of looks and amenities and the room was spacious and very clean.
schone en nette kamer. self-checking was makkelijk en flexibel.

great fun space would rent again for sure. i wish it was just a little more adorable and the listing said sauna but i didn’t find one. other than that the beds were so comfortable the staff friendly and the all around vibe great!

as a solo female traveller, my priority was safety and comfort. i had an absolutely fantastic stay here. the location at brooklyn was good, and accessible via subway and bus. thankful to melissa that she allowed me to do an earlier check-in and she was around at home to welcome me in. from the moment of check-in to finish, melissa's hospitality made me feel at home. the house felt very cozy. the bedroom, bathroom was clean! it was perfect, spacious and very comfortable. their kitchen was well-stocked. the space was immaculate, clean, beautifully decorated and had everything that i needed. i will happily return and recommend this airbnb to anyone.

location was perfect! you are just a block away from the street that will take you directly to times square, also you have one of the main subway stations just a couple of blocks away and everything seems super close. staff is superfriendly on main desk, on breakfast, cleaning; all of them were super helpful and great; we had to stay an extra night due to a winter storm and they were super helpful to make sure we didn't have any extra inconvenience. internet is not that great but i managed to have some calls and work a bit from the hotel. only real drawback we really had was about the elevators. one broke down on the second day so you have to wait a long time to go either up or down during peak hours, and it wasn't fixed in the full 7 extra days we stayed there.

shully and her husband were the best host ever! the place is perfect, very neat and clean- and smells amazing! the bed was so comfy and the nice added touches- some food for breakfast after a long journey- definitely recommend! awesome place-
stephan is great loved the location room was clean and everything was smooth and easy would definitely recommend

i enjoyed my time in james’ home. the home was accurately described and it showed exactly as it did in the pictures. the details and touches were carefully appointed. as soon as i stepped in, and every time i came home i felt the warmth of the hospitality (like i was really home), the temperature was always cool 24/7 (as it is summer) so it was important to me to come home to a cool home with the air conditioning always maintaining a comfortable temperature (vs enduring the heat while cooling up the place). the home always smelled clean and fresh! the bed was very comfortable it was hard to get up in the morning. the sheets and pillows were soft and clearly of good quality. we had our own bathroom which was squeaky clean and made up all the time it was like i was in a hotel! i didn’t expect this because it was an airbnb so i kind if expected we were going to clean it up ourselves during our stay. the shower was perfect! the water pressure was great (that’s important to me - it can make or break my experience). we had our own lounge area where i spent my lazy days watching tv and surfing the net. definitely a promoter of this home! will come back when i am back in ny. the experience was overall awesome and for the price i paid it met beyond my expectations. james is a kind and amazing host. i didn’t just meet the perfect host but gained a friend too! thank you so much, james!

amir and jennifer were great hosts. very responsive. the large home was extremely comfortable, with lots of different seating areas for our family. it was beautifully decorated and proved to be a great base for our one-week stay in ny. our son loved to play with the arts and crafts -- and it helped to be able to supplement his toys with the toys we found there. there were a few hiccups in the maintenance area (fire alarms kept beeping, door nob jammed), but amir was responsive and sent a handyman to fix what was necessary immediately. i highly recommend their home, which felt like a home away from home in the big city. thank you amir and jennifer! they also provided great recommendations for things to do for my family, where to eat and what to see. they were extremely kind too.
we loved it, boutique, unique, comfortable, thanks
can be hard to find affordable places in brooklyn these days. this location was a great value. very conveniently located near subway and off a main busy street. good location.
this place was amazing. 10 min walk from the 7 train and the g train. there’s a grocery store just a block away which makes it really convenient to cook. the gym is super clean and the sauna is great
beautiful and cozy place, had everything we needed and more :)

i had a most warm, friendly welcome at martha's place. it is so clean and everything is so well taken care of on a daily basis you feel like you are in a 5 star property. i salute martha and her family for going the extra mile to make her place as clean, warm, nice and a comfortable as possible. i already booked a return

a cozy place to stay with a great location at a reasonable price. the room is on the second floor, very clean. just be aware of the cockroach when the weather is hot. hosts lives on the first floor and they are very helpful. if you have any problem, ask for help and get it solved. overall a great stay.
great place. close to subway very easy to get to the city. nice neighbourhood. felt like home.
a great place to stay just outside the big city. easy access to the train, a few local restaurants, and a stylish interior. we would definitely stay here again.
nice home, and comfortable room many thanks
wonderful hosts went above and beyond! also this was the cleanest basement apartment i’ve ever seen!! immaculate.
great place to stay! clean, easy, affordable. would recommend

the hosts are beyond helpful and respond very promptly. the place itself is in a nice neighborhood is really clean and has a very homey feel. i would highly recommend anyone stay here if they get the chance.
new property and great outlook.

nicole is an amazing host! the place is spotless and has tons of natural light! it truly felt like a home away from home. train station that takes you to manhattan is a 15 min walk (c train). lots of cute coffee shops around and small restaurants with great food. got a nice glimpse of what everyday life for a new yorker is like.

leo and stan are unparalleled hosts with a beautiful home in a lovely part of greenpoint. their home is appointed beautifully and in an eminently walkable area replete with great food, bars, parks and extremely walkable to multiple lines of transit. could not ask for a better stay!
would stay again. host very helpful!
michael is a great host and made my daughter and me extremely welcome. he gave us lots of advice which was invaluable. we had a lovely time and the position of michael's place was perfect for us.

elizabeth was friendly, flexible, and extremely on top of things as a host (the binder with info about the apartment and surrounding area was a unique, helpful touch); apartment felt warm and homey, and the extra half-bedroom was a great value and use of floorspace for us. all in all, a wonderful experience!

i almost didn't get to meet christa and zach because of our busy schedules we kept missing each other! but, when i finally did, christa was nothing short of warm and welcoming and an instant friend! the fact that they had a keypad lock made it so easy for me and my schedule to come and go as i needed without having to deal with an exchanging of keys. the room and bathroom are cozy but were perfect for my stay. i definitely wouldn't stay there if you are traveling with a partner, but for one person its just fine. they were super close to the subway which made it very easy to get to manhattan. i did have trouble getting an uber to their place the one time i tried, so if you prefer cabs this place might be tricky. i found the subway train very easy and as quick as a cab though. they also let me leave my bags there on my last day after my stay had completed so that i could go exploring around the city and not have to carry them until i was headed to the airport which was a huge weight off my shoulders- literally! i will say, the surrounding neighborhood wasn't as fun and interesting as i was hoping as far as any cool shops or eateries or the general atmosphere. overall i enjoyed my stay. very pleasant.

john's place was very clean and supplies everything i would possibly need. i loved how close john's place was to the train line, which gave me access to go anywhere. it help since i didn't have a car. the neighborhood was easily walkable. loved walking around the area and discovering little shops.

great rental. easy instructions. raymond was very prompt communicating. had excellent recommendations and was very helpful. rooms were very clean, updated kitchen, bath, beds, etc. quiet area, shops and food close by. excellent experience, highly recommend. bonus points for dropping off an extra coffee mug (they left 6) as soon as we asked for one.

a gorgeous apartment with everything you could need for a great stay! ferris was very welcoming and helpful to us. at first we were very unsure of harlem as an area but it turned out to be a great stay! it's close to the subway and very easy to get around. there is a supermarket at the end of the street and lots of shops near by. the food around the area is great! we enjoyed the corner social and it's well worth the 20 min walk/short taxi to dinosaur bbq - awesome food!! defiantly worth a stay!

my husband, pup & i live in brooklyn, but were looking for a little 2-night getaway to the beach. the surfside studio is exactly as advertised. impeccably clean, bright, spacious...a stone's throw from the beach & right on the main hub of rockaway boulevard. right down the road from some of my favorite local haunts. melissa was a fabulous host, incredibly responsive. couldn't recommend it more!
beautiful home , i enjoyed everything about my stay . host was berry proactive & help make everything so easy . highly recommended!!!
great place to stay! amazing neighborhood and michael and emma are great hosts

johnny's apartment is a true design gem that presents an eclectic, yet complimentary, well-appointed home. the entire house was elle decor-ready at any given time with clean surfaces throughout. i was a bit worried about sharing a bathroom with a man; however, the seat was never left up, there were no stains on or around the toilet, or hair left on the floor or in the shower, and i never had to walk on a wet floor mat. the whole place was immaculate.

this is a perfectly comfortable, no fills spot from where to explore brooklyn and nyc. the beds are comfortable, the location is great. william and his property managers are very responsive and easy to communicate with. just a heads up the place smells quite a bit like stale cigarettes. it is not so bad in the apartment itself but the hall and stairs are pretty strong so not great of you are sensitive to that kind of thing.
janet was wonderful and very personable! her unit was clean, spacious and exactly as pictured. will definitely try to stay here again on future trips if available, highly recommend!!!
great stay, cozy room, nice bathroom, private. couldn’t ask for better

good place to stay if location is your priority. room felt small and cramped for 3 people, and a dormitory style bathroom was not ideal, but room was clean, bathroom was taken care well by the cleaners and the check in process was smooth. $3.50 per day city tax was required only by cash, and $150 credit card deposit prior to check in.

we had a nice stay at zainab’s place! very easy to find and all the instructions were clear. clean apartment with everything we needed. the room we stayed in was small but it was good for a weekend trip!
very clean and well-maintained. jason was very responsive and a great host.
great stay, great host.
beautiful historic house. annie was very responsive and helpful!

great host and brilliant flat, with everything you need. located in a quiet street. the neighborhood is alive and safe, with supermarkets, subway, and some shops and bars a few minutes walking from the flat. quick connection with central park and times square, around 20-25 minutes. the flat is a good size and well equipped. the roof is great, spacious and the view is great. all in all a great flat to explore and discover new york.
perfect location, great amenities!
marina's place is beautiful and in a cute building, in a great neighborhood a perfect distance from manhattan and williamsburg, brooklyn. i really enjoyed my time there.
easy communication and very clean!

we arrived in nyc far before the check-in time and had a ton of luggage with us. though yves was not in town that week, he went the extra mile to contact someone who was there at the place and ensured that we could drop the luggage off 9 hours before check-in. the place was spotlessly clean and very well maintained. the proximity to the 7 line subway station means you can take a direct train to both grand central and times square. all in all, i had a wonderful experience at yves' place and i would strongly recommend this listing to anyone visiting nyc!
great place! had everything we might need for our stay in brooklyn. i especially appreciate the pack&play and toys for our kids! very nice and responsive host :)

the apartment was easy to find, instructions for check-in clear. had a nice chat with kandi once we arrived. the room was unfortunately not "very clean" as stated in the description. there was a significant layer of dust on furniture, hair and fuzz on the sheets and blanket, and a strange smell to the bed. the floor of the room was covered with carpets, and it seemed like the carpets were there to cover up that a vacuum cleaner has not been used recently. the bathroom was not very clean either - if you're allergic to dust, your health will struggle. we did not spend much time in the apartment and were particularly mindful of the the time we spent in the bathroom as it was shared. on two occasions when we took a quick shower, we could hear kandi outside the door expressing annoyance that she couldn't enter. on the first night only the apartment smelled like smoke, unfortunately including our room as we hadn't fully closed the door.

karina's place was absolutely wonderful! i had a bit of an issue with the television and when i messaged karina about it, she responded right away to help with the issue which was great! i would definitely stay here again!

the apartment was perfectly located close to restaurants, shops, grocery stores, and the subway. we had a great stay and found the property to be spacious, clean, loaded with amenities, and more. a spacious property in a convenient location isn't easy when visiting nyc and this property definitely delivered. the host was friendly and responsive, which made the visit that much more enjoyable. we would definitely return and recommend to others!

great place that is in a quiet section of the upper west side but very close to lots of things to do. a few minutes walk from arguably the best amc theater in the country, the lincoln center area with opera, ballet and philharmonic. few minutes from central park and a very convenient subway stop nearby when needed. the room is cozy with a very cozy bed. a little bit limited on space for clothes and luggage, but that is expected in a ny apartment. morteza is a great host who makes sure you have what you need to make the stay comfortable. he also has good suggestions about the area.

everything about our visit was great. food recommendations were wonderful. she reached out to make sure everything was going well. checking in and checking out were easy. highly recommend. great neighborhood
so amazing thank you! second time staying loved the flexible check in/ check out!

we really enjoyed our stay at sharon's place. i definitely recommend it as, as long as you're okay with lots of stairs. sharon and shanice were very friendly and responsive. the apartment is beautiful, especially during the day with lots of sunlight coming in, and it's sparkling clean. there's a well-stocked grocery store around the corner as well as several restaurants (including a few great bagel and pastry/coffee shops). it does take about 30 minutes to get to manhattan, but the subway stop is right across the street and trains run frequently so it's easy.

potential visitors can expect an easy time at sunny’s place. it has a convenient loading area, not many steps and comfy accommodations. i am somewhat handicapped, and had no problem with access. the apartment is beautifully designed - with a sweet efficiency kitchen, big shower stall with good water pressure, a couple of luggage racks, and plenty of places to hang clothes and other belongings.

oscar's place is lovely, charming and cozy. i think it's actually nicer than the photos, which don't fully capture how thoughtfully the apartment is laid out and how well it maximizes the space. oscar is also a very welcoming and communicative host. the neighborhood has a selection of solid bars and restaurants and the apartment is half a block from most of them. it also has an unbeatable proximity to the subway and to the park and farmers markets! a+
what a great place. classic brooklyn vibes, curated artistic interiors, and a superb and generous spirit of a host. also a super comfy bed, quiet sleeping & great a/c. thank you, ian!
excellent near to train station!!!
i stayed two times there, it was great thanks!

beyond satisfied! clean, safe, understanding, spacious room for luggage especially intl travel but over all a very cozy n homely vibe which is needed before airport chaos. conviently close to airport n great food options in surrounding area that are walkable n safe to exercise. host was incredible: responsive, understanding, and professional. thank you very much.
this airbnb was perfect for us. the location was great, a short walk to the subway. the owners were terrific and very responsive to any questions.
beautiful place in the heart of brooklyn good of you have your own car they have car parking, but i’m not used to animals so ma beth have cats fyi

she is very honest, friendly and cooperative. her place is clean, towels are snow white. her “read me” file was very helpfull for first comers to nyc. i found what is promised nothing missing. her a/c systems performed excellently during record high temperatures, she send us e mails and warned us about dangers of high temperatures like a mom.🙏🏼

great place with everything i needed and more - and fairly roomy for a studio. note that the ceilings are indeed a bit low and there are points (going into kitchen area, bathroom area) where the ceiling drops even lower. the host warned me and put signs to remind guests to watch their heads, but at 5 ' 8", i was not quite tall enough for the signs to be eye level, but not short enough to get under the ledge, and did bump my head in those locations a few times, but got used to ducking. street parking was always available when i needed it. air conditioner and fan did work to keep the place very comfortable.

perfect spot and met our needs. four of us and accommodation more than sufficient. host so easy to communicate with and very responsive. thank you so much for helping to make our family event a success.

pod 51 offers tiny ultra efficient spotlessly clean rooms at affordable prices right in the heart of the big apple. very helpful and friendly staff. i stayed in a full bed/private bath room which was perfect for one person. would definitely get the queen sized bed if staying with my husband. two adjacent businesses are really great…amenity spa228 for massage and the french bistro. highly recommend both. walking distance to times square area and theaters.
10/10 staff, room, and location.
thanks for being a nice host, the host was kind and helpful in telling us the way to the airport. the place was neat and tidy too. it was a splendid stay.

we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. it was a quick getaway weekend with our 1 1/2 year old. the house was nice and very clean. the host was very helpful and checked in to make sure we got in safely. i would definitely stay again.

the brownstone is amazingly beautiful! if you love the feel of community when traveling this is the place for you. it was walking distance to the train, food and groceries! richelle and pela are very hospitable and lovely host. we definitely recommend you stay here!
this is the most beautiful and comfortable place in downtown manhattan.
great place to stay
thanks for all, we enjoy the room and found all perfect, the communication was amazing and very friendly, thanks again!
gabe place was very clean, lovely home few blocks to the train station and to get in the city. i will definitely stay again.

i spent a month staying at rachel’s. it’s an amazing apartment, spacious, well designed, comfortable. pictures don’t do it justice. you can tell that it’s seen some living in but that just adds to the charm of the place. would def recommend a stay here.
everything in the place was as described. the neighborhood is very safe and only a few blocks from the subway. there are many places to eat and shop nearby. i would stay there again.
i'm not sure how the location could be any better! if you don't walk around the corner and visit milk and hops, you've missed out. i'm not one for reviews but it was great!

my stay at julio's place cannot be expressed in words. julio and maria are so kind, friendly and his family made me feel so comfortable -i truly felt like a part of the family. it was really kind of them to invite me to celebrate their cousins birthday with them. upon my arrival they gave me tonnes of recommendations on where to eat and go and how to commute. the place was clean and comfortable & central. i totally recommend this place- its very rare to experience such hospitality!
enjoyed my stay. would definitely book again
overall it was a good stay. nice size apartment, clean space.
great apartment and even better host! adam was extremely kind and helpful. highly recommend!
sandra and her beautiful family treated me like their the 5th family member. it's literally a home away from home. i highly recommend the place and dear host sandra! btw, she is also an awesome cook!

if you would like to travel to nyc and will have a great time in the middle of the city i can strongly recommend this appartement. in the direct neighborhood you can find supermarkets and a lot of restaurants and should ask for recommendations to find the most delicious ones. in addition you can easily walk to times square. the appartement is very well equipped with everything you need. wifi, music entertainment, kitchen stuff... the host is very kind and helpful. he is always reachable for any question or recommendations and will help you with everything you need... we had the best time of our lives and can strongly recommend this appartement...

andre was very responsive to our messages and accommodating when we needed something. it was a beautiful area and there was so much to do within walking distance. 5 minutes to barclay center! will definitely consider another stay

anastasia is the best! she’s super kind, organized and responsive. she has great taste and the design of the bnb really makes the stay enjoyable. it’s also near a lot of cool coffee shops, id recommend this to anyone.

you can expect a wonderful welcome from mr. and mrs. taft. they will welcome you with open arms. they are such a pleasure to stay at their place. you will love it. it has everything you need and it has that warm feeling. mr. and mrs. taft are very helpful and wonderful people to talk to.
a great nook in a beautiful neighborhood. i won't say too much else because i want to keep this gem to myself.

sandra's place is located in a peaceful neighborhood of queens. there is not much to do in the neighborhood itself, but you can get to manhattan in an hour or so using public transport. the room itself is quite nice and large, and it has a private bathroom. sandra is a friendly host.

i absolutely loved juniors place! was an amazing host overall! made me feel very comfortable and left me with the best airbnb experience i’ve had in brooklyn! would def book here again! thanks again for everything junior! your hospitality made me feel at home!

vera is a model host and a ray of light. it is a privilege to be accommodated in her home! the neighborhood felt safe with a nice amount of foot traffic day and night and plenty of commercial venues nearby.

this pace is fabulous! it’s very rare to find a place with a backyard in the city that’s close to restaurants and transportation. easily walkable to the heart of williamsburg. anthony is a wonderful host. he’s proactive, very communicative and friendly. highly recommended if you’re looking for an escape to brooklyn

i stayed in that room for 3 weeks. filip and nikola are great hosts, gave me some tips and welcomed me. the room is like in the pics. the subway is 2 blocks away and the neighborhood is safe. i myself came back several times during the night. i really liked it and recommend the place.

this is the best airbnb we been in ms. marie place is soo sparkling clean really make you feels like home...her & her husband are such some sweethearts... she had juices milk bread tea coffee etc etc....my son really enjoyed staying there everything was just soo perfect!! thank you once again you are the best ; )

delightful, pleasant stay:)!!! some highlights!: - safe, quiet neighborhood - close by bus stops (including one to lga!) - extra pillows and blanket - co-habitants of the building were friendly and quiet this was my first visit to new york ☺️ and i have to say, this stay was a notable highlight of my trip. thank you, angel!!

beautiful house in a very nice and quiet neighborhood. this is a great airbnb experience. huge house, great space, equipped kitchen, tranquility and respect. jordan is an excellent host and person. friendly and responsible. i want to recommend this place to stay 100%.
