my boys and i thoroughly enjoyed the apartment. it was both spacious and cozy, and had just about everything you'd need for a home away from home. there are a lot of good options for food all around, and a subway station practically right around the corner. one negative is parking. if you have a car to park, there is very limited street parking, which i hear is pretty typical for nyc. anyway, i ended up parking and leaving my car in a structure a couple streets away for the duration of our stay, and it was very expensive.
fantastic stay and would definitely book again.

lilia was the kindest host , the appartment was clean and it was warm and welcoming. the room was great as well as the location. astoria is a nice neighborhood with restaurants and bars close to manhattan. in short we had a great time and we highly recommend this place :)
the staff were really helpful and i had a wonderful time there.
shelley is the perfect host and made us feel instantly welcome. the apartment is on a beautiful block in a great neighbourhood, walking distance from anything you could ever want. highly recommend!
lovely, clean, lots of space, quiet street, and perfect location to explore williamsburg. great food nearby. don’t miss the la bicyclette bakery. ming was super helpful in answer any questions.

great stay in lower east side, ac worked well and was needed for this hot and humid summer. we used the rooftop area everyday and appreciated the water fountain and communal area in the basement. my only gripe would be on weekends it was a bit loud and the mattresses could have been firmer. but overall a pleasant place to stay and good value for money! location worked really well for us
david is a great host, his place is convenient , clean & comfortable and he is very easy to communicate with.
it's always a pleasure staying at the place 😊

ray’s place was great! clean and with good location to access to public transportation! we arrived early and ray accommodated us by letting us drop our bags off until we could check in. 10/10 recommend rays place for a nyc trip.
easy to get to multiple subway lines from the apartment. keturah was responsive and flexible with our check in and out time. bed was super comfy! overall great experience, would recommend!

sol went above and beyond with her listing. extremely responsive and location was absolutely perfect. situated between major subway lines, getting around nyc was truly a breeze. the check in process was easy with clear instructions and a wonderful apt with viewsssss of downtown nyc. i can’t thank her enough for letting my girlfriend and i stay in her apt.
best stay in new york 💖

we really enjoyed our stay. the location was fantastic, just a block from the c-train and 3 short blocks from the 1-train. suncerae supplied absolutely everything we needed, and her communication with us was very professional. my daughter also loved her shampoo selection. i loved all the streaming services that were available on the tv and the relaxing back deck, which is quite a treasure in nyc.

anna was very proactive in communicating with me and my partner for our stay in brooklyn. the apartment is beautiful, homey and in a perfect location, barely more than two blocks away from the g line. i highly recommend staying with her and plan to for future visits.
sam's place was quite lovely. he was very attentive and got us into his place quickly considering it was a last minute reservation. would definitely stay here again.
great place to stay during ny, beto is an excellent host. apt is well communicated and has everything needed in order to have a great trip on manhattan.

basic accommodation in queens. does the job in having money for when you want to still visit manhattan. it's just a short subway ride away. be aware of tax that needs paying on check in. also expect a huge delay on getting your deposit back. its been nearly 2 weeks since check out and still nothing.

exceptional hannah's house is spectacular, it has everything as it is in the photo, the location is special, the order, the arrangement of all things is impressive, it invites you to take care of it as if it were your own. the social area is very comfortable as well as the room, it does not need anything. hannah was aware of what we needed, we could not have been better. i highly recommend it and i hope to return soon !!!!
stayed at win’s place for three nights & had no complaints! easy to access public transportation and win was very responsive and checked in on me ! 10/10 experience (:
really nice place, convenient location
very friendly host! clean and cozy room. nice building. everything great

place is ok, about what to expect for the price point on a last minute booking in new york. the wifi quality was poor and there was no toilet paper upon check in and had to ask for it twice before it was delivered the following day.

a great stay! the unit itself was clean, spacious and overall just a really nice place to stay. really close to a bunch of bars that were walking distance and about a 15-20 minute drive to times square. parking at the nearby garage is about $50/day so if you’re planing to drive and such come prepared but my girlfriend and i had a perfect stay.
great location and amazing staff!

i like the host, very responsive. the place is the best if you are on a budget. it’s accessible and convenient to bus station and the nearest metro going to manhattan. this place is highly recommended. will definitely go back
sissy and joey were incredibly friendly and welcoming! i would highly recommend them to anyone else visiting new york!

compact, functional room in a beautiful old building. great location that will make your life easy by using penn station to commute. easy instructions and 24/7 availability of employees. cons: no elevator, bed could be more comfortable. but all in all was really a great experience.
nice stay, nice flat. everything was good
nice place , location is excellent near to main streets and subway stations, the place was really nice! the room is small but comfy, may stay again on it!

it is a nice and quiet apartment. about 10-minute walk to the metro stations, and really close to shops and supermarket. also, tatiana was a really great host that responded fast to problems. i had an awesome time in ny!
selims place felt at home, very spacious and clean! communication was very good. will definitely book again.
everything was perfect! we love this neighborhood and it was great to visit it from a central location.
hannah’s place has been incredible, clean, and has lots of light. also both her and jordan have been amazing hosts and have gone above and beyond to make sure my stay was great!

when i arrived i noticed the door to the room was open. not unlocked but door open. the room was not cleaned very well at all. stains on the sheets. the towels that were provided were wet or damp. overall i was not satisfied and wouldn’t stay there again. very loud and busy neighborhood. it was fairly cheap and i was planning on barely being there so it worked out. they did provide me new towels. air conditioner worked very well. very close to the subway which was very convenient.
close to the subway, clean, with a responsive host. great value and a great place to stay.
leslie's place was great. walking distance from everything. clean quiet neighborhood nice neighbors, and extremely cozy. definitely will request this place again and again. thanx leslie & joel

great location other than that not worth it in my opinion,felt like i was intruding on someone’s personal life.the guy would sit outside even while we were in the bathroom it felt very uncomfortable his wife scolded us like we were her grandkids,they are nice people but as hosts they are not it felt like they were on top of us the whole time.
ryan was a nice guy. gave suggestions for eateries around the neighborhood. place was cozy and near a strip of restaurants. great stay.

abhi was very accommodating and helpful. i was looking for a place very last minute when my previous place fell through, and he responded immediately in the morning. he was heading to the airport that day, but managed to take care of the room cleaning and switch prior to leaving and allowed for an early check in - as well as check out. the place was spotless, bright, and had everything you could need. also in a great location with the a station for the airport is just a ten minute walk away, and great shops, cafes, restaurants in the near. i would highly recommend!
great place to stay, super clean and well maintained!
wonderful place to stay, brandon was a great host

this studio apartment was exactly what i was looking for! it was a great price and had everything we needed for a pleasant stay. the location is perfect for seeing any part of new york whether you’re walking or using other means of transportation.

i had a really wonderful and lovely stay at tucker's apartment ❤️ tucker is so friendly and very and very responsive. he gave a really great recommendations about and helped me with everything i needed. the location was perfect. close to a subway station that from there you have line j to manhattan. i loved very much the style and design of the apartment. i loved everything in apartment and everything. i'm sure that in my next visit to new york i will come to tucker's property thank you for beign a really amazing and friendly host. i highly recommend on tucker's apartment ❤️🩵😄

super kind host - place is cute and clean. located on a tree-lined street home to two publicly accessible community gardens with terraced greenery, bamboo bridges … nightlife is hopping if you’re into that. i enjoyed a soft clean bed and solid badly needed rest
great place! lots of space, beautiful interior, wonderful location, delightful spot to stay in bk.

had everything we needed. best part was that the subway was right outside the entrance, so it was very easy to travel anywhere in manhattan. nice, cozy room with a comfortable bed and clean bathroom as well. would recommend this place if you want to easily travel anywhere in nyc.

very nice and lovely place in astoria. 30 seconds walk from 46th metro station, so it was very easy for us to reach time square. the bed is comfortable and the kitchen is big (we did not use it as we only stayed 2 days to visit nyc and preferred to eat out). all the info to access and find the place is very well organised. will stay here again when visiting nyc.
adam was a perfect host, went out of his way to make sure i had everything i needed, including buying a fan for my stay. very nice area also. thank you!
emily and saul’s place was a nice cozy spot. very much enjoyed my stay!
great places to stay!!!!
beautiful loft. easily walkable to the subway. plenty of room for our family of six.

bed is not a queen. i’m almost 6 ft tall and my husband is 6’3”, we have slept on a regular queen for the twenty years we have been married. i chose this location because the bed was listed as a queen. it is not a queen. it was smaller than a queen (not sure if it is a double or a full, but it is not a queen). the place was clean, not far from subway, easy to get in and out of, and we enjoyed our stay except for trying to sleep two tall people in a tiny tiny bed. wish his post would have been honest about the bed size in the bedroom. it affected our stay both of us trying to not move all night so our spouse could fit and sleep. also the two pillows (the two not in decorative shams) on the bed were in fact rough fabric square throw pillows for a couch in a regular pillowcase. if your happy with a smaller bed, this place is for you. we were super disappointed at the dishonesty.
cheap and convenient place to stay in new york city
we really loved this garden room in park slope. it was roomy, very nicely stocked and full of storage space. we enjoyed being close to our daughter and the 7th ave station.
such a lovely place to stay, really professional and welocming host and a comfy bed. everything i could have asked for.

from the very first moment i felt so welcomed and at home. i stayed for an extended period of time while transitioning to nyc. i have zero complaints! i cannot say enough about monique’s kindness and how comfortable she made my stay. i am so glad i found this space for my transition to the area. parking was always easy and it was nice to have so much within walking distance. absolutely loved the neighborhood, close to everything!

this was our first experience with airbnb and it was a great one! the apartment is true to its description. we enjoyed dealing with tara, who was always prompt and helpful when contacted. her apartment was in the ideal location for our needs since we were in brooklyn to welcome our grandson, who now lives a short walk from the unit! tara has furnished the apartment with everything one needs for a comfortable and homey experience. we were close to the subway, wonderful delis, restaurants, bakeries and the park! we would highly recommend this unit to anyone interested in the williamsburg experience!
great host, and a great stay in general. it’s right off broadway about 10 minute walk from time square, subways were also very close and easily accessible

this place was so great! location was right at times square without too much noise for sleeping. i was a little nervous about the google reviews going into this, but i can assure you this place was clean and comfortable for our holiday!

this place is everything you could ask for and more ! my wife and i celebrated our 5th year wedding anniversary here and ulises was very attentive to all of our needs and the home was better than. i could’ve ever expected. the location is perfect , very quiet , the back yard and fire pit were highlights to our trip ! we live here in new york and coming to this home made us feel like we left the state ! i can only wish to find a place like this ! thank you for having us ulises ! you will be seeing us very soon. this is my new home away from home officially
great place to stay!

j is a great host! he lives in the beautiful and lively harlem in a really nice neighborhood. the couch is very comfortable! the accommodation is perfect for a great holiday-trip in new york. j recommends good restaurants or places you can get food (like jacobs place) and knows a lot about the neighbourhood. all in all i can only recommend this accommodation!

amazing experience. ryan’s home was perfect for our family of four from the uk. my husband and i have been to ny a couple of times before but this time we wanted to bring our two daughters (16 &12) to experience the city. it was such a great experience living the brooklyn lifestyle for a week and the best decision rather than staying in a cramped hotel room in manhattan. it meant that after a busy day we could come back and relax in our own space and when the kids woke up earlier than us, they could enjoy the living space! the house is in a great location, just five minutes walk to the subway and then ten minutes into the centre of manhattan. williamsburg is also a lovely neighbourhood , we ate out there a couple of times which again was a nice change away from the hustle and bustle of manhattan. we even cooked our christmas dinner in the house which was nice and easy as there are grocery stores nearby and the house has all the cooking equipment you could need.
lots of space. very clean. lots of great sunlight. mo quickly responds to any questions and concerns. couldn’t ask for a better place to stay.
truly, harlem chic! outdoor space with an extra bonus. hostess was fantastic. would stay there again thank you

vanessa was amazing. she responded quickly and was very accommodating to my trip needs. i was actually set up to stay at another place. when that didn’t work out vanessa, made sure i had a great stay at her place at the last minute. very thoughtful. i loved the tips that she gave for touring the city. we actually made out very well thanks to her tips.

i really enjoyed my stay in nyc 😊 the place was comfortable, well located, and overall i had a very good experience during my trip. the only thing i would suggest improving is the cleanliness of the shared bathroom. during the last couple of days, another guest left it quite messy, with personal items around and excess trash. i understand this is not directly the host’s fault, but maybe being a little clearer with guests about keeping shared spaces clean could help. other than that, i truly enjoyed my stay and would still recommend this place
this was great for a quick weekend away!

kim is a very warm and welcoming host. i arrived late in the evening but kim was very accommodating for the check-in. the room is charming, very comfortable and clean. i also appreciated also additional touches like the tea and water cooler in the room. i would highly recommend kim's place to anyone looking to stay in harlem and would definitely stay there again.

overall, great location and good spot. only downfall i experienced was the shared bathrooms of how there was no shelf’s to hang belongings and that the water you had to constantly press the pump to allow the water to flow. wish it was just a normal shower by handle.

the room was clean, had lots of storage and included a small heater. the kitchen and bathroom were stocked with the necessities and clean. check in/out was very easy. host had great communication, was easy to reach and kind. would recommend staying with them.

gregorio was a warm, welcoming and helpful host. always in for a nice chat and ready to provide tips/ recommendations where needed.. from transportation, to free museum days and nightlife and cooking lessons :) enjoyed my stay at his place to the max. the room was nice and cozy, just as portrayed on the airbnb site. wifi/ ac and all other ammenities were working properly. as a single female traveller i felt safe travelling around the area/neighboorhood even when returning late at night. there are plenty of nice latin restaurants in the area and supermarket is located in front of the appartment complex. would definately stay at gregorio's place again on a future trip!
judith was very warm and welcoming, even giving us samples of food they were preparing. the kitchen was remodeled recently and was reasonably well equipped.

was a great place to stay and would stay here again in a heartbeat. unfortunately our air conditioning unit kept breaking but the staff was very responsive and maintenance was quick to come and fix it each time.
amazing place, very accurate to pictures, great location, great hospitality. highly recommend!
perfect location for my race in greenbelt conservancy. silvia was so friendly, responsive and accommodating!
carlos is a splended host. the apartment is very nice. there is everything you’ll need.
beautiful stay in the heart of times square
i stayed at iradj’s place for a month, and it was absolutely perfect. great location, clean, and comfortable. highly recommend!
good location. the room is smaller than we thought, but overall the staying was pleasing.
albert’s airbnb was a great stay! super clean, beds were very comfortable and spacious. safe location to be in and many shopping opportunities. will definitely be back!

this place is exactly as advertised. it’s a studio apartment in heart of new york city. it is clean, private bathroom. very close to public transportation. i felt very safe. the room was very clean and comfortable.
great location and a nice apartment

we had a nice experience at marlice' place. marlice and marcelo are excellent hosts! apartment is clean and has everything for pleasant stay. perhaps it worth mentioning that at the first glance the neighborhood seemed to be a little bit unsafe for us, but we didn't experience any problem.

litza was an amazing host. the space was clean, kitchen had everything we could need, and the host was extremely generous with allowing a flexible check-out because our flight got delayed due to nyc weather ❄️ 🌨️

the place is really nice. kept clean and organized, everything you need is in walking distance. food, books, clothing, etc. even the subways are close by. we loved staying here and the bed is pretty awesome. definitely recommend staying here if you're looking for somewhere cozy and close to everything that you need.

karan’s place was very peaceful, very quiet and very home inviting location front and back. i love that it was private and i had all the amenities to myself at any time. everything was just like the pictures. and everything was fully functional. the only thing i would say is try not to bring so many bags with you if possible because you will struggle up and down the stairs.

this has been my best airbnb stay by far. it was easy to check in, the place looked better than pictures, the amenities were amazing and the washer and dryers on site was my favorite for my long stay! there was always staff at the front desk and the location was perfect near the train, food, stores, shopping and sites to see. i highly recommend this place and the price is worth it especially for how spacious it is. i’m looking forward to coming again.
nice apartment with space for two. convenient spot in greenpoint.

awesome hotel, staff was amazing from day one. hotel is located just a short walk from the 7 train which is one stop from manhattan. the free shuttle is also amazing you have the choice between bmw or classic taxi cab. next time i'm in new york i know where to stay.

this place is a great value with all the things me and my family were looking for. great location, plenty of space, full kitchen for cooking with utensils/coffee/tea/condiments, in walking distance to public transit, and many places to eat and grocery shop in walking distance. we result enjoyed our stay here and plan to use michelle’s place anytime we need to stay in nyc (as long as it’s available). she is a great host, very responsive and willing to help with whatever you need!

perfect location for exploring the city. very close to subway. room wasn’t super spacious but the beds were very comfy, the shower had good pressure and the kitchenette allowed us to have breakfast or reheat leftovers. would stay here again.

for someone like me, i just need a bedroom and a bathroom, a good place to stay. it was a shareable bath, the other people that where there where clean and quiet. all over all good. bill reacts super fast when you got a question. the rooms are a little warm, but with opening a window, no problem.
madelyn’s place was as expected very nice and cute space. she was very responsive with any questions i had. definitely would stay here again.

dawa’s place was great!! clean! quiet area! 3-4 block walk from subway and about 30 to downtown nyc. there are gas stations, cvs and restaurants nearby to choose from! dawa and sonam were extremely helpful and responsive! they were very accommodating to allow us to leave our luggage on the first floor since we landed hours before check in! we highly recommend to anyone!

every bit as beautiful as the photos would have you guess. the proximity to the park and nostrand ave nightlife is an excellent perk as is the grand piano. the co-host, douglas, was incredibly welcoming and made the stay all the more pleasant. highly recommend.

roberto was a great host who checked in on me periodically throughout my stay. to insure that i was happy with the place and that everything about my trip was going well. was very nice knowing had i needed anything he was just a text away with whatever help i was looking for. look forward to my next nyc trip would definitely rebook again as it was centrally located to alot of the places i was wanting to go.
great location in a quiet building. sam was a great host and we had a great stay.
great stay at monica's apt.! the location is great. close to the subway (but not too close as far as noise goes). quiet neighborhood. easy check in and out. highly recommend.
great location and a cozy clean room!

this was our first airbnb experience and, my goodness, we were amazed at finding such a large, stylish and well equipped apartment in such a fantastic location at such a reasonable cost! this place has two large bedrooms a huge bathroom (and further shower room/loo downstairs) together with a lovely sitting room and enormous separate dining room with a very well equipped kitchen. the washing machine and tumble dryer were excellent. we loved the location which was very close to central park. there were lots of shops, restaurants and supermarkets nearby. check out the local trattoria which was excellent at reasonable cost. there was plenty of linen and towels provided together with consumables such as kitchen roll, loo roll, soap, shampoo, washing powder etc. francesca is a great host who kept in contact with us by email to check everything was going well. there were lots of notes about the appartment and local services and we found everything we needed very easily. i have been telling everyone about this place and i'm sure that you will be getting lots of bookings from wimbledon very soon, francesca!

stayed for a week. easy to reach from jfk by train, about a 10-minute walk from the nearest station. there's a large supermarket right at the station, and multiple subway lines connect to manhattan, making it very convenient for sightseeing. the host was incredibly responsive and helpful—lent me dishes and showed me how to use the washer and dryer. the apartment is in a quiet residential area, so i slept really well every night. had a wonderful time in new york. highly recommend!

in an historic district near prospect park et al. the house is in good repair, but is it older. great carpentry details on interior lead you to the squeaky stairs and room upstairs with a shared bath. the hosts were gracious and easy to talk to. explained the claw-foot tub/shower plumbing, which is a marvel of finish plumbing retro. the room a/c and ceiling fan tamed the brooklyn summer hot spot. loads of funk and the fun is on you.

wonderful stay in super cute and well appointed home! shannon thought of literally everything when preparing this home. we had everything we needed and more. the neighborhood is quiet but a bit of a walk to metro access. we stayed over july 4 weekend and several places were closed unfortunately but otherwise there would be good food choices nearby.
perfectly clean, excellent location, exactly as photos represent.
thierry’s room was very clean and he was very welcoming. would recommend to anyone wanting to see the area
great place to stay for a few months while in nyc with the team. would recommend to others and would stay again
everything is good except limited time 9:00 pm to check-in.

was very good location right in times square clean room lots off stuff to do close to hotel only thing i find should be upgraded is the extra fees like tax’s when u check in witch was mentioned in the ad just be nice to see the full price when booking on here
very friendly hosts and clear check in instructions. the apartment was clean and spacious with good safety features. would definitely recommend.

i stayed at kat's for six weeks, and i loved calling it home! i commuted into midtown everyday, no hassle. the place is so spacious and has more character than any place i've visited--and by character, i don't mean a euphemism for small and old--i mean character! the care and genuine love you can tell kat put into her home is visible everywhere. the kitchen is better equipped than you will ever need, the neighborhood is a gorgeous community--treelined and residential but equipped with everything you need around the corner. loved my stay!
safe neighborhood. the suite was chefs kiss - loved having a private bathroom. the cleanliness was next level. will definitely be my go-to new york
it’s good to place to spend a night
loved our stay here! very convenient and very easy check in process!!

it was a cute little place and the street it is on has tons of things to eat at! the stairs are a little windy and small so be prepared for that. other reviews said it was noisy but we had the ac on and i used a sound machine on my phone. we couldn’t hear anything. it’s cute and fits your needs. we weren’t in the room other than to sleep.
matt's place exceeded expectations. location, cleanliness and communication!
i had an amazing stay! the host was awesome! the place was very clean and exact as pictures! would definitely come back! felt like home! :)

we have enjoyed our first visit to ny and our stay at christines. good location to explore manhattan. multiple subway options within a 10 minute walk. christine and her husband were very welcoming. christine was not at home for our check in but that was not a problem as she left the keys in a locker for us. we dropped off our luggage and were in central park within minutes!
super nice host. great spot right where we needed to be.
a totally very nice and clean apartment, in a nice area. olivia is a very varm and helpfull host. we were 4 adults, 2 couple, staying for 8 days and we had a wonderful time there!! gurli,denmark.

nice spot and everything was clean. i would stay here again and recommend it to others. just know that it's a small room, not that big of a deal but it really is smaller than it seems in photos. besides that, the rest is great.
we enjoyed the place. the room was small but very organized. we recommend the place for a short stay.

my visit to ny city and one of the loveliest visits by his grace and hosts along with hostesses help. the house was just as large, just as clean and just as beautiful in the site or as more with thrown ins of lovely old dig, family like warmth and lodes of apt advice. beatrice tracked us prior to our leaving the country, spoke to us and guided us right through jfk to the property. she was their in the house to recive us, guide us and train us on the appliances. the house was a pleasure to live in. her wifi was ver y effective and so were her inputs on gift shops, taxis, and sundry. she even adviced us on basics of safety tips for females in big cities just like a sister would. even while check out, she asked us to vacate by evening, if required. for my first visit to this warm hearth, i can summarise that the area is safe , has lots of hstorical significance, great architecture inside/outside house, proximity to subway, proximity to columbia and proximity to a great host!!! may i say more. remain blessed beatrice and bob.
thanks for being so inviting! i had a great time staying in your house and your family was lovely. will rent again :)

we had an amazing stay at nick’s lovely apartment! it was clean, spacious and very cosy with everything we needed on hand. the garden was an added bonus and nick was always on hand should we have any questions. thanks again and we will definitely be coming back to stay!
perfect when you need a no nonsense place to sleep whilst you explore the city.

my fiancé and i stayed at anna’s place it was amazing the check in was super easy and the instructions she provided was very clear. the bed was amazing had the greatest sleep and when you wanna stay in she has netflix if you need or want to catch up on shows and the shower was amazing . i really recommend anna and staying at her place definitely would stay again next time .

we were so pleased with george's place and how we were treated. perfect host. the lodgings were everything we were told. it was super clean, well-stocked, comfortable, bright, and cheery. we loved it.
nanonte’s place is beautiful and in a great location! she was communicative, warm, and welcoming. would highly recommend staying here!

great location, nice staff, clean rooms and a great view from the rooftop! read thoroughly before you book to not have wrong expectations. but it is a great place with all the basics you need to have a great stay in manhattan. thanks!
good stay. would stay again.
very nice place! easy to access and all the essentials are readily available within minutes! i would definitely airbnb at this place in the future!

i would definitely recommend rachel, for 4 simple reasons. 1) first and for most, rachel is super nice, helpful and accommodating. staying with her is trouble fee, i literally feel it at home. 2)very well equipped room, it comes with its own wifi, tv, fridge, e-kettle. and like hotels, she also provide towel, coffee powder and tea bags, even bottled water. you can't ask for more. 3) very clean room. the room is neat, and she also provided tissues and paper towel for the guests. the bathroom is also well maintained. she does provide toiletries as well. 4) great location. 5 min walk to the nearest subway station, and less than 10 min walk to shopping center and eating places.

the location & view were the best features. overall it wasn’t as cleaned as well as it should’ve. there was a few damages here and there which i brought to attention to the host. but pictures did match for the most part.
fantastic location in the heart of everything and efficient layout to maximize use of a small space. excellent communication by mario. recommended!
kathleen your very amazing and resourceful. i loved the breakfast and your cozy home. whenever i'm in brooklyn, i must book again....

we stayed here for a few months. park slope is a great location, and the space is great! the only issues we had were with ac units breaking down, but ahn and david were responsive in helping when this happened. generally, they were responsive and helpful with any concerns we had.

milton’s space was very clean and accurately described. it is near a subway station that takes you straight to manhattan centre. it was the perfect space for what we needed, equipped, clean and quiet. the mattress was way too soft in my opinion, but i was so tired after being out all day that i slept well any way.

enjoyed — however, in the future take care of the negative items (house keeping, etc) and you’ll definitely receive a higher rating & more recommendations from this family. also, if you have issues w/stairs be cautious (mobility problems) god’s blessings!
this is just a very nice place and a wonderful host. you will enjoy staying here

everything about this place was perfect , i really have nothing bad to say except for the group upstairs was a little noisy a few times but once they left everything was perfect. it’s a decent walk to get to major stores but there’s citi bikes for rent right across the street. well worth the price with everything included.

our family has stayed here twice and plans to return! beautiful brownstone with a lot of period features but updated amenities. the location could not be better, tons to walk to and an easy subway to manhattan. ame was lovely and helpful. you might hear others occasionally on the vintage stairs but it was a quiet and peaceful place to sleep, with low street noise at night. local joints we kept returning to: bagel pub slope foods inc (the 24-hr grill bodega on 5th ave and st marks)

the apartment was clean, has everything we needed, and looks exactly like in the photos. location is the best part - just a few minutes' walk to central park.the only downside was narrow stairs, but it didn't bother us. host was very accommodating and responsive. overall, it was a good stay, and i'd definitely recommend this place, especially if this is your first time in nyc

this was a lovely, clean apartment that i almost preferred hanging out in to going out with the friends i was visiting. a spacious updated studio with beautiful detail and the softest bedding, it had everything i needed for a short stay. machel is a very responsive host and i would love to stay here again in the future. one thing to be mindful of if you’re staying on a weekday, it is across from a school and park so you will hear that energy in the morning and afternoon, but it’s easy to tune out if you’ve lived in a city before. otherwise, it was a peaceful stay.

we stayed at edna + isaiah's place for five nights in october and had a lovely time. the place is spotlessly clean and in a nice area with lots of cute bars and restaurants nearby, and plenty of places to buy groceries etc. the nearest subway station is less than 5 min walk. edna also arranged a lift from the airport which was much appreciated by our two tired kids.
great place great stay. great host as well very respectful and helpful
great neighborhood and friendly neighbors, quiet street, easy access to train and local restaurants. i would stay again and recommend this place to others.

jessica’s place worked perfectly for me and my family when we were visiting friends in brooklyn. conveniently located, quiet, and spacious for accommodation in ny! it worked perfectly for us since we were traveling with a baby. jessica was also a great communicator. we would definitely come back!

i stayed for five days, and it was a great experience. the location is close to the subway station, making it easy to get to manhattan. the room was comfortable, and jiyoun was very kind and quick to respond to any questions i had!
such a special, lovely little spot in one of my favorite neighborhoods in the world. i'll definitely be staying again and you should, too!

my family of 4 had a wonderful stay at the urban retreat in brooklyn. the apartment is cozy and comfortable. beds were comfortable and kitchen and bathroom were super clean. minimal street noise is heard in the apartment which fostered very restful sleep. the apartment is just footsteps away from subway access. francesca is a great host. kind, helpful and very proactive. would absolutely stay here again if we are back in town.

devon was so helpful! he left us step-by-step instructions and made the check-in process so incredibly easy. the space was clean and tidy, and we enjoyed our stay. we were only about an hour outside of times square and had access to free street parking at this location, which made all the difference in the world! devon was also kind enough to provide wifi and other convenient amenities. thanks again, devon!

ph203 was a good value, though not particularly impressive as a room, relative to the other apartments on the floor. clean, pretty spacious for nyc, and everything works well. nice furnishing, okay views. front desk staff are pleasant and very attentive. a good alternative to frou-frou hotels for an extended stay.

we were super happy with our stay at philip’s. they were friendly, easy to communicate with, flexible and overall great hosts. the place was comfortable and had a nice setup and with rooms on opposite ends of the apartment for privacy plus we had a private bathroom!!! williamsburg is also great and there is lots of great shops and restaurants near by. we would definitely stay here again. thanks guys!

mr williams was great, we were a little late getting through the new york traffic but he was there when we arrived and explained all the information we needed for the flat. even provided us with water which was great as it was late and a hot day in ny. the rooms were fantastic size and there was plenty of space in the living room. the location is ideal, 5 minutes from the subway which gets you to times square in 15-20 minutes. mr williams also messaged to see how we were doing during our trip which was a nice touch. overall a great experience!!
place was nice and clean . they were super nice .

this was my first experience with airb&b. i used to live in astoria and i truly loved the idea of staying near the old neighborhood while visiting nyc. yioti got back to me immediately after sending an inquiry email. within 45 minutes, the two-night stay was booked! i was so excited. the room and garden was just as it appeared in the photos. including audrey's breakfast at tiffany's image! kyri was the one i dealt with in person, and he was very helpful and friendly. he offered local suggestions for great morning coffee and greek food, which i craved! i definitely took the opportunity to enjoy the outdoor garden and the sounds of the city. just lovely. though the rumbling of the elevated n train - ten blocks away - is quite apparent, it does not interfere with sleep...and perhaps even lulls. in fact, for me it only added to the city atmosphere! also, do not be fooled by the outside of the building, or the hallways which are under slight renovation. once you enter your room, it is a mini shangri-la! and the best-kept and best-priced secret around! so sweet! situated conveniently between both the n and r subway lines, no matter where you intend to go, it will be a short-shot into the city. i would definitely stay again. it was quite satisfying. enjoy!

we had a fantastic month-long stay at raf's place while we were in the process of moving. it was the perfect temporary home and made our apartment search so much easier. the location is absolutely perfect. the area is amazing with so much to do and see. it was incredibly convenient being just a five-minute walk to the bedford l train, which made getting into manhattan a breeze. would definitely recommend!
christopher was a great host. he was responsive and very hospitable. our stay was short, but his home made us feel cozy and safe.

david’s place is great, a real treasure. the house is comfortable and david is so welcoming and generous.the back yard and patio is a lovely place to relax and have a meal. the area is easy to get to via the subway and just about anything you want or need can found on king’s highway. i highly recommend staying at david’a, he’a wonderful host. you’ll be glad you did.
great host, great location and he is very helpful, would definitely stay again

normans place was adorable!! i loved my stay, didnt want to leave. place was clean quiet and cozy. nornam responded quickly gave clear instructions. location was amazing. will definitely be staying again.

i had a cold, gloomy, rainy, and wet week in ny and jasmine’s place was a warm amazing sanctuary that got me through the trip. it’s very well located next to the trains. there are so many food options around. the place is so clean and stellar. the cherry on top are the heated floors. it’s all chef’s kiss. jasmine is the absolute kind and sweetest host and has decorated the place in an admirable and truly welcoming way and the place is truly a gem. i cannot express how amazing this airbnb is.

the perfect airb&b experience! everything carefully thought of, nice, quiet, clean, lots of space, kitchen generously equipped - great location. wouldn't hesitate to recommend staying here to all my friends! hege&mona
10/10. would b&b again
great, quiet and neat airbnb in williamsburg that has everything you need, including very nice and polite hosts.

one of the more pleasurable stays i’ve ever stayed at!
convenient and good value in a cool neighborhood with jamaican influences and easy access via subway to manhattan. lots of good cafes and restaurants in the area too.
perfect for a one night stay close to jfk airport. clean and convenient.

what a fantastic space with really lovely hosts. had the perfect stay, and highly recommend. the suite was sunny, spacious, and perfectly equipped with everything i needed to feel right at home, plus some extra nice touches like the mattress/pillows and standing desk. astoria is a great location with easy access to both the city and airport and a very warm neighborhood feel. justin and tadela were communicative, flexible, and extremely gracious...justin greeted me at check-in and they gave me a batch of phenomenal homemade cookies i will never forget! again, highly recommend this listing!!
great location, fantastic host. within walking distance to everything.
anne’s place was great! it had everything we needed (including a cozy mini split) and it felt safe. we loved how clean and private it was. highly recommend!
great location, space just as described, wonderful hosts. would absolutely book again.

staying at the hampton inn near madison square garden was perfect for our girls’ trip. the location couldn’t have been better—central, convenient, and making it easy to get around manhattan and offering lots to do and see within walking distance. the room was clean and well laid out, with plenty of mirrors, which made getting ready with four girls surprisingly stress-free. i would definitely stay here again!
we had 1 bedroom available and a couch bed . the space was very nice and clean and had a nice balcony . the host was very sweet and answered any questions we had , we had a great stay (:
very convenient location. easy to check in.
this airbnb was beautiful! i would definitely stay here again. 10/10

yuvala and dror are very nice and friendly hosts, and they communicate very well! the location of the staying is absolutely a great value to pursue since you got 2/3 lines of the subway to travel to the city, and there are many great cafes and sightseeings to explore. the place is very comfortable and quiet to stay. we had a lot of luggage, and dror was very considerate and allowed us to leave the luggage there while we explored the city for the last day. we are very delighted with the staying! thank you for hosting us!
very beautiful space, with all imaginable amenities. quiet, safe, and convenient to stores, coffee shops, and services. kito is a call away, and very responsive. i would stay again.
dawn was an amazing and attentive host. she made sure all needs were met and went above and beyond her duties as an airbnb host. i highly recommend this listing. thank you for everything dawn.
you will love this apartment that victoria has decorated so beautifully. it is close to subway for an easy commute to manhattan. also close to many restaurants and stores.

great location (walking distance to javits center)! unit is cozy but comfortable and very well-appointed (although we didn't use, the unit has cooking appliances, e.g., full stove/oven). in-unit washer/dryer is great! beds were comfy; bathroom was clean and well stocked with necessary toiletries. would definitely stay here again!
very nice host clear place feel safe at home
augustin is a grea friendl host who was very attentive, provided clear instructions. ckean & great place to rest. i definitely would stay here again and i recommend his place.

annie is the best host ever. i was with my mom visiting nyc. she always made sure we had everything and texted me and was always available. she was very flexible with the check out time and was very accommodating to us. her place is lovely, clean and you have everything you need even with a rooftop and a very nice view of the skyline. i would always come back to her place.
king’s place is comfortable and warm. king is a wonderful host and very easy going and easy to communicate with. the room was so homey and the place was very clean! would totally stay again!

clean apartment and clean room located near a subway station, a grocery store, a laundromat, ... everything to make your stay comfortable and convenient. i never heard the neighbors and, while i was aware of the street's noise, it never prevented me from going to sleep. after all, as it was mentioned before, this is new york city. jane was a wonderful host. she was welcoming from the minute i arrived and she kept me aware of happenings in the city. she dealt with my odd hours and we shared many great conversations. i would definitely stay there again.

i stayed here for 10 weeks during the summer of 2022. i enjoyed my stay. the apartment was extremely clean and had everything i needed. the hosts were easy to communicate with, and overall i am satisfied with my stay. my two complaints is that the building itself constantly smells like cigarettes and marijuana. i bought an air purifier during my time and it helped a lot. the second is the bed is extremely uncomfortable, but for a short period of time, it will be ok.
erick responded us very quickly, his house is really convenient
great shared space! we needed a place to get work done in the areaa and this was it! recommend for anyone who is going to in nyc on a budget. really cool space with an amazing price!

i have stayed in many airbnbs in nyc throughout the years and tony’s place really stood out. he as incredibly kind, accommodating, and responsive. the house was beautiful and i loved using the kitchen and the back patio. my room felt super private and quiet and sharing a bathroom was not an issue at all (there is also one available for use on the first floor). it was easy to access the subway and i loved the neighborhood. for me it was the perfect combination of a private place to stay with an option to be social with the host or other tenants if desired. i will definitely be staying here again!
good value for the money. easy access to/from manhattan and laguardia.

it’s great if you’re looking for a clean place to sleep for the night. everything was clean. the room is right by the elevator and on the 5th floor so it does get noisy, something to note if you’re a sensitive sleeper. otherwise, everything was great.
loved staying at dee’s place! good location, very clean, and super cozy.
we had such a good time at chris place communication was 10/10 we definitely recommending!

the place was great especially for the price, i really liked the host and how walkable it was to the metro, as well as our own bathroom. my only slight complaint is one of the neighbors had a dog that constantly bark at any slight noise he heard

i was so lucky and fortunate to find this little gem of an airbnb right in the neighborhood that my children live in so i can come visit anytime the place was perfect. location was so easy and the host was very interactive, and there were no problems. it was a great day.

we had a wonderful stay! this apartment is a rare find in nyc — newly renovated, scandi-minimal design, with a spacious kitchen and a coveted washer/dryer that truly makes all the difference for city living. gisellah and her family are incredibly kind, welcoming, and always available, making us feel right at home. the location is ideal — close to the farmer’s market, multiple parks, subway, coffee shops, restaurants, and just steps from bicyclette and union market. the downstairs neighbor is lovely, and the building overall is very well-kept, peaceful, and quiet. highly recommend!
a hidden gem! great location
dina is wonderful & easy to work with. i had a great stay & was very comfortable. feels like an oasis unto it's own :). thank you, dina!

not sure how to write this. the hotel was fine but i had a problem. the good: nice location, easy check-in/check-out. the bad: it’s not exactly a hotel; there’s no one on hand when you need it. i had a small bug infestation or something (these little fruit fly looking things, about 20 or so of them in my bathroom). when i told the hotel about it, early at 7am, they told me they’d send someone at around 9am. which is…weird? maybe i’m not used to this but if there’s a ton of bugs in someone’s room it probably requires immediate assistance? anyways. they came, cleaned it i guess (i wasn’t there because i needed to explore). i came back at night and there were still a few bugs but not as many. i wanted to shower but decided to wait too the next morning, i had an early wake-up though. my mistake for doing that. i woke up with a whole other infestation!!! i was so livid. at this point though, knowing they’re only going to come at 9 am (because why would a hotel have people on board for these issues) i left, without showering. when i came back again that night, i was so scared of even entering the bathroom because i was worried that there would be even more bugs. i could not shower then either, and i came back after 10 so i knew i wouldn’t get the immediate help i needed. there were so many bugs in the bathroom (probably like 40 at that point) that some even came out to my room. i tried to kill some but i hate bugs and just everything. i do have videos and pictures for further proof. luckily it was my last night. i slept with all my clothes on, covered my face and freaked out the whole night. the morning, i again avoided my shower (i haven’t showered in 3 days and i shower daily). i checked out, peaced out and vowed to never again in my life stay here. also no elevator is either good or bad depending on your perspective: i almost died each time going up 5 flights of stairs, especially the first time with my luggage. but so many calories burnt so at least one thing that was enjoyable. so yeah, never again. i hope you fix this problem chelsea inn and not have others live through this nightmare i did.

just stayed for 1 night but highly recommend it. dimitri was flexible and very patient with me during check-in. it's a great value for the money. didn't move around brooklyn so i wouldn't know how well connected is the location, but bushwick in general has lots of good to eat, drink and hang around worth checking out.
great location and super friendly staff. the lobby was cozy, wish they had a bar/food service but nothing beat sitting by the fire after cold snowy day!

this was such a great spot for a week-long trip! the desk/wifi was perfect for remote work, and the neighborhood felt safe with lots of great restaurants/shops nearby. the place was clean and decorated in a way that felt beautiful yet homey. thank you to dee for hosting!
roberto’s loft is stylish and in a great location. everything was well coordinated and communicated and our stay was wonderful.

i use to travel back and forth many times a year to new york, and i have tried many stays so actually i would say that my experience is quiet relevant... jennifer and property link are truly a fantastic surprise. jennifer was very kind and understanding, she has helped me a lot. the apartment is clean, new, very quiet and for any problem just contact the customer service and receive assistance in a few minutes. a better solution for manhattan is hard to find. special thanks to amanda from the administration ... a kind smile every morning. we will be back soon!

sarah's home on airbnb was truly a gem. the location was absolutely perfect, just steps away from central park in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood. the house itself was spacious and beautifully decorated, with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. the bedrooms were cozy and the entire floor felt like our own private oasis in the bustling city. sarah and her husband were amazing hosts, always willing to help and make sure we had everything we needed. they were super kind and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. it was clear that they truly cared about their guests' experience. one of the best parts about our stay was being able to hear the birds chirping in the morning - such a rare and wonderful experience in new york city. it was the perfect combination of being close to all the action while still being able to relax in a peaceful and quiet environment. i highly recommend staying at sarah's home.
oscar spot was givin all the vibes clear instructions, easily accessible, wonderful living, kitchen, and bath, most importantly accessible environment both inside and out!!!!!

we stayed for 30 days and the apartment exceeded our expectations. it had all the amenities we needed, and the washer/dryer combo was very handy. our family of 4 had plenty of space to spread out, and it was helpful to have multiple rooms to go to for school and work calls. the location is super convenient. there is a large grocery store downstairs that we pretty much visited every day, and the subway is half a block away and takes you everywhere you need to go on the east side. if you have kids, there are at least a dozen playgrounds within a mile from here, and it's a half mile to central park. one thing to note: the wifi can be a little slow at times, but this might be because everyone is virtual right now during covid.
clean and tidy. friendly host and helpful. nice place not far from jfk. great deal
lovely stay . really enjoyed the location . i would definitely stay again !
a great place to stay, it's very close to multiple subway stations. the only con is the apartment is a bit noisy. the heater system made a noise while heating up.
thank you so much, your place is very nice, your home and people are so kind. i had a great time. the location is wonderful.

deborah's space is a great down-to-earth feel home that could not be more centrally located for someone interested in checking out greenpoint and is within quick walking distance of the the frequented north williamsburg restaurants and bars. low key spot with all the needed amenities and a super sweet hostess!
great place to stay, walking distance to the train, great places to eat nearby.

phil and monica were great hosts and super responsive! the apartment was clean and spacious. it had plenty of towels and comfy beds, which was much needed after long days in manhattan. we greatly appreciated the hot water and heat during our winter stay. the f train is a quick 1 minute walk, and there is a bodega on the corner for food and essentials. the apartment is located in a fun and safe neighborhood that was family-friendly. we have a 4-year-old, so the park and nearby shops and restaurants were great for us to explore. the apartment is on the top floor of a duplex—so be prepared for some steps, but if you’ve been to any other northern city—this is typical. we would certainly visit again!
very nice and clean

my stay at scott's apartment was picture perfect. from the minute we landed, and even the day we got home, scott was in easy contact. the amenities were exactly as he stated and he was a gracious host, going so far as to hand deliver delicious baked goods from his family's bakery. in nyc, where square footage always comes at a premium, the spacious outdoor private deck was one-in-a-million; the true gem of the apt. (next to the fabulous water pressure in the shower...) while there is a huge rooftop deck, we never even felt the need to go, what with our own decadent oasis right off the master bedroom. as for the building itself, it is a lovely residence. the doormen were almost like a private concierge with their personal attention when came & went on our merry ways. all in all, i highly recommend scott, his apartment and that you consider making this your next nyc destination.
alina’s place is superb! very cute, clean and nice location. close enough to visit all the hot spots but just outside of the city business. it was also very clean and the linens were nice.

i really enjoyed my stay there. it was easy to get to, and easy to take the subway to all the places that i needed to be. the host responded quickly to any issues i had, and it was well worth the price. loved it.

the place was nice for somewhere to stay for the two nights of our music festival in coney island. it was nothing spectacular but it did the job. alex was friendly when he greeted us and to our liking he allowed us to have the privacy we wanted. the only things that bugged us were the 11 o'clock noise curfew that was not stated in the description for the "party" house, and the car that was parked and took up all the space in the backyard area that was promised to us. overall we enjoyed our stay.
amazing place. highly recommend!
great spot on the uws! right next to riverside park. would definitely recommend this stay

the location is very convenient, close to times square, broad way and subway station. on weekdays night, it is not that load. but on weekend nights, music and laughter can be heard in the room since there are plenty of bars and restaurants on the street. anyway it's good and we had a good time in new york.

perfect everything was perfect, i had a great week, the apartment is even better than in the photos sergio is so kind and present for every question the appartement is very clean everyday and the subway is nearby
great place in a great location!!!! would totally stay here again. thanks stefanie

first things first, this place is in a very convenient location! very walkable, and is a short walk from lots of great shops and restaurants in les. it’s also a short walk from a lot of subway stations too, if you wanted to go to other parts of ny. as for the place itself, it’s small but homey - it’s clean and everything works. it does get cold at night so bring warm pjs. it can also get occasionally loud on weekend nights when people walk by, but that’s to be expected given that we’re in manhattan and for the most part my partner and i slept very well. highly recommend staying here if you get the chance to!

wonderful stay. wayne was kind and helpful at check-in, and responsive throughout our stay. the place was lovely, exactly as described and photographed. stocked with everything we needed. window air conditioners worked well. coffee and tea were great. full entertainment slate on the tv. quiet, clean, and comfortable. easy street parking. we felt right at home. one thing to note: for those with mobility issues, there are a lot of stairs. flight up from the street, another full flight (relatively steep) up to the first floor, then a third flight up to the bedrooms. we would absolutely recommend wayne's place and plan to stay here again the next time we visit brooklyn!
very respectful very nice and super sweet . very accommodating and helpful you should definitely boo with kim .
this place is a gem, exactly as described, super comfortable and a great neighborhood. definitely will book again soon.
excellent location, safe place, excellent cleanliness, what was contracted we had for 3 beds, i thought the place was a little small, but we had no problem, i would go back again
it is always a pleasure to stay at that place, peaceful, wifi, 50” tv 📺 for entertainment, very cozy!
i loved the room. it is small but has everything you need and it was well organized.
patricias place was great. it was in a great area near food and the beach. this is a go to spot if you want to be close to entertainment. patricia is great at making her guest feel welcomed.

we were three students who spent a few enjoyable weeks at elem's. we were more than satisfied with the service, fast response and location. the apartment is super close to the subway and the area offers many nice restaurants and coffee shops. central park is just a short walk away. it contains everything that one needs including a tv with netflix and a lot more. thank you elem for hosting us!
exactly as described. thanks!

thaya is a great host and her place is conveniently located. the apartment was clean, the room spacious. thaya is often around to help you with anything you may need, but at the same time, she respects your privacy. i'd happily stay here again.
the place was clean, quiet good value for your money. the hosts were very welcoming also communication was quick and timely. would stay here again if i was in ny.

we stay at nepreil’s while taking my daughter to jfk for her flight overseas. because of the close proximity to the airport and public transit, we had no apprehension leaving the car park at the apartment and taking public transit for out outings. the apartment was as described. very clean with all the necessities.
melisa and her husband are great hosts.

thank you for helping me during a difficult time. one thing - i forgot to mention to you that i needed paper towels, napkins, or another disposable paper product to clean up while eating, but next time. :) also, hurricane ida was quite rude, and caused flooding, but rachael and jerónimo were there to rescue me. thanks, y'awl!

ada was a wonderful host. she made herself available when we needed her, and also trusted us completely with her space. she is also very warm and friendly, and was very respectful and flexible with our needs and schedules. ada also provided us with a lot of privacy during our stay--she was mostly in her room or out--making us feel even more "at home." we were more than comfortable here. the location is also very convenient to the 2 and 3 trains, literally a two minute walk to eastern parkway / brooklyn museum station. the brooklyn museum and botanical gardens are directly across the street (the former has a great collection). you might find hailing a cab a bit difficult in the area, but it really is no problem given the proximity to the trains. we consistently looked forward to going "home," as we called ada's place, after long days in the summer heat and on foot. there was ac, a very comfy bed for two, television, wifi, and a beautifully decorated bathroom that we shared with ada (never a problem) that made our stay so easy and relaxing. i'd say the hospitality and experience exceeded our expectations. we love ada!!!

jason’s apartment is a great place to stay while in new york. if you want to experience the city besides the typically touristic things, this is the place. the neighborhood has everything you need in a les than 5 min walk and it allows you get to know and to enjoy williamsburg and brooklyn. it ’s also very well connected by train to manhattan (20-30 min ride). the apartment itself is clean and has everything you would need for your stay (including bath and kitchen products), and the bed is big and comfortable. jason was always attentive and answered fast when we needed to contact him.

this stay was amazing! it was so comforting to come back to such a clean and peaceful place after all the crazy of the city! jean was such an amazing host and checked in on us throughout our stay. we loved this experience! we hope we can stay again when we come back to nyc !

there was no door on the bathroom and the other guest would keep entering the bathroom while my partner was getting ready for work. multiple times. couldn’t get the light for the shower on as well. i can usually sleep literally anywhere but that bed was gnarly. biggest problem was no bathroom door in a shared house. that’s just crazy to me. had my partner getting ready for work and i had a job interview but the bathroom was occupied by the other guest who would continuously come back in the bathroom. seemingly only while my partner was in there.

thanks again for a wonderful stay!

nicole was so accommodating! we checked in late and she stayed up to help us and show us the place. great location! we’ll definitely book again if i’m in bk.

fantastic place in brooklyn. great location, lots of space and amenities, including a gorgeous backyard! ash was helpful and responsive during our whole trip. would stay again... and again... and again.

5 stars for our stay! unit was clean & exactly what we needed. easy access to the subway (2 min walk) & lots of good food around too. easy communication with the host. we had a little trouble figuring out the keys the first time in, but just made a note on our phone & no problems after that. too many air fresheners, we just unplugged them & let the unit air out. would stay again.
great place. this particular room had great views and the full moon could be seen at night. the same room as in the pictures.

beautiful, beautiful, beautiful place. the only downside is you won't want to leave! and, not sure it is in the description or not, but there is also a roof top deck that appears to be the only one up there. i would not hesitate to book this place again and again. susan was super easy to communicate with, the place was super clean, open, and cool!

tommie’s guest rooms are beautiful! the entire place is warm, welcoming, comfortable and cozy. the outdoor patio is a great bonus to have your morning coffee and people watch. highly recommend you stay and enjoy all of the restaurants and scenic views of the neighborhood!
great location with subway entrance right outside. responsive host within minutes through out the entire stay.

this is a wonderful place to stay and one metro line straight into manhattan. it had everything i needed.
nice stay, great location!

marianny’s place was perfect for our short stay. everything was as pictured. it was larger than i expected. we didn’t use the second bedroom but it was hard deciding which to sleep in because they’re both beautiful . she really made the space feel like a home away from home! i felt really comfortable knowing they make security a priority. marianny is a great host, as is the property manager kacey! i would definitely book again.

i have stayed at thomas and cindy's home a number of times . they are great and very accommodating host ! i have stayed here many times because the location is safe, quiet and affordable. also the bed is super comfy ! i would recommend their home without hesitation! thanks again thomas and cindy
price point is fair given the great location. while guests were respectful during quiet hours, the noise definitely travels so be prepared to hear guests above and around you moving around.
quick response, super friendly very helpful. enjoyed my stay and was a all around great experience ✨✨
very clean and in a nice location next to a 24/7 bodega.
great place to stay for the price

stephanie was super responsive and friendly. the location is awesome, and feels a bit more spacious compared to the photos. super easy to get to, as the g train is literally on the same block. my only complaint is that the place was not as clean as i would like when i moved in. no dust or stains, but it was cluttered in the drawers and cabinets. the apartment has dark furniture and lighting, which was not my favorite. it does get sun, but during the night it feels very dim. she was great at communicating if i had any questions, and when a lightbulb went out, her husband was able to come and fix it the next day.

description was accurate, it's a lovely apartment, well equipped and in walkable distance to subway and some major attractions (central park, museum of natural history, metropolitan museum of art). kevin was a great host. would return and stay again.
so great, easy check in and great location to surf!

we loved our stay at the moxy. our plane got delayed and they were flexible with our check-in. there is a lounge on the third floor that makes a really good spicy bloody mary. our room was on the 11th floor. it’s about the size of a typical nyc hotel room. it was reasonably clean, and the noise level wasn’t bad considering how busy the area is. the front desk staff, justin, and everyone else we encountered was super friendly. we would love to stay again.
a very special place to stay in ny.
overall it was a great location and great stay!
nice and convenient location in queens. close to subway
i booked a room with a bathroom but got the old bait and switch. just don't do it to yourself and move on
this was an absolute perfect stay. we are on a 27 day tour around america and this was a perfect crash pad for our new york city stop so much appreciation- lovely host !!
a truly beautiful apartment, area is nice and quiet, i have absolutely no complaints about my stay here! will definitely be booking again!

my husband, dog and myself have been staying here for at least 3 days every few months since june 2024. it is like a home away from home. i have never had an issue with the house. location is great, bases are in walking distance and there is a diner 1 block away. we already booked our next 2 stays.

elizabeth (liz) and ben were so friendly and welcoming. it was difficulty to find a dig friendly place to stay in nyc but liz and ben welcomed zoe with open arms and spoiled her with treats. the apartment was centrally located and a short walk to the subway. room was comfortable and had a desk and closet for personal items. overall a great stay with great people!

josh met us on arrival and was a good host. there were a few quirks to our stay but he did his best to help us when we were able to get in touch with him. the room is fairly basic, the bed was very comfortable and the bathroom clean, although it was through a common/shared hallway which we weren’t expecting. subways were a short distance away making it easy to get around to most places.

this was such an amazing stay. i thought with it being close to everything we wanted to do, it may be loud but nope. it was not loud at all. such an amazing host!! leigh is genuinely a great person with such good taste might i add. we are living in buffalo now, but we are from texas so the decor was very special to us during our stay. we will absolutely be staying at leigh’s place again. thank you so much for the welcoming stay!!

this apartment was in a wonderful location and was a very comfortable spot to stay. we were out in the city most of our stay so didn't spend a lot of time there, but were glad to return at the end of the day. we walked easily to restaurants and the subway. we would be happy to stay here again.

the apartment was comfortable, clean, spacious, and quiet. the furnishings and amenities filled my needs. the location was outstanding, within walking distance of major nyc sites in and near the financial district, very near restaurants of all types and prices, and very near wine, liquor, bakery, and grocery stores.
great location, great communication.
location 10/10 host communication 9/10 value 11/10 bed comfort 8/10 maintenance 7/10

alaric and anne are perfect hosts, very friendly and accommodating. the house is amazing, not just comfy but also a piece of history, it was amazing to hear and see everything they done to restore and preserve the place. the location is perfect with great connection to manhattan and close to many amenities. highly recommend!
richard is super helpful and always responds quickly! everything is clean and functions well. definitely recommend staying at rich’s place!
pablo was a great host. the place was clean, easy to get to, and the beds were very comfortable. i’d recommend this place to everyone!

my son and i stayed a full week here. the apartment is spacious and light, the bathroom is a great size. we were very comfortable here. the subway is about 10 min walk away with great connections to the city. jeffrey is a terrific host who responded to two minor requests immediately. he is a very nice person who took great care to make sure we were happy. it was kind of him to leave water and juice in the fridge for us, and i appreciated his taking the time to show me around the neighborhood and explain where everything was. saraghina restaurant nearby was great.

amy was responsive quickly and attentive, but she needs to be a little responsive with the temperature of the house. the house was cold, and i asked about it and said it will warm up eventually, but it didn’t. i am not trying to write a bad review or something, but sometimes a little bit up will do no harm. any thing else was ok…
great large space with available parking. quiet for being in a city. would definitely stay again.

we loved jeniffer's place. great location, easy access to subway and a central base for walking around chinatown, little italy, soho and tribeca. we didn't miss anything. we were certainly not the last time in jeniffer's apartment
conveniently located for my trip the next morning.

i visited ny with two colleagues for work and we were lucky to find this great apartment! shari is a very nice host, even though we arrived very late and she could not be there herself she had her mom meet us to get the keys and explain everything. the apartment was really spacious, welcoming and clean. we could even park our car in the driveway. i really liked also the breakfast supplies with bagels, cream cheese and much more. so we really think it was a perfect stay- thanks for everything! definitely recommended!

i really enjoyed staying in rachel's apartment. rachel was very friendly with a great laid back personality. she made me feel extremely welcome, making sure i had everything that i needed. she was very helpful about good places to go in the area and offered many different suggestions. the apartment is in a really convenient location, only a couple blocks from the g train and one block from the jmz trains. manhattan was extremely accessible, with only 3 stops to delancy street. the apartment was always clean and comfortable and had everything i needed for my two week stay. couldn't have asked for a better experience!
mahmood was incredibly accommodating. it was a treat to return to a warm welcome every evening after exploring the city.
perfect for our family of 5! conveniently located right by the subway. close to corner markets & coffee shop. lots of entertainment for the kids. we really enjoyed our stay!
jayu's communication is excellent, and her hospitality and accommodations are superb. our group of friends enjoyed our first trip to new york and had a great stay.
great amenities & location for price. bit of a busy building but overall as advertised.
very comfy. felt like home. would book again.

their home is in a charming residential neighborhood, people in the area were very helpful in steering me the correct way (i came by public transportation), the apartment was as advertised and well kept. plus i had fun dining at a local restaurant en route, over all, a good experience.
great location plenty of space quiet and nice.

we had a nice weekend in nyc staying at mary ann's place. overall, the apartment is worth the price. the neighborhood was okay, but it was not new and shiny. there is one supermarket nearby (ideal foodbasket) that was fine. the apartment is okay, i would not recommend it if you are not fit enough to climb narrow stairs. it is also not newly renovated, but it was clean, and the bed was great. if you need a stay near nyc for a fair price, i can recommend this location.

we enjoyed our stay! the best part was the great staff - they were always friendly and helpful, esp ruben and jesus. the place was expensive but likely on par for whatever you can find in manhattan. our 1-bedroom was as pictured, although a little bit more worn than we expected. the free laundry was awesome, and it was nice to have a big community kitchen available (we didn’t use it since we had a little kitchen in our apartment). would recommend if this place is within your price range.
lovely place. we had a very nice stay!

this is the perfect place for anyone who comes to nyc. i loved the room and sandra and cary are so welcoming. there is always food available, the house is extremely close to the station. they are true adventurists who will do their best to make your travel more diverse.

lee and teri were perfect hosts. they were very easy to communicate with. check in was completely painless and flexible. they were also very accommodating of me and my pet. the pictures, in my opinion, do not do the room justice. the room is huge, with an in suite bathroom complete with a whirlpool tub (a whirlpool friends). the room also comes with a table with four chairs. there is plenty of space for two people. i enjoyed buying things to microwave from the food coop and grocery store near the house and also ordering take out to treat myself. location wise, this place is also amazing. not only is it near basically all the stores you need, but is really close to prospect park and some beautiful houses that make up the historical flatbush malls. in the other direction, there’s a ton of of other food options including caribbean food, fast food places, etc, king’s theatre, etc. 10/10 excited to stay again.

flawless and excellent indeed ! one of my favorite thing in ny was chef step and his place ! he was incredibly thoughtful with my daughter and i. we were treated like family and felt at home every step of the way. five stars is clearly an understatment. thank you for making our vacation memorable ❤️
