this is a great place to stay in the center of harlem. the place is beautifully decorated with a lot of original charm and bed was comfortable. bathrooms are shared and very clean. easy to find and close to public transportation. would recommend.

adriane and greg's place was a perfect place to land at the end of the day. it being january, it was warm and cozy. i enjoyed the bath and comfortable bed. i had my car with me and always found a spot near to the door. the cafe le petit monstre and bar camillo were fun spots to visit right around the corner. the sounds from upstairs were louder in the morning, but everything else about the place made me not mind. the weekend days i didn't even notice they were upstairs. great stay and hosts!
pamela was a great host! she provided so much information on the area and was easy to communicate with! it was a great stay!

noelle made our weekend getaway so great! she was so nice and understanding of all of our needs. the apartment was super clean, and the location was extremely convenient. very easy to get into the apartment as it’s on the first floor. we were only 4 but it can easily fit 6, as the couch in the living room pulls out. noelle even set up the dining room for us because she knew it was my cousins birthday. i’d recommend this place to anyone visiting! and i will definitely be back here again. thank you noelle!
so lovely! beautiful old building and studio. just a few blocks from the subway, amazing deal.
great place, neighborhood, and host!

edgar is a great host, really proactive in making sure we had a perfect stay. the flat is comfortable and well equipped, and we loved edgar's art work throughout. the location is great, so near to central park and to the subway. very highly recommended.

on the one hand, the apartment was a large one bedroom as advertised. and it was very convenient to all of the times square attractions. jane was pleasant to work with. on the other hand, there was literally no storage in the apartment. all drawers and closets were full of the owners things. we lived out of our suitcases the entire time we were there. further, jane never provided us access code for the 5th (common) floor, which was where the fitness room, game room, and other amenities were located. we requested the code multiple times.
had a great stay at andre’s place. quiet neighborhood with great local restaurants. location was very close to the train making getting to the city a breeze. i would definitely stay again.
paul was super helpful and made our time seamless. the property was as expected, and the location was amazing (just a quick walk to the d). paul was a great host.

wonderful staying with aisha! i’ve booked airbnb’s quite a few times but this was my first staying in a shared apartment with the host. couldn’t have gone better! i had some last minute flight changes and she was flexible, understanding, and accommodating of my travel needs. the room was beautiful, felt super private and comfortable. the perfect place to touch down and rest after exploring the city all day.

had a great summer stay with my dog, harvey. for me, having the private yard in the city was an amenity well worth paying for in exploring places. adé and travis were both very responsive whenever i had a question or minor concern and were friendly while giving space. the apartment is very comfortable and is exactly as described in the listing. my dog and i would walk once or twice a day around the neighborhood, and everyone was very friendly. the weekly cleanings were above-and-beyond. being a block away from the c train really does make getting to manhattan very easy. one small thing to be aware of for fellow out-of-towners who love their sleep that can take some getting used to is the "sounds of the city" at night, but earplugs and a white noise machine provided by travis will help you adjust. would stay again in a heartbeat and grateful for the hosts!
the place was very clean, the air conditioner worked great, and it was close to everything. the yard was a huge bonus!

great apartment for an authentic ny living experience! the unit was clean and served it’s purpose well. located well within an easy walking distance to anything you need from mass transit to grocery stores. kevin is an excellent communicator, and made sure my stay was as comfortable and enjoyable as possible.

this was a perfect find for my family and i! it was very clean and perfect for our short stay! host was amazing and accommodating and responded very fast with any questions that i had would definitely book again!
joy is an awesome host. her place was very peaceful and no one bothered me while i stayed.

the place is very well located and very comfortable. i definitely recommend it. we had an amazing stay, and it was super easy to get downtown since there’s a subway entrance nearby. the bed was comfy, check-in was smooth, or the host was responsive.

my partner and i had a long stay planned (~70 days), however we ended up cutting our stay short due to unexpected various pests we encountered almost daily. with this being said, our host was extremely proactive and was willing to do anything in his power to help us with the issue. the problem ultimately persisted and made us uncomfortable which resulted in us looking for another place to say and canceling the remainder of our trip. we appreciated the efforts of our host but decided it was best to leave the listing.

the place is nice. the a/c works perfectly. there is no netflix on the smart tv or cable. the internet is fast, but isn’t anything crazy. melody is super nice and accommodating. her apartment is clean and she allows for space where you can keep dry & refrigerated goods. showerhead is in the middle of the tub instead of in front which was a little uncomfortable, but overall it was a good stay.
anibal was a great communicator and a cool neighborhood to explore!
this was a good place to sleep overnight between flights

our stay set the bar very high for airbnb experiences. james and siobhan's place was clean, roomy, and beautifully decorated. from stocking the fridge with local groceries to leaving us a bottle of wine and ample towels, this airbnb put hotels to shame. we had a great time, and i would highly recommend staying at their place.
this was a beautiful apartment in a great location to explore nyc. thanks!

great location! right in times square! i had a great view from my room, facing times square. the hotel was clean, and staff were nice and welcoming. i would definitely stay here again, the next time i’m in manhattan.

the place was clean and in a good location to all the sites to see. check in was at 3:00. i did inquire about early check in. henri informed me that cleaners were there at 11:00am and he would reach out when the room was available. he failed to reach out to me again prior to 3:00. so i wasn’t able to check in until after 3:00. the luggage service was amazing to be able to drop your luggage off prior to check in. very helpful. ceilings were very low in the bedroom upstairs and was extremley hot. the loud banging of the pipes occurred all night, and effected our sleep. with minor complaints overall experience was good.
great stay! will definitely stay here again when flying out of jfk.
great location and clean, lovely space! erika was a wonderful host—very communicative and friendly.
it’s where you would want to stay if ever in new york
george was awesome. him and his dad are very accommodating. i had never been to new york, and i think george's place is a great place to stay.
the was wonderful i can’t any time i stayed there
great time, great place, great stay !
great location - easy check in and out. spacious nyc apartment with a king size bed. would return.

this is a very nice space, 2 levels with the living area upstairs and the master downstairs. both levels look out upon the backyard. the master has a king bed, which is a nice touch considering most have queens. plenty of good large soft towels for the shower and he uses good toilet paper, not the cheap stuff you find often.the unit is really appointed well, and john the host is pleasant and very responsive to any texts. the location was great for us, as it was one block from our son and family, but it is also convenient to the subway and it's easy getting an uber. very quiet neighborhood, with lots of trees along the street. market is only a couple of blocks away. next time we go back for a visit, we'll use this one again if it's available. btw, the furnishings are very cool, including the pictures on the wall when you go up and down the spiral staircase. john is also located next door, which is reassuring, when you need something.
wonderful spot for an extended stay! 10/10 recommend.

rachel’s place in queens was a nice and convenient spot for my stay in new york. the airbnb is located on the second floor and was clean and well-maintained upon arrival. one of the highlights was the fully stocked kitchen, there were plenty of kitchenwares available, which is great if you enjoy cooking your own meals. that said, the quilts provided were a bit thin, and even with the ac set to a warmer temperature, it felt a little cold at night. there was also a slight odor coming from the quilts, which was a bit off-putting. aside from that, the overall stay was pleasant. the location was quiet, the apartment was tidy, and it served well as a base for exploring the city. with a few minor improvements, it could be an even more comfortable stay.

this was the perfect home base for a trip to new york for a conference. comfortable and quiet. so easy to get into midtown on the q line. do yourself a favor and check out no glu if you're gluten free!
amazing experience super clean and easy!
had a great stay, thanks!

daniel was a great host! responded very quickly, and was very accommodating.check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful. the apartment was very clean and well stocked. overall a wonderful place. would stay here again easily!
we had a nice stay, everything was as described and worked great.

"an absolute hit if you want to stay in the upper east side. super quick to central park for a run. breakfast just around the corner. everything you need in the apartment. very clean and well-equipped. also very relaxing for sleeping. i’d gladly come back anytime. thanks for everything!"

we had a great stay. the appartement was very clean, the staff at the entrance is great and very helpfull. in the appartement there is all the needed equipement. the building is well placed, but still in a quiet area, with stores nearby, and somes buses lines very close (subway at 10 minutes walk). there is just few minor things that can be fix or enhance to make it even better. thanks to all the beekman staff for our great stay in nyc!
solo traveled for the first time, and trey reassured me with the area and the comfortability of the space inside. properly communicated throughout my whole stay. 5/5!
the box house hotel was great! excellent location, very walkable for around the greenpoint area. room was clean.
great crashpad in nyc

check in process is easy. bruce sends a detailed attachment which outlines everything you need to know about the apartment, including where all the outlets are! everything was clean and tidy and there is bedding to serve anyone’s needs. the kitchen is well equipped. we enjoyed our short stay.
staying at daniel’s was a very good experience. i needed a temporary place to stay and that’s what i got. there is not central heating até the apartment but two heaters were enough.

alejandro's place is great. excellent location and very easy to get around. there are a lot of bars and restaurants near the area. metro station is only a few blocks away. the room is better than in the pictures and alejandro was a great host. he keeps everything in order and the apartment is lovely.

i really appreciated the size and privacy of this home. it is on the third floor so there is no noise from upstairs neighbors. the bed was really comfortable and the home was very clean and smelled lovely!! it was a great spot to unwind after a day exploring. thank you!
nice clean room and bathroom. own entrance and close to train station. very quite and very comfortable.
very clean and comfortable apartment on a quiet street. would stay again!
quiet and peaceful neighborhood. checking in was a breeze with clear instructions . home was quiet and clean. enjoyed my stay!
had a great stay at renee's "flophouse". beautiful old house with character, a short walk to the subway, quiet room overlooking a backyard with a beautiful tree. will come again!

what a wonderful, clean, inviting, safe and convenient home to stay in! thank you farhan for being an incredible host, for sharing some great food spots and tips for getting around easily in nyc. the check-in process was seamless and we were even welcomed into the home personally. this is less than 10 minutes from lga so it was awesome to be able to get to our place so quickly after our flight to freshen up and not skip a beat! hotel quality amenities and spotless! next time we are in nyc, i am looking for this place first!

great cozy attic room. tons of books to read plus some cool board games. the living room area had everything i needed including coffee and snacks. a much needed retreat for me to decompress and rest. loved it.
this place was great. it was a quick walk to the f train which was very convenient. it was clean and exactly how it was advertised. would definitely stay again!

we very much enjoyed our stay at the cozy studio. check-in and check-out were easy. the entire studio was clean and furnished as per the photos. whenever we had questions, hugo and laura were very responsive. we appreciated the thoughtfulness of the hosts in that they provided a few snacks, a keurig machine with some pods, tea, and some beverages on the house. we had everything we needed for comfortable stay and more. if are back in the area we would love to stay here again! highly recommend.
very nice stay! quiet & had lots of stuff to do around town!

great place. felt safe. the place isn’t the building you see in the street, you enter and go through that building to the one behind it. it got loud because my room was right by the court yard (between the two buildings) but it’s to be expected so it was okay. overall loved it.

nicole was so kind and accommodating! we arrived extremely late at night/early morning after a long international flight. nicole was communicative throughout the check-in process and the place was absolutely lovely. falling into a comfortable bed in a beautiful private apartment was definitely a huge relief after long travel. i can’t recommend her place enough!
karina was an incredible host! she was friendly and communicative. the listing was spacious and exceeded expectations for our 4 night stay!

my daughter and i had an excellent stay at e's studio. there was a basket with complimentary toiletries which was a special treat and greatly appreciated! the fridge was stocked with many cold bottles of water. we ate out but it was great to have cereal, cookies or some popcorn available for a quick snack:) the place was very clean with plenty of towels, soap and shampoo. the argentinian cafe around the corner has good soup and empanadas! thank you very much, e!
great place! i recommend to those who wanna have a real nyc experience

simple, comfortable and easy! ana is a wonderful host and made sure i was comfortable at all times! check in was a breeze and i even arrived earlier than expected. the apartment is clean and the room is exactly how it is advertised. perfect place to stay if you're looking for a safe place to crash while in uptown. subway was very close. close to everything you need, plus a beautiful beautiful park!
great value and location. host very responsive and helpful. we enjoyed our stay in nyc despite the heat and humidity of august!!

this airbnb was beautiful, clean and comfortable space for 7 people. the host was extremely helpful with instructions and quick response time. if you are staying with a lot of people just be careful of being noisy after 10pm the walls are fairly thin, including being able to hear the downstairs neighbors as well. overall though, it was a great experience and i will definitely book with him again!

not a bad hotel but rooms are not big enough for a family to stay in. also no rollaway beds available at all. not worth the couple thousand i spent for the week. the best part was the coffee machine in the lobby.

i was so disgusted to see bedbugs in our bed, among other bugs all around the sheets! there was a blood stain on the chair by the vanity, and the room had not been cleaned. on top of all of this, we have not been able to communicate with the host and receive a refund, even after we had to leave the trio and cancel our two nights due to the disgust of these bugs! i will be going to higher ups, because this is so disgusting.

first off i wanted to say it was a nice place, a bit overpriced in my opinion but was nice peaceful place. there was some heating problems which the host helped with that and i appreciate it, one issue was the stove only had 1 burner working for the first week, after that it wasn’t working at all. they made an appointment for someone to fix the stove a day before my checkout, i had to buy a lot of takeout because of the issue. despite the issue i requested an extension of my stay however they significantly raised the price, i asked why and was completely ignored. overall the place is nice and comfortable but i wish they were more sympathetic of the issues that came and at least responded out of respect. for future guest, to my knowledge the stove should be fixed now so you shouldn’t worry. this is my honest review
everything was as expected in lucy’s apartment. would stay again!

terrible staff communication. triple charged my card despite my stay being entirely paid for prior to my arrival . i was told it was an “accident” and the receptionist wasn’t aware i had already paid despite having receipt confirmation and already being checked into a room for several days. was told i wouldn’t get the $$ back until checkout since it was already pushed through. i didn’t get the money back, so i had to put a dispute through airbnb & my bank. made the most of my trip, but it basically ruined it. wouldn’t stay again nor recommend.
h it is a very central place, easy to find
clean, well appointed, spacious apartment. pleasant, relaxing vibe. surrounded by lots of great restaurant choices. lorna was a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. highly recommended.

great location & friendly neighborhood. the place is a lot bigger in person! affordable, cute & perfect for my friends & i. we had a great stay & alberto was a great communicator. i would definitely recommend! :)
wonderful little apartment in a surprisingly quiet area. the walk to and from public transit was no problem at all. only saw one really small cockroach, otherwise no complaints. would stay at again!
i would definitely stay at sabrina’s home again. she made my family and i feel like we were home. everything was as described and more.
really nice space, i would highly recommend and / or stay again.
roi’s place is clean and comfortable, and super well-located. roi and his wife are amazing hosts, very welcoming and thoughtful. we would definitely go back again!

stayed for a few day work trip with a few colleagues. solid place that met our needs. with rollaway beds, the space is designed to accommodate more people than you'd expect. a/c for summer nights was a nice amenity. overall a good value!

we had the best stay at eric’s place. our flight got in early and eric was very accessible and allowed us to get in early, and the place was just as described. the location was also great and we were able to easily get uptown and downtown from where we were! highly recommend staying here.
canal street is barely soho. except the noise that we did not know about, it is good location and a good deal.

a historic five-star hotel at time square at this price? incredible! clean and comfortable, with a great location, this is an excellent place to stay. the breakfast was the best one i've ever had at a hotel (albeit not included in the price, but there are other options to eat around time square).

i was very happy to stay in javier's place! he is a genuinely kind, polite and friendly host, respectful of your personal space and will leave you be (if preferred), or is equally happy to share interesting discussions. i hope to stay with javier again, and it will be a pleasure to get to know him better! the location is excellent for the les area, and convenient to walk or use the subway for any destination in nyc. for me the location was just steps from where i was working in the area! the apartment itself is minimalistic in a good way, with travelers' primary needs taken care of. in my room i had a comfortable bed with cozy linens and pillows, effective air conditioning (for hot weather during my stay), a desk with quality chair, and enough space for hanging clothes and storing luggage. everything was ideal and efficient for my needs. i very much look forward to staying again, and thank you javier for being such a lovely host!!

cute and high tech basement apartment in a great location, close to grocery stores, restaurants, cafes, bodegas, and prospect park. dan is very responsive, thorough, and helpful. great stay and highly recommend this place!
it was an amazing stay at gisele’s place. everything was better than i expected.
wonderful space. easy access to transit. host is wonderful and very easy to communicate with.
we had a great time at the hilton brooklyn! such a great deal, can't beat it. lots to do in the area too. we will definitely be staying here again i the future, thank you!

staying with laramie was a nice experience. the room is nice and super clean just like the bathroom. laramie is very attentive and always willing to help. the location is rather good, only 5 minutes walk from the subway to manhattan. i would definitely recommend this place !
great place to stay!
awesome place, stayed for a full month with my girlfriend and cat and the location was awesome!
although we've personally never met, ed was a kind host. communication was smooth, the apartment good, with an excellent location. thanks, ed!
erica was a great house. great communication and very helpful when a situation occurred
nice room. hosts were kind. it's nice that it was air-conditioned. it's a window unit by the bed.

i had a great time at the apartment. aletia is a great host, very friendly and helpful. the room was comfortable and has enough space to keep your stuff. the apartment is nice and aletia does a good job making sure it is in good shape. the location of the apartment is convenient, with a subway stop on the same block, and loads of places with everything you might need nearby. you will have a good time staying at this place.

cute and modern space. spotless with all the basics to cook and clean. we stayed for a month and we felt at home. the hosts were easy to communicate with and responded quickly. there is plenty of parking available on the street and the neighborhood is quiet. thanks for a great stay!

i stayed with tony for 3 months during an internship. tony is personable, kind, and full of great advice about nyc. he'll treat you like family if you're friendly! the airbnb is spacious and clean, and the location is hard to beat. good air conditioning keeps the place cool despite the summer heat. overall, a great experience. thanks, tony!

the best part for us was the location and easy check in! it is exactly where we wanted to be so that made it super convenient. the place was quiet and dark which was nice for sleeping. both beds were pretty hard and i will warn you not to accidentally touch the pipes in each room as they are scalding hot. the first night we stayed there it was very hot (december stay). we did turn off the radiators but the radiator in the back bedroom was broken so we couldn’t turn it off. we made sure to turn on the ac units the next day to cool the place down and then the air was nicer the second night. check in and out was one of the easiest i have had with airbnb in a while so that was super nice! the hosts were responsive as well.
we were in a great location just a few block from our family who lives in the neighborhood. highly recommend this lovely place to stay.
very central spot in queens. short walk to the subway if you feel like going to manhattan and lots to do around. ryan is a great host and will help you with anything

be's apartment was great. the place was clean and cozy, and it was exactly all that i needed. also, it is located in a good spot on the upper east side. overall, if you're looking to stay for a couple of days, this is the apartment for you.
marcia was a great host, very welcoming.

omg!!! florcie was wonderful!!! she had all the essentials for us, she responded so quickly, and was super nice. i loved the home and the location. super convenient for buses and trains. she definitely made my first time in nyc a great time. thanks again florcie. i look forward to returning asap!!!
great apartment that had everything we needed for our time there. also one of the best neighborhoods in brooklyn and close to everything. definitely recommend and would love to stay here again
shemi and her family are amazing hosts ! they are responsive and very helpful. we would definitely stay with them when we come back ! the listing is exactly as it shows on the pictures!
me and my gf had a unforgetteble time in your apartment not new york city. we definatly come back to same room !

“thank you so much, kathleen, for being such a kind and thoughtful host. allowing me to check in early took a lot of stress off my shoulders, and i really appreciated the privacy you gave me throughout my stay. you made everything easy and comfortable, and i’m truly grateful. i would happily stay at your place again and recommend your place to others!”
well decorated and quiet. close to public transport and perfect for relaxing trip!
this is a beautiful place. fred is an amazing host
wonderful place! sacha was terrific. would highly recommend place to anyone wanting to stay in midtown.
had a issue during my stay but host was great & responded quickly
the house was beautiful and the host was extremely friendly and helpful!
great location with easy access to manhattan. the metro is just right next door. the host is great and the place is great for solo/couple travellers. thanks marianna for your hospitality.
victoria is a very nice person and the place was just exactly as she described it.

we stayed for five nights in this brooklyn apartment. it is refurbished, cosy, clean, and spacious, situated in a quiet area close to a bus stop and within walking distance of the subway. the hosts were highly responsive, providing most of the missing items very quickly and ensuring that our stay went well throughout. highly recommended!
we had a wonderful time here! quiet neighborhood but easy access to many train lines

serene, comfortable, and immaculately clean. we arrived much later than expected and yet we were still greeted with a friendly smile. great communication throughout our short stay. we appreciated learning about this hidden gem and the history of the neighborhood. we would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing retreat with their pup!
great for what i needed and had the place to myself. wish i could rent longer term next time.

we enjoyed this location for our quick trip to nyc. the street was quiet but still very close to the subway, and an easy trip downtown to rockefeller center & uptown to the met cloisters. our family of 5 had plenty of space and everything was very clean with plenty of towels. would definitely stay again!

we only stayed one night with edward but stayed in the same building in another airbnb. this one was very small but the beds were comfortable. we arrived at 2 pm and check in was at 4 pm. we wanted to pay to have our bags stored which was $25. we weren’t planning to be back until 8 and because of that we had to pay the early check in fee of $50 to put our things in our room. since the room was ready it would have been nice if we could have just dropped our bags in our room, with no fee, since we were leaving to sightsee.

the team that helps out with this listing is so incredibly helpful! they were flexible with our traveling times, beyond friendly and always quick to respond to anything we needed. there is no kitchen, but they supply you with the basics you need to eat any small meals that you may want to prepare there (a refrigerator, microwave, toaster, and plates and glassware etc.) we didn't plan on doing any cooking, so it was perfect for us. two thumbs up for sure.
the stay in the apartment was simply great. location was nice to move around and actually yuki was very helpful, thank you so much i was able to make a great trip for my mother!

edward is a great host. responsive, easy to talk, welcoming. i am actually a local of nyc and know the living environment pretty well. the apt is located in the great area in lower manhattan and you can’t find a better deal when it comes to the price. apt is a basement converted into a livable space. also, to get into the apt, you should pass garbage bin storage… which may be unpleasant to some people. other than that, there are other issues. because edward tries to resolve all the problems asap, i won’t write the issues publicly. however, before staying here, you’d better communicate with him to better understand the place.
the apartment was just what was stated. beautiful neighborhood, plenty to do…..lots of places for food, coffee and nightlife.
everything was fine and neat. thank you!
very nice . being at the heart of brooklyn was an advantage. we only missed the washing machine not provided in the apartment.

great location, the apartment is perfect for long stays and has all the appliances you need. a few tips for success: you’ll need to go shopping on day 1 to get a few things in because it is very minimal in that regard; hand soap, a dish towel for drying dishes, etc. there’s lots of options nearby for that though and a whole foods a couple of blocks north. this is advice for any apartment in ny: bring ear plugs that are comfortable for sleeping in and a comfy eye mask. overall, i loved staying here. it was very convenient and clean, seemed new and modern for a ny apartment. i’d stay here again.
great place to stay! would recommend.
kathryn’s place is wonderful to enjoy nyc. we had such a great time ! location is conveniant to go to manhattan (bus or metro) and there is everything we need for a few days.

was definitely not 4.5 rated. could not leave room, door did not lock and had to wait for it to be replaced. room was definitely not 4 and above star. run down. hair dryer didn’t work. will not return.
very pleased for what i needed at the price i paid.

apartment was clean and close to the # 3 & 4 train. only plastic utensils and paper plates, cups. host was responsive when i requested pots and pans plus additional cups. washing machine stopped working shortly after i started a load on friday afternoon. host promised a repair on sunday. checked out on tuesday midday no repair or further communication from host regarding repair. the lack of a trash can outside results in rats going through garbage and contents spread on the ground.
pleasant and accessible atmosphere. very clean, comfortable and cozy.the host was very friendly and willing to answer any questions.

this studio is a perfect spot to "land" in when spending time in nyc. elizabeth is truly prompt responding to questions, and -- in our case -- a bit flexible with our check-in time since the cleaners has finished up early. the rooftop was still under renovation, as the airbnb announcement (and elizabeth herself) had made clear, but since it was quite cold during our stay this did not affect our feelings about the studio. plenty of hot water, nice towels and bed linens, huge closet so lots of room for clothes, 3 luggage racks (!), quiet building, and some great recommendations for restaurants/food nearby. we were happy that the three large windows (street-view) opened easily and had screens, as the studio tended to be on the warm side. this would not be an issue in warmer months. the problem was easy to fix by opening the windows and turning on the ceiling fan. street noise from construction, but earplugs are provided! we will definitely go back!

scott is one of the best hosts that i have ever experienced. we loved the apartment. i only made a couple of suggestions and i know that scott will take them into consideration. there is a grocery store just around the corner. i had scheduled amazon fresh to deliver and that worked out well for us. the apartment is convenient to the subway. easy to get to manhattan but can take up to 40 minutes. brooklyn area requires an uber. subway doesn’t really work. takes too long to get where you want to go. everything was wonderful. if you plan on cooking, let scott know what you will need before you arrive. kitchen is stocked well, but not complete. we had a blast and would definitely recommend!
this is my second time here, very responsive host with clear instructions, a very nice stay!
great location close to subway, the promenade and restaurants.

great and interesting space in the east village. location could not have been better. chris was super responsive and very accommodating when we needed to modify our original itinerary. would definitely recommend it to a friend.

jayu’s place was exactly as it appears on the listing and jayu is a wonderful host, she had plenty of water for us, breakfast and tons of fruit. she also immediately responded to any message i sent her and it was overall an excellent stay!

claudine's place is beautiful! it looks exactly as the photos. everything was nicely thought out. the space is nice and peaceful. claudine responded quickly when we reached out. will definitely stay here again.
awesome location, very walkable - place itself felt secure and private. host was very communicative and overall had a great stay!
mante is a very nice host and the room is perfect to stay over few nights.

we fully enjoyed our stay. anthony has been very friendly and helpful. the accommodation is very comfortable and impeccably clean. we enjoyed having breakfast in the quiet courtyard. we look forward to visiting again!

place was super small for 1600$ . the size of cubicle no exaggeration . she gave us only 6 towels and 3 blankets for 5 days and when asked for more she then tried to implement a 70$ fee . overall experience just makes me not ever want to go to nyc

i spent a wonderful month at charles’ place. the home is cozy, comfortable, and has everything you need. the location is great (close to central and riverside park), and is near the 125th metro station (which is an express stop for the a & d) charles was very accommodating and responsive throughout. i was worried about the couch bed, but actually found it comfortable for the month and easy to set up to convert the living room into a bedroom. overall, a gem of an air b&b with classic manhattan feel. thanks charles!
great stay! room is decorated so nicely & very clean. looks exactly like photos. bathroom is also very clean. rocelly is very friendly and a great host. i enjoyed my stay!

frances was the warmest host i have ever had. room was clean and her family were nice and sweet. she drove me to metro station to buy ticket. location is about 20 minutes drive to jfk. definitely will come back:)

anthony's place was beyond our expectations. it was everything we imagined our first stay in new york would be. a lovely brownstone home with character details and a cosy interior. the house was furnished with mostly new amenities and everything was sufficient for our needs. the neighbourhood is relatively quiet and safe, and quite near to the subway. anthony & lauren were also gracious hosts, always making sure we were comfortable. thank you for a lovely stay!

overall the property was very good for us. we had a group of seven for a weeklong stay. the house was spacious and felt comfortable. the location is in a great spot on the nw corner of central park right near several major subway lines making travel easy all over the city. the beds were comfortable, the kitchen had utensils for cooking, and on the whole the house was clean. evan was highly responsive whenever i reached out. we had a couple of issues though. first, the front door did not lock. this wasn’t the end of the world because there’s an external gate that did lock, but it was still a little disconcerting. we informed evan about the door issue the morning after our arrival. he indicated that the locksmith would come by during the week, but nothing. also, one of the three full bathrooms was not usable due to the toilet being sealed shut and the shower being in grimy condition. again, not the end of the world since the other two full bathrooms were fully functional.
enjoyed my stay, great location!
very clean place with easy access to the subway and nearby green spaces.
i had a wonderful stay at michael's place. can recommend!

the bedroom and living room are very spacious. the kitchen is not too small, but the bathroom is pretty cramped. however, for two people this is a really good size. like other reviews said, there is no ac which is not the best during the hot months, and the kitchen has a gas smell. the walk to the metro is less than 10 minutes, and there are a lot of places to eat in the neighborhood. the neighborhood was lively— my friend and i would walk back to the airbnb around midnight and people would still be out and about. overall, would recommend!

as described! honestly a great experience, clean, cozy, stylish, nice neighborhood, felt safe day and night. a bit far if all you want to do is hang out in manhattan, it is about an hour in subway, a subway station is a bit far to walk to from the apt and an uber to that station is about 12$. mrs. emma did recommend a railroad close to her house that we didn’t have the chance to explore but worth looking into, also if you have the time, i’m sure there are buses that can take you to the station aswell. ubers/lyfts tend to run high on prices, so looking into using public transport as much as possible since it is friendlier for the pocket. mrs. emma was an amazing host! she provides everything for a comfortable stay! couldn’t have asked for more!
all was good and communication in timely manner. close to metro and all action in ny.

this is the best airbnb i’ve stayed in. regina’s place is just perfect. clean, spacious, light and welcoming. it’s a true new york apartment. great location. regina is a wonderful host. i will stay again.
it's was very clean place, safe area, everything was clean and sophisticated, i will recommend to anyone

when my partner & i hatched plans to spend christmas / new year's in new york staying in a hotel for a few weeks didn't cross our mind. but finding a great place to call home on airbnb did and that's how we came across eric's wonderful apartment in bed stuy. as well as being affordable, the apartment is located within easy walking distance to a number of subway stations to take you on your new york adventure. the bed is comfortable and the neighbourhood quiet. we loved staying here and relished the opportunity to take a break from the hustle of manhattan at the end of a day or spend days exploring brooklyn. similarly, having the kitchen meant we could enjoy cooking in a few nights too. definitely make time to dine for breakfast and dinner at saraghina (a short 10 min walk).

a comfortable place, it has long stairs where it is difficult to carry large suitcases. the neighborhood is very quiet and the hosts are really kind. even though it's a comfortable place, it's about 1h using public transportation from manhattan.
best place to stay in ny.
great location. immacula was able to accommodate my early check in time. this was greatly appreciated!

nestled among the historic brownstones of the uws sits a fabulous albeit dated darling apartment. the location and functionality of the space more than makes up for its short comings. the stove is circa 1970, the microwave reminds me of one i had in my dorm room, and the coffee maker is a french press. it is a nice warm welcoming space thanks to the exposed brick and wood floors. the pics of the apt are pretty accurate except the sofa is now a loveseat and the coffee table is a long storage ottoman. the bedroom ceiling does leak if there's a consistent rain and harry was quick to provide pan and towels. the drip stops when the rain stops. you really cannot beat the price/value of this airbnb. on one side of the block you have central park, on the other you're on columbus ave. with a plethora of great bars and restaurants. my wife felt safe on early morning walks with the dog in central park and late-night walks on the block. harry was a convivial and attentive host. would book again.

sarah is a "super host" and deserves the ranking. great location near mta a train stop (2 blocks away) with great access from there to all of new york. we went to a train stop at 5:30 am, transferred to e, then to jfk air train, to arrive at the airport at 7 am. we were out late every night, often after midnight. it was safe walking in the neighborhood at any hour. the bedroom is neat and clean with a comfortable bed. we slept very well. sarah's apartment is tidy, the kitchen is nice and well-stocked. the bathroom is pristine. her rules are simple and clear. we met in person for check-in, then we were on our own for entering and leaving the premises, we left the keys on the nightstand when we departed. very simple and convenient. highly recommended.

the room is in basement so the smell is inevitable especially because the basement floor is hard to vent out the old air, necessarily humid. the air is really stuffy and stinks the lighting is really bad and it is worse because the sunlight is barely coming in. it is very depressing during the day and night too. the kitchen is there but there is nothing you could use but the microwave. no plates, no utensils (other than plastic fork), no pots or pans, no oven use, no stove use, just microwave. be aware that cooking here is not doable . the shower curtain smells sour and needs to be changed or at least washed. it is hard to fall asleep because you can literally hear someone in the next room yawning or snoring and also because the front door open light is constantly on and off all night and the window blind is not enough to cover it. make sure you have eye masks chang was responsive. you get what you pay for. the coffee provided was nice. no more than one night i recommend.
allen and his wife ann are incredibly welcoming. i had a few complications with my arrival and they were nothing but sweet. i absolutely recommend staying in their lovely home!
very nicely finished apt!

john is a very good host. upon arrival, he gave us a lot of local tips and also provided us a printed copy of his recommended restaurants and cafes nearby. there was also milk and food in the fridge. there is an attached private bath to the room for the guest use exclusively. the subway station is around the corner which makes it very easy to go out and about in the city.

the host and his family were nice and accommodating. the host responds to text very quickly which is great. the place was way bigger than expected and check in was very easy. we enjoyed our stay and will be revisiting in the future.

i loved the stay at romulo and vicky’s place. the room was spacious and very comfortable, matched the photos and description. the hosts were extremely friendly and very responsive, which i really appreciate. staying at their place was a wonderful experience, definitely great value for money. 100% recommend! 🥰

great place close to the n and w trains with lots of food nearby. the whole house is airbnb, with different guests staying in private rooms and sharing a bathroom and kitchen on each floor. the bedroom doors don't lock and the walls are very thin, but everyone was considerate and respectful; the bathroom was cleaned daily. good spot if you will be out all day and just need a place to crash at night. astoria is a great neighborhood. i booked this last minute when my previous accommodation fell through, and it was good value. thank you!

we will start with the good things. clean and cute, easy to get in and out. locks secure. the less optimal things, one thin bath towel . no washcloths . one shared hand towel w people you don’t know, gross! asked for another towel but never got one. our room was about 6 ft x 6 ft. you had to climb over the bed to get to the closet (meaning you can’t stand in front of the closet —- you have to stand in the closet to put something in it ).

the place was as shown and described. clean, close to transportation, and had ac. vibe was very responsive to all my questions and did their very best to accommodate any requests. i would recommend this place to solo female travelers given its safe neighborhood, 2 locked doors to the building, and 2 locks on the unit door.
tamika had a gorgeous home! she was very sweet and kind! there were a ton of amenities and tamika went out of her way to ensure her guests were comfortable! can’t wait to return 😊

very accurate description of the apartment and just a 10 minute bus ride to brooklyn. carly was a great host and made sure we had all the information we could need for our first time in ny. being our first trip to ny we were unsure whether to stay in manhattan (and pay a bomb) or venture a little further out and get more affordable accommodation.. and carly's apartment is great value for money. if you buy a metro card €33 each for 7 days (well worth it) then it is so easy to get from red hook to manhattan. we used the 61 bus from van brunt/dikeman street, then grabbed a coffee from baked (right next to the bus stop) took 10 minutes to get to brooklyn and then hopped on the subway to manhattan. if you want a quieter trip with the chance of seeing different scenery rather than just high rise, this is definitely the place for you. carly gave us her number before we arrived and any questions that we had she was quick to respond to. all in all, a fantastic experience.

great location, close to everything and all the stores either on 5th avenue and 7th. right in the middle. ideal for couple. quiet street. would stay again! i used it to host my parents from out of town. thank you!
great place for pilots/flight attendants. close, clean and a very responsive host.
a clean place and good communication with jack. a nice place to park and very convenient location.
this comfortable apartment was clean and welcoming when we arrived. it was even available early when our flight changed! we are very happy we spent our anniversary celebration staying here.

boris's place was great! location was excellent, close proximity to train (couple blocks) and 5th ave (lots of restaurants, bars, grocery store, pharmacy). the space itself was clean and the bed was comfy, overall a great spot for one or two people visiting nyc looking to explore!

very easy check in---her instructions were very good. great location--a very short walk to the subway station and the neighborhood is quiet per new york standards! we felt very comfortable being there.
enjoyed my stay here during my visit. cute place in a fantastic location to the subway, grocery stores, restaurants, and etc
excellent location and ideal arrangements for group of 4-6 people
hosts were very accommodating with our schedule and needs! super easy check-in process. unit was clean and well furnished. thank you for having us!
our family had a great time in staying in chris house. he is very nice person. we arrived late in first night but he still wait there welcome us. impressive brooklyn!

like others say, beware of hidden "credit fees" presented at check out. the listing does not say anything about it, and we only found out at checkout, there was a ~$50 per night fee presented as credit, however if you didn't use their "facilities" you still had to pay it. and only part of it qualifies, if any. so i would just expect an extra $50 per night.

wonderful place to stay in williamsburg! priscilla was very patient and accommodating with my changing travel plans and was generally a great host. super convenient location and friendly neighbourhood. i had everything i needed in the apartment, apart from a washing machine/dryer but there was a laundrette nearby so it was ok. would definitely stay again!

stayed for a month at jesse’s place for a rotation i had in the bronx. it was absolutely perfect for commuting there and for getting downtown very easily. it was quiet at night and i felt very safe as a solo female traveler staying in the loft. jesse was also a wonderful host and very easy to communicate with. i would stay here again in a heartbeat.

timur’s place is fabulous. the location is unbeatable. everything is very high-quality, well-kept and clean. timor was an excellent host. he was very responsive. although the apartment is a basement apartment the blinds can be raised to let in some light and the window in the bedroom looks out on beautiful greenery. although we did not cook because we were only there 3 nights, we would have been very satisfied making meals there because the kitchen is very well stocked. the sofa bed in the living room was extremely comfortable, which was a great surprise because we’ve never experienced a comfortable sofa bed! we highly recommend this place!!
i ended up checking in later than i expected, due to gps issues and mitchell was understanding which was much appreciated!
great host easy check in

amy and charlie are perfect hosts. we were very welcomed and assisted. they constantly asked if we needed anything, but always respecting our privacy. the entire apartment is very cozy, clean and beautifull. the bed is absolutely comfortable with all you can have pillows. the bedroom offers you the option to keep your bags and clothes in a clean closet, despite of a quite large dresser. the towels are amazingly soft, the hair dryier is powerfull and the shampoo, hair conditioner and body lotion have all a such great fragrance. considering the season we reserved the place, the whole apartament was well heated, which has provided us a warm and safe experience. the neighborhood is very quite and has everything you need right next to you, specially the subway station, which is 30 seconds away from the building. we definitely recomend amy and charlie's place. thank you so much for everything. we had a great time!
it was a fine stay.
amazing amazing amazing is all i can say. from a-z everything was beyond expectations. great place, location, service and price. what else can you ask for? would go to again in a heartbeat
excellent! a very beautiful place!

my family had a wonderful experience at maria’s place. she was very attentive and responsive to our needs and even purchased a high chair for us to use during our stay- so thoughtful!!! the space is beautifully decorated and renovated and super clean.

d's place had everything we needed to completely enjoy out stay on the beach! it was clean, organized and comfortable the entire weekend. she was very easy to communicate with and made us feel welcome. we hope we have the opportunity to stay here again next summer. i highly reccomend staying here for an awesome beach getaway!
rafel was helpful and responded to our needs immediately.
responsive host and very easy to get around the area, comfortable bed and quiet.

excellent property. the location is very close to the metro station. good neighborhood. stella was very responsive and helped us for many of our queries. great place for someone who wants to save money on accommodation.
great location to park slope area. host was very patient and accommodating when my flight got cancelled several times and i arrived late. comfy bed. clean and private.
i enjoyed my stay, thanks for the accommodation.
exactly as described: cosy, well located and super clean. and beauty is a fantastic host. do not hesitate to book! 5 stars

my mother and i loved our stay at regina’s, the only thing not being perfect was the two bedrooms not being separated by a door but rather them being basically one room with one bed in the far corner (the other bed not visible from the first tho). other than that i’ll have to say that the location couldn’t be more perfect if you want to explore the city, with two subway lines in walking distance both going to manhattan. the neighborhood is great two, many good corner stores, cafés and pubs in close proximity! all in all we had a wonderful stay with regina being always helpful and supportive! would definitely stay here again!
a gorgeous space with warm and welcoming hosts. the dog is super sweet and cute. i highly recommend staying here!

my boyfriend and i had a great stay! we were looking for an affordable place to stay for 3 nights while we toured nyc, and i think this is a great deal if you’re looking to save money! the money is only 5 min away walking that takes you to the staten island ferry (free, takes 20min). and then you’re in the city! mahmood was respectful, responsive and the room was very clean!
a great studio in a perfect location, right next to the subway station. sol was accommodating and very responsive to all concerns and observations.

brady's place was amazing. the energy was impeccable. it truly is a house for young adults and art lovers. the management was great - if there was a problem within the accommodation it would always be solved immediately. the location was good. i would recommend utica av for transport. i overall loved my experience and i'd definitely stay here again. omar was helpful, kind and very fun to be around.

yaniv is awesome- he made sure i found the place, changed his plans to help accommodate my change in schedule meaning he had to stay up later for me to get there and basically did everything humanely possible to make this a nice stay. look it was either $300 a night at the millennium or 100 at yaniv was a better host!

loved my stay with romulo & vicky during my short trip to nyc! will definitely book again. they made me feel like home. great accessibility to train station if you're planning to frequently visit downtown manhattan. very clean home and well furnished. can't wait to return and book with them on next trip! 100 % recommended.

great place to stay in ny, very neat, perfect hosts, near to the subway station and super close to central park, coffee machine, beers, tv everything was perfect for our christmas holidays in ny. thank you very much steve and amy for hosting us in this incredible apartment.

great place for a long term stay with everything you need. building was small and no concerning tenants. area was safe with always people right outside the door from the restraunts providing assurance. getting to anywhere in manhattan is 15-20 mins, and 25 mins to queens. close enough to times square without being overtaken by the chaos, and 10mins to hudson yards.
definitely recommend to anyone! very nice, clean apartment. lisa is very nice and communicative.

checking in was fine but when i left the apartment and came back, it was confusing as to which locks you are supposed to lock in order to not lock yourself out. the key to one of the locks inside did not work and i had to text ayana to come let us in. she came. after i left the unit, she immediately accused me of breaking an ottoman that was located in the bedroom. to my knowledge, ottomans can be used for a footrest and seating in addition to storage. if this ottoman broke while in the normal use, it certainly could not be on me, but on the manufacturer. she has no proof that i broke it but filed a claim against me for $65 through airbnb for breaking her alleged cheaply made furniture. that is some nerve after saying just the day before that we were nice people. i would never stay here again, not because it was a bad place, but this woman was not friendly and is obsessed with handwritten notes everywhere in the unit. surprisingly no note on this item she claims i broke.

we enjoyed joyce"s place a lot. spacious and quiet. comfortable bed. kitchen and bathroom are well equipped with everything you need. the area is safe day and night. subway lines c and 3 nearby. 35 min ride to lower manhattan, 55 min to central park. joyce is a very warm and helpful host. i highly recommend her place! thank you joyce!
omri's place was great, and he was really responsive and helped us out in all ways. thanks!

edna + isaiah's place is the perfect place to stay if you want to explore brooklyn and the area around prospect park. the apartment is cosy and comfortable, close to transport and main roads, but very quiet once you are inside! we made the most of the area, grabbing coffees at milk bar and tygershark, brunch at el atoradero, pizzas at emily, and beers at gold star beer counter, bierwax, covenhoven, berg'n and glorietta baldy. we'll be back!

pat's location is wonderful, it's center of manhattan! apartment is clean, bed is comfortable, kitchen has all stuff you need. could be nosing during weekend - but you 2 block from time square:) pat is great host, polite and friendly but also will not bother you at all. i recommend it.
walkable location plus clean and comfortable room

the place is so convinient for transportation. you can buy groceries to cook or just use microwave for heating up ready to eat foods. room is clean, wifi is fast and enjoy watching netflix. malose, the housekeeper is amazing too. cats are cute.

location is fine, but about a 30-40 subway ride into midtown. harlem was a fun spot to hang as well though. outlets didn’t work in one room, but otherwise the apartment was spacious and clean. check in and check out was easy.

vasili's place was great! i appreciated how responsive and kind vasili was and check-in and check-out was very easy. the space was open concept and felt spacious, but keep in mind that it can present some logistical challenges if you and anyone you're staying with needs to take any work calls at the same time (though i found an easy fix was just going into the bedroom :)). the space was very clean and comfy and i found very conveniently located near the main drag on ditmars and only about a 10 minute walk to the n/r trains, getting you into manhattan in 15-20 minutes. check out this place!
clean convenient stay! would come again
excellent place love every space
the area had good food

we live in the neighborhood and were looking for something close for our in-laws who were visiting over thanksgiving. her apartment was very nice and had everything they needed--wifi, space for them to spread out, tv, restaurants around the corner, etc. the elevator made coming and going easy on them and the proximity to the subway made going into town a breeze. nataliya texted to make sure they had everything they needed, which was a nice touch. would definitely rent it again for future guests.

check in was seamless. while i never met kaptan i did meet the wonderful sarah who was super flexible with my check-in. the neighborhood is trendy and the building was nice. plenty of bars and restaurants in the area. the apartment itself was well clean and well thought out with nice touches. laundry is in the building and you don’t need quarters, you can pay by card. the hosts, fortunately had enough detergent to share, i totally didn’t need to buy any, though i did beforehand. the balcony/patio area was good. and the apartment itself had plenty of space for a new york apartment. i expect a closet size apartment, so naturally seeing the place was a pleasant surprise. kaptan was responsive and accommodating. if you’re hesitating or on the fence give it a try.

great location, very cute cats, beautifully decorated space, and friendly/communicative host! :) minutes away from several subway lines to easily get you to anywhere you want to go, and lots of great restaurants within walking distance as well.

shelley was a great understanding host, she waited for us due to our flight delay, welcomed us in and asked if we need anything. this basement apartment has everything you may ever think of needing during your stay and it was safe for our 1.5 year toddler. it's about 8 minutes walking from the subway station but this station has no elevator if you're walking with kids and stollers. the neighbourhood is relatively quite, we had a kid so we never really stated late outdoor. all in all, it was great dealing with shelley and i would recommend this apartment for sure.

really great place to stay for our visit to nyc. the apartment was modern and lovely and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. great location. it was a short drive to the ferry and a quiet neighborhood with a park nearby. would definitely stay there again if we make it back to that area.

marek and grace were incredible hosts! the space was fantastic and sparkling clean and they even left us a bottle of wine. we couldn't get there until after midnight but the check-in process was very easy and straight forward. we can't wait to book again to enjoy the beach in summer!

hyacinth was a very welcoming host and, though i only saw her a little, i found the place and neighborhood welcoming and a great value as well. i definitely recommend checking out the bakeries and cafes nearby (especially around church and nostrand), though the street hyacinth's home is on was residential and quiet. thanks again!
great location. clean .private.spacious had a great stay . will definitely recommend

this place was so great. i stayed 4 days and it was perfectly cozy, warm, comfortable and super easy to get around from. it's close to the g and the c train which were essential for getting into manhattan and surrounded by really great restaurants, coffee shops etc. i loved the loft bed. i'll definitely stay here again and if i ever move to new york, maybe they'll let me sublease it lol.

our stay at anitra and steven’s place was great! and exactly what we needed for our holiday stay. the location is in a great area close to restaurants, subways, and the famous 125th street in harlem. the apartment itself is spacious, clean, and nicely decorated. the check in process is smooth and well communicated. and anitra is super responsive, friendly and thorough. the location is tough for parking , so i recommend utilizing the subway system. otherwise, perfect stay. would def recommend and stay here again.

the place was very clean and we have easy access. we walked to most of the places we needed to go. the train is also near by. melissa was an excellent host and answered all of my questions immediately.

great apartment! spacious, immaculate, everything worked! responsive host. only consideration is location - if you need to go to times square often (we did, daily). it’s an hour by subway and the express bus stops after 7 pm. so shows got out around 10:30 and it was close to 11-11:30 before we got home. $82 for uber.
the place is amazing, comfortable, and the anfitrion is so nice!! thank you again! 😊

the stay here was perfect! nothing to complain about. clean and matches the description. don’t sleep on the package upgrades! highly recommended. loved everything about the apartment and the hosts are super respectful, kind, helpful and accommodating. highly recommend this place.
great place to stay in a vibrant, active neighbourhood. would def stay again.

i have a wonderful time at nyc. babajide was very a wonderful host. he was waiting for us to arrive. he gave us plenty of information and the trains, parking and how to get around. this is the first time a rent via airbnb and was quite surprised. the apartment was clean and i felt very staff. i would defiantly recommend.

jamie is such a great host, very easy to communicate with. also her room is clean and located in friendly and safe area. easy to access to everywhere in the city. defo recommend to solo traveler, the best bang for your buck !
thank you for your quick responses to any questions we had. this worked great for three people visiting.👍🏼
had an amazing stay at stephen’s home - couldn’t have asked for anything better in an apartment or a host! he even shared freshly baked cookies one night - the best!
peppers household was very clean i was fully satisfied
great place to stay. very clean and rooms are exactly as shown in pictures. highly recommend!

we stayed here for our first time in new york this winter and we’re so lucky to have found this place! central to everything, 3 minute walk to a market nearby, 3 minute walk to the subway, and the indoors was nice and cozy. will definitely be booking again for future nyc visits! thank you so much for your hospitality!
great apartment and spacious, it looks exactly like the images. the hosts were great, very responsive and helpful when needed. i really enjoyed my stay!

i had a great stay here! the place is super new and very good furnished. i loved the short walking distance to the nearest subway. the contact with the host was always friendly, helpful and quick. definitely recommend.
jason is a very good host. he was largely available for us and the apartment was just so great. well located and very clean. we recommend a lot. cu next time jason.

if you are looking for a place to stay in nyc, look no further! our stay with blanca and teddy was just amazing. the apt was much larger than it appears in the pictures. it is spotlessly clean and well-kept. we arrived nearly three hours later then we expected - there was a blizzard so our plane was late. it was no problem with blanca and teddy, we tried to get them updated on our estimated arrival. they were very understanding, we felt comfortable and it was no problem at all showing up late. when we arrived, teddy was there as blanca didn't make it back home because of the blizzard, too. he showed us the apt and gave as a short overview over the subway map, nearest shops, etc. the moment we entered the apt we felt welcome and at home. during our stay, when we came back in the evening, it was really like coming home, just loved the apt. there's everything you need (towels, linen, kitchen tools, wifi, etc.) that you need to enjoy your stay. teddy even drove as around the town one night to show us the beauty of manhattan. when we left for the plane back home, he drove us to the next subway station for the e train we had to take. amazing!! a word about the neighbourhood: we felt absolutely safe and comfortable there. the neighbourhood is great, all kind of people, but we never met someone unfriendly. going around the streets even at night when we came back home with the subway (btw: subway station only 5 minutes away, bus station you just have to step outside) was no problem and we never had to worry. would i choose this location again? absolutely! great apt, great neighbourhood and the most amazing hosts you can imagine. so we surely will come back. a big thanks and hugs to blanca and teddy. you made our stay in this great city a not-forgettable experience. thanks! we recommend this apt to our friends, and some of them have already booked a stay with blanca and teddy ;)

nice place to stay. unfortunately didn't get to meet antonio while we were there but he was incredibly helpful with any questions that we had and always got back to us really quickly, would definitely recommend his place!

great space, good for a relaxed time indoors. his lunch and dinner recommendations were really useful for me personally, and it was a cute space filled with plants and antiques. if you don’t like clutter or prefer a more zen and minimalist space; this may not be for you.

ashek was an extremely attentive and amazing host. he was very on top of everything and did a great job. we loved the airbnb and how there was great attention to detail. there was an abundance of amenities and we enjoyed our entire stay due to ashek and his wife's thoughtfulness. we will be staying here again when we visit next time!
convenient, clean, and pleasant. only problem was one elevator was being repaired so there was a wait for the working one. felt very safe in the building and the apartment was comfortable.

i cannot recommend this place enough. troy was very friendly, easy to contact and even carried our case upstairs. the location could not be better, about 100 steps and your on times square. lots of lovely touches as well - toothbrushes, soap, maps and guides etc. brilliant value for money. thank you troy for letting us into your home.
this was a comfortable and convenient spot. i loved having a tv in my own room and everything was just great.

rachel is super friendly and easy-going. she prepared everything that we might need during the stay, we even got the chance to try her homemade bread ( which taste so good!). the room was really cozy and equipped with small fridge, portable tables, tv… we were glad to stay at her place for our first time in new york. plus, her cats are really friendly too! (they love to be pat!)

fantastic location, easy check in/out and great communication with the host. the facilities inside are perfect and we were very comfortable. safe and friendly neighborhood with lots to see and do. highly recommend this place.

florrie’s apartment is as beautiful as it looks in the pictures and then some. super clean and comfortable and florrie was the best host, very attentive and quick to help and answer any questions. we will be coming back and have recommended it to friends.
very nice, easy, and clean
seth’s place is an amazing location in the east village. accurately described. it was a great new york stay!
great place to stay, wonderful interior for the room as well. cara was a great host and really helpful with check in and gave helpful and clear instructions!

the place was very nice and clean, with a great location that's convenient for walking around and accessing multiple subway lines. it's also ideal for staying in the financial district. the only downside is that there’s some ongoing construction nearby, so it can be a bit noisy at times. other than that, i really enjoyed my stay!

very nice accommodations; family is friendly but respected my privacy. mei was clear about her expectations but always friendly and helpful. i loved the area and the price is very reasonable. i recommend for a convenient location and lovely home and neighborhood .

very kind and responsive and understanding, i had a great experience this was my first time staying at an airbnb alone and the help and instructions made it very easy and non stressful and i am very grateful, the apartment was cozy and clean and had everything i needed, payed for late check out as well and it was easy and kept communication to make sure everything was good. apartment is near some convenience stores and public transport is very close by. for one or two days there was construction and cleaning on the stairs outside of the window and the fridge does get a bit loud but overall i would stay here again and enjoyed my time. five stars.
this was a great experience and a lovely home. tony was very friendly and made my stay comfortable. nice, clean home and the coffee was a plus for me! will definitely stay here again!
great place near airports and long island. full kitchen was perfect. comfortable bed and pillows ( slept like a baby ! ). highly recommend and look forward to staying here again
close to all the action and subways.
very good location and nice staff
great place for value
only stayed for a night, good location although the entrance we went in was easy to overlook.

a great and convienent stay, especially after a delayed flight from laguardia. everything was clean and check-in was seamless. air conditioning worked well, so we slept great. we would stay here again. for this price point, this was perfect.
very cozy and quiet in a great spot. alaric was extremely kind and welcoming and was very knowledgeable of the area. we only stayed overnight, but everything was perfect for what we needed.

host was very responsive, and helpful. had a great stay no issues. street parking, but it was free. a little distance from the train but if you have a car it’s fine and if you don’t mind the bus it’s fine. had no issues, loved the stay.

transportation is convenient. only 5 minutes walking to subway station. delicious food around the house.only 25 minutes subway to uptown and also to downtown. linda and jill are very hospitable and considerate. they almost prepared everything we want, such as breakfast, silverware, glassware, etc. really recommend this place！
i had a short stay, flew in for a wedding and flew out the next day. this airbnb was the sweet spot for my commute. place was clean and very welcoming. would recommend to anyone :)
stay was ok. place was clean. tv in bedroom didnt work and wifi didnt work on living room tv but master bedroom was fine. price a bit too high to not allow parking in the driveway.

the room is large and very comfortable in a beautiful historic brooklyn brownstone. the dedicated bathroom was also quite nice with a tub and shower. miriam was an excellent host. she was clear and quick in her communication. the house is filled with interesting art and miriam’s poodle was sweet and friendly without ever being “too much.” i’ve always rented whole apartments, because i am worried i might not like sharing space with a host, but the home is quite large and miriam struck a perfect balance of being there when i needed something and providing space and quiet when i wanted it. the neighborhood has tons of great restaurants and parks and the saturday farmers market was delightful. it’s super convenient to multiple subway lines. i would stay again and would definitely recommend it to friends.

great place for anyone who wants to explore the city. lauren & anthony were very welcoming and gave really good tips about amazing places around the neighborhood. the place is located within walking distance from j, c and l subway lines, which made it super easy to get to any place in nyc.

kakuna’s apartment is in a great location, a very quiet and friendly neighbourhood, with excellent cafes/restaurants and the subway nearby. it was super clean and had lots of thoughtful touches, such as filtered water chilling in the fridge, very welcoming after a long hot day sightseeing. kakuna provided a ‘guide book’ full of suggestions on where to go including local restaurants/cafes, shops, parking etc. whenever i had a query she was super responsive and helpful.
we had a wonderful stay at gretchen’s place. it’s in a safe, convenient location. just a short walk to the subway. gretchen was a lovely host and we had plenty of coffee stocked for us!

check in at 4 pm and check out at 11 am to find the unit not ready was really disappointing after a long trip. receptionist was inconsiderate and the house keeper didnt even use a glove while arranging our bed sheets . demanded batteries for the tv remote and the answer was go and buy urself !!!!!! disappointed
great location and a nice place with clean, good-sized rooms. good communications and all very easy to check in/out.
definitely would recommend!! really cozy & clean. the front desk team was amazing
great location!!! great front porch

absolutely fantastic unit, great location. the host was so kind and gracious. five stars, highly recommended.
perfect place to stay in nyc . charming , super clean and in one of the cutest neighborhoods in brooklyn ! hosts were friendly and very communicative. hope to be back soon! loved my stay here

our stay felt like we were visiting a friend's house - cozy and comfortable, and michael is an excellent host. the neighborhood is beautiful, relatively quiet, and very walkable. i haven't had a 10/10 airbnb experience like this in a long time. we will definitely be back soon!
felix and his wife are very nice. they waited for us till 2am because the bad traffic at lga airport trapped us more than 2 hours. the place is safe and close to subway station, very convenient.
i had a very comfortable stay at richard and gabrielle's apartment. they were both extremely friendly and responsive hosts, and the location was ideal for my requirements.
yolanda was very welcoming and courteous! the house was beautiful, and she was very helpful.
great place good value
