for the price and being near the airport it’s great option! commute to other parts of the city are a trek fyi so be prepared to use public transportation unless you wanted to spend a lot of ubers 🫡 if you are looking to save money and have plenty of space then this is a good option for you!

i enjoyed staying at gladys and bob's place. it was my second time and it was just as pleasant as the first. gladys was even kind enough to receive my lost baggage from the airline when it was finally delivered. the subway is very close and there's a cool health store in the neighborhood where you can grab smoothie.

my wife and i had a lovely time at chantal’s brooklyn apartment! it was impressively spacious and very well equipped. the location was a major perk too as it is a quick walking distance from many corner stores, restaurants, and subway/bus spots. the only thing left to be desired was a more comfortable bed as the mattress was a bit too firm for our liking. moreover, the host’s family lives upstairs and the footsteps can be a little noisy - even as early as 6am in the morning. nevertheless, we had a fantastic time in this safe and cozy bed-stuy bnb!
i so appreciated the free breakfast and friendly and helpful staff.
awesome place and awesome host! i’ll be back!
great rockaways location! good size studio, comfortable space.

i had the most wonderful time staying at gisele’s apartment for one month while in ny. the apartment is spacious, situated in a lively and safe residential neighborhood. the building is well maintained, always clean, with security cameras in the halls. the apartment is spacious, good heating (it was fairly cold during my stay in ny), great shower pressure, hot water was always available, the bed sheets and towels were nice & clean, the kitchen is fully equipped & functional. be aware the apartment is right at first ave & traffic noise is part of the combo. i specially like the big mirrors around the apartment and the closet space is out of this world for ny standards, a lot of space! i would certainly stay again & can recommend to anyone.

the stay is good and as mentioned. yes, you will have two set of stairs as mentioned to reach your room. it was ok for us. she changes towels in the washroom regularly that is nice. we didn’t use the kitchen or other common areas due to covid reasons so can’t comment on any of that. but overall the stay was very good.

peter’s apartment was wonderful in all ways: easy walk from the subway, close to shops and prospect park, and the apartment itself is way more spacious than the photos indicate. it is well equipped with all you’ll need for cooking and relaxing and peter was quick to respond and easy to communicate with. i highly recommend his rental.

the neighborhood is really cute. i booked the place for a night just a couple hours before. she was kind and helpful. there was a mom with her kid next to me, some people might find it annoying but i enjoyed their presence, it was cute. the bathroom was clean. the room is small but it was totally fine for just a night. the host was kind.
we rebooked because the location was near work and the host was great!

this is such a nice place. the rooms have been designed with space in mind to make it really comfortable. it was quiet, clean and we felt very safe. a great location to enjoy all that nyc has to offer.

wonderful place to stay! my friends and i were visiting new york but found ourselves wanting to stay in and enjoy the home more. the space is really clean and comfortable, great place to relax after exploring the city. aneerban was a great host. he was responsive and really helpful whenever we needed something. highly recommend this place!
martin was an excellent host and the stay was very comfortable!
great location, easy to access and met my needs for my week long stay
awesome stay at frank and maria's place. lovely big bathroom and really comfy bed!!
had a very nice stay! the room is not far from the brooklyn botanical garden and close to line a and c.
great apartment with an amazing view of the skyline. everything as described and very easy communication with clara. can only recommend this place when staying in harlem.

i can definetely recommend this place: great location, check in and check out where very straightforward and the bed was confortable. the only issue i had was due to the window mounted ac unit: it wasn't properly insulated so the room would get chilly during the night, plus i'd get all the smells from the outside.
this a great location in brooklyn very clean and tidy easy to communicate with owner definitely would stay there again
this was my best airbnb we ever rented. the location was close to the javits and all cool restaurants. it was a chef kiss.

a quick 10 minute walk past shops and food to the subway, this a great spot to stay with easy access to manhattan and other areas. the host is great and responsive, usually within minutes. everything was as described and expected. will definitely book again.

lucas opened his home to me and i'm so thankful for such a great stay in astoria. he's easy going and very flexible. the bed was comfy and i felt safe walking around the neighborhood. i always stay in astoria when i go to the city because the location and price point can't be beat. thank you lucas

the host was excellent and very supportive throughout our stay. the building itself is nice, safe, and well maintained, and the building staff were extremely kind, welcoming, and helpful. the host always replied quickly, the apartment was very clean, and it had everything we needed, including towels, tissues, soap, and fresh linens. the photos were accurate and truly reflected the apartment. our child accidentally wrote on the wall and we also forgot to return the keys, and the host was very understanding and kind about it. overall, it was a very comfortable and pleasant stay, and we truly appreciated the host’s flexibility and attitude.
very cozy airbnb close to the subway. made for an easy trip around the new york area.
the apartment was very clean and a good size for two guests

this apartment is truly beautiful. the space has lots of character and is a wonderful place to stay in while visiting the city. dominik is a very helpful and accommodating host. he is also a fast responder. he will make sure your stay is the best possible. i definitely will book with him again!

i used to live in new york, and i chose to stay in julie's apartment because it's in one of my favorite areas of new york: the clinton hill/ft greene part of brooklyn. the neighborhood has it all: big brownstone houses, hip coffee shops, great bars and restaurants. if you're looking for a quintessential brooklyn experience this is the area to stay in. the apartment is a very short walk from a train stop on the subway, and from that stop you can get straight into manhattan (~15mins). it's also easy to reach the apartment from jfk airport. inside, the apartment is clean, nicely decorticated and comfortable, as was the room i stayed in. julie was amazing. she was so welcoming and kind-hearted. i broke my foot just before my trip and so i arrived in new york (from london) in a leg cast with crutches. julie had made arrangements ahead of time so that i was comfortable and safe in the apartment. she also looked out for me during my time in nyc to make sure i was ok. i honestly feel very fortunate that i had julie as my host: she was wonderful.

izi was the perfect host! the apartment looks just like in the pictures. it is fully equipped with everything one might need for an extended stay. izi was very responsive prior to check in and answered all my questions with great patience. he and elio were available the whole time for any questions, and provided recommendations for nearby attractions and restaurants. they are both very nice people. the apartment is managed very professionally. would definitely stay there again. thank you!

this place was great!!! one block from the subway and tons of restaurants and stores on broadway. the sunroom was very nice to have and the bedroom and studio was super spacious and perfect for my parents who were visiting.
great stay and as advertised. no problems and easy to reach the host when needed. recommend without hesitation 10/10.
great place and location.

we stayed at the stayhaus williamsburg for 2 months and i honestly didn’t want to leave. if you’re looking for that perfect balance of "cool brooklyn vibes" and "actually comfortable crib," this is it. • the space: the apartment was stunning—super high ceilings, tons of natural light, and high-end finishes. it’s clearly professionally designed, but it feels like a home, not a sterile hotel room. the bed was incredibly comfortable, which is a rarity in short-term rentals. • the location: you couldn’t ask for a better spot. you’re steps away from some of the best coffee shops (devoción is a must!) and restaurants in brooklyn, and the l train is just a short walk away, making it so easy to zip into manhattan. • the amenities: the kitchen was fully stocked with everything i needed, and the wi-fi was lightning-fast (huge plus since i had to take a few zoom calls during my stay). • the service: the stayhaus team was so responsive. 5 star stay!

we had such a nice stay. the apartment is beautiful inside and everything is so new and well taken care of. we easily walked from the subway to the apartment with our suitcases. the apartment is in a convenient location and you can walk to many restaurants and the park! it’s also not hard at all to get to manhattan - just hop on the f train and you’ll be in the west village in about 30 mins. the neighborhood is quiet and there is a walgreens and a market right across the street. we would absolutely stay here again. our only note is that you hear the subway from the apartment because it’s a basement/garden apartment. it’s not loud and did not bother us at all but it might be necessary for some people to sleep with a little white noise.

patritia's apartment was amazing! as first time travelers we always felt safe and at home in the room and the surrounding area. it has an incredibly authentic vibe! no negatives i can think of whatsoever and we will definitely be looking to return in the future. patty was a great host and always easy to get a hold of. has a great local knowledge and was very helpful in finding hidden gems that downtown nyc had to offer. 10/10 would reccomend.
this apartment was clean and tidy. i actually didn't want to leave. mattress was comfortable. the outdoor space was a bonus. i will definitely book again.

room was super clean and very nice. easy and helpful check in. close to subway and train. although the area didn’t seem to be greatest. took an uber at night instead of the subway train, but felt safe and secure at the room. would definitely stay again.

this place is at a great location. literally a less than 5min walk to times square. felt very safe. be mindful that there is definitely a shared bathroom and shower with other tenants on the same floor. also, be prepared to walk up some steps to get to the unit. (not sure if they had elevators because we didn't really look for them either.) never had a problem using the restroom or running into anyone. neighbors are quiet. what's loud is the intersection and fire station right across the street. didn't bother us too much since we would be so tired from being out all day, we would just knock out. bring ear plugs anyways just in case. there is both an ac window unit and a small space heater (that works amazingly). space is a little smaller than expected but you don't need much if you're just using it to sleep. anayah is really really friendly. we decided to fly home a day early, anayah was very understanding. we only left early because of the snow storm that headed that way. we would love to stay again when we visit in the next few months.

be careful, you will be charged additional $50-60per night. i stayed 2 nights and charged me 108$ more. there was a big fight form 10 minutes in the hallway one night around 2 am. most likely you will smell marijuana in the hallway, which i did. the bottom line is, i will not recommend that hotel.
enjoyed our stay here
amazing stay! everything was perfect!

this was my second time spending a month at jaime's apartment and i'd recommend it to anyone. the location is perfect and a short walk to the l train. the apartment isn't on bedford, so it's relatively quiet and great for anyone working remotely or someone who doesn't like noise. you're also very close to great restaurants, bars and stores and a close walk to the water. the apartment has everyting you could possibly need for an extended stay and jaime was extremely responsive and made the check-in process very easy.

what a gem! great location, pristine decoration, marvelous communication. everything at natalie’s is incredibly cozy, functional and stylish! - and the bed is to die for comfortable. i would highly recommend anyone to stay here and to be honest, wish i could live here myself. the three flights of stairs are fine but should be taken into consideration in case of any disabilities or too much luggage.
the place is nice cute apartment but be warned it’s got natural row how stairs so if you’re scared of steep and narrow steps maybe pack light 😆

staying at moes place was nice! subway was right downy street like 3 house down i love brooklyn and manhattan was fun thank you moe for letting us stay at your place we are for sure coming again and staying there loved it!!!
she is sweet and very comfortable accommodation
such a wonderful stay! thank you ✨
i am very impressed with the stay. i really enjoy staying here. would definitely come back again.

kristen's place was wonderful to be at. it was clean and the lighting in it really helped. even though you were in the basement, the windows were big enough to get sunlight in them. the appliances in the home we're great, closet was nice, and most importantly, the best shower i've ever had in an airbnb
great location. great host. love the location. host has always been easy to get a hold of and is super flexible. definitely recommend staying there.

we were really grateful that we could be accommodated on such short notice after our other booking was cancelled by another host. the unit was all we needed as 3 individuals. great location and walkable to lots of amenities. the place was small but i guess that's expected in the heart of manhattan. there was also a considerable amount of noise from the radiator which was not ideal and often woke us up during the night. one of the rooms was also very cold in the middle of winter as there is an in-built fan into the window which did let in quite a bit of cold air. on a positive note the hosts were really responsive and friendly, and they did provide really accurate instructions though a third party messaging service.
good stay. i’ll return if i come back to nyc. thank you.
the apartment was small, cute and very clean. location very close to station. easy access to apartment..and quick reply by the host. thank you

such a nice place to stay!! the location is perfect and i always felt safe. it was also a very short walk to grand central. the balcony was a great touch to sit out and watch the sun set/rise. if i come back to nyc i will surely be staying here!

john and ainslie are very hospitable and helpful. we got all kinds of great tips to do and see. we had a wonderful stay in their beautiful home and neighborhood. from their location you could easily get to manhattan and the surrounding area. we enjoyed our stay very much, it felt like a home away from home :)
perfect spot for what we needed.
great place and location! very nice and responsive host! let me check in early. very nice.
i loved megan’s place. it was the perfect amount of space for my daughter and i. megan was great. it’s comfortable and cozy and the area can’t be beat.
great location. apartment was as advertised. elevator was down when we stayed. james was attentive and a good host.

my stay at kathy’s home was great, from beginning to end very clean space and also home in general very friendly and welcoming hosts as well from beginning to end recommend staying at her home when you’re in new york city.

friendly, caring, and well organized host who made sure that i had everything i needed. room was pristine and location was convenient. shared spaces are tasteful, clean and newly renovated. host even provided a light breakfast. staying at this place is better than staying at any of the local motels. i'll likely stay here again next time i'm in town . very highly recommended!!!

cathy's place is a bright (cheerful) modern space in her basement. we arrived after dark, so we didn't have a chance to meet our host in person. but we came to know that she is neat, has lovely taste, and aims to please. the home is a narrow single on a tree-lined street. we had no problem parking. we ate a few blocks over at a greek restaurant. there are many to choose from. if we wanted to cook, there was even a portable inductive stove-top! cathy left us both instant and ground coffee, some fruit, and a refrigerator treat. if you like milk or cream in your coffee, you will probably need to bring your own. the bed and all the furniture seemed to be relatively new, possibly from ikea. the bed was very comfortable for us -- a hard foam that rivals the new side sleeper coiled mattress that we recently purchased. the room has a large tv from which you can stream, if you have your own account. we slept well and left quietly in the morning. it was lots of fun. thanks, cathy!
i lion was a great host! we had an amazing time during our stay, immersed in art, pets and the tranquility of nature. thank you for the fond memories! ❤️

nychaven1 was perfect for a weekend girls getaway! plenty of room, very clean and convenient to public transportation. there is a grocery store right around the corner. jason was extremely responsive to all questions. i highly recommend his rental properties.
the best house ever thanks cheryne for everything

very spacious and located very close to lga! we originally booked a space in brooklyn that was canceled and luchiano was very gracious to host us literally the day before our trip to nyc. the apartment was spacious!!! especially for ny and the apartment was fully stocked. the shower…amazing!!! the water pressure & temp was perfect. luchiano and his wife were thee sweetest and were pretty much avail night or day for any requests or questions! we were surprised that the apartment was directly above a psychic/healing business but that did not deter us one bit. for others…that may be an issue. i believe the furniture (not bed…that was made nicely) and perhaps the floors could have been cleaned better but we also realize that we were in a pinch and booked last minute. would definitely stay again with luchiano.

had a great stay at the brooklyn nook! location is great and perfect for getting around and exploring greenpoint & williamsburg. apartment was comfortable, roomy and felt at home. communicating with matthew was very friendly and helpful. music from the bar was louder some nights than others and wouldn’t recommend staying if you’re light sleeper, but was never a problem for us. thanks again matthew!

this would be a perfect stay for couples and friends. for families with young kids, bowen’ s home is beautiful but filled with collectibles that i spent a lot of time nervous my babe would break or ruin- luckily she did neither. there’s also a narrow & steep staircase which is best suited for adults. we loved this place though and i felt very cool- like i’ve lived in bk forever. very artsy & clean. very communicative owner. would stay again for parents night out.
fernando was easy to communicate with and made check in really easy. i felt at home during my stay. great location, not far from subway. thank you!
thank you for your kindness

we so enjoyed our stay at geoffrey’s place. beautiful and clean rooms, such comfy beds, spotless bathroom, and the living room was great for having some down time. love the window box in the living too. air conditioning works great. had everything we needed. geoffrey was super responsive to our requests, and we appreciate being able to leave our bags for a few hours after checkout. we hope to return, thank you geoffrey!
very smooth check in/out. spacious room for 1 person, clean as well! :)

we stayed 10 days and it was generally fine. any issues that we mentioned to the property manager were addressed. my husband had a chance encounter with the owner and she was very kind as well. the location was great for us because there was a beautiful playground for our toddler around the corner and lots of restaurants and train options nearby. i really appreciated being able to do laundry. the place has great character as a generally well-preserved historic brownstone. we were there on some of the hottest days of the year but the a/c kept the house ice cold. it was not the cleanest or most comfortable place i’ve ever stayed. but on the whole, it was fine and i was grateful to find a place within budget for such a long stay that ticked most of our boxes. it’s a particularly good option if you’re bringing a small child as there is laundry, a bathtub, they provided a pack and play (bring your own sheet though) and that playground nearby was great.
the location was perfect and convenient! the airbnb was clean and spacious! our host was very helpful and responded quickly to our questions throughout our stay!

brinton’s place is as advertised...clean, safe, close to public transportation, etc. having the whole foods a block away allowed us to stock up on groceries to make breakfast every morning before the day’s adventure. brinton’s hospitality was awesome, he was accommodating for a late check out that allowed us extra time in the city before our flight. all in all this was the perfect place to stay for a busy nyc weekend!
we had a lovely stay at matt’s apartment and everything was as described. great location for getting around and seeing new york
this was gem to find in brooklyn. as some qho has lived in the area in the last it feels good to have found some place i can return to when we visit. thank you!
host provided a welcoming atmosphere and suggestions that improved our plans during the trip. an excellent option if you are seeing a show at the music hall

martha is a complete sweetheart checking in with me to see if i needed anything, very welcoming. room was clean, neat and cozy. location is near lots of places to eat, the 225th street subway station and woodlawn train station. will stay again

alex lives in a very good part of nyc. one can walk anywhere (i do), many restaurants to choose from, many interesting, creative people (artists and writers) live there. in short, very colorful, active area, and easy to walk from to other parts of town. those who don't like to walk, or tire on the way, may get on one of the many buses that run along the avenues.

lou place was great. the backyard is a nice touch!!! i really appreciate lou and his hospitality to me and my family. this is my second stay with lou and i will continue to books my stays with lou. i recommend both his properties!!! great job lou!!!
the room was large and clean with a working ac. what more could you ask for in this hot city. details were clear and the shared amenities were nice.

awesome host beautiful home very spacious great layout super cool and very clean rare outdoor space roof top deck barn doors close walk to subway and short walk to bedsty.with unquie shops and restaurants
reka is amazing - everything you want in an airbnb host. communicative, flexible and nice. place was great - exactly as described.
we had an absolutely fantastic time at shelly's apartment. wonderful place to stay.

kevin was super responsive and the place is great for the price. it is far out in queens, so it does take a while (specifically later in the evenings where transit delays are wild) to get to manhattan if that’s your overall destination, but the place is exactly as described!

beautiful apartment. great location. 15 min walk from central park and surrounded by a number of great places to eat and shop. our host margo was incredibly friendly provided some good tips for first time visitors, and was flexible with our check-in and check out times.

this apartment was exactly what we needed. great location, spacious, clean, and quiet. good restaurants and trader joe’s near by. gisele was a responsive and helpful host. we would definitely stay again!

clean room. good price considering it was pride weekend. however the air conditioner was off when we got into the room and was not working on the side of the room where the couch was. the 6 of us had to squeeze on the two beds because the area with the couch was too warm. only one elevator was working for the whole hotel so there was very long waiting times.

greg was a perfect host. the house was clean, comfortable, affordable, and the private parking was the cherry on top. additionally, the house was close to the highway, which opened up travel. the house was perfect for my family of four and decor was modern and well placed. five stars! i will be using greg's spot for future visits.
very clean and spacious, great value. easy check-in and check-out process.
great location, thanks meghan you were a friendly host!

pros: great location for our adventures, very spacious city apartment for our family, it had all the listed amenities, everything was well stocked, and the beds were all very comfortable, and we were even able to get in an hour earlier than expected. cons: the heat did not work well, it was blazing hot on arrival and the cleaners mentioned it was broken, later that night it was super cold, the heaters alternately made a weird hissing noise throughout the weekend. the bathroom shower had a lot of mold and could use a bit of updating. sumaiya responded quickly to my messages, but never got anyone to come fix the heating problem or even brought any extra linens for us to keep warm after contacting her several times.

lovely apartment in a great neighborhood, with lots to explore on the doorstep. convenient for trips in brooklyn and to manhattan via subway 8 mins walk away (or longer if you visit velvette coffee shop😉).
sharon is a very good host, clean and all in order. the room was small but we only need to sleep.
nice hotel conveniently located in queens near 2 subway stations. easy to get to manhattan.
cannot reccomend enough, perfect place to explore nyc from!

highly recommend! 👍🏻 super clean, very comfortable bed, air conditioner works like a charm. room is very nicely decorated. very private. a separate entrance to the guest bedroom, and the bathroom is right next to this bedroom. kind and wonderful host who i chatted with briefly. and i met her beautiful cat. just two nights and i was at work all day long. i hope to return for a longer stay in the future. thank you so much, anisia

this was a nice little cozy spot for our weekend trip to ny! vinny was very accommodating and the place had everything we needed for our trip. we also had a great time checking out all the places down steinway st. by walking! overall, a great place to stay if you just need the essentials for a weekend trip!

warm family home, the room was clean and quiet, tv, ac, wifi. everything a guest could ask for. carmen was perfect the room is close to lga in a residential neighborhood but not too much to do or see close by. cute dog :)

best deal in nyc. i couldn’t believe how great the location was for the price i paid! it’s a small space and just the basics of what you need for your stay in nyc. if you’re planning on being on the go this is the perfect spot to crash at night and shower! i felt super safe in the area walking around as a female solo traveler. the price was unbeatable for the location! thanks for such a convenient, clean and comfortable stay.
very nice and clean. great central location in brooklyn. we enjoyed our stay! thanks!

we had a great stay! the apartment is exactly as described. obvously it’s small, however, it has all you need and is located in a beautiful neighbourhood. communication was great and easy. i totally recommmend the place.
kind employees and great location!
really fancy apartment with splendid view

susan’s place is amazing. we had a last minute booking and she was super receptive and quickly accommodated us. the apartment was better than expected. super super near subway station. restaurants, coffee shops, bakerys and so on nearby - a walk distance. 3 blocks from central park. even with many things around, it’s not noisy late night. recommended!! the levain bakery in front of the building and fairway market one block distant are both a must go nearby - don’t miss it!

a big thank you to milton for making our stay in the bronx a pleasant one. from the moment we walked in to the apartment we felt right at home -- the place is clean and well appointed! in the fridge we found water, sodas, juice and bagels. apartment includes wi-fi, smart tv with nexflix + apps, drip style coffee maker, microwave, toaster oven & blowdryer -- which are all important to me. located in a quiet residential street with several deli / mini markets within 5 min walking distance. portable ac unit located in the lr and along with the fan, we were able to stay cool while we slept in the br. milton is an excellent person and we plan to stay here when our travels take us to the bronx.
ample size, well equipped, great proximity to restaurants

skip’s place is located right next to lively ic with great restaurants and entertainment. the sunset park and the nearly area is very nice to walk around. the place is clean and has everything you need during a trip. subway station is a block away. will definitely recommend this to other travelers! above all, skip is very flexible and highly informative.

this apartment has a gorgeous view, but is overpriced for the unit. upon arrival, it was clear that the photos used to advertise the space were different than the unit we were placed in. the apartment itself was a little smaller than pictured, which was a bit disappointing. additionally, a few of the plugs weren’t working, one of the blinds had an issue, and the bathroom door didn’t close properly - all things that should have been fixed and resolved by the time we arrived, especially for the price we paid for this space. additionally, we found other listings on airbnb for the same unit, running at a lower cost than the listing price that global luxury suites posted. overall, the apartment was nice and in a luxury building in a nice location, but the experience we had for the price we paid just didn’t align.
i would stay here again. clean and cozy. as a solo female traveler, i felt safe. amazing breakfast restaurant/coffee just 1 block away.
great place! responsive hosts and great communication. would definitely recommend!
joe's place is great to stay and he is very accommodating and nice. i felt very safe and welcomed

for my partner’s birthday weekend, we chose the moxy and i’m so glad we did. check in was so smooth, the host was very responsive and we were able to get in our room easily. the concierge at the hotel was so accommodating, they even helped me plan a birthday surprise for him and left a lovely birthday message in the room. all the staff we interacted with were so sweet and friendly. the television unfortunately did have its issues with the streaming and channels but we still had a great time. i wish we stayed longer to fully enjoy all of the other amenities but we’ll definitely be returning soon.

there is nothing negative i can possibly say about sheila’s place. the amenities and extras she provides make your stay more than comfortable. the extra blankets, towels, sheets, etc and additional items you may forget about sure do make you realize the extra mile she goes to make your stay amazing. from the quick responses to the comfort of her home, we without a doubt will highly recommend sheila’s place.

the real "plus" of this flat is the location, which is really practical: close to museums/places of interest, and well served by public transportation. joe was a kind host, the communication was good. even if we had some little clealinness issues when we arrived, he quicly fixed it. what we also really appreciated was having an iphone at our disposal! very practical, it made our life much easier. overall, i recommend joe's appartment if you are looking for a good value for money option.

cemi's apartment was neat, clean, quiet and had plenty of natural light. amenities were good and the kitchen was well equiped for cooking. the apartment is very conveniently located if you want to catch the subway into manhattan or to explore the surrounding neighbourhood on foot. cemi was a great host and very accomodating. he even provided us with toiletries when he learnt that my bf and i had been separated from our luggage, which was kind and much appreciated!
amazing place, amazing location, amazing host. i really enjoy staying at iradj’s flat every month!
it was an absolute delight to stay at jenny's this summer. couldn't recommend her spot more highly, and am looking forward to coming back.
extremely clean very understandable about me being late
bronx is huge part of nyc, but frequently overlooked! enjoy your stay here! mariela is good host!

i had a great juneteenth at hotel hayden. the staff were so nice and flexible. i was able to check in early and offered me water whenever i walked out becomes of the extreme heat in the city that week. i would stay here again. it is close to times square and madison square garden. very close to the train and a safe neighborhood to walk in at night.
the location is really useful, host is very calmed and gentle, helps you solve any request.
wonderful place to stay

this place was perfect for a getaway. my family of 5 stayed there and couldn’t be any happier with the stay. place was clean and home is well decorated! we loved the message on the refrigerator it was a a nice personal touch!

the house is very nice, tidy and in a good location (10 min walking from the metro station) in a quiet area, yet very close to a street where there are several restaurants and stores. the room is small (as announced) but really comfortable! the bathrooms are spacious and clean.
great safe and nice location. very close to the subway so it was easy to get the manhattan. would recommend staying here 100%!
nice place to live i’d definitely stay there again
the apartment was in a great location and it was very spacious and cool. we enjoyed it thoroughly.
we enjoyed our stay here.
we loved staying at emily's place. excellent location with comfortable accommodations. be aware that this is a very popular part of town so expect to hear people enjoying themselves.
the place was so clean, cute, and cozy! very spacious and the hosts were responsive and super sweet.
this was our 2nd stay with igor. he’s wonderful, patient and understanding! very comfy apt!
people in the lobby are very direspectful

ester's apt was super super comfortable and very close to the train station. the neighborhood was also safe. ester is a super super nice and warm lady!!!!we arrived so late at the first night due to the flight delay. but she was still available and welcomed us, even it was already 3am at that time. she provided some bagels and coffee daily. the checkout was also flexible which was so convenient for us. it would be the smartest choice to choose ester once you have a plan to go to ny for trip!!
the place was perfect. exactly as described. loved the area. i would definitely stay here again

a great location near the j train, lots of classic bk shops around the corner- everything you need in a walking distance. no kitchen- so it’s best if you are staying in the room and always eating out. private entrance and bathroom is great for the price- and no stairs. whoever lives above the apartment thinks they are a dj (and they have a baby) just really loud with music before 9am- not cool. our stay was otherwise comfortable, and the host is great!
great location . matthew has been very helpful during our stay . he waited for us till 1 am as our landing time is rather late.
ann-deal is a fabulous host. her place was clean and spacious. very close to the subway! i highly recommend.

this is my second stay at stanley's apartments in nyc. both have been excellent. this one again is perfectly located, a block from the subway, a block from local market to get the daily needs. stanley is always spot on with his design of rooms and amenities. the house has a good wi-fi, spot clean, well equipped kitchen, room has all the necessary including the work table and chair and table lamp, comfortable beds, and a big wardrobe. i highly recommend staying here because its more like a private guest house with shared common space with other guests/travellers.
beyond what i expected, hoping to return soon

diana and her husband alex are phenomenal people. their mother in law who shares the space is such a kind and sweet lady. i’d recommend anyone to stay at there airbnb. super responsive, very proactive, and they want to ensure their guests feel comfortable and accommodated. it was bitter sweet to leave, and i am sure the next guest will appreciate and love it as much as i did. 10/10 recommend.
had a great stay. was spacious and comfortable. 5 minute walk to the train which was great.

great place for travelers looking to save a few dollars. room was clean, john was super awesome! it was about a 5 minute walk to the bus, 1hr to the city. overall a great place! would stay again if in the area.
i had a great stay! the place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. communication with the host was clear and prompt. would definitely recommend!
joanna’s place was perfect for our needs. very comfortable. she was responsive to questions but otherwise left us alone. we enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend!
nice accommodations! everything i love about new york was walkable, and it was also close to bigger public transportation stations so it was very convenient too.
the most amazing place in financial district. we love everything about it. 100% recommend!!

alejandro was a great host. he provided some recommendations for areas to visit in brooklyn. the room was in great condition as the pictures show. easy access to the subways. just would recommend getting back to the room before it gets too late.

if you need a private place to land after long days in nyc, lindsey's place is a treat. first, the unit itself has it own entrance, bedroom, bathroom, living, and kitchen. the furniture choice and linens are well kept and the neighborhood itself is safe and cozy. lindsey was kind and flexible and i couldn't thank her more for hosting my partner and i. highly recommend!!
excellent location, patrick was very fast at responding to any of my questions. the apartment was very clean and comfortable. would recommend staying here.
we loved staying at this airbnb! jeffrey and dan were incredibly responsive and accommodating, the location was fantastic, and the apartment had everything we needed.
our stay was pleasant. adam was very responsive and helpful. the place was clean and exactly as described.

nomads location was the perfect location to be at for time square and all fun nyc activities! it’s exactly how described but better the location is where you really get a bang for your buck! on top of that the service and communication was perfect between the host and i! i would 100% stay again for the location and vibe itself!

we stayed here for a couple of days. the staff are wonderful. you can't beat the location. however, the apartment itself was very old. the apartment itself and the hallways had a bad smell. the apartment was not very clean. definitely overpriced for this quality.
great host, great place to stay
i had a spectacular time

the apartment was excellent. very clean/tidy and exactly as advertised. location was fabulous within a 20 mins subway ride to all of manhatten. loved new york. obed, was fantastic from start to finish. always in communication, most helpful and made our stay trouble free. highly highly recommended
just what we needed. 👍
very good place. large room good location ruben was very helpful and friendly
very cute space. clean and comfortable. located in a great location -- safe/residential but within walking distance to a few good restaurants. also within walking distance to the subway.

we had a great time in this wonderful, spacious appartment in a great neighbourhood. (meatpacking/chelsea). the appartment is fully equiped, with a large kitchen, and modern furniture. it even has a garden! vanessa responded quickly to all queries, in spite of the fact she was on holiday herselve.

lisa's place was great! the neighbourhood is cool, the apartment had everything we needed, and it was super comfortable. lisa was a great host, always responsive, and someone was there to help us move into the apartment. highly recommend staying here.

lee’s place was lovely. a very easy walk from the j train, and lots to see and do around the neighbourhood. he was a very helpful and responsive host, and we felt right at home. the place is clean and stylish, and we got a tonne of local recs too. the dogs were also an excellent addition to our stay!

krystal was very accommodating and kind! she was able to accommodate an early check in so we didn’t have to lug our luggage around. the house and area were great as well! overall was a wonderful place to stay and it was great staying there after a long day out. definitely would stay here again!

i highly recommend ron's apartment for its many significant qualities : a unique location in the heart of manhattan in the very pleasant district of chelsea from which you can either walk to lots of very interesting places to visit or take the nearby subway. moreover, it is a very peaceful and quiet place and you sleep in a very comfortable bed. nearby one can either go to restaurants and bars or just cross the street to the very convenient wholefoods market . last but not least, ron is a perfect host providing us with very helpful indications as how to find our way around and kindly inquiring if everything is okay and if we have everything we need. we would gladly go back to ron's place if we were to visit ny again.
maria was very nice and understanding it’s a great place to book guys trust me

this is such a lovely apartment—spacious, clean, and cozy—and tori and leo are wonderfully friendly and helpful hosts the location is ideal with easy access to transportation, shops, restaurants and parks—perfect brooklyn living. the access to the backyard was an amazing addition and much appreciated. we definitely hope to stay again!
great place in brooklyn. very clean and private living!!! everything was so easy to get to. the host was very friendly and made sure we had everything we needed.
it was very clean and the location was exactly what we were expecting. we enjoyed our stay!

the check in process was super easy and the location was amazing. but: the sheets were completely pilled, the stuffing in the pillows had burst and was coming out and the bathroom shower tiles had black stuff growing in between.

this place was the best airbnb i stayed, it was clean, chris and the staff were awesome, the place is in the middle of everything, i will absolutely stay there whenever i'm in ny and i recommend it 100%
brian was so welcoming and friendly! he communicated proactively and made sure we had what we needed. thanks for a great stay!

salmas place is the best! this is my second time staying here the area is so peaceful the house is always clean and comfortable, salma is so responsive and helpful with everything this is a great stay.
we had a great stay at malik's place. the room had everything we needed and it was easy to communicate with malik. the location was exceptionally convenient for wherever you wanted to go.
i throughly enjoyed my stay here! the space was amazing and well set up, it really was the louvre in the heart of east village. close to a lot of attractions and convenient to get around. thank you!

spacious; private 3br; 2bths is a rare find in nyc!! our adult family enjoyed the fact that each couple had their own private space but also a large common space to hang out ; relax; entertain. the location was also perfect with great restaurants all around us; easy to get around walking; by subway as well as uber/lyft. we had functions in midtown; downtown; brooklyn; new jersey; red hook …. all logistically & efficiently doable from here!! also; very grateful for the a/c! billy was a most gracious & accommodating host!!
place was great! host was nice and respectful. loved the mirror in the bathroom!

kristina is a great host and her apartment is in an excellent location. i spent my first month in nyc living at her place and she was so helpful with tips, inviting me to events and generally making me feel at home. sugar is a great addition to the flat too, she's adorable and loves to play, if you're a dog person you'll love her.

we had the most amazing stay here - it has absolutely everything we needed for a short stay, in a beautiful building. everything was spotless, the kitchen and living space was wonderful with everything you could need. it was even better than the photos!! it is also very close to everything, walkable to most sights and very close to the subway too. for the price it is unmatched and we will be telling everyone coming to nyc to stay here!! thank you so much to the hosts :)
super clean and kind place to stay

we had a great stay at sabrina’s apartment, which was very spacious and clean. very cool decor throughout the place. air conditioner helped on some of the warmer days. lots of shops / restaurants within walking distance, as well as a grocery store and park that is basically next door. highly recommend!
the place was amazing and spacious, and also great response time and flexible. i would love to stay again!
marina was friendly and prompt to respond to messages sent her way. the home was cozy and practically on the beach, which made traveling easy and successful!

ibrahim is a great person, always helpful and very respectful. the apartment is located just 13 minutes away (walking) from the yankee stadium, or there’s a bus stop right next to the entrance. one of the top ten restaurants of ny, according to the time out magazine is also outside of the building.
peter’s place was great. exactly as it was described. great neighborhood with a good deli and good grocery within 5 minute walk. host was nice and a good communicator. great spot!
great stay in michaels home. the pictures do not do the apartment justice! really nice and spacious and a great stop. michael greeted me on arrival and gave me some tips for the area!!
it was perfect for an overnight stay. the room was clean and quiet and directly across from the shower and restrooms. very close to union square the l, 4,5,6 subway. the owner is a good communicator.

john was a great host, our flight got in late and he had no problems exchanging keys at that time. he also answered my 3am text about restaurant deliveries in the area ;) the home itself is gorgeous. the views spectacular, and a very quiet building. it's a modern minimalistic feel which we are used to so it wasn't a shock. very clean and the beds were super comfy. be aware its on the 6th floor, and stairs are the only option. the neighborhood was safe, and great shopping are steps away.

outstanding location right next to williamsburgbridge and view from rooftop towards downtown manhattan, stunning! host was quick to respond and super friendly with lots of tips for local amenities etc. can totally recommend!

we enjoyed our stay at jenine's place. it has a parking spot which is very helpful especially if you are in the city. the only issue we had was it was not ready/clean when we checked in. overall, my family had no problem in our stay in jenine's place. i would still recommend it.

mary was a fantastic host, especially for myself as a young individual spending time in ny for the first time. she was extremely helpful with explaining the area and giving advice for my stay. she's also the type of person that you will become friends with while there and want to revisit. bonus with the kitties, they are the sweetest companions to have around. apartment is extremely spacious and comfortable for a longer stay, consistently clean, a personal bathroom, and nicely decorated. the location is close to the subway for those who plan on making trips to manhattan, and there are plenty of places near clinton hill itself that are great to explore. i'm so glad that i wound up staying with mary, i couldn't have had a better experience!!

best airbnb i’ve had. location is perfect. the house is cozy and fully equipped - you can feel someone thought of every little detail to make your stay perfect. super quick responses from neanna the host - totally recommended for a classy brooklyn stay.
rooms have thin wall

we loved staying at christopher’s place. it felt like home for our four days in nyc. christopher was super friendly and helpful. he was kind enough to offer us baggage storage for the day as our flight wasn’t until late in the evening. one of the best airbnb’s i’ve stayed at! would highly recommend.
jon’s place was incredible. perfect location and so much better than the photos. would definitely stay again.

my stay was wonderful. the location is so convenient, the neighborhood peaceful. spacious, comfortable & beautiful property. miguel was fantastic. great communication. the place was incredibly clean which we appreciated the most. most importantly, my friend and i felt safe. can’t wait to return! thank you again miguel !!
it was a great place with nice beach equipment and a very helpful host.

this was such a cute hotel!! we absolutely loved our stay here. they serve free coffee and pastries every morning, the room was spotless, it was super cute, and it was an ease to check in and out! we would definitely stay here again when we return to nyc! the location is great and quiet- easy to get to any other area from here. my only complaint that really wasn’t a big thing because that’s just how it is in nyc is the room was a little small. however it was still so comfy and stylish and despite that all the good outweighed the bad so we would return! loved it!
this was my first air bnb experience and it was great. reka was really flexible with check in/out times and her housemate, erin, was super friendly and lovely! thanks guys!
great location and perfect place to get a good night sleep
stephan was really nice very respectful and understanding i highly recommend him if you guys are in the area
check in was very simple and the location is ideal.
ronald's home is within walking distance to the bronx park, botanical garden, and the bronx zoo. little italy is close as well!

this place was an amazing stay! really close to astoria park, short walks to buses and trains that take you all over the city, peaceful at night. was a really family friendly spot that accommodated everything we needed. although we only spent a very short time in the backyard due to weather, it was a really nice green space that livened up the apartment. considering our options for hotels in other areas, this was a great choice! well stocked kitchen, good size table and furniture, lots of closet space, comfortable bed, washer / dryer, and even a little desk area - overall amazing how well put together it is. really also liked that it was a quiet and peaceful area, so our toddler had no problem sleeping. if i’m in the area, i would definitely come back!

our stay at jeanne and george was great. this is a perfect getaway location. after all the huzzle and buzzle of new york it feels great to arrive back in greenpoint. there are all kind of shops for your convenience in the neighbourhood. the apartment is clean, tidy and cosy. and what a lovely shower! the subway is nearby and it takes about 30 minutes to get from greenpoint to times square and 42nd street. with one transfer. it was also very nice to meet jeanne, george and the kids. we will definately come back to greenpoint!

this was the second time we stayed with fahim, and we would do it again in a heartbeat. the space is exceptionally cozy, cute, comfortable, and private. also, the location is fantastic, with easy access to public transportation and a stunning assortment of exotic dining options. the availability of parking is a huge plus. fahim and his wife were wonderfully gracious and flexible hosts, and made us feel very welcome.
great stay beautiful and clean. host is very nice and reliable to communicate. very clean and spacious.

beth is an incredible host. we enjoyed our stay immensely! the location is great, quiet and comfortable, and just a short walk from the very quick q train. the kitties are especially friendly and sweet! recommended!
👍 i would book again
it was a pleasure to stay at aisha’s place

dominik was an incredibly hospitable host who waited to greet us at his apartment despite our four hours delay. his accommodative nature made us feel very welcome in his home. dominik’s home was a very good size by nyc standard for our family of four and it is also strategically located near subways, cafes, a laundromat and a grocery store. our two teenage daughters loved his warm, white and bright apartment so much (that was infused with lots of gorgeous healthy green plants) so that it was an effort extracting them from the place to go out sight seeing. we all fell in love with his projector tv that flashed on to the spacious wall of his living room and stayed up late every night watching netflix. a brilliant touch to the homely environment.
great location and value. kandi is a lovely host too.
this place is awesome!! i would definitely stay again. perfect location, great hosts, super clean and new! can't wait until the next trip! highly recommended
great place to stay if you have an overnight layover at jfk airport. quick uber or cab to and from.
probably this apparat has the best bed in all nyc!!!! best dreams ever! thank you edgar for the warm hosting!

the location of this apartment was outstanding! times square was two blocks away, there were great restaurants and bars all around the location, and the apartment was spacious and large enough for four people! the pull out bed in the living room was also very comfortable! iradj was also very accommodating regarding our check out time for an evening flight! he was quick to respond for any questions we had and was a great host. would definitely stay here again!
fantastic location and very clean. host was very friendly and quick to respond to questions.
great stay in a great location. would love to go again in the future
nate was fantastic super communicative and very very helpful. it is the perfect place for a long-term stay in new york city.

overall we had a great stay. i loved that we had a full kitchen and windows for natural light. the private entrance was awesome because we didn’t have to feel bad about coming in too late. there were plenty of locks and cameras outside so i felt secure! the bed was pretty comfortable too. i prefer soft but it was firm (most men like this). tv was great & personal touches like toiletries, cleaning supplies, & personalized wifi were so great. parking was ok. often found parking close at farthest a block away just beware of signs and be willing to move it early am on weekdays (set an alarm). that’s just the nyc way. neighborhood seems nice. lots of families and people just enjoying their lives. it was pretty quiet most of the time. oh and this place is close to the mall and delivery options if you don’t want to cook or forget an item. anywho you get it! overall we had a wonderful experience.

the place was beautiful, the hosts were friendly and helpful, and everything was as described. this was probably the nicest place i've ever stayed barring like, venice. would absolutely stay again, highly recommended!

henry's place was just as described. we didn't get a chance because we were only in town for a single night to see a show before it closed. the bed and pillows were super comfortable and just what we needed after a long day! to be so close to the manhattan bridge it was amazing that the bedroom was so quiet. what a location! i'll definitely consider staying here the next time i'm in nyc.

great place for my group! the place was easy to find, clean, and shimon was very responsive. one note is that the airbnb is a little further out than the listed address. location is pretty deep into brooklyn, but no issue getting ubers or to the train. book with confidence!

veronica’s room is tastefully furnished, cozy and clean. the location is perfect as a subway station is right across the street. the proximity to the subway means that one can hear trains passing by but the sound is not terrible. i could sleep alright despite being a light sleeper. would definitely recommend her place!
shedina's place was amazing, very close to the train station, very cozy apartment and very beautiful, we enjoyed very much our time in new york and i thank shadina for her hospitality.

spacious 2nd story apt. full kitchen and living room with tv which we didn't use. bathroom is functional but a little tight in the toilet area. clean and fine though. need to climb one flight of stairs. easy for us, but just so you know. debra is sweet and responsive. warm and hospitable. comfortable beds. enjoyed walking thru crown heights. good location. would stay again.
stay was awesome, will definitely stay again.
i highly recommend this place. the room has everything you need: a refrigerator, a tv, a large bed. convenient location.

we had a great few days staying in gary’s place, exploring new york. it is a good location with easy access to all the main attractions and on a direct subway route to jfk airport. lots of nice places to eat locally and several supermarkets close by. the place has a fully equipped kitchen. it is on the 4th floor. the neighbours were pleasant and welcoming. there was no noise from other flats but the road outside was extremely noisy all night. good earplugs are essential for lite sleepers. beds were comfortable and there’s a descent shower. the flat felt safe and homely.
leli was great, and the apartment was perfect for the month!
great location, huge comfortable clean space, responsive hosts. would definitely stay here again if traveling with a group.

our first trip to nyc as a family, and we loved this location! we were able to walk everywhere. the stunning views, privacy, lobby and building security, cleanliness, and comfort made the price absolutely worth it!! there is a great grocery store across the street, a wine/liquor store around the corner, an excellent bagel and sandwich place two blocks away called broad and nosh, as well as plenty of other options. it’s a short walk to pier 84, with great sunset views. we recommend the intrepid tour, and staying at this wonderful apartment of course! we had such a great time. thanks, justin!
great location, clean and tidy apartment, all the basics. it was the perfect place to get re-oriented for a few weeks. highly recommend!

even though it was just a few days, we had a great experience and time at robert's airbnb! the apartment itself was very very quiet and had a comfortable bed (and sofabed) with a well stocked kitchen area. the location was absolutely superb. it's located in astoria, a very safe neighborhood and is close to restaurants, grocery stores, and tons of transportation options. this made getting around very easy! we were able to walk 10 minutes or so to the astoria ferry pier (which we took down to pier 11). highly suggest walking around the neighborhood, and even later at night it was very safe. robert, the host, was also incredibly kind and accommodating. i'm very grateful for this airbnb and would gladly return again. highly recommend this place, especially for its great location!
great location! the space is adorable. everything you need is a walk away.
great host! great space! 5 stars!

i wish you could give 10 stars to alex and her amazing home. she was the best most responsive host i’ve ever had and her place was just perfect. great location, super cool, plenty of room to spread out both inside and outside. great neighborhood near fun places to hang out but super quiet on her block. it doesn’t get any better than this in nyc.
the henry norman is the perfect place to stay in brooklyn. very spacious, clean, and efficient. the staff is so lovely. very calm, laid back feeling there. x
it’s cool staying at ny sprite specially with the super kind ravindra ! your my man ravi

this was a lovely and very comfortable place to stay in brooklyn. nina provided many thoughtful amenities, including a first aid kit and a pitcher of cold water in the refrigerator. the apartment was quiet and clean, and it was a relaxing oasis after busy days visiting relatives, friends, and touring. the location was perfect for us. be aware that nina and the other reviewers are correct to caution about the narrow staircase going up to the apartment, especially with luggage. if staying with our friends isn't an option on subsequent visits, we will gladly stay here again if available.
this was the perfect spot for my 36 hour trip to ny. not too far from laguardia and not too far from manhattan. the amenities are basic, but it's a great value. i would definitely stay here again.
i liked this room, i was living in it for 1 month, and everything was amazing. i recommend
this harlem apartment is conveniently located, in a quieter neighbourhood than i had expected. there was plenty of space for our family of five to relax between sight-seeing. highly recommended.

very sweet, thoughtful host, providing a care package, a variety of high-end amenities including in the shared kitchen, along with lots of space. i like privacy, and was given plenty of it! would recommend to absolutely everybody.
this place is a little slice of heaven. the hosts were great and did everything to make things easy for you.

i had a great experience staying with jude, he was super helpful the whole time. the communication was great prior to checking in and the place was super clean. everything i needed was in the unit. perfect location where you can park on the street and still have access to public transportation. made it to times square in 20 minutes with the train 2 blocks away. we walked to yankee stadium and apollo theater. the block is very. peaceful and quiet. the apartment was fully furnished with everything i needed, from a well-equipped kitchen to a comfortable bed and cozy living room. i especially appreciated the little touches, like high speed wifi, free coffee and a designated work area, which allowed me to get some work done. it was cool that the whole building is operated for short term rentals. my friend rented the unit above mine. we were together and had privacy at the same time. can’t wait to come back.
it was ok for last min and you won’t be i. the room shower was small
great place at a very central location in midtown. we stayed here for a week. clean rooms and very helpful staff.
cheap place to stay
kerri was so helpful, helping me navigate the city and public transportation. everyone was super friendly and welcoming. thanks for having me!

od’s place was perfect for our visit. my son is attending pratt institute and we needed a rental near enough to the campus to prepare for his dorm move-in day. we enjoyed the lively atmosphere of the neighborhood while we walked around friday evening. lots of music and community. everyone seemed to be enjoying the warm august night. the street where the rental is located is very quiet. it’s off the beaten path. od was super available and forthcoming with information regarding our stay. there are two a/c units provided, one in the main area and one in the bedroom. very nice to have on these hot nights. there is a great coffee shop right at the corner with seriously delicious coffee and treats. across the street is a bodega that also has reasonably tasty coffee. i was surprised. the subway ride into manhattan takes very little time. this was a perfect stay for our needs. thanks od!
this was perfect for a ny family weekend.
this place is was so cute and so clean! it had everything you could possibly need. communication was excellent, i would definitely stay here again

we had a great stay. while the apartment is small, it was comfortable and easy to get around the city from. neighborhood was pretty quiet and i didn’t feel unsafe. aside from that, it was clean, cozy, and fit our general needs. price wasn’t bad, either.

for us the location was the deal maker! minutes of walking to the edge and many other attractions. many good places around at an affordable price and good quality. checkin at 2 am was smooth. thank you!

the location was great; host was responsive but the keypad was broken which left us feeling a little “insecure”; there was an additional door w a key also we really couldn’t use the bathroom sink; we told them it was ok; it would drain, hopefully it will be fixed for the next visitor; other then that we loved the location, easy to get to the trains, yummy food all around - we would come back

jennifer's place was great value for money in a place like new york city. the nearest metro station was a 5 minute walk and there were plenty of convenience stores and restaurants in the area. all in all, we had a very comfortable stay. the only thing to bear in mind is that if one is carrying a lot of heavy luggage (as in our case since we were on a very long tour of the usa), be prepared to carry it up a flight of narrow stairs to the second floor.
when i first walked in i was in love. the way it’s decorated is beautiful! highly recommend.
shelley's house is great, it has everything we needed and she has been very kind to us, she was always looking out for us :) thank you so much for everything!

sherry and her husband were super welcoming. this was my first time traveling alone and they made me feel welcomed and safe. their place is amazing, and the room has a gorgeous view. a lot of the touristy places are within walking distance and safe to walk at night. needless to say my stay here was amazing and i definitely recommend anyone visiting nyc to stay here!!

this airbnb was a great location however the place was too expensive for what it is worth. there were rats that ran right past me as i walked out of the bathroom scared me half to death. i screamed & the lady comes out her room with sticky paper and said this is an old building that’s why rats are here. globs of dust in all corners of the bedroom behind the bed on the side, spider webs all over the bathroom walls , shower, etc. recycling garbage all in the kitchen area. the wife of the owner is annoying trying to make conversation at the middle of the night. i had a weekend stay where she told me not to stay out too late. this place is not clean at all. very dirty! i don’t even think they washed the blankets. comfortable because of the air conditioner. the bedroom & bathrooms doors make a lot of noise when you move about. i would like my money back because ewww.

i stayed with jian's mom and uncle, they were the most gracious hosts i've ever had! super nice and was very kind. everything was nice and clean. made use of their kitchen for some of my meals. location was nice and convenient with a lot of shops, restaurants and asian stores. highly reccomend staying here.
amazing! we couldn’t have found a better place to stay for the group.
this stay was wonderful from start to finish. the location was perfect, close to everything. the front desk staff was especially kind and welcoming, which made the experience even better.
very cozy! nazleen was very sweet & attentive ❤️🙏🏽 thank you so much nazleen
its a very nice place, i enjoyed my stay.
extremely clean, neat and welcoming! it was a mini home away from home. thank you!

juliette was a terrific host and her place is clean and comfortable and well located for visiting nyc and brooklyn specifically. having the park nearby was very nice and access to subway and city bikes made getting around easy. highly recommended!

location, location, location! jamison's place is situated in a truly ideal spot. you are just one block from central park and one block from the express 2/3 subway line, with countless restaurants and excellent shopping right outside your door. despite being in the heart of it all, the apartment itself was an oasis—quiet and comfortable. jamison was an extremely responsive and helpful host, providing great local recommendations that truly enhanced the trip. we would highly recommend staying here!

we would like to thank you for your flat and for your availability. even if you got a problem with the bathroom you take care of all what happened. we recommend this flat near to the subway and central park!
great and sparkling clean place in a great location. mark is very helpful and responsive!
nice, clean space for one. enjoyed my stay!

we stayed at peterson's place during a weekend getaway in nyc from the west coast. it's a really nice home, clean, comfortable & easily accessible. i would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others as well. peterson is polite, respectful, welcoming & quick to respond if needed.
love the place. clean and close to jfk airport. host is very nice.
great place. close to the subway station and grocery store. clean and cozy place, very pleasant and welcoming host.
absolutely fantastic place to stay, spotlessly clean and beautifully furnished. billy has thought of everything. very comfortable beds too. excellent location close to cafes, shops and restaurants.

my stay at alicia loving was very comfortable. the room is exactly like showed and described in the ad. the private bathroom and the use of own front door makes the stay relaxing, for you don't feel you are interupting their daily business. bed is very comfortable, use of towels and linnen is provided and everything you need, they have in the kitchen. my first evening there, alicia took me to a small theatre for a text-reading in brooklyn, written by her friend. it was great to experience my first evening in ny this way. she's very helpful and great to talk with. it is a bit of a journey from 145th street to lower manhattan, for example. it's what you're used to of course. the neighborhood isn't as attractive as chelsea of lower east side(coffee/shops/bars) but is safe and it has everything you need. there's a cloister museum nearby and from west 145th trainstation you can take the train up north and see the beautifull area north of manhattan. check out was very flexible, eventhough it was thanksgiving day!
this is thus far one of my greatest airbnb experiences. the host has a great sense of hospitality...the place is super clean and the environment is impeccable. great job!

david was an amazing host and best host i ever met. the place is much better than the pictures it’s few minutes walking from kings high way station. the room is very clean and it have it own fridge the bathroom is exactly next to the room. david is one of the nice person i met in my life. definitely will be back. thank you

what a great find! we really enjoyed the location, cleanliness, and efficiency of the space. thanks for having us miao!
we had a great time there. joe prepared many foods for us. it's so kind of them. the rooms are very clean and warm.

thank you sigfus for the hospitality! the location was incredible and this was a nice crash pad for an nyc weekend. appreciated the good communitcation. the street is loud but it is what it is and sigfus provided ear protection. thank you!

our stay at chris and zach's place was perfect. great communication both before and during our stay and the check in process was very easy. the apartment had everything we needed and was only 2 blocks from the subway and a 30 minute ride to manhattan. we got to meet our hosts briefly and play with their lovely dogs and they are a very friendly couple. thanks again for having us guys and hopefully we can visit again in the future 🙂

comfortable and spacious room to stay in new york city. good location with great access to public transportation. will definitely book again if i'm back in nyc.

we had such a nice stay! contact with the host was super easy and clear. the building is a little old but being in the room it did not feel like that at all. also the public bathroom and shower were perfectly fine. very close to a metro station that can get you anywhere. would absolutely recommend!
lakshmee is a great host. the room was perfect -- comfy, clean and easily accessible to/from the airport. thank you for the great stay.

this is the perfect place to stay if you're in new york to explore the city. the apartment is well furnished and comfortable, and near the bus and subway. but, more importantly, michael is an excellent host who is helpful, knowledgeable, friendly, and great company. don't miss this gem in harlem.

beautiful my decorated in a great location. very responsive and flexible host. glad for the stay and not only would i stay at this location again, i would highly recommend others stay at this location when travelling to ny.
great location. everyone was very nice.
ot’ an fantastic house as you can see in the pic’s. well connected and alexa it’s great
talia is such a kind and thoughtful host with a clean and inviting home. would definitely book again!

john was incredibly communicative and helpful through out our stay. he worked with us through multiple things and angel was helpful as well. this is a quiet, well located spot. small building so it feels private. will check availability for this place before booking anywhere else in brooklyn for next time!

amy’s place desperately needs an update. the towels are definitely a decade old, couldn’t use them. for 4 days we had half toilet paper and when i requested for some there was no response back. i also asked for clean towels and no words. the rust and dust were alarming. repainting the walls are a most. just update will be great.
very kind hospitable people, they’re both extremely friendly and accommodative. i promise you will really enjoy your stay here and the room is well decorated and spacious

this home is exactly what we were looking for to have our small family wedding and dinner. we wish we could have time to enjoy the home more because everything was beautiful and well designed. every space was very clean and the kitchen has every tool you could imagine. aron is really quick to respond and is very communicative. i hope we can find a reason to stay here again.

staying at barry's and julie's place is fantastic! it's a wonderful apartment in a fantastic location. i didn't get to meet barry, but julie is great - our plane was hours late, and julie was still there to greet us, show us around, and give us tips about the neighborhood. i highly recommend this place!

waldemar was very welcoming. his apartment is cozy, the bedroom comfortable, and he was always friendly when we talked to him. the house is in a quiet part of brooklyn, but it has good delis, grocery stores, cafes, and restaurants around. it's also really close to the g train, so it's easy to move around.

first of all at check out, i found out about all of these ridiculous additional charges. , the view in our room was terrible, just the back view of other buildings. i had to change rooms because the door in my room didn’t close all the way and o could smell marijuana coming from another room . moved to another room and that door didn’t close all the way either. hotel was like a party hotel. guests were loud. there was an ironing board but no iron.

jaleh is a wonderful woman and one of the best hosts i have ever seen during my travels. she was so kind and respectful, giving me the feeling at home. the location of the apartment was also great, close to the subway station, and i could also walk around. i will definitely and definitely not consider any place other than jaleh's to stay on my next trips to nyc. thanks again to jaleh for her wonderful hospitality that made my first trip to nyc even more memorable.

my wife and i stayed here for 11 days in may 2013. the apartment is located in a good neighbourhood, literally right around the corner from the subway that got us almost everywhere in manhattan we wanted to go. nataliya was very welcoming and pleasant to deal with, providing us with recommendations and tips on good places to eat, how to get around, etc. the kitchen is reasonably well-equipped, the living room couch is good for two to sprawl on after a long day of walking (and nataliya kindly provided access to her netflix account) and, most importantly, the queen-sized bed is firm and comfy. however, we did have problems with the cleanliness of the apartment; it simply hadn't been properly cleaned in awhile – dirty floors, big dust bunnies, and greasy surfaces in the kitchen and on the dishes. we also had a few visits from cockroaches (although, to be fair, this is probably not unusual in older buildings in ny). we expressed our concerns to nataliya and she was quite apologetic, explaining that the apartment had been rented out back-to-back for quite awhile and offered to compensate us for the lowered standard of cleanliness – which we felt was a classy move and showed her genuine interest in providing a positive experience for her guests. hopefully, this is an isolated incident (and nataliya handled it well, responding promptly to our criticism and suggestions). so, overall, our stay was a mixed bag: good host, good location and decent amenities, but the cleanliness problems really took the shine off for us. just a few notes if you're thinking of renting this apartment (neither positive nor negative, just info): 1.if you are 'scentsitive', there are scented candles, cleaning products, incense and other scented products used. 2.the building has central heat, which was still on during our stay in may, when it was already quite hot out. since we're from the pacific northwest, we're used to much cooler temperatures and found it took several nights to adjust to the ambient temp + the heat pumping out of the radiators. this is not something nataliya has any control over, and if you're used to sleeping warm, it probably won't phase you. there is a big ceiling fan which definitely helped.

we had a very nice stay at kim’s place . the apartment was very comfortable with great amenities and was walking distance from the subway . the area was safe with a big grocery store and some nice restaurants nearby . kim is an amazing host who gave us great tips to see the best places in town . would greatly recommend her place for a great stay in new york .
great location! safe and clean. will return!
great location, the apartment had everything we needed!
amazing place! shanti was great and responsive! house was very spacious and homey.
i highly suggest staying here, affordable & amazing! bed is super comfy & the view is so pretty.
a really nice place to stay and clean. about 15 min travel to manhattan. a bus stop in front of the apartment. the host arranged a little snack when we arrived. very thoughtful after a long trip.
