very nice and comfortable, relaxing room
my second time staying in this amazing space. always always a great experience.
we had a great stay! easy to self check in, clean apartment, nice little touches throughout the place like toothbrush and toothpaste kits, and some snacks in the kitchen.
misbau was so helpful and responsive. was a great stay, definitely will recommend to friends and family traveling ny.
great centrally located space. clean, cozy and spacious. very walkable. plenty of food options nearby. gets good sunlight and beds are comfy. would stay again!
the space is cute and super clean. the location was great, tons of restaurants, a few blocks to prospect park. it's awesome that there's a private back garden to hang out in.
super cute and very comfortable space. perfect for traveling with a little one during a pandemic.

this was our first trip to new york. for housing a larger group, it’s hard to beat the price in the area. plenty of space for our group of five. the apartment is within a few minutes walk to the subway station which will take you right into manhattan without any problems. the photos are fairly misleading though as the apartment is in need of some maintenance and care. several possible safety issues due to disrepair. while the inside of the apartment itself was clean enough, the interior entry way and front stoop were disgusting with trash, months of piled up mail, and random odds and ends discarded and left. this host owns all three units and there is not any reason for such filth in the common areas. it should also be noted that you are unable to control the heat or air conditioning in the apartment which was uncomfortable at times with no response from host when mentioned. host was otherwise very helpful and responsive if any other issues or questions were brought up.

i had a very pleasant stay at alejandrina’s place. the room and entire apartment were sparkling clean, the bed was very comfortable and alejandrina graciously accommodated any request i had. the apt is located conveniently close to the subway and a short walk to restaurants and attractions. would love to stay again and plan to! thanks again alejandrina!

we enjoyed our stay and very much enjoyed the staff. they were very helpful and pleasant and went out of their way to make our stay perfect. this is somewhat of a strategic location depending on your plans, in that it is quite loud being right in the middle of times square but in this case, that’s exactly what we were looking for and it paid off beautifully. we had a great time!

this place is a home away from home, the room amenities are spot on remont controled bed, fridge in room, extra blankets, tv, big room and it’s actually really quiet. king is a great host, the train is so easy to get to the cuty and tgeres everthing you need close by. really outstanding homestay airbnb

this loft is perfectly located, quiet and exactly as described on the website. really very nice!

this is our third time staying with david and janet. the container house feels like a home away from home. we loved seeing them and their sweet dog mormon. since i wasn't traveling with my whole family this trip, we stayed in the downstairs portion. it was the perfect place to unwind after a long day out seeing all the sights. as ever, the location is so convenient to everything - walking distance to the subway and many great places to eat. thank you so much for having us, we're looking forward to our next stay!

this is a great little place and was perfect for our short weekend getaway. kathleen was the perfect host, meeting us to check-in and provide some basic information but then giving plenty of privacy during our stay. the cottage itself is lovely with all the basic amenities you need and a very comfortable bed. we weren't that familiar with the area but there was plenty to do and all accessible usually with less than a 15 minute drive. we thoroughly enjoyed vegan treats from love earth cafe as well as some great mexican cuisine at mezcal's. the gardens at snug harbor were definitely a highlight and you can't go more than a few hundred yards without running into a great bagel spot. overall, we loved our stay and definitely will plan to return in the future.

this was a great place to stay for our group of 4 couples, 8 people total. the living space was great for us to hang out and have breakfast before going exploring. the street is not in the greatest location but entering the building is easy and we felt totally safe. there is a convenient mart next door that was good for last minute supplies. the elevator entrance right into the apartment is different but we had no issues there are 2 bathrooms, hot water and very clean. the second bathroom is split into two rooms so the shower is in the hallway and the toilet and sink are in a separate room. it still worked out fine for us. lots of cooking pans , coffee pot and a nespresso but no coffee provided. a little short on coffee mugs but overall it works out great!! beds were comfortable!! and there was lots of storage within each room. i would recommend this place.

stella's apartment is nice, its location is perfect, just a few minutes walk to penn station and very close to times square. she is a very good host and kept me informed of the check-in information before arrival, surely i'd recommend anybody to stay there.

great apartment, clean and beds very comfortable. it is so close to the subway, with restaurants and shops nearby too. pamela was great. she ensured we had all the information ahead of time and even provided links and suggestions for anything we may need.
it was a last minute booking just for few hours , but i really how clean and fresh the room was!!
the neighborhood was quiet. the apartment was clean.
fantastic experience at this apartment. everything was new, clean, and comfortable. the hosts were very professional, kind, and amenable. would highly recommend.
please stay here‼️ the best host ever‼️‼️ everything was beautiful and clean. maribel and her husband went above and beyond. 💜

this is the fourth time staying at the princess and has always been homely. the place is neat, secure and any issues that we had were readily attended to. my family and i will always choose the princess!

wonderful place, is exactly as its listing and reviews suggest! only minor caveat is to make sure the automated lighting setup is responding to instructions and changes as needed. but other than that, a lovely stay, highly recommended!

beto is an excellent host and provides very detailed directions for entering into the home. the apartment is just spacious enough for a great getaway to nyc and is steps away from a fabulous bar and coffee shop. it is very easy to get to the 6 train which makes traveling around the city very quick and convenient.

what a great apartment! we loved every single detail. everything was very clean and comfy. we loved the bed and pillows. the neighborhood was really nice and safe. we loved brooklyn, park slope. we loved the tips that gary gave and he was right, the bagels from shelskys are delicious! thank u! hope be back soon.
the internet was unusable for work, so we needed to invest in a 5g verizon internet system, but had a reasonable two months here otherwise. right next to central park and prime subway station.

the apartment is big, plenty of space. stove excessively dirty. it's good for an overnight only. there are no bed linens and two very used flat pillows. there were two bath towels which were in poor used condition. there was no tv as reported on the listing. allah said i could cancel if i didn't like it. however, it was 9pm, when we checked in and cold outside. we had nowhere to go. we stayed the next night also because there was no refund. stuck!
dream apartment! beautifully decorated and lovely location

very well located, clean and cozy! we enjoyed every minute of our stay und would definetly recommend kasa to everybody who‘s searching for an apartment in a really cool neighbourhood! thanks for everything!

we had a wonderful time at yochi's place. he was superkind, welcoming, and available. breakfast was great. checkin and checkout have been very easy. the apartment is spacious, cozy, very clean, quiet, and in a perfect spot in nyc. our stay in nyc could not have been better. highly recommended.

hugo and his mom mahgeritta(sp?) were friendly and helpful hosts. i felt welcome and was happy to make their acquaintance. the neighborhood is block off broadway on 134th which puts it in hamilton heights. lots of delis and good places to eat nearby. the subway station at 137th is about a five minute walk
willie’s place was fantastic. insanely clean and in a great location! will definitely be back should i be back in ny.

great home away from home in queens! we needed more space for our family and this definitely met all our expectations. lots of space inside and out, and the patio area was the perfect place to hang out. i think this is great for anyone visiting family or friends in queens but wants a peaceful and quiet oasis from the hustle and bustle of the city.
it was a great spot for easy access to the sights and very responsive host but it does have another space upstairs and the other guests were not quite or respectful.
great host! very responsive & helpful. would stay again.
good space great host definitely stay here

great place to stay in brooklyn. it was so cute and quiet. we love that it was only a few minute walk to the subway to get into manhattan. would definitely stay here again!
cheap accommodation for a few days in a very great spot!
perfect location, very close to subway stop. i had no issues with the stay, but during colder months the place can get quite cold. thankfully there are two heaters which help a lot!
clean, safe with a responsive host, great location, would stay here again.

we were so happy to visit linda & robert again, another terrific stay. as always, their home is comfortable and quiet, a welcome rest after a busy day out. transportation into manhattan is easy, the subway station is a short walk along the lively main st., and a bus stop is nearby the house. the variety of small shops along main st. is handy. note: this is a good choice for the solo traveler, being a family home in a residential neighbourhood. if i were travelling alone, i would find the walk home from the main st. subway a bit lonely at night, there is a bus stop just outside the station, the bus (q65? ask linda or robert for instructions) will take you almost to their doorstep. we have enjoyed this airbnb for almost ten years; this is our first visit since the pandemic, and everything was just as wonderful as we remembered. a++ jennifer & bill
all your basic needs are met. nothing fancy. pretty much an empty apartment. my mattress was extremely old, with noisy springs, but nevertheless, comfortable enough.
the apartment was exactly what we expected and we were very happy during our stay.

good deal for the price you pay. also great for solo travelers. everything was perfect except one night one gigantic cockroach was waiting for me in the room, but i guess nothing remarkable, welcome to new york!

yva’s home exceeded our expectations. it was the perfect size for my sister and i on a weekend trip. she was flexible with our late check in time after our bus got delayed. during our trip yva was gracious and kind. the space was super clean and comfortable. we appreciated the snacks and sodas that were included. :)
kimball was a great host!! everything was easily coordinated and i would definitely stay again!!!!
perfect location and stay, would definitely recommend & stay again!

shari's place felt like home the moment we got there. she and her husband were very welcoming and attentive to our needs. the apartment looks just like the pictures. the neighborhood is very lively and accessible. the design of the apartment is very thoughtful and cute. if we were to go back to nyc, we would stay here again!
great host, beautiful place!
great location to varies attractions and a block from central park.

ideal east village location. host enrique and kendall so helpful and friendly. really great hosts! home is a lovely nyc apartment in a well kept building on a tree lined street. for such a busy neighborhood, it was quite quiet. no outside city noise, something not easy to find in manhattan. the kitchen was modern and spotless. bathroom also very modern. great shower with plenty of hot water. i was amazed to find a heated toilet seat. in all my years of using airbnb for nyc stays that was a first. an unexpected comfort for sure! bedroom is in the back, far from street car traffic, and like i said, nice and quiet. i slept well after busy days, in what was a nice comfortable bed. could not have been more pleased with my stay. highly recommended.
the location of the place is amazing but to make things even better, the decor inside of the apartment is on point!!

perfect spot just steps from penn station and close to the subway. i stayed here with 4 kids and it was the perfect size for everyone to relax after a busy day sightseeing in the city. the doorman is great, elevator to the floor with the apt, so easy to get luggage/bags inside. such a treat to have a kitchenette when we stay in the city!
great place, good location, quiet apartment, nice room, had a great time.
nice studio space. it was clean and as described. host was very proactive with communication. i would stay here again.
great place in great location. we were x2 families travelling with 2 children per family and made it work.
it was very easy to navigate, and there were plenty of helpful people to assist you. the bathroom was always spotless and the space was very clean. access to the building was super easy at all hours.

my wife and i just spent a weekend in gary's place, and it was perfect -- the size, the amenities, the location. especially the location. his attention to detail and smart use of space is impressive. rent this place to experience what it's like to live in your own manhattan apartment. we'll be back!
everything was nice! quiet,clean place and very good price. thank you 😊
lovely hosts in a great location for us to visit family nearby. only issue for us was night street noise, especially on trash night. white noise machine is available, as are earplugs.
clean, modern, and comfortable space in proximity to downtown.
great place & they were super accommodating. would love to stay here again in the future
great location and wonderful spot!

we had a great time in nyc at treasure`s apartment. its very near to l line subway that goes directly to manhathans heart. it was all very clean and cozy. theres no more flies at the apartment. me and my family recommends treasure`s apartment.

great stay at mandi’s place. everything was easy and efficient. great location and we enjoyed our stay. mandi checked on us to make sure everything was going well.

great property and location!! we immediately settled in and it felt like home! the beds, pillows and sheets were so comfortable, we slept great every night! the appliances were really top of the line, we cooked in every night (covid) which made it really easy and fun for dinner. the projector and apple tv were very easy to use when we did want some time to catch up on some shows while it rained. neighborhood was very nice and plenty of stores within walking distance. i would highly recommend the property! jules and michelle are great to work with, they were very prompt in responses and accommodating!

thank you for everything, we had a great time, sharon is a great host, everything we needed was there for us, whatever we asked for answered immediately, the house was very clean and the location was very comfortable. i definately recommend this place and sure i wil stay there the next time i'll visit ny.
daniels place is definitely worth for especially 4+ people. he was very communicative and friendly. will definitely recommend 👍

being a solo female traveler can be tricky, but derek did everything he could to help me feel comfortable and welcome. the room was clean, he was super accommodating about my pet cat who came with me, and he was really responsive when my plans had to change. i highly recommend!

this apartment is spacious and very quiet, a lovely surprise all in all. we've never found a rental in nyc with two bathrooms and a full kitchen for this price. the location was perfect for us, and we never heard the neighbors at all. there were even some holiday decorations, which was a nice bonus. the lockbox really made checking in a breeze. would definitely rent again!

looks as is in picture , very clean and the host is super understanding.

the unit is adorable. the host is friendly, respectful and professional. the unit provided a unique and comfortable home base for my excursions all over the city. a nearby bus route will take you to flushing main street, where both subway and train can take you into manhattan. if you dont. mind getting around at a leisurely pace the savings compared to a luxury hotel in manhattan are astronomical. also, staying in a picturesque middle class house in the burroughs and riding the subways is experiencing new york with an immediacy that you will never get spending $300 a day more on 5th avenue. and if you walk over to the river, the sunsets over the city are breath taking.

a little gem of a place in the heart of brooklyn’s classic brownstone streets. we loved just ambling around the immediate neighbourhood as it was peaceful compared to manhattan (which can be reached super quickly via hoyt subway) and full of great places to eat and drink.

fabulous! the location is amazing. it’s an easy walk to central park, times square and subway line. there are plenty of restaurants, delis, and shops for your convenience. the apartment is beautiful and clean with fantastic amenities.

beautiful space in a great location and rose was very responsive in her communication. the internet went out the second day i was there and she tried to resolve it but it was a bigger problem than could be resolved during my stay but otherwise everything was great - i had a wonderful stay in a lovely apartment in a great area. astoria park right across the street with wonderful greek restaurants within walking distances. i felt safe and even took the ferry to downtown area and saw a broadway musical. i would definitely love to stay at rose’s place again next time i visit.
it was amazing. it’s very quiet
we enjoyed our stay at dorothy’s! the location was excellent, with plenty to do in the area, and it was easy to take the nearby train or bus into the city. i would highly recommend staying here.
we loved the space! close to the van siclen subway, had everything we needed, and was so clean. as hosts, they were helpful and communicative. great stay, thank you.

i very much enjoyed my stay. the place was very clean and cozy. i found it to be a good base location, i was able to catch the bus and train fairly easily. there are really local own food places and groceries/corner stores within walking distance. my favorite thing was to visit the chinese carryout about a two minute walk away. there is a seems to be a caribbean population in the area and the shops around there shows, which i found really nice because i felt right at home. 10/10 recommend, and the next time in the city i will definitely safe here again.

place was extremely nice and clean and manuel was there for help whenever you needed anything. it was very peaceful and private during my stay which couldn’t make it any better. neighborhood was very nice as well i would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place.

beautiful apartment in a great location in brooklyn. the only complaint is that there are only two king beds and if people are not willing to share a bed, a party of 3 will have to use the couch as i did which is not very comfortable.

she was a really nice person:) she tried to make us comfortable and always provide coffee and some breads. the room was spaceful and good for 3 people! and it is really good location. you can take transportation right in front of the house. it was a good experience!

this was our first experience using airbnb and based on this trip, not our last. atsuko's place was perfect for our needs. easily accommodated 3 of us and in close proximity to our son's apartment (we were helping him move). the place was as portrayed in the description/photos and very clean with all the amenities . it was a little humid in brooklyn during our stay, so the multiple air conditioners and fans were much appreciated. i had a bit of an issue trying to access the entryway numeric door lock, so perhaps a small motion-detector light would help us old guys with old eyes (although the numeric keypad did light up when you pressed the 1st button). in all cases both atsuko & peter were very responsive about answering questions. since i'm new to airbnb, i didn't realize that atsuko includes an online guide to the area which would've been helpful for us. of course i also missed the printed guide that was stashed behind some local maps on a wall shelf...rookie move on my part.

the stay was great. it’s so close from the metro station that goes direct to manathan. for me the small weak point is that it is not a kitchen and that the only water point is in the bathroom. even if the accommodation is used as a place to sleep it is just perfect and big. the shower is great!!

exactly as described. i was extremely satisfied with my one-night stay at rosy’s place. what a friendly woman she is! the place was spotless, and the neighborhood felt very friendly and safe. this is now going to be my go-to place for a quick stay in new york. i was 10 minutes from the lga airport, which made things so easy! highly recommended!

david and janet’s place was beautiful and so well thought of. we were two adults and two children, and even though the place is small we were happy and very comfortable. every detail was in the right place. we felt at home immediately. the neighborhood is also great location.

we had an awesome stay!! it's a very cozy and stylish home, and most importantly spotless clean! it has all the amenities you need. very convenient location with nice restaurants, convenience stores and coffee shops. communication with edna and isaiah was fast and easy as well as check-in! would definitely stay here again 100% recommend!!
great place! very close to the subway and whole foods!

we stayed here for 3 months and really enjoyed our stay. the hosts and super were very responsive and the apartment was as expected. it was really easy to get to downtown because the subway was very close by. we would recommend this apartment to everyone.
nice, quiet neighborhood, but the subway and plenty of great restaurants were within a few minutes walk... apartment was cozy and the cleanest place i've stayed in nyc... great experience!

the stay was great. very nice hosts, great communication and a good area. the accommodation is well connected to manhattan (about 45-50 minutes without changing trains). jfk airport is also very quick and easy to get to. if we are in new york again, we would love to come back. a clear recommendation!

the apartment is as shown -- small by typical standards but spacious by nyc standards. anita was nice. she had water etc in fridge for us. the only negative is the amount of street noise we experienced on one of the two nights we were there.

we had a fantastic time in new york with martha and pat. our journey started with a disaster, we had to change our flight and when we finally arrived our luggage wasn't there. but when we arrived at martha's and pat's lovely home we immediately forgot all our trouble and despair. they made us feel welcome and at home from the very beginning, gave us everything we needed and even more. it was no problem to survive four days without our luggage as we had met the most generous and warmhearted people ever. martha's and pat's house is a beautiful place decorated with love to the detail, pat's breakfast was more than delicious, we're still dreaming of his wonderful pancakes. we will never forget our stay in new york because of martha and pat and would love to come back one day. thank you so much for everything :-) marcia, burkhard and caio.

it’s a great place! very comfy and clean. jennifer provided all the necessary information needed for the check in/out. if it was worth the money paid is probably controversial. it is def expensive but it is manhattan 🤷🏽‍♂️

elie’s apartment is on a relatively quiet city street for nyc and walkable to all the main sights and/or the subway is very nearby. the apartment is modern with contemporary fittings, it feels like a converted office building, and is pretty spacious given the location. the furnishings in the living room don’t match the photos, but are adequate, we’d have preferred the large sofa featured. the beds are comfy and the bathroom has a good shower. one bedroom is at the back and really quite quiet and cool with the ac, the bedroom at the front does get some city noise, nothing too crazy if you are used to living in a city. i’d recommend staying here for a spacious 2 bed base to explore the city.
good transport links. lots of friendly recommendations from sheena & lots to do in the local area. very busy and safe neighbourhood. would 100% stay at again.
christina is a good personable host, and her space is very comfortable and homey in a new york kind of way. everything about my visit worked perfectly.

i had a great time while i stayed at irfan’s home. he’s a kind and easy to communicate with if you need to get in contact. i felt comfortable and at home. the best part was the do-able 15 minute walk to brighton beach.

100% to descriptions and other positive reviews this was a perfect place for us to stay to visit old friends in the area after moving away in 2019. place is clean and matched the photos exactly and nice touches for guests. highly recommend.

nice apartments, very comfortable bed,really beautiful backyard.really close to subway and manhattan. guillermo is very friendly, we highly recommended to stay here.

chunsien is a very kind and friendly person, you can ask him everything you need and he will always be ready to aswer you with a smile. the house is cozy and the room is very clean, the neighborhood in which it is located is very quiet and peaceful. i recommend it and i would gladly return.

absolutely stellar location that's easily accessible by multiple trains. a quick and direct trip to several major sites you may want to see around the city, and it's surrounded by great culture and amazing restaurants. there's also a whole foods a five to ten minute walk away in case you need anything!

first of all, liudmila is a great person, very attentive, kind and always tries to help you, she also makes very good recommendations. the room is excellent: clean, good a/c, comfortable, i would definitely go back. the location is favorable; close to subway stations, restaurants, and it is quiet. i highly recommend it.

this place is great, a clean quiet haven in a busy city. close to the subway and stores, with the great ambience of little haiti around the corner. george is very accommodating and an excellent communicator. recommended.
the place was quiet and clean, i appreciated that everything i needed was there or nearby. ayanna even gave me a caribbean holla. thank you.
brian has a very nice apartment. and he is a professional host. give us a lot of recommendations which is very useful. hope to live his apartment once again in the future.
nice place. very accommodating host!

had a great stay at reut’s place! great location near the water and close to good food. reut is extremely friendly and responsive. the place is very clean and modern. highly recommend!

jeannie and everett were the perfect hosts! the apartment was so nice and clean, good location to get around! would highly recommend, they even provided us with umbrellas in the rain! thank you for making us so welcome!

kakuna is an amazing host with a wonderful location to make your home base while in town. clean, quiet, with a private entrance right off the street. i couldn't have asked for a more perfect place to stay.
i had such an amazing time! everything was exactly like in the description and everyone was so friendly!

cesar's apartment is very clean and nice. they are also very quiet and respectful. i enjoyed my time here and recommend staying here. the one thing i feel inclined to clarify is that the room has two twin sized beds that are pushed together. i didn't mind as i was the only one staying, but couples looking to stay may want to consider this.

the apartment was perfect for our very 1st time traveling to n.y. it was close to little shops and places to eat within a few blocks. a laundry place down around the corner to wash our clothes, a short walk to dunkin donuts for breakfast, and coffee. comes with 1 parking spot around the back which is nice and street parking if you have another car. pol and his daughter were very nice and made us feel comfortable during our stay. great communication and value!
fantastic surprise, in a charming quiet green neighborhood, friendly warm people and superb peaceful room with everything needed for a relaxing stay. hostess very kid and helpful too!
wonderful for our daughter’s wedding week. 💕

great place to stay. location is easy to get from place to place. environment is more calm and quiet. at the same time, couple of minutes away from the vibrant flushing area. overall, i enjoyed the stay

i enjoyed every minute of my month long stay at beverly's place. the apartment is on the top floor of an authentic bed-stuy brownstone. the space is very welcoming and a wonderful space for creative work and relaxation. it's located on a quiet street in bed stuy with quick access to the train, you can be in manhattan in 25/30 minutes. the area itself is safe and friendly, with a good selection of coffee shops, bars, grocery stores, and restaurants. beverly has made lots of effort to make the apartment feel homely and inviting for guests. the kitchen was well equipped with everything i needed to cook for myself. any questions i had, beverly was super helpful and provided some great tips on where to eat and drink in the local area. if you're looking to experience the 'real side' of nyc, and still be within a short commute to manhattan, then i couldn't recommend beverly's place enough.

tochi’s spot is always feeling like home. aside from it being spotless, i felt very relaxed and calm to be staying at the spot alone. this isn’t my first time staying there but it is a true home away from home. thank you tochi! 😃
wanye’s place was so homely and comfortable , stylish love the way the home is decorated . i enjoyed my stay and definitely would recommend staying here . i’ll be planning a trip here again 👍

liza is friendly and easy to communicate with. the apartment is centrally located in brooklyn so we should have probably expected this but there was a lot of street noise well into the night even on week days. another thing to note: the layout of the apartment is a bit unusual. basically all the rooms are in a row with the kitchen / bathroom first, then each of the bedrooms, and then the living room. this meant we had to go quietly through the room my baby was sleeping in when we needed to use the bathroom which woke him up every single time (to be fair, he's a light sleeper but this was pretty frustrating). there is an option to go out a back door and enter back into the apartment's front door but that door is quite loud so that woke my baby up too.

jessica was a wonderful host. i came in pretty late at night and she stayed up to make sure she was available to greet me, which i appreciated greatly. her apartment is quaint and tidy and i would love to stay here again should the opportunity arise. thanks jess for everything!
always a pleasure staying here i really feel at home

rj was very helpful and responsive. great location that is the perfect balance of tucked away and quiet but easy access to the nyc hustle and bustle :) other airbnbs i've stayed at in manhattan have a lot of noise and it is hard to relax/sleep, but with this apartment that was absolutely not the case. with the subway i was able to get to greenwich village/manhattan in under 30 minutes on a busy friday afternoon. the apartment itself was very easy to find with rj's directions, and very cozy but the perfect sized space for 2 people. clean and well-kept. thank you so much rj!!!
the apartment matched the description. many good restaurants and cafés in the area and within walking distance of the subway.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
sebastiane was a great host - awesome location and lovely stay.

monica is very helpful great hostess we enjoyed our stay. clean, cozy apt. in hell’s kitchen great restaurants. all amenities included. bed was comfy. awesome experience new years eve 2019 in town square. thanks again monica!

good location. tiny hotel room. can hear other guests full conversations and even them having intercourse. in the end i paid about $1k for 3 nights in a very, very small space, with no view & loud neighbors. i know it’s nyc but goodness, it really wasn’t worth the price. the maid kept coming in to make our bed. that was nice.

staying at darra’s place was a highlight of my time in new york! she is a thoughtful and communicative host. she was understanding of my delayed arrival time and accommodated all my needs throughout the trip. darra made it a point to give tailored recommendations for the neighborhood, which is the perfect, central home base for exploring the city. the apartment was also conveniently connected to the subway. the space is well-appointed, airy and bright. i’m so grateful to have found this les gem and highly recommend experiencing new york with darra’s place as a starting point.
chrissy and her sister were quick to respond and very helpful with any request. the space and location were perfect for us visiting our children.

the apartment is right in the heart of little italy on mulberry street — super lively, lots of people, and very loud pretty much all day and night. if you’re a light sleeper, definitely keep that in mind. the location is great though, easy walking distance to soho, bowery, and chinatown. the place has the basics and nothing more. we were working remotely and unfortunately the wifi was really bad — we had to rely on our phone hotspots or head to a nearby starbucks to get work done. for the price, i wish it was a bit nicer (the futon couch is really uncomfortable), but the main bedroom and bathroom are both spacious and get plenty of natural light. overall, it’s fine if you just need a place to crash in a great location.

this was an amazing home in a great part of brooklyn. nicole was fantastic with her communication and helped make the stay incredibly memorable. the apartment itself is beautiful, very quiet and a very good size. we were able to walk to most spots and really enjoyed getting to know the neighborhood. we'll certainly be back when travels take us back to brooklyn!
excellent location! evelyn was very quick with communication and has thorough, great recommendations for the area. would recommend

host is the greatest! feel like yr at home! everything was as described. great view. beautiful neighborhood. peaceful. recommend. i will be staying again! thanks ms b for being a great/beautiful soul.

a perfect stay! i hope to return and book again every time i visit nyc. i loved the neighborhood and really enjoyed being a little further out , as opposed to being in the heart of manhattan. very easily accesible. quick train ride and a short walk. i 100% recommend!

our stay was good aside from a few hiccups. my biggest issue would be the transparency with renovations taking place during the time of our stay. we were unaware, which i feel was not okay. we were there to explore so thankfully majority of time was spent out and about. i would recommend.
john was a great host, and the location was perfect for our activities. we’ll plan to come back the next time we visit brooklyn.

we stayed here with 3 young kids in aug 2023 and had a wonderful trip. the apartment is beautiful, the kids loved sleeping in the bunk beds and the swimming pool in the garden was a hit! great location - close to the subway and 40 mins from central manhattan. great local shops and tim was really accommodating. we fully recommend.

if you’re looking to stay at a place in nyc, this is the place for you! my friends and i enjoyed our stay at nadine’s place. it’s 100% accurate as described, stylish and clean! there are grocery stores, coffee shops, and restaurants within walking distance. the subway is accessible. nadine is a fantastic host. thank you for your hospitality, and we’ll come back again!

we stayed at roman's apartment for 10 days, combining work and vacation time. this is an awsome place. clean, comfortable and within walking distance of the beach. roman offered beach cheirs and towels we really liked the location; the area was quiet and exactly what we were looking for. lots of places for food , bar, restaurants, grocery stores and whatever was nearby. registration was very easy with the code key. the internet connection was great and there was enough space for 2 people to work. the air conditioner works very well and quiet. the kitchen is fully equipped and we love to dine al fresco. near the house there is a table and chairs, very comfortable. the host made sure we enjoyed our stay here. we will definitely return and highly recommend. matt and veronica

very cute little place! bed was small for two people but comfortable. great value for what you get but surrounding area can be loud and at times felt unsafe. short subway ride or uber from most nyc hot spots.
jason is a very kind host. the location of this spot is perfect and central in the city.

eric & justin are marvellous hosts, and the place was beautifully laid out with lots of thoughtful touches. the location is an easy walk from the subway, and we had a great time exploring brooklyn and manhattan.
great place to stay in brooklyn
great place to relax and feel at home

it was easy to find the hotel and it was in a busy, central location with lots of amazing stores and restaurants. the hotel room is a bit outdated, but an amazing view from the room window to see the beautiful time square plaza. the employees were very kind and the check-in and check-out process was very easy. the room was cleaned daily by the kind staff and i really appreciate their attention to detail. overall, the stay was very nice and i recommend it, especially to first timers to the city.

my boyfriend and i had the best time in this apartment! the location is amazing and james makes sure that you have everything you need in the flat. i would definitely recommend this flat if you go to visit new york!

the host: friendly and hospitable, responsive to all the needs i had no matter that was too small. location: centrally located, under 25 min commute to edison new jersey, 1 hr to manhattan. connecting ferry routes to manhattan and other buroughs is another fun way to get around and explore. cvs is a 2 min walk to the end of the street. frank and sals supermarket is a 3-4 min walk. 2 gas stations are a 1 min drive. dunkin’ donuts and local bodega is a 2-3 min walk. local water side park 2-3 min drive. great eats: i’m a foodie so i enjoyed the local eats. frank and sals italian market for freshly made mozzarella and aged t bones. pizzeria giovie in new dorp. other notable mentions in new dorp: stu for hot pot( spicy chicken broth with bass fish fillet and ramen with veggies and tofu) , vivi bubble tea and prince tea house. giuliana’s italian restaurant within walking distance. bagels r us. safe neighborhood, great for long term stays especially with pets, parking in front of house.
amazing stay and great host, definitely recommend!

i wish i could write a better review. the location was great, the price was pretty decent, and everyone we interacted with were, at some level, very friendly. however, the biggest issue was that the airbnb listing 100% said the room had a king-sized bed in it, and it absolutely only had a full bed. the size of the bed was a big feature in picking the room. after getting into the room and realizing this, i went to the front desk, who were fairly stand-off-ish and didn't seem understanding or all that eager to do anything about it (hotel was full, but no offer of partial refund, etc.). moreover, they claimed it was a queen bed anyway (it was not, we had a sewing tape measure handy), and that a queen bed was bigger than a king! airbnb co-host initially seemed friendly too, but was not very proactive at all in trying to resolve the issue either. if you're ok with whichever room/bed you get after booking, and ok with poor help if you run into issue, this could be the place for you!
the accommodation is so clean and new. most importantly, the host lee and teri are so nice and always helpful!! it’s easy to find good reasonable restaurant around.
this was the perfect place for my friends and i to stay while here for a concert. it was perfectly located close to subway stations to go into the city as well. staff was always friendly and helpful.

i was just in nyc with a friend for a week and we felt very comfortable in shayla's apartment. right next to the house are two great breakfast stores, a 24/7 mini market and the subway is only a 5 minute walk away. the apartment was equipped with everything we needed and there was even a free selection of drinks in the fridge when we arrived. so everything was great and we will definitely recommend the apartment to others. thanks again shayla! jan & lara

i warmly recommend ainslie's accommodation. firstly, because of john and ainslie's warm welcome and attention. secondly, because the accommodation is a super cocoon within their home, very pleasant and comfortable. finally, it's so nice to be able to enjoy the tranquility of brooklyn while being just a few minutes' walk from the subway for quick access to all the boroughs of ny. thank you so much!
had an amazing stay at this lovely apartment. noelky was a great host and was in frequent contact if we needed anything. will book again!

roger’s clear guidance, the excellent location, and the cleanliness of the room were truly outstanding. however, i would have appreciated knowing in advance that the washing machine and dryer were unavailable, as it could have affected how i prepared clothing for the trip. that said, it was still a wonderful stay overall. thank you!
great stay with natalie! super understanding and responsive host throughout our stay in new york. would definitely recommend :)
clean and cozy . quiet neighborhood with easy access to train.

had a really good stay here. anyone who says this room is small has never stayed anywhere in new york, especially manhattan. it's a good sized room in any city and positively big for new york. it was clean, bathroom was good, and the pictures accurately show the place. it's right in the middle of midtown, just a block from the subway station and you could walk up to times square easily enough if you wanted to
i had a great stay at andrew! thank you !

the bedroom is extremely comfortable with a large bed and soft pillows. it felt like a cool refuge during the humid summer months. elene was helpful and responsive to my needs and questions. she was also kind enough to inform me when i left a personal bag after checking out. she was flexible enough to allow time for me to retrieve it, even though it was already evening time.
great room for the price. hosts were great at communication

the place was immaculate and just beautiful 😁 the perfect ending each day after traipsing around the city!! the furniture was comfortable too which is something i always look for so we can feel like it’s a home away from home. absolutely recommend!!
very spacious apartment well equipped and nearby subway station
good host , always responded and very respectful. great interior design , beautiful backyard, very soft beds and heated bathroom floor
great place, would go back and very close to the subway into manhattan
it was lovely and peaceful!

we stayed in sonias apartment for one month and were happy with our stay. sonia was very friendly and a good host. the house is located close to a subwaystation (2min walk) which made the commute in and out of the city easy. we were provided with things like toiletpaper, dish soap and clean towels throughout our stay. recomend this place!

we stayed in nyc over new year 2017/18. we were pleased to find such a convenient location for our family of 5 at a reasonable rate. the apartment is in an unmodernised 1930's building with steam-heated radiators which work efficiently but noisily at random times (night and day) and although there is plenty of hot water in the bathroom, facilities are quite basic. the overhead subway line is really close and there are plenty of restaurants and grocery stores nearby. we appreciated the convenience, space and flexibility of staying here, with special thanks to sen who welcomed us, and enabled a later check-out time.
love it! i feel like home.
a wonderful place to stay-super clean, great host, great location. we hope to return <3

i went to ny for business and stayed here because i was tired of hotels.. pictures do not do this justice. if you are looking for a quiet get away minutes from everything ny has to offer, this is perfect. very clean. very quiet. very comfortable. it feels like a "home away from home". if that doesn't convince you, just talk to delores one time. she is an absolutely phenomenal human being. very pleasant and eager to help. she has great energy. i will be coming back.
emmanuel was helpful and friendly from the get go. he tried his best to accommodate us as much as possible.
perfect location close to madison square garden and the train station.
best place ever. very quiet neighborhood. lovely hosts. would definitely stay again. everything was accurate. the place looked exactly like the pictures. had the best time ever
great spot! would absolutely stay here again!

teresa offers an outstanding value in a city that has high prices. the room was quiet and clean and i felt right at home. if you are looking to save money without sacrificing quality, her room is right for you.
excellent find! adam was very accommodating and responsive. the unit is well equipped, clean and comfortable. we’ll definitely stay again on future visits to brooklyn

we were the first guests at beverly's comfortable 3rd floor apartment! the apartment was just as described. it's clean, spacious for 2, with an extra bed in a side-bedroom next to master bedroom. beverly took care of our needs promptly. the apartment is also not far from the subway station. there are many nice restaurants in the neighborhood that beverly recommended to us. we would recommend this apartment for short stay in brooklyn.

nice place to stay for a few days. easy check in—not too much noise, especially for ny. apartment temperatures are variable. depending on the season, i would suggest bringing suitable clothing to keep warm. close to the manhattan. local restaurants for delivery with vegan friendly options.

a wonderful stay, and a great price for something so conveniently located in nyc! fatou was flexible with us checking in later than we had initially stated when booking. their home was really cozy and peaceful. the beds were comfortable, the bathroom was clean. and having access to the kitchen was a huge plus! thank you for a great stay, fatou :)

mahmood are very good host, friendly and hospitable. good location close to bus stop, half an hour walk to ferry, close to beautiful snug harbor park. the room and bathroom are clean, comfortable bed, clean bed linen and towels, you can use the kitchen. recommend.

if you don't book this, you will be disappointed. lucas is an amazing person with a beautiful home. i loved my stay. i only wish i could have stayed longer or forever... hahahaha. thank you lucas for opening your clean home and being so hospitable. great location and stay!!

loved loved loved this place. i can’t express how beautiful and peaceful this place was. talk about smart house ! everything was top tier! i want whoever was the interior designer to come do my house lol ! 😂 10/10
the apartment is correct, clean, quiet. the neighborhood feels safe, and it is not to far from bushwick and williamsburg. i would recommend this place to anyone, i had a great time in nyc.
need to approve a lot, not satisfied for the first time from airbnb during these four years.
we had fantastic experience staying at emilie's place it perfectly fits columbia students

we had a really good time at bradys! the house and the room was really nice and clean. the location was good, just a 10 minute walk to the subway. i hardly recommend this airbnb and i definitely would book it again!

we had a wonderful stay at the house of tony torn and his family. as we arrived very late (1.45 am)in a blizzard we were worried about how to get in the house, but there was a warm welcome. the room is large with a garden view and the bathroom is so nice. you can shower together while sitting in a quarter round large tub. i can't explain but you have to try it! the house is quite big and there is a lot going on. the last night we fell asleep while listening to the sound of a beautiful choir. it is like being in the middle of the culture of new york. i myself had an artshow in the agora gallery in chelsea which was wonderful, but i am glad that they advised us to try the airbnb website to find a place close to the gallery. this added to quite an experience!

brando’s apt was excelent. the apartment was near madison square garden, empire state building and a few blocks from times square. the accomodations were excelent and brando was very helpful. i definetely recomend his apartment.
thank you ! i had a good stay.
this host is a scammer. completely unresponsive. on the day of check-in, the apartment entrance didn't match the photos. i had to book another listing that same day to find a place to stay.
very clean and easy check-in! it was a convenient location and friendly staff. i would recommend for a couple wanting to explore nyc! i am definitely coming back to enjoy their bar and restaurant.

it's a nice little place where we were happy to spend our time, my girlfriend also wanted to stay forever wow! the instructions were really easy and short. mohammed is a good host, i invite you to visit guys ...

heather’s place was me and my friends’ home in nyc during our trip. this was our first international trip together, and it was memorable thanks to our amazing host. her place was literally “home.” you can find everything you need, and she was willing to help any small requests to make the guests feel comfy. all rooms, amenities, bath rooms were clean with spacious place. location was amazing in terms of both neighborhood and transportation. i would say that this will be perfect for family or group trip. i would love to re-visit heather’s place for my next trip. i really hope that she also has a place for 1-2 guests so that i can reserve that venue!

very pleased with our stay here. no issues with the contactless check in. room was nice and clean. the rooftop was an awesome bonus, providing a gorgeous view of the city. my personal favorite feature was its location. highly recommend this place!
i had a great time staying with aleksandra. great accommodation! can recommend.
this was a perfect place to stay for nyc marathon weekend! incredible central location, claude had great tips for getting around and eating out.

frederick's apartment was the perfect retreat from my busy stay in the city. from well curated art and book collections to an incredibly comfortable bed and perfect linens, i was absolutely at home. the location is convenient to beautiful prospect park and the brooklyn botanical gardens, as well as the f train and a number of delicious restaurants. the neighborhood felt safe and was a (much needed) quiet oasis in contrast to the bustle of manhattan. i highly recommend this spot, especially if you're visiting alone.

sarah was a great host & she went out of her way to accommodate us & we really appreciate that. we were awakened every morning by running & walking back & fourth. i didn’t like that our bedding wasn’t clean to my liking stains on some of the linen. also and having to take out the garbage when we were charged a cleaning fee. other than that the stay was perfect.
such a fabulous place and location. absolutely loved it.

vanessa was a great host! not only was the space incredible and very instagram worthy, she put so many amazing touches into the space and went above and beyond by surprising us with cupcakes! she was super quick to answer any questions. we will be back for sure!
no pool service, not much equipment available in the gym, no lunch service. i love the fact that there was many options of parking available, kids friendly, and peaceful!
the entire team were very professional, honest, helpful and very responsive- i would give this unit this management a 10 out of 10 rating.

roberts place was amazing! two large bedrooms with storage and very comfy beds! everything was sparkling clean and all the appliances you need - plus laundry! very easy access and close to restaurants and transportation! the pack & play and high chair, plus all the dishes and appliances made our stay very comfortable! excellent communication and very helpful hosts!
comfortable space in a fantastic location. a great spot if you need a simple place to recharge whilst exploring nyc. would stay again!

i stayed in the apartment for a month. and i really appreciate : the localisation is perfect with a lot a subway’s stations. very easy to go to manhattan and also to the other neighborhoods of brooklyn. restaurants, movies theaters… everything within walking distance. and ricky is very responsive and helpful. i recommend this place.

matthew was a great host and this was a super space. check in was easy, location was very close to everything, lots of local tips were provided, the space was clean and attractive and plenty of room for my husband and i. matthew was very kind to let us check in a bit early and check out a bit late to accommodate our travel plans. would definitely recommend this to a singleton or couple looking to stay in the center of a great neighborhood in the heart of the city.

this was my first time using airbnb and wasn't sure what to expect, but i have to say that it couldn't have been a better experience. daniel and his mum were very welcoming, friendly and helpful, and i would highly recommend this to anyone visiting nyc. the apartment was clean and had a good sized bed. the neighbourhood was fine with everything you could possibly need (supermarket, laundry, restaurants, bars, shops, subway station) only a few minutes walk away. i worked in manhattan and it took ~20 minutes to get there on the subway. thanks for such an enjoyable trip!
really nice space and really good responsive host! everything was really easy to find and the internet tv was a great touch! can’t go wrong with this space

this location was pretty basic, no frills and not many amenities. it’s set up with several bedrooms, dorm style, with one shared bathroom. the place was quite warm and smelled musty, but luckily there was an ac unit in the bedroom. the bed was not very comfortable, i could feel the springs and the pillows were flat. i did not sleep well at all. the bathroom had some shared shampoo/conditioner, but not much else. i was looking for a first aid kit for some bandaids and couldn’t find any. it was ok for one night, the location is pretty close to jfk airport so if you need convenience and aren’t picky, it would be fine.
small but cute, good light, very lively and young neighborhood.

this is a great spot. we were able to check in early and it was so easy and quick! the host was very responsive and we had everything we needed. the hotel is in a great spot and super clean. we would definitely stay here again!
if you're just looking for a place to sleep and shower while you're in nyc this is a great place. priced great and less than 2 blocks from msg! will absolutely book again in the future!

sean and ingrid were great! sean arranged my booking and worked with me to still be able to stay even though i arrived many hours later than expected. i was greeted when i finally did arrive by ingrid, who is a wonderful host. she is very kind, warm, and inviting. although i didn't stay long we had a really nice conversation over morning coffee before i had to go to the airport, and i hope to have a chance to stay here again the next time i am visiting. highly recommended!

very clean room and apartment space that looks like the photos. bodrul was flexible with me checking in around 7pm and was also very friendly and thorough in showing me everything that was available to me, including the kitchen. cereal, fresh bananas, milk, coffee, and tea were kindly offered for breakfast (or anytime). tv, wifi, a/c, fridge, and microwave in the room. comfortable stay.

the appartment of deirdre was clean, comfortable and in an intresting neighbourhood. right around the corner there is a laundry, right beside that a nice cafe to hang around during the laundry. to explore brooklyn it is a good place to stay. also to got to the city it is easy to get there. concerning the check in and out - it is easy once you get to the appartment. for me it worked out well, following the instructions. i didn't need any further help, but deirdre was in touch via mail/mobile for any cases.

regiane was always very responsive and friendly. her assistant was waiting for us at check in and even helped us with our luggage. the location is incredible!! thank you for a wonderful 6 week stay in the big apple!
very good stay at chris, love the cats and very comfy and clean apartment, chris is very nice and responsive. direct subway to manhattan 10 minutes away.
great spot, walking distance to everything. brian is a great host. the place was clean and comfy.

marlyn and hollis were wonderful hosts. they made us welcome and shared delicious fruit from their immaculately maintained yard. this has been one of the best airbnb's we've ever stayed at! the home had everything we needed from comfy beds to towels and a great living space to enjoy when we were tired from exploring nyc. the pictures in the listing don't do this home justice. it is very nice and well maintained. hollis and marlyn have thought about many details including having fresh flowers in the home when we arrived. i had some concern at first about how far we were from the manhattan but the l train is super convenient and runs often with lots of connection points and service directly to the city. i will definitely visit again!
beautiful hotel. staff super friendly. room was clean. perfect location as it is walking distance to everything.
giovanni's place was very convenient to our son's apartment, so we would stay there again in the future.
we had a great time in nyc last weekend and seith’s place is just as described. very easy and convenient. great location, safe and comfortable.

with two daughters living not far from the airbnb, this was the perfect spot to be. the apartment was cozy with a very comfy bed and soft linens and towels. lots of restaurant options, groceries, and shops within walking distance. the train into the city was easily accessible and a quick jaunt into manhattan. excellent communication with the host and entry and departure went smoothly. i expect to stay here again in the future.
spacious, clean, ready with a recommendation. great parking in the area and could not be better for f train accessibility!
it definitely felt like a home away from home.! looking forward to going back

alina & seth’s airbnb was great. check in was super easy. location was perfect, 2 minute walk from astoria park and close to many restaurants. the place was private, clean, had everything you could need (extra bedding, toiletries, cooking supplies, washer and dryer). thanks for the stay, this airbnb is a gem

sammy's place was clean, lots of space, nice & comfy! amazing location!! close to the train, restaurants etc. good communication. easy check in/out. everything as described. would stay again. highly recommend.
super cute apartment! very stylish, great location and friendly host.
the place is convenient. there's a supermarket near the house(open til 11pm)
great central location. helpful staff.

labeat’s apartment is located in the fun turtle bay neighborhood very walkable, lots of restaurants, bars, street fruit /flower markets & cvs. public transportation up on lexington to all over the city. 6 streets up to the tram to roosevelt island felt very safe. the apartment is very stylish & comfortable too, he has thought of all your needs. we dined out a lot yet the kitchen was well appointed, we enjoyed morning coffee & blended fruit protein drink. don’t hesitate to book this location. thank you again for a great stay!!

great location and easy check in. but we had to buy the garbage bags and kitchen towels. the worst things were cockroaches and the smell of the sewage from the bathroom drain and toilet bowl. check out was easy, too.
great location, good for family of 3.

mario’s apartment was incredibly convenient of a walk from penn station. we were thoroughly impressed not only with the cleanliness of the apartment but also the updated smart technology throughout the entire place. mario was also such a cordial and responsive host. my family and i highly recommend him!
the space is very well maintained, and the hosts are very responsive and eager to do what they can to improve your stay.
a bit far from the train station specially if you consider the fact that its all uphill . bed was a little on the stiff side . other than that the place is perfect and the host is very nice person
i had a great time.

this airbnb is awesome. it was clean, easy to find, and in a pretty secure neighborhood. sheila was friendly and prompt. she lives on the property so if you need her shes there. thank you for an amazing, clean, little airbnb!

envinne was a great host. she was ver friendly and helpful. we arrived by car at night and she came outside to identify her house and even helped with a problem with our car. she also brought us a keurig machine that we requested. everything was perfect for two nights and the location was a short drive to the us open andy salerno

mark is a great host. our experience right after we landed (and we landed way before our check-in) till we checked out was top notch. mark helped us with our bags in his own living space until our room was ready to check-in. he even helped us with spare umbrella as it rained a lot during our stay. his books and newspaper articles for reference to experience the city helped us gain some new perspective of the city (we would have never visited green-wood cemetery otherwise). the space is clean and comfortable and has easy access to anywhere in new york/brooklyn as carroll st for local is 5min walk from his place. overall, i would highly recommend his place.

i stayed at ryan and lauren's apartment for a few days with my husband, children and parents in law. the location was great for a family like ours - a nice, quiet neighborhood with all the amenities you need within a walking distance, and only a short subway ride to downtown. the apartment itself is absolutely wonderful, clean and comfortable. would definitely recommend!
the apartment is at a fantastic location and looking at the price i paid it's well worth it.

rafael was a great and considerate host. his place is very close to the grand av newtown subway station. it is a short walk to the queens place and queens center shopping malls, and it is not too far from laguardia airport by public transit.
joseph's place was great. communication was great, and the place was about 5 min or less walking distance to the train.

while she did respond quickly to messages, the fact that she herself does not live in new york meant she had to rely on others to fix issues when they came up which would sometimes mean having to wait a bit for things to be resolved. the apartment was okay it terms of cleanliness but nothing to write home about. the location was pretty good as it’s just a short walk from the subway, a grocery store and other things you might need. in summary i think it was an okay place to stay at for 3 months and everything was tolerable but if i were to comeback to nyc for another 3 months i would probably choose a different place.
amazingly quick to respond and super flexible with check ins. the space is very inviting, and everything was nice and clean!
jason’s place was super clean. he was a good communicator and our check-in and stay was smooth.
they are generous and friendly. and two cats are adorable. it's convenient to sightseeing. there are many shops in the nearest station. you would have a great time with them in ny!

md’s place was a wonderful place to stay. you can’t get a better value in proximity to nyc than this airbnb. it was a short ferry ride everyday to manhattan that runs often. md and his family were very welcoming and provided everything we needed for our stay. i highly recommend this airbnb when you are staying in the area.
maya was very kind & very communicative she helped with anything i needed!! the room was very cute and calm

darling's space was just what i needed! it was easy access to to all the places i needed to go! there were lots of options for food, coffee, and groceries. the room is big and bright and i had more than enough space to spread out and get some work done without feeling cramped. super friendly building with easy access! i will definitely stay again.
jewel is great, room and location are great, highly recommend!
emil was a great host! fast response, very friendly. location was great.
the place is very cozy and in a perfect location - quiet street close to bedford avenue and metro. the host is kind and fast to respond. strongly suggest this accommodation. can’t wait to come back.
friendly host, great location for exploring red hook

by far the worst airbnb experience i’ve encountered. there was absolutely no ac only a small fan provided. i requested a second fan was not provided with another one. the room felt like i was in an oven i couldn’t stop sweating. same week nyc was under a heat warming. i couldn’t sleep because of how hot is was in the room. the bathroom was dirty. the host took hours to reply. i’ve requested a full refund completely ruined my vacation.

amazing stay at an amazing place , lovely home. the space is even more amazing then pictured, privacy and comfort. felt right at home from the easy check in , clean and spacious. looking forward to coming back

i enjoyed a five star stay in this beautifully maintained, ultra clean, and cozy space that smells fantastic. it's like having a luxury hotel right at home a perfect, peaceful nest. located near airports and convenient stores, it offers both comfort and easy access to everything you need.

we stayed here for only the last night of our trip, but it was a great experience. the room was clean and spacious, hotel staff were very nice, the neighborhood seemed safe and had good access. i would definitely recommend staying here.
wonderful space! outstanding location. stylish apartment. thank you
great stay. no problems. great hosts, great place and close to the subway!
great place and warm hospitality
great location and perfect set up for a weekend couples getaway into nyc for the weekend.

jacqueline is a stellar host! she reached out to make sure things were going well and was quick to respond to any questions. jacqueline even surprised us by decorating the living room with a small christmas tree and placing a few gifts under it. such a sweet gesture for my family who was spending their christmas away from home. thank you for the wonderful hospitality!

giovanni was very easy to talk and had great communication. the room was spotless and came with towels and dental care tools. the area was very walkable and gorgeous, we would definitely pay another visit and chose here again.

really enjoyed our stay at untitled. the building itself is cool and located in a great neighbourhood with lots around to do and see. staff were friendly and proactive, there’s awesome complimentary coffee and pastries each morning that we enjoyed. our room was small but had everything we needed and was super clean. would definitely stay again and will recommend it to friends visiting the city. thanks again!
great place and natalie was so kind

we enjoyed our stay at this home. we were in nyc to enjoy the us open and this home was in just the right location. however, this is pretty far east into brooklyn so there’s not much nearby in terms of restaurants and coffee shops. the home itself was well furnished and everything worked as expected. the neighborhood was extremely loud one of the nights we were there, i think the neighbors were having a party before the big caribbean day parade. all in all, we enjoyed our stay as found it convenient to get in and out of queens and manhattan.
room was lovely and private with so many amenities! hosts were very friendly and helpful, and let us check in late.

the neighbourhood is very lively with a latino vibe. if you stay there try pizza from across the road and taco bars near dyckmans station. very good value for money but a bit far from the centre of all the main attractions. it takes approximately 35-40min to central park. but connection is very simple.👍👍👍

karen's home is located within a classical, independent american residence. it is very clean and it is possible to find every kind of comfort for your stay in new york. it is close to two main stations to reach manhattan in a simple and fairly fast way. karen has always been very helpful with us for every kind of need and communication.
artemie is a very nice and welcoming host. the place is very nice and we’ll located. the garden is very charming.
it was a nice stay and easy commute from the airport by bus.

lovely spot in a lovely hood. ideal for busy visitors or someone like me who had a ton of meetings. the room is bright, full of beautiful house plants and comfortable to lounge, work or watch tv. the private loo and shower is the best bonus.

this was, hands down, one of the best accommodations we've had on any vacation. sarah and floyd were wonderful hosts, helpful and friendly. sarah had a nice chat with us every day, and she had great local tips and fun stories about the area and the city. the apartment was beautiful, spacious and airy, and was in a fantastic location, just a few meters from the subway and central park. lovely beds, soft towels and spotlessly clean. we could sleep with the windows open - in the middle of nyc! sarah and floyd’s apartment is highly recommended.
the single room with shared bathroom and common space was good for me. i only needed that and i was happy to get a good price in a great location.
we spent the last easter holidays in barry's apartment. we had a great time and felt very homy. this east village location is fantastic. i really recommend this place.
great location, convenient check in, nice modern room.
great place! close to everything, train station is 14 mins away walking, soo many restaurants nearby! clean place!

we loved our stay. the unit was a perfect respite after our days exploring. close to the subway. spacious with comfortable beds. it was easy to find and maggie’s communications was prompt and friendly.

the apartment is very nice and the views are spectacular. however, the shining in the living room at sunrise is not conducive to sleep. if you are sleeping in the living room, an eye mask is a must or you will not sleep at all. at this price point, blackout curtains would be an expectation since it is advertised to, “sleep four.”

kevin’s place is pristine and so cute! he was super flexible with our check in time (we ended up driving after our flights were cancelled). the bed is super comfy and the bathroom is luxurious as well. it is a bit out of manhattan obviously but the subway navigation was easy for us and we didn’t mind at all. kevin is responsive and checked on us several times. a peaceful getaway from the craziness of nyc! book it!!

stayed for 2 months now and booked the third month halfway through the first month. so far so good, and minor issues like a misaligned closet door were very quickly resolved with minimal disturbance. nice furniture, and large firm bed and huge l shaped couch. roku tv 📺♥️ most cooking utensils and cleaning tools are already there. laundry is in the basement of the building, 4 machines for the whole or half rhe building it seems. parking is unfortunately terrible, but the 7 train is 2 blocks away :). alternate side parking thu/fri 1130-1pm. very happy to be living here so far 👍👍

clean accommodation and great communication. the accommodation had some lovely touches like toiletries and snacks in the kitchen which really were a welcome surprise. plenty of tea (much needed after a long day). subway at the end of the street was fabulous. however please note that it actually takes an hour minimum (not including subway disruption/works) to get to the tourist areas of new york. if you have plenty of time like i had then this wasn’t really an issue but if you only have a few days i’d consider this point carefully as two hours a day really does start to add up. the hosts were lovely but i did get a sense that it was 110% profit making so if all you want is good value accommodation then this would be perfect for you. if however you wanted to interact with the homeowners and get a sense of the american way of life then this is definitely not for you. the accommodation was shared with 6 other travellers which is in itself interesting and frustrating as there was only one toilet and shower. the bed was superbly comfortable and the room was nicely decorated. i was granted an extended check out time and was allowed to leave my bags for collection later in the day on my departure date. all without even asking which was fabulous. overall there were definitely more positives than negatives to this stay.

stayed at guillermo’s place for a couple of days and was very impressed. you’ll find that this is a spacious, clean studio. the bed was comfortable, the kitchen was quaint and stocked with all the basic cooking tools, and the bathroom was clean. the pictures in the listing do the place justice as it was what i expected. it is a slight step down, basement apartment so keep in mind you’ll have guests/tenants above you in the main house. for those who are sensitive to noise this may not be the ideal place for you because of the the combination of upstairs activity and the outside activity as well. (but then again, you are in new york city: if you didn’t want noise, you’re in the wrong place) overall i enjoyed my stay as it was nearby where i needed to be, and a short walk to the l train. guillermo provides thorough instructions and guidance for my stay and made me feel welcome. i would definitely stay here again!
nice apartment, for the price is good. i liked be there and walking around that neighbourhood.

amazing stay at gary's. great space, loads to do around and enough room to fit 4 people if needed. the washroom sink still has a cosmetic issue that others have mentioned, but still works perfectly. wifi worked but went down after a rain storm, so can't really blame anyone for that. would definitely stay again. gary is very easy going.

lisa’s apartment is probably the quietest spot in new york! located on a nice street in brooklyn, within easy reach of multiple subway stops and prospect park. we stayed for two weeks during a july heatwave but the place remained really cool. lisa was a very attentive host, promptly responding to our queries. we would thoroughly recommend booking with her.
heping makes everything to help you feel home. convenient location, quiet area, definitely worth it
great stay very safe and clean
leon place was great! leon was a great host, very accommodating, checking on us to make sure we need anything. very clean has everything you need. definitely will stay again.
stylish ground level apt lovely backyard very private quiet & relaxing i enjoyed my stay will def book again
a repeat repeat repeat stay. i will return!

the place is great - it has everything needed for your accommodation! the location of apartment itself is very convenient: groceries / metro station / cafes - whatever you like! and huge thanks to justin and tommi for being very responsive and such a great hosts in overall - definitely recommend!
this place is in the heart of flushing chinatown. easy check-in, clean, quiet, and walkable to subway, train, and chinatown. we will be back here when we come back to flushing.
chikies place was great. close to transit and near fun bars. would happily stay there again.
always available for any need, kind and proactive. they made us feel as if we had known each other forever, something that’s far from obvious in a city like new york.
amazing place in a great location. really enjoyed my stay

one of my favorite airbnb’s i’ve stayed at by far. very reliable location for groceries and public transportation. the building was very easy to spot and check in process was smooth, had no issues. this was a very very cozy environment and it made me feel right at home. only con i’d have was the wifi wasn’t strong at all whenever you entered the bedroom so that kinda was a bummer but definitely shouldn’t be a dealbreaker considering the comfort and reliability of this home outweighs that. has all you need cooking utensils if you do decide to cook at home. i would definitely consider staying here again, really enjoyed my stay. host was very friendly
super fast responses! clean home. room was super bright!
wei wei's parent are very friendly and nice.

frederick's place is in a lovely neighborhood and in a nice old-fashioned building in park slope. i live in brooklyn and was staying there to allow space for guests from germany. i was working and therefore needed a calm place so i could get to work in the a.m., and a peaceful sleep when i came back. the bed is luxuriously comfy, and the apartment is lovely - nice light in the rooms and a laundromat in the basement.

cute but very small. the window looks out on a rooftop with a lot of machinery. sink situation in the bathroom borders on absurd. recommend for smaller people, but you will be very cramped if you’re someone who likes to have some more space to move around.
this place was great for what we needed and the hosts were friendly and communicative. the room was clean and everything was as expected.

i had a wonderful experience staying at this airbnb! the host was always responsive and quick to help with any questions or concerns. their hospitality made my stay so much more comfortable and enjoyable. i highly recommend this place!

j haze is an excellent host. personable and thoughtful and always checking in to ensure a good stay. tailored our stay to our circumstances and needs. good basement apartment in a good convenient and safe neighborhood. thanks
place was amazing and am looking forward to coming back
