astoria is beautiful neighborhood fifteen minutes to manhattan, easy to get to the train station, very close to astoria park with the panoramic view of manhattan and rfk bridge above the hudson river. i eat in greek restaurant i can recommended captain greek 37av and 33st.

loved staying at sandy’s place. definitely recommend if you want to stay in manhattan - great location, good value and experienced host. the location is fantastic, just a few blocks away from central park and subway. easy to get around whether you travel for business or fun, and very quiet at night. great restaurants in the area: if you a thai fan like myself, definitely check out sala thai - fantastic food! sandy is very friendly host. check-in and check-out was a breeze even though we haven’t met in person. would like to come back next time i am in the city.

saint is a great host! he knows and loves nyc, so you can alway expect a good advice about what to see and where to eat in the city. the room is really close to central park and two subway stations, it is spatious and the apartment has everithing you'll ever need. though new york is a great city itself, my impression of it wouldn't be full without saint. he is a great man and a true newyorker.
you get what you pay for.
our stay was nothing but wonderful. would highly recommend to anyone doing a quick quick to new york
this place is a favorite ❤️
jamison’s space is an ideal location. he had a good amount of space for a nyc apartment. it was very clean and his communication made everything easy! i’ll be back!
cheap and right next to penn station. recommended!

the apartment is perfect. super clean, has everthing you need for a long vacation. the neighborhood is safe and quiet. close to busses and subway, and there is a grocery near by. alina and her family are the best hosts - allways were available to any question we had.

our stay was great. k.v’s place was perfect and they really put thought into what guest may need during their stay. i loved having a coffee on the back porch. being from new york it’s always good to have a bodega on each corner lol. the train was a 10 min walk tops so it was very convenient.
great place to stay

anna’s airbnb is an excellent choice if you’re ever in nyc. the location is perfect, next to the subway, restaurants, cafes and bars. the airbnb itself is quite clean, spacious, and the bed is wonderful! internet is super fast and reliable too. communicating with anna was so quick, she responded to all my queries in a timely manner and even let us check out late! we can’t wait to stay at anna’s beautiful place the next time we’re in town!
had such a great time during our trip staying at suemattie’s home. she was responsive, helpful, and understanding!
ac is not good at all, many things need improved compare with the same price one in sattle

i loved this place! so clean, nice big rooms and great views over lower manhattan. would recommend it to anyone traveling to nyc. the only things that bothered me was 1) the significant hospitality service fee that i wasn’t aware of (according to google, mamdani’s administration had banned these hidden fees as of february 2026?), and 2) we booked a room with two beds (3 adults) but only one was available. there was a sofa bed but i had to ask twice for it to be made.

we loved staying at maria’s and brooke‘s apartment. it is even nicer and seems bigger than on the photos. maria and brooke are great and friendly hosts, which respond immediately and help you with any kind of matter. by far the best host experience we had on airbnb so far! the apartment is clean and has a very well equipped kitchen with everything you need. we liked the area as well, it’s quieter and you need some time to get to manhattan. but if you like to experience brooklyn and williamsburg as well, the location is great. all in all, big recommendation!
great and clean space. the private bathroom is an amazing plus. check in was very easy and flexible. would recommend the spot for folks looking for a space further out from the big city.
raj treated us like family. very kind and treated us to excellent hot indian tea before we left.
it's good to live at walder's house. the bedroom is clean and comfortable. besides the weather changing in the area, that made the room a little bit cold, everything else is great.
super nice and easy place to stay,, had everything i needed,, clean and comfy,, 7/15 minute walk to train stations and short walk to breakfast and coffee.
this place is very nice! it’s smaller than i expected, but it gives an intimate vibe. the sauna is a great plus too!
anthony was an attentive and accommodating host! i thought the price was a tiny bit high but then, even broooklyn is part of nyc;)
absolutely loved our stay. the place looks just like the photos, very central, lovely staff and delicious breakfast. we will be recommending it to everyone travelling to ny!

if you are looking for a place located in queens, don't look anymore. safe to stay & close to local places to eat. the bedrooms are spacious enough. highly recommend staying. ps. if you are a lighter sleeper you will be hearing how to place settles throughout the night. overall great place to stay!
even though me and my girlfriend arrived at midnight, liubov's roommate welcomed us. everything was alright, the room was clean. i would definitely come back! :)
really enjoyed our stay at richard's. his place is exactly as advertised and has plenty of space. the neighbourhood was great as well as being close to a lovely park and local transport connections.
great, clean and roomy space in the middle of lively w. greenwich village, walkable to everything you’d want to do. taylor was very helpful and responsive.

not happy with this booking at all. we booked a room with 2 bunk beds and the room had 1 loft bed and a sofa bed, which was shorter than a single, had a metal bar down the middle and was uncomfortable. we contacted koichi after 2 sleepless nights and said we wanted to check out and please refund the next 3 nights, had no reply so started a dispute and airbnb intervened and issued the refund and a credit on our account. the bathrooms are technically clean, but much older and worn than the photos. although it’s only a couple of blocks from penn st station which is convenient, the streets surrounding the building are unsafe compared to other areas we stayed in manhattan.
good value for the price, and very clean. it's just a block away from the station, which made things easy, and many shops and restaurants in the neighborhood.
it's good to access to lower downtown of manhattan.
yuhong was a great host and the accommodation was just right for a 2 night stay

this apartment is fantastic! teddy and blanca are lovely. it's 2 blocks from a train station and close enough to central park if you like to exercise in the mornings. things are cheap close by if you want to get food for the apartment too.
great place to stay. would recommend!

as advertised, amazing location :) remember it’s a shared bathroom so you always have to have a little luck considering cleanliness with the other people you share it with but all in all you get a good value for money ratio!

this spot was fantastic and i loved how central it was to commute to either downtown brooklyn or williamsburg with multiple subway options that were nearby. definitely recommend this location and the fellow tenants were kind and welcoming. thank you!
marek and grace understand that hospitality is offered in the details. we were treated to a magical weekend. as hosts they allow you to enjoy the moment. thank you.
an oasis in brooklyn. geoffrey's apartment is spacious, comfortable, quiet, and bright. a few yards from prospect park, it's a perfect location for seeing nyc.
great place to stay if you need to fly out

really great apartment in a peaceful yet still vibrant part of astoria. other than a bit of frustration when the n didn’t run into manhattan on the weekends getting to and from the apartment was super easy. great hosts, really kind and really responsive. i lived a while in hell’s kitchen and then the east village and honestly wasn’t a big fan of astoria but i really love that area west of the 30th ave nw stop. would stay there again in a heartbeat
be sure to take advantage of the skylight in upstairs bedroom; on clear nights, or when it’s snowing, so beautiful! plz see my previous review if u need more info!
great place with good access to local shops and t station. very comfortable apartment. beds and living space very comfortable. outside space could do with a little work.
great place and location, very responsive host.
great view, this lots of accessible ways of transportation and really close to many restaurants. also, did i mention the spectacular view?.

lovely stay! alexandra's apartment is in a great building, with an elevator(!), in a nice neighborhood. the studio-style space is cozy, clean, and cute. she's a great hostess that communicates well, provides great amenities, and is flexible. we'll stay there again!
great place! close to many shops and restaurants, right in the city! the apartment is probably best for a “mature audience” :)
great location and nice communication from the hosts.

it was the best airbnb experience i have ever had. i stayed 3 nights in there but i wished that i could stay more. they were so kind and helpful. i felt like a member of the family. if you wanna stay a place where you could feel at home, i advise this place with all my heart!!!

we couldn’t have asked for a more ideal spot than michael’s place. we were warmly welcomed, the room was cozy and clean and the irish pub downstairs was an added bonus. this was a our first trip to new york and we would gladly stay here again - a wonderful experience all around!!!!
great place. worked out nicely for my family and dogs
super host, wonderful place, great neighborhood, quick to city, clean and comfortable! what more can i say? hassan and his place are great - would highly recommend!

amazing location in the village! 3 minute walk from the subway and so many great restaurants and coffee shops all within 5 minutes of the unit. would definitely stay again. law was very friendly and accommodating to our check in/out needs.

my group of 3 stayed here for a week and really enjoyed our time in ny at ben's apartment. great location to get around manhattan and brooklyn. check-in/-out was easy, the apartment was clean and spacious, and communication with ben was great. thanks for hosting us!
great location, right in midtown/sutton place yet the building is on a quiet street. checking in and out was super smooth. place is clean, new and has everything you need for a short stay.

allison's is adorable and welcoming. the apartment is perfectly located to visit central park and surrounding. the room is exactly as it's pictured, clean, comfy. special kisses to the dog who is such a lovely puppy 🤩💕

this was a lovely quiet space in a beautiful brownstone with an elegant host. the space was comfortable and very clean. i liked the neighborhood, especially wtf coffee lab right outside the door! there's plenty of action and accessibility on myrtle street. the other adjacent streets had numerous neighborhood gems.

had a lovely stay here. the hosts were very helpful and always gave clear instructions on how to check in and anything else we needed they were very accommodating. also have a very friendly cat 'kitty'.

brigitte was so kind and has such a warm heart! when i came home and saw her smile, i totally felt like i was home. the house was kept clean every day, especially the bathroom and kitchen — they were always spotless. my room was spacious, with lots of shelves and hangers. they were so helpful for keeping my things organized. i’ve always loved harlem, but this year i fell in love with it even more because of her and this wonderful place. i highly recommend this airbnb to anyone visiting new york!
wonderful. book without fear feels like home.
thomas's place was great! a nice place to unwind for the holiday, very clean and he was an excellent host.

albert was very responsive and friendly. the place was extremely clean and exactly like the photos. this wasn’t the most touristy area nearby, but the r train is right there. i will definitely be back though !

sheila was a wonderful host. she met us outside the unit and was very responsive in communicating. this basement unit is clean, cozy, and quiet! the private patio out back is also a really nice perk to the unit. the location in east village is great for going out, close to public transit, and priced very reasonably compared to other units in the area. i would definitely stay here again!
wonderful and spacious apartment. road of restaurants and stores just a 5 minute walk away. very close to the bus stop to commute into the city. enjoyed our stay!
dan's place is great! clean, great location, and lots of things to do nearby

if you want to live the brooklyn life, like a local, this spot is it. surrounded by bodegas and local delis, you will immediately feel like a new yorker. ziggy and rome keeps the place sparkling clean as well with all the amenities you need. it was an amazing time.
this place is amazing, very clean highly recommended only wish there was an ac in the living room
juan was an excellent host! his communication was great and everything was as promised. we had an easy check-in and out. pictures are exactly what you get. it was a great first airbnb experience.
had a great stay here! the apartment was clean and well-decorated. the host was really responsive throughout, which made logistics straightforward. would recommend!
safe neighborhood with friendly and helpful host. basement room is cozy. separate bathroom is small but nice to have a private br! good value! about a 4 block walk to the bus.
really enjoyed our stay. connie is very helpful and the apartment was so clean and cosy.bedroom is fairly spacious and the bathroom is pristine. couldn’t have asked for a better apartment!

a overall good property. the seaport area is a close to brooklyn and the downtown/wtc area. the area outside of the apartment is a little questionable at first. a bit of a grudgy pub and a graffiti covered shuttered store surround it. there is no elevator so a flight of stairs is necessary to carry luggage up. inside is as advertised. some modern upgrades. the furniture specifically the sofa is a little old and outdated. on two beds, i saw hair when i turned back cover not sure if from cleaning lady or not. also only had three small towels, we had to wash towels for our 3 night stay. also, this property is not on peck, it’s around the corner. overall communication was good and we were comfortable.
excellent service. management was so responsive. it is expensive and noisy but you can’t expect anything else in the center of korea town…
dawn was great. her apartment is exactly like the pictures. my friend and i felt like we were home. next time i am in brooklyn i will definitely stay here if available!

pictures and description of this place was spot on. this place accommodate our party of 3 just perfect. the patio area was a plus, we stayed in one day of our stay and it was just the perfect place to relax. ana was a great host, she made sure to check in on us to make sure we were comfortable. definitely would recommend to friends and family.

lisa's home was such a great place for me to spend a week and a half. she was so welcoming and accommodating; i felt as if i was just staying with a friend! besides the apartment being very nice and comfortable, you cannot beat the location and the neighborhood, or the proximity to the city (this coming from a former new yorker). i also loved being greeted by ginger when i got home from work each day :) i will definitely look for availability here when booking my next business trip!
great stay, easy location

we had such a great stay at chito and xavier’s place. little hidden gem in harlem providing good value and great location as a basecamp for exploring manhattan. the private patio is amazing after a long day walking around nyc. the place itself is spacious and quiet. it also contained everything we needed to cook and was perfectly clean. chito and xavier were on top of things and very friendly so kudos to them! highly recommended!
lovely flat in a good location. close to subway and lots of places to eat. the flat is well curated and lovely.

minetta's place was absolutely beautiful, from the decor to the location, 5 stars all around. minetta and ozgur were great hosts. the apartment is minutes away from the subway, morningside park and columbia. highly recommend for those looking to visit columbia students. 10/10.

we had a great time here. benjamin was very responsive. the apartment is centrally located within a 10 min walk to the subway or a 5 min walk to the bus stop. kitchen was fully equipped for us to make coffee and meals. great stay at a great price!
i had a wonderful month staying here. the apartment is so close to soho and chinatown, making everything super convenient. thank you for a great stay!
a great place to stay within walking distance to a lot of places. very friendly staff.
room was as advertised and perfect for an early morning flight out of laguardia.

if you are visiting nyc with small children then this place is ideal. the apartment is very spacious, safe and accessible with only two steps at the entrance. i travelled with a five month old and couldn't have wished for more. the apartment is very well equipped, the garden is wonderful, and the hosts are fabulous. the street is very quiet compared to manhattan and just around the corner are shops, bars and restaurants. the station, which is less then a ten minute walk away, has elevators and trains to almost anywhere. this made using the subway far easier than i had imagined with a baby. the information provided by timothy in the welcome pack is brilliant. i tried out a couple of the recommendations and was not disappointed. i really hope to have cause to visit new york again soon just so as we can stay again.

this is a great airbnb. the room is really nice with everything you could want provided. i loved all the windows and fresh air. the room has a mini fridge and microwave and provides toiletries. it is about a 15 min walk to the subway and 1 block to one of the busses. the neighborhood felt safe to walk at night. overall a very nice and comfortable place.

fq was really easy to communicate with. this condo unit was in a great location, spacious, and well-stocked. building was full-service. lobby is currently in renovation. lots of street parking on nights/weekends nearby.
the location couldn’t have been better! the space itself was the perfect size and beds were very comfortable. the area felt safe and had lots great eateries. i’d absolutely stay here again.

we super enjoyed the stay. jose is very helpful and responsive, helped us with our questions and provided support when it was needed. the apartment is very clean and has everything you need (iron, hairdryer, fridge ... even cosmetics). the location is also good - a few mins to the train/subway (~30-40 mins to manhattan), park, lots of shops and restaurants nearby. highly recomend.

we stayed for an extended at millennium and had a great experience! very friendly staff all around and conveniently located at times square! it was a big plus for us that we were able to store our luggage prior to check in and after check out! we’d definitely come back here.

absolutely amazing stay here! the location was incredible, so centrally located could get anywhere so easily, the subway station was so close and had all the central lines to literally explore the whole city in no time at all. the hotel itself was beautiful, amazing decor and spacious rooms. there was a cute coffee shop with great coffee & a cute piano bar with jazz music. this hotel exceeded my expectations and really made my trip even better staying somewhere so nice!

this place was beyond perfect, everything about it from the bathroom to the bedroom to the living room area was absolutely phenomenal. this was 12/10 stay, and for my first bnb amanda made it a good stay and made my girlfriend and i feel like home. we will definitely return again.

the house was very clean and gabriel was responsive when we had questions. the neighborhood isn't as safe as we would have liked and there are not many options for food close by. the house was super close to the subway though! the listing says that the house sleeps 8 people, but realistically it sleeps 4. 5 could fit if someone sleeps on the couch. the house needs some maintenance such as a floorboard in the kitchen being loose and the tv in the master bedroom not working.
great place. jing is awesome and very helpful. will definitely stay again

chijioke was a very great host. he let us check in 5 hours earlier than his regular check in time, which was fantastic. his home is very beautiful and spacious seeing that we were the only ones there. chijioke was very responsive, answered any questions i had.
fun apartment, great location. needs some tlc- furn, towels, coffee maker

it was an interesting place, spacious and convenient. i liked the back patio for coffee in the morning and reading in the afternoon. there were some oddities, however. no soap, no washcloths, no hand towels or bath mats in or beside the tub. the shower has to be handheld and the step out with the very deep tub was almost dangerous. no ice cube trays or any liners in the trash cans. these are all small things but their inclusion would make this a very good stay.

we had a great stay at angelika's place. the apartment was clean, comfortable and just what we needed for our trip, and just as described. we had everything we needed and just a couple of blocks walk to the subway, coffee shop and local stores. neighbourhood was quiet and always felt safe. we didn't bump into angelika during our stay but she was really helpful over texts. would definitely stay again when we're next in new york.
she’s amazing and extremely helpful
such a great little studio in an amazing location!

brooklyn was a great host. the house is just like in the pictures, perfect for two. when we arrived, the house was very clean and brooklyn had left us recommendations for places to eat and to go to that was very helpful. she always replied to our concerns and was able to provide us with two pairs of keys and with a box to receive our online orders. there were only 2 negative points. first of all, you could hear the all the noise from the neighborhood as the apartment was on the first floor; and so the nights were pretty noisy. and the second thing was that during our stay brooklyn came to her apartment a couple of times and stayed for quite some time. that didn't bother us at all but could be a problem for those who want their complete privacy. the street was safe and had everything you needed close by. all in all, we would like to thank brooklyn for a very good experience!

amazing stay! water was hot when needed and the studio was super clean. enjoyed staying in k-town!! there wasn’t really any downsides besides maybe the bathroom being cramped but it was a studio apartment to begin with. overall a solid choice

the place is pretty clean. it has everything you need (stove, utensils, cooking stuff, soap, hair dryer,...) so you dont really need to bring anything except for clothes. it's also close to dollar tree (pretty convenient if you need to buy personal items), and yummy yummy chinese restaurant if you want some foods but lazy to catch a bus lol. the host is really nice. he check up with me once a while to make sure everything is okay and see if i have any questions. highly recommended!!
it was a nice easy stay that i was able to find for a last minute booking!
exactly what i was looking for for the location and price.

this apartment is in a great location; close to bars, restaurants, 24hour shops and transport links. the host was very accommodating; he provided a blow up mattress on request and was very helpful at check in with tips (particularly for the us open tennis). he was very flexible with regards to checkout and very easy to contact. we were slightly disappointed to find the fridge and freezer were dirty and there was leftover food and drink in there. i understand that guests leave food behind and it would be a waste to throw away everything, but some of the produce left behind should be disposed of. we didn't do a lot of cooking, but we noticed that the oven glove was very greasy and dirty and as a result we didn't use it. however, the apartment is in a fantastic location and was perfect for our needs so would definitely stay again.

the boat house was great, completly furnished with enough room for 4 adults. it was perfectly situated between the beach and manhattan. angus was a great host and knows the area very well. we highly recomend this place if you want to have a nice and quiet stay. p.s thanks for the beers angus :)

nina and keith’s place in park slope is truly awesome. excellent location! i felt safe in the area and it was close to the subway. nina and keith checked in frequently which i greatly appreciated as i was traveling alone. they made the entire experience so easy, from checkin to check out, and even offered an early checkin and late checkout (for a small fee) once they knew my itinerary. i would definitely stay here again the next time i’m in the area! thank you both so much, made my trip that much better!
we enjoyed our stay here, it was very easy to travel as the subway is right as you come out the doors. it you wish to travel through manhattan and extensions this is the perfect spot.

the place was literally doen the block from times square which was nice. it was fairly quiet where we were staying. upon check-in, which was on time, they didn’t have a room for us right away and had to wait about 20 minutes. we were even given the wrong room and has to go back downstairs and check twice to finally get the right room. room had a little bit of a smoker smell, although it did go away. it was fairly tight in the bathroom and the water didn’t get cold just stayed warm or hot. staff was friendly and a lot of food places around.
clean, beautiful neighborhood, close to public transport and am extremely welcoming host. room and batbroom are clean. this is one of my favorite air bnb places to stay!
this is an ideal location in long island city.

wonderful location and outstanding super host jean!!! enjoyed every minute of my stay and plan to return for longer stays in the future. apt is really luxurious and spacious. i felt at home immediately. highly recommend!!!
exactly what i needed
what an amazing family and exceptional hospitality.
unique. cool. great location. comfy bed. i’d stay again in a heartbeat.
had a wonderful stay!

awesome stay at sandra’s! she was so kind and helpful. she went out of her way to help us with recommendations and answers to our questions. rooms were lovely, spotless, and location is great, with easy parking and close by via public transport to ubs arena, citi field, manhattan, etc. highly recommend!
will definitely recommend it!!! the area was well kept, and the area had a lot of local restaurants, which is good if you're looking to dine out. it's also close to the subway.

this is a private, cozy, spacious, charming, quiet, convenient, well equipped and supplied townhouse. i felt right at home and slept super comfortably. gabe is very responsive, communicated promptly. i recommend this place and will choose to stay here again when i'm in the area next time.

i absolutely loved this beautiful, cozy apartment. it is well located in a lovely, safe neighborhood with great restaurants and neighborhood groceries. the proximity to fort greene park is a bonus. andrew and rosie are accessible and communicative. the apartment is beautifully appointed with everything one could need. i have recommended to family/friends and will base future ny trips on its availability.
the room is clean and bright. location is great for tourists. service is great!

we had a wonderful one month stay in anna’s apartment in brooklyn. the place was perfect for the two of us. the bedroom was cozy and comfortable, and we slept really well. the apartment is well equipped with everything you need to cook, clean, and take care of the space. some small things could use a bit of fixing (like the bedroom blinds and kitchen ventilation), but overall, everything worked fine. the building is quiet, and the location is great, just a short walk to buses and the subway. there are several supermarkets, corner stores. anna was kind, and available if we needed anything. we feel very lucky to have stayed here. highly recommend!
great room. always has the room ready within a hour even late nights. definitely would stay again
great flat on the lower east side - spacious, secure, clean and in a great location close to many eateries (little italy and chinatown walkable) and a very handy supermarket. subway close by too.

this was a wonderful place for our family. we had 2 children and appreciated having separate bedrooms. the apartment looks just like the pictures, very well kept and clean. the host was very responsive and helpful . the location is a bit far from most touristy activities, but just a few blocks from a subway station. also, just a couple blocks from a very nice park for the kids to play at. the street was nice, but the greater area was so so. overall this is definitely a place i would recommend!
location for me is great. apartment is spotless. shower is wonderful. bed was very comfortable, convertible sofa in living room not very comfortable..

lovely one room apartment, great free parking nearby, modern and updated, easy to find, relatively close to subway stops, all needed amenities including washer and dryer. neighborhood surrounding felt run down in areas.
harold was so kind and helpful! his place was very cool and comfortable! we we liked definitely stay here again.
it was a good warm stay cesar was very responsive and helpful. the place is just like described and check in was very easy

easy 5 stars! my stay with tash was amazing! unlike my first airbnb experience, she really goes above and beyond to ensure that your stay from check-in to check-out runs smoothly. communication was clear and timely, the living area was spotless, thoughtful decorated, and very welcoming. she will not try to micromanage your stay with annoying, unnecessary tours or tutorials on how to work the tv remote (lol). you access the key, put it back in the box and you’re all set to check yourself in for a quiet and peaceful stay. my room was cozy, clean and comfortable with a modern, stylish flair. one of my biggest concerns was the temperature of the room as i’m a person that’s always cold. not only was the room warm enough, she left a heater in the closet just in case. considering my previous say, the bar was set pretty low for airbnb and deciding to try again was a huge gamble but i’m so glad i gave it another shot. whenever i visit nyc again for work or leisure, i’ll be booking here once tash’s place is available.
the place was clean and comfortable, and obed was very helpful and quick to respond if there was ever any issue. would definitely recommend as a stay!
the hosts were so welcoming and accommodating! they provided clear check-in/ out instructions. also, they were very responsive to any questions we had.
nomam was a great host! the room was great. felt like i was at home. would deff stay here again
great bontique hotel to stay

the people's brownstone gave us a rich, authentic experience of this area of new york city. the local community were quick to assist us in times of logistical need and were chuffed to do so. this community has strong jazz roots and the place buzzes as a result. the subway is an easy walk and easy to negotiate (once you get your head around downtown & uptown) - single fares are $usd3. you are at the major cbd tourist destinations within a maximum of 45 minutes of leaving home (many are closer and took around 30 minutes). we also found taxi fares from the cbd back home very reasonable (approx. $usd30) if you're tired or have arms full of shopping at the end of the day. the home has everything you need - we didn't find ourselves short of anything during our week-long stay. we recommend it!

the apartment is lovely, the neighbourhood very nice and friendly, transportation is easy and plentiful. all is recommended, except - we had trouble with the wi-fi all along, and tv without cable in ny means (it seems) lots of channels in spanish and not one news channel in english. on the up-side - we didn't watch tv. but these are minor minusses compared to the plusses.
it was a very nice stay, vasili was a very kind host and easy to communicate. he was very patient with me with the questions i had after traveling all day. would definitely stay again.
really enjoyed our stay, everything was fine!
good experience staying here!

we are from colombia, first time looking through airbnb and was a great experience. we found this wonderful room where you have all you need very close, restaurants, bars, supermarkets, laundry, etc.. all the sights are very close, then you can walk without problem to central park, rockefeller tower, 2 blocks to times square, st. patrick's cathedral, etc.. half a block there is a hotel where we received orientation and were able to buy a card with 7 sights, meeting places were close (uptown and downtown tour bus 42th street - 8a avenue, hudson river tours 39th street - 12 avenue). you have subway stations close and you can go everywhere you want very easy, the place is clean and comfortable, exactly alike you see it in the pictures, the kitchen is nice, bathroom and shower very nice. yasu and akiko very nice people! hope to visit this place again very soon.
very big apartment and excellent located.
convenient location, comfortable room, and clean space for getting to/from jfk.
wish i could just live here. great location, super cozy and open space. will be back for sure! thank you!

we were visiting staten island for a wedding and dierdre's house was perfect! it was convenient to the venue, the ferry, and places to eat. it was very comfortable for 7 people. dierdre was easy to reach for questions and made everything very easy in general.
great spot! a definite must stay! enjoy the seamless experience in a pristine room with great views!
excellent as always very great host
chris is a great host, very responsive, we’re able to timely check in and checkout. his place is nice and cozy. we would love to stay at his place again.
what an amazing place and fantastic host! i highly recommend , our host has been super nice, the place is amazing and communication perfect . thanks a lot for a fantastic family vacation

michael place is a dream. i rented it for my parents to stay there and they had a wonderful time. their only complaints would be the thin walls— there was some construction going on and your room is on the street level— and the water from the shower gets all over the bathroom. other than that the garden is beautiful, michael is so attentive and the place is very modern and lovely. would definitely rent this place again!thanks michael!
di’s place was clean and cozy, with all the kitchen essentials. great location. thank you!

we really enjoyed our stay in ron's appartement. typical and really clean, in the heart of harlem.. was perfect for this we. ron is truly available and reactive and there is everything to feel at home (coffee, subway map, internet, computer, printer..). thanks ! :o)
we had a wonderful stay at shay’s place. the appartement was clean, and shay was a very welcoming host with plenty of great recommendations. we truly loved our stay and would happily come back again.

i stayed at kaz’s place for three months. the place is exactly as advertised. it was always clean and tidy and a cleaning lady came in once every week. it is very close subway station and there are some good restaurants options around. kaz was also really responsive to any inquiries. it was a great stay.
this place is super cool, plenty of space all the right amenities and super cool hosts! janet and david’s cozy container rooms are an awesome get away from the busy life of ny.

great location! close to q line which was super convenient for our jaunts to broadway, koreatown and soho. enjoyed the neighborhood restaurants. great sichuan food at a-jiao, huge breakfast at 3 deckers, quick coffee and flaky croissants at madam bonte cafe. very clean apartment. was not an issue for us but shower/bathroom is tiny. this is nyc though, i think that’s the normal size here

the room is very homey and welcoming, much cozier than a hotel room and there's a station minutes away takes into the city. the neighborhood is working class which isn't a bad thing by any means; it's just low key and lived in.
great location but behind busy restaurant so noisy late at night. bathroom light/fan very loud!!
strongly recommend if youre going to new york. very good location, friendly host, clean place. the bed was so comfortable. host is very nice,he did help me carrying stuff upstairs.

debra is a gem! our stay was amazing and we couldn’t ask for a better host. our flight schedules got changed and she was more than willing to allow early check in. she was sure that every part of our stay was enjoyable. the place has great amenities and was very clean. also, the food options and connectivity to manhattan and all over nyc are ideal. from the great conversations and helping out, she made it a memorable experience. thanks again deb for a great stay and i do look forward to staying here again.

perfect for our quick trip to new york! the space matches the photos and was comfortable. we did have some trouble finding parking for a bit, but once we found a spot we were able to walk everywhere and take the trains. it was a bit hot, i’d recommend maybe bringing a portable fan if you stay during the summer. victor was a great host and we hope to visit new york again real soon!

i had a really wonderful stay here, the apartment is on the top floor with lots of light and is very nice and clean. furnitures and appliances seems to be very new and in great conditions. the location is amazing, right off of 5th ave which is full of restaurants, coffee shops and bars and just a few blocks away from the park. daniel is very helpful and responsive and made everything very easy. highly recommend!

an amazing area to stay in. great spaces around to shop and eat. room smaller than expected for the value, so keep that in mind before booking. and also be aware of homeless people sneaking in to sleep on couch. other than, amazing area to stay in.

nanonte's place was incredible! a perfect spot to stay for a weekend at the beach. super walkable and sooo close to the a. close to restaurants and bars but on a quiet street with a very private backyard. the bed was comfy too! thanks for everything!
not bad for the price, nice views, really great location.

we spent a month at rachel’s place and we were delighted with the apartment and its location. the apartment has everything we needed and it’s very clean. it’s conveniently located near restaurants, grocery stores and public transportation. rachel is a caring host who communicates promptly. we look forward to future stays at her place.
love it here i’ll be back soon
nice room with a comfortable bed. marilyn was responsive and acomodating. great place to stay in harlem.
it’s a very location near the train station going to manhattan. christian is a very good host. thank you for hosting me while im nyc.
great stay quite neighborhood away from the busy areas but close enough to all burroughs. the comfortable furniture is always a plus. would definitely stay here again

it was overall a fantastic experience. very walkable and right outside of the subway station. close to china town and easy to get anywhere really. the place itself was really clean and didnt feel cramped. the view was nice with a lot of natural light. bathroom was clean. overall great experience and id come back.
great little place, super close to grand central and penn stations, definitely would recommend and come back another time.
great place. would book again!

really great spot. just as advertised and ignacio was very prompt in his responses. only slight issue, even with the fan on it can get hot in the room. i had to get another small fan, but wasn’t an issue in the end.
excellent place to stay. well situated in the financial district and close to plenty of amenities. would definitely stay there again.
nice place in good location with walking distance to coney island. comfortable apartment, large bed, kitchen with all you need. easy check in/ check out.
very kind and helpful. thank you chii
we visit the area every summer to spend time with friends. this is by far our best airbnb experience. we look forward to more stays!
great stay, great internet connection for tech heads.
very conveniently located. close to great food shopping options, subway and next to central park. very clean and safe building.

our stay in this brooklyn studio apartment was comfortable and clean we had a great time and it was somewhat convenient to locations we were attending the art was a great touch, thanks for a great stay
great host, great apartment, great location. the apartment was in pristine condition, the garden beautiful and well-kept. michael was friendly and helpful. no complaints at all.
i had a great stay. host was very warm and welcoming, very clean and cozy. would stay here again in a heartbeat. thank you!

at first i was about sketchy with this, because there were no reviews. however i just wanna say that this is the perfect place to stay for people who are looking for an affordable, convenient, and last minute trip to nyc. the place is great. a bit smaller then it looks in the pictures but it's not a big deal. elizabeth and her husband were great. check in was smooth and they even left a gift basket for us. awesome !!!
great stay! hamza is a great host. location was perfect, 5 min walk to the train station and 2 cafes directly next door (i already miss their food)! thanks again!
would definetly stay again!
perfect stay at jose's. he's very helpful, the apartment is clean, comfortable and very well located, in a safe area close to manhattan. we will definitely come back

really beautiful and cozy space in a great spot. lovely views and lots of stuff to do right nearby. convenient check in and out. sadly the terrace was closed due to rain which was what i was looking forward to most. wish we had access to it anyway, or at least a part of it. otherwise it was great!
amazing location and easy communication
nice stay in an amazing loft. even better than in the pictures. felt like a local in manuela’s place. she’s been really nice, very friendly and helpful. thank you.
cozy and comfortable place, also leona responsed very quick !! thank you !

jose's instructions for check-in were fantastic. we had four guys on a baseball trip, and each guy had his own room, and there were two bathrooms, so the space worked really well for us. it was a 15-minute walk to the elevated train, then another 15 minutes either direction to manhattan or citi field. the neighborhood was lovely and the busy road next to the place sung me to sleep at night.
good location, near to many interesting places, near metro n bus stop to but sometimes noise at night.

tony is the best host. always available, i really felt at home. whenever i needed him, he was available. the apartment is clean, looks exactly like in the pictures, internet works perfectly, the bed is very comfortable and the shower works perfectly! the area is 100% safe and nearby you can find some great cafe and restaurants. perfect night sleeps, very quiet and calm! the subway is just 10 minutes on foot and in 15 minutes you are in manhattan! i will definitely go back to tony in the future! thank you tony! loved it 100%
danielle was very hospitable. she actually walked me through the house to explain how everything worked. she was also very responsive via text messages.

augustina was a thoughtful and kind homeowner. the room was as cozy and tidy as described. the amenities described were as expected and were convenient to use. the bathrooms were neat. if you're someone who wants to travel to manhattan, the distance can be a bit of a burden. still, there is a bus that can go to manhattan without a transfer, so if you check the time, you will have a great trip without much difficulty.

great location close to theaters, hell's kitchen, times square and central park. the room was bigger than expected; larger than other hotel rooms we have had in nyc. we really enjoyed the rooftop bar each evening. we will definitely look at this hotel the next time we are in the city.

i needed a place to quarantine outside my home since my roommate visited a restricted state and francesco’s apartment is exactly as photographed. it was loud during the day, as construction was being done to the facade of the building, so it was difficult to work from the apartment. other than that it was a nice place.

agnes was very kind and very friendly. we stay in her flat just one night but it was the best choice. we felt very comfortable there because she gave and share with us everything. very kind!! we can really only recommend!! top!!! :-) thank you.

monica is very attentive to one's travel needs. her apartment is clean and contains all you need for a comfortable stay. it is a quiet apartment too, located on the back side of the building, away from street noise. it is conveniently located near broadway theaters. good restaurants, bakeries, and coffee houses are extremely close by. we will definitely stay at this apartment again! this is a jewel!
great location. very well appointed and besides the stairs, but that was good exercise, it was a perfect place to stay for our holiday in wonderful ny.

the place was very nice and clean. the beds were comfortable and plenty of towels were provided. the host was responsive within the hour; however, the communication she set up for check-in and check-out is a bit frustrating. information for check-in and check-out come last minute. i messaged host asking if she needs us to do anything specific for check-out. since i left pretty early (around 8) her response didn't come until after i had left and therefore i didn't put everything away exactly where she wanted it. accuracy was pretty good except for parking. both free street parking and parking on premises are advertised but only the street parking is available. we did find a spot pretty easily however so we didn't make a big deal about that. just the description itself is slightly inaccurate in this.

the space was calm and relaxing. be forewarned that the rooms can be on the 4th floor walk up with steep steps. there are staff to help but i would recommend traveling light (something i was unable to do!). loved their fresh baked goods in the morning!
listen .. just book it you wont regret it loved my stay i had to stay longer 🙂

nice spacious appartment, entrance to the appartment is easy and really clear. the appartment is not luxurious/brand new but nice and cosy old style which fits the brooklyn character in my opinion. all needed utilities are present for cooking, showering and dining. the small walk (less than one minute!!!) to the subway station which will take you to manhattan in around 20 minutes is one big plus. i would definately recommend this appartment for your new york stay.

for someone with low maintenance, and looking for an affordable place in new york city, pettrina’s place is perfect. it’s literally around the corner from the subway station so you can get to the city easily. around the corner are restaurants and bodegas. it may look rough on the outside, but the ppl are actually really nice. would stay with again

everything said in the previous reviews truly hits the variety of aspects one enjoys being hosted in raymond's and heather's guo. my positive experience was an overwhelming one. but words are too poor to describe both hosts' outstanding personalities. they made my stay a unique one starting with the open arms welcome to the amicable farewell. and all that despite their tight schedules as performing artists. the happiness of getting together will last forever. thank you so much raymond and heather. hopefully i will be able to get back to guo on my next trip to nyc.
andres is kind & respectful; apartment is clean, organized, pretty -- would recommend!

this is such a beautiful apartment- george was an incredible host and so many lovely touches , such as a very well equipped kitchen and very comfortable beds . we found it very easy to use the number 7 to travel every day into manhattan. the restaurant recommendations that george gave us were excellent.
for the cost this is a great deal. close to subway, quiet neighbors. locks were a little tricky at first, but you’ll quickly get the hang of it. william was a kind and responsive host.

stayed here for 7 nights with my partner over the new years break. we were after an authentic style new york apartment (kinda what we see in the movies - we’re from australia), and that’s exactly what we got. the pictures reflected the actual apartment. awesome location in relation to both central park, main subway stations as well as a great strip for dining. extremely close to all of those too. well within a five minute walk. evan was super accomodating, quickly answered any questions we had as well as personal recommendations as necessary. we would highly recommend this!
great quiet spot in greenpoint! love the surrounding area and low key vibe.
i really like henry’s place. it is very comfortable and clean. the location is second to none, only one subway station away from manhattan. definitely coming back.

thank you royalton, for being such a great host! i stayed here for my birthday weekend. when i came to check in, i got an upgraded room and complimentary drinks for my boyfriend and i. everything turned out perfectly and the location was better than i expected. i will be booking again.

conveniently located and very responsive host! i stayed here the night before the staten island half as someone who lives in brooklyn and didn't want to get up at 5am to make it to the start line. instead, i slept here and got to the start line in 15 mins!
georgia’s place was as described and in a great neighborhood. quiet and safe, with plenty of street parking available. we would stay again.

we love staying around the locals, and kips bay/murray hill has become a favorite area. steven’s townhome felt like we were locals… and fancy ones at that! his home is iconic and for new york city, we felt like we were living in the golden age. the beds were so comfortable and to wake up to warm tile floors in the bathrooms, heaven! we wished we would’ve cooked in as the kitchen is lovely, well stocked and large dining and family room. loved our time in steven’s townhome. he is a great host! definitely a memorable experience.
brady was very informative and his instructions were clear! the home is very aesthetic and so cute!

great location convenient for getting around the city. friendly helpful staff on arrival right through our week long stay. the apartment was spacious and comfortable, plenty of room for 4 adults. a little noisy at times but it is just steps away from times square. nice common areas on penthouse 1 and 2 levels, basic pastries and tea/coffee in the mornings for breakfast.
clean, organized, safe space to live

this has to be the best rental i've ever stayed in. angie and her entire family were so welcoming that i never felt even for a second that i was away from home. though her family stays in the same premises, we had our full privacy with a dedicated restroom. the facilities provided were top notch with all necessary toiletries provided, new towels stocked for our visit, full access to the kitchen and the refrigerator as well as a washer and dryer available for use at all times. angie has to be one of the most kindest and generous airbnb host i've ever come across and i strongly doubt i ever will again! she is friendly, cheerful and also knows to give you space when you needed. she didn't just share her home with me and my son, but also shared fun and amazing moments with her family and also kept feeding my son! boris ... her cocker spaniel...was one of the best part of my entire stay and i will miss him the most and forever....as he is the first i've ever petted and loved so much.

all my interactions with steve were pleasant and informative. anytime i had a question, steve was quick to address it. this place is a hidden gem, everything is close by or within a reasonable walking distance. i have enjoyed my stay, very quiet place and everyone followed the house rules.

this place is really great. seana went the extra mile to make the house feel extra homey and welcoming. i stayed here for about 7 weeks and would certainly stay here again. 2 minute walk to the subway also. i highly recommend this house and this host.

i bet everyone could have a great time living there. the host is friendly and open to questions about the place. the location is easy to find and quiet at night. more importantly, it’s cheap and worthy!
wonderful stay in the village!!
spacious apartment. great location. quiet neighborhood. accommodating hosts.

mona's place was amazing and really made our trip special. a beautiful studio at a great location, perfectly decorated, comfortable, and welcoming. mona was always quick to respond and accommodating of our travel schedule. we'll absolutely be back next time we're in town.

an incredible stay right by penn station in manhattan. very reasonable price for the quality and location. the 24 hour diner is so great and the hotel has such a fun charm. room was spacious and the view was amazing. 10/10

we had an amazing stay at mustafa’s! he responded immediately when we reached out about a last minute stay. the place is so quiet and beautiful and full of beautiful objects and art. the bed is so comfortable. we received photos to clarify details about how to get the keys and he checked in every step of the way. we felt truly like guests. it’s a great neighborhood with awesome restaurants, close to two subway stops and the lirr. most importantly, after long days out and about, it was a welcome relief to return to a peaceful place that felt like home. thank you mustafa for making us feel so at home! we will be back!
wonderful stay in a great location. had everything i needed for my trip.

i’m not sure if the usual cleaner was off. but the property smelt musty. the furniture in the terrace was very dirty and my friend cleaned it so we could use it. we left our cases on the morning of our departure and when we went back to collect them the cleaner was there and it definitely smelt clean for the next guests. so not sure what happened with our stay.

we had a fantastic stay. no issues what so ever, just pure enjoyment of the flat. definitely recommend it. we have 2 boys and they loved the bunk bed especially hosts were very kind and helpful. the perfect stay

sj was an excellent host. from the point we got there it felt like home. sj remained in contact with us throughout our stay to ensure we had everything we needed. i would definitely recommend you choose to stay at one of sj's apartments, you won't regret it. thanks for everything sj
jaile was very responsive and helpful during our stay. absolutely amazing and wonderful host! in terms of price and privacy, this property is a very nice choice.

unfortunately only stayed at bertha's place very briefly while going back to toronto by train after a long trip across america, but she was extremely friendly and helpful to me and really cares about her guests. the guest room is very clean, comfortable, and nicely set up, with clear instructions. would definitely consider again whenever i am next in the city. thank you!

maxime is an excellent host, he is very friendly and always willing to help in what is needed. the apartment is very nice, it is equipped with everything you need including tv in the room, kitchen elements, microwave, coffee maker, fridge, etc. also, everything is perfectly clean and in order. the place is close to two different train lines (you can reach downtown in about 25 minutes) and there are places to buy food nearby. i highly recommend maxime's apartment to which i would definitely return.
this location is incredibly close to the a train station, and amy is a responsive and friendly host whose home is very comfortable and welcoming.
amazing place! great location and very easy to work with hosts.

daren is a super friendly and kind host. his place is very cozy, just like in the pictures. it’s very close to the subway l and m, both headed to manhattan. there’s also quite a few coffeeshops and bars around there. would definitely recommend it!
this was a great place to stay

i had a great stay overall — the place was totally worth the price, the bed was super comfortable, and everything was clean, warm, and exactly as described. check-in was smooth, the location was convenient, and all the basics you want from an airbnb were solidly handled. it felt like a reliable, no-nonsense spot. plenty of amenities which is always a nice relief. my only real complaint — and i’m clearly not alone here — is the number of rule stickers everywhere. at a certain point it felt like i was being coached by laminated hall monitors. it didn’t ruin the stay by any means, but trimming those down would make the space feel a lot more relaxed. i do however understand good hosts may encounter a streak of bad guests. otherwise, a very good stay and i’d book again.
very helpful staff! cesar always greeted us with a smile

edgar was great with communication leading up to check-in. even though getting into manhattan was a trek, it wasn’t undoable. i didn’t spend much time there, but the room and space were clean. great value.

super clean. a lot of space and right near the metro . had everything we needed for a restful sleep and kitchen for food prep. the deli shop down the street was great for a quick sandwich and the subway is just down the block
bed was terrible dented on the side, carpet looked clean but dusty, dated expensive for the amenities.

i had a fantastic stay at this historic brownstone. the host was extremely responsive and gave clear instructions on how to get inside. the place was exactly as described- clean, comfortable, spacious, and thoughtfully constructed. i’d absolutely stay here again and would highly recommend it to anyone staying in the bushwick area!!!
the host was great, very responsive. the place was small but in a great location.
nice place and waldmer nice and helpful

amazing place to stay. great place to come back to after exploring the city. staff were very friendly and accomodating. great coffee and pastries in the morning. would recommend anyone to stay here. great location - central starting point to all of ny!
alex was very friendly and responsive, and astoria is a nice place to stay. checking in was very simple and convenient.
my stay was great. waldemar was very welcoming, great communication. perfect location.
nathalie was very communicative and helpful when needed. the apartment is beautifully decorated, extremely comfortable and clean. walkable to great restaurants. over all an amazing place to stay!
such a wonderful stay! we enjoyed our trip so much because of the ease of orestes airbnb. we can’t wait to come back

very clean and nice house. the house is modern and almost brand new with beautiful lighting. we could find parking spot easily and there are small restaurants near the house. the host’s recommendation helped a lot.

everything went ok... althought our plane was delayed for many hours, ted (jenny's husband) was there to welcome us. his hints were very helpful. some noise from the metro line, but we slept well however. the room was clean and ted found us coffee for every breakfast... recommended!
great location and host! highly recommended.

everything was accurate as described and posted on the listing . the hosts were both very responsive, privacy was given and they were accessible if needed . i felt safe and at home the entire apartment was beautiful and spotless . we were within range of stores etc if needed , ordered take out and the location was easy to be accessed by the person who delivered the food .overall will definitely stay here again and recommend to others. as far as pricing it was worth it due to the modernization and comfortability of the entire apartment. the ceilings , floor work and wall designs were all astonishing. i rate this a 10/10 ! thank you again for your welcome and hospitality!

great place to stay in brooklyn! right by the subway and a perfect little coffee shop and deli on the way for late night or early morning bites 🤩 location was quite and felt very safe!! 10/10!! can’t wait to visit again!
very clean and comfortable with a nice view on the porch!

we had a wonderful stay in the lovely park slope neighborhood. this unit was just as described and the perfect amount of space for 3-4 people. the host was also super accommodating and let us keep our luggage in the unit later than checkout since we had a late flight on our last day. we would book here again!

we had a great time in square 42 apartments! my family and i were very happy in the 3 bedroom. rooms were clean and bedding was comfortable - the bunk bed room was ideal for us. the entire place was newly updated. the living room was so nice to have and had great windows with a view. the location was exactly what we wanted, right in the center of everything. only a couple blocks from time square. the host was communicative and responded to my texts right away. we would definitely stay here again.

i had a very pleasant stay here. the room was clean and well-prepared, and the instructions provided made check-in and navigating the space very easy. the host was nice and responsive, which i really appreciated. the location is convenient, with several bus lines nearby, making it easy to get around. one thing to note is that there’s no access to the main kitchen, but the room does include a microwave and a fridge (though the fridge can be a bit noisy at times). overall, it was a comfortable stay and a good option if you’re looking for a well-located and tidy place with a helpful host.

amazing stay. will be back! great value and perfect place to stay if not focusing solely on manhattan. explore brooklyn from this apartment whilst also only 30 mins into manhattan on public transport which is a short walk away. laurence was friendly and super helpful with local recommendations etc. prompt communication. apartment was spacious modern private and in a great location. not much else to stay but wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again ❤️
very well kept place, ashek was very friendly and helpful would definitely recommend.

their place was perfect! literally a 5-10 minute walk to central park. the host were very pleasant and helpful. they checked on me everyday to make sure i was fine. any questions i had they were very helpful. the place was super clean and cozy. me and my girlfriend enjoyed our stay!!
nice hosts, close to public transportation.
the space a lovely and looked exactly like photos. i had great stay overall.
bobby was a gracious host. the apartment is beautifully furnished and private. nice location with on-street parking. we had a great time.
lovely stay, would stay here again!
great host! he was such a welcoming person and took me in last minute. highly recommend !!!
lovely spot in the heart of williamsburg! perfect landing place for a longer term stint in new york. would love to return!
great value for the location. really nice to have a private bathroom especially for the price of this airbnb!!
very happy with my stay thanks to amy, fantastic location with things nearby and easy access to other boroughs
we had a lovely stay at andrews place. great location and andrew is very helpful!

michelle and jackson were flexible with my check in time and were super welcoming. they gave me a lot of privacy but made sure to check in and make sure i had everything i needed. the room is very clean, bed was comfortable, and it was surprisingly quiet at night for nyc. close to the subway and a number of good places to eat. a perfect place to stay while visiting nyc.

nash was a great host. he is responsive, flexible, and very respectful of space. i appreciated that i felt like i could use the entire apartment, and parking was extremely easy. he also cleans up the kitchen table, so i could use it. i def recommend nash’s place.

additional fees were hidden under the “show more“ section, which you don’t see unless you click the drop-down. i’ve never been to an airbnb before where they ask for more money once i get there. airbnb should mandate fees be listed in the checkout section, i can no longer trust the “total price“, without digging into all the details to see if they want more money somewhere.
very nice space, great location, quiet neighborhood. really worth it.
accommodated every need. provided breakfast. great spirit.

this is a great room - spacious and clean, and the bed is comfortable. the host communicates very well and is super accommodating. college point is close to flushing, where you can get go to great asian restaurants and shops.
fantastic apartment in a great location close to restaurants, coffee shops, and the subway. annette's place is exactly as pictured and perfectly functional.
pettrina & her place are an absolute brooklyn gem 💎 great price, super sweet mumma who will help you check in, and responsive to issues/ questions that arise.

the laundry room and game area were closed and had been closed for months. they notified us only the day before our reservation. we were banking on these amenities to entertain our kids and minimize packing. the staff was apologetic ands said we could get a refund for our wash and fold bill but they ghosted us after submitting the receipt.
our stay was very peaceful. mike is very helpful and responsive! would definitely book again.
the airbnb was exactly what i was looking for. john was very communicative and friendly. the location was very close to public transit, too, and it was easy to get around. i highly recommend!
we had a wonderful stay!

the listing was exactly as posted and better. the house had absolutely everything you may need. check-in was externally smooth and flexible. host was very easy to contact, and the home was perfect. made my group feel right at home. absolutely would consider using lorrie’s place again.
awesome place in brooklyn, almost brand new apartment with great views and near to the subway stations.
excellent stay. we will come back
very clean and walkable. i had no issue with the stay.

the apartment is in a great location and is walkable to many restaurants and subway stops. it felt very central to anything you would want to do in greenpoint and williamsburg. the space itself was comfortable and clean and had excellent amenities. highly recommended.
i really enjoyed staying in this apartment. great location and great amenities.
lakisha's place was very clean and nice. directions was well written and explained
great ! have nothing bad to say

chrys’ apartment is great. we loved to stay there, it felt like our home away from home. there are so many little things for the guests to make their stay as comfortable as possible, which counts a lot. chrys, thank you for eberything!
best value in manhattan. highly likely to stay there again when i'm next back in nyc.
great location to check out new york city! we’ll stay at this airbnb again!

omg, i loved staying at this location. i'll be booking her place everyone i come to new york. i even went out of my way to buy constance a thank you card. we became really good friends. family friendly, business friendly, gay friendly, art friendly and she knows the city like the back of her hand! what a sweet sweet woman. i'm going to miss her until next time. she really knows how to treat her guests. her place is one of a kind.
great location, and ben was super helpful and accommodating to make my stay work. great place, definitely looking forward to booking again if available!

this space was so perfect for our quick nyc trip. the space itself was so clean and comfy! they provided anything we could need. loved the added touches of toiletries and cold water in fridge. leaving our bags downstairs after check out was the icing on the cake! will definitely be back.
the place was perfect for our weekend in nyc. the location couldn't be better, very clean and the hosts were always helpful and quick to respond. i would definitely recommend it!
jude is a great host! very responsive and helpful. the place is nice, clean, exactly like the description and photos. i liked the decors in his place.
great location with plenty walkable things to do. close to subway stops & easy to find
nice place would stay again.

hands-down recommend jaran & linda's place. my friend and i planned a vacation trip to nyc and happened upon this place that was great for two. we didn't know much about brooklyn let alone bedstuy and we fell in love with the neighborhood. the location is central to great streets full of restaurants, bodegas, cafes, public transport, and more. aside from the amazing community, the stay was everything we could've asked for. communication with linda was impeccable and she was graciously accommodating and welcoming. the apartment was spacious, clean, and the comfort was immediate with this place feeling like a second home to me. linda also had a ton of local recommendations that we definitely followed through on and thoroughly enjoyed. i would 100% stay here again thanks to the hospitality, comfort, and location.
doug was great! super friendly and informative! staying here was such a pleasure. great location and the zen garden in the back is a great escape from the city. 10/10
wow! what a beautiful space in a beautiful location. easy access to all things williamsburg! the hosts were amazingly accommodating & communicative. will definitely return!
she is an amazing host and always replied back immediately. place is great and matches the photos.

loved our time at samara’s place. loved the vibrant art and decor - full of personality and energy. the beds were very comfortable, shower was good and the backyard was a great pleasure. note, it’s hard to tell from the pix but, as the listing does note, it’s a garden apartment so there’s very little natural light. not a problem for us, especially since we could always go chill in the backyard, but just fyi. the location is great - not too far from prospect park. samara was a great host too - super communicative, kind, and helpful, both before and during our stay. i’ll definitely be recommending this place to friends visiting brooklyn!

we arrived in the city without a place to stay (our previously booked and paid for airbnb was “no longer available”. we found vk’s listing and it ended up being perfect- probably even better than our original booking. check-in was smooth and easy and the room was perfect!

clara is a great host. she responded right away and was very accommodating. the rental is clean and simple in a great location. my only suggestion would be to add a chair and a few more counter spaces (coffee table), but that just me... being picky. we may come back at some point in the future. gracias clara! la pasamos super chevere!

very close to the airport. like a 6 minute taxi ride from the terminal. had a overnight layover in jfk and it was super convenient to have somewhere near the airport to catch an early flight. room space was much bigger than i thought and the host was helpful with a mix up during check in
rochel’s space is so nice and looks exactly like the photos. the bathrooms were so clean and had plenty of towels. we really enjoyed our stay, hope to be back soon!

this place is a real gem! i walked in and felt right at home. it's a beautiful space with everything you need. so well located and easy to get to (i took the newark airport express bus straight to port authority and walked 2 blocks and was here!) i slept like a baby. as a solo female traveler i always have to be discerning about where i stay, and i felt so safe with johnny and instantly connected with him. my nyc weekend getaway was a total success, and i hope to come back next year and stay again. highly recommend!

this is a really lovely place. it is beautifully maintained and chris takes pride in it and he is receptive to ideas. very clean very comfortable and 10 minutes walk to three subway stations. i thoroughly enjoyed my two week stay and would highly recommend this apartment.
cozy stay to escape the bustle of the city. the hosts left a coupon for a free pastry and coffee from a cafe right around the corner - a nice extra touch!
the apartment was very clean with very basic accommodations.

katya did a great job of making me feel welcome, helping me find the place and always making me feel like i could ask her about anything. her place was well situated, had all the amenities mentioned and was the perfect place for easy access and close to lots of places and things to see and do. great price, too!

linda’s place was everything we wanted. comfortable, , light-filled, beautiful and historic and in a great location. linda was communicative and had the best recommendations for places to eat in the neighborhood (seraghina was so tasty). would highly recommend linda’s place to anyone looking to visit bed stuy!

we had a very pleasant stay for a month in the upper east side, i would recommend it to anyone, the subway 6 line is just 5 min walking and central park is also 10 min walking, the area is espectacular, while the apartment is a bit old, we did not have any complaints and if we did, they answered shortly and solved our problems! great service!
good hotel with pleasant service. centrally located. the only thing that could have been better was the bed. the mattress was really hard.
this is an apartment in a great location within walking distance of many places and quick subway access to most of new york. the place is comfortable and elegant with good facilities.
its a place where you can call a home 🏡 i would have this place a five star 🌟

fantastic for large groups - i was in a group of 10 and the amount of rooms and bathrooms was perfect. clean space, nice patio opportunities upstairs, great board game selection, well stocked kitchen spaces. safe space with gate, easy access to the subway, walkable neighborhood. responsive host.
great spot with many things to do very clean

juan was a very kind and responsive host. a really nice cat lives here as well. great location that’s right on the subway, so getting into the city and coming back home is really easy. great airbnb, absolutely recommend it :)
view looked just like the pictures. friendly staff and very easy check in and check out process
a wonderful location with everything you need.

my husband and i go to brooklyn to visit our children and grandchildren. marie-line's place is absolutely perfect - it was so clean and beautifully decorated. there was a microwave, coffee maker (with coffee, cups, sugar) and a little frig (with real milk, tropicana orange juice and bottles of water). the bathroom was beautiful also with plenty of towels, a hair dryer and a first aid kit. the last bit was so helpful as i tripped (those brooklyn sidewalks!) and was thankful that there were bandaids and neosporin to dress my scrapes and cuts. there was nothing i would change and i can't wait to go back!
really enjoyed staying at rosa's place in brooklyn! rosa is very kind and the place worked as a great base for exploring brooklyn and manhatten.
the room was exactly what i needed for my stay - a bed, place to shower and a desk. it was comfy and tahirou was a good uncomplicated host.
this address is in a great location. the owners are very responsive. easy walk to broadway, the empire state building, time square, central park and more. many dining choices by this location.

super clean with great amenities and the buffet breakfast was a real win. bed was super comfortable but you could hear sirens pretty loudly from outside however it didn’t keep us up. would definitely stay again! great for walking distance to the barclay centre.

radio hotel's rooms are industrial looking with mid-century custom furniture, nicely designed spaces and a flair of washington heights + dominican culture. loved the vibe. there were folks from everywhere, the food from the dominican restaurant (jalao) at the ground level was delicious and service was friendly, the cappuccino available at the reception area was delicious. highbridge park which is located across the street from the hotel is a wonderful space with sport practicing designated areas, bike and walking routes, playgrounds, and much more. i needed to extend my stay, and while my host, roompicks (through airbnb) couldn't accommodate me, i was able to easily get a new reservation and stay for an extra day. loved the experience and will definitively return to the hotel.

from the moment we booked with blair, she has been nothing but easy to communicate with, helpful, and made us feel comfortable. the apartment was comfy, cozy, and functional. definitely served its purpose for us. i would stay here again, and again. and i would, no doubt, recommend blair to anyone! thanks, blair! (and, remick!) ❤️
place was in a perfect location.

the place was as advertised and gregory was very responsive with my questions. it was conveniently located within a 10 minute walk to the train station. the bedrooms and bathrooms were clean and neatly appointed. all amenities provided in the rooms made our stay comfortable and enjoyable. if i visit nyc again i would definitely stay at gregory's place and would strongly recommend this place to other visitors.

i really enjoyed my stay at louann's home; the room is very clean and full of useful amenities. a lot of love and care has been put into furnishing and decorating the space. 10/10, i highly recommend!
if you are looking for a place to lay your head down and sleep it is great. nice tv in bedroom if you want to hang out.

i rented this airbnb for my brother who unexpectedly needed to change his flight for school. peter was not only incredibly accommodating with the quick check in, he was also just a wonderful host throughout my brother's stay. he even brought him a plate of turkey dinner on thanksgiving!
i enjoyed staying at anthony’s place. the space was spacious, clean and comfortable. will definitely stay again when in the area. highly recommend!

nice location, near metro lines and in a residential area, out of the noise. in 20min you can reach downtown thanks to the express line. the host was friendly and helpful. we much appreciated the precise indications and pictures about the flat location and check in. the apt is shared with the host. the bedroom is in fact the living room with a sofabed made more comfy thanks to a thin mattress on top. the room has however everything from towels to coffee maker, bin, towels and usb ports. overall a good experience for a few days stay.
