overall, we had a good stay. the apartment was clean and nicely updated which made it feel comfortable and modern. the location was convenient about a 10-minute walk to the train station, with plenty of food options right on the street near the airbnb, plus a nearby plaza with even more restaurants and stores. it’s located in queens, so getting to manhattan (like times square) takes about 45–50 minutes by train, which is just something to plan for. we did experience a heater issue during the first couple of nights, but the host checked on it and airbnb helped resolve the situation. overall, it was a pleasant stay and a solid option for the area.
this place is located in the center of some amazing attractions. the third floor bar/recreation was amazing. i would definitely stay there and again.
close to everything. 25 minutes from manhattan(car) enjoyed my time and it even snowed!

the communication was clear, looks like the picture. good value for money, but there is scope for improvement. for example, plates, cups were not clean, there were mold in the shower curtain, comforter in one of the bedrooms smells bad.
we loved everything about this air bnb from the location to the experience of being in new york.

this host is terrible, disgustingly untrustworthy and unresponsive. it was confirmed over airbnb chat i could extend my stay, then ignored for days while i followed up over airbnb chat, email, and phone to multiple members of the team. a few hours before checkout, i called airbnb support as i still hadn’t heard back. they said the unit was still available and i had no problem staying, they would block the dates and escalate a response from the owner. just 20 minutes before checkout, the owner finally got back and claimed i couldn’t stay anymore as there were no units—despite having over 40 listings, many still available on airbnb. they are unresponsive, unhelpful, and blatantly dishonest. this was the most stressful and frustrating airbnb experience i’ve ever had putting me out on the street without warning and nowhere to go. the cost and location was attractive but i would avoid at all costs.

the stay was great! the process from check in to check out was pretty smooth! it's close to public transport, however it takes good 40/45 minutes to reach manhattan times square or nearby tourist spots! apart from this, the rooms were awesome, the kitchen was well equipped and living room was spacious enough too!

shemi’s place was perfect for my family and i. easy access. shemi’s instructions were clear and he was very responsive . i would say that there were some men sitting on the steps when we arrived. however, they were mannerly and moved immediately so that we can pass. the house was very clean and looked exactly how it was displayed . the bathroom was small but clean. the bedrooms were also clean but i would appreciate more pillows. the location was very convenient. it was a 5/7 minute walk to the subway, where we were able to catch the 3 or 4 train to get to manhattan. the neighborhood was very busy and safe, they were people on the road most hours of the night. my family and i will definitely stay there again. thank you shemi!
great location, great view, great value! elevator situation could be better, but we weren’t going up and down a lot.

5 day stay that turned into a 1 day stay because i ended up moving into my new apartment sooner than expected! location is fantastic and the apartment is exactly what you need as a single traveler! would stay again, brad was great with communication!
great location, réactive communication, charming apartment. would stay again!
vida was a really friendly and helpful host, very responsive and keen to help us enjoy our stay

dee’s place was the perfect fit for my family and i. it is very conveniently located by many fast food restaurants, near the subway station, and even near a great food market. upon leaving we accidentally left some items behind and dee was very helpful in contacting me asap and assisted us with shipping our items same day! we are very thankful to have an honest great host, would definitely come back.

after lots of walking, elliot's place gave us a well-needed place to rest and plan for the upcoming days. there was a subway station a few blocks down that made it easy to travel around the city. several places to eat as well.
i loved it will be booking next time thank you
kate was very kind and helpful! super responsive and the area is super great with lines to every subway. the room was very homey and furnished well. was nice using the gym in the building too.

was in town for a long work commitment and could not have been happier with my stay. perry is so kind and friendly and quick to respond, and beyond helpful. the location is incredible, the amenities were great (everything you need plus lots of lovely touches and personal notes and snacks), the space is stylish and clean with lovely views. the apartment was quiet at night which is amazing in nyc. i strongly recommend to anyone looking for a good base in nyc. it is perfect.
great host and place!

the flat was nice and fit our purpose nicely. there are good kitchen facilities, so we were able to make breakfast. shah was helpful and check-in/out went off without a hitch. great price. if you're noise sensitive this flat might not be for you. passing trains and noises in the rest of the house/flat are quite audible. all in all, we would stay here again.
roy was friendly and very responsive. i had a great stay. i would come back to stay here again!
really wonderful stay! no issues at all and very convenient stay! 10/10 would stay again!! loved it
really great place for an amazing price! will defiantly be coming back
place was clean and comfortable, fakhar is a very thoughtful and attentive host who goes far out of his way to make sure you are taken care of. would stay here again anytime!
the host was very nice and the place was very quiet.

this is a nice "garden" apartment in queens. it has a good location (two blocks from smith street where there is lots of shopping and restaurants). the apartment was clean, the bed was very comfortable and the hosts had all kinds of great amenities such as a variety of coffees, sugar, half-and-half, a bowl of assorted candies (like halloween candies), bottled water in the refrigerator, etc. big tv in living room and a smaller version in the bedroom--both samsung. i didn't cook in the place so i can't attest as to the quality of the oven, etc. the washer and dryer work well but are small. i have no complaints about the place and would not hesitate to stay there again.
as described, great location with plenty of street parking. clean, quiet, cozy space.

i stayed for 2 months, and felt welcomed and right at home. kaina was a fantastic host who made sure the place was clean and well stocked with toiletries. she was helpful and very responsive. also her film showings that she hosts once a month are amazing! and the train station is a 2 minute walk from the place makes getting to manhattan very is easy (about 20-25 minutes) 10/10 would recommend 😁

best deal in rockaway. it’s a small apartment, laid out to feel roomy and comfortable. naomi kindly leaves plenty of drinks and snacks and now i’m spoiled. the beach chairs and towels and cart are so appreciated! she goes above and beyond, which is why this is my second stay. i look forward to coming back!
great everything its super clean and legit. very new building and a huge new laundromat around the corner!
irina is such a lovely person and also her husband. it was a pleasure to stay with them. my room was really nice and clean. i would stay with them again. the communication was also very easy:)

it needs amenities like iron, dryer, etc kitchen need things like sugar, tea, water, etc the whole apartment smelled of marihuana it also needs a mirror in the bathroom and full length mirror in the rooms

anthony was a very gracious and accepting host. he was able to accommodate me for a late check in time, which i appreciated. the location turned out to be very convenient in terms of having access to local transportation options. i found the space to be very comfortable and just right for my brief stay. i would highly recommend this place for anyone who wants to stay in brooklyn, and would not hesitate to stay here again myself.

my daughter and i had a wonderful long weekend at the michelangelo hotel. we arrived early and were able to check in around 12:30. we upgraded to a studio king which was a small extra cost ($25/day). it was much more spacious than i expected for a hotel in new york. we had a king-sized bed, a small couch and and chair, and then a closet, a vanity area with sink, and a spearate tub and toilet. it felt very luxurious! i also asked to be in a quiet part of the hotel, which it definitely was. we didn't hear any noise and were able to sleep well. i also appreciated the $10 credit each day at the restaurant. it meant i could go down and get a cappucino each morning without leaving the hotel. the staff were super nice and helpful. i will definitely be coming back to this hotel!
lou's place is clean and quiet. perfect for a quick trip to the city.

great location literally steps away from the subway into manhattan. beautiful location and great restaurants less than ten mins walk. great hosts, very accommodating, helpful, quick to reply. would highly recommend!

it was a great location and the room was fine. but, lack of communication, expectation, and issues with the only place that matters in a space that small; the bathroom, made it difficult to do much. essentially a launching pad and nothing more than a bed, where, even in nyc, was not worth the price in my opinion… there was also hesitance from the host in response to telling people it was an airbnb and his roomate, while kind, had to do most of the upkeeping of which there was very little and yet, little done. i think elliot is a nice guy, but wouldn’t recommend staying there unless literally a bed is the only thing you want.

beautiful place! leyla was very accommodating and responsive host! i felt extremely comfortable and the photos matched the space exactly! also, it’s located in best neighborhood in new york! definitely will book again when i’m back in the area for sure!!! thank you!

really nice appartment, clean and comfortable ! devon has been really kind and was always ready to help ! i also had the pleasure to meet evan who took the time to show me around, which was really kind of him ! the neighborhood is totally safe, being a girl on my own, i had not any kind of problem. :) i had a wonderful stay in nyc, and i highly reccomend to stay here : just next to central park and the subway station 72nd street, really close to the museum of natural history and surrounded by plenty of nice cafés and restaurants. thank you so much devon !
always a pleasure to be here.
it is a very good place to stay! we had a wonderful time!
maurice is a great host! the apartment is exactly what it promises to be! we had a very good time!
alex is a very accommodating host and owns a perfect apartment for your stay in new york/brooklyn. i will definitely recommend this place to my friends and family in case they want to travel to nyc.

my stay was generally a positive experience, and an excellent value to boot, but there were a number of "good, but" factors that made it, for me, a four-star rather than a five-star overall rating. i'll try to sort this out by category. >>> price and value: given airbnb's variable "smart pricing," i lucked into a great price. for example, i just checked the cost of several different stays here over the coming year. the daily rates ranged from about 50% more than what i paid to about three times. of course, everyone has a different perception of what constitutes good value. >>> location: this would be the main reason i'd come back. it's an easy half-mile walk from the 7 line (the listing says seven minutes, but that's only if you're moving really, really fast) for a quick trip into manhattan or to citi field. there's also a bus a half block away that will take you to two other stations on the line -- one with an elevator -- in about 10-15 minutes, depending on traffic. another bus at that stop will take you to williamsburg, in brooklyn. also within walking distance is a remarkable multi-national assortment of restaurants and shops. (don't miss de mole.) and within a few stops on the 7 line are even more restaurants and shops, a few museums in queens, plus access to the lirr. the neighborhood is safe and quiet; no worries there at all. >>> bedroom/bathroom: the mattress was a very comfortable medium-firm tempurpedic. as you can see in the pictures, there's a ton of dresser and closet space. it was a nice shower, with plenty of hot water. great towels, but no washcloth. the older in-wall a/c was loud but worked well. as with most older houses, you could hear footsteps from upstairs, but it was quiet from about 10 pm to 7 am. (and, fortunately, the other two occupants on my floor were reasonably quiet.) the headboard and dresser were stylish, but there was just a folding table and folding chair (not the office chair that's in the pictures) to use as a desk. there's a simple doorknob lock for when you're in the room. a dedicated key lock would have been better, but i was told nyc doesn't allow that. the walls were completely bare except for a construction mark. >>> cleanliness: generally ok, but a few slips made this four stars instead of five. there was some debris on the plush bath mat, so clearly it hadn't been carefully vacuumed or shaken out. the a/c filter was very dirty. (i cleaned it.) the bathroom exhaust fan also looked dirty. (i didn't clean it, but it's probably clean by now.) the other occupants were somewhat lax at cleaning up after themselves in the kitchen, but things improved after i mentioned this to the caretaker ernesto. >>> communication: generally good. i recommend using airbnb messaging to communicate with jose, if needed. (and definitely download the airbnb app.) ernesto was helpful, but his command of english wasn't always the best. also, on one occasion, while i was in the bedroom with the door unlocked and closed, he knocked but started to enter before i had a chance to respond. obviously i didn't appreciate the intrusion. >>> other stuff: do be sure to read all of the house rules before you request a booking. i certainly understand and support the concerns about safety, cleanliness, etc., and i know that some guests can try to take advantage of a host's hospitality, but a few of the rules sounded more like a hostel's than an airbnb's -- for example, $10 for an extra set of towels or $15 for extra bed linens. i'm very neat and leave a small footprint, so i decided to go ahead with the booking anyway.

perfect space for my 12year old son and myself to use as first time new york visitors. the space was tidy and cute and provided what was needed. we were able to save money by cooking breakfast at ‘home’ and the little market around the corner had everything we needed. lee and teri were responsive and for us, perfect hosts!
great location and very new york like place. comfortable beds and amicable hosts.

yet another fabulous stay in brooklyn in the "sunny boerum hill apartment!" this was my 3rd or 4th stay and i'll be back again and again. this comfortable and exceptionally clean apartment has everything you need for a few days or a few weeks in new york city, including a modern kitchen, bath and laundry. it is located in a wonderful area near brooklyn heights and cobble hill/carroll gardens, and is within a short walk to several subway stations as well as many restaurants and plenty of shops. the owners live upstairs but you will see them only as much as you like. they are responsive and helpful with plenty of suggestions should you need them. the wifi is great and the bed very comfy... what more could you ask? thank you again, judy and sascha! see you in october!
great place to stay, pretty spacious, and not too far from the subway and other restaurants. would definitely come back.

great location, central and walkable. rooms are nothing fancy but do the job. the staff at check in were so friendly and helpful, they gave me a bottle of water on arrival. i asked on checkout if it was possible to have a bottle and was pointed at the gift shop. also i was told there would be a $34 ish charge per night as tax. on check out of only one night it was over $130!! inconsistency on the front desk.

our stay was wonderful! pierce was incredibly nice and easy to contact. we were able to get around brooklyn and the city really easily. the apartment also has everything you could need, pierce really thought of everything. we kept saying “oh they have this too!”. the neighborhood was calm and a nice place to get away to after touring the busy city. highly recommend staying here and we hope to visit again!
clean but very small. the garden is really the leaves of some street trees. not very polite or accommodating but not mean just very business like
the place is clean, stylish, and roomy and in a safe location easy accessible to manhattan. host responds quickly, and check in is easy. would recommend!
great location with great metro connectivity into the rest of manhattan. very nice appartement
amazing location if you want to explore coney island! galla is a great host and was very attentive to what we needed during our trip. i highly recommend staying here!

space was great. room was very comfortable, making for a great place to lay your head. location close to train, but still on a quiet street. thoughtful touches and basic kitchen condiments included. television and workspace makes for a good spot to rest or work in case it rains on saturdays. great sunlight in the apartment. the garden doors to the apartment are generally kept open, however, the bedrooms have doors with locks for privacy when needed. overall, great apartment and yvette gave a welcoming overview of the space.

this was my first time using airbnb, and i’m super happy about my decision to stay at jilly’s. it was a beautiful place and great experience! very responsive and helped with any questions that i had. i really appreciate the kindness and understanding. i will most definitely be booking here again, maybe on a regular basis during my travels to brooklyn! it definitely was a pleasure and beautiful. i recommend staying here!! 🤩🙂‍↕️💕

so, here is how it started. i drove 4 hours from dc and thanks to waze landed right in front of paget's house. i parked right in front, next to the fire hydrant and unloaded my things quickly. the yale lock worked perfectly, allowing me to get back to the car before it was ticketed. i started the car and didn't see another real parking space. bummer. but then a miracle happened! the lights of the car behind mine came on. i was able to back up and park legally right near the front gate. i wanted to kiss the driver. a miracle. after the parking miracle, i knew everything would be perfect and easy. and i was correct...paget is a lovely person; she was most helpful, caring and accommodating. the apartment is immaculate, light and comfortably furnished. the bathroom has a small japanese like tub...lots of hot water and harry brand soap. wow, i was relaxed and ready for what would become a long family dinner out that night. the bedroom's big window overlooks the garden. i found time to sit in the garden, get some sunlight and marvel at the trees and architecture of old brooklyn's rebirth. the mattress is so very comfortable and the sheets stylish and lively. hooks and drawers galore and a very good closet in the other room held all the extra clothes i didn't need. brooklyn is a casual place. i wish for those reading this to find the same comfort, ease and pleasantness that i found as paget's guest.
place was exactly as described, host was kind and helpful. we parked directly in front of the building, and could see our car from the window. it is quite loud at night, but manageable.
the place is clean and very well located.

our family stayed in michael’s house while attending our daughter’s wedding. the house is spacious and well-appointed. it’s walkable to restaurants and important services like groceries and the subway. highly recommend

shemi was great to deal with. my husband and i came to ny to see our children and grandchild so the place was close to them and in the community. the place was clean and well lit, and we found a closet with a bigger table that we used for shabbos in the bigger bedroom.

this was my first experience at airbnb and it was very nice ann and her husband were really great and we had a great time there!! the place was clean and very comfortable it was located in brooklyn and it was a 10 minute walk to the nearest subway station it was the perfect place for a weekend thanks for everything !!
this place has always been very accombodating
inside was nice modern and good host, good amenity’s.
diavanna was the perfect host for our stay, very considerate and responded quickly to all concerns. also, the location and interior is so cute!! i will definitely come back soon.
great location and very comfortable beds. nice having a kitchenette, perfect for our trip. would definitely stay here again next time we visit nyc.

pedro is a fantastic host! he is extremely responsive and quick to problem solve. we were here for an extended stay for work and although we had several small issues, he was quick to respond and resolve. we didn’t have a working refrigerator when we arrived and he had a small, portable unit available until the refrigerator could be replaced. he then offered a free cleaning. we had several issues with inadequate heat, and he provided space heaters until the heating issues were resolved and when the wifi repeatedly went out, he replaced it with a new router. the unit is large, so my 2 colleagues and i had comfortable space. it is 1 block from the elevated train, so the back bedrooms are noisy. the neighborhood is south williamsburg, about a mile walk from the trendy-hip area of williamsburg. the building has a backyard, but it was winter, so we didn’t use it. apparently it is only accessible through the first floor unit, so it’s not clear how we could have used it if we wanted too. there is parking and a building washer/dryer.
very clean! was a good stay

do not stay here if you expect a private space or what is advertised. i have never written a negative review for anything, so i don’t write this lightly. the add for this bnb is very misleading. it is not an entire apartment but rather a small side room in a basement suite. a piece of particle board covers a door into the rest of the suite where the host lives. it is a shared space. you can hear everything in the rest of the house, both the people upstairs and the host next door. there is no kitchen. it’s far too expensive for what’s offered. it has a strong smell of mothballs and mildew. just to reiterate, it is 100% a shared space but is not advertised as such. do not stay here
alexandra’s place was amazing, great decor, location,etc she was really helpful and kind.

mike is a very kind and generous person. my check in nite was very cold and rainy and i was about to go back out to an electronics store to buy a charger for my cellphone mike produced a brand new spare charger and offered to sell it to me at a very reasonable price. he was very helpful in explaining the neighborhood, and really went the extra mile in making me feel welcome. i will certainly look to come back to mike’s

such a clean and well organized space that was perfect for my work trip in the upper east side. walkable to many things, including the 4/5/6 train that gets you almost anywhere you need to go! also, responses to any questions were always very fast.
great location, very clean, beautiful space

our stay at maya‘s apartment in greenpoint brooklyn was fantastic. her place was clean and beautifully decorated and we loved the landscape of the apartment. she had al the amenities we needed and the bed was comfortable. the street was quiet and the apartment is walking distance to the best restaurants, bars and shops. we enjoyed a couples massage at the greenpoint spa (highly recommend) and we ate twice at la gamin (delish). we had my nieces wedding to attend and made it a three day getaway of fun and relaxation. we highly recommend this airbnb and we will definitely stay here again. ❤️🙏🏻
amazing location, very clean and host is always there to help you with what you need!
the place was really cozy during the hash win ters

kathryn is a wonderful host. very hospitable, responsive to messages, and left clear instructions for everything. she also gave us directions to the nearby grocery store and recommended a coffee shop. the thing that stood out to me the most was the extra treats that were included—tea and coffee, baked goods, and chocolate. it was a lovely stay!
really great experience. staff was super friendly
nice place, the locación is perfect.
joseph is a great host. the apartment is exactly as advertised and is in a great location. check in was easy, and i felt welcome immediately. i will absolutely stay again if there’s availability.
overall, had a good experience with him would stay there again

this place is in a great location if you are planning to go all around manhattan. friendly staff. a little dated, but clean rooms that were pretty spacious compared to some other places i’ve stayed. this listing is for two connecting hotel rooms. we stayed in the south tower. very quiet at night considering it’s in midtown. air conditioning was solid. we didn’t go to the sushi restaurant but thought the concept was cool.
aaron was a great host, responsive with messages and a great help, and a genuine care for his guests!
stephanie was an amazing host! as soon as i contacted her, i had response within minutes. the place is outstanding and the views are amazing. loved staying there.

the location is great. the subway station is a short walk and easy to get anywhere in the city. there were restaurants all around. the lock box made it easy to check in and out. the bed was a little too stiff for my liking and the pillows didn’t have much support but the stay was pleasant. i enjoyed the style and the suggestions of what to do in the city. kumar was quick to respond and a great host.
house was great. very easy to get to manhattan and there was a lot of stuff to do nearby as well. everything was as described and very clean.
great soft beautiful space to land in bedstuy
bobby was very helpful at responding and sending us all of the info we needed. comfortable, nice amenities in a convenient location.

eli’s place was well equipped right next to kp mall.. their is a restaurant right around the corner called ii posto.. available for take out and dine in. i enjoyed my food from their also wide delivery options are available for the italian taste such as knapp pizza. this studio has a sauna .. with a radio inside of it very great set up. my experience was wonderful with the steaming experience the temperature was perfect also theirs a radio inside of the sauna with led lights exterior/interior. extra bedding provided in the drawers. towels were set up in the bathroom and sauna. place was very clean and smelling fresh. hulu , netflix , and dozens of more apps available on the television set upon your choice. bed has changeable led lighting, pool table perfect sofa couches. kitchen is well equipped for long stays with a fridge.. patio available outside for sitting under the roof preferably for warmer days haven’t got to experience it due to weather but surely its a great time. 5/5 stars.

this room was great as i was really only in to sleep! bed was super comfy and i enjoyed the option of turning on the big screen if i wanted to catch up on a show before bed :) will def stay here again as i loved the location!
good spot if you wanna ditch your things and don't plan on staying there other than sleep, for a couple days. i would need more if i were to stay for long period of time. super clean tho

stayed for almost 2 months, and was very amazing experience. clear instructions from the host from beginning to end. the apartment looked exactly like the photos—clean, neat, and well-prepared upon check-in with a well-functioning bathroom and a lovely kitchen, and all essentials were provided. the location is absolutely the very central manhattan, with very great neighbourhood — safe, vibrant, and very convenient, with a convenience store just downstairs and plenty of restaurants within walking distance. definitely worth the price for the location and quality. absolutely stay here again the next time in new york.
great location and super clean and comfortable. easy entrance and felt very safe.
justin was a great hose, very responsive and check in/out was a breeze. the place is walkable to many great restaurants and the train station. highly recommend.

we had such a great time in new york and staying in williamsburg, brooklyn gave us an authentic nyc experience. we loved our time in new york. sid's place is so authentic downtown loft which was cosy and comfortable. sid was easy going, friendly and offered heaps of recommendations for us to get the best experience. we loved the cats and they loved us (they slept in our room with us 🥰) they were friendly and cuddly and completed the homey feeling. can't rave enough about this place! we already miss new york.

cristina and robert are so nice and welcoming. the room is spacious and well equipped. about 10 minutes away from the subway station. the neighborhood feels safe and peaceful. had a great time, thank you 🙏🏻

the listing showed as a “2-bedroom,” but it’s actually a 3. during my stay, one room had 5 people (3 adults, 2 kids), meaning 8 people total were sharing one bathroom — far more than expected. the kids frequently left urine all over the bathroom, making it unpleasant to use. a longer-term guest mentioned it’s common for entire families to occupy one room even though the listing says maximum of 2 people. the apartment was not clean, with water damage on the ceiling in my room, dust everywhere, and a very dirty main area. i spoke with guests on another floor who had been in our unit for laundry, and they said this unit is especially dirty and run down. my room had no light bulbs, and there’s no system for organizing food storage, so shared spaces felt cramped and chaotic. overall, the setup and conditions were very different from what the listing suggested. if you are wanting to stay in bed-stuy, i would stay on the 3rd floor or preferably another apartment.

this was a perfect spot to stay at while visiting brooklyn and manhattan for the week! beautifully and thoughtfully decorated by our friendly hosts (a+ for coffee table books!), great deli's on both sides of the street, safe location, just a few blocks from the subway into the city, hot water, full kitchen, super comfortable bed and bedding - everything you could ask for in a stay. highly recommend staying at josh and victoria's!
paul was super responsive and helpful! i had a wonderful stay.

carol was out of town but she arranged for joy to meet us at the residence . we had a wonderful visit and were in walking distance of my son's home. the room was very clean and cozy. this was the second time we have stayed here. would highly recommend it.
loved staying here in jane’s place! it was an easy location to get to and had amazing places to eat + amenities around the area. the apartment it’s self was super clean and beautiful. thank you jane!
catia’s place is amazing. it’s gorgeous and cozy, i am using it as inspiration my my own bedroom remodel. everything was clean and communication was great. i highly recommend.

the host was great about communication. better than i was and really appreciate that and he gave some good recommendations. location, what a great location. we took the train to a lot and it was perfect. by the end i was finally picking up the train system. i saw some mentioned the outside noise & you do hear the outside noise but it's also greenwich village in nyc. it's expected in my opinion. all in all, good experience and you feel like you live in ny with everything.

jessica was very friendly and responded quickly to my message and any questions! she had stocked the fridge up with drinks, which was very kind of her! we had everything we needed. first night was a bit noisey upstairs but second night was fine. the tube was very close about 7min walk and lots of supermarkets round! easy access to the house
we loved staying at giovanni’s place! the room was perfect and we felt at home.
natalia was really friendly and helpful, the room was clean and comfortable, definitely recommend!

we enjoyed our stay at patty’s place so much! it’s a great loft studio in the bustling and arty lower east side/chinatown hood, with great restaurants and nightlife steps away. patty was super communicative and easy to call/text with questions. highly recommended.
jane’s apartment exceeded our expectations... we loved it here! charming, clean, awesome location. would love to come back and would definitely recommend staying here!
this place has such great access to the subway and is a lovely apartment. eric was a great host, would highly recommend.

carla's place is clean, beautiful, comfortable, everything you need and a fabulous location. she responded quickly to any questions i had. we were very comfortable and enjoyed our visit to brooklyn so much--and part of that was due to staying at carla's place. i highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reasonable, comfortable, great location place in brooklyn!
it was exactly as described, and had everything i needed.
really liked this hotel. will be back.

erica’s place is truly a sanctuary away from the hustle and bustle of nyc! i was really impressed by how spacious and clean the apartment was - it made me forget that i was in nyc for a second! i’d definitely stay here again.
lawrence was very responsive and helpful. the apartment is spacious and in a great location. the whole process was easy and efficient.

the stay was nice and the hosts were accommodating. however, the check-in was a bit disjointed and several key supplies we’re not originally available. also, you might want to have ear plugs available as freeway noise was intermittently a factor.
enjoyed our stay at micheline. place was as described and my family and i found it very warm and comfortable. would definitely visit again.

beautiful spacious apartment in a great neighborhood. large remodeled kitchen with every amenity. we enjoyed sipping coffee on the back private patio accessible from the primary bedroom. bathroom was clean, bright and new. i highly recommend this property.

this was our third year staying at joy's apartment and we feel so lucky that we get to be there. the apt is clean and large by nyc apartment standards and had everything we needed in the kitchen and bathroom. we had plenty of closet and drawer space, there is a table for dining and also a work desk for computer work. the location is quiet and just 3 blocks from the subway. i always felt safe traveling by myself at night. she is a great and fast communicator for any issues. thank you again joy!

the place is so clean and comfortable. great access to the manhattan area, and you can enjoy creative neighborhood as well. jonathan is so kind that he always takes care about traveler and it was great experience for me. i highly recommend the place.

a wonderfully peaceful place to stay, surprisingly so given it’s location. the subway to manhattan was a reasonable walk away. we had a choice of restaurants within a couple of blocks and ended up at a wonderful thai restaurant a block and a half away. dawa and phurpa are kind and accommodating hosts, a complete pleasure to meet. would definitely stay again.
great location right by the a train. clean, spacious apartment. romero was very helpful and responsive :)

i surprised my cousin with this stay and she loved it. the layout of the apartment is very unique and looks exactly like the photos. the night view was very serene and the neighborhood was very quiet. the host made himself available when needed which was perfect. i would definitely recommend this place!
everything is as advertised and you get what you pay for 🤷🏽‍♀️

i loved this apartment, it was absolutely ideal for me and my son. melissa and cary are both very friendly and helpful, i couldn't have wished for better hosts. i would thoroughly recommend this apartment for anyone wishing to stay in nyc. it's close links to restaurants, cafes, gyms and subway system make this location perfect. i will definitely use this apartment again if i need to return to new york.
i loved this airbnb!! the host was extremely accomodating, kind, and helpful. the apartment itself with extremely clean. and the location was amazing!!

she was excellent in communicating with us before/after checking in. the apartment is small with no exterior windows, so it's dark. we were out and about so it didn't bother us. the place is a bit cluttered but b left us enough space for our clothing to hang, etc

danielle's house is so charming. once you walk in, you feel at home. the duplex apartment is huge with plenty of space. we found everything we needed. and danielle is a wonderful host. she greeted us with a big smile and fruits. she was very helpful and communicated very well throughout the whole process. the neighborhood is really beautiful and safe. we found parking every time. i will definitely stay there again and i do recommend danielle's house. thank you for having us.
exactly as described. great location. good, clean room.

our stay at chito and xavier's place was absolutely fantastic. the apartment was so homey and possibly the cleanest i have ever stayed at (easily comparable to a hotel). they thought of every last thing a guest may need, including extra pillows and blankets in the linen closet, making the stay all the more enjoyable. it was a short walk away from a subway station, and we felt very safe staying in the apartment. chito and xavier were wonderful hosts, and they clearly care so much about their guests. we would defintely stay here again on our next visit to new york city.
morlisa was a wonderful host, was quick to respond, and was always ready to give us input and suggestions! the snacks and beverages she had available for us were a great touch!
easy walk to bus, subway, manhattan school of music, and more.
julia is hostess extraordinaire. she makes you feel welcome and has a list of local recommendations when you arrive. the place is super clean and a great location to explore dumbo.
beautiful apartment in a very walkable and accessible neighborhood. it was very easy to get in and out of manhattan. paul and gia made us feel very welcomed and were quick to respond or offer help.
michelle is a good host. we enjoyed our stay and the room/house were comfortable and cozy. she is very accommodating to our need.
very cozy place and the host was very responsive and helpful.

the unit was very clean, super convenient, and had amazing amenities. i think being next to prospect park is a huge plus and there is so much space. great location for short term and probably also longer term stays. hosts definitely thought through nice decor and toiletries.

sarah was a warm, welcoming, and gracious host during our stay. the cottage was well furnished and maintained; and it had a sunlight that was just beautiful. the outdoor garden area outside of the cottage was perfect for brunch and getting work done in the morning. restaurants are nearby and the neighborhood was charming. we ate at putnam's both mornings. the only hiccup that we experienced was upon arrival when our key to gate wouldn't work. fortunately, sarah answered immediately and we got everything squared away. i would definitely stay here again!

virginia was a great host. everything she described was true and correct. i really enjoyed the location and cozy feel of her air bnb. i highly recommend staying here. the subway is so close and getting around was easy. virginia responds quickly and it amazing! thank you for everything virginia!

it was a nice apartment, bigger than we were expecting. we found the location to be good. we were able to get to manhattan for work, we were able to explore the food scene in brooklyn at night, and it was a quick commute to the airport for our early morning flight. we are uberers so i can't talk about public transportation but the location worked of uber.

dawn was awesome and the house was perfect. it was our first time in nyc, she took the time to write us some pointers on the city and gave us complimentary subway cards. i would highly suggest her house to anyone.
great place to stay if you need a place to work while exploring brooklyn. a little out of the way but close to many areas. definitely amazing value.

donavan was very personable, and patient with my delayed arrival. the room was comfortable, and the neighborhood was great. good central location if you are looking to travel to varied areas, such as williamsburg and prospect park.
great stay! already looking to book again !

this cozy apartment is well stocked with everything needed for a long stay (except for a washer/dryer). it's on the 2nd floor of a walk-up and a short walk from the broadway subway station (g line). downside is that there's a shared door (accessed by the interior stairs) with the tenants on the floor above, and the walls are extremely thin. so, i could hear every conversation the tenants above me had very clearly as if they were in the same room with me. i could easily hear when they played music, washed dishes, or watched tv. i felt uncomfortable knowing that the strangers above me could probably hear my private conversations just as easily as i could theirs. if you don't intend to spend a lot of time in the apartment, then this may not be as much of an issue for you since they were quiet at night. couch was old and not very comfortable. there's central heating so you'll need to contact the host every time you need to adjust the temperature. the host was very responsive.
place is amazing 10/10 will book again!!
had a great stay here. would choose this place again if i were to travel back!

anastasiya's place was perfect for the time that i spent there! the place was well situated in the neighborhood, walkable to lots of great spots, and clean. she was very responsive and flexible with me, which i appreciated so much!
awesome - love the vibez.
annas place is in a great location. it was surprisingly quiet for being in williamsburg. she is a lovely host.
had an amazing stay

the room was smaller than shown in the photos. very thin walls, you can hear what’s happening in a hallway and the rooms around you. the housekeeper was clearly sick. they are also charging an additional daily fee while checking in. the location is pretty good though

this was my second time staying at raymonds. he is such an amazing person and the best host i've ever known. the place is as described: an oasis. the location is excellent, the subway is close and lots of restaurantes and shops around. i'm sure you will get the full ny experience.

amer's place is one of the best homes ive stayed at! the neighborhood is beautiful & quiet, amer was very kind and helpful! the home was absolutely stunning, clean, cozy, & private. i have no complaints and highly recommend this home. thanks so much for being an amazing host amer!
great place for a group to stay in.

the place was very clean, cute, and comfortable. viviana was a great host, very responsive in answering questions/concerns i had, she had great recommendations for local restaurants, and was above and beyond in accommmodating us, for example, she provided items specifically for us traveling w/a toddler (baby tub, bottle rack, pack and play). light housekeeping was done every other day or so. viviana was also very patient when we had several changes in booking days and number of people staying with us. the area is walking distance to lots of great brooklyn highlights and easy to get to manhattab with public transport.
steven and he’s place is great 👍🏻 the room was clean and relaxing steven other house mate are very friendly. i highly recommend 5 ⭐️ 😃

i was really excited to stay here because it was so close to family and had great reviews now i can’t say the communication was great but overall i was underwhelmed the pictures on the listing or chloe from when they first listed it and you can tell many people have stay there there were no couch pillows on the couch just a decorative pillows. also i understand it’s a basement apartment i’ve lived in a basement apartment and they can’t get rather cold however the small heater that was on the wall barely put out any heat definitely not enough to heat the year i contacted the host and was told there was a heater in the closet i got it out plugged it in but it doesn’t work so the entire time we stay there i was freezing cold luckily we were only there to sleep but again i was freezing cold. 3rd i have a five and a six roll so i know a little kids can be loud however i’m on vacation i don’t wanna be woken up at 7o’clock in the morning and the noise was so loud i mean running and stomping i could hear whole conversations. the noise was so loud and constant but we only slept there and went to visit family if you on strong in the unit all day the house will be extremely bothersome. i also didn’t like especially with covid going on that there were so many used condiments inside the fridge raid also that ice tray in the freezer was half empty which lets me know they didn’t even touch the freezer or bother to clean the ice tray and refill it this may seem nitpicky but i pay close attention to detail. all in all would i stay here again... but not for the 150 a night i paid absolutely not. it’s not a terrible airbnb it’s just depends on your preference and for me the noise and the cold were deal breakers
sigfus' place was great, and very very convenient to the subway! the bed was also ridiculously comfortable, and i appreciated the provided fan as well. great place to crash for the weekend.
great guy and a very talkative guy. super nice and his place was full of history and very interesting!

i stayed just one night at mo's place so that i could attend a concert nearby. check in instructions were clear and getting to the room was straightforward. the bathroom was clean and well-stocked with supplies, and check out was just as easy as check in. mo was very responsive and friendly through the airb&b app. he answered any questions i had promptly and made planning this last minute trip easy. thanks mo!
dee was awesome to ya and her family is awesome.
all in the apartment was perfect. it is close to the subway, in less than 20 minutes you can be in the central park. our experience for 9 days was excellent!
great host, 10/10 recommend

my stay in magnolia house was a truly unique experience with an intimacy and comfortability that would never be possible in a hotel or traditional setting. danforth and darwin were the definition of a host; going above and beyond to ensure that you felt comfortable and happy. the house itself is a gem- more farm house than any usual city dwelling and a welcome site coming from busy manhattan. the ferry is short and with good views making it also a very convenient location for moving in and out of the city. i had a great stay and recommend it for anyone looking for a change of scenery when visiting new york.
beautiful neighborhood to walk in and many things a 15 minute walk away. host is friendly and the place suited our needs very well.
louise did a fantastic job and was a great host
wonderful place, clean and the host was accommodating. definitely going to come here again.
this is a charming studio in a lively part of the village. emma is a great host. the place is small, but functional, especially for just two people and it was clean and furnished very nicely.

jenn’s place was comfortable, tidy and ideal for my week in nyc. i enjoyed exploring brooklyn but was able to travel into manhattan without any problems with a few subways to choose from within walking distance. the flat was clean and presentable, and jenn left thoughtful touches like porridge for breakfast, cereal bar snacks and a little card upon arrival - very sweet plus useful instructions about local amenities. jenn is a lovely, smiley & helpful host - you couldn’t ask for a better host! thank you!! :)
it was an amazing experience! they were very helpful and attentive!
the place is small, but it’s nice. also if you’re concerned about being awoken at night due to traffic they provide earplugs.

dan’s place was perfect for us. it was very cozy and loved the fact that there were 3 ac units! we had one issue but through communication dan resolved very quickly and kindly. sunset park neighborhood is very quiet and homey. the views at sunset park are outstanding and easy access to the subway which leads you right into manhattan. a definite stay if you are visiting nyc.

i went to see a show at the gramercy theater and this was a perfect location to stay for one night for that! bedroom is private but bathroom is shared. there is a sink in the room though which is convenient!
we had a great stay! very good location and the patio was a nice touch to the weekend!
little spot right next to public transportation and in walking distance of tons of shops and restaurants.
a beautiful clean bright room with great facilities and a cute balcony. maria was very responsive and friendly. i felt safe in the neighborhood with a great local atmosphere.

i want to thank remo and his wife for providing a warm and welcoming home for my family to stay in. great location, close to mta and local deli corner stores. quiet neighborhood. they provided prompt services and communication. thank you for being great host!
we stayed only one night, but henry was very nice and friendly. the place was super clean and the location is also very convenient. definitely recommend it!
beautiful place, great host communication, and so kind. def book!

we had a great time at step’s place! everyone was extremely nice and accommodating, including the adorable dogs. sadly, we had a long drive and weren’t able to stay for breakfast, but the gesture was wholly appreciated. highly recommended!

we went to n.y for our first time and we need a room for just one night. dee rented us a comfortable room and she was so nice and kind. if someday we return to n.y definitely we'll return to her department.
the hosts were very commutative and understanding.

had an amazing 6 week stay, the apartment was beautiful, cozy, and quite spacious, even beyond what the pictures capture. it had all the amenities we could want for a long term stay, including plenty of cookware + appliances, smart tv, washer/dryer, comfy bed, and 2 desks for remote working. the only slight inconvenience we had was the walls seemed thin and the neighbors were pretty loud getting up at 5am every day, but not much you can do about that. the neighborhood was perfect, a block or two from the subway, prospect park, a grocery store, and lots of restaurants and coffee shops, yet still on a quiet street. i was even able to park my car on the street in front the whole time, just making sure to move it for street cleanings. and jeremy and caitlin’s communication and hospitality was beyond superb. highly recommend, wish we could have stayed longer!!

this place is huge! we booked it to accommodate 2 people working remotely for a week and it was good to have the space. the bathroom is very clean. the kitchen is good. during our stay, there were problems with the wifi, possibly because of recent storms. we messaged the host about resetting the router but had to follow up again before getting a response. eventually the issues were fixed.
i arrived very late due to holiday traffic coming into manhattan. i had to go my concert before arriving at the hotel. it was very late and someone was there to check us in.
all great. place was clean, close to subway, spacious and i honesty felt like home.

lawrence is a very caring host who pays good care of his apartment. the apartment was exactly the same as showed in the pictures. and the location is super convenient since it is super close to multiple subway lines and bus stops. would recommend it to anyone who's looking for a comfy stay in ny.
jaleh's place is excellent for a comfortable stay with a lovely host, i felt like in home. i'd come back for sure.

vadim and his wife were wonderful to me and my dogs. the space i stayed in was extremely roomy with a very comfortable bed, fridge, and private bath. they gave me privacy when needed and were very friendly if you wanted some company. they even allowed me and my girlfriend to join them for nye dinner and some drinks! would highly recommend this place for the price and location.

so clean, modern, nice and private. wonderful to have private bath and also to have a communal "kitchen" area. anthony is easy to reach and communicate with, and a kind, quiet host who answered all my questions. i felt very safe walking the 6 blocks to my daily destination. thank you anthony. i will definitely return.

joaquin was such a wonderful, kind, responsive, and hospitable host! i felt right at home immediately and he was so thoughtful to help with things like my luggage and dishes and local recommendations. it felt like a cozy b&b. there is also a sweet as pie dog named molly who lives there too! though i was too busy during my trip to really get to spend too much time in the space, joaquin's home is just beautiful with such thoughtful aesthetic details and a focus on sustainability, which i really appreciated. the neighborhood is very easily accessible via subway and in a quiet residential area. i would definitely recommend him as a host to all!

the best anyone can say about a hotel/ airbnb in nyc is would you stay there again and do you recommend it to a friend- i would vote hell yes on both counts. the room i stayed in was great, five mins walk to the f, j, m, z trains which was convenient for my work and most of all was the wicked friendly staff. they were probably the best part of the stay. there’s also a gym with sauna which i will be taking advantage of next time.
just as described. fantastic location and had everything we needed
great place and great communication!
very happy with our stay!!!
lovely spot in a location that is perfect for hanging out in brooklyn or accessing transport to further out. jospeh was a great host and the apartment was a pleasure to live in for my few days.
great place to stay in nyc
amazing location in ny. i was looking for an apartment close to coffee shops and the subway and this apartment clicked both boxes. easy to walk everywhere. i highly recommend this place.
great place even better hosts

staying at sonia’s place was an absolute pleasure. the home was cozy and exactly as described. check-in was smooth, and sonia was incredibly responsive and thoughtful throughout our stay. she provided clear instructions and helpful local recommendations that made our trip even better. the neighborhood felt safe and welcoming, and everything we needed was close by. the 52 steps to the fourth floor apartment gave us quite a workout during our stay and i was able to achieve my step goals daily 😀
beautiful place and beautiful views! definitely when coming back!! i’ll be staying there again. thank you justin for everything!

we booked nelle's place to attend a nutrition workshop held at another hotel about 4-5 blocks away. nelle's place was perfect for us - we had 2 of us share a room with two twin beds, 1 person had a room to herself, and 1 was even comfortably situated on the couch. the location is literally one corner turn from the dekalb market, a target, starbucks of course, and trader joe's, so staying at nelle's became a much easier and less expensive option as we could go grocery shopping and cook very easily there. we thoroughly enjoyed her beautiful terrace every evening, sitting out there for cooked meals and a glass or two of wine. one note for future stays: only one room in nelle's apartment has curtains, so if the bright morning sun will wake you, bring a sleep mask (and ear plugs). also, the guest policy is strict - when we asked if we could have 2 additional people over for a study session, the answer was no! so confirm every expectation/situation with nelle beforehand. we hope to be back in october for our next workshop!
this place was as advertised, not glamorous, but adequate. easy access to prospect park and the subway.
joann’s place was clean and cozy! it was a home away from home and perfect location for our needs. additionally, joann and michele were so kind and helpful. definitely would book again!

tom's home is a perfectly clean and comfortable place to stay when visiting new york/brooklyn. it is conveniently located near the j train and has many cafes and eateries nearby. the amenities are endless including walkability, w/d unit which was such a nice thing to have during a 1 week stay, and even a beautiful backyard area. will definitely plan on staying here again!

clean, quiet and green (trees outside & plants inside) apartment in a cool neighborhood. try out restaurant zoca, 426 marcus garvey blvd, which is around two corners, has very good food and is reasonably priced. if you take the express subway train a or c, you are quite fast in manhattan. the only improvements for the apartment would be another larger pot for the kitchen and a reading lamp beside the sofa.
great stay, 7mn walk from transportation, it was nice meeting ester and her family ! roosevelt island is a quiet and enjoyable place to stay ! we definitely recommend
very nice host, very clean room.

ava was very nice and accommodating and the space was as advertised. location was convenient and safe (of course) if you aren’t familiar with new york, it’s not the best location to be near a lot of day to day activities/ more aesthetic areas with lots of lifestyle activities around but it’s central and very convenient! an overall positive experience!

the room is exactly as in the picture, however this is a basement room. also room has no closets or any place to hang/keep clothes or store anything. there is individual heating in each room and main heating is probably kept off so the lobby, bathroom and kitchen were freezing. the location is really close to the airport but will take a while to get to the main city.
great amenities, perfectly furnished. maria was super easy to contact! perfect!
we had a great time at nick's place in bedstuy -- tompkins ave a couple blocks away was a party all weekend long!

it was great place to stay in new york and the owner is very friendly and nice. i definitely recommend people to stay at this place if you are considering about your living budget, this where you should stay for your new york trips.

had a great time. as described, the apartment is quite small, but we knew that beforehand, and that wasn’t an issue for us, as there were just the two of us. it certainly felt very welcoming and comfortable. in a good location in easy reach of all of the places we wanted to visit in manhattan, and felt very secure.
michael has a wonderful space in an excellent and central downtown location. his apartment is clean and comfortable and i would happily stay there again, especially for an extended stay.

where to start! may is absolutely phenomenal. may has been exceptionally responsive and no matter the time of day, will communicate back and forth diligently. her home is beyond beautiful and i have never been more happy with an airbnb experience in all of my airbnb dealings. not only is it available for a fantastic price, and very affordable for a nyc listing, but i believe the space is worth much more. it is huge, well decorated, exceptionally clean with a very comfortable environment, having everything you may need, but also, it is located in the perfect location. i have been here for roughly 6 months, and could not have been happier. right outside the door is the b38 bus which takes you to all the most important areas of brooklyn, but also to a central train hub in brooklyn. right next to the b38 is also the b43 bus which takes you less than a mile away to a central shopping/food/gym/hospital area etc. there are also all major trains within a short walking distance. right near by is a great bravo grocery market as well as coffee, wine/wine tasting, and the phenomenal brooklyn blend restaurant. the area is very safe and i have had zero issues in this environment. the neighbors are as helpful and kind as the host, may. if i were to stay in ny longer or again, i would only want to stay here. with many airbnb experiences most being very positive, i could not recommend this home higher. i strongly recommend this home, the amazing experience of interacting with may and her family, and her wonderful neighbors. after 6 months, i do not have a single complaint or negative comment, and i hope to only stay here in the future when i return to nyc. this space is beyond exceptional.

location is great but common spaces and elevators not really clean and smelly sometimes, ideal for young travelers or if you just need a central place to sleep in the city. corridors and room neighbors can be loud. no direct light or windows to open in the studio. good laundry/drying automatic service in the lobby floor, easy and fast communication with the owner. fast wi fi working. my studio was clean and with everything i needed, i would just suggest to renew the cooking oven, didn’t look safe. considering the price, i’d say it’s a good place to stay if you are in a budget and not a lot in the room.

loved the brightness of zeta's place. it's as good as it looks in the pictures - spacious, clean, with a big backyard. also loved the location - lots of things to do locally and an easy commute into lower manhattan and midtown.

we just returned from a week at ellen's place and it was everything we wanted. the location is about 15min away from the west side tennis club in forrest hills and the usta national tennis center. the apartment is located in a 3rd floor, very large for ny standards. everything was exactly as detailed in the description. we enjoyed eating fantastic colombian food in mi gitana which is about 4 blocks away in the busy woodhaven blvd, and you can also find peruvian pollo ala brasa as well, everything is in a walking distance. parking is not that difficult. i highly recommend ellen's place. we'd be returning in the future.

the apartment is beautiful; just as it appears in photos. the neighbourhood is vibrant with some great restaurants and bars nearby (highly recommend red rooster) and it's super quick and easy to get from the nearest subway into town or over to brooklyn. would absolutely stay there again. we loved it!
excellent host for a very comfortable and nice apartment. host is very responsive and extremely helpful. i recommend staying in this house.
the house is so clean, the space is enough to live. the location is nearby some subway stations, so it is comfort to enjoy good spots in nyc.

luke is a superb host and if you pay attention to the details in the home you can find he is a person who loves life, stories and every beautiful things. luke’s place is close to the tube station, and he is a very kind host that helps us. love the few days we spent here. - m&s

my experience here was very positive! the first room i stayed at for the first night did not have a view, but when i asked for another room i was changed to a nice room with a great view, which made the experience a perfect one, among other things. the location is so very central, surrounded by amazing jazz music, musical theatre, shops and restaurants, the hotel very stylish, breathing the old times in nyc which i love, while being up to date. the (discounted) breakfast i chose across the street at bakery angelina was very good and the staff at the gregorian was very friendly and helpful during my stay. thanks to all and i will definitely be back!
nice spot , comfortable and cozy
great place, so easy to access the park and the subway. nice quiet and cool.
this was an amazing place to stay! the location was even better! super clean apartment and a great host!
everything you need! not much that you don’t. well placed in the city. incredible deal with longer stay discount.

this is a great place to know about, especially since riverdale has so few places to stay. it was perfect for us -- clean and quiet -- and orit was very easy to work with. we will definitely stay here again!
super clean room, wonderful service and beautiful location.
great establishment, easy to locate, not far from the city, great value, very friendly host and neighbourhood definitely would recommend for future ny trips..
great place to stay. good value, be aware that it is in the upper part of town. close to the metro and la guardia.
beautiful place! a little far from a lot more central locations in brooklyn but we had a great time. steve is great and was very helpful!
it was okey , it could be better
this place was in a perfect location, with a good host that has a very tasty cafe downstairs. the light on the mornings is to die for!
great location, easy to get around and i enjoy getting breakfast from their cafes. definitely will be back if i ever visit nyc again
omar and kareema's place is perfect for a new york visit! their communication was excellent and the apartment is spacious and well-suited for a larger group to enjoy the city!
such a cute and very spacious suite. it was in a great location with many local eats and attractions.
great hotel !!! very professional people 👍🏻
nice , clean and very quite place

i had a long term stay at maria's and i enjoyed it because i am familiar with the area and it's very easy to get around. the apartment was clean and comfortable and i liked the fact the area was quiet and fairly unbusy. maria was easy to reach and receptive.

olivier was very attentive all the time and although he don´t live in the apt, he is always present when you need. the neighborhood is great, near subway stations, with many groceries and coffe shop nearby. the apt is clean, quite, cozi and bright. i enjoyed a lot staying there this week.
great location, nice neighborhood, bed is very comfy. wonderful host.
wonderful time. lovely hosts. great location. comfortable amenities.

the apartment was located in a very convenient location with ample space. wang greeted me in person on the first day and gave me an overview of the apartment. overall, the apartment was fairly easy to live in. cleanliness was okay, could've been better. the wi-fi was a little finnicky. otherwise, i had a very comfortable stay.
clean and close to airport.
cute apartment in a quiet neighborhood.

kaitlyn was a great host! her apartment is well decorated and very clean, and you can tell that she cares about her guests' comfort. she was easy to reach, and i would not hesitate to go back to her place whenever i'm in brooklyn again!

the best thing about this airbnb is definitely juliana! she is the sweetest and most caring host you could wish for. check in was super easy. juliana had snacks and drinks ready for us and the apartment itself is super clean and spacious. the bed is really comfortable. there are supermarkets in walking distance. juliana did everything for us to feel comfortable and safe. on the first day she even walked us to the nearest subway station and showed us how to buy a subway ticket. she gave us a quick tour of the neighbourhood which was very helpful. we were two women and were unsure if we would feel comfortable using the subway and walking home at night etc. but after 5 days i can definitely say, everything was fine and the people in the neighbourhood were really friendly and welcoming. to get to the typical tourist spots in manhatten it takes about 30-40 minutes with the subway, depending where you wanna go. we had a really great time in new york and would recommend a stay here to everyone! ☺️
ryan is a great host !

she is a wonderful and sweet woman . me and my friend had really nice time at her place . the neighbour is safe and good atmosphere . there are many cute shops and restaurants . i highly recommend her place !
nice experience!! good value, great location, very quiet. this is an actual apartment building that people live in full time, we didn’t realize this! overall, good experience.

i had a great stay at yuval's place and would reccomend this to anyone wanting to come to nyc! the location is amazing with great access to cool spots in prospect heights and an easy trip into manhatten. the room was simple but had everything needed for a comfortable stay, the rest of the apartment was nice with beautiful natural lighting during the day. 10/10 recommend!

we had a wonderful stay at irena's brownstone, which was even better than it appeared in the listing. it's very much a "real home" that's spacious, comfortable, and beautifully appointed. there are a few reasonable rules you'll need to observe, such as not wearing shoes inside, which mostly help protect the old home's and furniture's surfaces and finishes. and being an old home, you'll need to take care to make sure the doors and windows close completely (the large front door in particular.) you'll also need to be okay with climbing flights of stairs, which is part of the classic brownstone experience. although it's in the center of everything the park slope neighborhood has to offer, it was remarkably quiet inside. restaurants of nearly every sort are just a short walk away, as is prospect park. the subway is also relatively close by, though we didn't need it during our stay. it was easy communicating with irena, who sent a very thoughtful and comprehensive guide to all the home's features. check-in and check-out was easy, using a lock box system. and thank you, irena, for opening your home to us.

greg was incredibly helpful with check in and made sure we were very well taken care of during our stay. plus, the neighborhood is fantastic - many restaurants and cafes close by, with the express train a mere 4 blocks away. i would recommend to anyone who is looking for either a short or long-term option in the city at a reasonable price. thank you, greg!

perfect location and the beds and pillows were very comfy! the apartment was perfect for two nights and has the basics- few dishes, towels (though, just the 2 bath towels), shampoo/body wash in shower. no complaints here! slept like a rock both nights and the shower was a nice size as well.
marc was very nice

what a perfect place! first it really is as good or better than described. secondly it is so conveniently located in a really nice safe area, and as close to a subway station as you could ever wish. we were 40 minutes from leaving a broadway show to getting back there. interaction with richard and joey was timely and efficient. we were a big party and we all agreed: a really great place.
great place to stay. we were only there to sleep. perfect for my husband and myself.
