from the moment we arrived noelva made us welcome, showed us the apartment and advised us on eating in city island and travelling to the city, the apartment was spotless and very comfortable and the private beach a definite plus, will be back
great location, close to subway. rebecca was so nice and accommodating. would definitely stay here next time
place was clean !
the landlord is very kind, and the environment is very nice
everything was perfect. thanks to hui and jonathan for welcome. this place is affordable and good for travel by public transport to the city center.

he was kind and cared a lot about what i needed. the room is a clean and quiet neighborhood. it is a small room, but it is a cozy space and it is good to hear the sound of the sea. it is a very cost-effective space.
this is a clean room in a great location.

we had an wonderful stay at dee’s apartment. the apartment was easy reachable via subway and there were several small supermarkets in the neighborhood. it takes approximately 30-40min to downtown manhattan by walking to the subway and the subway ride. we really loved the apartment and would stay there again :)
great place to stay for first timer in nyc. far enough away from the action but close enough to be accessible. would recommend for everyone. jackson and michelle are great hosts.
don’t have a negative thing to say; from start to end ulises was amazing and the place was incredibly beautiful and very modern! my favorite thing was the hot tub!
carlene was very attentive and checked in on us mid stay! would absolutely stay again
jesse is a very helpful host! great accommodation, very clean room. we really had a great time. this is better than a hotel room. highly recommend and we would definitely gonna come back👌

exactly what i needed! the bed was super comfortable and the place had everything i needed. it was nice and spacious and sharing the kitchen and full bath was not an issue. host was friendly and accommodating :)
daisy is so nice and the stay was enjoyable! love the place and the squirrels!
great place to stay near the metro for a good budget.
excellent location for dining and shopping. clean apartment and responsive host.
irfan is awesome host. last time i stayed in his place for one day i was running late due to flight delays. he allowed me to stay longer in his place to get more rest.

sarah’s place was so cute, clean, and comfortable. the location was very convenient and close to great restaurants and cafes. sarah was very responsive and helpful. i will definitely stay there again.
perfect, ideal stay. comfortable with good restaurants and shops near by.

gregory is easy to communicate, responsible and very kind host. the location is close to nyc and downtown brooklyn both, which is great for tourists and business trippers. the space is well organized and comfortable. i would strongly recommend everyone to stay at his apartment, and enjoy the time with gregory, his neighbors and of course his cats!

i stayed at ben's apartment from early october through mid-january, spending fall and the holidays in new york. this place made it easy to explore and enjoy the city. location: amazing. multiple subway stations within a block or two, surrounded by grocery stores, restaurants, boutiques, and all kinds of shopping. the apartment: expensive, but worth it. the space seemed small at first by my standards – i'm not used to manhattan living – but it's surprisingly practical. two large wardrobes with plenty of hangers, and even the tiny bathroom fit all my things. kitchen worked well for cooking, good-sized fridge, and i liked the art throughout. working from home: very comfortable. solid desk, reliable internet, nice sofa for breaks. host: ben was responsive and helpful. his friend who handled check-in carried my heavy luggage up four flights – really appreciated. highly recommend for an extended manhattan stay.

miad was very helpful with my stay at his place. he was very responsive when i needed help late at night and came to the rescue. this was my first time booking an airbnb and i am so glad he was my first one and the experience was great. please consider booking him.
nice airbnb! and in a great location. the apartment is small, but is has all you’ll need for your trip to ny

perfect place to stay if you have a layover at jfk; since it’s in close proximity to the airport. was at the airport in under 10 mins. room was clean and well kept. really appreciated the private bathroom. would definitely stay again if i have a layover at jfk.

this apt is wonderful! i was in ny for work and wish i had more time to take advantage of the back porch. the beds were very comfortable and the whole place was very clean. the apt is a fairly short walk to the express trains on 125th and an even shorter walk to the 6 on 116th. i had a vehicle with me and parking was easy to find. i was also traveling with my dog so i was glad this place allowed her to stay! i will definitely be back next time i'm in ny!
perfect stay at thomas and elisabetta's place, very stylish, clean and super great location. they are really nice and give very good advices to find the good spots around.

marjorie's place was clean, comfortable and quirky! we loved our stay here! the apartment is walking distance to restaurants, times square and other attractions, further places are easy to get to as the train is only a few blocks away. the area feels safe at all times of day. marjorie was easy to communicate with and was always quick to respond to any questions we had. would definitely recommend staying here if in ny!
the place was perfect and extremely clean. patricia was very communicative and answered any question we had in a timely manor. worth every penny!
beautiful place in an incredible location! thank you for all the hospitality as well!
great place to stay near times square. staff is very professional, friendly and helpful. central location, well maintained and quiet!
great experience !! would definitely recommend :)!

comfy room and j. took care of everything i needed when my timing didn't go exactly to plan. neighborhood is a bit sparse but enjoyed the local jamaican restaurant around the corner and there are plenty delis for a quick bite.

we had a great stay at caroline’s place. we found it to be exactly as described: a very stylish and private space, very clean and comfortable. we had everything that we needed - and when we ran low on soap, caroline restocked us right in time. there were a few weekend nights that the neighbors played very loud music a bit too late, but that’s what you’ll get in new york sometimes. overall, we felt right at home and enjoyed exploring the neighborhood.

erica and john's beach house experience is truly one of a kind. my girlfriend and i wish we could rate them ten stars because that is what they deserve. i was looking for a place in the city to celebrate my girlfriend's birthday and relax away from worldly stress. based on the reviews, i knew erica's and john's airbnb would be the right place, and they did not disappoint! the airbnb itself is very clean, cozy, and filled with lots of nice touches. erica even provided bagels, snacks, and wine for us. we believe it was such a thoughtful gift. i asked erica to decorate the room for my girlfriend's birthday, and it was perfect. the bedding choice, balloons, chocolates, rose petals, and gift bags. my girlfriend was over the moon, thanks to erica. the backyard is spacious, stunningly handcrafted, comes with a stocked outdoor bar, and the jacuzzi was an outstanding highlight of the weekend. we spent hours in the jacuzzi. we even spent time in the jacuzzi with john, an incredible host who knows how to have a good time! as if the weekend wasn't already fun, erica wanted to give my girlfriend one more special surprise. she designed and decorated a cake table with balloons for my girlfriend. how many hosts would do that for their guests? this weekend was magical. staying at erica's and john's felt like we were at home. a huge thank you to erica and john for their hospitality and generosity and the sunday vegetarian soup (so good)! we had a blast and cannot wait to visit again!!!!

this is a nice, clean space in a great part of the city. it was an easy check-in process with clear communication, wifi, and everything as expected. you are a short walk from all the un buildings and the east river. there are groceries within a block and menachem and their team were very friendly and available if you have any questions.

this is a great small place near the q line. super convenient for getting to manhattan. lots of good food in the area. great neighborhood. owner seems to be living here up until the minute you arrive, and so it’s a bit like being in the house of a friend of a friend. only things for cleaning are industrial size clorox and industrial size dish detergent. but otherwise has what you need for getting by.

scott & audrey are great hosts. we enjoyed our stay in their beautiful place. they provided some of our requests and quickly responded to our inquiries. their place is just several minutes walk from the bus and train station. overall, we had a great stay. thanks again scott & audrey. 😊
small but functional, perfect for a short stay in a neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and cafés.

great safe walkable location on the upper east side. awesome restaurants and fun bars within a few blocks. nice easy walk to central park and quick inexpensive cab to anywhere else. the bathroom and the fixtures (switches) may appear old but don’t let that dissuade you. the bed is super comfortable, the ac and hot water both work really well. nathan was very responsive to all questions.

gary's place was great ! comfortable bed, lots of hot water in shower with nice thick towels. he even had decaf coffee available with half and half in fridge which was a plus as most airbnb do not offer decaf. the location was perfect for us. we have already booked another trip with gary for may 2020.

this spot was great for our trip! walkable and so close to grand central station that it made getting everywhere very easy. they were always responsive to all of our questions and overall it was a great experience.

a big thanks to sumeira for hosting my husband and i’s first time in ny! the studio is cozy for a couple & is located in a safe & convenient neighborhood of astoria where everything is only a short 20 minute drive - a perfect spot to rest after a long day exploring all over ny. the active communication with sumeira was much appreciated on our trip. as much as we would love to stay for longer, we will definitely be back & recommend this listing for a ny couple getaway.
booked the place for my parents, they also loved it
perfect location, easy to reach. kind employees. gym was difficult to get entry to.
maria is very friendly and was always avaliable if i had any questions. the house was very comfortable and met our needs for the weekend. very nice.
had a great time staying with paul! he was really nice, communication was great, the room was exactly as described and i loved the neighborhood! would definitely stay with him again :)

a very nice appartement, absolute value for money. with a subway on the corner, and within 30 min in downtown manhattan.
great place, great location, clean. great host, always at your service.

this place is a gem of a place. a lovely market and coffee place right around the corner and in the midst of this covid cleaned our rooms every night we stayed. i am very grateful to box house and will be staying here again.
the size of the unit was perfect...it was clean and he left a thoughtful welcome gift.

fantastic apartment, very spacious, fully equipped, well decorated and clean. fabulous kitchen. in a perfect location for exploring brooklyn heights and close to subway and short journey to manhattan. luke responded very promptly to any queries.

sandy' place was great. the apartment is very nice and extremely close to central park and various museums, as well as just a couple blocks from subway stations. i had a great experience, and would definitely stay there again.
great host! very responsive, helpful and flexible.
lakshmee is the best host i’ve dealt with. she was very attentive to our needs and proactive at providing solutions and recommendations! excellent host!

i’m so glad i chose to stay with justyna and her family. their place was wonderful and they were great hosts. they answered any questions properly and were receptive. the neighborhood was clean and quiet and i could walk to staten island university hospital where i worked if i chose to. my airbnb accommodation was private, clean and had everything i needed including a tv with dish satellite! i would stay here again without hesitation. thank you again justyna!
a great location and wonderfully helpful communication!

exactly what i needed. the host was very responsive and the hospitality was great. if you need a place to crash in for a few days, this is the place. two clean restrooms and the apartment is always quiet and respectful.
we had a great weekend stay at diane’s place! she is a great host and very responsive if any problems arise!

we found the apartment ideal for our trip, cozy and simple located in an amazing area. we walked a lot around manhattan and loved the contrast from the way too hectic times square with the lower east side. aside from the need to see the obvious touristy places (this was our first trip to nyc) we would have happily stayed around the lower east side. so many places to eat and drink. as much as we wanted to eat out, we had a few nights in watching netflix and ordering take-out with which there were endless options, although williamsburg pizza popped up a lot! never had the pleasure to meet sausan who was away at the time but her partner steve was great in getting things sorted. would stay again and recommend

great roomy place with good access to the city, as well as the local williamsburg shops and todos. incheck was a breeze, and the local tips from susan helped me get my feet on the ground quite fast. all bathroom amenities where available, and there is a grocery shop right around the corner for your first-day food/drink supplies. great stay for williamsburg!
i am looking forward to coming back. i’ll definitely stay here. it is one of the best places i’ve booked on airbnb
cozy comfortable and peaceful

anh & david have a great place right in the heart of brooklyn. it’s got easy access to all kinds of restaurants, amenities and attractions. the place was clean, perfectly furnished, and a great deal for this amount of space. if we’re ever in the neighborhood again, we’ll definitely look to book again!
great, easy check in, clean and nice shared areas, nice sizeable and reasonable priced room.

this is the ultimate nyc homebase in the city that never sleeps, complete with skyline views! we stayed at jeniffer’s place for 6 nights in august and had a fantastic experience. the room was larger than expected, which was a nice surprise, very clean, bright, airy and quiet, with plenty of closet space. the kitchen was convenient for coffee, tea and light meals and the window view of trees added a peaceful touch. we also couldn’t have wished for a better location, it’s walking distance to cafes, restaurants, shops, bars and several subway stations, making it easy to get around the city. the rooftop was the highlight however, spacious with incredible city views. check-in and check-out were smooth, with great communication from the host. we’ll happily stay here again and highly recommend it!

i spent a wonderful time at mary sue’s. not only did mary care about my needs during my stay, but also we had wonderful conversations about theater and performing arts. the place is great for one or two. conveniently close to lincoln center and 15-min walk to time square, in a safe neighborhood and with all the facilities that makes you feel like home. thanks mary, looking forward to staying at your place again soon.
great place to stay! clean and inviting.
apt in bad condition
great location in midtown. friendly staff.

everything about this experience was absolutely perfect—an unforgettable stay! a true blast! if i could give it 6 stars, i absolutely would. the location is unbeatable, right in the heart of the east village, with everything just steps away. justin was the perfect host—relaxed, accommodating, and incredibly thoughtful. the studio itself was wonderful: spotless, cozy, and full of charm. i can’t recommend this place enough—it’s the ideal home base for exploring one of the best neighborhoods in new york.

asad was extremely responsive and the instructions and communication clear! i had a last minute change in my travel plans and needed a place close to the airport for an early flight. even though was last minute i got my reservation and instructions within hours, making it easy for me to have a rested evening before my flight. this place is walking distance from la guardia (i did the walk and it is 15 min at the most) the room i stayed at was clean. the best perk besides the proximity to the airport is the contactless check-in.

my daughter and i really enjoyed staying in the flat which is artsy and well cared for to the last detail. this neighborhood still echos the true ny vibe...jazz venues, local eateries etc., which is changing fast (i lived in ny about 20 years ago). so, go there and experience it while it lasts! erica was responsive and flexible to all our requests. merci beacoup, a & s
our second time. we will return.

lakisha is super nice and responsive. i needed a last minute place to stay for a couple nights and her place was clean and convenient!! she’s so accommodating and the apartment has everything i needed. i appreciated the locks on each bedroom’s door, it was kind of a hotel vibe almost and felt very safe & secure. room had ac and tv which was suuuper nice. thank you lakisha!

i stayed here for only a couple of days during my trip to new york and it was like living in a dream! first, i’d like to express my gratitude toward the customer service that arlo nomad provided. as this was my first time in nyc, people aren’t as outgoing to be friendly compared to where i live, but those who work at arlo nomad were very pleasant and it was refreshing to exchange greetings. luckily, our room was ready an hour before check in time, which we were extremely grateful for as the check in was @ 3pm. that’s always awesome! the common areas and room looked just like the pictures. the room was a bit small and i wish the bathroom was fully enclosed—as there is a small opening where air can travel between the room and bathroom—but i couldn’t have been more happy. it did its job. it was such in a convenient location with tons to do around, day and night. they also offered free coffee for guests in the lobby! overall, i would definitely stay again.

it was extremely easy to get in contact with christina she is always available. her place is spacious and looks great. the walk to the subway was safe and about 5 minutes, their are multiple grocery stores in the area and plenty eating spaces. like most hotels/motels/hostels/roomshare et....in new york it is a non smoking space, but i was safe going outside to smoke. i like the fact she provides you with a code to the door, basically their is no key, so you don’t have to worry about loosing it. the beds are extremely comfortable and the rooms are spacious. i stayed their with 5 of my friends and i didn’t feel like their wasn’t enough space. we played music, watched tv and even used her laundry.

amazing, just as described, just what i wanted. the building isn’t the nicest but the apartment is super functional, every small space is made to work! and is was super clean! it was just like staying at someone’s house - but only in a good way. like, for example, when you wake up with a pounding headache and there is already aspirin attractively arranged in the medicine cabinet. the snack were a real perk too! thanks again !!
mr domingo place is a very nice place to stay. quiet and clean
second time staying here - can’t beat the location for the price. so close to everything and extremely walkable and clean. cool vibe, great staff.
amazing experience. my first time saying at a airbnb and i would definitely go back. robert gave me a tour and answered all my questions.

thank you for a great stay! this was my first time traveling to nyc as an adult, and jerry's place was perfect! close to the subway stations and very walkable. jerry was always responsive and kind, he went above and beyond!
andres's place is fantastic - comfortable, cool, and it feels like home. the neighborhood is great and andres is a fantastic host. without a doubt my best airbnb experience.
beautiful house. great location. very clean. jessica was very helpful in a small crisis. would've definitely stay again. thank you for everything jessica!
good visit. good host. clean apartment. very nice experience.

i had a wonderful stay with silvia. the location was perfect. it was close enough to the city by subway for easy access, but far enough to offer a peaceful atmosphere. it was the ideal balance. the neighborhood felt very safe, and there were cute shops within walking distance, making it easy to explore. i also appreciated having a private bathroom, which added extra comfort, and the amenities provided made the stay even more enjoyable. highly recommend for anyone visiting nyc!

linda is kind enough to take our last minute request to stay at her place and made us feel very welcomed and comfortable. and the clean room with good beds and nice bath tub, we had relaxing time there. we enjoyed our stay. thank you linda!
it was a nice place to stay for the night.
very convenient location, great communication , easy access great for my pets

i had a really great stay here. the room was clean, comfortable, and very peaceful, which made it easy to relax after long days in the city. ron was extremely kind, attentive, and always helpful whenever i needed anything. the place felt safe, calm, and welcoming. i truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting new york. thank you again for everything!
the best! so gorgeous, sparkling clean, and larry is an incredibly responsive host. highly recommend!

had an absolutely wonderful week staying at karen and jamie’s apartment. the apartment itself was beautiful and had some really lovely touches, we felt right at home immediately. easy walking distance to multiple metro stations. lots of delis/restaurants/bars nearby. i would 100% come back, couldn’t recommend it enough. this is a wonderfully presented little gem in williamsburg. 10/10.

good place to stay when you arrive late at jfk as it‘s very close. clean room. check-in /out was easy. table and chairs are missing. in case you plan to stay longer than 1 night and would like to eat there, it might be an issue. the sofa is not enough in case you wanna talk to other guests as we did.
this is a great place with lots of space in a quiet neighborhood. the hosts were really responsive and helpful. clean and cute.
the most amazing hosts! super responsive & were able to fix anything asap ! love them! & location is close to trains
suliman is warm and sweet, it really felt like a home away from home.
emily was a great and responsive host. there was an issue with the bathroom that leaked from the upstairs neighbor so i could not stay for as long as planned but she was very helpful and attendant.
great location for us - very close to our destination. so easy to check in and flexible time. this was a large studio with two beds - very clean. everything was just right for us

it was ok, little vibe.. only issue i had was the family that lived upstairs was pretty loud. floors is paper thin, you can hear every single step made. it’s more hangout party vibe. it’s cool for what it’s worth. it’s clean.. wasn’t there long just needed the space for an event day near by.

we loved it! warm, inviting & perfectly outfitted for friends or family. commute was fast & easy, took 20 minutes from your bedroom to manhattan! bathroom and vanity nook had hairdryers and lots of mirrors throughout. beds were so cozy you don’t want to get up. we opted to have the single rollaway bed added to the bedroom and it was a perfect fit for our family of 5. ample storage space visible and hidden, we liked the underbed storage draws. fully equipped kitchen but with so many restaurants nearby, we tried a different place every night and ate our take-away meals in her dining area which has a large table perfect for meals, visiting and card games. all the thoughtful touches made our stay extra comfortable. after a long day of sightseeing, monica’s place was an oasis to come home to. we had a great time. we would 100% book again!
very clean and affordable. just a few miles from jfk.

lovely apartment very close to the subway. quiet and clean with fantastic beds! michelle and mike were very easy to contact and any queries were promptly answered. we recommend staying at their place.

to start with: the appartement looks exactly as beautiful as in the photos. once you stay there longer you really real at home. the subway is right in front of the entrance of the house so you can get everywhere in manhattan very easily. you already know the next time we come to new york we will try to stay again in this apartment and we really can recommend it to everybody who is planning to stay longer in manhattan.

junior is an extremely caring host, the best we have ever met in our years of airbnb. the apart. had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable: the bed and pillows super comfortable. dove shower soap as announced 🙂 junior provided us with a complementary pack of bottled waters and there were the basics for cooking a meal and more. to commute to manhattan is very easy by taking bus b46 that takes you all the way through uttica av. to the subway to manhattan. junior was so helpful and he even offered to take us to our bus stop in manhattan driving through heavy traffic. a real gentleman! it is a pitty he was fully booked for end of august we would return. i highly recommend and will keep the contact for future visit to nydc. thank you for making our first trip to the usa such a good experience!

benjamin and tiffany had an amazing house which was in a very easily accessible location in brooklyn. the house is clean, has plenty of space and they were very helpful during check-in, providing options for going out, and were very responsive. great experience

we loved our stay at esef's place, he was so kind and responsive, we particularly appreciated his offering us a late check out so that our daughter, who was unwell, could rest in the lovely cool air-conditioning until we left for our bus. the location is fantastic, it's a great neighbourhood with plenty of bars, cafes, broadway shopping, and eating in little italy and chinatown. many thanks to esef for being such a great host.
great place in midtown!

mungyu is very good at both communicating and giving you your own space. the downstairs bedroom is very nice because, as mentioned, there is an attached half suite bathroom, and also, there’s a laundry machine and dryer! the only thing that took me by surprise is that there is absolutely 0 natural light. even though it’s in a basement, i thought that there’d be a least a small upper window.
leo'a place was absolutely perfect. couldn't have asked for a better location and host.

one of my favorite things of the apartment was camilo the dog, he is adorable and such a funny little guy! the room was beautiful, the bed super comfortable and the pillows and sheets too… i was working remotely so having a little desk in the room was perfect… ariel is super sweet and gave great info of things to do in the area
great place clean pictures where as described very responsive even surprise my girlfriend with a bottle of wine for her birthday
we had a wonderful stay in this airbnb. its highly recommended. the host is very friendly and responsive. close to everything and breakfast was pretty good.

ken was a fantastic host! his place was exactly what we were looking for and he couldn’t have provided a better experience for us in looking after all the little things. from a selection of teas to a gallon of filtered water to thoughtful bathroom essentials, it’s a great spot hosted by an even better host!

avery nice studio. looks just like the pictures, host was also very helpful. instructions were clear so it made it very easy for me to get in and get to the room fast and there’s an elevator so it you have lost of stuff with you, you could also use that. there was a lot of near by restaurant and gas station and a 3 minute walk to the subway. it was very easy to get around. would book again, host checks in to make sure you’re set and it’s very peaceful.

i enjoyed meeting marjorie and staying at her place. the room was spacious and thoughtfully furnished. i found the bed comfortable. there are multiple convenient transportation options including the ferry, bus and citi bike.
great studio apartment, perfect for two people and in great shape. would not describe it as quiet in the summer months but nice to have proximity to park. would definitely come back!
it has a fair value for the price you pay. the train is 15 minutes from the appartment so it was very convenient. the communication was very good.
great cozy place to stay. john and catherine are a delight and very welcoming. easy and quick access to subway. i will be returning to this air b&b in the near future.
delightful location, stunning home with absolutely beautiful light. the apartment is very special and we loved spending time there and walking around the neighborhood.
while the space was compact, it was impeccably clean and well-maintained. the location was absolutely perfect for exploring the city.

aron is a great host! he was at home when we arrived and personally introduced us to the house. very responsive to the messages. he provided us with some food and snacks to start the trip. all the beds were very comfortable and the sofa (black) is different from the photos and is able to pull out to form a bed which we slept comfortably in. otherwise the place is gorgeous as seen in the photos. the shower is awesome too! his place is fully equipped with all the necessary kitchenwares and it is very clean too! place is very near the metro and batatas was a great recommendation. basketball court was empty in the night and morning so not an issue in terms of noise for us too. my friends and family truly enjoyed our stay in brooklyn with aron.
the place was great & comfortable. i would recommend this place to a friend!

great stay. this location is super -- just a block and a half from the subway (with good direct service to manhattan) and a block from lots of food options (both markets and restaurants). the neighborhood is also steps from prospect park. this first floor apartment is incredibly quiet as it is in the back. the apartment itself is pristine and well equipped. the bed is very comfortable. the kitchen is basic and has lots of things for cooking. oscar greeted me and showed me around his place. he responds to communications almost instantly. i'd be more than happy to stay here again and again. worth noting: the unit's kitchen (and eat in counter) shares a wall with a neighbor's bedroom. oscar is a caring neighbor and wants to ensure that his guests don't disturb next door. you need to be willing to help him out in this by keeping conversations low in the kitchen area. if you aren't willing to do this, look elsewhere.

very affordable and amazing for it’s value. you have almost everything there: hair straighteners, coffee, vacuum (for those who use air-tight packaging) etc…. just make sure to check out on time because while we were checking out we left an hour late and the new airbnb people were arriving so it was a bit of a mess. so just make sure to check out on time!

beautifully renovated property with a minimalist aesthetic. i enjoyed staying in this home and would love to stay again when i visit ny. donald is an attentive host and went above and beyond to ensure i had everything i needed. neighborhood is quiet and the home has upgraded entry smartlock features. i highly recommend staying here!
place was very clean and cozy. very well equipped as well
good place for the price, host was accommodating and proactive!

this airbnb is beautiful, reliable, spacious, clean, amazingly decorated, and hosted professionally and kindly. my family and i highly recommend. working with the hosts was a great experience, victoria replied immediately to any questions we had. we were amazed by the space, it was beautifully furnished and decorated, while also being very convenient, practical, clutter-free, and clean. this airbnb is all around amazing, it's in great proximity of the bk neighborhood, for those who enjoy walking and using the train. we had a person in our party who had limitations with walking, and despite the usual stairs for a brownstone, it's an otherwise very accessible and spacious space with easy pathways. the airbnb also provides all necessary amenities for week long stays, a well-stocked kitchen, and helpful added appliances that were a plus to the space. we definitely will rely on this airbnb when we return, it was no doubt worth it.
while there was a walk for public transportation, the home made up for it. it was clean, comfortable and spacious.
very comfortable - morning coffee in the sun!
a sun-filled morrocan living room to relax five floors up above the hustle and bustle of a real nyc neighborhood. i loved walking to pabade cafe in the morning for a delicious coffee and pastry.

exactly as described. the location is great, it was perfect for my very last minute trip to nyc. easy access to penn station and the whole city. very easy to come and go, and check in was great. the bed is a little short if you’re over 6’ tall, but it does the job. i’d happily stay again.
shane's place was impeccably clean and had all the amentities i needed for a long stay. the block is quiet and easily walkable.
nice host and nice room

jorge was a great host and was responsive and accommodating. i would stay here when i visit again. jorge's 1st response to my initial inquiry to his prompt responsiveness as very much appreciated. jorge was home when we arrived and left the door open which showed his open welcome to his guests. he showed us around the appartment and was available the entire time we were there. he went out and purchased extra blankets just in case we got cold and was happy to tell me where he got them because i liked and wanted to purchased some of my own.
carmen’s place was perfect for my visit to the bronx. everyone was so nice and helpful, definitely would stay again !! thanks carmen
worked for my stay.

i really enjoyed my stay with jane. the apartment was super clean and almost everything looked brand new. the bed was comfortable and the location was convenient for getting around. jane is a fantastic host, answered to my messages quickly and overall had a great experience. recommend!
chic, comfortable place to stay. the quintessential nyc apartment. loved it!
we had an amazing weekend staying in crown heights and rodney was a great host. very helpful and accommodating as well - would definitely recommend!

louise's place was just perfect for my stay! the bed is extremely comfortable, and the building was quiet with practically no street noise (a rarity for nyc in my experience..). definitely no frills here, but perfect location with quick access to the park, subway, coffee, and plenty of restaurants around. louise was easy to communicate with before and during my stay, and i would absolutely book her space again. thanks, louise!

it is a very cute and clean place and worth the stay. very close to flushing and all the restaurant. the room is very clean and organized. the most important is the host is very friendly and very responsive. love this place and will come back😀

this is a great place to stay, right near tourist attractions and quiet at night. it was easy to get around and mike and busser were very helpful. the apartment is big and clean, with everything in it you could need. mike kindly let me checkout a couple of hours later at no extra cost. there's restaurants, markets and places to get take out food all within a short walking distance. i would definitely stay here again.
this was a fabulous find. greg was so helpful, responsive and accommodating and (because of the set up in the flat) you got to meet his parents who were equally helpful. than you so much..
exactly like the photos, was flexible with my check-in time because i had an earlier flight and i was very appreciative of that! the other guests were respectful as well.

melissa was one of the coolest people i met in new york - such a great human. we bonded over animals and typewriters and photography. she’s extremely clean and just an all around lovely human. i hope to stay in contact with her and will definitely stay again!

charlotta was a wonderful host! the apartment was spacious, stylish, clean, comfortable, and was the perfect home base for our family’s trip to new york. charlotta gave us a ton of tips for local spots to check out, was incredibly responsive, and was also really accommodating to make sure our stay went as smoothly as possible. we look forward to staying here again on our next trip to the city!
seth has a very nice apartment with a cozy room and everything's very clean! he made our visit easier by being in constant communication. would recommend to others.
lola place made me feel at home.
this place was beautiful super clean and close to public transportation !!!

this house was so beautiful very earth and modern i loved it ! the house is very spacious and has a very cute playroom for the kids! me and my family enjoyed our stay ! aaron was a wonderful host. only thing that sucks is the parking but overall everything was really great.
we enjoyed this short stay with our kind host samir. a cozy, clean space and lots of room for discussion about samir's life in nyc. we loved the area!
lynn and andy are awesome!!! overall experience is 10 out of 10! i have decided to stay here again next time i come to new york!

the room and the apartment are like described on the profile, very clean and equiped with everything you need. also seth and his friend were super friendly and helped us with every question we had and invited us to a private event with their friends. we really had a great time in ny, also cause of our fantastic hosts! if you got the possibilitiy to book this room for your stay in ny, do it! you won´t regret it ;)
great place with lovely host.

perfect sized apartment for an extended work trip. the location was amazing and the building is a real new york classic and very well looked after. unfortunately due to the virus my almost month long trip was cut short after a week but it is what it is. would stay again.

wanda was an excellent host — super responsive, allowed for late checkout & helped whenever we needed. we felt right at home here. i would definitely stay again & recommend to anyone to stay at this cosy abode! highly recommend.

i’ve stayed in many air bnbs over the years and this one hands down has been my favourite experience. edgar has the type of place that when you walk in you think ‘i want to live here’. cosy, clean, cool and very well located for getting about brooklyn and easy access to the city. edgar himself is the perfect host, creating a relaxed, friendly and welcoming atmosphere and offering the most incredible recommendations. i can’t recommend this place highly enough thanks for the stay edgar and hope to return soon!
stayed here for a month with michael while onboarding for a new job! he was a phenomenal host and the place was a great stay.

we stayed at the box house hotel for 4 days. it was a great overall experience. we found the hotel to be clean and spacious. it's a convenient 10 minute walk from the subway and offers easy access to manhattan. the hotel also has a chauffeur service for areas nearby. throughout our stay, the staff was very friendly and helpful. i'd recommend the box house hotel to anyone visiting the nyc area.
great stay, responsive host, decent home!
terrick was super communicative. the place was clean and in a great central location. would definitely stay again if visiting the area.
joel and anna’s place was perfect for our family. the apartment was beautiful and we loved being right in little italy. we will definitely stay again.
wonderful! clean, convenient, peaceful. unbeatable price for the location and hospitality. check in and out was easy. highly recommend.
i would stay there again

read before booking: the good: - great location, good amenities, nice-sized bedroom - early check-in the bad: - the listing should be "shared unit." yes, it's a duplex. but what howard needs to disclose is that a wooden board over the stairs separates you from the downstairs (where he stays while you are at the airbnb). you can see down into his unit and can sometimes hear him. the really bad: - several instances where howard entered our unit without consent or communication. on a few occasions, we came home to find a motor bicycle in the living room, which was later moved. he also plugged back in an overly strong scent dispenser that we unplugged - meaning he came into the unit 2-3 times without asking us. this is against airbnb's policy. - one morning, he knocked on the wooden board separating the downstairs and asked us if we needed extra towels. appreciate the gesture, but please, privacy... i would not stay here again. not worth the $ given the lack of privacy and space.

except for a rather officious, unfriendly reception desk worker on arrival (late), room was very comfortable and quiet. cleaning - top notch; door men friendly. would have liked in-room coffee maker, ironing. “resort fee” seems excessive - we only used the room!
nice clean room, close to metro. a cheap option for travelers.

we spent, tarik and i, a fantastic week at dulus home. they are that nice and homy. calm place and next to manhattan by ferry. cant imagine a better place for our first trip in nyc. i recommend this sweet home. thanks to dulus :)
the inside of the house was well done.
sophia was an amazing host and was very good at communicating with us leading up to and during our visit!

our host, michael, was great! he was responding to all our needs/questions and definitely went above and beyond to accommodate us. when we arrived it was our fault we did not read the instructions more carefully on which door to access for entry. michael graciously came to help instantly. a host like michael made it this a memorable trip worth remembering! the space was clean and it was as it was described. the area gave us an easy walk to restaurants and the subway stations. only thing was the walls were thin. we heard foot steps on the floor above us. we’ll definitely be back again!
this is an exceptionally clean unit in the center of crown heights. we had a great stay. shower was great. strong wifi connection. only 8-10 minutes from subway stops. we had a great time.
lonnie is a fantastic host, so quick to communicate and his apartment is such a comfortable, clean, convenient space. couldn't recommend more highly!

henri is a great host and his instructions were so helpful. this is small but really stylish and well equipped apartment in a lively, youthful neighbourhood. my 26 year old son loved it and he would definitely stay again.

the place itself is sparkling clean and a wonderful and easy place to stay if you need somewhere to crash in the city. multiple rooms share the bathroom, with that said i only had to wait once for it the entire time i was there. its located just a short walk from the n/w so getting around the city is a breeze and astoria has a plethora of food options so its easy enough to stay in that area as well.
great stay for our business trip. clean and nice!! very roomy, living room is great for watching movies and hanging out !

i cannot say enough about this beautifully restored second floor apartment. i didn't want to leave! it's very spacious and well furnished. it's got great natural light and beautiful floors. it's more like a fine historic inn than your typical rental in the area. lory and and cindy are wonderful hosts, great communicators and thoughtful about all the amenities. i was delighted to meet them. the location is convenient for access to either of two subway lines and near shopping and restaurants on either flatbush ave or nostrand.

ludina is a wonderful host! i felt right at home, it was like visiting family. she is kind, responsive, helpful, and thoughtful. the room is super comfortable, the bed and pillows are great, everything is clean and tidy. the neighborhood felt safe, people were friendly, and the metro is super close. i would definitely come back here! thanks for everything, ludina!

rahul's place is perfect and he is an amazing host. the house is close to m and j line and you can find a lot of delis close to there. about rahul, he give us a private time at home and u really appreciate it that. thanks for this great time. hope to see you soon

great private suite. it was much closer to public transport than we anticipated. the neighborhood was nice, with lots to explore. felix has a great host, the suite was well set up. we would definitely return.

nothing bad to say here. was exactly as advertised. in fact it was better than the add even said. grocery store less than 2 blocks away. park less than 2 blocks away. was a great stay. lots of room and kitchen is amazing.

we lived in a different part of brooklyn for over 20 years and we're coming back to visit family and friends. we are very happy we stayed at this lovely two bedroom place. it is in a great area, with so many different grocery stores and restaurants. a short walk to the subway. the kitchen has wonderful pots and pans. wifi was strong and good for video calls. it was a great space and happy we stayed here. we hope to stay again in a future visit.
greg's place was absolutely amazing and he's a very good communicator. i'd definitely recommend this place

this is a lovely house very close to the subway system so it was really convenient to get to most anywhere in the city that we wanted to go. the room is spacious with 3 sleeping options so it would be great for a family. tw and her husband were very accommodating and helpful with suggestions of places that we could go to hear live music in the area. i would definitely return here on my next trip to the city.
nice place! outdated but spacious rooms. nice staff!

what a treat to arrive at this little oasis - it feels like an airy country cottage and is beautifully and simply styled. very calm and choc full of comforts. netflix, plenty of towels, bed linen - super comfy bed and also sofa bed - and a kitchen with lots of appliances and a larder with supplies that guests are welcome to use. i had a restful, inspiring 8 days here and didn't want to leave! there's a little back garden perfect for sitting out in with your morning cup of coffee and pastries from the nearby bakery. the area is pretty bustling and diverse but when you turn onto jill's street it feels very homey and safe. jill was very responsive and attentive to any queries i had. i had a wonderful time.

we had a great stay with our 11 year old. kept our car in a garage nearby and ubered back and forth to the car when we were headed out to the city. we had everything we needed and host was responsive and kind! would stay here again for sure. corner store right at the corner with everything we needed as well. neighbors were friendly!

andrew and adriana are great hosts! this is a wonderful home with everything you need and spotless. close to prospect park and within steps of a subway to get anywhere. i enjoyed my stay and would love to return. it truly feels like my home away from home.
great location in the heart of bk. very accommodating host and 2 awesome cats!

we enjoyed our stay. the listing was accurate and we were comfortable overall. the small terrace off the primary bedroom was nice and peaceful to sit outside and get some morning sun! the host was friendly and helpful.

this is an amazing place. beth greets you on arrival and gives you a house tour. she's super friendly and her cats are too cute. the house is spacious and clean. the area (as well as the other rooms) is safe, clean, and quiet. there's a few buses about five minutes away, and a train stop a little further. near the train station is a convenience store and a supermarket. what's even better is that the room had snacks, and that water/tea/coffee are available. every morning, beth and her cohost maria provide breakfast. maria is super nice too.
clean and very quiet, good value

this is a very small studio centrally located in brooklyn. it is walking distance to great restaurants and bars and the subway. when i needed a place to stay last minute, i was lucky to find their studio available. check in was a breeze and the space was very clean and tidy. the windows look out onto a garden, which is a nice refuge from the concrete of the city.
great place everything as expected.

we had a fantastic stay at jenny's place. we were very late arriving after a long delay in immigration and jenny waited up for us to let us in and bought us some much needed muffins and milk. the apartment is in a great location between williamsburg and brooklyn heights, perfect for exploring brooklyn and manhattan. the apartment is spacious and interestingly decorated and great value for money. thanks for a great trip!
beautiful and cozy apartment! the apartment was extremely cleaned and smelled very fresh. kamroon was super helpful and she is a great host. i'll definitely rebook. thank you 😊
their place is great and hospitality is amazing. it’s a very private and quiet room and they are available if you need anything. would definitely go back, even just to see their sweet dog mormon.

we thoroughly enjoyed our four night stay. we have a family of six (kids ages 6-12) and this fit our needs perfectly. plenty of space for all of us. i especially enjoyed the spacious bathroom; we weren't all on top of each other. we spent our days in manhattan and found it quite nice to go back to the quiet, calm neighborhood of the airbnb each night. the area is full of families and is significantly quieter than manhattan which allowed us to sleep much better. the host's communication and response time was excellent. once we arrived, he even initiated to see if there was anything else we needed before we ever asked. a small amount of food/milk is provided for breakfast for the first day, but you'll need to plan on buying additional food if staying multiple days and wanting to eat in. oh, and the backyard in the fall was gorgeous. highly recommend poking your head outside to check it out. i don't know if we'll be back in nyc, but if we ever are, we'd definitely want to stay here again.
maria is a super communicative and helpful host. apt was comfortable and as described, would stay here again.

zandy was a wonderful host ! the pictures are accurate and you will feel at home there. zandy baked cookies, gave advice on what to do in the area, was super nice and generous. his cat, l, is harmless and affectionate. i really enjoyed staying there and getting to know zandy, who will make sure that you feel comfortable in the apartment. the area is very nice and safe, close to the subway which will bring you to manhattan in 10 minutes, and to nice cafés, restaurants and shops. i liked everything about this place, i strongly recommend zandy's room (plus you'll meet an amazing host aswell!) !
unique space in a great location!

really liked this place. i don’t think the pictures listed do it justice. it was at the top of the stairs. so, the area between the bathroom and rooms, is not private. but, we had no issues with anyone downstairs. it was very clean. the r subway is at the end of the block. but the r goes pretty much everywhere you plan on going. had some great pizza a block away. our cars were parked around the corner for 3 days, no problems with them. i would def stay here again.

although ana was not there, she organized everything prior to our arrival! abraham was the responsible for our reception and he was great, giving a lot of advices and helping in any issues we had. the 10 days we stayed at maria's apartment were fantastic! everything was like in the description. clean and with a great location: near 2 subway stations, the museum of natural history and the central park. it's perfect for 2 people, who want a quiet and nice place in this great city! i recommend this apartment to my friends and everyone who is asking where we stayed :) and if i will be in nyc again, i would definitely rent maria's apartment again! tip 1: there is a shake shack on the columbus avenue with w 77th st, they have great hamburgers! tip 2: if you are arriving late and every restaurant is closed, there is a bakery that is opened 24h in broadway with w 78th st. you can find great pizzas in there. thank you ana and abraham we had a great time!
i really like this place , so beautiful
nice clean cozy room. calming and beautifully furnished with everything you need. chris responded to my every text in a timely manner. lovely warm apartment.
great location. convenient next to the subway. j train to get into brooklyn was very great.

we really enjoyed our stay at dominik’s place. it was perfect to spend a few days around thanksgiving in nyc. the apartment is as beautiful as on the pictures, everything works well and the interior is very elegant. the kitchen had everything we needed to prepare for dinner and the living place was spacious enough for everyone. we can highly recommend this place to explore the city, which is easy since the metro is quite close. the neighborhood is lively but not too loud and the apartment itself is looking towards the courtyard so it’s very quiet. we would love to come back!
i have to travel as a single parent alone and this place was wonderful. can't recommend it enough. clean, warm, friendly and easily accessible to all the nyc things.
amazing location between east village & les. you're right there. the room is small but honestly bigger than i expected based on other reviews. would definitely stay again!
great, roomy place for two. clean and close to the subway.
staying at dan’s place turned a routine work trip into a luxurious retreat. the space is beyond stylish, the hosts are responsive and welcoming, and the access to the a train is unbeatable.

i stayed in the place for two weeks and had a great time. i can highly recommend it! everything as shown in the pictures with fully equipped kitchen, ac (if needed) and good bathroom with a tub. the neighborhood is diverse, safe and welcoming. you can find shops, restaurants, delis, laundromats,... around. sunset park is a hidden gem and very nice to spend time both daytime and nighttime. also the flatmate was very friendly and welcoming. the place is very well suited for people who want to discover authentic new york and live in a residential area outside of manhattan. there is very good connection to public transportation to manhattan, other parts of brooklyn, coney island etc. the trains run all night and getting back from 9the avenue (d-train) is very convenient. for seeing the major sites in nyc, you mostly just need to jump into one of the subways that run closeby. thanks ia for the very kind and straightforward communication throughout this trip! i felt very comfortable with you as a host and in your amazing place!
great quick stay in the city. 😁

the apartment is even bigger and cozier in person! the space is simple, but very chic – and everything we needed worked out perfectly (heat, shower's great, kitchen's well equipped, netflix works fine, wi-fi is fast, etc). the backyard is super cute too, if you're going to ny in the spring or in the summer, i'm sure that's a great bonus. the location is super convenient, right next to a subway station and plenty of mini markets and local restaurants. if you're a runner such as i am, you'll be glad to know there is a public park (mccarren parl) with a track field just 2km away from the apartment! :)

good place for a short-term stay. nir was very helpful and accommodating if i had questions or potential issues. it's probably not the best place to stay medium or long-term (for various reasons) but it is definitely clean and has everything you need. everything in it appears new, too. i think it was just renovated.

my husband and i had a wonderful stay. laura and francesco were gracious hosts. the accommodations were very comfortable and clean. perfect and convenient location for us as we worked 9am -10pm 7 days a week for 4 weeks straight. we had peace and quiet when we returned home each night. anytime we needed help they would assist us and they would leave all of our packages in our room. we would highly recommend that you book this home.

very very frustrating. they want you to do everything without a person, but none of their automated things worked as intended. there appeared to be opaque charges to my credit card as well. the room itself was lovely, comfortable and well appointed. once i waded through the long line to talk to the single person able to help me, she was indeed helpful, it just would have worked better if there’d been more people and less reliance on questionable technology.
i really loved the space. i would stay there again gladly. very clean.
host was awesome and attentive. the area has endless things for you to do, tailored more so for a younger crowd i’d say. area is so good to get to other parts of new york.
good communication, very clean place, quiet area and really nice place to stay at.
great place - amazing price and breathtaking views! will definitely stay again !
enjoyed my stay ! was very comfortable thank you !
such an amazing stay! so close to the subway and surrounding neighbourhoods. clean and beautiful apartment. jojo and jack are excellent hosts!
i stayed at ismenes place for a month and it was great! super uncomplicated check-in and the place had everything i need.

this property is absolutely wonderful - the space is clean, comfortable, and exactly as pictured on the listing. on top of that, felisha is incredibly kind and responsive. cannot recommend this stay enough!
edgar was really friendly and the space was gorgeous & clean. the cat digi is so sweet and friendly. i loved the music playing when i arrived.

this is a must- stay! fabulous place with lots to look at and amazing hospitality! lucas makes his guests feel welcomed and taken care of. the area is central and was easy to come and go. thanks lucas!
it’s okay for the price but not the best good for two beds tho
nice and comfortable space with really easy access to manhattan.
great digs! just as described. more spacious than i expected. perfect location, stellar host. i'd book this apartment again in a new york minute!

my time at j's apartment was amazing, especially the furniture is beautiful. you can go to manhattan easily. on my first day j told me about some places i could visit, and they were absolutely worth it.

this place was very clean,comfy and cozy with such a helpful and friendly staff. we had to stay 2 days longer due to our flight being cancelled and were able to come back and extended our stay.i will definitely make this my new york hotel from here on when i am out here!!
i had a fantastic stay at toshi’s apartment. there was plenty of space, apartment was clean and toshi was extremely quick to respond and always very helpful. thanks for a great stay!

my mom and i stayed for a week and this lovely little accommodation was full of good and positive vibes. virginia and steve are very thoughtful hosts, checking in to make sure the ac temp was just right since the weather was warming up during our stay. and they gave us a heads up about the street cleaning so we had time to move our car. the location was perfect for a nearby class that i was taking in a very safe and friendly feeling neighborhood. there are lots of different options for food, russian, and turkish to name a few. and fun little novelty shops nearby as well. our favorite part was the back porch, where we relaxed with wine and background sounds of children playing in nearby yards. the birds were also a lovely sound to wake up to. i hope to stay here again when i’m in the city!

we loved our stay! this place was clean, comfortable and felt safe from the moment we entered. glen was a gracious and responsive host who quickly responded to any questions i had. glen’s property felt like a home and we will definitely book again!
quieter than expected spot in brooklyn, and still just a quick walk to really good restaurants and bars. jessica was kind and welcoming and the space was lovely and comfortable for the two of us.
had a great stay at dimitri's place. it was comfortable and clean and spacious. he is a warm and welcoming host. great location in the heart of bushwick. i would stay again.
i could definitely come back. the deck and housekeeping staff were really friendly. i really love the place.

staying at omri’s place has been great. the apartment and room is clean and nicely set up (as the pictures suggest). it’s easy to get to manhattan, and there is lots of fun restaurants and bars close by. also omri is responding fast to your messages or questions, and can provide amazing tips for dinner or activities. recommend this for a stay in brooklyn.
michael was a great host. he had perfect recommendations and his home was perfect for our group. we had the best weekend

lovely spacious apartment with a nice kitchen and living room, perfectly located in a quiet neighborhood only 10 min to manhatten by metro. we stayed in the apartment for 7 days / 3 girls and had a super awesome time. the room is a little smaller than what it looks like in the pictures and the door doesnt close 100%, just keep this in mind if you are sensitive to noise. aracelis is a great host and was always there to help & advise of cool places to go. highly recommended!

in the heart of restaurants, coffee shops, shopping and near subway stations. the rooms look a bit old, but the bed is comfy and everything is immaculate clean! definitely recommend to stay as you can walk everywhere.
renzo was very responsive and helpful for the trip down to his airbnb. it was a very nice place to stay due to easy accessibility to the subway. great host and very accommodating!
great spot. clean and bright.

we had a great time at menachem’s place in nyc. it was great to find somewhere reasonably priced with two proper bedrooms. menachem was helpful with check in details and the place was clean, clutter free and in a great location
nice comfortable bedroom and bath with kitchen access in an amazing location. alejandro was friendly and helpful when we needed him. we enjoyed our stay there.
the stay was nothing short of exceptional. we enjoyed every single second of it. view was breathtaking. will definitely recommend to anybody looking to stay in manhattan.
my family loved the apartment, it was very clean and spacious !
easy communication and great room.

ayman's place was very clean and had a nice scent once you walk in. it had all the amenities needed in the kitchen as well as the bathroom - great water pressure in the shower. there were extra towels, blankets and the portable heater and snacks/water were very much appreciated. it is a private property area and i felt safe. many places to eat within a short driving distance. pictures advertised are accurate. thank you, ayman for a great stay!
great place, quiet and nice location

marianny was an excellent host. she communicated well during the entire process. i had questions before booking and she answered them quickly. she even messaged us during our stay to make sure everything was ok and that we had what we needed. we were able to drop off our things before check in and they were brought up to the room when it was ready. the airbnb looked just like the pictures and smelled good. we found everything that we needed. the bathroom was stocked with shower caps, q-tips, soap, shampoo and conditioner. we loved the assortment of teacups in the kitchen. we had a problem with the shower and toilet and she sent a plumber over to fix it. the airbnb was on the 3rd floor and had 2 nice skylights in the ceiling. we loved the natural light. we didn't have a car, but there is spot to park in the driveway. there is a train station in either direction that was about a 5 minute walk. we enjoyed our stay.

ruby's apartment was the perfect place. very clean and only 2 min walk from the subway, perfectly located if you need to go uptown or to brooklyn. ruby was very nice and made me feel like i was home. her apartment was the perfect pick for my stay in manhattan.
very nice place to stay at and affordable everything went very smooth i would stay there again!
great place very clean and the host is really friendly

if you ever visit nyc for a show at united palace, there is no better place to stay than this spot, which is just steps down the road. subway stops are just a couple of blocks away, too. this is a tremendous value, and the hosts were always quick to reply to any questions that i had. highly recommended!

dana is an amazing host! she is really nice and easy to communicate! also, she is truly helpful. i was too comfortable at her house through the end it kinda felt like home. i used most of her coffee and her kitchen is easy to use and cook! the neighbourhood is calm and secure i came late at night and all safe! the room is two-person room and really big! you also have your own closet and towels and everything! thank you dana!

jason’s place was a lovely stay for us. as we had to get to manhattan for a few activities and had friends inside brooklyn, jason’s place was perfect for us. close to the “l” about a block and half. near some great markets and food spots, especially win son bakery. the place was cozy , private and easy! perfect for a spot to rest & recharge as we were often on the go! jason was very friendly and helpful. we would definitely stay again.

this basement apt is in an great location: very quiet family street, with subway stop and supermarket, restaurants and bars literally around the corner. just 2 stops to manhattan: we were looking for quiet for our family (2 children) and this was a perfect place to sleep/have breakfast. not much light coming in, being a basement apt and by my tall husband's standards, the ceiling is low. we were busy in brooklyn/manhattan so we did only really use it to sleep. owner very easy to contact by text message and friendly, stove was not working but he offered immediately to come fix it if needed. nicely decorated, modern ikea style, comfortable beds. everything you need including bin bags, shampoo/conditioner/body wash in shower, soap dispenser at sink, lots of towels - nice touch, didn't miss anything. airco & fan working. we met very friendly cleaner when we were leaving. would stay again and loved the location.

the space was amazing and easy to find. the only draw back for my personal case was that the driveway was a little on the narrow side and i have an unreasonably wide car, so it took a bit of work to park appropriately. all in all, amazing space, great value, and i look forward to booking it again.

clean, easy check in and great for a weekend stay. my friend and i came in for a concert at forest hills stadium, good location to get to and from. elevated rail right outside the window. at night a light sleeper may have a hard time but, it did not both either of us.

this is a beautiful and spacious apartment comprising the top two floors of a brownstone. it is a half a block from central park, and 4 quick blocks from the subway, and trader joes and wholefoods are right around the corner. the kitchen is fully stocked and has plenty of everything, so you really can make meals there, which makes the whole new york experience more affordable. the living room has two long couches perfect for relaxing after a busy day in the city and before moving on to dinner. francesca was very prompt and thorough in her communications, so the whole experience was easy.

marisol responds with in a day to most messages offering quick solutions. the property is one block away from lagurdia airport terminal b. the unit was clean with essentials like coffee and cleaning materials. i was notified before the reservation was approved that there is a daycare above the unit. i thought it would be more like a pre school, i had no idea that it would be essentially kids running, jumping and screaming in between nap time. i didn't mind, but dont plan to sleep in.

what an amazing find in new york city! i can't even describe how huge this place is. i didn't know places like this existed in manhattan! having this loft as our "home base" with our two kids was perfection. after long and tiring days in the heart of the city, it was heavenly to be able to come back here and just relax and recoup. comfy beds and a dishwasher were added bonuses! we really enjoyed the neighborhood as well, it was great not to be in a touristy area and feel more like we were in the real nyc. (that said, we did come back on the earlier side via subway most evenings--by 7:00/7:30pm because of our kids--and we did make sure to be more cautious walking back at that time.) all in all, a gem of a find in manhattan. you won't regret staying here!
great neighborhood and location in brooklyn. very nice apartment. stairs are steep and narrow but that's normal in ny!! we would stay here again!
lovely place, great location, super sweet dogs!
this is a luxurious space and bruce is a great host. 10 / 10
very quaint quiet neighborhood, about a 10 minute walk from the c. lots of cute coffee shops nearby. a little harder to get around brooklyn than anticipated but not the worst.

had a wonderful experience staying here! ligia was nice to let me stay at her apartment for 2 months while i searched for my own apartment. the place was very clean, the hosts were incredibly welcoming and accommodating, and the location made getting around super easy with quick subway access nearby. would definitely stay here again.
perfect spot for nyc.

spacious and very well equiped. previous visits to nyc i have stayed in more “tourist” areas. here i really felt i got to know the real local area. excellent transport nearby got me to a couple of broadway shows in around 20 minutes. highly recommended.
highly recommend! everything was as advertised, richard responded promptly to any inquiries. clean, comfortable, close to the beach and transportation. i would definitely stay agan!

estefania and her partner were wonderful hosts. the place was as listed and better than the photos! super quiet and walkable to the subway stations, and we just enjoyed our stay. truly enjoyed our time here and would stay here again!
alison’s apartment was beautiful, spacious, and an ideal location. highly recommend!

if you are visiting new york and want a place to stay that is central, comfortable and in a lovely location, you can't go past ricki's place. we had a lovely two weeks staying there and are only sorry that it's come to an end. ricki is also the perfect host, very communicative, but leaves you to get on with your own things. also, the location is perfect. it's really close to restaurants, shops, bars, theatres etc and within a couple of minutes walk from subway stations. highly recommend!
very helpful especially at check-in and check-out.

eric’s place was very spacious and just as described! he was also very accommodating with our delayed flight as we arrived very late in the night. our privacy was an important part of our stay, and just as promised we were left in peace. thank you eric!

it was a nice and clean place. they provided us with towels, clean linens and plenty of space to place our things. they had tea and kettle that we were able to use daily. the television was very easy to navigate. there were ear plugs available in one of the rooms. john was very friendly and provided us with essential tips on how to best navigate our surroundings. it was a safe haven in the midst of the hustle and bustle of new york city!
close proximity to various points of interest
we found this property to have a relaxing atmosphere and we appreciated the start up basic groceries supplied.. the interior is 5 stars worth.
amazing place with an amazing host.

perfect location. lots to do in the neighborhood. space is super clean+airy. mo is a great host, super quick to respond to any inquiries+had amazing suggestions for spots in the neighborhood. would definitely stay again.
excellent place to stay

we had a wonderful one month stay at this apartment. the location is excellent, close to central park with easy access to transportation. the apartment was very clean and well-equipped. communication with the host was always friendly and prompt. this was our second stay here, and we would definitely choose it again.
alex was very kind
excellent place to stay in ny city.
fantastic house fantastic host
incredible location and very clean with tons of space and character. karen and kevin made the check-in process very easy and made sure we were set for our stay. definitely recommend staying here!
absolutely great stay. would definitely recommend keith’s place!

it was not made clear that we would be sharing with accommodation with strangers. this made me very nervous as we could have been sharing with someone untrustworthy. we could not relax during the week we stayed at this house as we had three different house guests. we were asked not to leave any of our belongings outside our bedroom as we had to be mindful to the other house guests but the other house guests left their belongings wherever they wanted too. the bedroom wasn’t big enough for all of our luggage and belongings. we also had no privacy to relax in the sitting room as the cleaner would come in and sit on the stairs. this made me very uncomfortable. the property is extremely noisy and the sun comes in through the bedroom window which has you awake very early. in all, the accommodation was not satisfactory at all and we will not be returning in the future.

if you need a simple bed and private “room” for a very good price in the nearby of nyc, this is it. perfect for solo travelers and if you want a budget bed to crash on. showers, toast/bagel breakfast, and the private, locking door space are great for the prime location next to msg and penn station
winda great host.respect. nice place,everything is clean. little bit time to go to manhattan, but it easy. thanks for all.

georges was an excellent host! very friendly and welcoming. had great communication and accommodated to our needs. very flexible too which was great! loved the art decor in his place to make the vibe of the place feel nice and cozy. location was very convenient for us and walking distance to times square was excellent. highly recommend as georges will take very good care of you! overall great experience and would definitely stay here again! thanks a bunch georges! :)
great, central location. clean and perfect for two people. dimond was very responsive.
one of the best airbnbs i've stayed in while in the city.
erica and luna was all we can ask for a great stay. the place is very nice, private and the neighbourhood is amazing with a lot of wonderful recommendations from erica !

this was, by far one of the nicest airbnb experiences that i have had. eliza’s place was immaculate. it was in a perfect location ( not in the middle of congestion, but within walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go). eliza was very easy to work with. can’t wait to come back to nyc and stay here again😀
my wife and 3 older children spent four days in nyc. liat’s home in brooklyn was the perfect spot. communication with liat was great before and during our stay. i would recommend this space.
very responsive hosts, very clean, updated and well supplied apt.

caio was a gracious and amazing host!! me and my family are so thankful that he opened up his home to us in such a crazy time. the place was spectacular!!! the set up was beautiful, the heated floors in the bathroom was my favorite, everything was super clean upon our arrival, the space was gorgeous, just wish the weather would of been a little better that way we could made use out of the patio. our stay couldn’t have been any better. if your looking for an airbnb and so happen to stumble across caio’s, don’t hesitate! book right away! i know the next time we’re in nyc, we’ll be booking caio’s place right away! he was also super communicative.
if you want walking distance access to times-square this is the place. they have some hidden fees or i don't know i guess that is something between airbnb and the hotel*.

as a first time airbnb user i was very satisfied. the host was very responsive and friendly and flexible with the check-in time. she provided everything needed for self check-in and always responded to my questions or concerns with compassion. there were only three things i wasn't so fond of. firstly, the floor looked clean but when my child walked bare foot his feet got super dirty (thank goodness we brought our house shoes). second, the inner door 🚪 never locked so we didnt feel completely safe at night (had to put the desk in front of the door at night). third, it was always hard/nearly impossible to find parking (but that could have been b/c it was a holiday weekend). other than that our stay was great and within walking distance to the hospital my dad was in. we would most definitely rent again. thank you mrs. beverly!

jerry's place is a little home away from home. the kitchen is equipped for home cooking and the level of privacy we had during our stay was unparalleled to any other experience on this service. everything was clean and the location was perfect as it was very close to a metro on the q line. we highly recommend this stay for anyone that is looking to be in close proximity to the city, while also enjoying independence and ample space!
hong was very kind and understanding

great place to stay for a couple days with our kids for spring break. close enough to subway and activities but also far enough for a little quiet break between sightseeing. plenty of space for nyc too.
nice place and nice host
great place for a great ny experience
super easy check in! can even leave your luggages and walk around after checking out. made this experience super easy!

staying with brandy felt like staying with an old friend 💛 her place felt very homey, cozy and safe. she’s very attentive and caring, always ready to help out. the apartment is only 7 minutes away from the subway station and an easy commute to manhattan by j train. this was my first shared apartment experience and i’m so glad it happened to be with brandy. thank you :)

aleks did a great job! his home was extremely convenient for our trip and acted as a great home base for the weekend. simple, but came with all the necessary amenities you could want for a stay in new york. would definitely stay here again!
