donovon is an excellent host. he was very responsive to all my questions and very accommodating. donovon’s place was exactly as described and spotless. bathroom is clean and big with plenty of towels. main bedroom has a very large tv for downtime, and the living does too! kitchen is fully functional with a large and refrigerator. access to the building and the apartment is very easy. place is quiet and the surroundings are very nice. walked by a beautiful garden to and from the location. and to top it off, it was very affordable. thank you donovon for letting me stay at this great location.
perfect location and great amenities.
perfect stay for a long layover near jfk! clean, large and so convenient.

room is exactly as it looks in the pictures, pretty good size, clean and it is located in a great area near many businesses. it is a 15-20 min subway ride to manhattan and subway station is just 5-7 min away walking. wendy gives you keys for your room and you have all the privacy needed. great value, recommended!
great location - very walkable & close to public transit options. lovely space, lots of room. very comfy beds & lovely shower. would stay again!

we had a great stay and will definitely book here when we come back to nyc. the unit was just as described and a great value! building was safe and had a really cool atmosphere. staff was very friendly and helpful. about 30 min subway ride to broadway or central park. fairly walkable to chinatown and downtown. soho is close by so there’s plenty of good shops and food close by.

i felt very much at home in tito' place my room had a fridge so i was able to prepare breakfasts of oats and yogurt the actual kitchen itself is not included but i did not need it. the attached bathroom is very convenient. a 10 minute walk takes you to the subway station and its about 30 mins into central manhattan. tiro has a little dog. minnie that barks a bit but she is really very nice after she gets used to you.
excellent airbnb and rashid is a great host! highly recommend!

really happy with me stay ! room is in a great location less than a 10 min walk from the subway and loved the fruit markets just 2 streets away! host were amazing and super responsive and accommodating and so respectful. really had a nice peaceful stay ! def recommend. also i felt super safe even coming back at night time
excellent location and communication. would book again!

large one-bedroom apartment in east village. marie was very responsive and also flexible on check-in and check-out time. we really enjoy our stay and did not have any problem with the place. would recommend it and would definitively come back if i was looking to be in east village.

daniel was a great host! he kept in touch to confirm everything was ok, and when i had a little issue with the heater he told me how to solve it almost instantly. moreover, the room was pretty spacious and comfortable (specially the bed), with pretty big closets, tv and a drawer where i could put my computer. the wifi worked fine, and the common areas -kitchen, living room, bathroom- were modern and clean. the area was fine as well: perfectly safe, with all kinds of shops and restaurants around, and not too far from manhattan (the subway was just a couple of blocks away). the museum of the moving image (a must see for cinema lovers like me) is only a 5/10 minutes walk, so that's another good point. overall, very recommendable, i'd definitely go back! =)

everything was nice and host was very reliable and responded very quickly. price could’ve been a little better but overall everything else was great! the place itself was nice and roomy and fit everyone comfortably!
so thankful to find owen’s place. wonderful location. amazing spot to rest in the city. owen is a great host!
overall nice stay! one of the cheapest options for places to stay close to the city and i appreciated that they had a nice bathtub

evelyn is a great host! the place we stayed in was very clean and we felt at home. for what we needed, which was just a place to stay while we explored nyc for a weekend, it was perfect. evelyn was very commutative whenever we had a question or a just wanted to update her on our arrival. she included extra toiletries and towels, which was great! we loved that we had our room, plus a room to sit in and watch tv while we ate some food, and a small kitchen. the bathroom was very nice as well, only small complaint about that was the low water pressure but it was nothing too bad. although other people lived in the house, we never heard them at all. we loved how close 2 subway lines were (the 3 and l), which could take us to manhattan pretty fast. overall we had a great time, but we did want to mention that the area did feel sketchy at times, especially at night. but we saw officers patrol the area quite often. we hope to come back soon! again, thank you for accommodating us.

okay stay. not sure if i’d recommend, unless you’re really looking for a place. didn’t meet expectations or description tbh. well priced, especially as i had the whole apartment to myself. but there were a lot of things not available/missing. the internet didn’t work, well, so i couldn’t do work. and the tv also didn’t work—said couldn’t connect to wi-fi. tried messaging the host & the instructions just didn’t apply.
jeff place is great highly recommended.
stayed for a month. everything was exactly as listed and clean. appreciated the quiet in the apartment and the given kitchen supplies etc. enjoyed my stay!
the house was in immaculate condition, communication was smooth, the house overall was very spacious.

bran was an exceptional host. everything was very clearly communicated - from entering her space to the check-out procedure. the apartment is absolutely adorable and “sun-drenched” is exactly the right adjective. i wish i could just move in! we had an unexpected family tragedy happen during our stay, and we left earlier than planned as a result. bran checked in on us and was so sweet while we were trying to figure out all of our logistics. she even gave us a condolence card and a box of chocolates - a sweet gesture that went a long way during a sad time. i really can’t say enough nice things about bran and her space. oh! and be sure to eat dinner at the loft while you’re in flatbush.
we only stayed a night but overall was perfect for what we needed. it felt a little hostel-like with quirky decor but not a bad thing. smooth check in, ticked our boxes!
vance is really nice and kind. she also knows a lot about different culture. chatting with her is awesome!
bed was comfortable. ac unit in bedroom was a life saver! it kept a good temperature while cancelling out the very loud music being blasted by neighbor.
subway is close, neighboarhood is safe, confortable and clean room, i must say that there was a lot noise from nearby subway. but everything was right
communication was great and the place was very friendly to my wallet!

ryan's place is awesome. it is excellently located to all of the fun places in greenpoint, the subway and transmitter park. ryan's communication was fantastic and was easy to reach during our stay. thanks for having us!

we loved charlotte's haven - and thats what it was! beautifully designed, very peaceful and true to the photos. it was clean, calm and close to just about everything. a wonderful space to come home to after a day in the city. charlotte left us very helpful information, was quick to respond to any questions we had and was very amenable when planes and trains didn't arrive on time. you couldn't have asked for a better host. you are an 8 minute walk to the subway (2nd av ), a 12 minute walk to delancey and essex station and roughly a 14 minute walk to broadway and laffette station. walking distance to shopping in soho, nolita or a quick bite at katz's diner or perhaps you prefer clinton st bakery.... whichever tickles your fancy- it's all in this neighbourhood. this was my third time using air bnb for a stay in nyc - and by far my favourite. every stay has been roughly two weeks. thank you charlotte for making our stay truly wonderful and for letting us stay in your special space.
a nice and comfy place. carol is very detailed and serious about the upkeep of the room.

very comfortable stay :) the room is spacious, the bed is wonderfully firm, and the hostess is responsive and lovely. i wasn't too familiar with the area initially, but i had no problems - seemed safe to me. the subway lines are so close, and there are various grocery shops conveniently around in case you need to purchase something to eat or get a needed toiletry. only con would be that you have to share the restroom and kitchen (keep in mind you do have a mini-fridge in your room which is super convenient!), but thankfully the other tenants/guests were all incredibly respectful and clean so tbh no complaints there.
great appartment at a really good location. i can recommend.

susan is great host. i would rate her 5+. the place was outstanding with lots of room, beautiful art pieces and many special touches. i have stayed in several air bnb and this is my favorite. great location, great place and great host. pictures are accurate of this beautiful place. if available i will definitely stay again. thanks susan for wonderful stay. john
awesome place for a quick stay! plenty of safe parking on the street if driving. the 5 train station is a quick walk up the block too. tuan is a great host and was available for assistance if needed.

super hosts for sure! such an amazing experience staying in their home. the place was very clean, spacious and had everything you need when you are traveling. there was plenty hot water for the shower ++ parking was perfect because of their help. very attentive, checked in on us to make sure we were ok and if we needed help getting around they not only told us but walked and showed us. one of the best experiences i’ve had with abnb and will forever remember it. it’s the little things. traveling through brooklyn to everywhere helps experience public trans. and see everything ny. 👍🏼👍🏼
brian was a great host. he went above and beyond to ensure i had everything i needed. his place was exactly what i needed for a day in nyc.

we really enjoyed our stay at this airbnb. it was our first time staying at an airbnb where the host was also living with us but she was very courteous and accommodating. we never felt uncomfortable and had an amazing experience.
another great stay at andre’s. everything great as usual. thanks andre!

we stayed at the apartment for six nights. the apartment seemed large for a studio. the location was terrific. there is a great variety of restaurants within a block or two. subway stations were within several blocks. the apartment was clean and well equipped, although we didn't use the kitchen due to the convenience and proximity of good restaurants. the neighborhood was quiet and seemed safe at all hours. lisa was a good communicator -- she always responded, if not immediately, certainly within an hour or two. the apartment was a good choice for our new york visit, and we would gladly stay there again.

very good place. perfect location or restaurants right downstairs that are really delicious. walking distance to a lot of parks and sites. the place itself was really nice and clean and i highly recommend staying here.
great place for a stay in nyc. the hosts were very kind. the house is a bit far from downtown manhattan but very close to metro line 2.
it was an amazing stay, she was a great host. i highly recommend her and her wonderful space.
great location!! clean and convenient with a concierge. only a 4 rating because mattress needs updated.
close train ride into the city and a nice place!
great location, the space is exactly as described, and karen is great to work with. would book again!
good and comfortable overnight stay - nice hosts as well.

we had a wonderful time here. the apartment is peaceful, clean and comfortable. the back bedroom was very comfortable and quite. nice bed. neighborhood is friendly with many stores and restaurants just a few blocks away. perfect location for access to central park. a short walk to the 96th street subway station took us to the "wtc" in 25 minutes. we did enjoy the library in the parlor as it allowed us to prepare for our adventures to the parks and museums in the area. a very interesting building with much history and a perfect location.

pamela’s accommodation was excatly as describe. she was really helpful, always answered quickly and guided very clearly and gave helpful tips. apartment is very close to subway station and it was really easy to go to manhattan from pamela’s place. only one change and this change was also very easy, the next track on the same platform. for the guests is good to know couple things: it is not possible to lock the door to your own room, at least out room did not have a lock. for us it was not a problem. there might be also noisy sound from heatingsystem at night, that does not last long though. there were several rooms for guests and one bathroom. so if all the rooms are full, the bathroom (toilet in it) is very occupied if everyone is taking for instance a shower in the morning. thank you pam for accommodation and all the best to you and your family!

e&m gave me the best experience i can ever have!! they are so friendly and accommodating. as a single traveler first time in new york, they have me a lot of useful info for the attractions and transportation. i will definitely want to come back and stay in the lovely apartment!! thank you both so much again!!:)

this place was perfect. it was just like the photos and description. the location is within 2 blocks of the subway so it’s pretty easy to get around. the area is pretty quiet for new york and the host was accommodating and quick to help with any needs.
great space very clean and exactly as described 🙏🏾🙏🏾

norma and daniel’s place had exactly what one would need for a stay. the place was clean, the beds were comfortable, and the kitchen was stocked with necessary supplies. there was cable and air conditioning and de-humidifying which i very much appreciated. the surrounding neighborhood can feel a little questionable upon arrival but the neighborhood was quiet and it seemed everyone knew one another and mostly kept to themselves. the beach is literally around the corner. daniel and norma were highly responsive hosts and i very much appreciated their excellent hospitality. 🙏🏼

enjoyed my stay just as much as the first time & now with my boys, they had fun & my 3 year old even called it home💕 thank you yolanda for getting me checked in at an earlier time due to traveling , i appreciate the gifts & thank you for hosting my little family ✨
great place to stay for a quick in-and-out trip to nyc!
we spend 5 nights at john’s place and we loved it. super clean and well located. looking forward to be there again in the future.

i had a wonderful stay at mike’s place! the home was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. check-in was smooth, and communication was always prompt and helpful. i really appreciated the attention to detail from the comfortable linens to the peaceful atmosphere. the location was convenient and quiet, perfect for a relaxing stay. i’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!

it was one of the best if not the best place me and my partner have ever stayed at in new york using airbnb. the location is convenient as it’s close to the subway station, it’s easy to ride the bus, and you can ride the ferry to reach manhattan so there are a lot of options for traveling from place to place. there is also a supermarket near the station at 30th ave that’s open even at midnight. the view is breathtaking, the room is very stylish and clean and cozy, especially the bed! there was a table complete with utensils and there was a microwave and a mini fridge. check in was smooth because nazleen gave us very helpful and clear instructions, response is also very fast. i definitely recommend this place and would love to come back!
my stay at kareem’s place was absolutely fantastic! the apartment was spotless and beautifully decorated. the location was perfect,

this unit is awesome and the beekman tower is awesome. hector, at the front desk, was welcoming, engaging, and helpful. perfectly located in a quiet part of manhattan, but near some lively eating establishments on 2nd ave. million dollar view of east river.
beautiful block, just a little far from the train station. the house was great, very clean and private.
very accommodating to your needs
great host responsible celan and cozy place thx kai
it was an okay stay, just wasn’t the right place for me personally
great place to stay!
very friendly host, cosy and affordable space.
pretty, homey and cozy interior! walking distance to parks and cool restaurants. it was so clean and i felt totally safe and comfortable.
great spot! would be happy to stay there again!
nice, clean and very central apartment.

love love love the location. great views and so close to the ferry and train. lots to do in the area. the apartment is very big for nyc standards and very nicely furnished. only negative, the shower. barely trickles through the shower head and takes forever to get hot (which may be a building problem more than host problem). all in all a great place, great location, great visit! definitely would use debra again!!

i booked this accommodation for my dad as he came to new york to visit me and he had a great time. carol was an amazing host, the house was spotless and felt very homely. the house felt safe and secure and was so close to the subway station. my dad stayed for 2 weeks and had absolutely no issues during the stay. anytime another guest checked in during dads stay we were notified. we were taken care of extremely well and it really does show that carol and her daughter care about their guests!
very clear to communicate
it was comfortable and easy access to transport. i would recommend this place to anyone.
very economical; clean, and served our needs. if you want luxury, go elsewhere.
thank you for the perfect stay for the evening- we will definitely book this space again!

we couldn’t ask for a nicer place to stay. the host and accommodations are lovely, and the carroll gardens neighborhood is beautiful! it was really easy to get to other parts of the city from there. we had such a great trip!

great place . great value for money . such hospitable hosts . you will feel at home the moment you walk in . the place is located 10 min walk from all the restaurants and cool bars of bushwick , and 2 min walk from broadway av which is a bit dodgy , but nothing out of the ordinary in bk . the space itself was super clean , well equiped as if josh and victoria took care of all the nuances you could imagine . bed is amazingly comfortable, and the ac was a life save in one of the hottest days ive ever experienced in ny . will definitelly come back again .
javier is a very good host :) location is extremely convenient near chinatown, can go to downtown/lower manhattan by metro within a very short period of time
great stay, would happily return. easy communication and check in.

shelly was one of the sweetest host i’ve had using airbnb . the space was just rite , had everything i needed . she helped in so many ways i didn’t expect also . there’s nothing to complain about . i would definitely book with her again ❤️ thank you shelly

it was a pleasure staying at mondy's airbnb. the hospitality, cleanliness and neighborhood was excellent. the room was very cozy and relaxing. mondy's willingness to offer any assistance was 👍🏽. i would definitely rebook this airbnb.

great space, even better than the photos. very modern, quiet, and secure building. nawid was extremely responsive, helpful, and kind. the space had everything we needed and more for a comfortable month. we loved our stay and will be back!
cozy room. good accessibility to land marks. friendly and kind host.

really, really loved staying at saint's place. it was in a great spot right next to central park and bustling outside. saint is such a lovely, warm and welcoming person who truly loves hosting people from all around the world. be prepared to receive a warm hug upon arrival. the kitchen and bathroom was always exceptionally clean. really recommending saint's place to anyone looking at staying in new york.
diane was friendly, proactive and responsive. this is a simple apartment at a good price point. there are many local amenities and i would stay again.
geny is a wonderful host and made me feel completely at home. she's very kind and helpful. the unit is a great location if you want to be close to the city

my husband and i stayed in leecia's home during our recent trip to new york to celebrate our wedding anniversary and we couldn't be more happy with our choice of accommodation. we received a lovely warm welcome when we arrived and were shown to the lovely shabby chic apartment that really suited our taste and our needs. the apartment was very tidy, super clean, with a comfortable bed and great shower - there was also a fan and air conditioning in the room which was perfect! on our arrival leecia provided us with a map of the neighbourhood and took the time to advise us on the subway routes. even before we arrived in nyc, leecia was so helpful with our questions and really quick to respond. the apartment was in a good neighbourhood, with friendly locals and we felt completely safe and secure throughout our stay. the apartment was just a short walk to a choice of subway stations and we were able to get to everywhere we wanted to see quickly and easily. we had an amazing time in new york and feeling so welcome in leecia's lovely home meant that after a long day of walking and sightseeing, we looked forward to coming back to the apartment. we have already recommend leecia to our friends and family and this place would be our first port of call should we return to new york in the future - thank you leecia! xx
erica was a great host. great response and studio was in a great location, so close to the subway stations. would definitely stay here again.
marjan was such a great host! the listing is exactly what you get and more! would stay here again.

i had a great experience with andrew and this apartment! the location is great- tons of good restaurants and markets within a few blocks. and the apartment was even nicer than i imagined it would be/looked from the photos- loved all the light (which you often don't get in nyc apartments) and the spacious bedroom. andrew was super responsive and accommodating. i would definitely stay there again!
for the price a great location and room. russell very accommodating and flexible. would recommend.

definitely would come back. roula provides her place 100% clean this is the cleanest place i stayed in all airbnb so far. very comfortable. warm in winter and quiet. plenty of space and a fully equipped kitchen. everything worked out perfectly. everything as expected no late surprises. highly recommended.

i enjoyed my stay at serenity space. the room was spacious, clean, quiet and comfortable. communication with marie and yasmina was nice and easy. they were friendly and kind. the location has good public transport connections, access to supermarkets and cafes/ restaurants. please note the room is on the top floor (up a few flights of stairs) in case you intend on bringing a heavy suitcase. i would be happy to stay again one day.
great option for temporary stay. clean room and were friendly host. highly recommend
lory and cindy was such great hosts! the apartment is huge and very clean. beds were very comfy and the neighborhood is pretty nice. everything was perfect. highly recommended :)
thank you for the accommodation. the place is fine. you just need a few more things in the kitchen. but it's cozy
i love your place. you're a great host. thank you for everything.

bobby was very thoughtful and readily available whenever we needed help. he showed up to help us get into the apartment, and made sure we had a place to store our luggage. the place was super clean, and he gave great pointers on local things to do. 10/10 would stay again!

the location was very good, very easy to go to manhattan. there were amazing restaurants nearby. the place was very clean and the room we stayed was very quiet. vincent was nice and friendly. we recommend his place!
bedroom was extremely hot for summer night, no air conditioning or airflow in bedroom.
brady's hospitality and welcoming was above average and was a great host. highly recommend!

great apartment, exactly what we needed, since we were only there to sleep - sightseeing tours in the area of brooklyn, manhatten and new jersey, all areas easy reachable by a subwaystation nearby. the coffee from the deli next door was the best we've had during our stay in brooklyn. communication was easy and very friendly

andres was super accommodating and super friendly along with his wife marina. marina is an incredible host, and she made me feel right at home. i thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a home away from home. thank you andres and marina.
george is a really nice person and a great host. the apartment was a great place to stay. thanks again!
great stay! clean, good location, great communication from the host. would definitely stay again!

eric was a great host where he not only showed us how to work appliances but to do’s if anything bothered us. the place is beautiful and def will book this place again. i was nervous about not having a door in the loft but the brick walls and space portion ensure 100% privacy. we absolutely loved this place ! eric was responsive and respectful. as a bronx native the neighborhood was quiet and eric’s home felt as if you were not in the city. thank you again eric for such a great experience.
this listing is as described, close to jfk, clean, and comfortable. i recommend this listing highly.

very responsible & respectful hosts. they went above & beyond to make everything as comfortable as it could be during our stay. they even brought us pastries and teas which were amazing. definitely would recommend this place for anyone looking in the area, not only for the airbnb, but for these hosts. if i’m back in the area in the future, i will be staying here.

this apartment was absolutely ideal for me and my friend. we felt right at home it was spacious, clean, lovely area. we didn’t want to leave at all. we had everything on our door step and the walks down the pier were unbelievable. i couldn’t thank alice enough for giving us a home away from home
lee’s place is exactly as described. it’s nyc so there’s a lot of street noise. the apartment is nothing fancy, but it’s close to all the action, clean and exactly what we needed. thanks lee.
i have been at nick’s place several times. it is clean, very pleasant, and organized. nick is a wonderful host. he really looks out for you. plus, the location is perfect for park slope.
i totally loved the hospitality offered by joo and her husband. would definitely keep visiting !

my stay was perfect. the interiors were well designed and chic. the building was quiet, clean and in a wonderful neighborhood. i would recommend this location and any that the host has and 100% would stay again.
amazing stay in ny convenient and close to china town. make sure you arrive on time , check in doesn’t start until 3pm
a very good host. i felt at home
great place, close to a train station & immediate surroundings provide with the basic needs for your stay. furthermore it’s quiet and a great getaway.

what else can i say ? ronald and i lived real "buddy" moments in we sometimes watched tv shows together when back from my trips in nyc. his apartment is comfy and warm, the room is big. i really enjoyed the view on soundview park at mornings. ronald is available for picking you up and bringing you at the airport, just bring cash to pay tolls. nobody bothered me in the bronx, there were old ladies blessing me and even guys cheering me for bringing beer at home :) i found real italians in bronx little italy, which i reached in 40 minutes by bus, speaking italian and telling me their stories. you will find a lot of spanish speakers ad well, so life will be easy as a tourist. consider have a tour of northern bronx, you will find awesome natural parks. only downside is that corridor in the building had a strong weird smell that make me feel bad when i was leaving the apartment, but that's not ronald's fault.
clean, convenient, and comfortable. host was very responsive and helpful.

i recently had the pleasure of staying at jessy’s place, and it was a fantastic experience. the apartment is beautifully decorated and impeccably clean, providing a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. the amenities are top-notch, making it feel like a home away from home. jessy, the host, was incredibly responsive and attentive, ensuring that all our needs were met. from helpful local tips to quick replies to our questions, jessy made our stay seamless and enjoyable. i highly recommend jessy’s place for anyone looking for a lovely getaway. you won’t be disappointed!
jenny’s place is clean and well labeled. she was very responsive to my questions. i would stay again when i am in the area.

marcus was absolutely amazing. first off communication was very efficient and clear to start off with when we got there, the place looked remarkable everything was spotless and clean. i love the aesthetic. it definitely gave a new york vibe the entire day. i felt very comfortable and at home, i really enjoyed being toiletries. he had a new restroom. they definitely came in handy overall i had a wonderful experience with marcus and can’t wait to come back.
great location. easily accessible to all over the city. very clean and friendly staff

andy was warm and understanding. initially we had an issue with the smell inside the room so we had to air out the room for a whole day. then it was fine. the kitchen has all the amenities. the room had cooler, ac and heater the location was good. overall good stay
this was a fantastic stay. it's the only place i'll stay when i visit nyc. the price is great, location, free coffee and pastries every morning. the bed was heavenly, like sleeping on a cloud!

hi, apologies for grammar and typos, doing this on my phone. i stayed at this apartment for five weeks during peak covid 19 (july 2020). upon arrival the space wasn’t entirely cleaned, there were quite a few loose hairs in the bathroom and the dishes clearly hadn’t been cleaned. i expected better for a $100 cleaning fee, especially since we are in a pandemic. i had to thoroughly clean everything to be comfortable in the space overall the stay was enjoyable. great location don’t get locked out! they're going to charge you $50 before they will send someone to unlock the door. but thats the least of your issues, good luck dealing with the grumpy “emergency line” i forgot keys inside taking out trash at 9pm (understand its late so brevity etc is acceptable) but was greeted with sarcastic and aggressive responses such as “i’m not a mind reader” when i forgot to include apartment number in my initial text. fyi their guy came with a roll of 50ish keys it probably didn’t matter all they needed was my name to charge me. i would have appreciated a “what apartment #” or something similar instead of sarcasm additionally, i forgot an item moving out. i knew housekeeping was there because we connected on the way out. since i didn’t have keys i had no means of getting into the building. i texted the emergency number to ask to contact them. zero response. i followed up the next day thanking them for ignoring me and they said “we only respond to emergencies”. i dont expect 5 star hotel amenities from an airbnb but for a professional short term leasing agent they should have a better system in place. they’ll charm you until you pay and stay and goodluck. its not a bad place but be prepared for absolutely zero support systems. also theres only one washer/ dryer for 16 units four flights of stairs down

manuel’s place is beautiful, spacious, comfortable and convenient. we loved our stay - it was easy to get to prospect park as well as the subway and cute places around the area. we enjoyed the grocery store nearby, the coffee shops and wine cellar, as well as some restaurants in park slope that were a short subway ride/uber. we could easily walk to spots in fort greene as well. we would definitely come back!

brooklyn and rr were great hosts and what stood out is rr was extremely proactive and responsive. anything we needed, he supported us quickly and went out of his way to go above and beyond. the place was great and well decorated, making us feel right at home. we enjoyed using the well-stocked kitchen everyday to make food, although there are also plenty of restaurants nearby. for us being super close to trader joe’s and whole foods was great! highly recommend.

hosts were amazing and they responded in a timely manner. the house was clean and looked exactly like the pictures. loved having a driveway to use (ny parking is horrible), as well as the back patio. definitely stay again.
michelle’s place is amazing! the house is so conveniently located that we didn’t have a hard time getting around places. overall 10/10 and i would definitely come back and stay again.

great spot for a long term stay (10 weeks). host was very responsive with various fixes we needed throughout. the location is unbeatable with trader joe’s a minute walk away. great restaurants and nightlife in the area too. neighborhood is very safe and by new york standards, very quiet as well. the check in / check out process was seamless and the keyless entry / virtual doorman was fantastic. the apartment was well stocked with utensils and kitchenware, and the beds were extremely comfortable. a+ stay and would not hesitate to book again.

great place in a great location. this is the little downstairs apartment you wish you had when out of town family comes to stay. warm, homey, and just a block in either direction to everything you need. j was so very accommodating in every way. she was there for our late night check in and totally flexible with check out time. thank you thank you for sharing your home with us.
quiet neighborhood & nice bed!
the best house in flushing and host give me much helps i really appreciate.
we love staying in this house and all the owner's hospitality
timely responses, very flexible. well maintained and clean apartment

my mom, baby daughter and i had a wonderful stay in this beautiful historic home. theresita is a warm, responsive and very helpful host. although we shared the bathroom with her and she stayed in a nearby room, we felt that we had enough privacy. extra special touches were a toothbrush/toothpaste kit, ground coffee and some snacks. she was also flexible with check out time which we so appreciated. thank you!
a good clean stay. locks were a little difficult to open.

the apartment was spacious and didn’t feel cramped for a party of 8. also was clean and tidy. however, the location was different than what was advertised on the listing which led to some confusion. also, the area was a bit rough and noisy. so if you’re looking for a quiet neighbourhood, this is not for you.and the water pressure in the bathroom was rather inconvenient. the apartment had all the immediate essentials but it could do with a little more investment in the rooms and better dining table and chairs.
my host was very helpful. she showed me how to get in and out of the building. my room was very clean. i will be staying here again as it is a short walk from my daughters apartment.

great location and simon is a great host. the apartment is exactly as described, very clean and spacious. we immediately felt at home. simon is very responsive and always available. we liked the neighborhood, two subway stations as well as the supermarkets are very ease to reach by foot and we felt very safe also when coming home late in the evening. will book it again the next time we visit ny.
clean, neat and spacious the beds are comfortable he got clean dishes there as well
one of the best places to stay at

what a superb quirky find on airbnb. the best possible location from which manhattan is a walking island. janet is a great and friendly host, helpful and responsive. the flat is spacious and comfortable. very private! it is a great asset to have a small kitchen for a quick bite or drink before going out! i hope we will be back!!!!
ruth is an excellent host who goes above and beyond to cater to the comfort of her guests. i highly recommend.
wendy is so nice & friendly. my stay was wonderful!

my wife and i had a great time at this appartment and would not hesitate in recommending it to other people. this was out first booking through airbnb and we did not know what to expect, but the entire process was so easy we will be doing it again. daniel was great at answering any qeueries we had prior to our trip so we knew exactly where we were going. on arrival the doorman was very friendly. he couldn't find the key which worried us slightly and when he did, it wouldn't open the door. a call was made to the super who was there in minutes and cleaned out the lock. it was great to know that the doormen and the super where there is anything else happened. but there was no other issues, and it was a very minor blip on what was an amazing stay in new york, we found no fault with the apartment. it is very comfortable, very well located and felt like home. the shop across the street does all sorts of food so check it out for breakfast on the terrace. also, connolly's along the road does great food and is great after a long day sight seeing. we were sad to leave, hopefully we'll get to go back soon!
host went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable at home. they made a personal connection and advised us on our travel plans. great stay!

ronald is truly one of the best hosts i've met. going out of his way to make sure you got everything you need for the stay. pro's: best host ever, good location, close to central subway lines, room and bathroom are very clean, towels replaced frequently. con's: room is small, aircon a bit noisy (quiet fan available), kitchen isn't very clean, no place to eat but on your own bed. smell of weed at times.
wonderful harlem townhome. cool space. great kitchen and dining area for our large family at thanksgiving. we walked to the apollo, shopped on 125th street and enjoyed great restaurants.

great location—about a block from a subway station, ~¼ mile from the famous 1915 lanzhou noodles, and within a mile of many excellent chinatown restaurants. check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow. the room itself was modern, clean, and comfortable. a few downsides: the outlets didn’t fully charge devices (battery packs plugged in all night only reached ~30%), which made navigating the city difficult w/o a reliable charge. the thermostat also kept reverting back to 65 no matter what we set it to. one day there was a very loud noise that sounded like thunderstorm sounds. it didn’t bother me personally, but i could see it bothering others. the stay is very self-service—you need to carefully follow instructions and keep track of multiple fobs/cards (with $150 loss fees). we stayed 4 nights and only had one towel/washcloth per person the entire stay. lastly, the patio door was extremely difficult to open. it might help future guests if there were instructions provided for ho

maia'a place in the east village was perfect for my 8-day stay in nyc. the place is very clean and is located close to some amazing restaurants and lively nightlife. maia is also a fantastic host, she is full of recommendations for places to try and is extremely accommodating to guests' needs. i had an awesome stay here and would highly recommend it to anyone looking to explore nyc.

it's the second time we stay there and it's an awesome place to stay in!! guerlaine is such a great host. she made sure we had everything we needed and recommended us what to do. the house is in a great location and its really easy to get places from. it's just as described, so lovely. we're choosing it again if going to ny.

really great apartment. stayed here for a month in june, and it was perfect for two people. could reasonably fit a third if they slept on the couch (which was very comfy). the apartment is brighter than the photos make it seem which was a pleasant surprise. location was great - always felt safe, right across from target and other shopping centers (including whole foods and trader joe’s just a bit further), great restaurants in the area. it was generally very quiet, thanks to the double paned windows, but there were regularly dirt bikes/ atvs riding down flatbush which made it a bit louder sometimes; however, the sound at night was never an issue - we never woke up from loud noises. the fan in the bedroom also creates some white noise. there’s lots of storage space to utilize, which is appreciated. kitchen was a bit barebones but still useable (most everyday kitchen tools are included) - pretty good size as well. communicated with owen’s father henry (the building owner i believe) for the stay when needed, but thankfully there were never any issues that warranted us needing his help. overall, i highly recommend this listing - it’s really a great deal, and a wonderful place for longer stays.

aika’s place has great subway access and is convenient to everything you need. the bedroom is really clean, the bed is really comfortable and aika was really nice and easy going. the subway of course as advertised, and there can be street noise, as would be expected for much of new york but aika offered earplugs which was kind. definitely this apt was a great deal. thanks so much!!
great location! the place is cute and comfy. perfect for a couple.
perfect spot for a stay in new york! close to multiple subway lines and comfortable and safe.

so michaels place was amazing, the house has such a great vibe with all the walls having some sort of poster/ comic or a funny quote. it was clean, smelled good, had a mini fridge in the room and overall the place was great. and as for michael, he was very social and welcoming as soon as i arrived and made me feel comfortable instantly. he was responsive, a great communicator, gave recommendations for places to eat and helped navigate the new york transport as soon as i got there. he also allowed me to take anything to eat or drink from his fridge/pantry which made it easier for me incase i ever felt hungry, and also it helped me just grab a quick fruit from his fridge the last couple of days from my stay. he had netflix and other streaming services as well so there was nothing which was not available on tv. as i was travelling from a different country i had forgotten my charger and michael had all sorts of converters and adapters for my phone to charge. highly recommend this place.

really one of my best experience in airbnb felt like i was going to my own home really feel like a family, will definitely stay there at least two more times this year. i highly recommend! me gusta mucho este lugar se siente como mi casa!

the apartment is simple, but very charming and has everything we need. it is very near central park and subway and buses. there are stores in front where you can buy food and lots of things. dana is a wonderful hostess! she gave us all the instructions about the keys, lights, bathroom, places to visit, buses and subways we had to use...she is really friendly!
perfect all around. big and beautiful in my favorite part of the city. i look forward to returning!

i enjoyed very much staying at nadia’s place. it is a very pleasant studio and very easy to get to the subway and bus.nadia was very kind offering to drive me to my daughter just as i arrived from the airport.

we've been to countless airbnbs in nyc and this has to be the best place all the boroughs have to offer. great owner, awesome super, and overall great place to stay. this is the type of apartment that screams out city living while having all public transportation, bars, entertainment, and food just steps away.
great location. cozy place with everything you need. tal is a very responsive host. would stay again.

we cannot say enough how much we enjoyed our stay in brooklyn. the subway was within walking distance, as were various stores to pick up some additional items besides what was there for us already. there were snacks, breakfast items, and hot dogs, bread, bagels, etc. everything was clean and was in working order. when i needed paper towel, i texted and it was there in a flash! both hosts were easy to contact and very nice about checking in early and leaving our bags until our flight left later in the evening. we highly recommend staying, as long as you can walk the 10 minutes to the l train!

the location is fantastic for a city break. our family was in nyc for 6 days and the central location was spot on! we had a late departure flight, but the hotel was happy to hold our luggage free of charge, which was excellent. if your used to a comprehensive hotel breakfast, then you might be alittle disappointed. but considering it's free with ab&b, you really can't complain. our son was really quite happy when he realised he could have fresh waffles every morning! great host, great stay and great family trip.
me and my boyfriend stayed for 2 nights as we were in ny for a concert. cute cozy place and we had soup made by one of the hosts on our 2nd night. lovely time!

angelica was a fantastic host! she was flexible with me having to arrive quite late from the airport, and was really responsive the whole stay. the room was exactly what i hoped for and was a wonderful place to relax. i would stay again anytime!
sparkling clean, quiet and affordable 😊

we really enjoyed our time in jo's place. the room is big, with space for our luggage, a table and air conditioning (it's really warm in august). the area is awesome too, with bars, markets, restaurants and subway stops nearby. i recommend it.

honestly great place. easy check in, clean, and great price. you’d pay the same at any hotel except without all the extra fees and hidden charges. train stations are easy to find, so if you don’t mind using the train to get to the popular spots around the city then this place is perfect. will definitely be looking to book again next time i’m there.

enjoyed a lovely stay at noelva's cottage. the heated bedroom floor was a welcome surprise especially on the snowy morning. carlos is a treasure! noelva and her neighbors all gracious making my first trip back home to city island a wonderful experience. nature provided two awesome sunrises over the sound. i definitely recommend and hope to return to noelva's great hospitality soon
awesome host! very accommodating!

i did not get to meet olivier when i was there but we kept in touch via text, especially when my flight was cancelled and i could not arrive as planned. he was very helpful and made sure someone in the apartment could help me get in late. i really liked the apartment overall, everything is clean and organised and the room was perfect. he also left a lot of useful tips and asked me how i was doing now and then! which i really appreciated since i was travelling alone. i used the a and c subway lines most frequently and these are just 10 minutes' walk away. i would definitely stay with olivier again next time i am in new york!

the apartment is very well located with lots of places to eat within walking distant. there is a whole food a block away but there is a cheaper option just a block from it. bedford street is vibrant and fun and has the best bagel place! area is very safe to walk. we will definitely come back to stay for sure.
definitely recommend, i would stay at this place again
jg sohotel is a great at central spot in the heart of manhattan. the hotel was clean and the beds were the very comfortable. i would definitely recommend this hotel for the price!

ingrid's space is lovely and very clean. communication was excellent. my family was there on thanksgiving and ingrid was very welcoming, helpful with local restuarants that were open that day and even left us a pie! she is a very kind and gracious host.

my husband, son and i enjoyed our stay at nili's place. the location is perfect with a short walk to the subway and lots of wonderful restaurants and shops nearby. the beds were comfortable and the kitchen well stocked. we agree with a former reviewer that you can hear noise from upstairs, which wasn't a surprise since you are sharing the living space with nili and her family.
good place to stay in a good neighborhood! alaa was responsive and helpful.

thank you for being such responsive and helpful hosts! apartment was exactly like the photos . unlocking the door can be tricky but you get used to it! unfortunately, my stay was cut short due to safety concerns which were out of the hosts control.

this was my first airbnb experience and i have to say chavis was awesome. the place was very convenient and happen to be were i needed to be. i was able to get early checkin, was actually able to find parking on the block and close to the house. the home as pictured so your getting a nice place. the kitchen was bigger than i thought. very welcoming atmosphere. home is on a quite block as well. i would definitely recommend and visit this home again. thank you chavis for your hospitality.

the apartment is in a fantastic location, it's so easy to get everywhere. we spent most of our trip in brooklyn and the lower east side (the former was a 2 stop subway ride and the latter was a simple walk to the best restaurants and bars in manhattan). the apartment was perfect for us, it had everything we needed and dan was a great host. he was super helpful, gave great suggestions regarding the area and made the checking in and out process very simple especially on our last day when we had a late flight and he kindly let us stay in the apartment until the afternoon. i fully recommend booking this place to see the best of nyc!
great location. friendly staff
great space and location… walking distance to restaurants groceries and more. kitchen well stocked, furniture and beds very comfortable. easy subway access. great communication.

great location! claude was both sweet and considerate. he surprised us each morning with gourmet cookies, muffins, and personalized notes. my only complaints were that i wished that the place was cleaner and that previous tenants were gone before i arrived. overall, i feel that claude was a generous and accommodating host. thank you.

the good: location - pretty close to the subway, so great connectivity to nyc and beyond adorable cat - gigi, their cat was adorable. 5 stars for her! ac - we visited on a very hot, humid weekend. the effective and strong ac was a life saver! kitchen: the kitchen was well stocked and we appreciate the fact that they were ok for the guests to use kitchen stuff. the bad: cat litter/poop smell: the living area smelt of cat litter/poop for the whole of our stay. and there was litter on the floor. as cat parents ourselves, we didn't mind having the cat around, infact we enjoyed it. but having to spend 4 days smelling (rather trying not to) unchanged smelly cat litter was painful. cleanliness: dry splotch on the kitchen counter, used underwear hanging in the master bathroom, stained (looked like blood) pillow cover in mb, untidy backyard - nowhere as clean as the photos suggested. on the whole place was unclean and untidy, pretty disappointing. this is my first not so good experience with airbnb, in our 8+ experiences so far.
mark was a great host, super responsive, apartment was exactly as described. great location and overall very positive experience!!
we had such a great time! the stay was exactly as described, the location was great, bed was comfortable. will definitely look to stay here again!
i stayed at yuval’s place for a month and i enjoyed it. subway is very close, which was super convenient for me. nice place!
wonderful place. great location. sharam was lovely.

on thing to notice of the house is that the place is on the basement. it is a really convenient place if you´re having a vacation trip since the metro station is really nearby, 3 blocks away for the d and 4 metros. the place is safe to walk during the night and it has nearby places to buy food if you ever need to. also i sent some stuff frome amazon and sharon dind´t have trouble with that. sharon´s husband was a very nice person to us
the unit is very clean and large for nyc standards and photos are very accurate and location is excellent and safe. if you’re driving there are quite a few lots within a 5 min walk

excellent experience we had complications with our flight and arrive a different time than we thought and they helped us with an effortless check in because of great communication. the space had the necessities and the location is perfect. 10/10 recommend.

ms. gretchen is a beautiful soul. she was very nice to my family and me and greeted us with the warmest welcome. ms. gretchen let us know if we needed anything to let her know. she was very accommodating from the start. the jefferson estate is a wonderful airbnb to stay with children or adults. this airbnb was beautiful, clean, and had everything you needed. a place to call home for a few days. the neighborhood was very nice. we did not have any issues. it was just enough room for my family and me to enjoy a lovely weekend in brooklyn, new york. we plan to come back in the summer, hoping that the jefferson estate is available for us to stay. the jefferson estate is definitely somewhere you want to stay when you visit brooklyn. it's a fantastic place.
clean house with busses going into every direction in walking distance

such a great find! sophie is a very responsive host, and we appreciated the thoughtful amenities like the white noise machine. perfect location to walk to cobble hill and several other neighborhoods, plus easy access to multiple subways lines. highly recommend!
a phenomenal place to stay! we enjoyed everything from the beautiful decor to the warm hosts to the close proximity to lots of shops and restaurants. can’t recommend highly enough!
the place is perfect about location. the room was super clean and stylish. i really enjoyed the time there.
great place it looks exactly as it does on the website alkadher is very friendly and respectful to the guest privacy.

place is super convenient if you want to be right in times square. our room was clean, spacious and the double beds were very comfy. noise level was surprisingly very low. the room had no fridge. beware this listing doesn't clearly states that there will be extra fees and taxes collected at the time of check in. we stayed 3 nights and total extra collected was around $300.

decent place if looking for affordability. pros: - super close to subway station and penn station so access everywhere was easy - cvs across the street for any last minute needs cons: - room was smaller than expected, but very “new york typical.” - worried cleaning wasn’t great with 2 leftover soap bars in the tub - they recently changed systems, so had difficulty finding the airbnb reservation so checkout was a little long - concierge was quite rude when checking out which was a bummer because otherwise was quite decent interactions with staff
blown away by how beautiful this space is! stephanie was very accommodating to our needs.
location was great! short walk to times square
amazing stay! the location is great if you’re traveling by plane and also a good distance from the city if you don’t want to be around a lot of tourists. overall extremely clean place as well.
anthony’s home is perfect for your family. extremely clean, and has all the items you need for a comfortable stay. this is a can’t miss location. we hope to stay again.
we had a great stay- great neighborhood and nice room. i would definitely stay again!
luis is an exceptional host. the space is clean and comfortable. the area is safe. my daughter and i had a perfect stay. thank you luis!
i loved this place. nice size space. clean and quiet.

the apartment was clean and conveniently located. the space was a nice size too. unfortunately, due to a neighbor who left their water running, we had a leak in the space halfway through the trip. but the hosts were immediately responsive and had people over to repair the situation. and with minimal hassle we were able to enjoy the rest of our stay.

we had a great stay at alex's place in mew york. it was as advertised and had so much to do so close. time square was right down the street and so many place to eat and drink were so close. definitely perfect to walk to major attractions as well as easily walkable to subway stations as well as grand central station. great for holiday travel as so many holiday attractions were close by. host is great and super responsive as well a flexible. i would highly recommend this place to anyone!

turnkey!!! once you open the door, this rental ticks all the boxes. i mean, nothing is left unmet or unkept. i would recommend any of their rentals to friends and family. communication is at the tippity top - always having a solution to your needs. much gratitude to these brothers.
staying with michelle was great! she is a wonderful host and person. i've gained a friend after my staying!!
this brownstone was very roomy and immaculately clean. the location was just 2 blocks from the subway and was an excellent stay. 10/10, would love to stay in again when we are in new york next.
jim's place has an excellent location given its proximity to the barclays center metro hub. the apartment is nice but would benefit from some investment in furniture and kitchen equipment.
terrific location, very welcoming hosts, charming old brownstone building.
hong was amazing and so kind. the place was clean and tidy and the neighborhood was very walkable and friendly as well. no complaints
super nice host, super clean space. totally recommend

karen and doug are wonderful people, and their home is lovely and inviting. they are kind and welcoming, and though i didn't stay for long, we had couple nice conversations. the room itself is bright and fairly large, and the bed is so comfortable! they had a binder with menus of good places around to eat (i will have to check so of them out when i am in town a little longer). the mini fridge/freezer in the room came in handy, and they had even stocked a few snacks and drinks for me. the bathroom is also big and bright, with big, soft towels and a fantastic shower/bath. the house was big and beautiful and the christmas decorations made it feel like home:) i thoroughly enjoyed my stay, and hope i have the pleasure of staying with karen and doug again!!!
nicole’s place was exactly as advertised. she was communicative and accommodating.
amazing responsive, there when i had any questions. family oriented place, felt at home. great location near mta .highly recommend!!

the apartment is quite nice. it is in a very small building, and it seems rather new. it is conveniently located close to the subway, and manhattan is only a three-stop ride away. the room was great. it is spacious by ny standards, and the amount of storage space is huge. i loved the skylight: it provides plenty of natural light, and you can control how much of it gets in. it can also be opened to get fresh air! there are plenty of outlets all around the room to charge all your electronics. the whole operation runs very smoothly. pre-arrival instructions were very clear, and there is signage throughout the apartment that clarifies many practical details. checking in and out on my own was super easy due to the electronic door lock. also, it was extremely helpful to be able to store my luggage before check in and after check out. as others have noted, there is only one bathroom that is shared among four rooms. i got lucky and personally never experienced a long wait. the only one thing that detracted from my experience was noise: the walls are very thin, and the people staying in the next room were really loud.
i enjoyed staying at this lovely apartment with its quiet garden patio! the location in bushwick was very convenient, and the apartment was surprisingly quiet for such a busy neighborhood.
i would book again.

super clean house with lots of space. great value; won’t find a cheaper way to comfortably host 5+ people. all bedrooms had their own air conditioner, which was great for customizing the temperature for each guests desire. kitchen is very new and had all the essentials. washer and dryer was great too. absolutely would stay here again!
heather’s house is a gem in park slope. beautiful decor, great location near prospect park, restaurants and shops, and in a very quiet neighborhood. i can’t recommend it more highly!

franco's place was perfect! very clean. having a washer and dryer was very helpful. the neighborhood was very safe with cafes, pizza, and anything you need or want within blocks. street parking easy to find a spot. very close to the subway to go into manhatten easily. we loved the place and plan to stay again!
it was fine. i wouldn't stay there again. the plastic sheets on the bed felt like a weird choice.
thank you had gr8 week in nyc

we enjoyed the location, particularly with it being close to the brooklyn area and lower manhattan. the kitchen has all the equipment needed to cook up anything, all the amenities were provided for jill was a great host making sure that our needs were catered for. our stay here was far better than i thought it would be.
very nice studio in a very good neighborhood. highly recommended!

if you are looking for a safe quiet place to sleep for your nyc trip this is it. there is security at the main door & the other doors are locked. you can drop your bags for a small fee & the host was flexible with check/out. the place is cute, clean, & the beds aren’t luxurious but are comfortable. it’s small but as another person said if you are spending all day in the room you are doing it wrong. we had 3 adults & 2 teenagers & had plenty of room to get ready. the neighborhood was safe & walkable to so much! def recommend apollo bagels! the host was very responsive & helpful. the only negative is the radiator pipes going from floor to ceiling behind one bed get very hot. we ended up pulling the bed away from that wall so we didn’t accidentally fling an arm over our head at night & burn ourselves. so if you have a young child that doesn’t understand absolutely don’t touch then this may not be the place for you. other than that 10/10 recommend!

nancy’s place is clean , quiet and convenient it’s a 5-8 min walk to the subway ( 7 stops to manhattan ) and there are many restaurants and smaller shops nearby. nancy always responds quickly and is a great host.

i had an amazing experience in alex’s place. everything was really beautiful, decorated and always clean, reaaaally cozy. i’m a girl who travels alone and he make me feel safe the entire time there. i was even able to smoke a cigarette in the beautiful balcony of the apartment. the neighborhood is really quiet, the building really safe and the subway is really close to the apartment. when i go back to ny i’ll definitely stay there again. thank you alex for everything! you are an amazing host!

just a 10 mins walk to belle blvd where you can find nice restaurants. also just 10 mins walk to railway station which is a convenient access to ny downtown. the room was spacious with kitchen, bathroom, living room, full-size fridge, and a bedroom. washing machine and dryer are also available, no need to go to outside coin laundries.
i had an amazing time here!
cozy, clean, apt bigger than expected 🔥

my wife and i stayed here for a quick weekday trip. anna’s place had exactly what we needed and nothing we didn’t. great location, comfortable beds, and minimal neighbor noise. much better than staying in a hotel for double the price.
great, easy place to stay. communication clear and helpful.

i stayed here for two months, and i had a pleasant stay. jose was a great host and quick to answer my concerns. this is definitely a vintage nyc apartment, and it’s a peculiar layout. this is where to stay if you want a true nyc experience: cons: the bathroom is very narrow, and there's a pole running through it that leaks a little when the heat is on. very difficult to regulate the temperature, but it might be better during the summer months. i personally didn’t mind the walk-up aspect, but it was definitely a pain upon arrival with 2 suitcases. can get quite noisy on the living room side of the apartment, but quieter in the bedroom (i still recommend earplugs). might be nitpicky, but i think the apartment should include a tv (but there is a monitor). pros: decently spacious for nyc standards, great area (especially for dining and going out), and close to subway lines, comfy bed and couch, good windows, fast wifi, nice desk to work, equipped with supplies, has character/charm.

it's a nice house in a nice area, close to the metro. the apartment was nice but for 5 people it's too small. it wasn't as clean as we hoped and there weren't sheets for all the three of us, just the big beds had sheets on it. but all in all we had a great time and would sleep there again.
great place to stay. 10/10 would recommend. michel’s place is super nice and he is an absolutely great host. would recommend to anyone staying in ny for short or long-term stays.

not private, only a heavy curtain in main doorway and bi fold doors-no locks to unit from theirs, not clean, cobwebs, mirrors “ tiles “ placed chest height in bathroom, no hooks or shelves for items in bathroom, broken items such as faucet knobs in shower, tiles coming off shower floor, poor lighting, awkward feeling while you are in unit, smells from their kitchen are in the unit. far from “ cozy, private” as listed. would not recommend to anybody!
my favorite place to stay. it's my third time staying here and it just keeps getting better. it's a safe and secured neighborhood and building. spacious studio with a comfy queen-size sofa bed.

a great location, a short walk from times square and broadway shows. yasu is incredibly quick to communicate and is willing to help make you as comfortable as possible. some odor from bathroom drain, and somewhat thin walls-- but nothing beats the hospitality of the hosts, the price, and location.
sarah is a lovely host, great communicator, and very personable - we loved her little doggos so much! great apartment in brooklyn and would 100% stay here again if in town!

it was a wonderful experience. what a place! plan was new year's eve, so obviously prices are high (but totally affordable). the hotel is beautiful, clean, friendly staff. during the night you can enjoy some beers and cocktails at the bar in the lobby. in the morning that place is for pastry (patis bakery). they have croissants, doughnuts, cookies, pecan buns, sourdough/rye/croissant sandwiches, latte, and a really delicious mocha. the room itself was great, cozy. a giant bed, a super nice view from a huge window. there's also a tv with loads of entertainment. a coffee machine with some capsules, complimentary water (replenished during our stay). bathroom was clean, private, hairdryer, plenty of towels. nice lighting as well. there's just one thing i missed: a small refrigerator (i have some diet restrictions so it's super useful). it was not a problem in fact, but it would have been nice. hosts are friendly and super fast answering any crazy questions you might have. trully recommend

we were very happy in this apartment. bedding was comfortable and gorgeous. it was warm and comfy. the space was good as described. i needed a table just to work on it and write. that was missing. keishera friend and neighbour was kind enough to bring us some more light. the tv was not working well. i missed the news but internet was working fine so i managed to get the news i needed. on the kitchen ware side there is something to improve also. no decent easy going coffee machine to make a regular coffee and no decent pan just to fry an egg. that's not so complicated if one is renting. we liked the place and the street and it's easy to go everywhere.

ronan's place gets it done! great space and tasteful decor (also well-appointed). i've done over 50 airbnb's and this is top shelf -- particularly for ny. excellent location, close to transit, lovely place to crash, nice neighborhood and very responsive and friendly owners, right upstairs. i hope to be back!
karen and norbet's apartment is spacious, warm and secure. our family enjoyed our stay. the only thing missing was a tv to watch the football but that might just be me. grant, australia

place was big & beautiful looks way more beautiful in person , i love that there was a radio and also wifi made my stay feel at home the home owner was also great he helped me with everything i needed definitely a 5 star stay !! ❤️ & their is a wonderful bar downstairs

we really enjoyed our stay. the neighborhood has great mexican food (sonora) and coffee (september) and is a short walk to the c train on ralph street with easy commute to manhattan. parking was fairly easy to find close to the brownstone. the apartment was lovely, comfortable, spacious, well-appointed, and had everything we needed. the host was extremely communicative and helpful! bonus outdoor space!

keishera was great. she was very helpful and was available to contact throughout my stay. i spent 5 weeks in the apartment, which was beautiful. the neighbourhood was great too with lots of cafés and bars. keishera's neighbours were so welcoming and friendly and they helped out if needed. huge thanks
very nice area definitely worth for what your paying for enjoyed every second of it.
it was in a nice neighborhood and close to the subway.

had a great stay... we got in late that night and we were able to park in driveway instead of having to look for parking. definitely need a microwave but besides that it was great for a quick weekend trip.

i had a wonderful stay at jane’s apartment. it was spotless and everything inside was brand new, which made it feel fresh and welcoming. it’s in a very convenient location, and the space itself was cozy and comfortable. communication with the host was excellent - jane was incredibly responsive, kind, and such a lovely host. i would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting new york.
2nd time i used raynald apt and everything was great and clean as always. definitely planning to use it again next time.
this was a great weekend spot! we enjoyed our stay.
clean, comfortable room at a great price. host was very helpful and the apartment is close to the subway. would stay here again!

spacious, comfortable and clean apartment in a lovely neighborhood. brian is a super friendly and welcoming host. he had great recommendations for restaurants in the area and even helped us get a last minute table at one of them. highly recommend this airbnb!

the overall place was great! it was clean and cozy as well as quiet, chantel and lennox went above and beyond in terms of communicating and accommodating our needs for the stay. would absolutely recommend!

caroline was a great host, we never met in person but she was vey friendly and responsive when we reached out to her via phone and text. she was also very flexible with our check in time which we really appreciated.
great stay at anne's home. connection to the main points in ny is really efficient. the place was really clean and we felt like home!
this place is amazing!!

pauline and niji were great hosts! the apartment is very new and the room, bathroom and common areas were always kept super clean. i stayed for just over two months and had no issues - just a bummer i wasn’t able to extend my stay!
great place. will definitely stay again.
nice apartment in central ny.
such a great stay with so much space and in a wonderful location for getting to all of downtown manhattan.
very convenient and as described. the host was also very responsive with any issues and the building was secure and quiet.

brooklyn's place is so beautiful, cozy, clean and central in manhattan. while it was noisy outside, the place was so relaxing after a long day of touring the city and it was very easy to get to public transit. thank you for being so friendly and so communicative to our needs! my family and i would come back again.
very near to airport. great for short stays
the best stay i've had in nyc by far. such an amazing accommodating host. we plan on staying here again in our next visit!

esteban's place is amazing. perfectly clean house which feels like home. me and my girlfriend we stayed at esteban's place for 5 nights and if i am coming back to nyc i will definitely stay at he's place again. the breakfast is delicious, the home is close by the subway nr7. do not hesitate on booking this place!

raymond's place is great, clean, and the room is pleasant. raymond went out of his way to help when i encountered problems getting in the first time. we had great conversations. the building is located on a fairly busy street, but fortunately raymond provides earplugs. i'll stay here again on my next visit to nyc.

great apartment very accurately described and close to the a train (about 20 minutes ride to columbus circle). it is a third story walk up, the building is well maintained. vibrant and safe neighborhood with good restaurants. fort tryon park and the cloisters are not far. nancy communicated clearly, made sure we had all we needed while we were there and even left some adult beverages for our enjoyment. we didn’t use the kitchen much but it is very well stocked. also very quiet! would definitely stay here again.

we were met on time, place was clean, accommodations were good. only issue we had was five floors of stairs to the apartment with no elevator or door man. giancarlo's person on site was accommodating and helped carry them with us. the place is less than two blocks from central park.
liked this place. great location. room was a little bit worn, but very clean and nice view of empire state building. roof-top deck is a bonus. good value. will book again.
the place was great and cozy. it was also very clean. alizé is a good host and so was her communication. all around a great place to stay.

me and my boyfriend stayed one week this summer and it was perfect. the location of the flat, a typical flat of brooklyn, is perfect in order to know, not only manhattan , but also the real and popular new york city trough this part of brooklyn. the communication with manhattan island is easy and fast with the subway. the owners eric and justin were ideal; they gave us all the facilities and information about the flat, the neighborhood, and how to arrive it from the airport. the flat was fully equipped and the fridge had the basic food you need for the first day, if you arrive late like us. the apartment is decorated very carefully (even with fresh flowers!) sincerely we have been very comfortable in this apartment and we recommend it. thank you eric and justin.
brian’s apartment was great. it was easy and clean. the beds worked well and the bathroom was amazing. having central air and heat was extra nice. would stay again.
baby and kitty are awesome feline hosts
everything is good on this price
great location, wonderful host, peaceful stay, perfect for any trip to brooklyn!

this place was the perfect quiet getaway in the city. close to the subway so options were plentiful, but it was quiet so at the end of the day we could unwind. i would recommend this place to a friend in a heartbeat
apartment was clean and host was very responsive throughout our stay. we enjoyed the outdoor space. overall a great spot and would return again.

as a result of the wonderful experience of living at gordon's place almost 2 years ago, i came back the second time with my family members. the home is very clean and tidy, it is a home away from home. the location is absolutely convenient, as it is very close to the subway and tourist attractions. the neighbours and local community are friendly and welcoming, one of the main reason why i came back, is because gordon is such an amazing host, very supportive and engages in intellectual discussions. i will most definitely recommend it.

i have to say this experience was not only accommodating, but it truly put other airbnb hosts to shame. from communication to cleanliness to accommodations, debbie is the epitome of a host. in 4 days i bounced from sub-par living situation to sub-par situation. 4 places in 4 days, the third being a room that had an opened slide double-door in which myself and the other side of the door, another room in which we saw each other because it was perpetual slightly opened. debbie's places was a last minute situation and one of my best experiences with airbnb to date. everything clean, stocked with every living appliance needed to create a home environment. their backyard was a peaceful scenery with two beautiful big dogs who would run and play together, adding to the ambiance of feeling like you are in a home environment. i had so much to do and take care of in a short span of time, and the quality of where you rest your head matters so much ny as the time flies and you're always on the go. the bathroom was clean the rooms were clean, and each bedroom played it's role in a beautiful european theme that was uniform through the entire apartment. it's approximately an 8 minute walk from to the train, and literally around the corner from the b15 that takes you directly to the airport. thank you, for being the calm in not only the new york, but the airbnb storm!!! 5 out of 5
