such a lovely host and a lovely place to stay!
wonderful place to stay.

sarah was a great host and provided great local suggestions. she was very friendly and even invited us to her kitchen for morning coffee which was delightful. thanks for the great stay sarah and floyd.

overall the place is good. definitely a cute little place that has everything you need. my partner and i were struggling a bit to fit in the bed but other than that the place was nice. subway is really close so that definitely helped us when we were going around the city exploring!

the apartment was absolutely perfect, we had a great stay here. it was perfectly suitable for 3 of us and had everything you needed. the staff were very friendly and helpful during our entire stay. the location is ideal. it is in a great area with plenty of choices for dining, peaceful (as much as new york can be...) and, getting transport was convenient especially getting to times square by subway in roughly 20 minutes! i can't recommend this enough, great value for money and certainly provided a memorable stay during our visit!

i spent the weekend with my family here. we celebrated my youngest birthday by having a intimate gathering in the private backyard of the unit it was very comfortable to fit our guest for the day. the kids had a blast in the backyard. the host was very attentive and made sure we felt at home. the stores on ave l offered a little bit of everything making the stay super relaxing. it truly was home away from home thanks again to wayne and his family for having us.
everything was perfect for me and my husband
we had a wonderful time. everything was clean and cozy. it is also a good location to stay for transportation options.

absolutely stunning place to stay. definitely one of the best airbnbs,feels like a 5star hotel room.clean,very spacious. amanda is the best host ever, special touches every where. i'd stay longer if i could but its already been booked. book it! don't even think about it.
i had a good stay at irina’s place , thanks a lot !

rubens was very accommodating and kind. my girlfriend and i really enjoyed our stay. everything was perfect and clean and in working order. the description and pictures matched the place well. we would love to stay here again! five stars all around!
great place to stay on a budget in nyc. no surprises, you get what you see. alfred and staff were very nice and pleasant to deal with. would recommend and would stay again. thanks for having me!
angela’s place was very comfortable and it was a great place to stay for the night!
karen was very helpful with everything. i even checked in earlier than we agreed to and she had no problem with that at all.

the apt. is quiet and lovely, just what i needed. it isnt, however, in the heart of things. you'll need to walk a bit to the closest subway-which isnt a m. watch. out for a price increase. though listed at $165, it jumped to $225 at
this place served for what my coworker and i needed, place to sleep, shower, and get some work done. patricia was a great host and met us later than expected upon our arrival.
rena's place was great. location was perfect, 10 minutes walk to subway, an hour to the times square on subway. streets were safe and calm.

you should definitely stay here if you haven't already. from the smart tv, to the snacks, to the comfortable bed and the bathroom amenities. this was an incredible stay and i did not want to leave! the front desk staff was also knowledgeable and incredibly helpful during our stay. will definitely stay here again, so until next time!
great value for money in brooklyn. james is an excellent host and the place is exactly as described. recommended
excellent communication. clear instructions. spotless accommodation. peaceful quiet neighborhood in brooklyn.

amazing place! the neighbourhood is lovely, the apartment is very quiet and clean. you have all the supplies you need. you'll sleep very good there. i'm already missing the bed. bonus: if you decide to stay in, yuki has a very tasteful movie collection that you can enjoy! we had a great time.
kaz and his team are really nice, quick response, and kindness. highly recommend to stay here or some places are hosted by kaz's team.

luosong’s place was everything i needed:) i missed my flight and booked a stay very last minute. when i had trouble with the gate, a family member promptly came to help. turns out i just didn’t read the directions carefully and was trying to get into the wrong lockbox lol. extremely friendly and accommodating. they agreed to hold my bags for a bit after checkout, but i ended up just taking them with me.

jaleh's place is wonderful if you just want a comfy room and clean place. she is wonderful, friendly and kind. jaleh is flexible on check in and check out times. the room does not have ac, but did have a fan. the room itself is very tiny, and good only for one person. overall great for a short term stay in the city with easy access to subway lines.

jhovana and james were amazing hosts. not only was the room great, but the neighborhood was very hip and lively with lots of good bars and restaurants nearby. they gave me lots of good tips on things to check out around the area. also, the room was clean, private, and the mattress was comfy.
evelyn was a great host! the guesthouse has an unbeatable location near many amazing restaurants and bars. staying at evelyn's made me feel like an nyc native! can't wait to come back again.

i had a great time in this place,martha is super helpful with tips regarding tourism, she made me feel as i knew ny before as she provided me with tips about the place. two things to note, if you are caribbean man like me, i wouldn’t advise this place during winter, the cold breeze skips through the door and windows which make the nights super cold inside despite the heater. well if you are from winter places, i assure you it wont be a bother. secondly, there is no area to prepare meals as listed, i guess the microwave is interpreted as such but that is not what i understood. otherwise, it is a perfect spot, private, quiet. i would definitely do it again but summer only.
great stay in a great location. everything is close to apartment.
loved it! great location
perfect for 2 people and one pet , clean and affordable! would definitely book again .

the apartment is spacious, clean, cozy. i especially appreciated the bathroom, small but recently renovated, and very clean. the neighborhood is alive, young, authentic. the essex/delancey subway station is close by (5 min walk): very practical both to reach the airport and to go anywhere in manhattan. only one negative point: even if the apartment is very quiet during the night, it is quite noisy in the morning. however i admit that i am a very light sleeper... moreover it's nyc, and you are mostly like to get up early and enjoy the multiple opportunities that the city offers to you. blue is very friendly and kind, and let us check out in the afternoon without any problem. i would definitely recommend this apartment and this host.

this apartment is awesome! so spacious, well decorated and stocked with everything you need. you can’t beat the location either; essex market and the f train right outside! apt is on street side so bring ear plugs if you’re not used to city noise. the views are unbelievable and lawrence is awesome and timely with communicating. thanks for a great stay!

minetta was a great host! nice, friendly and a super nice flat. perfectly situated next to the parks and metro. the street is not loud at all and the private room perfectly suits the needs for a trip to nyc. kitchen, sofa, all what you need is there and super stylish designed by minetta.
raval was very communicative and eager to help with any kind of problem. great place to stay in harlem!
incredible views, quiet, clean, and nice location!

this host called me while i was in the er with my 3 year old sick hooked on an iv, after i told her i am in the er, to tell me to “please leave the apartment” because she has somebody else booked for 4 months and she doesn’t want us staying there to ruin it for the next person. then she went on to complain that it’s unfair how i blamed her for the radiators being noisy. i was hearing this while in the er not knowing if i will be able to get discharged. staying at this house was the most stressful experience even after my finals this semester. the radiators was so loud they would wake us up. we ended up homeless for a half a day with a sick child. i have nothing good to say about airbnb and this host.
great location, apartment exactly as described. jose is responsive and helpful.

agnes’s place was very clean and had just the right amount of character and personal touches. the kitchen was well equipped and had all the basic provisions for cooking and making meals. there were lots of grocery stores nearby. overall a very positive experience and we would definitely recommend staying here.
the unit wasn’t very clean, wifi wasn’t working and we didn’t get effective support for it either.
staff was very accommodating and nice. room was close to elevator, clean and easy to access.
great value for money - spacious apartment with everything what we needed and more. great communication with the host, mr. phong. we have enjoyed our staying in brooklyn! thank you :-)
danielle is a great host, she given best airbnb experience to us.
great, clean place for the price! and easy to get to manhattan with buses and trains. the best was that herman has a super cute kitty that was playful and friendly 🐈‍⬛
nice place to live.
aaron was considerate abd responsive

i only stayed there for few hours since i already live in ny, but its not a bad place to stay at all if your a tourist and want to be closer to the train station and jfk. muhammad was really sweet and reliant when i struggled getting into the airbnb at first as well.

reginald's place met our expectations. the location is great for anyone landing in jfk. the subway station is located close to the apartment as well. reginald was a great host and worked with us to accommodate our check-in time. we recommend his place for any future endeavors.
great location and very communicative!

we had a great time staying with cristina, she was very welcoming and helpful. we had a lovely double room and our own bathroom. everything was just as we had hoped. the neighbourhood was great and she lives so close to central park, it was really easy to get around. i would recommend cristina's place to anyone who wants an accessible and welcoming place to stay during their time in new york.

definitely the most beautiful and comfortable apartment we ever been. good location and easy access. owners are very friendly and they have provided all information and supplies needed. thank you very much!

the place was more than you could expect it to be. it was very beautiful inside and out. i love how the host was available whenever i needed her. my family and i really enjoyed our stay. i would most definitely stay again and recommend this home to others. thank you for making us feel at home..........
when i come back to new york i will be staying in bensonhurst again. this place was so amazing. i love the surroundings it was safe.

great apartment, much better than a hotel if traveling with family. location and responsiveness were both excellent. the only complaint i’d have is loud heating system. overall a fantastic place to stay in
we will not be disappointed with your stay at linda, you will love it!!!
this was my second time through and enjoyed once again. apartment is very comfortable and convenient to anything you need. mustafa is a great host and i will be back.
i definitely come again

stayed here on a 3 day trip to nyc. the good thing is that it is exactly what you see. no surprises. it was extremely clean and tidy. the bed was a bit small for me but i am very tall. bring your own pillows as the ones there are flat…like flat. bring earplugs! i am so glad i did. (that’s just new york) was totally expected. you definitely need an eye mask as well as the curtains in the room are more of a sheer so a ton light comes through. i felt very safe. it is a bit of a hike from the downtown core 35 min. i drove so parking and not ideal. there is street cleaning so you have to move your car on different days. it’s not a huge deal but did add an extra measure of anxiety. i would suggest not driving. if you are flying into laguardia it is perfect. very close to that. this place is exactly what you pay for. i did not want to spend 400 a night downtown. i wanted to spend that money doing things and that’s is what made me choose this place and it was great for my first trip to nyc

jeremy & angela’s place was perfect for a week's stay in brooklyn. well-decorated & clean, it's close to restaurants and bars. they were super responsive to any messages i sent and check-in was easy with the lockbox. it gets a decent amount of light for a garden apartment! the bathroom was small (as correctly advertised) but fully functional and no problem for one person.

we loved our stay in bed stuy! good price for a two bed especially during dec. walkable to subway, nice road and we easily commuted around brooklyn and manhattan as tourists. duane was great host - friendly and good instructions. highlights were the tall comfy beds, shower and the tvs in the rooms giving us a bit of a hotel vibe after a long day.

barry's place surpassed my expectations. it's comfortable, a friendly environment, well kept and over all amazing. everything was on point and he even picked me up from the train station and brought me back when it was checkout time. i would recommend this place to everyone and i'll definitely be back! thank you barry!
nice place with laundry facilities and everything you need.

the best accommodation if you want to stay near to jfk airport and not to worry about safety - i liked that neighborhood, very quiet place! very clean, cozy and well-designed. we enjoyed our coffee in the morning and madelyn is a very nice host 😊

we had a wonderful time at andre’s airbnb! booking and check in were seamless, as was our stay. the location is great, close to lots of cafes and the train, and really cute tree line streets. the brownstone is beautiful and the garden apartment was the perfect place to stay, with all the amenities including lots of extra comfy bedding! the outdoor space is also super charming. would stay here again and definitely recommend.
very clean. well stocked. they have thought of everything. well located. walkable to many sites. janet-david are very welcoming!

i loved our stay at jay's. the setting and beauty of her place was unexpected. the photos don't do the home justice. we were very happy. there was plenty of room to spread out. the little sunroom doubling as a place to snack and make coffee or tea was so cozy. the neighborhood is beautiful, close to subways, little cafes and restaurants. fort greene was made a historical landmark in the late 70s so history is present and thick.
will stay again next trip to nyc

this is such a nice place to stay. it was very clean and ernesto is a very friendly and helpful host! it looks nicer in person, and the location is great! it's very close to the subway station and various restaurants and stores. staying here felt like i was at home, and i would definitely stay here again.

we had a great stay at evelyn's characterful apartment. the bed is very comfortable and there's lots of hot water. the area is great - nice bar next door, the blind tiger and lots of good restaurants nearby - we ate at johns pizza which was fantastic. evelyn was very quick to respond to any queries. it was a little noisy but it's the middle of the city so we expected that. thanks evelyn!

inna was pretty available at all times. wished i'd have a more direct channel though like whatssap. it was all through the app. cable could be improved, there where 3 channels available only. internet didn't work well either. and if you are looking for a glamorous neighbourhood, this might not be the choice, i fellt somewhat insecure at times. otherwise everything was ok.

this was our 1st visit to 🗽 from 🇬🇧. the taxi from new jersey had a really good ride in. sonia very helpfully let us drop our bags early. we got straight on the metro to the 9/11 memorial, then to a yankees game & were home in 15 minutes after it ended. the next day we were bird spotting at 0700hrs in the ramble, central park. no hassle getting there. we came back for a bit & were out again to rosevelt island. back late, but yet again, no problem. the space is light, airy & quiet. the area is edgy but feels safe. new yorkers all over the city were ready to help us navigate the maze it is. this space was cheaper than a pod room in central tourist locations like times sq, but here we felt like we interacted with real new yorkers in their home. do stay.

great place to stay in new york! i had originally planned to see more of the city during my weekend stay but ended up reading the entirety of infinite jest which i found on the bookshelf. when i did get out i found i was close to many excellent cafes, restaurants, and bars. would stay again!

perfect accomodation for a stay in the heart of manhattan. very close to public transport (grand central is round the corner), restaurants and shops. the entire apartment was super clean and well furnished. no audible noise from the street or from within the building, very quiet for such a central location. the only downside was that the apartment stayed rather warm at night, regardless of the two (noisy) airconditioners.

very conveniently located, right next to the q line on the subway, allowing easy access to the rest of manhattan and other boroughs. the wifi and ac were broken for the first week of my stay but the host was responsive and shipped me a new ac unit that i was able to setup as well as scheduled an internet technician to visit. on the first floor, right next to the street side so it can get a bit noisy. i worked remotely for here for a month, no actual desk but i used the dining table and brought my own surge protector.

jenny was very helpful and friendly. she was accommodating, and gave us many tips. her apartment is very clean. the bed is comfortable and the linens were fresh and clean as well as were the towels she gave us for our stay. bathroom and shower impeccable. location is excellent, easy walk to the closest metro. great bagel place for breakfast and fresh orange juice great coffee right below her apartment. note that she does have a coffee maker and pods offered in her apartment as well. i stayed there with my daughter, a great mother-daughter trip. you can get to anywhere in manhattan easily from this excellent location! definitely recommend. in addition jen went to visit with relatives and we ended up having the apartment to ourselves most of the time, which gave us additional privacy. in any event she is very pleasant and non obtrusive.
great place close to the airport. really quiet and clean.
garcia's place was excellent value for our group of 7. close to prospect park, and had basics we needed for our stay. garcia was a communicative host and flexible host.

the staff was not only professional, but very, very helpful. very active lively lobby, which makes you feel at home and late night. there is a jazz quartet drinks and dinner very comfortable. very peaceful in great location.

fabulous space. was not there over a weekend but the bar downstairs is pretty tame-sound was never and issue. great a/c units in both main room and bedroom(unusual). most comfortable and stylish couch ever and i have a bad back!!! street parking is possible just watch the signs carefully. you won't be disappointed! thanks, brian!

we had a wonderful stay. the place was clean, well stocked, and most of all air conditioned! it was a beautiful little haven when the rest of our day was spent in crowds and on the subway. would definitely stay again.

such a gem of a place to stay and a gem of a host! jiajia was great from the beginning in reaching out before the trip to the last day of my stay. she went above and beyond my expectations with making my stay equipped with the little things and providing great city information. she is incredibly warm and welcoming. the room was a great size, too, with lots of space! i will definitely book there again and highly recommend this to others!
jasmine is just the perfect host, she is sweet and caring. me and my son (3 years old) love the apartement, the cat and the neighborhood. we will return there anytime!

we spent four nights in the wayne's flat. we really enjoy our stay in this appartment. the location is perfect (30 minutes away from downtown of the 5th avenue with the sub). sub station is 10 minutes away by walk. the neighbouhood is very safe (we came back at 11 pm without any issue). the flat is nice for two or three persons with all required equipment (a/c for hot weather). the only point to improve is the general cleanliness. even if there was no real dark point, it could be improved.

we absolutely loved staying at jennifer’s place. the bedroom was clean and very comfortable. the bathroom was spotless. honestly, it was like being in a 5 star hotel but even more private. jennifer was great at communicating with us and very welcoming. this was an amazing stay for us and one we highly recommend!
absolutely perfect in every way
victoria is the best host and you won't find a bigger apartment nor a better deal in nyc.

we stayed for 1 week and were super happy! the apartment is super clean and everything looks like on the pictures. especially the bathroom was amazing! we felt very comfy. the apartment is located in a nice neighborhood with lots of grocery stores, bars, restaurants etc. subway is only a 5-10 min walk away. kristina was reachable during our stay and always replied very fast to messages. she is taking care of everything. also, a late check out was possible for us as our flight was in the evening. we would love to visit nyc and stay in this beautiful apartment again.
the brownstone is a very nice apartment, i will defenitly recomment it to my friends for their nyc visit. simon was very nice and very helpful. thank you simon!

we really enjoyed our stay here! a great place, super close to the subway and short walk to several really good restaurants. the place is small but perfect for a place to crash after a day in the city. we had no problems at all and would definitely recommend it!

agnes place is just like the description. the room was nice and cozy the position is perfect to reach the city center. the subway is just two minute walking from the appartment. agnes welcomed us at the check in and was available to share info and to help us when needed. it was a nice stay.
clean, quiet, and private room. great location. no complaints!

don't get me wrong, the host was very responsive and accommodating. there was no hot water, but she did explain he got fixed after i left. the main complaint is the upstairs neighbors. the noise from the neighbors is entirely unbearable. you hear their every waking move, and they play loud music early in the morning. you won't be able to rest while there.

our stay was very pleasant. we appreciated the proximity to jfk and the nearby bus stop that allows easy access to the subway to reach downtown new york. the accommodation is clean and the hosts are responsive. the arrival instructions are very detailed, and they were very accommodating with our luggage—thank you again!

jerica's airbnb manager gave us a warm welcome. the apartment was clean and it had everything we wished for. the best thing about the apartment is definitely the location... the neighborhood is safe and union square is one of my favorite places in nyc and very close to all the highlights. we had a lovely stay in jerica's apartment!
we had an excellent experience! the apartment is beautiful and spacious, it is near the subway and main avenue. jeff is friendly and responsive. thank you!!!!
this was an excellent place. the house is very spacious and well maintained. convenient to subways.
great place, would definitely book again. clean and beautiful apartment, well stocked and a responsive host. 10/10

great space the mounted bluetooth speakers in the living room/kitchen and bathroom were a great plus to the fun and getting ready. although this space is in a hotel like setting make sure to note there is no daily cleaning and things like trash bags and paper towels you may have to contact the front desk and go collect yourself. other than that quiet location near a nice water way to walk down or watch the sunset and boats. the location is about a 20-30 min ride from actual city sites like times square and fun activities to do.

fantastic stay – highly recommend! we had an amazing stay at suet's place! the home is spotless, comfortable, and truly felt like a home away from home. the location is unbeatable—just minutes from south beach and super close to the st. george ferry, which made getting to midtown and manhattan a breeze. there’s also a train station just a 3-minute walk away, so it’s really convenient for exploring the city. suet is an outstanding host—very communicative and responsive, making sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay. we can’t thank her enough for the wonderful hospitality. i’m already planning to come back to new york next year, and suet’s place will be my first choice. a 5-star rating is simply not enough for this place—wish i could give 10 stars! highly recommend to anyone visiting new york.

we had a great time at craig's place - it's an amazing dumbo loft as described. craig is very polite, funny, communicative and at the same time circumspect in a pleasing manner. he was helpful and welcoming. unconditionally recommendable! :-)
perfect location! 2-minute walk to the nearest metro station that takes you to downtown brooklyn and manhattan. the bedrooms are very clean and spacious.
lovely place and lovely guest. one of the cheapest places and nicest places you can find in nyc.
i had a great stay at stella's place. very convenient and close to subway station. however, i didn't spend too much time in the room besides sleeping. she has a beautiful garden in the front yard.

luke's place is the perfect brooklyn apartment. the pictures don't do it justice. plenty of space, all the amenities you need, and a beautiful garden to boot. luke is quick to respond and gives you all the information you need for an easy stay.
great place to stay.

my family had a lovely stay at jonathan's. the apartment was exactly as listed - clean, comfortable and recently updated. the location is wonderful too. i would highly recommend jonathan's apartment to anyone.
great stay! quiet and clean :)
i was definitely happy i had the opportunity to choose this hotel through the airbnb, no complaints and great location.
jacks place was everything i needed, a comfortable and private room with all amenities i needed and great location downtown

great place, very clean rooms and both pettrina and ms monica are very welcoming! the house is well connected to manhatten, it just takes a while to get there. but probably this is normal for nyc/brooklyn.
we had a great stay at edna and isaiah’s home!

i cannot begin to say how much i loved my stay. such a perfect location and space. the aesthetic makes you feel right at home in bk. so clean and well lit, the owners were very quick with responding. the building was so quiet i thought i was the only one there. would definitely stay again. highly recommend.

this was a cozy apartment that is in a very convenient location! you can catch the bus to lga from here and there are two subway stations near by. lots of food options are within walking distance; great place overall!
good location, lovely room and great host.

3 friends arriving different times. she let 1st person in early while she was still cleaning so that he could drop bags and he actually just holed up there and did some work. i arrived an hour later and she greeted me and gave good suggestions to going out to the market. our 3rd person came a few hours later and she offered to meet him back when he arrived if we were out and about. i don't think i've ever had a host ever offer that! (we just stayed in so didn't take her up on that offer). place had mini toothpastes, individual advil packets and the list goes on. phone cords avail in every room. half a block from the 1 train to go downtown. artsy space and awesome host!
clean and in the heart of nyc. everything walkable from this location, especially broadway shows.

​i stayed at elma's place for two weeks whilst in new york for academic work and pleasure. it was the first time i had used airbnb and the whole experience was excellent. elma is a wonderful hostess who keeps her atmospheric apartment immaculately and it was a real pleasure to stay there. she made me feel thoroughly at home, putting fresh flowers in my bedroom and even made me soup when i fell ill which was way beyond the call of duty (thank you elma!!!). not only is the apartment great but the area is also fabulous. there is a host of small and varied restaurants and bars at reasonable prices and the subway station (f line) is just a four minute walk away. i was zooming about a lot in brooklyn and manhatten and it couldn't have been more convenient for getting around. i was so glad not to be staying in a hotel and enjoyed the relaxed sensation of feeling at home, thanks to my great host whom it was pleasure to meet. thoroughly recommended in every respect!

the apartment is in an amazing location, close to q train station and many great restaurants, bars and a grocery store right on the corner. elem is a great host, quick responses and efficient action to requests. one recommendation if you stay here; bring headphones or earplugs, upstairs neighbors were super loud at all hours. we had a fantastic stay here in nyc!! thanks again elem!

cozy studio in a very nice part of brooklyn! we had a great time!
thank you very much for everything juan! my friends were very comfortable, happy and satisfied :)

claude was very kind during our night stay at his place. he was detailed and brief us how to use the appliances in the house. he also ensure we are comfortable and enjoy our stay in nyc.

i highly recommend this airbnb. it's as clean and charming as the photos suggest. it's located in a tree-lined neighborhood within walking distance of restaurants, groceries, and subway stations. great communication.
cozy place to stay at, thank you! :)

the place is well situated in queens, close to a metro station, the area felt safe, there's groceries & a bakery nearby & a laundry-mat. the downside was that you can't open the windows well (typical us house). the street got a bit loud early in the morning. the girls living in the floor are very friendly, the place is clean & it was great to meet other co-travelers in the kitchen.
great location to explore brooklyn or travel in to manhatten. cozy despite all the snow we had and very clean

wahid house was so great i came back for a second time. my 2 year old son love his piano and guitar. he also has a bookshelf that caught my son's eye. the house has everything you need. if you need anything he respond quickly and meet your needs. he's an awesome host he always asked if everything was okay or if we needed anything. he keeps his house clean and tidy. we enjoyed our stay and recommend this house.

loved this place and the area. my apt was clean, i felt very safe and being 5min wapk from trader joe's was wonderful. having the park a hundred feet away was awesome. highly recommend for long term basic no frills stay. the laundry room had plenty of machines and i enjoyed my stay very much.

seth's place was beautiful and intimate. we only stayed one night and were out most of the time but did run into seth who was lovely and inviting. the location is a heart beat away from the l train and a beautiful part of town. great experience! will stay here again if possible :)
clean new renovation., and street parking was not crowded on our stay., subway down the street., western beef and deli
this is a great place to stay, with lots of food options nearby, as well as easy access to subways. great rooftop for whatever your needs are.
cheryl’s place is great a charming, functional and great location. cheryl also very supportive and accommodating x
this place is awesome for getting to and from manhattan. it's right next to an l train stop. fantastic location and quick responses from the host.
awesome stay, walking distance from subway stations that go directly to the major nyc tourists locations. super great host!
diane was amazing and absolutely saved me in a pinch when a different airbnb fell through in the middle of the night. had a wonderful stay and can't appreciate it enough.
my husband and i loved our stay! chris was warm and inviting. we instantly felt at home. we hope to stay with him next time we are in town.

the room is pretty confortable, near to the subway station, deli, grocery store, laundromat, mc donald’s, it’s convenient. the apartment is clean and well manteined. gilberto was super nice to us and we enjoyed the stay a lot.
beautiful garden apartment in a nice location. well maintained. modern, convenient, secure, and comfortable.

the stay was great! loved that we didn’t have to wear shoes inside. owner was attentive and quickly responded to messages. it took about an hr to get into the city but the bus is nearby and easy. the sheets had some oil stains but still seemed washed. the comforter had paint stains or something too but i wasn’t too bothered by it. little bottles for body wash and shampoo and conditioner sets for both male and female are provided and 2 face towels and 2 big towels. the place was quiet. there’s dining table near kitchen and desk in bedroom so suitable for work if needed. the couch set was comfy. 2 tvs (one in bedroom and one in living room) but couldn’t connect to our computer by screen sharing / bluetooth. overall my brother and i liked our stay. we shared the queen bed but someone can sleep on couch if needed.
william was exceptionally accomodating and very friendly. i would highly recommend this spacious room in brooklyn.
kurt was a great host! very enthusiastic! really appreciate his effort. 👍

this was such a great place to stay in new york! richard and gabrielle are wonderful people to talk to and really made sure to help me navigate the city. the house was clean and such a great space for what i needed!
we had six family members stay for a weekend and enjoyed the experience. clean, quiet and modern. nice amenities. thanks brian and rachel!
excellent stay and host, highly recommended.

the house has 3 floors, big spaces to live the house, a equipped kitchen and a little garden with a barbecue. we can’t ask more. the location is incredible, near a metro in brooklyn and amy is super fast and kind.

vana was kind, communicative and easy to work with. the house itself is perfect for a couple with a kid, or a couple friends wanting to check out the city. it's in a very walkable location and right above a great puerto rican restaurant. the outdoor area is something you just won't see in nyc in many other places. if a quaint, bohemian apartment is where you're looking to stay, this is the this for you.
very clean and as described. room was alittle small but otherwise a good place to stay. very conveniently located to public transportation.
i’m waiting for chewing for 5 hours !!! i was damaged all my day in new york
comfortable and clean, calm appartment. owner care about it. thanks a lot

kiriko and dominic are great and reliable hosts everytime ready to fulfill our needs and to suggest what to do in new york. we totally enjoyed our holidays and we found a perfect house for us. we strongly recommend their apartment.
great spot for a stay if you want to explore. easy access to public transport but nice and quiet area.

it’s my second time to stay in sandra’s home. it’s very clean and comfortable. their is a little shop to sell breakfast in one block away. the breakfast is very delicious and cheaper. five stars to recommend sandra’s house.
5 stars hosts were very accommodating
yonathan was a great host. the place was nice and clean. very large room with ensuite which was great to have. would stay here again and it's not that far from manhattan. thanks!

gerry was very responsive to address all my concerns and queries. there was one night that unfortunately the metro line serving closest to this location was down, but it is so accessible that there are alternative lines to get here! only extra 2mins due to that station being slightly further. gerry was really kind to let me leave my stuff in the house beyond the check-out time for me to enjoy the city a little longer on my last day. really big thanks to gerry!
great location. no real bed so kind of slept on the floor. wouldn’t recommend for elderly people or anyone with any back issues. to be honest a tad average to be sleeping on a floor.

ivan was a great host! so accommodating and helpful. his apartment was in a great location and was eveb better than the photos! it had everything we needed, was bright and super clean. i would stay again!!
very nice place, but the parking spaces are limited.
great stay and was very clean and responsive. also at a great location.
ms. yvonne provided a quiet environment that felt very private and comfortable. just like home...
it was greag staying in jesse his place. super clean, wonderful coffee and communication and he was so accommodating. thank you for everything jesse!

this location was just what you hear new york apartments are like. it was small but has everything you need. it was easy to walk to all of the touristy places. easy check in. if you visit in winter, i recommend asking for a space heater the day you check in. being tx girls, we felt the cold and the apt was temperature controlled. nothing unbearable.

the apartment was quiet, cool, and close proximity to trains as well as many restaurants within walking distance. a/c was much appreciated and the wifi was reliable to allow us to work remotely, host zoom meetings etc. the street was quiet and fairly low traffic for the area. never felt unsafe walking about even at night. the host was responsive during our month long stay. checkout was simple. the bed in the bedroom was full rather than queen size, so it was snug for two adults.

great location. but hotel is u see construction and side entrance not convenient. often absent doormen made for doors hard to open and homeless hanging around which as both sad and unfortunate. no reply from property after repeated attempts.
the place was excellent, clean and with a location that can't be beat.
really nice room, good location, clean, chris is a very friendly helpful host with good tips for things to do and see and finally his dog is very cute.
the place was very clean and close to public transportation. the host was extremely kind and respectful, which made the stay even more pleasant. an excellent experience overall.
everything was smooth sailing and easy which made the whole trip exactly what i needed!
our second stay at james's place within a couple of weeks. as before, great location and facilities. there is a little street noise but, hey, its new york!
logement conforme à la description.

tash was a very great host! she was willing to work with me needing a shooting location for my student film and gave me an amazing deal price-wise given the amount of space i was using. she was always responsive and so friendly! i would highly recommend:)
love the place very clean comfortable will rent again
friendly staff and great accommodations!

my stay at say's place was perfect. say was so accommodating and made me feel very welcome. even on my birthday, she surprised me with a big 'happy birthday' banner! the room is spacious and very clean and she provided towels for every day of the week. location is great and there are lots of places to see locally. 8-10 minute walk to the subway station. thank you once again say. you are highly recommended :)

naveen’s place was very comfortable and clean. the neighbourhood felt very safe and had everything you need within close proximity in terms of groceries, shopping and restaurants. it is about a 35 minute commute to the theatre district/ major spots to see in new york so make sure that you pack strategically for the day because commuting back and forth isn’t realistic. a tote or backpack and good running shoes are recommended. overall nice quiet place to stay- just be careful on the front entry steps as they are steep and there was no light to put on so you could see the key pad —we had to use the flashlight on our phones when coming back at night.

being our first time in nyc , we didn’t know what to expect. this location made it super easy for us to get to the subway always felt safe. jewel was always so attentive, place was nice and cozy! would definitely recommend
really nice guys that responded to my needs with no hesitation.

a nice spacious room and a clean shared bathroom with one other guest. a few minutes walk to metro for easy access to manhatten and jfk. very responsive hosts and easy, flexible entry. i enjoyed my stay and i hope i will stay there again.
had a great stay! super convenient location and clean apartment

truly the best in park slope. if you want to get the best in the area and visit new yorks safest neighbourhood i strongly recommend to stay at philips place. the location is prime: nearby you will find shops, restaurants and coffee shops. the walk to the subway is about 5 minutes and to the park it is really just a minute or two. the street is quiet and you can relax from the hectic life in the city. philips place is more than you can wish for: it is super clean, has more than enough space and feels like home after just a few minutes. the best is surely the host: he is the nicest and most casual host i have ever met. philip will welcome you to his beautiful home like no other. i had a lot of work while staying in park slope and still we found the time to have a coffee and a talk. with his knowledge of the area he cann fill you in the extra info you will need to make your trip the best experience. thank you again philip for the great time at your amazing place!

the magnolia house was the perfect location to stay as we were in town for the new york city marathon. short walk to the ferry when we went to manhattan. great local restaurants recommended by our host. the host, danforth, was the most interesting, thoughtful and considerate host i’ve ever had at an airbnb. he goes out of his way to help in every way. very charming. the magnolia house is definitely a place i would stay when visiting nyc (or running the marathon) again. the house itself has a lot of unique collectibles everywhere and a library full of books that were co-written by the host. this is not like a hotel stay. if that’s what you want, this place is not for you. this place has a lot of character and a very unique style. we loved it and are so glad we found it for our stay. take time to get to know the host and enjoy your time at the wonderful magnolia house.
clarissa’s place is very clean and had everything we needed for our stay. moreover it is very close to the subway which made traveling to the city hassle free.

this was by far my favorite stay in all the years i’ve been booking with airbnb. i didn’t even want to go home after. it was comfortable, close to long island and but still very close to jamaica, queens. this was more than perfection!
great host and location! highly recommend and would come back.
love love love this place. best loaction in nyc!
neil is a great host and his bedroom was as described.

good value and a great location for a weekend solo trip that i planned! the place was a tad rearranged when i was staying there, but nothing drastic at all and it was still a very homey, modern apartment to stay in for a couple of nights! my only slight concern was that the door lock had only one turn and there was no additional lock/chain, so it felt a little bit unsafe at times, especially when i was leaving the apartment for the entire day. nevertheless, would definitely consider natalie's place again if i'm even in nyc for a short trip!

wayne was a wonderful host, got us everything we needed. good communication 😊 the neighborhood is so convenient, with the subway stop for the 2 and 3 trains and for the m2 bus within easy walking distance. we bought the 7 day unlimited boarding metropass and went all over town on transit, no problem. sylvia’s restaurant on nearby malcolm x/ lenox is an outstanding place to eat — come there hungry! i will definitely come back here whenever i come to new york city.
small and comfortable accomodation in a great location. close to many things. would definitely stay again.

it’s all about location! this place is right in the heart of it all, which is what made it worth it. it is a very small space, with no bells and whistles. if you need a place to crash for the night near to the center of the city, this is fine. the bed was decent, clean sheets and towels, a small kitchenette with mini fridge to store our drinks etc. the host was very responsive and helpful, the management company on site was also friendly.
patrick was very helpful and place was clean, just the subway was too close we couldn’t sleep very well at night

the place was tiny but the breakfast was great. the shared bathroom could have been cleaner and wish had some hangers to hang clothes. it is a 5 floor with steep steps..better to have light luggage if you are planning to stay here. there was some disturbance on the first night..but all other days was peaceful. ibwill recommend the place if u are looking for something with tight budget.

this apartment is in such a great location- literally 2 min walking from the l train- as well as walking distance to some great bars/restaurants! the apartment is spacious and very clean and checkin was a breeze. the bed wasn’t the most comfortable for us (it’s a foam pad on top of couch cushions that didn’t always stay put) but it’s huge! would def recommend.

i love mary j's home. fashionable classic chic apartment with nothing but good vibes and talented people. very nice neighbourhood close to lots of restaurants, bars, grocery stores, fresh fruit markets, etc i would definitely return whether it is for a stay or just for a visit

marjorie was a very discreet host, so she only gave us the most important information. the room and the bathroom were very clean and cozy. there was a coffee machine and milk in the fridge, thanks for that! first we did not felt that safe in the neighborhood, but that was only the first feeling, because it looks like a ghetto and you are one of the only white people arround. we did not experience something bad there. there was no problem on our way from the subway to home at 10 p.m. in the night you maybe should take a cab back there. marjories husband was very helpful, becaus we could use his phone when our shuttle to the airport did not show up. so an advice: do not take a supershuttle, you pay in advance and they do not show up...
great and convenient place. recommend for anybody. masud is a great host.

our stay was great and magen’s home was beautiful! better than the pictures even. the room was cozy, magen was helpful, and it was located in brooklyn which was beautiful and had a great community. it was a bit hard to get into the place and we had to wait a few minutes to be let inside, but that was mostly my bad for not reading instructions through all the way. the only real disturbance was the dogs that would bark a lot but i love dogs so it wasn’t really a problem. i would 100% stay here again! loved it and was decorated so well!
this place is amazing in all ways! the bed stuy location is perfect and easily walkable to lots of great restaurants and shops. would highly recommend!
great place, good location, chill cat.
kyriaki's place is beautiful! stay here!
great place, look exactly like the photos. quite neighborhood restaurants in walking distance.
lovely hotel, centrally located!

it is quaint and quirky with lots of charm, but also some setbacks. internet went out on the first night and the rooms were not efficiently set up with the furniture. enjoyable overall, but would likely choose something different for a second visit.

jakey’s place was exactly what we needed and as described. he was so flexible with check in and giving us a place to store our bags safely before check in and after check out. that alone is worth the listing price.
super clean and comfortable

dylan's place is small and cozy, it is clean. it is located in an amazing area where ther are many cool shops, vintage stores, and restaurants. the area is vibrant and nice, it feels safe walking at night since there is a lot of families in the streets. it is next to the subway and it takes about 20 minutes to get to manhattan.
friendly host!!! great location, subway a few blocks away which gives easy access to all of manhattan.

clean,cute and homey. theres a station right down the street which is really convenient, with some pizza and coffee shops along the way too. not too far by train to all the big attractions either. it’s a nice place to come back to after walking around the city all day
great location and value, would definitely recommend!

my mother in law flew in for thanksgiving week and stayed at marina and eric's. the apartment was spotless and well-stocked with amenities. the water bottles and popcorn upon arrival was a very nice touch. we plan on booking again for her future visits! the location is ideal and the value can't be beat!
had a great stay. would stay again.
loved the location- high ceilings ! great place-responsive host !

a wonderful location exceeded only by the host. joseph met us when we arrived and gave us the lay of the land. he's an incredibly knowledgable guy when it comes to manhattan - especially the world-famous stuff and little bodegas just around the corner. we slept very soundly and comfortably on the trundle bed set-up. the windows look out on 10th ave, so it comes with some background street noise but nothing too strong. if you're coming from another urban environment yourself, you hardly notice it. as for transportation, joseph's place is close to bus and train lines and is about 10-15 minutes' walk from columbus circle and the sw corner of central park. also close to midtown manhattan locales: times square, madison square garden, penn station, etc. joseph's neighborhood is lively and filled with restaurants and shops. we were in town for the nyc marathon and it was a perfect spot.

this place is perfect for someone who really just needs somewhere to crash. the location is perfect, the room offered great light and privacy, there was a desk in case you need to work for a bit, and haffro was very responsive. i really just needed somewhere to shower and sleep and the location was the perfect for that.
had a great stay- didn’t spend much time in the apartment itself but larissa is a friendly host, the place was clean and close to the subway, and her pets were friendly and cute!

this was the perfect place to stay during our visit to new york. jason was very responsive, the room was clean, had all the amenities, and smelt amazing when we arrived. we came during a heat wave and having the a/c unit was a game changer. the room was small but perfect for one or two people who are planning on being out most of the time and the bar downstairs wasn’t too loud, and had great music and vibes. the location was perfect, right across the street from the subway, close to so many shops and restaurants; plus a 15 minute walk from the a view of the water and manhattan skyline which was incredible at night. will definitely book again if/when i come back!
amazing place. private & safe. lost of locations nearby. definitely would come back if the opportunity rises again. thank you!
clean, comfortable, responsive host.
jessica’s place is an excellent value! it’s in a great location, has everything you need, and jessica is a fantastic host! everything was clean and comfortable. we felt right at home and very safe!

this place was terrific. the bedroom, kitchen and shared bathroom were clean and comfortable. it is near transit as well. henry was a wonderful host: communicative and very helpful. i would stay here again , most definitely!
great stay the place was clean, comfortable, and in a perfect location. the host was friendly and responsive. would definitely stay again

loved the contactless check-in. typical hotel room size for nyc, great value. located on a busy street, but heard no street noise. we were only in town for one night and it was the perfect location for walking to bars and restaurants. room was clean, bed was large and comfy. would definitely recommend.

this is a lovely first floor apartment in williamsburg - beautifully restored with character and spotlessly clean. communication with ming was great from the outset and checking in and out was very smooth. the facilities are great - the kitchen is well equipped and sunny whilst the bed is very comfortable. new york was quite cold during our visit but we were warm enough. the location is very convenient and safe - great coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance and the l train to manhattan took no time at all - we were there for the ny half marathon and it took us about 25 minutes door to door to central park. i would certainly recommend staying here.
amazing experience host are very nice

if you are spending a few days in brooklyn/nyc, this apartment is a perfect place to be. zora & chris were helpful hosts who gave excellent recommendations for local eats. the apartment is close to the metro and there is free street parking out front.
juliana was extremely accommodating and thoughtful throughout my stay. she made me feel at home although i was away from home. i would book another stay with juliana in a heartbeat!

stayed here for a month. nice simple studio in a great location. nathan was very responsive and went above and beyond to accommodate my needs. he also ordered a brita filter for the unit upon request. the apt has basic pots, pans, kettle, and coffee machine. stocked with toilet paper, body wash, hair products, cleaning supplies. thin walls but neighbors aren’t terribly loud. tv was not great and you’ll need to log in to stream. wifi is reliable. very clean and was spotless. bed is not the best and could do with more sheets, pillows, and towels. however the location makes up for a lot of this and the apt is a stroll away from several trains.
very sweet, cozy house in a lovely part of greenpoint. i loved the light that comes into the room and really enjoyed my stay.

this was my first time visiting nyc and chester was extremely helpful during our stay. although the location is pretty far out from the city, it was easy enough to commute there and relatively uncomplicated—just expect to travel. the apartment is located only a few blocks away from the subway station, but if you’re not up for a walk, it may not be the best place for you. the surrounding area didn’t have much to offer in terms of restaurants/ activities, but again, it is so easy to get to those places from chester’s place. it was extremely clean inside and had all the amenities we needed! chester was really helpful with helping us set up the tv and gave us some tips on our visit. i was initially worried about visiting nyc with a group of young women, but chester was really reassuring and eased our minds! we had a great stay and i couldn’t recommend him enough.
this room served me well. it's very easy to walk around the neighborhood from here, and everything i needed was at the place. jermaine was communicative, as well.
very large apartment, especially for nyc standards. full kitchen with island. modern, clean, hip.
thank you brother for the great stay and all your help. really enjoyed staying at your place.
excellent place to stay, it was so last minute and joseph was so welcomed

i had a fab stay at kaitlyn’s apartment - and loved all the little touches! definitely feels like a home away from home. great location too, and super easy to get into manhattan. she’s also a really lovely and helpful host with great reccos. room has lots of storage space too which is a big plus! thanks kaitlyn :)
house and pictures posted match to a tea so no hidden surprises also loved the easy communication especially when plans changed on my end.

incredibly open to questions and communicates well. really nice and easy check in and check out. three beds and two bedrooms with an open space centrally for tv and wifi. kitchen is decent and 1 bathroom. excellent value and right by the metro for the d line which is ~ 50 min to manhattan

this apartment is a solid value in a good neighborhood (as in 2 minutes from gold star beer counter) and accessible to more than one subway line. kevin and karen are friendly and responsive. in my opinion this place is best for a couple or someone flying solo. i don't want to belabor the point. if you see this place available, you should strongly consider it.
perfect stay for a couple nights in the city. would definitely recommend if needing a place to sleep and for your belongings. lovely breakfast in the morning provided

ariela's apartment was wonderful for myself and my friends who i was travelling with. it was simple, comfortable, clean and well located. the space was rather larger and the four of us didn't ever feel like we were all in too close quarters. the laundry and net flicks were a huge bonus for the moments where i wanted to have a quiet moment to feel like i'm in my own house. the location was also great for anyone wanting to hang in bed-stuy, clinton hill/prospect heights or bushwick, also quick and easy to manhattan. i'll be back!

we had a wonderful stay … the place is fantastic and the guys at the reception help us in every questions… really appreciate the chance to leave the luggages until 8 pm .. and they also organize us the transfer to jfk! amazing! highly recommended!!!!
great place and location - couldn’t recommend it and luis as a host anymore.
marks place is super clean and well located. he gives a lot of attention to detail.

we had a wonderful stay! the apartment was clean, stylish, and very comfortable. the location was perfect — close to everything we needed. the host was kind and helpful, always quick to respond. would definitely recommend and stay here again!
the flat corresponds exactly... spacious clean and the garden is so beautiful...and paul & ewa was a perfect host. we spent a great weekend there
thanks for hosting and being flexible on time.

i came into town for a day looking for something that was close by to the airport and not too far away from manhattan. win's place was perfect, in a nice neighbourhood and had a good nightly rate. i had a little difficulty upon my return to the place (my own fault) but win and his partner assisted very promptly. for such a short trip, i was overwhelmed by their attentiveness, willingness to help and hospitality. would 100% recommend win's place to any traveller!

honestly for my first airbnb experience i expected the worst, but garcia definitely made those worries disappear. responsiveness and clarity on expectations made things much easier. definitely a good spot to stay at in new york if you don't want to be in the center of the city!

i had a wonderful stay at hal's place and would absolutely stay here again. the apartment was exceptionally clean and very comfortable. he is an outstanding host—extremely friendly, responsive, and genuinely helpful throughout my stay. the location was perfect. i came back very late at night and felt completely safe. the subway was just a short walk away, and having a 24-hour grocery store nearby was incredibly convenient. best of all, there were so many amazing restaurants literally right outside the door, which made exploring the neighborhood easy and fun. astoria is a fantastic area, and hal’s place was the perfect home base for my trip. highly recommended!
fantastic location, with a very helpful responsive host.
fantastic place in a fantastic neighborhood! well designed and lovely comfortable spot! i would totally stay there again
perfect place for our trip to belmont race track. nice safe neighborhood with lots in walking distance. the home was spotless and jaspreet was the perfect host. looking forward to going back!
great spot with a cozy room in a historic building, walkable to the park and plenty of interesting restaurants and things to do. the host is super friendly and helpful.
place was beautiful. very clean and well kept. very cozy and keren is a pleasure to communicate with.
susan’s place had a lot of character and was cozy. she was very responsive, and very accommodating. i would definitely stay here next time i am in new york.
easy check-in and check-out, great location, clean and spacious with beautiful windows.

other than my being 6 foot 6 inches tall and the bedroom full size bed’s head & foot boards cramping my laying full out, which was solved by my sleeping comfortably on the futon sofa bed in the living room, this was by far the cleanest, most uniquely beautifully furnished space, & the best of hosts i have experienced yet via air b&b. thank u very much marek!!!

my work team & i stayed here for 1 night to put on an event close by in brooklyn. the airbnb was so spacious for 5 guests. if we had our original 7 guests, there’d still be so much space! remember there is 1 bathroom so have a system if you’re running on time. we appreciated the 3 space heaters for each bedroom as it did get cold. if you’re driving, consider that it’s difficult to find parking at night. day/afternoon looked fine. we booked a garage & dropped off our van in advance to avoid any late night headaches since we returned around 4am. of course, avoid using a car if you can but for those traveling in a large group, from afar or for work—there is a garage a 7min walk from the airbnb. closes 12am, opens 6am. also paid an oversized fee about $55 total. hope this helps those considering this airbnb! we hope to come back again in the near future. thank you manuel :)

great location and decent value (for manhattan). i booked private room 2, a very small room with a bunk bed. don't expect luxury, but the location is what you're paying for and i paid less here than most other options in the area. super close to major sites and easy access to subway system.
sho-boo was extremely communicative and helpful in getting us settled. the room was spacious, bright, clean and very close to public transportation. i cannot ask for more for a trip to new york.

great host, beautiful place, clean, warm and homely. the parking was a blessing. though street parking was available most times. all was perfect except the people upstairs being extra loud, the floor was squeaky it’s like walking on eggshell for them, the walls were thin so that was the only issue.

i wouldn’t recommend this place. the comments below about the smell and 20$ fee for each hour after checkin are absolutely true. the bed isn’t great either. so much soft in a way that my back isn’t straight which resulted in a bad night of sleep.
super friendly host, place has everything you need, great location (right by j train and citi bike station).
very nice stay. clean house, short walk to subway. friendly host. overall very great.
very sweet place, awesome halloween decorations. really easy to check in with good directions. comfy clean bed and good sized room. bathroom was great. no complaints!

expensive, but worth it. two very good sized bedrooms. fully stocked kitchen. a real treat, with a great midtown location. the apartment is a real find. it’s definitely a home, albeit it was spotless and really felt like the best combination of your own space, yet hotel quality amenities. very stylish in decor - magazine shoot quality. still plenty of practical space for nyc. a lot of furnishings so it felt better suited to 2-4 adults. and the entrance lift pops up straight into the apartment - very cool! location was excellent. enough security, easy to access. in the middle of things (in midtown), yet wasn’t overly noisy. bedrooms at the back helped. subway within easy reach. leo is an excellent host. he stocked the kitchen with plenty of high quality food. we didn’t need or touch most of it, but it was enough for several days! too many places to eat in nyc. leo was incredibly responsive during the stay (and before). he was there if we needed him, but also left us to it.
perfect one night stay for an early flight from jfk...

it is a cozy room, perfect for the solo traveler. a nice mini mart in the block corner, and a close subway station. andrada & will are very kind, and their dog skippy is very friendly. i really enjoyed my stay. thank you andrada and will.
janet is a very nice person and her place was very clean. if your looking for a quiet place to stay this is the place.

directions were excellent and i was met at the dock and was given detailed instructions on the keys and boat. wet and rainy, a little slippery on the gang plank, but warm and cozy in the houseboat. furnished with everything i needed. unit was immaculate, comfy bed, good linens, lots of blankies. enjoyed my stay, great 24 hour deli right next to the boat dock, tgi fridays, jordan's lobster, knapp street bagels, plenty of parking. express bus right to manhattan, $6.00 and to top it off there is a wine store and dunkin donuts, 100 feet away. 20 minutes to jfk. i would stay here again.
my second time staying at niko’s apartment and as before was exactly what i needed - clean, great location, really good living space and of course wonderful hosts
great location for easy access to the city, queens and the subway. walking distance to everything you need. good light for a city apartment and had basic amenities.

my family and i had a wonderful stay at asad’s place. this location had everything we needed. i highly recommend this property. the only issue i had was the second floor tenants played their music both nights until 4-5 am despite the signs on the wall asks everyone to keep it quiet after 10pm out of respect for other neighbors. it was impossible to stay asleep in the main room with the two queen beds. aside from that all else was great.
amazing stay as before! great host!
beautiful, quiet apartment just ten minutes from grocery/waterfront/subway stop. five of us stayed here and had plenty of room.

i booked mrs arlene's apartment for a 3-day stay in nyc to please my children, our stay ended up being a nightmare for our family. first we find handwritten notes (talking about children) on a wall in the apartment which made our children think that someone wants to hurt them. as a parent, we spent the stay reassuring our children. second nightmare, after our check out, i receive an invoice of almost 800 usd from the host that we have to pay according to her, we have spoiled her chair. the water chair poured by our 4 year old child that we have to reimburse. if you have children, i strongly advise you not to reserve this apartment at the risk of finding yourself in the same situation as us. as a parent, we expected to receive a little compassion from the host for what our children went through during our stay.

the studio apartment is a private entry basement that felt like home.. it was clean quite, warm and comfortable for my business trip.. easy access to transportation if you want to go to jamaica avenue and green acres mall.. it is about 20 minutes from the airport.. it doesn’t have a kitchen, but it would have been nice to have a mini station with an electric kettle and tea up to make hot beverage… however, there was a lot of restaurants close by.. the host was very quiet on her response and welcoming. over all i love my stay.. and i would definitely go and as well as recommend this airbnb to everyone.
this place is incredible. the photos tell all. great amenities, close to the train (utica and ralph stations). the hosts were very responsive and welcoming. i would highly recommend this place.
great host. everything you expect and more.
it’s a well maintained, safe and pleasant place to spend and quality time. thanks to ramneet for making my holidays so beautiful and lovely

this apartment was great! two large bedrooms, sleeper sofa, two bathrooms, a full kitchen with plates and things to cook with, dining table and living room. great location near shops and public transit. communication was great and very fast!

great and convenient location! the building is definitely not the cleanest, there are constantly strangers smoking weed in the staircase and you can smell the fumes across the building and apartment. not the host’s fault: the elevator was during my 3-day stay not once functional, so i had to walk up 5 floors for 3 days. the apartment is spacious and offers bare bones necessities.
dimitri was a great and kind host, i would definitely stay at his place again!!

nice and cosy studio wis a perfect view on the roof ! extra shower and perfect air conditioning in this period . the bed was really comfortable . daniel and nazleen were really helpful and really great people. around 20 min to go to manhattan with bus and train , bus stop just 10 sec from the studio . train and bus 24/24 and 7/7 . calm neighborhood. and close to the train station maybe the best breakfast food truck you can find in nyc . that was perfect . thanx a lot daniel and nazleen !
we recommend. be careful: leving your car there all day will require more planning than anticipated.
very clean and nice! close to subway. quite neighborhood in historic brooklyn.
matt’s place was fantastic. check in instructions were easy and matt was super easy to deal with. location is great and we loved the newly renovated kitchen.

highly recommend all around! the most picturesque brownstone for your brooklyn stay. incredible location next to major train lines, steps to a bodega and delicious restaurants (try pasta louise!), and a short walk to prospect park. huge floor-through apartment means lots of space, light, and comfortable space including full kitchen and bathroom. alain was easy to communicate with and offered flexible check-in for our visit.

wonderful, classic, old-school new york type of living in a brownstone house. love it! having the owner staying in the same house (the brownstone house is divided into different apartment sizes), indeed ease my concerns in staying in an older apartment as i know that they will be there should i needed assistance. in summary, both ted & diane are experienced airbnb hosts who are staying with the family in the same house. i am full of praises for their fast response! both are constantly making sure that we are comfortable in the apartment. when i casually mentioned about the sudden drop in the temperature in the city which made the apartment heating not so warm, they immediately try to think what could be the problem and provided a solution. impressed! the apartment is on a street where real new york families stay. so, perfectly safe. it is between 5-10mins (depending your walking speed) walk to the 72nd subway. many uptown / downtown / crosstown buses available. you can walk to hudson river, lincoln centre is just around the block, central park is just 10-15mins leisure walk away. lots of amenities & shops on broadway, amsterdam & colombus. cannot ask for more. the apartment is well-stock with hand wash, diff types of shower gels / shampoo / conditioner / bath soak / body scrub. impressive! toilet rolls, tissue paper and kitchen wipes are plenty. washing detergent too! towels n linens are clean and good quality. hot water and water pressure are good. the hosts also provided coffee, tea, sugar etc. the photos are true to actual apartment. if you are looking at this listing, i would strongly recommend if you want a true old-school new york living. the only “deal-breaker” would be if you have a huge and heavy luggage and you don’t want to deal with flights of stairs. thank you ted & diane for the lovely memories at your apartment!
nora’s place was great. she and her husband were very helpful throughout and communication was excellent! if i’m ever staying in queens again, i know where i’m staying

we loved everything about this place. perfect location- close to subway, easy to get to manhattan…but also one of the best parts of brooklyn. we would definitely stay here again, thanks so much, jenni
a great, no-frills, centrally-located spot. convenient!

this is my second time staying here and definitely won't be my last. both of my stays have been for concerts and it's nice to come back to somewhere calm and clean after the chaos. carolyn is an amazing host.she is extremely responsive and very friendly. the place is spotless and exactly like the pictures. i'm looking forward to booking here again next time i'm in queens.

i can’t brag enough about sunny’s place. it was clean, well taken care of, and decorated so cute! the detailed instructions given by sunny were accurate and easy to follow. it’s a short walk to the subway station with easy access to manhattan if that’s something you want to do.
the place was cute and friendly! they had lots of nice snacks to eat and everything was simple and worked.
nice private room. great people. close to transit. walkable to local restaurants and amenities. safe neighborhood. great value.
good place to stay on staten island!

the host was responsive to any needs or issues. the apartment is half a block from the a train station—very convenient. many restaurants and shops nearby. lively neighborhood, a real new york experience

great stay! needed an airbnb for 1 night. bed and bathroom were comfortable and every room has its own lock which made me comfortable sharing the home. only downside was the transportation convenience. i had to use the bus from this airbnb which isn't an issue. but just be aware if you are traveling ti brooklyn or manhanttan that you will catch the bus to the subway station and then use the trains. would stay again for sure.
great private space in lovely area
karen was a fantastic host. she was very quick to respond, helpful and flexible. her place has all the needed equipments for a stay. thank you for everything!
good place quiet area
beautiful home, very communicative property management — highly recommend!

this place was very clean and comfortable. we stayed with our whole family including two children. alexeys mom was very nice and helpful to us the entire time we stayed there. she always answered and helped us whenever we needed something. the location is great and is of walking distance to the boardwalk, nearby stores/restaurants and attractions. highly recommend this place!

the apartment is just as in the pictures. it's very clean and comfortable. the room is spacious and warm. gilberto is very nice. the apartment is located up north, but there are subway stations very close, also places to eat or buy food. the neighborhood seems safe. i recommend staying in this apartment!

alison and her husband welcomed us on the night of our arrival. they are very friendly and good-looking couple. we had a cozy and relaxing stay for one week time. thank you for your hospitality and we shall be back.
great hosts, nice décor and awesome value.
awesome stay, great location, love marcy neighborhood, loved to see all the playgrounds and the locals enjoying the outside! def will be staying again
my two friends and i enjoyed our stay at edna’s charming apartment near prospect park. we had everything we needed and more. edna was very responsive to us and was the perfect host. would book again!
tony was by far the most helpful host i’ve ever had. he went above and beyond to help me when my trip didn’t go as planned. i am very thankful!
great hotel, quiet, clean in a great downtown neighborhood. enjoyed my stay

this is a great place with the most gracious and accomodating host. it is clean, spacious , well appointed, and private. the location is the best - easy access to any place in the city - and in a safe neighborhood with great character. this will be our first choice as a place to stay everytime we visit nyc.

location is great, near the subway g and also the a & c. the place has all you need to spend a few days knowing the city. waldemar was a great host who keeps the place clean and confortable for the guests.
the family was so nice helpful and the home was absolutely beautiful. there are many things to do around the neighborhood and transportation access was quick and efficient! would stay here again!

roxiny and shan were great hosts, their guest house was comfortable and fit our needs to explore long island city, astoria and nyc. we appreciate their responsiveness and virtual guide to help with all of our needs. best of luck and best wishes on your hosting adventure!
this location was lovely, thank you to the host for being so responsive❤️❤️ definitely will book this home again.

carolyn was a very friendly and accessible host. i lived in the unit for two months. rosa is the property manager who is always on site and she was wonderful. carolyn and rosa made arrangements to help me move into the unit late at night due to my flight arrangements. the unit looks just like the pictures and it was extremely clean. whenever i needed anything i was able to reach out to rosa. the beds were very comfortable and i had room for my husband to come and visit and some girlfriends. the internet worked well and i was able to work out of the apartment when needed. the neighborhood is up and coming so you do need to be aware of your surroundings, particularly on the block where the building is located, but there are also some incredible restaurants one block away on 9th. you are also within walking distance of hudson yards, times square, and the major subway stations. i had a wonderful stay.
great place to stay for a month with family. convenient location and great host. very close to manhattan and lots of cafes/restaurants nearby.

i enjoyed my stay at evan’s airbnb with my 2 kids. the location was great for walking around and easy to get into manhattan. it was a new airbnb, so the decor was simple, but it was clean and spacious - evan said he would continue to add to the space, but it already had pretty much everything we needed. would stay here again!
great place to stay if you’re a traveler

nice and cozy place to stay! the host was very responsive. the only thing was that it was a little too uptown for me so going back and forth to midtown/soho etc. took a little longer than i expected. however the location is near the riverstate park which was nice to go to right after work and just walk or bike along the river. family friendly area, and stores are pretty close by and i felt safe. laundry was in the building which is great for nyc and there was an elevator.
lakshmee's place is at a very convenient location and rooms were clean. we loved the hospitality.
it was a really great stay. proximity to train station, safety at night. in general, it was a good stay, and i hope to return.
very nice apartment and welcoming host. excellent location.
thanks so much for a lovely stay!
great place to stay
