the house is incredibly large with great communal living area — chefs kitchen, dining room table, enough seating for everyone. the bedrooms upstairs are lovely. the backyard and roof deck are fabulous and enhanced our stay. it would have been great if there was firewood available for the fire pit. there is also no coffee grinder — but three coffee makers for pre-ground coffee. (local coffee shop was very helpful for grinding beans!) the neighborhood is a bit to be desired and fairly far away from nyc or brooklyn main attractions. luckily we used this for a work retreat and it did the job very well. bright light. beautiful indoor-outdoor living from the kitchen and big glass back doors. the only other annoyance is you need to go outside to access the first floor apartment with two bedrooms. and the door from the garden enters a bedroom. so a few times we found ourselves having to use the front steps and entering the key code over and again. it’s manageable but not great in pjs :)
no complaints, definitely want to come back
it's a pretty good place overall.

can't say enough good things about this place. great hosts, great location. personally i found the design elements to be the best part. closet with hangers, filtered water on the dresser, towels on the desk. never had to scramble, everything was right there. gets nice morning light. clean. easy five stars.
perfect room for anybody is coming to visit new york, kaptan is very nice and helpfully, thank you very much
great stay and awesome hospitality!

mark is a very good host; he totally respects your privacy, and he’s there when you need him. the studio has everything you need for a good comfortable stay, very clean. i would recommend it to anyone who wishes to stay in queens.

this apartment is super cute and has loads of space to sleep and relax with it's three sleeping spaces and 4 beds. if street noise bothers you, pack your ear plugs or you can sleep in the basement which is much quieter and has a very comfortable mattress. it's also just a couple blocks from the l and has good walkable restaurants nearby
great spot, really enjoyed the stay
nice place, great location. quiet and clean ! thanks jazz !

j and lana's beautiful home in ditmas park was our first experience with airbnb and it will be hard to beat! everything was as pictured and promised in their listing. their home/guest room is lovely and the bed very comfortable. we enjoyed a private bathroom for our stay as well. it was very hot in ny during our visit and it was a total blessing to be able to return to our blissfully cool room ea. night. we drove this trip in order to deliver some furniture to our son for his new apt. our hosts were super accommodating with the convenient/free parking of our vehicle right outside our door ... a true luxury in brooklyn! j and lana are wonderful hosts and we look forward to staying with them again in the future!!

lovely spacious apartment in a great location. accommodation was even better than the photographs. very clean. really easy check in and check out. clear instructions on everything and useful information on supermarkets, local restaurants etc. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend and will return. luis is a great host. deborah, ireland

incredibly accommodating and responsive host. any concern i had was handled immediately and communicated appropriately. location was 10/10. newly remodeled interior homey and comfortable. check in and check out process smooth. one of the better airbnb experiences i’ve had.

margaret went above and beyond to provide a wonderful getaway with a friend from abroad. the beautifully stocked kitchen and wood burning fireplace make it special. the space is beautiful and the bed is a dream. very grateful to have stayed with her!
my only complaint was no outside guests. other than that the listing is pretty accurate .
location was amazing and checking in and checking out was very easy. the area has lots of bar and restaurant if that is what you are looking for. the room was clean and very private.
excellent location for my needs.
kandi’s home was exactly as described — extremely clean, simple, and comfortable. you’ll have a private room & bath, which is great after a long day of being outside exploring brooklyn.

we recently had the pleasure of staying at angel's airbnb in new york, and let me tell you, it was an absolute dream! from the moment we arrived until the time we left, everything about this place was simply perfect. we couldn't have asked for a better experience. location was ideal. nestled in the charming neighborhood of astoria, we found ourselves surrounded by a vibrant community with a plethora of restaurants, cafes, and shops just a short walk away. one thing that really stood out was the host's attention to detail, starting from coffee, teas, fruit, water, everything you can possibly need from cosmetics and other supplies. they were also incredibly responsive and accommodating, ensuring that we had everything we needed throughout our stay. their warm hospitality truly made a difference and contributed to our memorable experience.
amazing home and host
trong is a great host. we enjoyed our stay in the property.
perfect place for a solo traveler who is out busy exploring nyc. comfortable bed, clean place, easy access, good street parking, would stay here again!
perfect little place, clean, great location, close to everything. carla is a wonderful host. highly recommend and would definitely stay here again.
just what we expected. great value.
great place for solo travel work trips
it was so peaceful, i would definitely stay again!

this place was great and i would stay again. the location is amazing and close to so much and getting over to bk was so easy because the bridge is right there. we blew a fuse on accident and kimberly helped me fix it within minutes and saved our night!
amazing stay, host was extremely thoughtful.

apartement is nice, spaciuos and clean, fully equipped. bed is a bit short, but very comfortable! metro is a 15 min walk away. several grocery stores around, and a supermarket is 5 mins away. neighbourhood is quiet and peaceful. kostas and his family is nice and helpful!
christophe’s place was fantastic, we loved the apartment and felt right at home. the cats were lovely as well :)

matt's place is better than advertised! it is in a prime location, has an amazing set-up and is both cozy and and hip (like the surrounding neighborhood). matt is easy to communicate with and flexible. i would love to stay at this location again!

everything is digital at this place, including check out and check in. if you were staying for a longer time, there’s a $35 cleaning fee for each time you want room service. the price was great and the location was phenomenal. good value.

the host omits some very important details about this space. 1.) this is a 4th floor walk-up. 2.) the couch in the living room is also rented to travelers. the description did say to expect other guests; however, i was not expecting to walk in on someone trying to sleep when i arrived. it was late and i felt terrible for disturbing this person. ues is a great neighborhood but i would not recommend min's place.
i felt like i was home!
erma place was great, she was very helpful and it was great experience.

the host was incredibly kind, and the accommodation was exceptionally clean. they prepared an american-style meal for us, which was absolutely delicious. i definitely intend to visit again in the future. thanks to their hospitality, i had a wonderful trip to new york. thank you so much!
perfect, would recommend. and also great service

caroline was a delightful host and made sure that my partner and i felt right at home. it was extremely cozy inside and the hospitality of caroline made it even better. i would certainly return here again to take advantage of how close it is to ubs arena.
was the perfect place to stay and felt very safe! we were always out and about but it was a great location for everything and walking distance from the subway, restaurants, shopping, etc

we've spent a month at kat's place and would've spent much longer if it were possible. we loved everything about the place, from kat's and maria's incredible hospitality to the apartment itself to the location of the house. there are lots of grocery stores, laundry, restaurants, etc., located ±10 minutes away from the apartment, or less. manhattan is about 20 minutes away by metro, and it was incredibly easy for us to get around nyc from the place. the apartment was fitted with everything one may need for an extended stay, and looked exactly like the pictures. and best of all, kat and her mom, maria, made us feel like we were part of the family. they reacted to all our requests/questions momentarily, and whenever we needed something, they jumped in to help. all in all, this stay is among our best experiences with airbnb :) thank you, kat and maria, for the wonderful stay!

wow, where do i begin? for first time new yorkers i felt right at home! mateo & greg were excellent hosts, incredibly welcoming and made the entire process smooth. the property was in excellent condition and well heated, everything was clean and comfortable. we had plenty of space to move around each morning. i would also recommend mateo and greg's space to my friends/family in the future, it was a treasure you hope to find in such a big city. the nearest subway into manhattan was franklin avenue and i found ubers were also surprisingly affordable each way. i can't explain the magic i felt when our cab pulled up to the property and we were immediately greeted by a waving mateo! thank you guys so much!

sean’s place in bed-stuy was our best nyc stay by far. it’s a large gracious space with a full kitchen, comfortable bed, sparkling bathroom, and beautiful artwork, plus it’s located in supercool bed-stuy with tons of great restaurants (chez oskar) and coffee shops (september) right around the corner. plus it’s located in a transit hub, near the subway. on top of all that sean was a super responsive host, and helped us with all sorts of things pre-stay, during our stay, and post-stay. a superlative airbnb experience!

the home is beautiful and easy to locate. there was 2 good sized bedrooms with roku tv's. living room is big with 2 nice leather couches and a giant tv. kitchen has a large almost commercial sized fridge/freezer, with all the appliances you could need on a trip! dining room is nice with a large table and 6 seats. there's even a little room with a computer desk if you need a place for a laptop. there is a small deli about a 3 minute walk from the house. has a little bit of everything so it's perfect for drinks/snacks etc. i personally recommend their bacon, egg, and cheese it's amazing. now depending on your walking speed the ferry and the food/shopping outlet is a 15-20 minute walk. my only minor gripe with the place is the home runs a little hot even with all the fans and ac's running full blast. that said i'd still give the home a 5 star and recommend anyone visiting ny to stay here.

everything was great. happy to have chosen this place. will choose it again in the future if the need arises. its close enough from manhatten, the subway is across the street, the connection is fine and the neighbourhood is very mellow.

great location near 6 subway. tons of storage space. nice kitchen and large dining table. cozy bedroom filled with light. washer/dryer in unit. dishwasher. responsive host. great restaurant/market right downstairs and drugstore across the street. large tub and double sink in bathroom. everything you need for a great trip to nyc.
marek's place was really well designed. we were very impressed. we loved our stay there. for reference, we had a 2 1/2 year old. everything was safe for a toddler. thank you marek!
i had a really good time there. such a lovely place!

our family enjoyed our stay at gayla’s apartment. it is one of the most well-appointed and cozy airbnb’s we have stayed in (and we travel often). gayla was very accommodating of our family. i took classes at nyu and it was not a challenging commute using the myrtle ave stop. thank you so much for hosting us!
perfect location, close to central park and lots of restaurants. a bike station right outside the apartment makes it easy to bike the city!
a clean comfortable private stay that is also economical. great host!

guillermo is an amazing host. the place was incredibly clean when we arrived and he was interested and helpful with everything. the studio is gorgeous, it has all the essentials and the location is perfect. we will certainly come back .
this place is great! right in hell’s kitchen, close to so much. perfect place to lay your head after a full nyc day and way less expensive than two hotel rooms!
nice place to stay. friendly environment at the hotel

this property was dirty and depressing. i gave 2 stars b/c the front desk staff (except for 1 individual) was incredibly kind and gracious. the room itself smelled of cigarette smoke but reception was unable to move me b/c the hotel was sold out. they sent housekeeping in with a can of febreeze which made the migraine i had even worse. the hallway reeked of marijuana and vomit (which was just as pungent the next day - it was pervasive.) the room was beat up - stains on the lamp shade, toilet seat with multiple chips, bottom of bathroom door was in great disrepair, bathroom door couldn't fully open b/c toilet was in the way, lighting in bathroom was terrible. thank goodness i brought my own sheets. i rolled myself into a sheet like a little burrito and slept on and off for only a few hours.
great space super comfortable beds. definitely will be back

we enjoyed our stay in nick’s airbnb located in park slope, brooklyn. it had a nice large bathroom and the kitchen was equipped with coffee and a nice refrigerator. we were in brooklyn to visit our son and his girlfriend. our daughter and a friend met us in ny from tennessee. we had plenty of room to invite all 4 in our airbnb for a visit after a dinner one night. overall it was a good experience staying at nick’s airbnb.

vera is such a nice, welcoming host! she respected my privacy and was very friendly at the same time. she even gave me some advice about life... the room was cosy, clean, beautiful, and even had my own big fridge! bathroom was spotless and i could use clean towels everyday. i spent 3 weeks in ny and hopped around several airbnbs but i am so grateful that i finished my trip to the dream city at vera's place. i would definitely come back! fyi there is a very cuddly kitten at her place
good place to stay ,

visited new york on a solo trip & this place suited my needs given the price of some hotels there. the room was fine & clean, it had a/c which was bonus given the temperature at the time of my visit. i don’t usually book a place with shared facilities but they were fine & most times i passed to go out they were always being cleaned so in turn were spotless. location wise was spot on as well being a few blocks from penn station & close to the usual tube stations etc, if you are looking to do new york on a budget i’d recommend this place over some of the “hotels” i saw listed on other sites.

nice place, well located. having a balcony was a plus. the only downside was the noise. being in the second floor it gets quite a lot of noise from the street, since is it located between two busy avenues (lexington and the third). it is perfect for short-stays and for a person or couple, otherwise you will feel the space is too small.

the space was perfect for what we needed. it is a great location, with easy access to the city. lavonne was a great host. she kept in touch but was never invasive. she made sure we had what we needed. we loved our stay.

felix and his wife were absolutely lovely to mee. they were both so accommodating, i felt very welcome in their home. the room itself is large with a comfortable bed. the location was perfect, right down the street from the park. i would stay here again in a heartbeat.

my wife and i spent a great time with marialuisa and her family during our 5 day travel in new york. the house is very clean and beautifully decorated. we strongly recommend other travellers to book their house. we are very sorry for mistakenly taking their charging plug with us. we realized this when we came back to durham.

caroline’s space was perfect for a weekend getaway with my friend. we enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere the place had to offer. there were lots of extra toiletries available if you forgot something and she even left us water and champagne. overall, we loved our stay and will definitely book with caroline again in the future.
super cute, stylish room

rosa was a great host. very responsive and communicative if there’s anything you needed from her. she’s also very accommodating! i would recommend staying with rosa if you don’t mind commuting to the city.
this place was great! my stay was so comfortable i kept extending it. :) mcarthur was a very communicative and hospitable host. i definitely recommend this place!

what a great apartment in nyc. my wife and i took our two adult sons for a quick two night trip. what a great apartment. clean, easily accessible and everyone had their own room with a very comfortable bed. thank you mike... we will stay here again!
i would happily return to this wonderful space. you feel part of the greenpoint community and also have easy access to manhattan etc.

barbi had great communication with us answering questions before booking as well as after. she wanted to welcome our family with holiday cheer and asked if we celebrated the holidays etc. she was quick to address concerns. she was flexibile in adjusting booking dates since our plans included international flights. the host greets the guests for check in. she is keen about keeping her building clean as it appears to include both long and short term tenants so be sure to follow the trash and recycling rules:)

alina was a nice relaxed host. i have no hesitation in recommending this apartment to visitors to new york city. the apartment is pretty much in line with how the listing describes it - it is neat and clean and it is a convenient location. staying here was so easy for a first time visitor to new york city. i hope i can come back sometime soon and stay again!!

the house was super clean and smelled really fresh when i walked in. the hostess was very friendly and understanding that i had my stepdaughter with me even she wasn’t on the reservation. the parking was great as well. the tv had a nice selection of streaming services which was a big plus.
i really liked it. the only downside is if you arrive after 6 pm with your car, it's hard to find parking. and in general i am very pleased. i definitely recommend
very lovely home, lots of cool artistic touches, cozy and warm throughout. very central to all the fun cafes and stuff going on in fort greene.
apartment is great, looks exactly like in the pictures. very close to subway. sara is a great host.

everything was great, but the only thing i didn’t like was the mattress. i even communicated this to alex, but he did not respond. i also saw a previous review mentioning that the mattress was not comfortable, but it still hasn’t been fixed. i highly recommend that alex address these small issues and not ignore customer feedback. other than that, everything was great, and i liked it. thanks.

the bathroom was dirty the mirror in bathroom had spit all over it, hair in the tub, tub was dirty visible dirt, you can hear every little noise in the home, very basic, the bed was extremely hard and no tv, two travel size soaps
this was my third airbnb stay in newyork and i have to say it was my absolute favorite. i would definitely stay here again and i would definitely recommend 1000 times over 👌🏽😊

this place has a perfect midtown manhattan location and rich amenities inside -- and that's basically it. the place clearly cannot fit 5 persons -- the upper floor of the bunk bed is extremely shakey and hard to climb up to; the stand-alone single bed is right in front of the ac so you are either getting a cold or blocking the air; and otherwise there is literally no space to open up even your suitcases. there were only 3 of us with one carry-on and one medium-sized suitcases, and it felt extremely crowded inside. the wifi also did not work for the whole 3 nights we stayed there. the wifi instruction is also different from what is shared here in airbnb, and regardless it was just not connecting. i would recommend this place to anyone who would want a quintessential nyc experience -- and be aware that other than the central location, it's not gonna be comfortable!

great place to stay. awesome location and value, and evan made things very easy. it's a nyc apartment and has its quirks (heated by radiator, shower temp fluctuates a bit, bed a little small), but it's very comfortable and evan had it spotless for us. the apartment had everything we needed - plenty of blankets, paper towels, trash bags, even umbrellas. great experience!
great place to stay & very responsive hosts. we stayed here for a month while waiting for our permanent lease.
this place is a miniature paradise.the artistic display and perfumery is classic.kimberly is an angel to a guest in human form prince arinze,esq

it's a great apartment near times square, pretty close to subways and some major spots in the city. however, we did have some trouble during the stay. the location provided in the listing is incorrect. the bathtub was choked, which they did nothing about during the 4 days we were there. we had to fix it ourselves. some of the utensils in the kitchen were unwashed too. they also have almost no lighting in the hall, so you basically rely on the lights coming from outside the window. the hosts were pretty responsive otherwise.
the place was very comfortable and felt safe. and the host seemed to be very welcoming.
room was just what was described only issue i would have to say is there were very limited channels on the tv. with no instruction on how to use it. we finally figured it out after two nights.
we stayed with 3 more friends, and we had such a good rest at rafael’s airbnb. rafael is an incredible host!

had a great experience at this hotel, the rooms were cozy and were perfect for me and my girlfriend’s trip to new york. very close to the subway and other amenities such as the shops in soho and multiple food places. overall a really positive stay and i would recommend to anyone coming to new york!
yves is a really good guy, and he helped us a lot. we loved his dog, she welcomed us every day!! his apt is a perfect home for traveller, we had a really good time there! thanks a lot yves!
it’s a very safe place and the apartment was really nice!

this house was just as advertised. the host was communicative and very thoughtful. he provided snacks, charging cables, and any necessities that are often forgotten on a trip (toothbrushes, pain relievers, etc.). the house was clean and orderly. it was spacious by nyc standards. there were four of us and we would not hesitate to stay there again.
very convenient location, amazing chicken spot right across the street but also so many places around. room was clean and comfy, great for the price!

the host was very communicative, helpful, and friendly! 5 levels of rooms and comfy beds. it would make for an excellent photoshoot location, with interesting details such as fireplaces and exposed brick walls. it would be the perfect spot for a group of friends getting together - individual rooms with their own kitchenettes and door locks. the best feature is the lower level, with game room basement and back yard. they thought of everything! it's the perfect hang out spot! note: if you are a bigger bodied person, or have difficulty with stairs, this may not be the ideal spot for you. otherwise, the beds are very comfortable and supportive!

a warm, cozy townhouse in the heart of a community with heart—park slope. lovely, charming hosts, jaye and spike will help you feel at home, and provide a relaxed atmosphere for you to enjoy your stay. my highest recommendation!

we had a great stay in new york. the location was excellent—very convenient for getting around and exploring the city. the place was clean, comfortable, and overall exactly as expected. everything went smoothly during our stay. thank you for hosting us!
it’s a nice place to stay, raj is very kind!

my fiancée and i came up to nyc for my birthday weekend. definitely was not what we expected and the rooms were pretty small for us to move around and open our luggages. also, there was no microwave or fridge in the room, so you either have to store your food in the fridge on the first floor, or eat it or throw it away. the sheets were dirty, so we had to sleep on our own sheets, and the carpet was also dirty. i didn’t mind the scenery because the stores, restaurants, and subway were all convenient, but the guys out front who were in front of the building selling merchandise everyday gets annoying sometimes. it also gets hot in the room, and you have no way to adjust the temperature unless you ask the staff. however, the staff is very nice and responsive if you need any assistance. the wifi was good, which we had no problems with. i expected much better than this, but i understand that you get whatever you paid for.
very friendly and super nice and accommodating felt right at home!

wonderful stay. before i booked sammy's place, i looked at the photos, read the reviews and read his advice for guests, and my experience matched what i had read and seen. excellent value, spacious, clean and comfortable, with a host that genuinely wants to ensure his guests have a great time while they are staying with him. what i liked: - sammy is super responsive, and you know he's willing and ready to help his guests in any way he reasonably can. this was very comforting in case i needed anything. - very spacious, clean, simple, uncluttered and updated apartment. 2 bedrooms, nice shower, comfy couches and bean bags to chill on. 2 tvs and complimentary netflix. decent wi-fi. - night light outside worked well when coming in late, quiet neighborhood, clean and safe surroundings, digital lock with keyless entry. note: if traveling to manhattan is something you will do often, learn the bus and train options. it's more than an hour away.
great place to stay. barbara is a great host!
great place! very close to airport, and host was very responsive when i reached out. would definitely stay here again.
very nice place to stay

i stayed at this location for 3 days and i loved it! it was peaceful neighborhood, peaceful stay and the hosts responds quick if you need them for anything! everything was lovely, i don’t have any complaint. thank you so much to emily and saul.

fantastic stay. great location, as in i don’t think i could’ve asked for better for my needs for this trip. hosts were extremely responsive and transparent. would definitely come back in the future and feel very fortunate that i stayed here without doing extensive research.
we had an amazing stay here. jesse was a very accommodating, responsive, and helpful host. the space was kept clean, and had the amenities we needed. would recommend!

great place. there are some reviews about the ac but it’s pretty simple on how to operate. people out front are a bit sketchy but it’s not unsafe if that makes sense. the apartment is great, the controls make it nice. the bathroom is super cool. balcony. it was a great stay. i’ll be staying here for all my ny stays.

i had a great stay at this airbnb! the space was very clean, quiet, and well-maintained. . the location is convenient, with only a 10-minute drive to jfk and about 30 minutes to manhattan. it's also walking distance to the train, which made getting around easy. there’s a playground park right across the street, which is a nice bonus if you're traveling with kids or just want a peaceful spot to relax. i would definitely recommend this place!
cute little place in a great location. host was extremely accommodating & nice. would definitely go back!
an amazing stay. perfectly clean and comfortable. happening neighborhood.

i and my wife kerstin just came back to stockholm today after another exciting week in new york city. one of many. when we first came to new york, and fell in love with the city, in 1989 we were told, rightly or wrongly, that white people didn't venture into harlem. but then 42nd street a couple of blocks west of times sq. wasn't all that safe. new york has come a long way in 25 years. today harlem just feels more laid-back than midtown, strangers giving you a friendly hello in the street, that kind of thing. adrianne's apartment -- which we now consider our new york home -- is roomy, clean, well stuctured, well kept, well equipped and very comfortable. not least the beds; we slept like logs -- partly also because the house and the location are more quiet than you would expect on manhattan. the location is perfect. not three blocks from the subway station. 133 and 134 st end at lenox ave., so on the east side of the avenue, it's just one block, three minutes walk, to the 135 st station and express trains downtown. but first and foremost, adrianne is the most thoughtful, caring and considerate hostess you can hope to meet. we warmly and sincerely recommend adrianne and her apartment. and we will be back. often.

the apartment was perfect for our stay in new york. subway is around the corner, same as restaurants and jfk also easy to reach. gayle was welcoming us even though we arrived very late at night. we had everything we needed and would recommend everyone to choose this accommodation for their time in nyc!
good location and great value for nyc
great apartment!! close to park and reaturaunr$
clean and pleasant environment

we had a great stay. it is just a few minute walk to the subway where you can get a direct subway to central manhattan. the apartment is beautiful and well decorated. we didn’t see jeffrey and dan personally but they answered always quick and after our arrival they checked in to know everything was fine. at our arrival we found fresh baked cookies waiting for us, that was very sweet. overall an amazing stay at this awesome apartment!
elsa and juan were so kind and helpful during our stay. the location is perfect and they were so accommodating. i hope we can stay at their place again in the future!

this place was a delight to stay in and the host was extremely accommodating and helped me find everything i needed to be comfortable during the stay. it was very clean and the beds were extremely soft and comfortable. the spot is a 2 minute walk to the nearest metro with food and groceries all within a 10 minute walk. i couldn’t ask for more!

alfred's place was simply wonderful: comfortable, quiet, beautifully decorated, stocked with amenities, and loaded with books. the lovely backyard garden area was a welcome spot to hang out after exploring new york all day. alfred and helen were great communicators and very helpful with recommendations. both bill and ihighly recommend staying here, no matter what.

the accommodation is really recommended. everything was as described. the fridge was already filled with food, so you could feel right at home. check in / check out was uncomplicated. near the apartment are several bus stops and also a metro station, so that you can get to manhattan. we usually took 30-40 minutes to reach different destinations but if you live in manhattan you also need a lot of time to reach different destinations. we would definitely come back again. thank you vadim
we had an amazing time at matt’s home. it was very centric and everything was really close. we will use it when we return to the city!
a beautiful property. full of charm and character. harriet and ray where brilliant with all communication regarding the booking and would recommend to stay with them.

this is a great airbnb hidden near jfk. lots of good things nearby, too. yahira was an incredible host and was patient as well as accommodating when we had rough flight delays prior to checking in. highly recommend this airbnb!
great place! everything was so clean and cozy. very easy walk to the metro or to grab a bite in the morning.

excellent all around! the location is easily accessed by subways and buses, and it's a lovely neighborhood without being too busy. the place is incredibly clean and cozy, and supper charming. my son and i definitely loved this place, felt like home while boarding here. allen and ann are such outstanding hosts with warmth, helping with any questions and responding to messages fast. we will definitely return during our next trip to new york. you can't find anywhere else better than allan and ann's place!
we had a great stay! thank you!
perfect stay and perfect time we had in brooklyn.
very clean. plenty of space. lots of fans.

great communication. exactly like the pictures and description. thank you for a pleasant stay!

meghan was supernice, the apartment is in good style and the room is great. the location is superb with only a few minutes walk to the ferry. we had problems with check-in though. we came as announced but meghan didn't open the door. we couldn't contact her either, because we didn't have her mobile number and she didn't react to our mail. after more than one hour she finally opened the door. she apologized a lot, but still it is important to mention. we would still highly recommend staying here, as we felt very welcome and had a convenient stay.
best place at central manhattan. great location. very friendly and helpful host. i would recommend this place to everyone that plan to stay at new york.

if you’re visiting nyc or surrounding areas and don’t mind public transportation, you can’t go wrong staying here. room was awesome, cozy, right next to the apartment door and bathroom. corner store right next to the apartment which is very convenient. he really goes above and beyond to make sure the space is something special. the lighting was nice to adjust! shower clean, has shampoo & conditioner to use, as well as toothbrushes and pretty much anything you’ll be needing. cool little rooftop as well. ben was always very quick to respond to any problems, questions, or anything we needed. would recommend anyone to stay here!

i loved my quiet, very private room and bathroom, and also greatly enjoyed hanging out with the hosts (and their wonderful dog) in the morning before i headed off to my nyc day. the neighborhood is a joy to wander, with lots of options for food and drink, and plenty of good people-watching. and if you need to go elsewhere, mta stops are just a few minutes' walk away. pretty much perfect.
we stayed on the 11th floor in the room with the king bed. it was spacious, super clean, comfortable bed, had a great shower, and had a great view. very safe location for walking day and night.
i have been here several times. it always feels like home great host and great air b and b.

this is such an awesome place with wonderful skyline view! the host responded very quickly, and everything was easy to follow and understand. also, there are grocery and restaurants nearby that are very convenient! recommend to everyone!!!!!!!

we lived in this apartment as a studying couple for four months. there was enough space, especially the closet space is very large. the apartment is as beautiful as it looks on the photos. everything was very clean and the interior design is very thoughtful. the apartment had everything. we didn’t miss a single thing. the wi-fi is great and will allow you to study/work from home with your partner. also the neighbourhood is very nice: everything you need is in walking distance (bars, restaurants, supermarkets, laundromats etc). the only thing to be aware of is that the neighbourhood can be pretty busy, hence it was sometimes noisy due to traffic/people/bars etc. but we didn’t find that too disturbing. but most importantly: fenix‘s team, especially alexis and jay, we’re incredible. we could reach them literally 24/7 and would get an answer within an hour every time. they arranged help whenever we needed it within a very short time span. we recommend this apartment 10/10!
great apartment with wonderful kitchen, we cooked several times and had everything we needed. also ate out locally a couple of times and felt very much at home in the neighborhood.

ben was really responsive and accommodating as i booked the room quite last minute and arrived earlier then planned. ben's place is very homely and located in the heart of trendy williamsburg. bonus: if you need tips to explore the area and eat/drink/socialise like a true brooklynite, ben's your guy!

this is by far the best airbnb i have ever stayed at. the apartment is spacious and clean as a whistle, kay provides you with everything you could possibly need, the wifi works great, the location is ideal, the bed and pillows are super comfy... it's simply the best. for the cost, location, distance to public transit (train is half a block away... buses are even closer), cleanliness, ease of access, friendliness of host, and the fact that it's 420 friendly .. if you are considering staying at kay's loving home, do it. you will be so happy you did! i sure am.
expensive for low quantity stay.
room and bathroom were in clean condition. henry made sure to answer any of our questions either in person or via text. great location! so close to manhattan!
elizabeth was a great host! her home was more than what was expected and near the subway. the next time i’m in new york this will be our go-to place.
beverly was an accommodating host. the place was exactly as described in the listing will recommend it to others.
great place on a nice block, as described, and a very nice host. thank you for having me!

one night only is fine. for those on a very low budget… they are still a charitable organization and that’s wonderful.
wonderful property and awesome stay. this property was super clean and had absolutely everything anyone would ever need. this will be our go to stay when visiting brooklyn.
great deal for a clean place very close to la guardia! sweet and welcoming host!
it was amazing to stay with jenny, she is a great person and amazing host! ❤️

great spot as advertised. immaculate and just like photos. andrew and adriana are pros and kind people.

clean. it’s a small room. i’m 174cm and fits ok by a few cms for bed. otherwise can lie on your side. breakfast options are great. alex is very nice. luck of the draw if others make noise etc. i had a good experience, most ppl are understanding and quiet

this place is as clean as the pictures show on listing. nice location you just walk 2 mins and that is a subway (#7 train) station. i did not see any reason you do not like this place.

everything was exactly as described and the staff was amazing. william the front desk clerk was super friendly and accommodating! the views were beautiful and the food sold there was very good as well! i cannot wait to go back!

kaz and his team were very professional and on top of everything! the location was just a few blocks from two subway stations. pretty easy commute into manhattan, but it does take about 30-45 min total (including walking time) for your trip one way. getting to brooklyn is much longer. i would also recommend checking out flushing and/or forest hills for a concert while you're there. sunnyside had plenty of restaurants, shops, and there are grocery stores within a block. there is a donation based community book stand just one block away if you are looking for a book to read during your stay. laundry in the building was very convenient, but keep in mind you will need quarters. apartment was equipped with towels, and had a fully stocked kitchen (pots/pans/utensils/plates/cups/bowls/etc.). the couch in the living room can also be converted into another bed. by the way if you watch the movie "babes" with ilana glazer and michelle buteau, you'll catch this street in the final scene.
enjoyed our stay at sigfus. warm welcome, spacious room, cosy kitchen. very easy to reach with public transport.

the apartment is very clean and it looks just like the photos, it´s near to the queen´s center mall and to the subway, sussie is very kind and polite and it´s always available¡¡ i truly recomend this place¡¡

just the perfect place, simple check in, beautiful, and the host was super kind and came in from brooklyn just to turn the ac on for us. we loved it here

during my stay i was pretty much gone the whole day but my time in was great! marcus is very communicative and easy going. the room itself is very unique and i loved the amount of local information provided. i found myself in prospect park most of the time which is just a short walk away. all around a perfect place to explore brooklyn from.

kaitlyn is such a wonderful host. she's thought of everything, is easy to get in touch with, and lives in a beautiful apartment! it was great to have such an approachable host to advise me on how to plan out local coffee and snack trips. the apartment is clean, beautiful, and bright. i enjoyed my little room and deeply appreciated the air conditioner in my window - a must in any nyc apartment. i had a lovely time, and i recommend kaitlyn's place to anyone who needs a nice place to stay in a cool part of town.

elizabeth’s apartment is excellent. the bed is very comfortable and the bathroom was clean and had all the needed amenities included soft towels. i would highly recommend staying here if you are looking for a conveniently located home in manhattan.

i was so so happy with our stay! it almost felt too good to be true, the hotel room was perfect and the view was out of this world 🤩 check in and out was super easy, they even had a spot to hold your bags which was very helpful. host was always responsive and helpful

everything that was posted about it was pretty accurate. echoing what other reviews have said, when people push the intercom thing at night it is insanely loud and can be annoying, but only happened about 3 times during our 2 month stay. the smaller bedroom is reallyyy small. the whole visit we didn’t have any problems with bugs, appliances, or too much at all. just please please don’t forget your keys in the apt as if you do you’ll need to have $75 of cash handy. the proximity to the 6 train is so amazing (literally outside the door), especially late at night when you don’t wanna be walking around too much. proximity to central park is also superb for runs/walks/chilling in the park.
beautiful stylish apartment steps away from brooklyn museum, library and boranical garden. amazing spot!
convenient location. great daylight from the windows. clean apartment. we enjoyed our two-month stay.

this listing is everything that it claims to be and more, i would certainly go back. the room is very nice and private with a tv, ac, and an attached clean bathroom. the common area with the kitchen is quiet enough to get some serious work done and also cozy to relax with a cup of tea. i was able to find parking within a few yards from the stay, the neighborhood is okay.

our stay with moying was fabulous! we felt right at home and moying was such an accommodating and friendly host. this was our first airbnb stay in a “shared living space” and with a host like moying we would be more than happy to do so again. the listing is exactly as described and photographed, and moying is a very respectful host and gives you your privacy as required. the apartment was well connected for us spending time in both brooklyn and manhattan, and there were great restaurants in nearby nolita. thanks moying!!
great place and looks exactly as the picture!

i had an amazing time staying at michael's place (9 nights). he was extremely friendly and helpful (even when i forgot my keys inside in the middle of the night.. hih!). place was located right by the subway and bus stops and it was clean and quiet, just like in the pictures michael provided water, snacks, fruits and everything what you could hope. you can´t find better host than michael :)

a well-decorated and clean space located conveniently close to jfk. we were pleasantly surprised to find that the space was fully furnished and even stocked with snacks and breakfast items making it an actual bed and breakfast. this was super convenient especially after having returned from overseas exhausted with both our sleep and eating cycles all over the place. we were very grateful for the water and fresh milk provided for our coffee and breakfast. thank you for the extra forethought that was put into our stay!
the place was actually nice walking distance to little stores in the area and food places subway right up the side walk i would actually book again!
marialuisa's place is gorgeous, and her communication was fantastic. we're excited to make another trip to brooklyn soon!

jennifer is quite an attentive host who ensures that your needs are met. the words comfort and tranquility come to mind when you occupy the space. the environs is set up just for you. within minutes of walking distance you can get any and everything, just name it. all you have to do with jennifer's place is to bring yourself. it's a place waiting to spoil you.
amazing! will stay again!

i thoroughly enjoyed my stay at dj's place. we fit eight people pretty comfortably. location is fairly convenient to manhattan, and dj came to check in on us a couple times, which was much appreciated. all the amenities were great, including the ac, which was key because it was so hot in nyc that weekend. overall, just a fantastic experience and could not recommend this place enough.
great spot! comfy bed and amazing shower!
christian’s place was an excellent choice for our short night stay in new york. the space was super clean and everything was as described! really enjoyed our time there!

o.d. was an incredible host--from check-in instructions to making sure the place is well stocked with supplies and amenities. his place was so lovely, clean, and updated. the location was also super convenient and close to the subway. it was the perfect stay for my work trip. i will definitely come back to this airbnb again the next time i come to nyc.

we had a wonderful stay at jason’s place! our flight was delayed and we weren’t able to check in until 4am. the instructions were very clear and jason was wonderful to check in and make sure all went well! the beds were comfortable and everything was very clean. the subway was just two blocks away. several nights in a row we didn’t get back from the city until midnight and we felt completely safe walking from the subway to jason’s place! jason was fantastic and easy to work with! i highly recommend and would stay at one of his places again!
near transportation very convinient
loved the place, jacqueline was very helpful and responsive. the place was comfortable and clean. it was close to the airport and manhattan. will stay there again!

i enjoyed my stay. jeannelle was helpful and responsive to any questions or concerns. she also provided great tips on local restraunts and entertainment. the place was nice, clean, and convenient to the city's transportation.
great value for nyc. good location. host is responsive and helpful.
perfect stay. clean, comfortable great location, fancy amenities. smart, thoughtful use of the space.

hoi is a lovely host. very kind, responsive, and helpful. place is clean and felt very cozy with a comfortable bed and clean bathroom. location is nice with restaurants nearby. would absolutely recommend!
zhiqin and rob are lovely hostess and the house is really great and absolutely clean!

this place is a gem! so so clean and cute with all you need to feel right at home with special touches like snacks, travel toothpaste and a projector with appletv. i wanted to stay near a friend and this hit the spot. very walkable, close to the metro and a quiet neighborhood. plus the price is right.
good location, decent rooms. wished the balcony attached to our room was cleaner without any trash.

our stay at asad's apt was great. the directions for check-in were very clear and we felt very safe and secure with the way it was set up. everything was easy to find and it was the perfect spot for what we needed - a clean, simple place that was as close as possible to the lga airport. would definitely recommend!
tim’s place was an awesome stay. he’s a wonderful host and extremely resourceful if your new to the city or area!
quiet and comfortable place to stay at. spacious bedroom and living room. very clean apartment. definitely recommend it.
great stay, love the location, communicative hosts - would stay again!!

i had a wonderful time at this accommodation. i felt right at home when i arrived for the first time. i was allowed to leave my luggage before check in and after my check it and i comfortably explored the city knowing my luggage was in good hands. i will be staying with them again.

fernando’s place was awesome! it was so clean, which was really nice for us! they had a crib for our toddler, which was awesome! the snacks and freebies were so great to have too!! would 100% recommend!

awesome stay in brooklyn! we rented a room but basically had the entire first floor to ourselves, including the kitchen, which made it feel incredibly spacious and private. the place was clean, and surprisingly peaceful for the city that never sleeps. the location is great- close to shops, transit, and all the brooklyn charm. gil was very responsive- we're convinced he operates on brooklyn time, which apparently means no sleep- any questions or last- minute needs were handled instantly. highly recommend for anyone visiting the area!

we stayed for 3 nights. we apprciated nicole opening her home to us. it was very clean. once i reached out for check-in instructions, they were very easy to follow. we had issues with the tv the second night and didn't hear back from nicole so we weren't able to watch tv once we got back to the airbnb for the night but not a big deal. unfortunately the bed was very uncomfortable. it was extremely lumpy and i had to sleep in a very specific way to avoid hard spots. the biggest reason we booked this spot was just to sleep, since we were out exploring the whole day. the bed was a really big bummer. enjoyed the rest of the stay.

the place is very nice, especially for groups of 5-6 people! everyone slept comfortably, the airbnb is close to the subway station, good restaurants, and grocery stores. we stayed here during the nyc heat wave, so the window ac units were a lifesaver! there was one miscommunication about the door code, but lorna was very professional and helped handle that.

curlene‘s appartement was very cute and cozy. everything was super clean. as a host curlene took care of everything and was so nice. if we had a question she was always there to help us. overall we had a very pleasant stay in nyc! :)
very clean comfy beds and a big common area!
great place! host was quick to respond!

this studio was ideally located to the schomburg, where i was working for the week. christina was responsive, even while traveling, with my entering her home. if you need a centrally located place in harlem, this studio is ideal.
had a great stay. thanks 🙌🏽
really great stay. :)

michelle’s place is immaculate! from the cleanliness to her own personal style, i was in love with her space. she gave me helpful tips in navigating my way around the city. she was so prompt in her replies too. i was there for a wedding so we barely ran into each other but it was nice to come back to an inviting place. the bed was so comfortable! i would stay here again if i had the opportunity.
great value, close to the grand central station so you can go anywhere you’d like with ease. very comfortable stay as well

samaa is a wonderful host. the place is in a great location, fully furnished, and very cozy. we felt very welcome and will definitely stay at samaa's place again if the opportunity comes. without a doubt, the best airbnb experience i had so far.
great area for cafés and food, guests were respectful, and friendly hosts! will def come back again ᵕ̈

really appreciated both richard and his concierge, joey. super helpful and accommodating. and the house is great. we loved it! super neighborhood

great location. surrounded by places to go grab coffee, restaurants, for drinks and nightlife. also local stores and plenty of options to go shopping if you feel the need. walkable distance from soho and other touristic zones. most subway stations within 5 blocks. she mentions the steep stairs to the bedroom. it just takes some getting used to. worked from there most of the time with reliable wifi and great conditions as it is quiet. take advantage of the terrific private patio. loved my stay there
very tidy place with easy access to public transportation, will visit again!

great host, great location and a comfy bed! always a wonderful stay. can’t wait to come back!
great stay, very nice place. responsive host.

my gf and i were in town for a show, and yvette’s place proved to be the best value and location for us. her place is easy to get to by subway, and is in a very walkable neighborhood. our room had to be arranged due to unexpected changes, but yvette worked with us to find a solution, and even ungraded our room. she is an excellent host, with great communication, and plenty of recommendations. i will definitely keep her place on my list for places to stay in nyc.
dynamite spot in a dynamite location. couldn't have been better for us.

i really enjoyed the stay, very quiet n peaceful. i was able to rest after my trip back to n.y., the home was beautiful n lovely. i would truly come again. when i do come back to n.y. to visit, i'll check to see if they are available. great host!
this was a great house for a weekend get away! affordable lyft into forest hills and the metro is near as well! loved having a gas stove to cook on! clean and comfortable.

vanessa is a great host and always kept a friendly and solution oriented communication. it was very nice to be able to rely on a host in a safe way and quite rare on this platform to be honest. nevertheless, altho the space is comfortable, it does need quite a lot of maintenance but apparently the listing is new and vanessa is always reactive and willing to improve. neighbors are friendly and the neighborhood is very pleasant and quiet, specially if you have a bike like i did, in the summer. the kitchen is super comfortable to use and the shower was great - also a rarity on this platform. overall, i would gladly be back considering the good nature of the host and the comfort of the space. thank you vanessa!

had a great weekend staying at boris’s place. good location with good food in the surrounding area. apartment is clean and very spacious and well set up. boris was a gracious host leaving a bottle of wine for us and drinks in the fridge. the bathroom was absolutely beautiful. would definitely stay there again

the apartment was beautifully decorated and had everything we needed for our two night stay. the beds were comfortable in both bedrooms. perfect location, close to restaurants, subway access, prospect park/zoo, yet quiet at night. mia was very responsive and made check-in smooth. i would recommend this place.
great location and views off of balcony and rooftop were amazing. bed was very comfy! we didn't like the shade situation... or lack there of in the bedroom however.
lovely space, great communication, super helpful, awesome location
great experience and stay! phenomenal location and well-described. planning on staying again — thanks for everything!
very good communication from the host! if we had a problem, she would come down asap to fix it. we had a very pleasurable stay!
we really enjoyed staying at jason's place. it was cozy and very comfortable, and the location was great. jason was so helpful as a host and made our stay very easy!
amazing location, super convenient and easy to access. accommodations were great for a very short term stay.
close to the jfk airport. comfortable place, has everything we needed. shirley was constant communication with us, providing us with helpful information. thanks
cherry was an exceptionally nice host and the place was great.
everything was perfect. it was a pleasure to stay at sucong‘s place. i‘d go there again.
excellent location and beautiful neighborhood!
loved it here everyone was super helpful and nice!!!
a relaxing stay in a beautiful home at a very convenient location. greg and his family were great hosts, and they and cody (their friendly cat) made our week in nyc an enjoyable one.
great place, close to airport!🥰

my friends and i had a great stay at rafael and stephen’s place. the place is very close to the “a” train (about a 5 min walk) and also very close to jfk airport (10 min drive). the overall commute to times square/port authority station is about 40-ish min for reference. overall, our stay was great! the room was basically a 1 bedroom apartment. both beds were very comfortable, even the sofa bed. the hosts thoughtfully provided basically everything to make our stay fantastic. when we needed something, such as toilet paper, they were also quick to respond and fulfill requests. i would say the only thing is to be aware that the room is on the second floor. otherwise, i would totally recommend staying here.

great stay at minerva’s lovely apartment - second time i’ve come back and feels like a home away from home. minerva is a super responsive and attentive host and the apartment is a perfect place for a long stay.
fantastic place to stay! excellent hosts, super friendly, everything was as expected or better.

this was a great property & carolyn and her team were wonderful to work with. there was a change on plans toward the end of the original departure date & we were able to add on 3 additional nights with appropriate per night fees. thanks for everything during the recent stay.
prime location for touring nyc. place was clean and well maintained. reasonably priced. host was very welcoming. would stay again.
nice location with all the comforts of home. will definitely stay there again!
cool lil rest area in a good area if you like to explore the city home was very beautiful and peaceful
i had a great stay!
great location. close to metro, grocery, restaurants.. we had all we needed!
beautiful place and great location. very clean, comfy beds and amazing backyard space. would definitely book again.

the room itself was nice, but i'm not sure about the location - i was attacked near the subway one night. someone yelled at me and ran up to me and kicked me in the back. probably a rare occurrence though.

we had a months stay at this lovely airbnb. it was wonderful to have a place ready to move into with extras like tissues, and food stocks. we appreciated the abundance of towels, like-new comforter and shower curtain. the apartment is bright and cheery and was truly a home away from home for us. the location is perfect, in a family oriented neighborhood. a short walking distance to everything is an added bonus!
best airbnb i have ever stayed in. exceptionally clean and well appointed. a great value for ny and i will definitely rent again when i go to ny.

dwain’s place was wonderful. the apartment is even nicer than it looks in the pictures! he was a great host and was very accommodating with letting us check in early and even had cones out front to save us a parking spot right in front of the building! it smelled fresh and clean and felt so cozy. and it was a great deal for the amount of bedrooms, bathrooms, & space you’re getting! the only small negative that had nothing to do with dwain or the apartment, we specifically booked this place because of how close it was to a train station and the train wasn’t running the weekend we were there. we have a better understanding of the subway systems now and will definitely be checking for scheduled maintenance in the future. we would absolutely stay here again!
gordon is very nice and super laid back. he's great at communicating and has a lovely home for anyone staying for a weekend in brooklyn!
prince was a great host. the apt was super clean, the room was just like you see it on the pictures. the bed was very comfortable. i highly recommend staying here.
the place was so cute in the perfect location. so close to the subway as well as a lot of bodegas and late night food!

yuval was a really kind host, room was clean and the overall experience was amazing! i lost the keys and bothered him 3 at night on a weekend, but he showed up and helped me get in to the building, i will definitely remember the hospitality and positive attitude. all the best yuval, you're a wonderful person!
great spot to stay in nyc. lots of great places around and it’s super easy to commute through manhattan. apartment is clean and spacious, we had everything we needed

considering the city limits and great location it was worth it. but compared to comfort space and basic reception and phone service was desirable.. but i guess that’s the norm of hotels 🏨 in manhattan at that value i guess. thanks
for the price for the location very goood

we spent 5 weeks in the apartment, everything was good. the apartment is very nice, modern and clean, more beautiful than in the photos. beds are very comfortable. the host was very friendly and helpful. check in was easy and checking out was easy. the metro (2,3 and 4,5,6) is located a few minutes from the apartment. calm neighborhood. there are several shops and restaurants. it is about a 20-minute walk to the central park.

had a great stay, place was as advertised. was actually next to my old junior high school which brought back memories for me. place was clean and the ac was great during the heatwave there was during my stay. transportation wasn't a big deal for me since i drive. but there's a bus near by and trains a couple blocks away in about 3 directions
excellent stay, would definitely recommend!
excellent host, very convenient and very accommodating.
we had a great time, the flat was very well equipped, 5 min walk from subway. thank you!

the rate you get is great and asad is an outstanding host who is always quick to respond and available almost all hours of the day. it’s literally in walking distance from rental car places and the airport. however, the airbnb was a lot less pleasant than the pics entailed and it is very small. i was hitting my head in both bathrooms and am not tall whatsoever. it was also quite dirty where me and my family had to organize and clean up certain parts to feel comfortable.
i appreciate what you done, if offer the pick up and transfer service on the airport, that will wonderful.

this is my second time staying at this property and boy was i happy, the location is great, the host is great and easy to communicate with, i stayed in a smaller room this time but it was by choice, very nice airbnb, highly recommend, going to book soon again

nice and simple place for a few days stay, good amount of space and facilities for us and our baby. easy enough to get to the city, neighbourhood has good access to laundromat, grocery store etc. wayne and tinisha were good at communicating with us.
we had a very nice stay. pictures match the place and it was very clean. definitely recommend.
looking forward to staying here again! perfect location, beautiful view, super clean, spacious, comfortable main bed, super walkable to so much!

diego & saya's garden apartment was just like the pictures. it was easily accessible from the airport, and check in was a breeze. it is a spacious and private floor in their townhome. the subway was only two blocks from our doorstep making our trips to all the nyc sites quick and easy. saya & diego were better than any hotel staff with their hospitality and advice. we also had some of diego's bbq, which is competition grade yummy! the neighborhood is a vibrant mix of people with lots to see and eat in the immediate vicinity. looking forward to our next visit!
really cool hotel in soho
no complaints, beautiful upper east side neighborhood, super convenient laundromat on first floor, close to subways

was such a great place to stay for my first time in ny! it was a quick walk to the train station which was helpful and had lots of food markets in the area as well. the room was enough space for me and my 2 other friends.

gina was incredibly accommodating and communicative from the get-go. she checked in with us multiple times before the trip just confirm our check in and was flexible when we had changes. her apartment was cozy and just as advertised - a great little spot in our old neighborhood with a great set up for a studio! she made sure we were all set up in the apt and the neigjbirhood. couldn't ask for a better host!

this spot was perfect for me and my partner. it was affordable, had everything we needed, very close to public transportation, and we had a wide variety of food to choose from since this spot is located in chinatown but is walking distance to little italy, the east village, and so much more! not to mention house keeping stayed on top of it, the front desk was very attentive, and the hotel has complimentary breakfast! 10/10.
great location, perfect for a stay in the city. clean and comfortable, would definitely recommend.
great location for a great price!

i spent 5 weeks at shijia's place during june and july and really enjoyed it. would rebook! lots of great restaurants, bars, clubs nearby. tons of nightlife but also very neighborhood-y! loved how they would close part of troutman on the weekends for live concerts or other performances. lots of grocery options within 1-2 blocks. jefferson "l" station is ~10 min walk for easy access to manhattan. the "m" is not too much farther. the apartment is just as nice as it looks in pictures. having laundry in-unit was so nice, not to be underestimated if you're staying longterm in nyc! my favorite part was the back balcony. wonderful little oasis. ac units held up great during the heat wave that came through town. lots of space to work from home. internet was reliable and fast.

super nice place to stay. the rooms is exactly as described, super quiet, clean and kept us nice and warm. not too far from the subway too. check in was super easy, i had no issues arriving at 11pm to check in. the area feels very safe and has very cute interesting bars and restaurants right near by. i would definitely recommend this airbnb for anyone who needs to stay in the area.

honestly exceeded my expectations! ron is super personable and proactive in answering all questions. he really went above and beyond to make his guests feel welcome. room was luxurious with nice sheets and supportive pillows – dreamy! location is not too far from the l train, making trips into manhattan convenient and easy. the location is also super quiet and peaceful, a great place to relax after running around all day. thank you so much! i'll definitely look into booking here again during my next visit.

i don't like to put bad reviews for anyone but i don't want someone else will go through what i went through. she is the worst host any person can imagine. may god give her some wisdom to be polite, non discriminatory, non racist and non egoistic.

second time attending this location. i always have a great experience staying at this location hence the reason why when i am in the area i choose to this at the location. thank you again for your service.
i stayed with my 2 grandchildren, ages 12/15, great place, near public transit. highly recommend!

check in was easy, unit clean, the location was practically impossible to beat for the price. the host was also super accommodating with extending my stay last minute after my flight was cancelled due to a blizzard.
the room was short on amenities, but spacious. the hotel itself is in a great location, and the price was very good given the location.

place was clean and neighborhood was pretty safe. it’s right next to a police station so it can get noisy with cars passing by. the only thing was the building is kind of old and going up the stairs was worrying. host is nice and responsive so don’t hesitate to reach out if you need anything.

i cannot say enough about what a gem this listing is. right in the heart of prospect heights and on the cusp of crown heights, this gorgeous, true one bedroom with a private entrance sits on a perfect treelined street. it is beyond clean, a large space, with modern appliances, big windows and a lot of natural light. the hosts are gracious and responsive. i highly recommend this for your next bk stay.
super convenient location fir the g train, right on the same block.

ray and harriet are excellent hosts! they respond to any requests or concerns very quickly. the location, amenities and space are very convenient and comfortable for a lengthy stay with a large group.

my stay in the house was absolutely brilliant and elena was an amazing host. it was an incredible experience that i would recommend to everybody interested in visiting ny. the house was perfectly clean and very comfortable.
clean well furnished unit. great neighborhood with shops and coffee places. nice backyard. easy entrance and exit
it's a wondeful stay! we live here about 20 days, queen give us many help! she is a nice host, we will return next time.

i loved staying in this beautiful apartment in the upper east side of new york city. it is a 10-minute walk to 5th avenue and central park, and along the way, you'll find the best coffee shops and restaurants. there are nearby dance clubs and comedy clubs. the apartment is always maintained spotless, with all the things you need to cook at home if you choose. the 24/7 concierge made me feel that there was always someone available if i needed it, which is great as a female traveling alone in a big city. there is a code for the apartment building, the apartment, and my room, which provides triple protection and makes me feel safer. my room was incredibly comfortable and quiet, featuring a desk and excellent wi-fi, allowing me to work remotely. i was planning on staying one month, but since it was such a great apartment and location, i extended for an additional month. i am definitely staying here again next time i come to the city.
i enjoyed meeting daniel and staying at his place . he was a gracious host and i would recommend his place to others.
everything as described, works well for a short stay in manhattan
great guy great host. no problems at all
it was a great place to stay in.

it was wonderful to have a spacious space to come back to after our daily adventures in the city! the space was spotless! beds and furniture were comfy. we didn't cook much, but had breakfast almost every day there which saved time and money! the kitchen was stocked with everything we needed except the food, which was easy to pick up at the grocery store that is only an 8-minute walk away. wifi worked great and having netflix was a wonderful perk. the subway is only a 5-minute walk and you can get anywhere you want to go. rebekah was a wonderful host. she was very communicative and responded very quickly from the time we booked to the day we left. check in was super easy and there was a place to store our luggage for a few hours before our flight back home. overall, really great experience!
we loved staying here- if you are looking for a different area to manhattan with a beautiful and historical home this is it! loved it- thank you for sharing it x

we had such a good time at maurice's. he was very helpful in finding local delis and even escorted us down to,it. the apartment was clean and anything we needed he took care of. we would defiantly visit again.

the bed sheet wasn't exactly clean for the first night i arrived, but they seemed to clean it/change it the second day. besides that, everything was great. the noise was a bit much but it's understandable regarding the great location, just need to get used to it. the staff is amazing, super helpful and friendly, highly recommend if need kitchen and in unit laundry at an awesome location!

great place to stay. looks exactly like the pictures. had a very warming environment. hans catered to our request of dropping by early seen as we had arrived early, great location if you’re wanting to get away from the rush of the big city, but is only a short ferry ride away (which is free). there is several buses to the ferry port - but we enjoyed the 30min walk into the centre. not the place if you don’t like cats or stairs.
great place and privacy

genuinely enjoyed my stay at mark's apartment! the place was comfortable and made our trip in nyc so easy. great location, safe environment, friendly neighbourhood and within close proximity to a lot of various cafés, diners and grocery stores. love that it's also within walking distance to the subway, central park,the met and other places of interest! mark was also a responsive host and was always prompt in answering any queries we had during our stay in ny. thanks for having us mark ! :))

my stay at eric's was perfect. the apt was very clean and set up nicely for both work and comfort. the neighborhood is quiet and convenient to great local food and stores. eric met me at check-in and went out of his way to ensure my stay was a pleasant one. i highly recommend both eric and his apartment for anyone traveling to the city!
great place to stay
hugo went above and beyond in accommodating us. a wonderful host of a beautiful apartment. we loved our stay, and will definitely look hugo up when we return to the city
pretty neat place. only issue is parking and the people upstairs are noisy.

we loved our stay at carlo’s place! the apartment was in the perfect location. tons of great restaurants, bars, and activities nearby. super walkable in terms of getting to other boroughs like east village, west village, and soho. it was the perfect spot for a month long stay!

from the moment i booked this place i knew it was a gem from the interactions i had with carlyn. she is the most organized and detail oriented host that i have encountered to date. the apt. is phenomenal. super clean, spacious, trendy, modern and ultra comfy. our room was huge, with beautiful big windows, clean and comfy sheets and pillows. our bathroom was great and we loved having access to the kitchen for before dinner drinks and snacks. the locations is fantastic. we drove from canada and there was plenty of street parking plus the subway is literally a minute away - bonus! the housemates were really social and made us feel at home, giving us tips and helping us with any questions we had during our stay. all and all this place is a true gem! we will probably come more often just because this apt. is just that fantastic!
it is not bad to stay at merle s

we stayed at this beautiful home this past weekend and it is amazing. modern and very clean. it is stocked with everything that you could possible need. it is located right across the street from prospect park which is so beautiful. so much to do there. they have roller skating, kayaking, paddle boats, water part and many other fun things to do. i actually picked this place as our son was married at the boathouse in the park and we are so glad that we did. lots of good restaurants in the neighborhood. do not hesitate if you are thinking of staying here as you will enjoy it as much as we have!!!
i had a very nice stay. elke and andrei were great hosts. the room with private bath is great!
alex’s place was as described on the photos. the place was very cleaned, organized, extremely close to many local restaurants and shops. the neighborhood was very nice and secure.
elizabeth is a great host, and the apartment is clean, spacious, and welcoming. i highly recommend it for your next stay! :)
if you want to contact the host, they will reply anytime! even if you want to stay for a long time, it is very convenient and safe. the host is very nice and helpful.
excellent location, very pleasant staff and extremely good value. some of the decor could be updated as it’s a bit tired but very comfortable bed and decent extras like breakfast and hot beverages
mary was very responsive at all times and made it easy to check-in. the apartment has great light and it’s in a terrific location very close to many amenities, the subway and prospect park.

this is a beautiful apartment very well located for visiting the city and the rest of brooklyn. it's less than a 5 minute walk to the subway station which brings you into manhattan in 15 minutes. norga gave us a lovely welcome and was very much available during our stay if we had any requests. the bed was super super comfortable and the apartment was excellently stocked with towels, water, juice. we had a brilliant stay at norga's apartment.

very great host. she wasn’t around, so we had the place to ourselves. her apartment was in a great location in manhattan. eastern east village and there were a lot of cute restaurants and bars every block. her bed was incredibly comfortable and having the complimentary snacks was outstanding. will plan on staying again in the future!

the house is fantastic, 7 of us stayed there, lots of room to be together and also apart. great views of nyc. the bus stops are really close for getting to the ferry and the drop off is literally outside the house. there are local shops for day to day stuff and found the food delivery in the area great if you need it. absolutely recommend arkady, he was always available to answer questions, helpful and courteous at all times.
definitely recommend staying here, host is friendly and helpful. place is small and clean.

i highly recommend johnny's home. he is such a great host and his home is perfect.the place which is super clean, spacious offers five star hotel experience to you. if you're on your way to new york i'd recommend staying at johnny's home.

this was a great little space in a wonderful area! it was clean and quiet. marie-line respected our privacy but was available for anything we needed. the subway was a short walk as were many restaurants and markets. we fell in love with park slope and hope to visit again sometime soon!

rodolfo is a great host, who it was easy to communicate with. the place was really clean, we appreciated to have a parking spot and there were great attentions. but we had a hard time finding restaurants and bars from a reasonable walk time. we wanted to spend time in brooklyn, but we were far away from great spots.

the photos of this place do not do it justice. the layout is perfect, the restoration is done beautifully and for someone who is ocd the apartment was spotlessly clean. we loved our stay at lory and cindy’s place. they were both such lovely hosts and we had a great couple of chats with them. they were so respectful of our space and were so quiet and accommodating. the bath products provided were lovely to use. there were eggs in the fridge and a great supply of condiments. the bed was very comfortable. the subway was close and easily accessible. there was ample linen and all the necessities provided. we cannot recommend this place enough! stay here for your nyc visit!!!!
location! location! location! fantastic place to stay & explore times square!!!!
