madison's apartment was perfect! we love how it was decorated. it was well equipped and super clean! unfortunately we didn't have the chance to meet madison but her husband welcomed us instead. communication was easy and everything worked out well. we enjoyed our stay very much. only the neighborhood didn't offer much but the j train brought us directly to manhattan and williamsburg rather quickly.

my first trip to new york was one made even better by the hospitality of christa and zach! although we didn't see each other much during my stay, it felt like i was coming 'home' each night after a long day exploring the city. their home is adorably quaint and their furry kids sure know how to make their guests feel loved. thank you, zach and christa, for opening up your home! i can't wait to stay with you again! :)
a great experience, lovely spot, and awesome location (a bit of a touristy street.) the roof deck was amazing.
we really enjoyed our stay. the host was extremely friendly and responsive. the apartment was clean and beautiful. great stay in a great location :)

we loved our stay at karter's apartment! we had 4 adults and there was space to spread out without feeling cramped. there's a nice kitchen with lots of cooking tools (utensils, coffee pot, silverware, pots & pans). there is a lot of street noise, but that's the vibe of the neighborhood! such a fun place to stay with easy access to multiple subway lines and tons of great restaurants, coffee, and culture.

absolute perfect location. right in the middle of everything like the subways, and soho. great neighborhood, beautiful scenery with street art. hotel was spotless and loved self check in. would highly recommend to anyone wanting to travel around in the city.

beware ⚠️ although the hotel is cute and trendy, they run a full blown night club on the first floor. music was so loud in our room that we couldn’t hear our tv (rm 327) bass thumping and vibrating our bed until around 3am. not to mention the foot traffic it draws to the lobby, there was a line out the door and young drunk kids stumbling about in the main lobby.

i stayed with ampere for two months, and it was a very pleasant time! ampere is always attentive to your needs and even sometimes prepares meals for everyone in the house. :) the location was excellent for exploring the city, the m train station is right on the corner. i would definitely stay here again!
very nice apartment. good location.

my friend and me stayed for 5 days at cristina's place. she is a welcoming host and even if she was not at the appartment during most of our stay, due to a trip, she was always e-mailing us to check everything was going well and if we were enjoying a good stay. the loft is very nice, very confortable and very, very clean. the building has a terrace in the roof with amazing views of manhattan skyline. the appartment is 5 minutes walk to metro station and just one stop far to manhattan union square station. the neighborhood - williamsburg - is amazing full of young - and trendy - people, and with a good bunch of good and cosy restaurants for breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner or a drink.. we tried several, and all of them were really good, with different type of cuisine. we recommend cristina's place and williamsburg neighborhood.

this is the second time we've stayed here, the first on a higher floor with a terrace and view and the second in this smaller lower-floor room. the location (for us, at least) is fantastic, and the rooms are comfortable and clean. they added a little coffee shop on the first floor between last year and this year, which is really nice. i would recommend this property for young people and people who think young. it's hip and usable, and you get what they advertised. i would not recommend it to people who want a high degree of luxury or a full-service hotel, but that's not what they advertise themselves as. also, i'll pay extra for a higher floor with a view and a terrace in the future. this time, i decided to save a little money and book the lower floor. the room was fine, clean, and worth what they charged, but there's a reason it's cheaper. the room was smaller and less fun than the rooms on the higher floors that have a terrace and a view.

gayla was a wonderful host! the place was as great as expected with enough space for two couples who were spending some evenings in and working from the apartment during the day. the area is amazing with tons of great places to eat and nice people all around. it is a bit of a walk to the nearest subway, but there are buses and citi bikes around the corner, if that is more your speed. and the home theater was an amazing addition! we watched an action movie and got a full cinematic experience.
great property and would definitely stay here again! adam was very responsive to questions and small issues.
this was a nice stay and i would book again here. the staff was nice.

sam’s place is just as described. a spotlessly clean, family home, decorated with real love and soul in a traditional nyc walkup pre war apartment. perfect for us as we are a couple traveling with our toddler, they had all the things we needed including a crib, books and toys. sam was great communication wise and left breakfast for our arrival.
lovely place and daisy is an amazing lady !

this is place is everything! all the things you want your airbnb to be: cozy, comfortable and an amazing host. plenty of room, beds and sofas are cozy, tvs work with tons of options, super clean, all things you need in a home and for the beach. yeah, the beach! it's just up the block! bobby and holly have helped with plenty of stuff for you use: chairs, toys, umbrellas, the lot. and bobby and holly couldn't be nicer. they're always up to help with recommendations on where to eat or get the things you need. great location, close to tons of things. and remember, it's still the city, so you can order anything to be delivered! it's great!
the perfect place to visit on your first stay in nyc, perfect location and easy access to check in.
good spot for 2 people- close to morningside park. a/c works great. short walk to metro. tom was helpful.

this place looks even better in person! well stocked and comfortable for a long stay. a lot of space for a two bedroom. luwam is a fabulous host and very responsive if you have any needs throughout your stay.
i would definitely recommend jackeline and her apartment...
great place great host would stay again

living in allen&sandy's house was an unforgettable experience to me. the first impression this house took to me was, it was so clean and warm! also, allen and sandy provided me lots of help which made me feel like living in my house. it is really great and i am hoping for another chance to live there!

we absolutely loved our stay here!! so clean and comfortable with a spacious layout for nyc staying. great location and neighborhood!! a short walk right to brooklyn bridge park and your choice of plenty of restaurants. we will definitely stay here again!

staying at shelley’s place was totally amazing. beautiful building, street, great location (bedstuy vibes!) - literally 6 mins of walk to subway. kitchen with all its amenities lets you prepare all food that you want. place is very comfy for 4 people, great relax after each looong day in ny. shelley was very helpful and nice to us. :) highly recommended, wish to come back again!

third floor means just two stairs up, close to subway, about 10 minutes walk (normal/slow), very clean, bright apartment and high lumens bulbs in every space, look like new renovated apartment, very comfortable.

the apartment was extremely clean, beautifully laid out. nice and cozy size rooms, spacious kitchen and bathroom. wi-fi and tv was available. there was free parking in the front (always)and private parking in the back. finally, the host was out of town and left us with a trusted colleague by the name of joseph who was polite and very helpful. if you love privacy, then this is definitely the place for you. big enough space for a family of 4/5. love the place, would definitely stay again. thank you 😊
the team at maison bella were very responsive and helpful! the place itself was very clean and located in a super convenient part of ny. i’d stay here again!

jennifer is an awesome host and amazing human being! her home is beautiful and cozy. my partner and i felt right at home. this review wouldn’t be complete if i didn’t give a shout out to oswald the dog. he’s such a good boy.
it was a pleasure to stay at ayana’s place.
nice and simple, friendly host, great value.
great place! very modern and clean. easy check in and out.

perfect spot, perfect neighbourhood, amazing raw vegan food across the road at grassroots. great clean sizeable room and bathroom. right next to l-train stop to head into manhattan if you desire leaving brooklyn

victor's apartment is in a great position, lots of great restaurants and bars, and easy access to the subway. victor is very proactive, quickly replying to messages. while we were there the weather became very hot and victor asked if we would like additional air conditioning installed, which he did. all essentials were provided in the apartment: olive oil, coffee, tea, soaps, slippers, towels, toothbrushes, toothpaste, washing up essentials, ear plugs, lots of toilet roll and a lovely bottle of wine. we did not need to shop for any essentials during our week staying there. the apartment was very clean, beds were clean and incredibly comfortable. the shower had plenty of hot water. victor met us on arrival and explained how everything worked and gave us some local recommendations. four of us stayed in the apartment and there was room to relax together. we have stayed in a lot of air bnb apartments around the world, this is at the top of the list for providing home from home amenities.

we truly enjoyed our stay here. the room was clean, tidy, well organized and felt more spacious than expected. i will say if you are traveling with a stroller just be aware that the elevator is a tight fit. the location was continently centered around good food, shopping and the subway is easily accessible. this was our first trip to the city and this room was perfect as we just mainly slept/rested here. we agonized over our choice when we first booked our room as we were so nervous but it truly was a perfect fit for our family. we truly loved our stay here and would definitely stay here again. thank you for such an awesome experience!

adeola was the best!!! i couldn’t ask for a better host. her hospitality and communication was second to none. the house was clean and spacious, everything you needed was provided. i would definitely recommend this place to anyone needing a space for a big family. she also assisted me and transportation and i’m very thankful, made my trip very easy thank you! 5 stars!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

great price for new york city with amazing customer service. every single staff member working the front desk was personable and helpful. the walking distance to multiple subway stations is great, as well as very close to classic sight seeing & beautiful rooftop restaurants and lounges. i would book this hotel again in a heartbeat!

we stayed in michael‘s apartment for two months. it is exactly as described and shown on the photos and great location. michael was an amazing host - he always responded very quickly and always asked if we needed anything. would definitely recommend to stay.

excellent stay in w harlem/morningside hts. lovely historic brownstone on tree lined streets. proximity to the a/c lines unbeatable. studio is well equipped with very basic kitchenette, and bathroom right outside the doors not an issue at all during my stay, merely a quirk of the historic building. quiet at night, plenty of local food options, and very near columbia. well worth the price for the area! a great stay. do bring your own toiletries as they are not provided.
cute little bedroom and living room in a pretty great location! the host gave my bf and i an amazing recommendation for a bar where we could watch soccer, it was the highlight of our trip!
tong and michael are very good hosts. everything is well organized. the room is spacious and well-equipped. i felt comfortable there.
we had a very pleasant stay at amy's. the flat is well equipped and perfectly clean. its location enabled us to visit the city very easily and to have long walks in central park.
such great hosts and a wonderful home, loved the holiday decor🎄

clean, easy to access apartment, in a convenient location! the radiator in the apartment could be a little noisy at times, and the bathroom was a bit colder than the rest of the apartment. all minor things, overall we had an enjoyable stay.

what a beautiful place to stay in brooklyn. it is exactly what you expect when you think about a typical new york apartment. monica was a perfect host. metro is close and the area is nice. we had a blast here and definitely we can recommend this place.

this place was nice and i felt safe as a solo traveler visiting family in downtown brooklyn. i appreciate the response time from the host and the restaurants that were around, which was very convenient!
this place feels like home.

king was a great host and a really nice guy. on the day of my arrival, he had plans, but put them on hold so he could welcome me and show me around the apartment. any time i had a question, he was more than happy to help me out. the room itself was very nice and clean. big, comfortable bed, air conditioning, refrigerator and cable tv were all really nice touches. the area the apartment is in is a residential area, but it is a short walk away from restaurants and stores and a short subway ride away from a big mall. overall, i had a great stay here. very highly recommended.
great place, fits the description

we had a quick over night visit to brooklyn and didn't get to take advantage of all the wonderful things to do so close to this apartment, but we would definitely return and stay here again. the apartment is located close to good restaurants and shops, with excellent dining options within a few block's walk (we had a delicious dinner at terre). it's a bustling area, so the side-street location was a real plus, especially at night when it really quieted down. the two bedrooms are at the back of the unit, away from the street, which makes for very quite sleeping. the unit is spacious, bright, clean and comfortable, with a full kitchen facing a courtyard and a nice size living room, dining room, and office (with exercise bike) on the street side of the building. matthew was a great host, responding quickly to our queries. it's clear he wants his guests to have an excellent stay!
maia was a very nice host. her place is clean and only three minutes by foot to the subway station. i enjoyed my stay so much. highly recommended.

jesse’s place was very clean and it is in a very good shape. everything worked perfectly and we had a great time staying there. unfortunately we didn’t meet jesse in person, because he was out of town but his instructions on how to enter the place were very clearly written and easy to understand. he also answered all our questions quickly and very friendly. the suggestion and information he has placed in the apartment were very helpful as well. the location of the apartment is a little far off. to get to lower or midtown manhattan takes about 30 - 40min. by subway, to brooklyn about 50-60 min. but there are several subway lines within a 10 min walk that take you directly to those locations. we never felt unsafe or got in any trouble in the harlem neighborhood even coming home late at night with the subway. the opposite is the case, it is a vibrant and diverse part of nyc. in total we had a great stay and would recommend this place anytime, also because of it’s great value.
sylvia’s home is amazing. very clean and was in a great location. was perfect for me and my family.
nice place good value for the money in the heart of a hispanic area of brooklyn right next to the l train plenty of room for two couples building was safe clean and secure
i enjoyed my stay here! very clean and homely
very good location and cute place to stay , friendly host and very clean , worth the value :)

had a wonderful 1 night stay. room- lovely very large clean room with kitchenette and seating area. very private (below host house). nice towels & very soft sheets. host- amazing. they went above and beyond to help me. i was a solo traveler arriving late at night after a long flight & was worried about walking alone with all my stuff after finding parking, so they kindly went out of their way to save me a spot. they also supplied me with snacks and hot tea. highly recommend!
place was great and just as advertised!! enjoyed our weekend very much!

the airbnb was perfect for what we needed. relatively close to times square and many other attractions. plenty of toiletries were left for us, the place was spotless and the host was responsive when we asked questions. would deffo come back!

we had a great stay at mia's beautiful home! loved the antique decor & good location for the subway. mia had left a thoughtful guide to the area, and we visited some of her restaurant recommendations.

this place is exactly as represented in listing. it is less than one block from subway station which is great. very clean, has all we needed and host was very responsive. don't miss la jugueria around the corner if you stay - great salads, smoothies, etc.

what a great apartment in a perfect location!! so close to the subway.. across the street from central park and just a 5 min walk to times square. we had 6 people (3 adults and 3 teenagers) and i was thrilled to find a 3 bedroom in nyc! plus there has a full kitchen, and a washer/dryer in the apartment! this place is clean, comfortable and such a great value for the location. it's also on a 1 way street so loud street noise at night isn't a problem at all. i would hands down stay here again!

the best airbnb i had so far! really nothing to complain. paid a lot but it was all worth it. the kitchen was just amazing and the room itself really big. really quiet place. would love to come back some day. thank you!

it was near midnight and we were all tired, pull up to the hotel just to find out they don’t have a room available…. had to go around looking for a room in the middle of the night just because they didn’t warn us or let us know beforehand that no rooms were available to us. a shame.

we honestly couldn’t recommend this place any more! we had a rough travel day but mia was there for any help we needed and always answered our questions. the actual studio was incredible, i don’t think our trip would have been the same without this space, absolute luxury toilet and huge space, the bed and pillows were so comfortable and needed for those long tiring days. we tried 3 of the food recommendations and loved them all. we wanted for nothing in this area and could navigate around easily. a huge plus for us we did not expect was luggage storage after check out, this allowed us to explore the area before our flight rather than have a wasted day. thank you so much for a beautiful space and everything you brought to our stay! we won’t forget it

as promised by the photos and description, this apartment is a classy choice for an upper westside visit to nyc. arriving from the airport was easy as was checking in with the doorman of this nice sized high-rise. it never took long to catch an elevator to go up to the 29th floor. you come into the apartment and can see straight out to central park. the living room area is really lovely. a comfortable couch, nice art, floor rugs and pleasant lighting. the balcony is such a treat for high altitude views of park and city. a well equipped kitchen and dinning area makes it possible to enjoy home cooked or take-out food in a nice environment. the apartment is ver clean. . in the neighborhood there are stores for groceries and fine wine etc. the apartment is extremely convenient to catching the subway. also, central park is one lock away.
great location with a decent sized clean room, friendly and accommodating host. would definitely recommend!

we had such a fantastic stay! have never stayed in brooklyn before and loved it! right by the subway, so easy to get around and the place just felt so homely and was so nice to return back to after a long day out of being tourists. the bed was incredibly comfortable and everything was kept clean. lovely hot showers, and a quiet house. this was my best stay in nyc, thank you!
it was a great place to stay!

1st off lemme say the place is beautiful, i booked the place to relax , be at peace for a day before my grandfathers funeral. i booked for the 18th ended up requesting another day for the next day also. we loved it there and we are planning to go back soon. thank you again francisco and amanda 😊
risha was an amazingly accommodating and friendly host. the place was perfect as was the neighborhood. would give more stars if i could :)
this was a great find, and elizabeth was super easy to communicate with! i'd definitely stay again.

what can i say about wayne.. he's one of the most polite persons i've ever known. he took care of us like we were family, and for us it was a great experience, especially because it was our first time in nyc. the house is great. clean, comfortable, and just a few blocks away from the metro station. the room is big enough for two and super clean. harlem is a great neighbour. despite the bad reputation, we never felt unsafe. you won't find a better place to stay than wayne's!
beautifully decorated and in a safe area. conveniently located near metra and bus lines. dan was very quick at responding to all questions while there and even gave some nice recommendations!

alison was a very proactive and gracious host, and her place is a stylish and cozy oasis. when you’re on vacation, it’s not common to feel this excited to get back to your airbnb. highly recommend staying here!

molisa's home is exactly as listed beautiful, peaceful, and incredibly comfortable. the neighborhood feels safe and welcoming. molisa herself is a sweetheart so responsive and attentive to anything i needed during my stay. i’ll definitely choose her home again the next time i’m in new york!

our family of 4 had an absolutely wonderful weeklong stay at emmanuel's place. the location is to die for and there were so many wonderful touches that made our stay just that much better (blackout shades in the bedrooms, toiletries, etc.). we've stayed at many airbnb's in brooklyn over the years and would happily return for another stay here!
lovely spacious apartment, comfortable, great kitchen set up, incredible rooftop patio. bluetooth speakers
great loft beautifuly designed with great personal touch and care. host is super communicative accurate and fast.
wonderful hotel downtown across wtc and easy access to all subway lines.

stayed at oleg's place for a few nights in august 2023, it has all the listed amenities in the unit, check in process is easy, oleg met us in person, gave us the key and introduced the basic info about the unit. the unit imo is not spotlessly clean but acceptable as a basement unit. location is great, 12-15 mins walk to the ferry pier for the 24/7 free ferry to lower manhattan. it is in a residential area which i find quite safe even in the evenings. free street parking available. oleg is a very friendly host and super responsive whenever i have any questions. overall this unit offers great value for anyone who wants to stay away from the main action but has an easy accessibility to it.

clean place and calm neighborhood.. we loved our 2-month stay.. the hosts are very responsive and we had everything we needed for our stay.. it’s very close to the subway station and easy to get around. highly recommended!
i loved your home i felt very comfortable and thanks for letting me in ur home

very conveniently located close to the metro. we had no trouble getting to/from manhattan from this place and there’s plenty of great cafes/restaurants nearby, especially for breakfast. the airbnb was very clean and had everything one might need. the hosts are also super friendly and helpful! would stay again!
the best italian restaurant across the street! such a fun stay!
thank you, very clean room and excellent service!!!

this was an amazing experience booking with maxine. she was an awesome host and the place wad exactly as described. the private place had everything you needed and maxine was super responsive to any questions. she also has a list of recommendations for things in the area for anything you might be interested in. for anyone looking to be in the area, this place is also close to bus station and subway so you can get around easily.

truly amazing! a cute and quiet block which is centrally located to all the things that make park slope the best! very close to the playground so fantastic if you’re traveling with little ones. the apt was clean, quiet, and exactly as photographed. we had a fantastic time and felt right at home!!!

we just spent 6 months at this apartment. couldn’t ask for a better location. everything we needed was an easy walk. a few short blocks to bus and q subway. nathan is an excellent host and made sure all our needs were taken care of promptly. the apartment is very small but had what we needed for our extended stay. note that there isn’t laundry onsite but a laundromat is directly next door. we wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!
great location. private room
margrethe's apartment was clean, well-appointed, and on a quiet street in a nice neighborhood. we appreciated the welcoming touches, and the guide to local restaurants and sights. we will be back.

this was our first visit to nyc and this location was perfect! a short walk to subway and central park. the street was beautiful and quiet. the people were so friendly in the neighborhood, especially the locals. david’s place is located in a neighborhood full of wonderful restaurants and coffee shops. highly recommend!

michelle's place was exactly as advertised, great location, neat, tidy and michelle was very accommodating. last minute changes on our part caused last minute communications and different numbers of people staying at the airbnb. michelle was quick to respond, professional and accomodated our requests. we highly recommend michelle and her airbnb.
laura’s place was a nice, cozy studio in a cute area of astoria. the heated floors were definitely a much appreciated touch in cold mornings!

finding a place was a tough decision with a family of 4, especially with one member being an infant. we lucked out with booking kris’s place, it had everything and more. we felt right at home and enjoyed the privacy even though it’s a shared space. the host was attentive and provided great suggestions. check in process was simple and the host responded quickly. the location is in a quiet neighborhood and walking distance from the train. highly recommend& thanks again kris!

we didn’t have the best time at martin’s place and are only leaving a review as we rely on reviews for making decisions on where we should stay. firstly, i’ll say that the property was in a good area, really accessible to 2 subway stations. the bed and living area were very comfortable and the kitchen and bathroom facilities were great. however, we had a really big problem with the noise level coming from upstairs (the host’s home). the hosts’s wife was home all day with a baby, and in the morning, afternoon and late in to the evening there was banging, stomping, screaming and other ridiculously loud vocal noises that were inescapable. in the mornings if we wanted to sleep a little later, we couldn’t. in the evenings, we couldn’t come back to relax after a long day exploring without turning up the volume on the tv. it was our honeymoon and we certainly wouldn’t have booked anywhere with a child if it had been mentioned. we tried contacting the host to ask him to lower the level of noise but if anything it only got louder. taking things through airbnb, it only got nasty and he went as far as calling us scammers and trying to blame the noise on the fact we were staying in brooklyn, when the sounds from outside didn’t bother us at all. it’s safe to say it spoiled our honeymoon quite a bit so i can’t say i recommend this place.

this place is wonderful. very close to everything in brooklyn and manhattan very accessible via subway from here. made us feel completely at home in brooklyn. will definitely be back soon. highly recommended!

anna was very helpful in her instructions and kindly amenable to our late check-in. the apartment was clean and the kitchen was well stocked with appliances and utensils. parking was tricky to find when we arrived around 11:00 pm, but we found a better spot early the next morning. the shower head and water pressure were great, but the shower towels weren't the best and left a lot of lint when drying. we had a pleasant stay. thanks so much, anna!
2nd time staying in this unit! :) loved it all the same. would easily return & stay again.

really enjoyed my time exploring new york, a lot of this was down to mark’s place. so close to the subway which made getting around really easy. mark’s place was wonderful, everything i needed, spotlessly clean, great bathrooms with wonderful showers. the beds were great, really comfortable. mark was always helpful, his info helped for getting shopping and getting around. great place! amazing stay! very highly recommended!

i reserved mariko's apartment for two co-workers of mine during independent film week in lincoln center. it served as a nice retreat for them during a very busy week of meetings. great location, very clean and spacious, good wifi, and they loved the private deck. overall, the best airbnb experience they've had!

perfect location for a stay in brooklyn. stayed 6 nights with my wife and our 2 teenage children. when we've visited nyc in the past we always stayed in manhattan, so this was our first stay in brooklyn. value for money wise it doesn't compare - the outside space, lounge/kitchen and extra bedrooms whilst still being so close to manhattan make it a special place. so quiet at night, such a friendly neighbourhood, and super close to the subway for travel within brooklyn and over to manhattan. 30 mins and you're at central park or coney island, can't really go wrong. perfect comms and a very warm friendly welcome from stacey and ricc. cannot recommend this apartment highly enough.

i stayed here a week while my apartment in the lower east side was getting work done on it. as a local to this area i think the nolitan has a perfect center point to rolling to the best neighborhoods in either direction downtown. rooms are snug but well thought out and some of the rooms on the east side have great desks for working. staff was friendly and accommodating.

what a wonderful home! we really enjoyed our stay here and the place itself is very clean, comfortable and equipped with whatever you need. parking was a breeze and the location itself is really convenient at the heart of queens. we will keep gregory’s place in mind for the next time we’re in town!
samara was a very helpful and attentive host but also gave us our personal space. the place was very homely and perfect for a little getaway away from the hustle and bustle of the inner city.

i was in a balcony room , that makes it so worth it . although i left the door open while i went for food and came back to a cockroach on my wall. super scary . and also the tv situation could be way way better for my stay .i wish there was an hdmi to hook up my laptop , because the channels were not all that . aside from that the showers are to die for and the cool view . the food in the area is amazing !! for 182 a night it’s worth is because of the area and balcony . that’s all though to be very honest . still will come back 100 times for a staycation.
karla was a great host and the apartment was a rare find! it was clean and just as it appears on the website. it is also very secure. there is a little street noise (but it is nyc).
frank was very responsive!

the views were spectacular, and the apartement/furnishings were well setup, i also found the location especially convenient, as cabs were easy to hail, and there are a bunch of subways lines converging near by. finally the logistics of the stay, especially around picking up the keys in the lobby, and instructions about how to use the tv, etc, were great. all in all, highly recommended.

2 adults, 4 teens. it was close quarters. but for somewhere to sleep after visiting nyc, it was great. cheaper than the other option of 2 hotel rooms in manhattan. loved the rooftop balcony. my own personal issue was i couldn't find the coffee pot, and had to buy coffee😊. it all worked, the donit place next door was very accommodating. loved how responsive and helpful henry was
great ! no complaints everything was exactly as stated and in great condition . thanks for a excellent week .
room was cleaning and the view was amazing!!!
nice apartment in a perfect location. 100% recomendable
it's more what you can imagine for. everything is as described. tammie is very responsive. she even let me stay in the common area for a few hours after checkout. she deserves to be a super host.
perfect place for a short stay near brooklyn. easy access to jfk and downtown manhattan. peaches was great at communicating.

staying at lauren’s place was good! the place was spacious and clean. lauren was quick to respond and thoughtful by leaving information and tips on the area. the only issue i had, which i suppose is just a part of nyc living was that the upstairs neighbors were pretty loud, sometimes until late into the night and started quite early in the morning. definitely wasn’t something that would deter me from staying at lauren’s place again, but maybe good for others to be prepared for!
i needed this space in a pinch and chris was an outstanding host. 10/10
very nice area, and good communication with owner :)
perfect location for exploring manhattan. great host. all good.

great garden level apartment just a block and a half from the subway. suited our needs fine, and lots of delicious local restaurants! since the space is connected to the rest of the house, you will hear noise from the upstairs including voices. we were a little worried the family could also hear us, but we were out most of the time during the week anyway. :) this was not a showstopper for us, but just a note the space is also a bit darker than the photos.

perfect in every way. to have such a spacious, carefully curated, authentic new york apartment, all to ourselves – it wasn't easy to tear ourselves away and go to the city... and so perfect to come 'home' to. the best days were not going to the city at all, but just stepping out into the blossom-tree lined friendly streets to discover amazing places to visit and eat in the neighbourhood. our hosts were welcoming helpful and provided the perfect balance between giving us space and being there when needed. amazing. recommended. see for yourself.
stayed with chris before this my 2nd time and like my first time it was amazing , christina is really nice and she checks in and her communication is amazing. will definitely book her over again
great apartment in an accessible location. saint is a great guy and goes above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need. would definitely stay there again.
pamela is a wonderful host with a lovely place. just what i needed for my brief stay in brooklyn.

this was a great spot to visit friends in queens but to also have access to nyc by the bus, subway and the train. could tour the city and return to a quiet, spacious place to relax! there were great amenities nearby - within walking to an excellent pizzeria, liquor store and ice cream shop, etc., at the utopia parkway and union turnpike. would recommend this stay/location to others.

renee was an outstanding host and went over and beyond to be accommodating, warm, caring, and considerate. i stayed for over a month due to a new transition and i couldn’t be more grateful for a safe space to plan, organize and stay productive. the area is really close to grocery stores, the train, utica ave, eastern parkway and more. all the essentials areas and places for a vibrant stay in brooklyn. i highly recommended this place if you’re a student, working professional , returning to nyc , or simply need a vacation 🩷

the best airbnb experience i already had. pettrina, her mom and her son were so kind. i had a good rest, good shower. the house is very cloose to the subway. when i arrived i found some snacks, water... thank you very much! hope i back soon.
it's a nice studio apartment at a really great location. very quiet inside, warm in winter, cool in summer. plenty of restaurants, laundromat, public transport in the vicinity.
the apartment was very nice and clean, and the hostess provided me with clear instructions and many nice tips which were really useful

we got exactly what we expected from the listing--it looked like the pictures and was a very good size for 5 people. the included coffee was a great touch. they were gracious enough to set up an air mattress for us too at request. host was very communicative and responsive and helpful. one critique is we would have loved a few extra towels. overall, for the price we paid to stay the night in nyc close to the subway and lirr for 5 people and for the space and beds we got, it was a great deal.
paul was very helpful - easy to contact, made instructions and info clear and easy to follow

this place is perfect! i am a huge nyc/broadway nerd and this location was perfect! being in hell’s kitchen made times square and all the broadway theaters within walking distance. it was really easy to go out shopping and then walk back to drop my things off and go back out. the only downfall was the 4th floor walk-up, but if that was my biggest problem, then it was a total success!
amy was a great host and her place was super clean. would definitely recommend it!

ruben cancelled the booking whilst i was on the plane, and did not inform me prior to this so i realised when i logged back in at the airport via airbnb customer service. this is quite an unsafe behaviour for a solo woman traveler.

clean & beautiful apartment! was a real joy to come back to it at the end of the day and just __rest__. very good communication with host, eduardo answered all the questions with really fast response time and good info. nice ac in the room at night when sleeping. would book again if coming back to koreatown or other areas nearby. thanks again eduardo!
everything was very nice. we enjoyed our stay. thank you!

authentic brooklyn apartment with all the quirks of the city. frantz is an accommodating host that does a great job adding to your experience. the location is perfect with access to prospect park and the subway. the room is very comfortable especially the bed and linens. i look forward to my next stay in this bonafide brooklyn spot.

charming and well equipped studio in a calm neighborhood of chelsea. clean bathroom, spacious kitchen and built-in closet with plenty of hangers. loved the small balcony. the host was very responsive.

this place is a gem! i really have nothing but positive things to say about chris’s place. the room was clean and felt very private, with a full bath just next door. the bed was incredibly comfortable, and we appreciate having the couch, table, and chairs in the room as well. the neighborhood is beautiful and feels safe, with excellent walkable restaurants and cafes. there are nearby subway stops to easily get to soho. chris was a spectacular host! very friendly, with quick and responsive communication. he provided a binder with local recommendations, which made exploring the neighborhood easy. chris was also incredibly easygoing when we requested some flexibility for checkout. excellent value, we would definitely stay here again when visiting the city!

a huge property for new york, you could very comfortably sleep 8 here. place is clean and there’s so, so much room. also conveniently located next to an express train station (lines 4 and 5) and a few minutes walk away from the m60 bus that goes straight to laguardia. would come back!
this place is amazing. perfect location, wonderful layout, thoughtful decor and responsive host. 10/10 recommend!

we enjoyed our stay at this spacious and very clean, well decorated apartment! seda was an excellent host, friendly and upbeat while not being intrusive at all. the apartment has historical touches and is well-maintained. the bed stuy location makes it convenient to take cars to get to the best brooklyn places like williamsburg and bushwick, downtown brooklyn and dumbo. if you’re not experienced with new york living, you should know to expect an eclectic neighborhood with lots of diverse locals, smaller bathrooms than you might be used to, and some noise from the street as well as from upstairs and next door neighbors. these things are pretty standard for anywhere in ny and you’ll find them here too. all in, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend the host!

had a great stay at george’s place in brooklyn. as described plus more . close to the subway and easy to get to manhattan. jenny and george are great hosts . very kind and quick to respond with any questions. highly recommend this airbnb. thank you jenny and george
i wish i would stay there for longer. lovely room. host is very nice lady.

my son and i called this place home for 4 days. the apartment was a perfect way to experience ny without being in the city. the apartment had an updated bathroom and kitchen, and was exactly what we saw on the listing. litza was an amazing super host, greeting us on arrival and offering lots of tips in person and through her well documented guide book. anything i would have asked was in that book…so helpful!! the place was clean, airy and quiet! yet with easy access to ditmars and the n/w into the city. having been to the city many times, i’m glad i found this great alternative to a noisy (and cramped) nyc hotel. the locks were a little tricky at first, but we got the hang of them and came and went with ease. i’d definitely recommend this apartment to someone wanting more space than a city hotel or flat.

i had an incredible stay in this room! it's not only beautifully designed but also in a fantastic location, surrounded by vibrant bars and restaurants. the convenience of being just 30 minutes away from times square was a huge plus. the host was exceptionally responsive and made me feel truly welcome, checking in from time to time to ensure everything was perfect. i couldn't have asked for a better experience. i highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a memorable stay in the city!
this place was pretty nice, it had a great view of buildings and is in a nice part of town. if u stay here i recommend going to mimis resturaunt it was very nice

clean, pretty, sunny duplex with great outdoor space. well laid out . only drawbacks and i would say these are quite minor: 4 floor walk up plus couch is not super comfortable for sitting. i would rent again in a second.
great location. within 5 min walk of a bunch of lines to get you anywhere in the city. has everything you need to make you feel like you're home.

we really enjoyed our stay here. the location is fabulous if you want to experience chinatown and it is only a short walk to the subway. we would stay here again if we pass through. thanks for hosting us!
nice but too expensive
excellent host. very thoughtful and helpful. nice place.

our hosts were very accommodating and helpful, answering many questions before we arrived and helping us decide on whether we'd have time to do a couple of things. the accommodation was easy to find with the instructions provided and was everything that was promised. a great little area of town with lots of great places to eat and drink within a few footsteps! i would recommend staying here :)
the place was beautiful, the location great (about 3 blocks from the subway that takes you almost everywhere), and the host was amazing. 5/5

the location and the place was really amazing the only problem i had was they double charged me like i paid on the app and they let me pay at my arrival too which i never understand upto now . the wifi was so hard to get.

edmund was the perfect host for me and my family during the 12 days they stayed at new york. the place is super nice and has a very nice decoration. edmund also received us with many delicatessen. very available and supportive as well. the neighborhood is super quiet and people were super nice to us. i would stay again and recommend this place to everyone else. tiago and family.

this was my second visit, and i hope there will be many more. the apartment is a creatively designed, spacious, and well maintained home. it is pristine and the hosts are welcoming. all this and the location is great for visiting my family.
rhonda welcomed us and made us feel right at home! loved her place! it was very clean and had everything we needed! rhonda was so sweet and thoughtful!

the accommodation is really very comfortable and welcoming, you feel at home. the photos perfectly reflect the environment you will occupy. it's perfect for three people and we found it very functional. you'll fall in love with home appliances and netflix's availability on tv, a little less than the four flights of stairs, as the apartment is on the fifth floor and there's no elevator. but it is feasible with a little effort and goodwill. the apartment is clean, however there will be a problem with the dust that accumulates in disproportionate amounts, but i think it is more a problem in new york than in the apartment. one thing is dirt, another is dust that is easily eliminated. the house is equipped with a very sensitive smoke detector, every time we cooked something fried, it is taken immediately, so be careful. it's not a negative note, it's just a warning. we laughed, many and many times. the area is really very characteristic and equipped, a few steps from the subway, a 7eleven, a supermarket on the 31 and a pharmacy behind the house. overall we loved the apartment, we loved it and i hope to come back or have other contacts with the host which was really impeccable. thanks usa stay and goodbye new york.

fantastic place to stay! plenty of toiletries available. less than 5min walk to the grocery store. about a 10-15min walk to the subway (depending on which line you head to). so many food options nearby, and always felt safe. bed was comfortable. would stay again!

a good apartment for two people with everything one needs for a short stay. we stayed for 6 nights and enjoyed it, as it was well equiped. the station church avenue (line 2 and 5) is about 5 min away. the area is pretty wild but at least it does not get boring.

kandi's place was absolutely perfect for a short weekend in the city. very close to the nearest metro station, manhattan was reachable in a couple minutes. i never felt unsafe in the neighborhood (where you can find great eateries; restaurants and coffee shops just two blocks away). checking in was really easy as the instructions given by kandi were simple and clear. the room was absolutely lovely and faithful to the pictures, which actually don't do justice since the room is very spacious and cosy. i would definitely book it again whenever i go back to nyc!
the apartment is very well placed. communication with proprietor was seamless.
very big space, safe and comfortable. matched the pictures. lots do to in the area plus super close to public transportation. highly recommend!

brigette is a warm and welcoming host, who is friendly but very respectful of space and privacy. spaces were always tidy and clean. i thoroughly enjoyed my stay with her. great location on central park and close to all transport and amenities.

i really enjoyed my staying at andrew and adriana's place. the location is incredible, sits in the middle of the park slope neighborhood with a plurality of dining and shopping options. the apartment is only a few blocks from the famed prospect park and the road leading towards the park is tranquil while possesses striking vistas. have a cup of coffee and stroll along the neighborhood will surely kickstart your day in good spirit! the metro station is right around the corner of the apartment, with easy access to most parts of the city. mostly importantly, the apartment is clean, well decorated, private, exactly as depicted in the pictures. i would highly recommend andrew and adriana's place to people visiting new york, and would love to return to stay again in the future.

our stay was wonderful! the gentleman i spoke to at the front desk was so kind, helpful, and just made the whole experience a step above. the room and view were great, the lounge/bar area had such a fun atmosphere, and the location was situated close to everything. i look forward to staying here again.
the freehand was very nice. i really liked the warmth of the wood and the decor overall. i would definitely stay here again and it was very clean too. a+
very convenient and walkable location! perfect for a weekend of exploring.

this is our second time staying at jaime’s place. it’s an amazing home. clean, comfortable, everything we needed, excellent communication, and what a location! right near bedford ave with all the food and shops you want.

we had a nice stay at seith's place, the place was as in the desciption and had great location. seith replied to all of our questions really fast and clearly, so everything went well and we had a pleasant first airbnb experience.

this air bnb was splendid. close to shop and food spots (i went to sweet chick and vanessa's dumpling house). 10 minute walk to the subway. you could even walk the williamsburg bridge into the city if you wanted. the rooftop area was relaxing though i only went up there last once. the room itself is great for a single person. the bed was amazingly comfortable, especially when it stormed and i stayed in for the night. on one of the nights, i had left my apartment and room keys back in the lockbox so i wouldn't lose it, but another person staying in the room next to me took them by accident. russell was kind and accommodating to my situation and let me pick up his apartment keys from him at his workplace. definitely bring your keys with you when you go out so you avoid the mistake i made! i enjoyed my solo trip even more because of this location. it was a tranquil place to come back to after long days in the city. highly recommend it. thank you russell!

had a very nice stay, my room was clean and comfortable, house is situated in a very nice neighborhood, with supermarket , restaurants etc nearby, irina is a very responsive host. i will definitely stay again!

this apartment was perfect for visiting our son who lives nearby. very clean, and exactly as described. we were surprised at how quiet it was despite the proximity to public transit, and enjoyed the special and unique touches that ronan has added to the space. we'd definitely return, thanks.

staying with collen was excellent. getting an apartment in nyc can be tough, and highly varied, especially when it comes to check-in or long walk-ups. in this case, the check-in was simple, and collen was great about communicating and putting up with our changing schedules day-of. we easily found parking just a block or two away on the street for free, and the neighborhood itself felt safe, friendly, and diverse. plenty of excellent shops, cafes, and venues in easy walks, not to mention how close the train is if you want to get around. the space itself was cozy, but more spacious than a lot of other apartments i'd been in in nyc, and the space was used well. the decor was tasteful and homey too, better than a lot of the basic spartan rooms i've had elsewhere. definitely a lot of care and attention went into the space! would definitely recommend.
shane's place was awesome and he was great host.
everything was good for 55 days

there were rats during our first night there. the train would be mildly distracting at night but it's not disturbing sleep. there's a funky smell in the staircase up to the airbnb. the spiral staircase is small as hell. everything is smaller than the photos but it's new york. it was a great place though, had great experiences. it's only 30 minutes from times square basically.

dimitri was a fantastic host. super warm welcoming quick responses and clear check in instructions making the whole process quick and easy. he has great tourist recommendations and local neighborhood insight too. looking forward to coming back and staying longer to explore more of bk.
the place was great! we loved the view from the bedroom, the location and easy access to the train in the same block, and the fast communication with sol

my family and i chose this location due to the proximity of our daughter who lives in brooklyn, and we were pleasantly surprised by how nice the place was! very spacious, with clean and comfortable beds. there wasn’t a kitchen table to eat around l, but we made it work. we also enjoyed playing uno for several hours. we’ve had some questionable experiences staying in brooklyn and other parts of ny before, but this listing is definitely our favorite, and was the most accurately described by its advertising.

win’s place is in a good location not to far from train station. also in a quiet, safe neighborhood with restaurants and grocery stores nearby. win is a great host and his home is kept very clean and cozy. would highly recommend staying at win’s place.
grateful for the hospitality, and a very peaceful stay
really nice and quiet place to stay!
the place was as described.
i felt amazingly safe and cozy....having a king size bed and air conditioning during nyc's record heat wave made this air b n b priceless. so close and easy to the heart of manhattan
great location, clean, and kind hosts. couldn’t ask for anything more!
very clean and comfortable room, with all the amenities needed for a stay. the location is also very close to the carroll stop off of the f and g. also, mark and his wife are wonderful hosts.
our second time being here and wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else! great little spot to stay at!
this is a great place with wonderful hosts
i will say it again

i had a great time. checking in was super easy. the room is great, quiet and the bed was very comfortable. the en-suite bathroom is definitely a plus. the apartment was very clean and i felt at home. the neighborhood is nice, there are a lot of restaurants and coffee shops close by. it is also only a short walk to the subway, and you can be in manhattan in 25 minutes. all in all it was a great experience and i’d love to come back next time i’ll be in new york.
a great time! perfect location to walk to get food and drinks. loved the outside patio to chill at night and have a drink with friends.
comfortable stay in a good location that is convenient to getting around ny.

lisa was a wonderful hostess, made us feel very welcome in her home. she was quick to answer any questions about our stay and provided help if needed to get around staten island and to the city. easy off-street parking, safe, quiet neighborhood and back door access to the living room and bedroom. all areas were clean and use of the kitchen was a plus. bedroom was large and allowed a private area if needed. the weather did not allow us to take advantage of the deck off of the living room which would have be a plus. lisa does have an italian greyhound which is a very sweet, mild, quiet dog. most of the time he was upstairs. we really enjoyed our stay and after just an hour found we had a lot in common with lisa and enjoyed her company. we are looking forward to staying with her on any future visits to staten island. thanks lisa, pat and dee

erenita was extremely helpful and very friendly! the apartment is close to the train station and the area at night isn't bad to walk through. we even got free water ♥️ ✅2 minute walk from the train station (that had a police station in it) ✅20-30 minute train from every major attraction ✅bodegas on the same block ✅a lot of handy utensils ✅full kitchen ✅hot water ⚠️no elevator

great place on a very quiet street, set up well for guests with maps, wifi code on the wall, etc. joy was a pleasure to deal with and very responsive. comfortable beds. our only little issue was that the heat was turned up too high one night and the thermostat control is in the apartment upstairs, but when we texted joy she responded right away and took care of it, in the middle of the night. great host making the most of an old but clean, comfortable and well-equipped apartment.

my friends and i stayed here during a work trip as students and we had a great stay. we received the apartment in great conditions, found the location to be great and convenient. the amenities were all as described. the space might be tight depending on how much stuff you have and the layout of the apartment you get, but otherwise it matched with everything we were told. the laundry situation wasn’t as bad as some reviews mentioned - yes on days with heavy rain that basement floor would floor so it wouldn’t be ideal to do laundry that day, but otherwise there were no other problems. the rooftop amenities were nice, clean and never too busy.

moying is just incredible. so kind, helpful, and thoughtful. the room was comfortable and the pink was so cheery. location is so convenient, in the heart of china town and very close to a subway station. thank you, moying !!!

we had a wonderful time. guerline is a very nice person and easy to communicate with. we arrived late and she ordered pizza for us, which was very thoughtful. we enjoyed staying in guerline's place very much.
it was really good house. i wont lie. there are famous resturant near the house.
sarah’s place was very convenient and perfect for our needs! it was clean and comfortable.

angelo and mindy were excellent hosts and made us feel right at home. the location was close to the subway for straightforward travel into manhattan. it was always nice to return to the flat at the end of each day, and the ac was much appreciated during the heatwave. we would definitely stay again. thank you mindy and angelo!

great place to stay. i requested a change of sofa (it was in bad shape) and a lamp that wasn’t working and they changed it quickly. the place feels new and in great shape with spacious rooms. the only 2 things that we didn’t liked much was that at night we could hear very clear the sirens from ambulances and firetrucks but that’s not their fault. and the other thing was the laundry, specifically the dryers, most of the dryers weren’t working and there wasn’t any information about it in most of them so we ended up paying double almost every time we used them.
very friendly people and cool view! the pool is nice and the restaurants stay separate in what you can order so it doesn’t feel like youre eating the same thing in a different location.

this was a great stay, nicholas was very accommodating with check in and check out times. he was always available and very quick to respond. the area is great near the f train, store and food. the neighbors are very friendly and helpful. i would recommend this stay and look forward to staying here my next trip!
we had a great visit to nyc and it was so nice to "come home" every night to our cozy little ground level airbnb. so close to subway, made getting around really easy. would stay here again.

josh & marni have a wonderful space! the location is convenient to everything you might need (subway, grocery stores, some restaurants) and the space itself was a great size, layout, and had lots of light. we three friends shared the space for over a week (2 shared the bed, 1 on the couch) and did everything from enjoying cooking in the open kitchen, relaxing with dinner in the back patio, staying up streaming tv in the living room and explored the neighborhood(s) restaurants, bars, wine shops, and stores throughout the week. the family wasn’t around the first part of our stay but was very proactive with communications and made sure someone was there to assist with checkin and other needs as they came up. overall we had a great stay and would stay again!

rory's east village apartment is in an ideal location. you can't walk a block without there being a little nook of a restaurant or café that attempts to pull you in. the apartment was safe, clean and comfortable and don't forget to ask rory about his dad's german restaurant just a block away - it was fantastic. rory is an ideal host - easy to talk to, helpful and was quick with responses. highly recommended!!

great place! very clean and organized. we used the kitchen and laundry and machines w/o any issues. great shower also. the place is ussually very quiet, so its a great place to rest and panda the dog is just so cute.

during my short stay melody was extremely inviting and friendly; her hospitality, the room's cleanliness, and overall comfort (i usually struggle sleeping away from home, but here i felt right at home) was through the roof!
cute place! walking distance from times square and very accessible to public transport! absolutely loved it!
very accomodating host, i didnt expect that i will have my own tv. easy checkin and checkout. place is near the subway laundry shop and restaurants.
hosts are very responsive and accomodating. clear instructions and location is walkable to public transportation.

my friend & i loved walking down portland ave every evening to miriam’s brownstone after our manhattan adventures. the forte green area in brooklyn is beautiful. miriam is kind & considerate. on the bedside desk i found all her insightful notes for local restaurants/markets/etc. we tried a few & all amazing! very grateful for her.

the space is just as described with tons of thoughtful touches and loads of fluffy towels! comfy bed and adore the location! easy access to the train for downtown and lots of wonderful local things to do as well! the park! sottacasa! paris blues!

this day was great clean location much bigger in person there is a tub there if you want to take a bath good location this day was great clean location much bigger in person there is a tub there if you want to take a bath good location post was great wasn't able to meet him talk to him throughout the stay and communication was clear and criss i would definitely recommend staying there
great neighborhood, nice hosts, very clean place

casey's apartment had everything we needed. before we came to new york we were a bit worried about what we read about the area, but once we arrived, we felt safe. it is great that there is a supermarket and the subway station just two minutes away. you will have a good sleep at casey's home: the apartment is very quiet.
what a great space! absolutely loved the back garden!
nick is very polite and always available to answer my questions! the place is nice with good transportation to manhattan!

we absolutely adored the location. great for what we needed. enough of a kitchenette to make sandwiches, have bagels and yogurt for breakfast, etc. the staff was friendly but not too chatty, just right in my opinion! it felt safe. i heard staff speaking several languages to guests. the only downside is as described in other reviews the wait for the elevator was really pretty absurd. the signs say they are working on it, but on the 17th floor with 2 kids under 6, we still opted to walk down a few times. my advice would be to ask for a room on a low floor so you can take the stairs some of the time. each elevator was crammed full because people were willing to make accommodations out of common elevator frustration. i would really give this a glowing review were it not for the elevator waits. we didn’t use the 26th floor but they have a bar, business center and work out room up there. we’ll check here next time we go to the city to see if the reviews all still mention the lifts.

gerard was an amazing host and the apartment is great! really nice location in chelsea, close to public transport, and unique vibe of the apartment to make you feel like a local new yorker. gerard was also incredibly friendly and always on hand in case i needed anything. cannot recommend this highly enough.

this was one of the best airbnb’s i’ve stayed at! it’s unbeatable for the price. the amenities are great, and it’s a 4 minute walk to the green line and a 10 minute walk to the blue line. it makes getting into the city super accessible (20-40 minute train ride) and it’s in a great part of brooklyn where everything is nearby. victor is super responsive and a great host!
great place! extremely clean and well kept. top it all off with a wonderful host... that made for an amazing stay. thanks tom. i highly recommend!

great airbnb. the space was much larger than i anticipated. i thought it was perfect for a weekend when we spent most of the weekend out and about. it was perfect for both walkable spots and to hop on the bergen f/g train to go elsewhere. i will definitely stay here again if it’s available.
it’s beautiful and clean. we met him the day we checked in. he was nice and made us feel welcome. i would definitely rent again.
so easy, so comfortable, so private. i’d come back any time.
barbara and casey were great hosts and their ensuite room was perfect for our brooklyn visit.

we felt very welcome, there were fresh flowers and a personal welcome message, food supplies for first needs. the apartment is pretty and clean, sunny and quiet. the bed is very comfortable. plenty of (nice) plates, glasses etc. 2 sets of door keys, great if you split up for the day. lots of info on public transport, places to eat, things to do. sometimes some street noise in the evening but always quiet after 9-10pm. upcoming neighbourhood, nice & kind people, some parts better kept than others. easy access to public transport: 2 nearby subway stations, plenty of buses and citibike points. we had a great stay here.

wow! what a beautiful apartment and who ever expected such a spacious place with so many modern updates. the kids enjoyed the jacuzzi after a long day of traveling and walking around nyc. the beds were perfectly comfortable and the kitchen had everything we needed. the best part was that we were able to park- in the driveway- and walk about 3/4 of a mile to the train. 20 minutes later and we were at union station for $2.75. you absolutely can’t beat the price and there were plenty of places to eat within a few miles of the house, for the days we didn’t go into the city. great place with great hosts who gave us many helpful tips and were st our beckon call within seconds!

brian's room is in a great area surrounded by many great restaurants and bars. it's ideal for a short-term stay, especially for the younger audience. the connection to the downtown area and brooklyn is very convenient, and the location is within walking distance of a few nice supermarkets. however, the room is less suited for someone who plans to stay here longer than a month. the room faces the street, which can be noisy at night - there are a few restaurants nearby, and garbage trucks frequently visit the area. if you are a light sleeper, that can be a problem. the room is also quite dimly lit, so it is not an ideal environment for staying inside the whole day. i had to share the apartment with brian and one more person, which was always manageable. the living room has no natural daylight, so it feels less cozy. on the other hand, it is new york, and it is difficult to expect high standards in a 1900s house. none of this would be a major issue for a short-term stay.
a crappy hotel that gets away with being a crappy hotel because it's pretending to be an airbnb... not worth the price.
great stay with easy access to different subways. would definitely stay again!

joseph's place was great for my family of 6. lots of space and very clean. felt right at home. when i had questions he was very responsive. very secure felt safe coming and going .will definitely book again

peter’s apartment is awesome! we stayed there for 6 days over the winter holidays and by the first night the place felt like home. the interior decoration of the apartment is really great and makes you feel cozy and relaxed after a day of exploring the city. the location is pretty much exactly where you want to be – you can walk to all of the tourist spots in the city and there is a major train station (penn station) right around the corner if you don’t feel like walking (manhattan is quite walkable). peter himself is an excellent host – he answered all of our questions and has a streamlined check-in/check-out process for the apartment. he’s also just a great guy with a great personality. overall we couldn’t be more satisfied with our stay here in nyc.

up to 2 persons only, our room was small but had the private bathroom. the host has provided a newly refurbished bathroom which was tiled nicely. kitchen down the hall past two other rental rooms. area was clean throughout.

cute and updated place to stay! very close to the subway but the neighborhood isn’t the best :/ also the tv is very small and barely works unfortunately. the beds are comfortable and the kitchen had all the amenities we needed. host was very communicative and accommodating. overall great stay! thank you sandrine
good location. small but adequate. good price.
very good experience for the price. sharon was very quick to response and very helpful about any queries. would recommend.

cathy’s place was just as described. clean and well though out apartment with attention to detail, for extra comfortability. we had an extremely pleasant stay during our first trip to new york. apartment is only a 5 min walk to the subway station and there’s a little supermarket next to the subway too. good location for if you want to be out of the hustle and bustle of manhattan. cathy was a great host, and gave us great recommendations. would highly recommend cathy’s place!
good airbnb in a convenient location.

a good stay if you're looking to avoid the pricier options. lots of subway access within 10 minutes of walking, so easy to get around. nice quiet stay as it faces the backyard, and a surprising amount of space considering the location.
anne was so pleasant and responsive! her home was beautiful and clean! i would stay there again!

i really enjoyed my stay at pedro's apartment. i did not get to meet him in person, because he was away for the holiday week, but cristina was really nice and gracious and very helpful with everything. the place is super clean, the location is amazing, check in and check out was really easy (and the hosts very accommodating to my specific need for flexibility), the bed was very comfortable and the location very quiet, so i had a great sleep both weekend nights. i would wholeheartedly recommend pedro's place.
very convenient location to the c and j train. easy access and reliable accommodations.

spacious place that was clean and safe that was extremely close to public transit (j train), grocery stores, and laundromats. easy access to the rest of new york, if you don't mind a train ride. anastasia is a good host, and provided a lot.

i stayed at lauren and anthony’s home with my sister and our stay was really fun. they were both really friendly and informative on what to go check out. the house was super clean with a cute garden in the front yard. it was conveniently located near a few metro stations over in brooklyn with a fairly quick ride to manhattan.

wonderful, tranquil, comfortable space! the room is quite spacious with a private bath and sitting area, and the whole space is freshly remodeled. sara is an ideal host--when we let her know about a broken piece of furniture, she replaced it within hours! bottom line: we felt comfy and and safe here even during hurricane irene, so you'll definitely enjoy your stay!

great stay and the host was very nice, the place was spotless and had all the things we need for the stay, including clean towels and toilet paper... even waters. thank you so much i will be back soon.

miriam’s guest room and her home are so lovely. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay there. her place is truly located on the best block—conveniently located, beautiful, and right next to the park. we had no issues with the room or bathroom. her family and pets were welcoming and very sweet! we would definitely recommend her place to other travelers!

everything was great! the place was really clean and had everything we needed. we got also some nice tips about how to use the subway and what some nice attractions/restaurant were in the neighborhood. the communication with martha went also really well.
cara’s such a sweetie! and her place is adorable! will happily stay again next time we’re in nyc.
eric was a good host
place was very beautiful and clean and daniel was very responsive and friendly. we will definitely come back when we visit brooklyn again.

great place! comfortable and with a very convenient location for us. our host responded promptly to our inquiries. well equipped kitchen and the appartment is very well kept. we look forward to staying in it when we return.
great stay! would definitely recommend rosy’s place to anyone who needs a place to stay that’s close to the airport.
the listing is exactly as portrayed by the pictures. vernon and his wife are very hospitable. he checked up on us every day. we really enjoyed our stay. :-)

immaculate, well equipped, and spacious (for nyc). excellent location with express and local subway lines within a block in either direction, a short walk to central park, some of the best pizza anywhere right around the corner (harlem pizza), and many other local sights worth seeing. the neighbourhood has some interesting characters and can be quite loud at night, but everyone seems to just go about their business without bothering the tourists like us.
great place. will visit again

clean place in astoria. great facilities and effective communication with toni. location is a bit far from manhattan and brooklyn, takes a while to get around. the air quality was not too good, a bit humid. good value for money.
a great location, little small.
stylish place with everything you need in a vibrant neighborhood, an easy ride to the city.
just as lovely as it looked in the photos. so comfortable, clean, and relaxing. the perfect place to come back to after running around the city all day.
overall great stay and you get what you expected.

this was one of my favorite spots yet. super spacious, super cozy and it felt like home away from home. the apartment was very clean & the shower in the master room was amazing! the host left so many towels and there was also new toothbrushes available for us. i would definitely recommend and go back again!
very beautiful home. host was very polite and made sure that we had a pleasant stay

great spot in the heart of east midtown. it's absolutely perfect for a couple or single person. 3 blocks from the 6 train that will take you downtown and back without making any transfers drop off just a few blocks from world trade center. we really enjoyed our 2 nights here and would definitely consider staying here again. i was luckily able to check in early but you can drop your bags at the lombardy if not. 12 min walk from central park, and walk-able to grand central, empire state building and madison square garden. it's a pretty standard midtown room as far as size but the price was right and i enjoyed a concierge and elevator. would recommend for sure. great pizza place across the street too with the best margarita pizza i've ever tried in nyc.
great place, pleasant stay

the listing was extremely accurate. this was my first airbnb and marjorie made sure that it was a great start! throughout the trip, i knew that i could rely on marjorie and that she would be willing to answer any questions that i had. she was very receptive and friendly and i thoroughly enjoyed my time in brooklyn.
really price worthy accommodation and great location. henry was an excellent and responsive host. can highly recommend!

great place with lots of light, all the comforts of home, and very comfortable beds. loved the neighborhood and so much to do and explore. kids and adults enjoyed immensely. the perfect pad for downtown exploring.
perfect view of the wtc. also super friendly and professional staff

and quiet oasis in the middle of the city. i couldn’t have asked for a better stay. briana and her family were super accommodating. the home was a dream. the calm you get from sitting in a swing next to the waterfall was everything. you forgot to stop for snacks/drinks? not to worry the fridge was stocked as were the cabinets. i’ll surely be back!
can’t describe how wonderful carolyn is.really nice host,and pretty clean and quiet place.highly recommended

great host, wonderful location, and all you need for a quick kip in nyc. the bed seems like it is going to be uncomfortable at first (it is a pull out sofa), but it is suprisingly nice; firm, but not painful (i am quite a large man, so this is saying something). host is responsive and flexible; would absolutely stay again.

we stayed here for a night very nice neighbourhood close to the city and the airports. henry was an excellent host,very respectful and helpful he was able to accommodate to our needs.would definitely recommend

amanda’s place was wonderful, very spacious and in a relatively quiet area. her aesthetic is top tier and i felt extremely comfortable in the space. it’s in a great location if you want something quieter but still with easy access to manhattan. the m and l lines are a very short walk and i felt fairly safe walking alone later in the night.
exceptional spot, it is clean, easy to check into. overall it was great to work with nalani.

great location! we had a great time at this rental. it was clean, very comfortable and conveniently close to lots of restaurants and shopping options within walking distance. we felt safe in the building/neighborhood. i would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking to stay within the area.
dorion is a great host , and the apartment is clean and well located. we enjoyed staying there for a few days.
room was a a described, very close to public transportation. i enjoyed my short stay.
a nice one man privacy bedroom to gather all your thoughts and know what you gonna do in life, a nice spot to think out loud.
when are the best places i stayed at in new york city?
clean & comfortable room close to subway station. due to the layout of the apartment that was plenty of privacy as well. i would stay again if in the area!
clean and very convenient to nyc subway stop. very large bedrooms with comfortable beds. the wifi is very high speed. offered everything needed for a stay near, but not in, nyc.
great place! exactly as described and easy to work with management company. would stay again!
i would come back at any time! 😊
