the place was as described. i wish we could have checked in or dropped our bags off earlier because we were heading over to the us open and knew we getting back to the place really late. we walked past the lock box three times before we found it. it was not clear that the boxes were located on the gate. so we did have a good laugh. if you are bringing a car there is a parking garage 500 feet to the right. of course we did not see it until we walked past it to get to the other garage…another good laugh! we would stay there again. it was a quiet neighborhood with a wonderful bakery, a food takeout store and a starbucks on the corner.

dachi’s place is very clean and minimal. he was communicative the whole time, even when i had multiple questions back to back. we had to stay here at the last minute due to unexpectedly having to bring our dog with us. we loved that it was dog friendly!

we had a short stay in nyc and couldn’t be happier with the room and location of the hotel. the front desk staff were very friendly and check-in was super easy. the valet parking was very convenient. the room itself was very clean with comfortable beds. the location was very close to the metro and easy to get to all the attractions. jason was extremely quick to respond to any questions we had. he was very friendly and ensured we had a comfortable and enjoyable stay. we hope to return back to nyc in the near future and would not think twice to re-book this unit!
my first experience with airbnb. i was very satisfied. really nice place for spending our trip in ny. agnes provide a lot of useful information. perfect communication whole time
jaime is super friendly and very helpful. her house is a good choice in a accessible location for someone on a budget.
aka central park is a hidden gem. the staff is professional, the location is unbeatable, and the price was amazing.
lovely hosts - would recommend

mahmood and his wife are incredibly warm and kind-hearted people, with excellent hospitality and respect. their norwegian forest cat lupus was also adorable and very friendly. the location is so convenient, near to a bus that goes to the ferry, and a few minutes walk to a small supermarket on richmond terrace (that is open until 11pm every day). the ferry operates 24hrs to manhattan, which is excellent. overall, a pleasant stay. thank you!
was a nice stay blocks away from de madison square garden

good location, very clean. allen was there when we arrived and helped us find our way to the subway. we have verizon phone service and had difficulties with connecting inside the apartment, but the wifi works great and we were able to get uber rides. good to know if subway is on holiday schedule or not in service, but that is nothing our hosts could control. we did have trouble getting used to city noises and close living, the windows have street lights shining in so it never gets really dark in the apartment. we did appreciate the lovely space and complete kitchen with lots of little extras that made our stay special. there is a lot to do in brooklyn and we look forward to coming back!
great deal for nyc
good place to stay with clear instructions and near all the famous places.

claudine's place is a really great find! i coordinated accommodations for a group of six on a weekend trip. everyone was thoroughly impressed with the space! first time i've ever been in charge of booking the squad airbnb and it was a hit. super well renovated/decorated and immediately inviting. each room has its own climate control! comfortable beds, spacious rooms and big closets to stow luggage. two full bathrooms with fresh linens. showers got hot quickly. full length mirrors made it easy for the crew to get dressed and reset for nights out in town. the space is a little further out from where we spent our time but it didn't matter. subway access is convenient. (a trains have express service to manhattan). we found affordable lyft/uber options. the street is very quiet and residential. we felt comfortable and safe walking in the neighbourhood at all hours. i think all six of us would agree that we could not have found better accommodations for our trip than the black forest!
this is a very amazing place, my wife and i stayed in this place for almost 2months. it was an amazing experience with breathtaking view.

excellent!!. this was our second time in this place. now, they have free breakfast (coffee and pastries), which is great to start your day. the location is very good. few blocks from the subway, from soho and little italy. next time on the city we will go there again!

the apartment is really nice with a lot of space and well located close to main subways and lots of restaurants. is very well equiped with everything you need. the place is very clean and has a lot of natural light with a nice view to the garden. helena was always available to help with any questions. the best apartment i have rented in brooklyn. i really recomend it.

just checked out of aminah’s place and we had such a wonderful, peaceful time. everything was just as described and aminah’s instructions were clear and left nothing to be surprised by. the restroom was lovely and the dining room is very spacious and was perfect for enjoying some pizza in on our first night. we would love to stay here again for another trip to ny. i particularly loved the close proximity to the subway which made getting just about anywhere super easy. thank you!!!
the experience was great!

from the moment i walked into the apartment i knew this was a different kind of airbnb experience. the interior decoration is beautiful and each room looks great in its own unique way, with chandeliers, mosaics and chic modern art all around. cynthia is a generous and kind person who went out of her way to make my five days in new york as fun and easy as it could possibly be. there are lots of grocery stores, restaurants, and things to do in the area, and walking around was pretty safe at night. central park is a five minute walk, the subway is 90 seconds away, and there's also the metro museum of art about a 15 minute walk away. all really convenient, but if you'll be spending most of your time downtown then lower manhattan is very easy to get to in about 20-25 minutes on the subway, and times square is about the same with one train transfer on the way. cynthia was extremely considerate and always thinking ahead - she really is a wonderful host in what many might see as an intimidating city. new york is a great city full of predominantly great people, and cynthia really made it feel that way as soon as i got there - after the first night i was more than comfortable and really enjoyed myself, when maybe i would have been a bit tentative going out at night by myself, it was great. i absolutely loved my stay and will be trying to make sure that all my friends stay with cynthia when visiting this great city in the future.

wayne was awesome.... i went for my mom's funeral and his well wishes and condolences met me there..... he made a hard time easy for me......the place is emaculate.... he responses was quick......everything you need is right there...... close to everything.... i would stay here everytime i come.... just on a better note

we could not be more pleased with our stay! our hosts truly thought of everything our guests may need. we stayed with our one year old the downstairs bedroom was dark peaceful and perfect for her naps and bedtime and we got to enjoy the beautiful kitchen and living room for movies. it is a two minute walk to a ton of restaurants theatre the park the subway and really lovely neighborhood vibe. the place was perfect comfortable and well thought out our host was so sweet and communicative and we had the best time. don’t miss out on this place we almost hesitated to review because it’s that good- you want to gatekeep!
edgar and his cat digi were the best hosts. such a warm welcome, lots of natural light. overall the place has style and soul. thank you two for a wonderful stay.
great location. the room is small but you won't be staying there that much. location across from central park and near museums and amazing restaurants. definitely great value.

photos listed are accurate- apartment is nice and cozy in a great location in the city. perfect for two people. the host was always responsive, helpful and acted promptly, as well as everyone else in the building. stayed here for a little over two months and would do it again!
very stylish place. close to the train and good food spots. would highly recommend
had an amazing time very clean and very responsive. love the time i had and love the time i spend. amazing host!
great space! great host!
the apartment was exactly as the photos and the host was quick to respond if i had a question. thank you for everything!
nice place to visit new york. great location although a bit noisy. nice room more spacious than i thought. host quick to answer

the best airbnb host you could search for in this area. micheal was super accommodating for us not once, but twice and always kept us in his loop. the house was very clean and is perfect for a private getaway or if you need to bunk the night in the brooklyn area. we enjoyed our stay and look forward to more stays with micheal!
its a very big apartment, 10 minutes to the subway and supermarket, evething work perfect and its very clean ! we are very happy with are stay !
a great place to stay in a fun neighborhood for an unbelievably good value.
verena our host was wonderful. she is a friendly person and she gave us every thing we needed. every thing that was written was true.
the best airbnb experience you can find in ny! super clean, friendly hosts, private, and inexpensive for the value you get. love the location too, trains are close. highly recommend🤌

we were very satisfied with our choice to stay with sharon. it is a lovely area in brooklyn. not to crowded, very local and with a nice tavern and café around the corner. all communication went very smooth - hope to be able to visit again some time!

j's place was, as advertised, great for parents! my mil and brother in law were in town to meet our new baby so we needed something close (we live in downtown brooklyn) and spacious. the location was ideal and j was an exceptional host. she met me in person to give me the lay of the land, which offered plenty of space for the two of them. j had an extra room available at the time of their stay and graciously offered it as well at no extra charge. the garden was a big part of why we booked the place, and it was gorgeous. j had warned me ahead of time about the mosquitoes...i would recommend bringing repellent if booking in the summertime, they were pretty aggressive! overall very happy with j's place and her generous hospitality.

the apartment was great. it was exactly what we needed; 3 separate bedrooms, a living room and full kitchen. it felt like a home which was very nice. the best part was that it is on the same block as the express b and q trains so getting into the city was a breeze. would definitely recommend staying here
very clean very lucrative experience and nice
overall great stay. easy check-in and very close to subway stations to go anywhere in the city.

we had a fantastic stay at this lower east side apartment! the location is unbeatable—just steps from the subway and surrounded by great restaurants, shops, and everything nyc has to offer. the apartment is walking distance to chinatown, little italy and soho. highly recommend this place for couples or small groups looking for a clean and convenient home base in nyc. would definitely stay here again!

one thing i can say about this airbnb it’s one of the best ones i’ve stayed in new york city. its on a great street restaurant right next-door food is ok not our taste.now let me tell you about this peaceful lovely home it was a lovely welcome gift which i thought was very sweet and thoughtful the jacuzzi was so relaxing the shower was amazing it’s like a spa in essential oils going throughout the home and make it so peaceful was so clean she answered all my questions i had no issues definitely a great airbnb

the bed was very comfortable, and the area had plenty of good restaurants and was convenient to the l line. however, the place had a noticeable smell (maybe from the cat?), and the living room was cluttered and disheveled, which made me never want to be in it. overall, not bad pricing for nyc, and julie was a nice host. plus, her cat was super sweet.

pleasantly surprised with the space! felt like i had the whole thing to myself. stayed for two nights. wasn’t there most of the time but i didn’t see alex once except for our greeting at my initial arrival. bed was fresh. bathroom was spotless. i didn’t use the kitchen but looks like everything that you need was there including a full sized fridge. plenty of things to eat in the waking or delivery distance. couple mins from major metro and bus stops. 10/10.

great place and the nicest people you could possibly wish to meet. and their children are so nice and welcoming. the apartment itself is perfectly private and separate from the house above and has its own entrance.

we have stayed here a couple of times but this time, i checked in late due to delayed flight and they were so responsive and accommodating. they gave me a higher level room which was great. walking distance to port authority bus & times square. subway is within the port authority bus so everything is so accessible. free breakfast was really good. just make sure to go down early cause it could get crowded. they also store luggages for checked out guests for free. i would definitely recommend this place & will surely book it again.
the apartment was really clean! few minutes walk to the 7 train, easy connections. very responsive host and peaceful neighborhood. would recommend!!

diane was a great host. very pleasant and easy to work with. the apartment is centrally located near transportation, shops, and restaurants. easy to get to the city from here. thanks for a pleasant month's stay!
the apartment is quite spacious and in a perfect location - we really enjoyed our stay!

jerry's place is a modern basement apartment that comfortably sleeps 4 adults (with full size pull out sofa). the location is great, only two blocks away from a metro straight to manhattan. bathroom and kitchen are new and well maintained. our only issue was noise. the ceiling and walls are thin, and we got unlucky with quite a bit of night disturbance from upstairs (loid voices/steps/thuds). this is obviously outside of jerry's control, but just something to be aware of. earplugs recommended for a better experience at night!
mante was great! the apartment it’s only at 2min walking from the metro station, and 5 minutes walking from the central park!

very nice private room, it honestly felt a lot more like a tiny studio. there were so many little things like an extra loofah, heated blanket, bottle opener, etc. that really made it feel like the host put a lot of thought into setting up the room!

i recommend this location, as it was affordable, safe, clean, comfortable, and the host was very kind and communicative. being so close to the metro made it super easy to get around to different parts of the city, and the price point was very affordable for the two bedroom lodging in nyc! additionally, there were great amenities and nice touches such as cold water bottles in the fridge, as well as a coffee maker with complimentary coffee, and fridge to store our leftovers. we were a group of three, and all were very happy with our stay!
have stayed here multiple times. love the location and easy convenience.

excellent value! cute and spacious for brooklyn. the sky lights are a nice touch. not super close to the trains, about a 10 min walk to ralph or 15-20 to utica. neighborhood is relatively quiet. really good value and and excellent hosts.

leo was a great host. since i was so busy before going to new york, i forgot to contact him. he contacted me and took care of me first. he was very responsive and thoughtful. my friend and i never felt uncomfortable while staying his place. the place was very silent, so perfect to be relaxed.

this place clean & quiet we enjoyed staying at annicks. we were the only ones on the floor making it feel as if it was our own. we had lots of privacy and loved the fact that it had it's own entrance so we did bother our host when coming in late at night. annick gave great heat during the severe weather that we experienced a few days ago. this charming bedroom was the perfect romantic getaway . parking was decent and not too hard to find. i highly recommend staying here stars*****.and 4 thumbs up.
it was so clean and quiet and had parking!
this was a fantastic location, a short walk away from the subway. seda is a lovely host and the apartment is very quiet and clean, peaceful. i would definitely stay here again!
great location in a lively neighborhood. apartment had everything we needed. kristina was a super host. would definitely stay here again.
the place was clean and comfortable. i highly recommend if you are looking for a place to stay in the area.

stefanie was a great host. very communicative and her place was designed so thoughtfully and i loved the vintage decor. ac in the summer was key and the bed was very comfortable. location is great and so close to tompkins and popular restaurants and shops in east village. overall, her space was as clean as it could be. i will say, the building itself isn’t the nicest or as well-maintained as others. i’ve actually stayed on the same street in another airbnb, where the building was much better—stairs, common areas, character, bathrooms, kitchen, etc. that also means you can hear footsteps on the floor above and doors/any loud conversation from the hallway. not a deal breaker for us, just a note. and i think because of those factors, it’s reflected in the reasonable price. not a knock on the host, wanted to note for other renters. thanks for an enjoyable stay!
nice place to stay in ny, near by everything!

great stay!! nice place to come back to shower and catch some zz's. i rarely heard much noise from my room besides 12pm kids from the school would scream at recess. plenty of bathroom space to put all my makeup and appliances. (hairdyrer, iron, microwave, mini refrigerator)!
great location and attentive, extremely helpful host. you will not be disappointed
my family and i had a good stay in brooklyn. this is a great place with full kitchen, comfortable beds and close to subway.

we had a great stay! the host was very friendly and always responded quickly to any questions we had. the house was clean, nicely decorated, and had everything we needed — perfect for a family trip. the unique touches in the decor really made it feel cozy and welcoming. just a heads-up: the street can be a bit noisy at night due to traffic, but it wasn’t a big issue for us. also, there’s free street parking available, but make sure to check the signs for time restrictions. would definitely recommend!

i take accountability for not updating the correct number of guests, but the listing clearly said the price was per person — not per person per night. even though it states “up to 5 people,” the host tried to charge me an extra $120. i agreed to pay half of that because it was my mistake, but i still had to call airbnb, which took time out of my day while i was already dealing with airport delays. another issue is the $3.50 tax fee. they didn’t mention that after a certain hour it becomes cash-only, so i had to figure that out at 4 am due to my delayed arrival. customer service at the front desk was not helpful at all. i’m sure these things can be fixed, but the fact that the host attempted to overcharge me tells me a lot about what to expect. i booked through airbnb thinking the service and clarity would be better, but it seems cheaper and more straightforward to book directly through their website. the location was the only good thing. the room itself was average.
adams place definitely is amazing. and he’s a great host.
home was as described and accommodating.

location was exceptional, great access to subway lines, restaurants and anything else you need. apartment was a good size and well equipped. had some issues with the water pressure, but nina was responsive. sound insulation could be better but the street is usually quiet so not too much of an issue. overall a good stay with some minor issues.
my boyfriend and i loved the king sky room at alro nomad! we will definitely be booking again. great location and a fun lil romantic get away with your significant other. 10/10
nice place to stay, about a 10-15 minute walk to the train station. plenty of convenience store and restaurant. enjoyed my stay. would stay again
a really great place for the price. you would enjoy the comfort.

i really enjoyed this stay in queens, new york. the place was clean and very comfortable. the host, tekecia was very nice, understanding, and friendly. there are a lot of local stores and fast food restaurants around the place. you won't go wrong booking this! the house is private and gated in a safe area that's close to everything. you will notice most airbnb take photos of their places that do not really match what they are in real life but tekecia’s place is exactly like the photos. 10/10 highly recommend , would stay here again.
great adress- soho/noho/ east vilage and little italy and chinatown in walking distance. the best - upper deck tereace with view- manhattan skyline - to enjoy whenever you want - sunset or sunrise👍
great cozy place! quiet neighborhood and easy access to everything. chuck was away when i was there so i didn't get the chance to fully thank him. awesome guy, thanks chuck!
great place to stay. i’ve stayed here multiple times always worth it.
this spot is a great value. it’s a less than 10 minute walk to the j train with nice cafes and restaurants all around.
it’s in an amazing neighborhood away from the tourist traps but still very walkable to central park and other beautiful places
cute place for couples to relax!
beebe was an excellent host and the stay was exactly as described. would definitely return!

staying at richelle place was an unique experience. i loved her passion for life and the warm welcome she deserved to me. she let me discover some unique places in ny and i did enjoy sharing our experiences and getting to know her and her son who is a talented young artist. her apartment is very cute and extremely clean. it is conveniently located at walking distance to all major ny attractions and very close to central park. last but not least richelle's home made biscuits and muffins ! i definitively recommend to choose her place and discovering richelle exciting world.

ming’s apartment was a perfect apartment for both short and longer stays. we found the space incredibly clean, with excellent amenities and space to unpack and feel at home. it is close to all williamsburg facilities - food stores, coffee shops, bars and transport all close. the street is very quiet. ming was always available, responded promptly to any query we had and was a perfect host. we loved the apartment and will certainly stay there again in future. john and jacqui (australia)

spacious, spotless, comfortable room with its own bathroom for a reasonable price?? in a great location? i’d stay again in a heartbeat next time i’m visiting nyc!! only downside: i did hear trains at night but i’m a light sleeper. otherwise fantastic stay.

you get a tiny room with a single bed. works fine if you want to explore the city during the day and just need a bed to crash in at night. it was very humid and hot in the room. the showers and restrooms were also fine. i would personally not stay again but just because i’m not a fan of shared restrooms and showers.

really comfortable in this cute airbnb. super surprised at how big it felt compared to what i expected. everything was super clean, not cluttered, soft sheets, soft towels, and great water pressure in shower. communication with the owner was excellent both pre stay and during our stay. not cons, just awareness to future renters: 1) yappy dog next door and very close to twin bed room. dog is out all hours barking and definitely impacted my son's sleep. i woud bring ear plugs for sure. 2) no shampoo/bath gel. def don't forget yours 3) other than salt & pepper, there are no extra spices or cooking items. so think about what to bring if you plan on eating in. kitchen very usable - we ate in 5 of our 6 meals, but i did have to buy everything from sugar, garlic salt, butter stix. not a big deal - just an awareness. 4) i did not feel safe walking in the area by myself - fyi you need a car loved the tv set up in main & master bedroom. watched a few movies. a great stay and great experience
very nice and very clean. worth the stay!
a very large and clean 1bedroom flat. perfect for a small family. the area is very safe. don t forget to visit the local wine shop in the corner of the street.
thanks! reliable and perfect for a one night move. as a foreigner, a bit expensive though but i guess this is new york city prices.
very comfortable apartment in ideal location!
very spacious and private. definitely would recommend

i was on a jfk airport layover and stayed at the room for one night. the arrival time was flexible due to the self-check-in, which was very convenient given that i was arriving late at night. it was easy to find the house and open the doors. to my delight i found a small stock of microwave popcorn, which i gladly consumed for breakfast. bathroom was good. i recommend monisha's place.
enjoyed our stay here! i’ve stayed at this location in several different units and have been satisfied every time! will definitely stay again

my 11 yo daughter and dog stayed in eduardo’s lovely home for 2 weeks. it was our first time staying in the city and eduardo was great! he was so fast to answer all of our questions and so accommodating. we were in town for my daughter to take classes and i worked all day. the location was amazing. easy walk to anywhere and the best dog park is only 10 mins away! at least 3 amazing grocery stores; a full range of restaurants if you can’t be bothered to cook; tons of work out options; and at least 3 great dog groomers all within a 5-10 min walk. there’s a reasonably priced parking garage immediately across the street and a bunch more near by and we had no problems unloading and loading up the car over the weekend. his home was so clean and comfortable and offered a perfect respite from the hustle and bustle. i was on calls all day at a desk in one of the bedrooms and it was perfect. a cozy sectional to relax on and plenty of options to stream. we were much later to check out than we originally planned and eduardo was incredibly accommodating. thank you for making our first nyc trip amazing!

debbie hosted our group for labor day weekend at her beautiful beach house. debbie was very hospitable and made our stay incredibly comfortable. the house itself is ideally situated, just a few steps from the beach. easy access to restaurants and grocery stores as well.
jeff was a great host. the location was convenient for us. we enjoyed the lovely claw foot bath tub. if you are visiting pratt institute, this is a super close spot to rent.

the house is very clean, big, well renovated, close to the subway, nice neighborhood. we did not meet the hosts but the communication went smoothly. we certainly recommend this house for a group of 8 people.
great location, cool space. the bed was very comfortable and much bigger than expected. enjoyed our stay here!

this two bedroom one bathroom with in unit washer and dryer retreat from the concrete jungle was not only refreshing but a well enjoyed change of pace from do usual living situation. the spacious apartment never felt too cramped and actually had an insane amount of organization and was well stocked with supplies from cleaning to kitchen utilities. with it being right next to a bus route everything is within either walking distance or a short bus ride away. guy was super helpful and very friendly with any questions that we had. would highly recommend this place and will definitely stay again.
the place is definitely good to stay. the roommates very nice and kind. i totally recommend it if you come alone to nyc.

the work into the space is evident. sadly noise carried from the upstairs late into the night. not conducive for light sleepers. it is smaller that the impression given in the pictures. convenient for the si ferry. not sure who was upstairs but garbage bags were left in the front yard the whole weekend. it’s obvious wanda cares, and we know some visitors won’t.
skippy is a good host. a very knowledgeable and a kind man.
walkable distance to upper east side and central park! this apartment was very spacious and had everything we needed.
great place very clean & quiet would recommend this place to anyone great host!!!
this was an amazing stay

the apartment was lovely, with lots of room for all of our group. big bedroom and very usable kitchen with all of the necessities. nice location, always felt safe, and used the subway every day. even a small grocery store across the street. joy was very helpful and always responded quickly. she even left us lots of info about the area, restaurants, etc. not a lot of noise from the outside, but the ceiling must be very thin because the only noise issue was hearing the neighbors above us. i would certainly recommend this place and hostess!

the location is really good, but the room is in poor condition with many things not working properly. the host was very responsive but was unable to actually help us during our stay besides directing us to the front desk.
wonderful place, thoughtful touches and above all very clean.
exactly as described, easy to find and access, very helpful host. perfect.

nathalie was very welcoming and communicated very well and promptly. she left us very clear instructions on everything about the apartment and was very gracious. the place was absolutely wonderful, clean, charming, and very beautiful in its historic details, furnishings and international decor. we felt warm and cozy on the rainy cold days we stayed there in december. our elderly mother was very comfortable and it meant so much to her to have a place where her family could gather. the kitchen was well stocked with everything needed. the light and layout of the apartment was excellent, and the backyard upper deck was beautiful and private feeling, like the rest of the apartment. we would have enjoyed using it had the weather been better. the pictures show the place very well, but the details of the two fireplace mantel pieces, the old plaster moldings, the wood work and chandeliers were wonderful to see. all in all, a great place for us to land for our family gathering in a perfect neighborhood. we are very grateful, nathalie!

jennifer's house is clean, in a great location in a quiet, safe neighborhood that is easy to access by public transportation (and has a driveway for parking as well as plenty of street parking). everything you need plus more; modern and clean appliances that work well, good internet and ac/heat, smart tvs, plenty of space and well equipped kitchen. would definitely stay again!
outstanding staff and lovely, comfortable accommodations. much roomier and airier than typical nyc locales.

this was a good value for the location. our room (904) was very clean. the pictures are accurate. there is a lot of outdoor noise, but this was expected. free earplugs are provided. the wifi was reliable. they accommodated our request for early check-in and late check-out. this was a good place to stay for an extended weekend in manhattan!
awesome stay. initially booked it for a week and booked another month extension. quiet place. good communication with the host, garnet. definitely recommend for long-term stays.
abdoulaye is a very nice guy and a good host . he is diaponible to help whenever i needed him. we got along so well that i decided to rebook again with him .
super cute and clean little apartment. great for one or two nights.

pedro is a great host, always responsive, he let me leave my things for a few hours after checkout and pick them up later. the location is great and the place is as described, very clean. if i come back to visit new york, i will book this again for sure.
verry accurate with the photos, great hospitality and quick response
very clean, communicated very quickly, and the apartment as a whole was very comfortable.
great place! extremely accommodating. perfect for families
great place. super clean. newly renovated. hosts very responsive.
beautiful spot, very clean and close to transportation. great communication and hospitality. highly recommend.

wanda’s apartment was ideally located for visiting all the major highlights of ny. the apartment was spotlessly clean, felt like a real home and the extra little touches and attention to detail made it stand out for us. we would definitely visit here again and really appreciate how responsive our hosts were. thanks for helping make our visit to the big apple do special.

worked for us because it was a great central location to go anywhere and it was within our budget. place is clean and well maintained, not very large but larger places would cost more. we will come back.

we stayed for a month and a half and we felt right at home! it was in a great location and only a 10 minute walk to the subway. it’s a prime location for tourists to explore brooklyn!! the hosts are super kind and responsive. it’s close to a lot of great restaurants. it’s excellent for long stays since they have a laundry mat right up the street. there’s also a few grocery stores that are very easy to walk to. not to mention their patio is beautiful in the summer!! we loved our time here and we highly recommend!:) thank you!

although i didn't get to meet alina, everything went smoothly, she arranged for her neighbour to meet me on arrival who let me in and made me feel welcome. the place was perfect for our needs, great location, everything as described, would certainly stay again!

the host was highly responsive and communicative throughout the stay. the space was cute, private, and well maintained. everything was clean and met a high standard. i especially appreciated the thoughtful details, including the matching microwave and dish sets . i would happily book again in the future.
loved it here definitely would come again for any future stays thank you jamie you were a great host

i couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. the room was very clean, and has everything you need including a comfortable bed. the reviews and pictures won't let you down. marie was a superb host. she was very helpful and gave some great recommendations about the area/food. i'm looking forward to stay again.
beautiful room in good location with less than a 5 minute walk to the subway! loved our stay here and would stay again
3rd time booking and if this place is available when i need to travel i will always book with them😌
i had a great time staying at manuels place! the apartment and room were incredibly clean and manuel was all around a great host.

my brother and i stayed at rose’s place for 5 days during our first trip to nyc! we couldn’t have found a better space for us. it was such a cute and cozy little area with the perfect amount of space for 2! short walking distance to many restaurants/convince stores, and lots of tips from rose & her family for local eats/sight seeing. we couldn’t have asked for a better host for our first trip and we hope to visit again sometime!!

everything went very smoothly and the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. the place was clean and quiet. i really appreciated the included breakfast. the room was small, but there was enough space for my luggage. the price paid would be expensive in other cities for this kind of accommodation, but it was worth the price in nyc. the location was very good as it was just some minutes walk from the penn station.
so comfortable and nice quiet area . my friend and i felt safe, and comfortable
best stay and best host ever!! thanks a million for a wonderful time ingrid, we had a blast! so happy we rented an extra night, we were in heaven :) we will be in touch soon, it was per-fect!!

a great apartment in a great location. the space was very clean, and is a very large two bedroom. the shared kitchen is on the floor below, but we had too many great restaurants in the vicinity to cook a meal ourselves. the beds are soft, but comfy. we stayed here on halloween weekend, and we could hear the college kids in front of beetle house in the evening. but during the week, the noise level from the street wasn't noticeable. we would have extended our stay, if we could. but we will definitely be back.

greg’s place is in a perfect location and he and/or his parents are always around (though not in the way) to answer any questions. easy check in process and greg let us check out late due to our flight! the heater works very well so it does get a little warm but it was freezing outside so it felt good. would happily stay here again!
it was a comfortable place, immaculate, safe, and spacious. the landlord is responsible and caring for his accommodations and guests. it was a pleasure to stay there.

the place is clean and renovated, all amenities are provided. we spent a wonderful weekend to go to the us open, it was very close and convenient. it was a great stay and ferdousi was accurate and responsive. and on top of that she provided us with coffee k cups and saved us the hustle of going for coffee in the morning ( dunkin’ is close though). would recommend the place, we had a comfortable stay. 5 stars.
great place to stay and a nice balcony to sit on see the city.

the house is quite amazing, comfortable and fun. the kitchen is well equipped. the bedrooms are comfortable, space is very sufficient. we came with 3 teens and had ample room and privacy for everybody. there are great restaurants in the area, walk to the subway takes about 10 minutes. i liked the neighborhood in general - it is very diverse and up and coming. the only thing that did not quite fulfill my expectation was the garden - it is not usable, overgrown with tall weeds and not tended.
we had a great stay! host were very accommodating

my partner and i had a lovely weekend here and the place was exactly as described. very clean, cozy, safe and private - and the house was well situated just a short walk from the subway and some nice cafes. would absolutely recommend for a short stay in nyc!
nice clean apartment close to manhattan would definitely recommend staying here
great location, lovely host and minnie
the stay was a treat.
nyesha’s placed was great and the communication was outstanding throughout. super easy self check-in and close to some great coffee shops around the corner. would book again.

it’s a clean and well organized studio. the parking space was real nice for me. the location is convenient. but a lot of noise was from the street . but we had a good night sleep nevertheless. highly recommend

the apartment was everything as described and more - we felt at home. the location is close to subway and buses which provide easy access to all parts of new york. the apartment is located in an area which has good access to amenities, shops and restaurants and we felt very safe in the area. jeffrey had everything organized for us and when we had any questions he promptly replied and provided us with assistance.
steve’s place is a gem: super tall ceilings, skylights, huge soaking tub, nice kitchen,near subways and shops, clean and comfortable.
great location, great price, a good place to stay for a short break in manhattan. phil was friendly and helpful.
great location, beautiful apartment, overall amazing experience!

kostas’s location was beautiful, clean, organized, and stocked. it felt comfortable and nice. the location is great, only a couple blocks from steinway street. checking in and out was easy enough. we had a very pleasant time.
great communication, clean and nice.
great place, super clean and spacious. walking distance to both a and 4 train into town. peter very helpful, would definitely revisit.

ken was an amazing host from to finish. he and his wife were very hospitable and welcoming toward us. the space is perfect for a quick stay and totally worth the inexpensive price. it has all that you need. the house is close by to many restaurants, public transportation, and is in between greenwood cemetery and prospect park :-) i would definitely recommend to others and would book again. thanks ken!

we had a great time in new york at robins apartment. robin was friendly and helpful. the apartment was clean, comfortable and conveniently located to explore the city. we would definitely stay there again, if we ever visit new york again.
very nice place. easy communication. near to subway stations.
this was a return stay and will definitely come here again! a very special experience. cozy and peaceful.
amazing location! this apartment was perfect for my family of 5! it had everything we needed!

the location is perfect! very walkable with great restaurants nearby. the staff was very courteous and helpful. the room was clean and had plenty of space, which is hard to come by at this price point! highly recommended for a trip to nyc!

lovely stay in brooklyn. the spotless apartment is on the middle floor of a three-story building — two bedrooms and a small but complete kitchen, perfect for our needs. our host was thoughtful and easy to communicate with, and her tips on the subway and local shops were a huge help. she even went above and beyond to help us secure a parking spot. a quick note for mold-sensitive travelers: i'm on the more sensitive end of the spectrum and had zero reaction here — the space felt clean and fresh throughout. would happily book again
latanya was a fantastic host, very responsive and the apartment was super clean. about a 20 min walk to the subway station and a very quiet neighbourhood.
we had an awesome stay. the room felt very homey. it was more than enough for what we needed. since we were out all day. the traffic noise wasn’t terrible. highly recommend staying.

my stay at stan's apartment was excellent. i was late arriving due to nyc traffic; however, stan stayed and made certain that i was able to get in and knew where everything was located. he was extremely cordial and accommodating. by brooklyn standards, this is an above average apartment both in size and amenities. it has a very large sitting room with a warm atmosphere due to the furniture and stan's unique decorations from his travels. the bedroom is downstairs and has a washer and dryer room next to it. the bed is very comfortable. the kitchen is more than adequate and has everything needed for preparing meals, if needed. there is a modern large screen television set in the living room that is open to the kitchen. there is a small garden area in the back that is meticulously attended by stan. overall, my stay of four nights was very comfortable and very brooklyn. this is in the fort greene area of brooklyn. this is a very safe and upscale area with many restaurants to choose from. there is the added bonus of stan's apartment being located directly across from washington park with its many activities and area to run. the view from the front door is the park. i would definitely stay at this location again.

staying at uma's was one of my best experiences with airbnb. uma is very friendly and accommodating. her place is clean and she provided us with everything we needed. she even got a blender so that we could make smoothies. uma's place is essentially a studio with private entrance that makes you feel at home. she and her son even allowed us to leave our luggage with them for a little longer after our check out time so that we could tour around the city a little longer. she went the extra mile in so many ways. i do find her place to be a gem in airbnb, also because it has access to all the metro system! thank you very much, uma 🙂
jenny made to sure to welcome us to the apartment and make sure we were comfortable, she was great at getting back to me if we needed anything. she was a great host. we enjoyed our stay and the area!
we enjoyed staying at angel's. it was a nice apartment in a great neighborhood.
wonderful location and great space!

nice, sunny, basic apartment. good location close to restaurants and small grocery stores. easy walk to the g and a/c subway stations. we stayed a week to visit family in the neighborhood. i think this might be better for a shorter stay since the studio is small and the cooking options are limited with only a 2 burner cooktop and no microwave. fairly quiet but there is some noise from guests at other apartments in the building.
easy to find and check in, the place matched the description and was fairly walkable to yankee stadium. we didn’t spend much time there but it was plenty comfortable for the time we spent

katya's place is easy to find, well located, stylish and quiet. katya is a great host - she's busy but flexible and found time to chat and give us tips, but also gave us lots of privacy and space. she really made us feel at home and we loved living at katya's place for a few days. definitely would recommend.

located on the border of brooklyn and queens, close to subway line j, good for short solo visits to new york city. patrick is a good host and was kind enough to allow me to check--in an hour early. dilip

we stayed at garcia's for two nights. everything was very easy and garcia was very responsive. this place is a great value near prospect park. i recommend it for anyone staying in that part of brooklyn.
it’s an excellent option antony and dalia are super comprehensive and helpful. the apartment was perfect and it had everything
loved the property and location. eric is a wonderful and thorough host. our stay was a 10/10 would recommend.

my friends and i enjoyed our short stay at michael’s place. it was exactly as pictured and the arrangement was comfortable. we appreciated that each room is individually temperature controlled. michael was very responsive and helpful before and during our stay.
janet was so friendly and supportive. the house was super clean, quiet, and lovely.
we had a very nice staying at alex and lorelei's, the room is quite large and cozy, having "our" floor was comfortable.

candlewood suites is pretty straightforward: basic rooms with the benefit of a kitchen. we got a great price for manhattan, and the hotel was very quiet. no view except of windows from our room. very nice to have a laundry room, which was clean and tidy. we used it a few times in our week’s stay to make our carried-on wardrobe disappear. we also worked remotely and found the plug situation adequate. elevators were fast; we only waited more than a minute or two once or twice. gym was small but fine for two or three people at a time. we had housecleaning twice in a week -/ once more than promised. we had no problem getting more towels, etc., from a housekeeper other times. very friendly desk people. it took two requests to get a lightbulb replaced. maintenance took care of something else — forgetting what now —more promptly. the hotel next store has an atm. our lobby usually had cold water and a free beverage like lemonade for guests. location was excellent for our purposes.

we had a wonderful stay at gladys’s place. the check in and access was super easy. when we arrived everything seemed very well cleaned, except the bed sheets….they did not appear washed or clean. we actually went and bought some cheap ones. besides that, the location, safety, and overall stay was great. the subway station is a 3 min walk down the street that takes you right into the heart nyc, from midtown (all the main sights times square, etc.) all the way to downtown. we used this daily and it was super easy! it’s about a 25min subway ride to midtown. we felt safe and comfortable during our stay! this is a great place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city after a long day.
our go to hotel in nyc. kid friendly, great location, and nice staff.

our host met two of us and was helpful in showing us the bedrooms , closets, wc's, and all other rooms and laundry that could be used. however, i feel a more thorough walk through might have been necessary for example explaining why some linens were not up to par or lamoshade alltorn up or any furniture which might be susceptible to damage etc i think our host needs to hire and monitor a better cleaning service however. the 1 tub was very dirty with moldy shower curtain and soap with hair on it the one bedroom had a child's sock and underwear under the bed and also very many dust bunnies. the washer worked but she asked we not change water hot/ cold level cause it was not working well. our host was helpful, there were staples to use for breakfast but also the electric coffee maker was moldy and not cleaned the internet pw's were hand written not typed and it was difficult to decipher . she also left her museum entry cards for our use which was very nice of her . her telephone line was ringing downstairs to our unit which was a little annoying.
great apt! super clean, modern and spacious. would recommend 100%
stella is a nice and friendly person, always response quickly, the best thing was that letting us put luggage after checked out, that was really helpful and sweet!!

i had a lovely stay at this gorgeous place, it was perfect for a few days. the street is really quiet at night and i slept well. the location is perfect, very close to the subway and chelsea and west village neighbourhoods a short walk away. alex and his team were very thoughtful from check-in to throughout the stay and left some lovely touches, including flowers and a bottle of wine. i would definitely stay again, thank you for a great nyc base during my stay.
fantastic airbnb! super comfy, exactly as described and a wonderful respite in the city! david was a great host, super thoughtful and communicative. highly recommend!

this place is incredibly amazing. super cozy and clean. the ambience is pleasant and soothing. peaceful and nice neighborhood, lots of nice restaurants and shops nearby. it feels like home and make u don't want to leave cos everything u need to make it home is being provided like clean linens n utensils. laura and hugo are always super helpful and responsive. will always stay here whenever i visit new york

allen and ann were amazing hosts, we especially loved having breakfast with them. they have been in the area for awhile and have so many great stories about how brooklyn and the city has changed. their place is a few blocks from multiple subway stops and a perfect location to be out of the city. would definitely stay there again and would recommend!
great place, and i intend on staying again.
lacy's listing was as described and she provided great communication throughout the process.
love patrick’s please, it everything i for when renting and airbnb.
the place was as in photos. quiet neighborhood. jacqueline was very responsive to any messages.
fast responses, great location. thanks!

marie- claire was an amazing super host and very helpful. her place felt home from home and was spotless. location was near to the subway, manhattan only 15 mins away. i would highly recommend this property.

wonderful little place to stay, though smaller rooms, like i had, do not contain the same "upbeat classic hollywood" vibe their pictures do. there are definitely a few "landlord specials" sprinkled in like wall sockets being glued on cattywonkus, but for the area, price was pretty good and front desk was always kind and open to answering questions from the random southern girl in room 202
very convenient, near public transit. clean and quiet
absolutely loved staying here. really enjoyed our time, great neighborhood, superb hospitality. highly recommend!
clean, spacious, convenient and well stocked. the kitchen and bathroom were well stocked. it was a great stay!
great place, great location and will defiantly stay again in the future.. thanks oskari
very nice apartment with ability to sleep four. clean, great set up, warm and at a great price. we will look to book this spot again!!

i could not be happier with my ~5 week stay with jess. from day 1, the place gave off such a bright and welcoming vibe, it was easy to feel right at home. jess is wonderful and so helpful. the room was spacious and very comfortable, with ample natural light and comfy bed. the location could not be better. i enjoyed the proximity to the beautiful long island city waterfront and also loved the nearby restaurants and cafes off of vernon st. i had a great stay and would recommend jessica's place in a heartbeat. thanks jess!
this apartment is great and the woodwork really is as beautiful as in the picture. easy, effortless and conveniently located, highly recommended.

i loved staying with marie. i felt like i have gained a new friend and will definitely connect with her when i am back in the area. her place is very clean and organized. she is incredibly accommodating and will give you as much space as you need or interact with you as much as you want. she is an incredibly kind host and i would without a doubt stay with her again. wifi was fast enough for me to work and be in all day long zoom meetings too which was a huge plus.
bed was comfortable! location was perfect for me. i would stay again.

we’re a family of 6, two tween/teen girls, my husband, brother and dad. there was enough space for all of us and had everything we needed. it was clean and neat when we arrived. the laundry machine was great for the new york summer. air conditioning was great. as others said, the 2 and 5 train is 2.5 blocks away and about 45 ride to times square without transferring. and there is everything you need a half a block away - plenty of bodegas etc. yaakov is an incredibly responsive and thoughtful host. we ran out of a supply and we got a resupply that day. thank you for a great stay!
dan was incredibly accommodating. the apartment was clean and just perfect.
nice flat close to a metro station direct to new-york.

i had an incredible experience staying at linda's house. the experience started even before i arrived at her house, coming out of the station at flushing, greeted by the tune of a musician playing a traditional chinese instrument, finding myself at the center of a large chinatown with an amazing special energy all its own. from the central street with a macy's and all the chinese and korean stores and restaurants, i made a turn toward her house onto a quiet street, and the walk was peaceful and beautiful. when i arrived at her door i heard the sound of a "furin", a traditional japanese wind chime. this is a sound that stirs up a sense of deep peace and nostalgia in the heart of most japanese people, especially hearing it in another country far away from home. i was delighted to learn that linda and her husband have a deep connection to japanese culture and language. this was also evident in the many design choices in their house, reminding me of what i see when in japan because of the many expressions of east-west fusion, the attention to detail and mindfulness toward both the visual and aural senses, the immaculate cleanliness, and the creativity. linda is an incredible host and such a kind beautiful person. she made me feel genuinely welcome and put me at total ease instantly - within 5 minutes i was in an inspiring conversation ranging from art and culture to language. any question i had she always kindly responded right away, and did the same at the time of booking which thankfully made my very last-minute booking possible. the house seemed to breath both peace and life, offering an abundance of privacy and quiet, with green plants, totally adorable cats, and a parrot. also nice was all the well-thought out details that reflected linda's kindness and hospitality, such as cute friendly signs to help make things easy while making you smile. on the door of my room was a hand-written sign welcoming me. the room was wonderful, with a window facing the garden, and a very comfortable bed. thank you so much linda - i had a blissful 3 days!
the best! every time we are in new york for work we are staying here

this was one of my all time favorite airbnb stays, and definitely the best in nyc! the host’s instructions were clear and they were super great at promptly answering any questions. the apartment was lovely, with privacy, space, cleanliness all amazing. and the bed was the most comfortable mattress i’ve ever slept on! lovely neighborhood too with easy access to trains and lots to do nearby!
great location, immaculately clean, and a very good value. mary has prepared a good booklet of information on the neighborhood which was very helpful. i would definitely stay there again.
vladimirs space was excellent. a superb space for anyone’s stay in the upper east side!

great place close to everything. just a short walk to many of the things people want to see in nyc. checked in after midnight and there was a guy ready and available at the front desk. atmosphere was chill. room was good for my wife and i with 5 older kids. one bathroom was a bit tough, but there was a two bathroom option.

lovely stay! i was nervous about staying in the city, but marjorie made me feel right at home. great communication, beautiful apartment, great location, private room and bathroom. it’s a steal for the price! definitely recommend!

place is well furnished, and there is so much to do in the area. sandra and greg were great hosts, and offered many tips on what do in the area. despite being in the middle of manhattan, the place was fairly quiet.
thanks for the stay again beautiful home ❤️
amazing stay in a quiet, accessible location. will definitely book again in the future.
super convenient location, close to public transport. our room was nice and clean. stayed very briefly but andrew was a helpful and welcoming host!
perfect location close to penn station and msg! would stay here again!
place is nice if you’re out and about a lot but don’t expect a very private room, noise enters and exits as it pleases. great location otherwise.
julian& karen are so kind hosts. we met just julian in person, and he gave us all the information we needed. the apartment is clean, comfortable and useful for visit nyc.
rodrigo & cecilia were great hosts with a really comfy room. the room is private and has everything you need. the location is also great with easy access to the subway and buses.

linda was very nice. we arrived at midnight so she had told me everything to self check-in. she prepared a whole set for making tea because she knew we are from china. the decoration in her house was sweet as well. she had almost every daily life utilities ready for the guests. the last day our flight is at night so she let us to save the luggages in her place. the area is around chinese town which is very convenient for my mom since she has a chinese stomach. the bus stop is right in front so it s also convenient to go out anywhere.

good location in excellent position. i stayed in mary sue's flat for 15 days. the bedroom is comfortable, and she has been nice and collaborative. the bathroom is a bit old. to sum up i had a positive experience.
great place and great people. what more can you ask for?

this was a great space and very large! every room had huge windows with an excellent view of the bridge and manhattan. there was tons of comfortable seating and a huge dining room table. i would definitely stay here again in the future.
the address that was listed had the house number and street number switched around. once i found the place it was a very pleasant stay with nice roommates.

i have stayed in the same building before so i was very familiar with everything. it's an old building, classic nyc, so don't expect high-end modern features. having said that the kitchen and bathroom are modern and recently renovated. the location is amazing and a real plus. in 5 minutes you are in soho, little italy, nolita, chinatown etc… can't really get much better for the les experience. one downside is that you will be right next to a night club. expect noise in the evenings especially the weekends. if that doesn't bother you or you want to clubbing yourself it's perfect :)

gladys and bob’s is in a great location. easy walking distance to many eateries and the metro. also a safe neighborhood even at night. gladys provided cereal choices, milk, juice, fruit, coffee, croissants for breakfast-above and beyond my expectations. the only drawback for me was the entry into the backyard parking. it is very narrow. i have a subaru crosstrek and it was very tight. just make sure you fold your side mirrors in and go slow. in all fairness, i am a country girl, and if you are used to city parking you will have no problem.
professional host, i was able to check-in late at night. clean place, and very good location.

a month before arrival i added my daughter’s name to the reservation, instead of merely changing “anonymous guest 4” to her name. this triggered an $820 surcharge. when i messaged matthieu about it (four times), he ghosted me. airbandb asked him to reverse the charge and he refused. my mistake, but i was heavily charged for having more than 4 people on the reservation, even though we did not have more. when i booked, i had asked if my daughter and granddaughter could visit my husband and me for a few days and was told sure. nothing about surcharges for extra people (and again, we never had more than the 4 initially reserved). that said, the apartment is quite spacious, comfortable and well located. the rooftop is spare but has lovely views (the back yard is not accessible as photos might intimate). the area is very walkable, has good subways and is close to fort green park, restaurants and downtown. so despite the communication gap, we had a great stay.
great place and great location, would definitely stay again
very nice, clean and updated apartment. would definitely stay here again. devora was great!!
place looks exactly like the pictures . very clean , spacious , quiet neighborhood. the host were very polite & responded quickly. definitely would recommend !

overall we had a really nice stay at travis’s place. positives: - beautiful apartment with great kitchen appliances. - large bedroom with an incredibly comfortable bed, sheets and pillows. - heated bathroom tiles were such a nice touch. - travis was lovely, responsive and easy to communicate with. - close to the subway. things to consider: - the location felt a little misleading as tourists. we interpreted “15 minutes from manhattan” as close to main attractions, but most trips were realistically 35 mins–1 hour depending on where we were going and time of day. - the area was noisier than expected and often woken up by loud music, people outside and constant sirens. - while the neighbourhood had a wholesome local feel, it felt rougher around the edges compared to other parts of brooklyn i’ve stayed. - in hindsight, for the price, we probably would have stayed closer to williamsburg or manhattan, although the apartment size and amenities were great.

we spent 4 nights at thomas & terry's room and had a really great time! the room is spacious, well-equipped and a good place to relax after longs days of walking all over new york city. thomas and terry were friendly and flexible hosts, who made us feel welcome.

they were absolutely amazing hosts, any questions or slight issues (coffee maker) they were able to solve immediately!! beautiful apt highly recommend!!! location is amazing! i will truly miss this apt!! thanks for hosting me!

my partner and i had a wonderful time at this airbnb. the closest subway line was just a 5 minute walk away and walking distance to many bars and restaurants. the listing was also way more spacious than anticipated which was a nice bonus! the neighborhood also felt safe and was quiet at night to get great rest.

this was a great place to stay. there aren’t many walkable restaurant or shops in the area, but it’s very accessible to public transportation. the place itself is gorgeous - a rare gem in the city for sure. very thankful for a communicative host who let us keep our suitcases and sent suggestions.
comfy bed. rustic and tech savvy. ben was helpful

gio is an incredibly kind and flexible host, who is always available to help you with whatever you may need. he replied very quickly to our texts and made sure we were comfortable and had all we needed. location wise, this airbnb is awesome! it is very close to jfk so you can easily take an uber there. to manhattan you can take the bus to flushing and then the 7 train. the entire ride is around an hour long. the airbnb has everything you may need to be comfortable during your stay. we found both beds very nice and comfortable. i highly recommend this lovely place! i will make sure to book it in the future again.
beautiful apartment in chelsea located right near penn station. eric is a wonderful host and we loved our stay!
very nice and able to communicate asap. i thank them for the airbnb chance.
